name: ILYSB: ไอเลิฟยูโซแบด
review_1_text:
ILYSB: ไอเลิฟยูโซแบด
Among over 500 coffee houses in Chiangmai, ILYSB admittedly stood out very prominently in terms of coffee served, atmosphere and location. It was conveniently located only 7 kms or 14 mins from Chiangmai University on Chiangmai Outer Ring Road (Chonprathan Road) with ample parking spaces provided at the front and back of the shop. Its professional baristas served a special blend of Brazilian and local grown coffee that gave a uniquely smooth taste and mellow aroma into each cup of its coffee served which guests could experience right away upon stepping in the shop. High-ceiling glass windows added warm daylight onto its minimalistic ambiance which black and white dominated its design while a few quiet corners at its shop encouraged working privately with own laptops.

review_4_text: Their blueberry cheesecake was delicious. Drinks were good. Prices are good, normal range. The cafe is spacious with big parking lot. You can sit outdoors and enjoy the fish pond.
review_5_text:
A Hidden Gem for Coffee Lovers

This coffee shop has quickly become my favorite spot to relax and recharge. The prices are very reasonable, especially considering the peaceful and beautiful environment they offer.

The garden is absolutely lovely — filled with big trees that provide shade and a calming atmosphere. There’s a pond with fish that adds to the charm, and the sound of birds singing makes it feel like a peaceful escape from the city.

The staff here are always friendly and welcoming, which adds to the overall relaxing vibe. There’s also a big car park, so parking is never a problem. If you’re looking for a quiet place to enjoy your coffee and unwind, this is the perfect spot. Highly recommended!

the cafe was lil bit far away from the city but trust me it was worth it. they have parking too. also, to worth your trip, there's a second hand thrift shop around there (like 2-3 places with like 10-20 baht per pieces) if you interested too!

Such a lovely and heartwarming cat café! 🐾 The place has adopted 14  cats, all super friendly and playful.

There’s no entrance fee – just order at least one drink per person, and you get to enjoy your time with the cats. Drinks are nice, the staff is kind, and the cats bring so much joy. Highly recommended for cat lovers or anyone who wants a peaceful, happy place to relax.

The people spoke good English and we return ed 2 nights in a row. If your visiting Hoi Chi Minh I suggest visiting Cat Alley.

review_1_text: I've been here for a year now, and I still can't get used to Thai desserts; they are too sweet and cloying for me, and the taste is quite strange. The coffee here is milder compared to other coffee shops. I strongly do not recommend the Turkish coffee unless you are particularly fond of its unique flavor.
review_2_text:
Hot day and WFH day so we decided to take a motorbike ride to get some ice cream and pancakes.

Interesting shop !

The back of the shop is a tobacco factory which is still in operation.

F&B :
I had a dark chocolate with a cigar scented biscuit. Cant smell the cigar scent but can definitely taste it infused in the biscuit. Unique flavour profile !

Wife had ice cocoa less sugar . Not to thick and good to cool down in this heat.

Wife had a crepe suzette , very rich orange sauce taste , more like an orange marmalade. We were told it's made fresh that's why it took some time to make.

My green tea was served in an elegant squarish teapot with some faux jade. Pretty !

Service : very friendly and they speak English too.

Workshops : they have an upcoming workshop using gold leaf

Parking :
Kerbside.

review_5_text:
There is a small library called Aruna within that compound. The monthly membership fee is 250 Baht, which allows you to borrow books for the whole month.

There are nearly three thousand books of various types but mostely Myanmar language. The collection is comprehensive, including both non-fiction (knowledge) and fiction (entertainment), with a considerable number being reprints of rare books. While there are cartoons for children, the number of children's books is quite limited.

You can borrow two books at a time for a maximum of 14 days. You can also borrow and return books on the same day. Seating is available for reading inside. They also provide Burmese music cassette tapes and a cassette player. It gets a little hot during the daytime.

The library is open daily from 10 AM to 7 PM, but the librarian will sometimes close for a couple of hours if they have to go out for business.

It is known that the founder brought their personal collection of books to Chiang Mai for reading and then decided to arrange them so that others could read them too.

Their dishes are bold, flavorful, and perfectly suited to Thai palates, while the presentation adds a stylish and contemporary touch. The price range is reasonable, from 100฿ to 400฿ per dish, making it great value for the quality and experience.

The atmosphere is clean, fresh, and welcoming, making it an ideal spot for a family lunch or dinner. Whether you're dining with parents or bringing your kids along, the cozy setting ensures a delightful experience.

Keep in mind that the restaurant closes at 8:00 PM, so be sure to plan your visit accordingly. Highly recommended for anyone craving delicious Thai cuisine in a refined yet approachable setting!

This review sounds natural, inviting, and informative. Let me know if you’d like any tweaks!

name: SOLACE
review_1_text:
Coffee shop below co-working & meeting spaces.

Well made coffee and fresh ham & cheese bagel.

Attractive spirit house in the center of the parking lot.
review_2_text:
While traveling through East Asia, we kept running into the same problem. The coffee just wasn’t doing it for us. We love coffee, and after tasting it all over the world, our expectations are high. Then, in Northern Thailand, everything changed.

We were driving through Chiang Mai with no real plan when we noticed a small sign that simply said “Solace.” Something about it caught our eye, so we pulled in without thinking too much about it. That turned out to be one of the best stops of our trip.

The second we walked into Solace Café, we felt it. Not just the smell of fresh coffee, but a calm that made you slow down without trying. The space was bright and open, with sunlight coming in and soft music playing. It felt peaceful, welcoming, and honestly like exactly where we needed to be at that moment.

My girlfriend and I have always bonded over coffee. Over the years, we’ve made it a thing to search for great coffee wherever we travel. It started with Ethiopian Yirgacheffe, and after that first cup, we were hooked. Since then, every place we visit, we’re chasing that same feeling.

We’ve walked through coffee farms in Colombia, tasting beans roasted right there on the spot. Brazil surprised us with rich, chocolatey flavors that instantly made sense once you tasted them. Costa Rica gave us clean, bright cups grown high in the mountains. Italy taught us to appreciate a simple espresso done right. Turkey and Vietnam showed us completely different ways coffee can be enjoyed, and we loved that too.

Coffee, for us, isn’t just about caffeine. It’s tied to memories, places, and moments we’ll always remember.

Back at Solace, we took our time looking through the display. Freshly baked cakes, snacks, desserts, and fresh squeezed juices all looked incredible. You could tell nothing was rushed and everything was made with care.

I went with the blueberry cheesecake, and it was unreal. Smooth, creamy, not too heavy, with a buttery crust and just enough blueberry to balance it out. I paired it with a cappuccino, warm, rich, and comforting in the best way.

They also offer three coffee roasts, light, medium, and dark, so you can really choose what fits your mood.

We shared a Thai Harvest Energy Bar made with dried longan, toasted coconut, nuts, seeds, and a touch of honey. We also grabbed fresh squeezed juices and a ginger lemon shot, which was the perfect pick me up before heading back out into the city.

Some of the best travel moments happen when you don’t plan them. You just follow your instincts and see where you end up. Solace was one of those places for us, and it’s a stop we won’t forget.

review_5_text: Here is a wonderful and helpful place to enjoy a cup of herbal tea or coffee and have healthful desserts. What sets this Cafe apart is its innovative use of spirulina, a natural supplement that is higher in protein than beef and very high in antioxidants. The Green Cup has found ways to tastefully integrate spirulina into many of its recipes and even soaps and skin products. But it goes beyond food, beverages, and toiletries. In addition, the Green Cup has a strong allegiance to women's crafts. Not only does it sell locally made quilts and wall art, it also has a training center and collective where women can use their skills and learn new ones together. Some locations also have short-term apartments for rent. This is well worth any travelers' stop over to see what strong, independent, and creative Thai women can do with community support.

review_5_text:
Absolutely adore this utterly charming restaurant/coffee shop!

review_5_text:
Very neat wee coffee shop that's very easy to miss if you're not looking for it.

Nice riverside atmosphere, though it can get noisy with groups, so it’s not the best spot for focused work or meetings.

Prices are on the high side for the quality. The croffle was the biggest letdown; it wasn’t proofed properly, and the dough was undercooked, which left me feeling bloated.

Overall, unless you have a specific reason to visit, there are better options nearby with better food and value for the price.
review_4_text: Seems to open on Sundays. The coffee shop is on the 2nd floor, above the parking area. The staff are polite, the price is reasonable with good quality drinks. review_5_text: This is a really nice coffee shop at the recently opened Senior Wellness Center. The coffee is excellent, served by friendly staff in a relaxing atmosphere with views of the Ping River. They also have a selection of ice cream and bakery desserts.

review_1_text: A little disappointed they only serve you in plastic cups. Felt like the service was a bit out of sync with the venue. A good place to chill out for a day to work - two indoor spaces and one outdoor patio is available. Personally did not feel like the coffee felt a bit too flat for a latte, so I would probably opt for a non-coffee drink or espresso next time.
review_2_text:
The Arc Cafe in Chiang Mai is a spacious and visually appealing destination that caters to both food lovers and those seeking a beautiful backdrop for photos.

Ambience and Setting

Spaciousness the cafe is known for its ample space, but they have few comfortable seats few aren't if there are more than 10 couples you have to sit outside in the hot temperature

photogenic Corners: It boasts many corners designed for taking beautiful photos, including a swing seat. The overall design seems to lean towards a tropical style.

Atmosphere  a relaxed vibe
Food and Drink:
The cafe offers a variety of food options.

Pasta Carbonara The Pasta Carbonara is highlighted for its very creamy sauce.

Iced Latte The Iced Latte is praised for its strong coffee flavor and aroma.

Menu Variety Besides the mentioned items, the cafe also serves other beverages, baked goods, and potentially other dishes.

Additional Points from Online Sources:

Location: The cafe is located on the road along the railway, near Montfort College Secondary School.

Opening Hours: The cafe is open daily from morning until evening.

Features  both indoor and outdoor seating areas.

Surf Skate:  The Arc Cafe has a surf skate area.

Parking: Convenient parking is available.

review_4_text: As a inline freestyle slider in Chiang Mai, I recommend this place. It’s big enough and the area is smooth. They also can do vegetarian egg fried rice without onion and garlic
review_5_text: Not too far from the railway station. Lots of parking space. Good place to get some coffee and some cake early afternoon.

name: ฮิลล์คอฟฟ์ Hillkoff Learning Space
review_1_text:
We booked a Latte art 101 workshop a few days ago through Messenger. We had to pay half of the workshop (~7k TBH for 2 ppl) to secure our booking. All the process was smooth.
Today we had our training with the lovely Ticha. She was very kind, patient and cheerful. We really enjoyed the training (9-12 ; 13:15-16), and learned a lot. We truly appreciated the way she taught us: practicing with water, showing us first, helping us for the right gesture, recording us and then giving us detailed feedback with the video, step by step. It was really helpful!
Thanks again Ticha and all the best!
review_2_text: Had a wonderful training session by Kru Tica! Such a cheerful, helpful and patient teacher! Enjoyed the latte art lesson. Done tons of latte art! Would highly recommend this lesson with Kru Tica!
review_3_text:
Fun and knowledgeable staff — amazing coffee beans & tea selections! You can’t beat the price— and they grind the coffee for you.

Great experience.
review_4_text: The coffee is rich and tasty, and there are all kinds of coffee and tools. The prices here are very favorable.
review_5_text: Hands down nicest coffee supply shop in Chiang Mai and one of the only places to buy green coffee if you want to roast beans yourself. At least 20+ different varieties of coffee to choose from. I think they have the best prices on coffee beans as well. I can say enough good about this place. A must visit coffee shop and supply shop if your living or visiting Chiang Mai.

Staff's a bit panicky when you speak English but they can understand you if things are explained well. The shop, in general is clean. I highly recommend this shop.

review_5_text: The dog is cute. The owner is very friendly.

name: Over 8 café x ตึกส้ม
review_1_text: I eat kra pao with beef, the food is tasty and the staffs are friendly❤️ will visit next time again
review_2_text:
Orange Building's Krapao Platter. I usually order from Grab, but today I came down to the front of the shop to check it out.

The atmosphere is great, air-conditioned, and the shop is very cute, almost like a cafe. There are about five tables, each table can seat 4-5 people. Inside, it seems like a co-working space.

The shop has rice, tea, fresh coffee, and a wide selection of drinks.

The Krapao Platter is delicious. I've tried many dishes and they're all great. The portions are huge.

But today, I tried the Krapao Kai Omelet. It's a dish with Krapao and omelet inside. The omelet is fluffy and crispy, and delicious. I highly recommend it.
(You can choose the level of spiciness.)

The owner is very friendly and kind. The service is excellent. Please come and support us.
The shop is near Montfort School. You might have to make a U-turn to get here. If you don't want to make multiple U-turns, I recommend parking at Montfort and walking to get it. But there's parking in front of the shop.

Google reviews also say they have free fried chicken with jaew sauce. It's amazing!
It's so delicious and they give you a lot! 💕
They also have a promotion where you check in on Facebook and get 1 fried egg or 2 sausages. So many great promotions!
Highly recommended! 🤍🫶🏻
review_3_text: The shop is clean, the stir-fry is delicious, and there's air conditioning to keep you cool. The menu focuses on stir-fried basil, but there are also stir-fried dishes. The service is very friendly.
review_4_text: The food is delicious and the portions are generous. The owners are lovely.

review_1_text: Absolutely blown away by this place. If you want a few hours entertainment for the kids do not hesitate it’s amazing! Everything for all ages and it’s sparkling clean and new. Wow it’s amazing, my 5 year old even cried when we left!
review_2_text: This place is actually 2 separate buildings - one houses the paid play area (120thb/hr) and the other houses the cafe. Cafe has free wifi and a small play area that is free entry. Paid play area is clean and very well stocked with lots of variety suitable for toddlers/preschoolers as well, not just Lego for big kids. Cafe's free play area is less well maintained but still fun for the littles. Very quiet on a Monday midday timing.
review_3_text: Playtime with the most amazing Lego-Sets! Great for special-dates with your children. It’s not a toy-shop. You play for a certain time and you pay per hour. Great value!
review_4_text: This place is, to borrow an American idiom, “the greatest thing since sliced bread.” My wife bought 50 hours of play so our kids can play while she does lesson planning and other work. Our kids love being here. They love Legos and spend their money on them any chance they get. The great thing about this place is that the kids can have the satisfaction of building the Lego sets they want without having to buy them. Not to mention, the very helpful staff cleans everything up and/or stores the unfinished project for a later date. There are other toys available for various ages of kids, so toddlers up to teenagers (who like Legos) would enjoy this place. I’ve never ordered food from the cafe, but the cookies and drinks are good.
review_5_text: It's hard to get my boy to leave these many themed rooms of great inquisitive fun, so we end up staying for multiple hours.

review_5_text:
A small shop with a homey feel.
Nice music, good coffee.
*All the desserts are delicious, a must-try!

name: ร้านอาวเวอร์คอฟฟี่
review_1_text: I ordered thai milk tea (less sweet) and it actually was not that sweet at all. It had this creamy flavor which was great. Loved it! Would go back again for this milk tea.
review_3_text: A cozy and relaxing cafe with a friendly owner, great coffee, excellent service, and a wide variety of menu items. I loved it!
review_4_text: The staff provides good service, the parking lot is spacious and convenient, the coffee tastes good, and there's also a small meeting room available.
review_5_text: The owner provides excellent service and the cake is delicious.

review_2_text:
Delicious, eat often, never get bored
The owner is cute, kind and friendly.

Pearls, perfect size, friendly price

name: One'er cafe
review_1_text: Be engraved on memory........
review_2_text: Delicious tea

name: โมสาร์ท คอฟฟี่ เฮ้าส์
Molen Cabin
review_1_text:
Molen Cafe, but it's a board game cafe. They sell drinks, the air conditioning is nice and cool, and you can park right in front of the shop. It's a black and white building on the main road, convenient for a quick stop.

- Delicious Molen (traditional Thai noodle soup)
- Lots of games
- Great place to hang out and have fun with friends.

name: มิราเคิลคอฟฟี่
อนุบาล1คาเฟ่
Bake Me Home
review_1_text: The location of this cafe is perfect. Amidst the green and abundant vegetation, lies a cute coffee shop and bakery. I have personally found baked items that I rarely see anywhere else, and the quality is great too. This place is not at all expensive for the quantity and quality served. It is a little bit out of town, but definitely the place to be when you want to be in the quiet and have a peaceful time. Place has WiFi, friendly and helpful staff and is clean. Definitely recommend.
review_2_text: We went to the waterfall stop by the cafe, it’s next to the entrance of waterfall. We ordered the latte, but you can check the photo that it’s really common. My wife felt a little itchy because a lot of mosquitos there. So it was not a good experience. But we hear that there are some delicious bread there, maybe we will try it on the next time.
review_3_text: A humble cafe in a lush green setting. We stopped by for a quick drink and snack after a hike. The owner was lovely and suggested a few items to us. The garlic and cream cheese bun was delicious 😋 Such a lovely place, worth a visit.
review_4_text: Cute little bakery, stopped there on our way from the waterfalls (btw. almost no water there in Feb/March), if you like sour, you will love their iced lemon tea. The savoury pastry on the photo was also delicious!!
review_5_text: Excellent home made crossant, danish,... Good coffee and tea. Worth to drive up a little. In the mountain, surprising cafe in the nature.

name: Sweety berry
review_1_text: I've never seen it before.
review_2_text: What is this place? There is no information.

name: 99 Villa & Cafe
review_1_text:
visited the café with a friend and it was such a beautiful experience. The café is a bit far from the city center (around 5 km), but it’s absolutely worth the trip. The place is peaceful, charming, and surrounded by nature. At times, it felt like being in an Alice in Wonderland garden, with rabbits hopping around, ducks, and even pigs nearby.
There were very few people when we visited (day week around 4pm) which made the atmosphere even more special. It’s the perfect spot to disconnect, read, write, or simply relax, with the sound of the river flowing in the background.
The service was incredibly kind and attentive. We shared a two-tier basket of pastries with fruit. The portions are small, more like tasting samples, but the flavors were outstandin, delicate and absolutely delicious.

I forgot to ask for my cappuccino without sugar, and the staff was so kind that they prepared a new one for me without charging for the first cappuccino at all ❤. That gesture really stood out.

Overall, the place is beautiful, calm, and full of charm. I highly recommend visiting for the pastries and for a quiet, relaxing afternoon surrounded by nature.

Service and experience: 10/10.
review_2_text: The house's colors and the gardens made me feel like I'd stepped into Alice's Wonderland. The food portions were enormous, and the rabbits, ducks, geese, and piglets running around on the lawn—the harmonious coexistence of people and animals—made me feel completely at peace. It was a wonderful feeling!
review_3_text: Decoration and vibe are the best . You can chill with fine atmosphere and so cute to take pictures and they also have some kind of cute animals which is so nice with positive energy. One of my top three favorite cafe in CNX.
review_4_text:
Found this wonderful café while staying in Chiang Mai for a month.
As soon as you walk through the outside gate, you’ll know you’re in a unique place. It really feels like you just stepped into a story book.
There is a little stream outside with ducks and bunnies and the café even has its own pet pig.
We sat inside one of the air conditioned building and ordered a cake two smoothies which were huge btw. and looked more like art works rather than beverages.
Location, food, drinks and service was all outstanding.
Love this unique and beautiful establishment. 🫶👌
We will be back for sure.
review_5_text:
I understood now why people give high ratings.
All great 👍
Animals cute.
Stuffs are friendly,well take care.
Drinks are nice.
Definitely i will bring my fam back here.

name: Urban Cafe
review_1_text: Great coffee, rustic yet modern design, friendly boss, and a killer view!
review_2_text:
Do not chase.
Nice shady place.
review_3_text: Friendly and good taste, You can take your laptop and do your work in this cafe. (a lot of Thai computer graphic contributor here)
review_4_text: Lovely owner, great quiet place to work
review_5_text: Nature, silence and good taste

name: Tara Coffee Chiang Mai
review_1_text: Great little Thai coffee shop with fair prices and a cozy atmosphere. The coffee tastes good and feels carefully made, not rushed. A nice place to relax, catch up with friends, or just enjoy a quiet cup of coffee.
review_2_text:
1st of all, What a nice place and nice people working there. Pim and tung ting we're fabulous. Both very friendly and talkative, I think another review complained about the service and workers, but a friendly face usually is returned from another. This is Thailand and the land of Smiles.
We have eaten their several times during our stay and will go back again before the end of or trip. Everything is Clean, food is excellent and the staff is hard working and professional. Coffee choices and bakery was terrific.
See you soon Tara Cafe.
review_3_text: This is a wonderful coffee shop off the beaten path. They feature decent coffee and wonderful desserts, including many great cakes at very reasonable prices, about 50 baht per piece.   The service is quick and it is located right on the edge of a nice pond that you can look from above and enjoy your coffee and cake.
review_4_text: Cute small cafe with a lovely seating area facing a pond. I love the bar area that faces the water (indoor and outdoor feel). Unfortunately the coffee isn't that great given the numerous high quality coffee around here. We got a cappuccino which was very milky. Could have been a one off moment.
review_5_text:
Good location. All
Menu was yummy. Friendly staffs and cheap. Nice atmosphere. You can order Krapow Tad with choice of size. Bread and coffee also good quality and taste. Must try.

name: MAKUB.COFFEE
review_1_text:
This place is special. I have never had such a "favorite coffee spot" as this. The coffee is made with so much care, there's even a secret milk ratio recipe — which means you get the absolutely perfect hot latte.
Plus we could chat for hours with the cheerful, smart and interesting owners. 💛
review_2_text:
For any special techniques or megical reasons... They serve the best Hot Coffee latte.
(cow milk with half shot of dark roasted coffee)
review_3_text: The coffee is delicious and affordable. The owner is lovely and friendly, making you feel right at home 🫶🏻
review_4_text: Makub Coffee is a cozy, thoughtfully designed space serving quality brews and seasonal drinks. The minimalist interior and calm atmosphere make it a perfect spot to work, read, or simply relax. Friendly staff and solid espresso.
review_5_text: They have the loveliest cold cream americano - nicely balanced and very refreshing. A must try!

name: coffee shop Estuntr
review_1_text: The food was delicious, and the coffee was very fragrant and smooth.

name: O no chikara Teahouse
review_1_text:
Friendly staff and beautiful Japanese style garden.
Green tea of different kind was introduced to us patiently when we couldn't figure out their differences.
We enjoyed our morning green tea time there very much!
review_2_text:
Asked the staff for a cold whisk matcha with a nutty tone and went with one that had walnut notes. It was nice, though there was a slight bitterness at the end. Personally felt it was a bit pricey — but the hojicha totally delivered! So well-balanced and only 100 baht. Loved that one.
Sadly, most dessert dishes are sold out didnt have a chance to try.
review_3_text:
One of the best matcha usucha I tried recently!
There’s a really wide choice of matcha to choose from and the service is excellent.
They explain you flavours, aroma and tricks to do also matcha at home.
The ambiente is really cozy and in a Japanese style. I will definitely come back to try other matchas. Thank you again!
review_4_text: Very nice green tea (I order roasted green tea and macha latte, you could pick your own cup), delicious snacks, beauty setting and very nice staff. Don't miss it if you are a tea lover.
review_5_text: “This tea house is truly unique in a city filled with coffee shops. If you’re looking to try something new, I highly recommend coming here—you’ll definitely fall in love! I will be back to try more matcha for sure.”

name: Kumo Bake Uchi
review_1_text:
The cakes here are absolutely delicious!
I ordered the orange cake — the jam on top is a little sweet with a hint of tanginess, and the sponge itself has just the right level of sweetness. The balance of flavors is perfect.
I also tried the peach cheese milk tea, which was super refreshing. I asked for 25% sugar, and it turned out just right.
My friend got the coffee yuzu soda without specifying any sweetness level, but it still tasted great — very smooth and well-balanced.
Overall, both the cakes and drinks here are perfectly sweetened. Highly recommended!
review_2_text:
I love everything in Kumo Bake Uchi
One of the best Pure Matcha in Chiang Mai 💚💚 highly recommend
review_3_text:
The coffee shop has new zone for larger space. The price of bakery is reasonable and it's all home made.
I love having time here.
There are 2 house separate space between coffee shop zone and seating zone. If you want to find some coffeeshop for working I recommend to visit Kumo bake.
review_4_text:
a lovely japanese style cafe. I liked the matcha tea very much.
It would be better if the cafe uses porcelain instead of plastic cups
review_5_text:
Love this cafe atmosphere. The owner is very cute and kind, she’s good service.

Their cake and drink is good and the price is ok not too expensive

review_2_text: There aren't many tourists, so you can leisurely look at the menu, order a drink, take a few sips, and continue your journey.

review_4_text: I'll go try it then.
review_5_text: The Thai tea is delicious, living up to the brand name. The staff are polite, the atmosphere inside the shop is cool and comfortable, and there is convenient parking.

Have medium roasted and dark roasted from local.

The price is adorable ( 1$ per cup, 25 - 30 thb).

The owner can speak English.

Recommended for coffee lovers who wanna try good local coffee.
review_2_text: It is a very simple place but loaded with amazing coffee beans
review_3_text: Stopped at Cha B-Chu on the way to Wat U-Mong ( U-Mong Temple ).
review_4_text: Great little coffee place at the side of the road, owner speaks fair English and is nice and helpful, awesome coffee!
review_5_text: Great coffeplace. Not to mention cheap!

Oxygen Coffee Studio - Wildside
review_1_text:
Since arriving in Chiang Mai last November, I’ve explored dozens of cafes, but Oxygen Coffee Studio Wildside is truly in a league of its own.
The outdoor seating area is a sanctuary. It offers a nature-oriented atmosphere that brings a sense of calm and relaxed joy that is hard to find elsewhere. If you are looking for comfort and peace, this is the place to be.
The coffee quality is top-grade. I particularly enjoyed the "Thai brightness" of their standard beans—the flavor profile and texture are unique and sophisticated. It’s clear the baristas here are operating at another level. Whether you are a coffee connoisseur or just looking for a beautiful place to unwind, I cannot recommend this studio enough.
review_2_text: We had amazing lattes here, had to come back for more!
review_3_text: Very good
review_4_text: Everything is great, including the service, snacks, and drinks. The prices are affordable, not too expensive. You can work here, get free Wi-Fi, and enjoy a shady atmosphere. ❤️
review_5_text:
The drinks taste good and are reasonably priced.
The shop has a quiet and peaceful atmosphere, located in Wild Side. You can work comfortably all day, and there are cats too.

name: ร้าน พาสต้า คาเฟ่
OON Cafe
review_1_text: An underrated cozy café in a homestay. I’ve been here twice and absolutely love it.

name: Ohayo Gyoza & Cafe
review_1_text: Little gyoza restaurant just outside the city a great hidden gem for a delicious meal. The fried gyoza is crispy and full of flavor, and the pork katsu set was delicious —tender and perfectly fried. 😋 There’s small seating inside and the service was excellent. The food tasted so fresh and authentic. They also are on grab and food panda.
review_2_text: It's great! We came here very spontaneously and we're surprised with how delicious the food was. Very cheap as well
review_3_text:
Quaint little restaurant hidden away.
We ordered the medium size original gyozas, the pork tonkatsu with rice and extra kimchi.
Within 10 mins our order came out and it was absolutely delicious.
If you are a fan of gyoza they have the option to add cheese or spicy(mala).
Would come back again.
Price is really good for the amount of food you get.
review_4_text: The mala spicy and original dumplings are ok. Not crispy, more on the soft side. Mala had lots of spicy flakes so you will only taste the flakes. Bright, calm and cozy atmosphere. Nice staff.
review_5_text: Delicious restaurant and cafe. Excellent gyoza with options for spice or added cheese.

name: Starbucks Chiang Mai International Airport
review_1_text: The staff were so friendly and went out of their way to get me a seat . the woman serving me my coffee was so friendly and made such polite conversation with me  but didn't catch her name . my matcha and Americano were lovely and my banana cake was really nice . I have never met such friendly Starbucks workers there normally so grumpy
review_2_text:
On ground floor.
Food & service is okay.
review_3_text: Fast service and with available tables and chairs
review_4_text: Standard coffee shop good services and alot of drinks
review_5_text: Staff very rude!!!  Not even waste ur time in this coffee place special the evening staff.  1 little girl very rude.  Never again will go and pls pep don't try go there or buy something good staff looks like don't want to work or be there or even help clients.

name: Doi Chaang Cafe
review_1_text: Drinking coffee here has become my routine whenever I leave Chiang Mai. It’s consistently delicious. The staff service is smooth, and it’s just right in every way.
review_2_text:
Coffee is good and they are open early in the morning, but it is expensive.
Please note this cafe is located after security, you need to be a flying passenger to be able to access the cafe.
review_3_text: One of the best coffees in Chiang Mai , try the ice doi chaang coffee for the drink. It has a robust coffee taste and with a touch of sweetness is perfect. A must-try when you’re in Chiang Mai!
review_4_text: I ordered the mixed berry smoothie. I thought it had a great taste. It was not entirely ice. The barista did a good job. I've read through the other reviews, and I'm not sure what people expect. Food at an airport is always overpriced. For me, that's to be expected. Yes, it cost me 120 bhat, but I got what I wanted in an inconvenient place at an inconvenient time.
review_5_text: This outlet is horrible. The iced coffee is 80% Ice and 20% coffee. For 110 baht. You're better off at Amazon or even MacDonalds. I've been to other Doi Chang outlets in Thailand and it's not as poorly run as this.

name: Black Canyon ท่าอากาศยานเชียงใหม่ (Domestic Outside)
review_1_text: I initially ordered a vegetarian fried rice, however what was served contained chicken. I informed the waiter that we do not eat chicken and requested a vegetarian replacement. Unfortunately, instead of preparing a fresh dish, the same plate appeared to be returned with the chicken removed. Small pieces of chicken were still present in the meal. This raised concerns about food handling standards and attention to dietary requirements. While mistakes can happen, the response to the issue was disappointing. Other than that, the atmosphere was nice and less busy than downstairs. Food selection was good too and the staff members were friendly enough.
review_2_text: Located just at the entry to the checkpoint for international flights, nice place to sit around till the crowd clears and then clear the customs and security for your flight. Coffee and tea here are decent but nothing special. Decent place to get a drink to kill some time but that’s about it.
review_3_text:
Black Canyon at Chiang Mai Airport (Domestic Outside) is a convenient and comfortable spot to grab a bite before your flight. Located near Gate 3, it’s perfect for a quick stop to enjoy a meal. The menu offers a great variety of food, and everything I tried was delicious. The dishes are flavorful, satisfying, and definitely worth the price – a great value for airport dining.

I felt really happy with my visit here. The food quality is excellent, and the service was friendly and efficient. It’s an ideal place to relax and refuel before your journey, whether you're traveling for business or leisure. If you're at Chiang Mai Airport and looking for a tasty, affordable meal, I highly recommend Black Canyon. It will definitely make your wait more enjoyable and your day more flavorful
review_4_text: Airport coffee.  Blackcanyon coffee means a good consistently tasty cup of coffee.  Service is professional. Typically, quick and easy.  Comfortable seating inside the airport with free WiFi.  There is only 1 dark roast offered.  There is ample supply of snacks and yummy sweet treats. Price is fair
review_5_text: I had a very unpleasant experience buying coffee at the airport. The Thai staff was impatient during ordering and spoke negatively about customers right in front of us. This was very unprofessional and made me feel uncomfortable. I would not recommend buying coffee here.

name: Wake Up
review_1_text:
Best spot at Chiangmai International Airport! Open 24hrs, offering good coffee and many other beverages, various Snow (bingsu) options, light snacks, accompanied by a Subway counter, a delicious pizza place, AND a Thai cuisine counter.

Spacious, so much variety to suit different preferences, and wifi is available for customers too!

Departure, arrival, or just waiting to pick someone up at odd hours is so much better now.

Where else could we have had pizza, subway, and bingsu all at once at 23.00?
review_2_text: Terrible cafe', DON'T waste your money here
review_3_text: Moved to second floor in domestic building.
review_4_text: The reason I gave it a perfect score is because the food prices are the same as at other branches; there's no markup. The taste is also the same as other branches, with no reduction in quantity or quality. Overall, the restaurant is spacious, not crowded, and has Wi-Fi and power outlets like other branches. It was a little hot, I'm not sure why they didn't turn on the air conditioning, but it wasn't a problem; it was comfortable to sit there. There are other shops nearby, but the smells weren't strong, so it wasn't an issue. Overall, I like it because it's cheap! 555 //RYO
review_5_text:
The staff should be replaced. The one who was in charge on July 10, 2018, at 6:00 PM was chatting loudly and even screaming in the lobby. I don't know if the branch owner knows this or not. The male staff member didn't seem welcoming and didn't smile at all. He just wanted to sell, collect money, play games, and play on his phone. #Looks like he's not mature enough to work in service.
#ImprovementsNeededUrgent

name: Yes Coffee
review_1_text: Stopped here before boarding the flight. The food tasted decent but slightly over priced. I got the break eggs with bacon and a toast and Americano
review_2_text: Even in such a busy environment, they still maintained great quality and attentive service. I really appreciated the care and effort they put into what they do. It made the experience much better than expected.
review_3_text:
This new coffee shop in the Chiang Mai airport is really great.
They have all of the usual coffee drinks (hot and cold), matcha drinks, etc.
They have baked goods, sandwiches, and even full hot breakfast made to order.
We like that they have almond and soy milk as an option, too.
It’s a great addition to the International terminal.
review_4_text:
The small outlet in the domestic departure hall is conveniently located opposite one of the security screening points. I ordered their scrambled eggs with bacon and for my wife the chicken sausage with fried eggs. Both menus came with coffe and the taste was very good, real eggs and tasty bacon and sausages. The coffe here is excellent as always, and the service is very good by the attentive staff. I will definitely visit this shop whenever I fly domestic as it is a positive experience in the overcrowded airport.
Happy to have need your guest today. 😊 👏 🤗 😻
review_5_text: A coffee shop at Chiang Mai International Airport. The coffee was okay, and the service was quick!

name: Café Amazon สาขา 1191
review_1_text: I loved the waiting area, the coffee and matcha was delicious, the staff was super sweet and the A/C was awesome
review_3_text: It has always been my first choice to drink Thai tea and other drinks.
review_4_text: This is a chain of affordable coffee shops located inside Chiang Mai Airport. The coffee is slightly bitter, but the price is reasonable. On a hot day, an iced coffee (a large iced Americano is 80 baht) is very refreshing.
review_5_text: The shop is located in the airport, the air conditioning is cool and there are many customers. The price is about 5 baht higher than the branch outside. The drinks are delicious and up to the standard Cafe Amazon. There are seats, but there is no charging point. The staff are agile and quick, and the service is good.

name: Wawee Coffee CNX Airport
review_1_text: This cafe is located right in the domestic departure lounge at Chiang Mai Airport. I ordered a cappuccino, and it was okay. The service was quick. There are few seats, but it's not a problem since you can take your coffee back to the lounge.
review_2_text: A small coffe outlet with few seats. Its gets crowded when some travellers decide to stay and relax after they finish their coffee and drinks. Located just outside of the arrival hall, so its pretty easy to find. Coffee was really average for the price it charges. Food served was cold. Staffs seem to be impatient when taking our order. Will not revisit.
review_3_text: small cafe inside the airport. comfortable and nice. delicious coffee. helpful staff. green concept. encourage customers to use the plaster coffee cup as a flower pot
review_4_text:
Wawee Coffee is a decent coffee shop. It’s not exceptional, and certainly not up to par with many of the more local shops scattered around Chiang Mai, but it’s better than a place like Starbucks, McCafé or Dunkin’, so that’s what matters most, right?

We got a strawberry americano and a strawberry soda. Both were pretty good, but I prefer the orange coffees and lychee coffees other coffee shops offer. Wawee’s tasted a bit bitter to be honest. However, it’s probably the best coffee at CNX Airport, so if you’re here, Wawee Coffee is the place to go!

One positive was the fact that when you buy coffee, you can sit for 30-40 minutes in their lounge area, which is much more comfortable than the regular seating area outside the coffee shop. Honestly, I’d probably get Wawee again when I fly into the Chiang Mai airport!
review_5_text:
Awful awful awful. Had a hot chocolate.

There was no chocolate. It was not hot.

Literally like drinking warm water with no chocolate.

Waste of money. No refund. Prices are expensive for Thailand standard.

There are other coffee shops upstairs.

Places like this make Thailand and Thai people look bad.

name: PHUKHAO Cafe & Bar
review_1_text: This is a nice little cafe within the domestic waiting area at Chiang Mai airport.  The food is slightly expensive but not outrageous considering ‘airport prices’, and it is surprising tasty.  I had the Krapow Gai and was satisfied.   The drink selection is good.  They have beer and wine in addition to the obvious coffee and tea options.  They have a small sitting area and it you eat there they serve the food on proper plates with proper silverware, not plastic as some other places offer.
review_2_text:
Very good coffee!
They have oat milk
review_3_text: The coffee itself is very good, which is kinda rare in Thai airports, they have oat milk
review_4_text: Good quality coffee. They sell several quality true roasts as well.
review_5_text: Best coffee in Thailand

name: On Ground
review_1_text: Sweet potato bubble tea had no flavour apart from milk, just a strong purple colour, and the pearls were hard and chewy, not good at all.  Not sure how they got this so wrong.
review_2_text: They have a restaurant on the ground floor, so if you are close to gate 3, you have to take stairs down. They serve a surprisingly good Khao Soi with chicken. Probably the best thing you can get at this airport, if you are taking a domestic flight.
review_3_text: It's like they think you will not be back but as someone who flies monthly from CNX it is disappointing all the coffee is ordinary.
review_4_text: I ordered 1 mocha and 1 hot chocolate. Worst chocolate I have had in my life.  Can’t be that difficult to make it well.. I had to throw it on the bin straight away. The coffee was cold and tasted so so. Save your money.
review_5_text: I ordered a smoothie and got a slushy

name: Caffe Ritazza
review_1_text: Way better than the alternatives in the airport.
review_2_text: Another coffee shop that makes a decent coffee.
review_3_text: very delicious

name: WaWee Coffee หน้าเกท สนามบินเชียงใหม่
review_1_text: Rude and unprofessional staff. I was simply looking for a place to sit and enjoy a muffin while waiting for the check-in counter to open. First, a staff member asked me to move to another table. While I was in the process of switching, she started yelling at me to leave my bag outside the café. I had no issue placing my bag elsewhere, but the tone and behavior were completely unnecessary. That’s not an acceptable way to speak to a customer.
review_2_text: Good coffee and good price that’s acceptable at the airport
review_3_text: One of the worst experience. Super rude staff, scolding me because I was asking for a tissue. I mean you can tell it nicely but they were really unfriendly. I will not have any  wawee coffee anymore that's for sure.
review_4_text: No overcharge coffee. Close to the gate 7 6 5 . There is a (vert small but peaceful) dedicated place for tables and sit .
review_5_text: Staffs are talking loud behind the cashier with their phone speakers on. Wish they were more professional

name: ร้านกอล์ฟ & น้ำตาล Coffee BikeCNX!
review_1_text: Delicious drinks, a wide variety of menu items, friendly prices. Closed on Sundays 😁😁

name: PunThai Coffee
review_1_text: Finally I found out Punthai coffee in Chiang Mai where a ton of coffee shop both branded and local coffee. I'v got a free coffee for birthday month from PT maxx card. Recommended.
review_2_text: Great place to get gas at gas station, mini mart and have Cafe/snacks!
review_3_text: My favourite gas station coffee franchise. Great flavoured coffee served in a large cup with a glass of water on the side.
review_4_text: Impressive service, fast, delicious. Whenever I'm hungry for coffee, I have to stop by because it's close to the shop. (Last time I came, 18.11.68, the person taking the order had a very sullen face and didn't greet the customers at all. There were only 4-5 people at the counter. The service should be improved.)
review_5_text: A small shop with not many seats. The air conditioning is cool and comfortable. The drinks are strong. There are two lovely, friendly staff who are agile and quick.

name: Café Amazon สาขาเซ็นทรัลแอร์พอร์ต เชียงใหม่
review_1_text: Stupidest coffee experience I have had in Thailand in my 2 years here. I ordered a large hot cappuccino which took forever to make. When I finally get my order, I get a large cup which is only half full of cappuccino coffee. Then when I ask them to fill the cup, they add in some ice. Like really? Then when I tell them that's not what I wanted they act rude and unhelpful. I ask to replace the drink with a black coffee, which they begrudginly agree to do. Then again I get a large cup half full of black coffee. Why even serve in large cups if you can't fill them with coffee? I mean I understand about kreng jai but I'm not Thai so what the... I finally gave up arguing and just drank what they gave me. Maybe there was some issue with my limited Thai language skills, but there's too many other good coffee options in Thailand to deal with this nonsense chain ever again.
review_2_text: Customer service was unsatisfactory 😡😡😡😡😡we ordered 2 coffees and paid with Citi bank credit card, which we should have 10% off from purchase.  There were 3 staff for us, none of them aware or care about the promotion, and didn’t even bother to find out what we were asking for!!!  We had same purchase in other CAFE AMAZON, there’s only one staff for us and other 3 groups of customers, and she managed our drinks and payment correctly according to promotions of Café Amazon.  As we asked them why we couldn’t get 10% off, three staff went off to their mobile instead of taking care of our queries 🤯 I’m upset not only for 15 baht discount, but their attitude and ignorance!  Minus Star for rating!
review_3_text: The quality is not the same like in the other beaches...
review_4_text: All good!
review_5_text: Medium-sized shop with about 10 seats. The shop is beautiful. The staff are friendly and take orders quickly. The system is very good. The service is fast. The shop is clean and tidy. At this time, the glasses are cute with festive designs. There are many snacks to choose from.

name: THE VOLCANO Central Airport
review_1_text:
This restaurant situated in Central Plaza airport shopping mall. I have ordered a melon toast with cheese and a peach yogert mochi😳

They made the toast immediately as a result you have to spend around 10minutes to wait! The toast is incredibly amazing! I am so surprised that melon and cheese could be a perfect match inside a toast!!!!🥰 And the price is reasonable too, it costs 65 babt only😱😱

For the peach yogert mochi, it just so so, nothing special! I recommend you ordering a toast here instead of a mochi!
review_2_text: I will miss this franchise when I leave Chiang Mai
review_3_text: The outlet in Nimman is much better or may be it was just the fact that we were having The Volcano for the first time. So glad we stumbled across this
review_4_text: Less people in the morning
review_5_text: The taste remains consistently delicious. No matter which branch I pass by, I always stop to try and support them. The custard toast and Thai tea smoothie are the best!

name: ยอดชา​ คาเฟ่​ สาขาโฏโฮลเซลล์เชียงใหม่
review_1_text:
Hey guys, so I just had the best experience at this café! The staff here are super friendly and welcoming. When I came in, there was this guy and a lady working, and honestly, they were both so nice
anything I asked for, they were happy to help.

I actually first came here right after I landed in Chiang Mai
it’s called Yodcha , and it’s inside a mall just by Chiang Mai Airport. A couple of days ago, I tried one of the best teas I’ve ever had in Chiang Mai. It was this lemon tea, super refreshing. My friend got a hot latte and an iced latte, and both were amazing.

They also have this local specialty called ‘Chiang Mai Bread’ it’s basically toast, but it’s so good. And the ice cream? Sweet, creamy, and honestly, I think it might have coconut milk in it… not sure, but it was incredible.

So yeah, if I ever come back to Chiang Mai, I’m 100% coming back here. And I’m totally telling all my friends about this place!
review_2_text:
Some of the best iced tea I've ever had anywhere.

The Chiang Mai white flower iced tea even without any sugar has such an amazing natural sweetness.

My wife's pure matcha was also excellent.

We also got two very nice cups that we can use at the house.

Great quiet place to hang out if you are waiting for people at Central Plaza or the Airport.
review_3_text: No cash accepted. That’s so disappointing. What’s wrong with paying cash even though I told them no need to change. Amazon next door always welcome all kinds of customers with option to pay .
review_4_text:
Sunday, 3 PM

I usually order online. The tea is delicious. I recommend it to everyone I meet. When I arrived, I was very disappointed. Not with the tea, but with the staff.

- The customer stood at the counter and didn't pay attention. When I called to order tea, they looked upset and didn't say anything. Another person came to take my place. They were busy, standing in the wrong spot, or something. Could they just say, "Wait a minute," or something?

- When I ordered, they were silent. They didn't accept cash, and they abruptly said, "No cash accepted." They looked at me like someone using cash had a problem, even though it was government-issued.

- When they called for tea, they didn't call my name. They just said green tea. Who knows whose cup it was? They put it all down at the same time. Then the staff complained, "I want to get off work at 4:00, I want to go live my life."

- I wonder if the shop is forcing the staff to work overtime. Why are the staff complaining and not being attentive?

- The atmosphere is bad. The shop is hot. They're not as friendly as the staff.

I won't recommend this place to anyone again. It's a shame the tea is so good and fragrant.
review_5_text:
The atmosphere is great, the shop is nice and comfortable.
It's located inside the Go Wholesale mall.
There's hardly any crowding.

They have a wide variety of teas to choose from.
And there are promotions where you can buy a drink together or bring your own cup for a 5 baht discount, but these promotions can't be combined.

The tea taste is average.
The orange tea was a bit too sour (maybe because I ordered it less sweet).
The matcha latte was okay.
But I really liked the atmosphere and the cup design that doesn't require a straw.

name: Café Amazon Go Wholesale เชียงใหม่
review_1_text: There was an Indian waiter with a bad attitude
review_2_text: Delicious Strawberry Yogurt Frap. Slow store inside Go Wholesale. Clean.
review_3_text: Good Banana
review_4_text:
Please train your employees on manners.
They laugh at customers who come to buy things every day.
review_5_text:
The staff were unfriendly and placed items with extreme force.
They seemed uncaring.

name: Eternity-Specialty Coffee at Central Chiangmai Airport
review_1_text: We really love this coffee shop and will definitely keep coming back. Their cappuccino with dark roast and mocha with medium roast (with just a bit of sweetness) are spot on, creamy, velvety, and silky. The Basque burnt cheesecake is also amazing and honestly worth coming back for on its own. Such a perfect little spot.
review_2_text: Skip all the others in the mall, because this is the best. I ordered a flat white and it was spectacular. The menu had it listed under specialty coffees not sure why as im a kiwi and for us this is an everyday drink.  This one was anything but every day. Highly recommended.
review_3_text: Coffee is quite good, service staff could be more friendly. Place had been downsized tremendously, they are OUTSIDE Robinson on the 3rd floor. No glasses served for cocktail coffee, something U might want to note.
review_4_text:
High quality coffee made by careful baristas.

If you are at the Central Airport Plaza it's a great spot for a shopping break.
review_5_text: This is a great coffee shop at Central Chiangmai Airport shopping centre. The range of coffees was good and the medium cappuccino I tried was very good. Prices were reasonable city prices. Would try again.

name: Coffee World - Central Chiangmai (Common Area)
review_1_text: Nice location inside the mall. Very comfortable chairs.  Nice place to relax.  Coffee is ok.  Chocolate cake is on. Service is good.
review_2_text:
New location is open now on 1 floor
, coffee is nice , with many select choices.
review_3_text: Me and a partner had to work on some things for school. Since Starbucks only took card, we found this place who took cash. Got waffles that were good and had free wifi. This is the only time I recommend Coffee World over Starbucks.
review_4_text:
One of me favorite coffee place.
As expected, serve good fresh coffee and cake. Is one of the chain shop.
review_5_text: Good coffee, comfortable seating in an open area of Central Airport Plaza.  Shame that their free wi-fi didn't work; even the staff couldn't get it.

name: The Baristro at Central Chiangmai Airport
review_1_text:
Newly Opened & Worth a Visit!
The Baristro at Robinson Chiang Mai just opened and it’s already one of my favorite spots. The interior is modern and cozy, perfect for relaxing or working.

I had their signature iced coffee topped with whipped cream and espresso, beautifully layered and delicious. The menu also features great pastries and drinks.

If you’re nearby, definitely check it out. Stylish space, great coffee, and a chill vibe!
review_2_text:
One think what i dont understand, why i can't add cheese creme.

And why isn't the cheese cream available for separate purchase? That's the only reason I come here. Now I have to buy two drinks and add the cream to my cappuccino myself. Please consider this. Offering the cream separately would make things much easier.
review_3_text: I enjoyed their hot chocolate with latte art and their tiramisu was really good too. They’ll give you extra cane syrup if the hot chocolate isn’t sweet enough for you. Just an FYI, I went in a couple of times and the tiramisu was sold out, but they would usually have more after 12pm.
review_4_text: At coffee shop that resembles high quality in the states. Love the presentation, latte art and taste is great! Aesthetic as well!
review_5_text: Nice big coffee shop. Good for meeting a friend, coworking space. Good coffee and still spacious. Even when its full its not over crowded. One downside. The AC is often too cool and to much airflow.

name: On The Way Cafe Chiangmai อร่อยยันพวงมา@ Central Chiangmai Airport
Wawee Coffee
review_1_text: Lovely clean fine coffee shop, internet great friendly staff, relaxing to be there for young and older🙏🏼

name: กาแฟเย็นใจ Yenjai Coffee
review_1_text:
Do not support this shop and the owner, extremely disrespectful while yelling inappropriate things at my wife.

All we asked for the normal amount of bubbles with no tea and we would pay the normal price, his workers did it but when he saw what they did he lost it.

His workers are great and accommodating and service has been good the many times we have been but after this please do not support this business.
review_2_text: Terrible service. The owner is an extremely rude & angry Thai man. He even yelled at me in front of my two kids. I recommend getting coffee ANYWHERE other than this place. Absolutely horrible experience.
review_3_text: Nice little tea & coffee spot. Quick service, unpretentious.
review_4_text: Hot latte was surprisingly good and inexpensive.
review_5_text:
Robinson Chiang Mai Airport has a "Kad Muang" (city market) which houses the Yenjai Coffee shop ☕️. They offer a diverse menu including coconut coffee, hot coffee, iced coffee 🥤, and honey coffee 🍯. The shop is conveniently located and easy to find, with friendly prices and high-quality drinks.
Customers can sit and relax at the shop, but please don't stay too long due to limited space, to ensure a smooth customer turnover.
🍶🧉🧋

name: kafae inn
review_1_text: Cool. They have great matcha!

name: Caramellow Cafe
review_1_text:
I love their coffee and the cozy, relaxing atmosphere. There are so many unique coffees to enjoy. One of my favorites is the coconut milk one. So good!
We also got an almond croissant, and it was delicious. We ordered the truffle soup, and it was slightly disappointing, but my kids still liked it.
review_2_text:
Caramellow Cafe in Chiang Mai is a charming gem with a near-perfect rating & consistently ranking among the city's top cafes.
The vibe is cozy and whimsical—lush greenery, pastel decor, and plenty of photogenic spots that make it feel like a relaxing escape, ideal for brunch or remote work (strong WiFi and outlets available).
Menu highlights include fresh, homemade dishes using local ingredients (no MSG or artificial additives): all-day brunch, artisanal pastries, signature drinks, and standout desserts.
Staff are friendly and attentive, prices are fair, and it's conveniently located near the airport.
Highly recommended for a delightful, feel-good experience in Chiang Mai!
review_3_text:
Awesometastic Cafe!
We stopped by at Thai cafe before heading off to the airport.

We got the eggBenedict and the Thai traditional pork basil with rice on top with fried egg.

Chocolate banana smoothies is a must and don’t forget the Matcha charcoal cream-pied pastries.

Windy breezy vibes outside, we sat for many hours enjoying our lovely tjme in Chiangmai.
review_4_text: I would recommend the bakery items, but definitely not the food. I ordered two types of steak, and the texture was terrible—it felt like chewing on wet cardboard. The starters were also very disappointing. It is common sense to serve starters before the main course. I ordered the mains just a minute before the starters, yet the server acted as if it’s only natural for the mains to come out first. Their attitude was quite baffling and unprofessional
review_5_text: I walked 1.5km from airport. Quite a nice cafe.  Cake, drink and brunch are fantastic. Variaty of food to choose from. Outdoor area also nice with a lot of greenery

name: KOBION CAFE
review_1_text:
I have been to Kobion café couple of times for a cup of coffee but this time I tried their food as well.

This place is a calm oasis tucked away from the bustling main street making it the perfect spot to work or read. Its modern, tastefully decorated space creates an instantly peaceful and welcoming atmosphere. The coffee is expertly crafted and delicious, the concise food menu offers fresh, Thai food, and the genuinely friendly service completes the experience. It’s the ideal spot for a serene escape with a perfect cup in hand.

The staff is friendly and  attentive without being intrusive, allowing the calm atmosphere to remain undisturbed.
review_2_text: The environment at Kobion is super calm and cozy, the interior is super aesthetic as well. I ordered a mango smoothie and it’s got to be one of the best mango smoothie’s I’ve had so far. The service here is also amazing as the staff are kind, patient, and polite. Would highly recommend.
review_3_text: How amazing is this?!! 45 THB for a delicious Dark Roast Espresso that is full bodied, velvety and full of passion as it caresses Your tongue, like something from a dream ❤️ Thank You Kobion Cafe' 🙏❤️
review_4_text: Ambience is good: coffee is just soso. But not expensive. Chill cool n good place to work if u wants
review_5_text: Comfortable seating.  Coffee is good.  French fries were very tasty.  Easy parking.

name: INU COFFEE
review_1_text: Small and friendly cafe. Was greeted by a warm barista and got a hazelnut latte for only 45baht! Not a great deal of sitting space and no wifi for those looking to surf and chill. Early morning at 7am was nice and calm.
review_2_text: Cute, off the highway coffee shop. Very friendly and kind service. Great place and price for a cappuccino. The milk was very nice and the coffee had a great taste.
review_3_text: A small coffee shop with delicious coffee and a variety of roast levels. The prices are very affordable. The seating area may be a bit small, but it's not uncomfortable. You can sit comfortably for a while. There is parking available.
review_4_text: This tiny little shop is soooo good, the barista working was so kind in wiping down the outdoor seating and making such amazing drinks. We’ll definitely be back when in Chiang Mai.
review_5_text: Probably the best coffee I had in Chiang Mai was purchased from this coffee shop,, and for just 40B what a bargain. As a point of comparison Starbucks charged me 125B for a small latte at the Central shopping centre down the road which was horrid.

name: Underbridge coffee
review_1_text: I went to this coffee shop recently for afternoon coffee. It is a nice place to have a coffee and relax but the unfriendly staff (a lady) with very poor customer service make you feel like you are getting a coffee for free. The price of cappuccino was above average price in Chiang Mai city. I was happy to leave the place as soon as possible.
review_2_text: Came for an early morning coffee, price of a latte is 70 baht (large size latte BTW) ambience is nice but staff not friendly.
review_3_text: Freshly ground coffee, and delicious pastries heated at the moment. Americano coffee with a bit of milk is so tasty. Overall, cozy little coffee shop.
review_4_text: Cozy vibes, food, coffee and services are perfect. One of the best in Chiangmai
review_5_text: Very distinctive and cozy space. Coffee and snacks are very good. Recommended!!!

name: นมโต คาเฟ่
review_1_text: Very good 👍
review_2_text: OK.
review_3_text: The food is delicious. I really like the green tea menu. It's not astringent at all. The price is very good for every menu.
review_4_text: Delicious drinks and food at affordable prices. This is the place to go! 👍🏻😍💕
review_5_text: This is my favorite delivery restaurant. They have everything from savory dishes to desserts. Highly recommended!

name: Rilak Cafe ลิลัค คาเฟ่
review_1_text: We visited with friends and had an excellent meal. The spaghetti was perfectly cooked exactly as the Italians do. We will certainly visit again next time we are in Thailand.  They also make the best cakes in Chiang Mai!
review_2_text: My friends and I visited Chiang Mai over the weekend and made time to visit this place twice because of its delicious food, cozy atmosphere, and extremely kind owners! Highly recommend!
review_3_text:
Our favourite cafe near Airport Mall!
Rilak Cafe is a hidden gem along Soi Chom Chan. The food is always delicious, reasonably priced, and served in a cosy setting with a lovely European touch. The warm, family-owned team is super friendly, and their homemade cakes are a real treat! We've come here many times as a family and with friends—it's our go-to spot whenever we're in the area. We much prefer this relaxing spot over the usual mall cafes. It just feels more personal and inviting.
review_4_text: This place is awesome! It’s in a secluded little alley; super quiet and peaceful. The atmosphere is very homey and the owners might be the sweetest people I’ve ever met. The food is also delicious. Highly recommend!
review_5_text: A pretty little cafe with great cakes . Staff are friendly and helpful.  Recommend a visit.

name: ชาพะยอม ซอยชมจันทร์(ศูนย์เชียงใหม่)
review_1_text: The female employee acted like she didn't want to sell. When I ordered something, there was no response. It was like she just got up and did it as if she was asking for it. I've come many times and encountered this female employee many times with this kind of terrible service. The first time, I thought she was upset from somewhere else or something. But the 2nd, 3rd, and 4th time, I encountered the same thing again. The service was not welcoming to customers and she had a terrible expression. However, if I'm lucky some days, I'll meet a male employee who provides good service and speaks well and asks what I want. I'd like that female employee to improve her service and sales to customers a little. We go to buy, we pay, not treat customers like they're asking for free food.
review_2_text: A variety of drink menus at affordable prices
review_3_text: Chill and relax

name: ฟรุ๊ต ไอเดีย น้ำผลไม้ปั่น ชา&กาแฟสด
review_1_text:
This is another small shop with great quality.
I was impressed with every drink. The prices are incredibly good!
I wish this shop had more reviews.🥹🫶🏻

name: Café Amazon
review_1_text: Mostly located every PTT gas station one of my favorite coffee shops in Thailand, they have standard and almost same coffee taste in every location , good strong tasty coffee. Reasonable prices .  Coffee Amazon is my always first  choice.
review_2_text: As expected, Amazon has a good consistency with it's menu, looks and taste, so you can always order your favourite drinks, this one has nice amount of greenery to look at too, it is little bit hidden in the corner of the gas station tho.
review_3_text: Came here for online meetings while in Thailand. Very consistent service from all Cafe Amazons in Thailand.
review_4_text: Every day at 6a. Great coffee and environment for starting the day! The people are great!
review_5_text: Disappointing, limited range of not very attractive sandwiches etc

name: Roastniyom Coffee - ปั๊มน้ำมันบางจาก มหิดล
review_1_text: Nice coffee brand of Chiangmai and nearby! Fresh and clean cafe with good atmosphere. Drinks are in medium price, not too cheap and not too much expensive.
review_2_text: Great coffee! The pastries are nice and the drink selection is so good - recommend !
review_3_text: Coffee here are always soo nice!!
review_4_text: Ok but a little bit too small...
review_5_text: Fairly place and price

name: Fuel Coffee สาขา มหิดล
review_1_text: There are a lot of coffee shops in Chiang Mai, but this is a hidden gem. The kids that work here are just wonderful. A coffee is Excellent, But moreover, it’s the best people that work here. They really make it a wonderful experience.
review_2_text: Great coffee shop. Friendly and professional staff. Cool and relaxing vibe. The coffee is excellent too 👌🏻 😄
review_3_text: Best coffee ever would definitely come again.
review_4_text: I was a little surprised when they said 60 baht for a cappuccino in a gas station parking lot, but as I walked away drinking said cappuccino, I was blown away by the flavor and creaminess. IT WAS SO GOOD! Worth 60 baht.
review_5_text: Nice, although small, place for coffee, tea, or a smoothie. Internet speed is good but the hours kinda suck (closes at 5!).

name: Fulfill Coffee Bar
review_1_text: great coffee great music.
review_2_text: Good music  great coffee

name: สุข-ขิต คาเฟ่
review_1_text: The coffee is really delicious, no complaints, and the price is not expensive.

name: กาแฟมิลค์คัพ Kafae Milk Cup
review_1_text: It's a coffee shop that also serves drinks and Thai desserts. It's next to a really delicious Tom Yum noodle shop. The atmosphere is nice, with spacious seating, a cute little garden, and convenient parking.
review_2_text:
The green tea is so delicious! It's fragrant, sweet, and creamy. I love it! ♥
The Thai desserts are also very tasty. They're not too sweet, and they're only 7 baht each.
I've never even heard of some of them, but this shop has them! Hahahahaha!
review_3_text: The shop is beautiful both inside and out. They sell cakes and Thai desserts by the slice, and the coffee is good.
review_4_text: The desserts were arranged beautifully and looked delicious, and there was also a photo corner.
review_5_text:
The shop is next to a noodle shop.
The walls are beautiful.
The coffee is delicious.

name: Branches and Vine
review_1_text: A great small local coffee shop which you can selected coffee beans from normal to special

name: HOP Chafe สาขาถ.มหิดล
Moon light flower
review_1_text: Very good latte 👍 good price 👍 little cafe next to the garage with good ambiance.  support this small business.
review_2_text: The fresh coffee is very delicious. The service is good. The owner is lovely.
review_3_text: The green tea is delicious. The seller is very nice and helpful.
review_4_text: It's a small roadside coffee shop, but they make delicious coffee. The owner is lovely.
review_5_text: The matcha from this shop is really good. I really like it. Pinned this as my favorite shop.☺️🥰

name: เอื้องเหนือกาแฟสด
review_1_text: The best coffee I've had in Chiang Mai. At a very good price  👌
review_2_text: Wow
review_3_text: The cappuccino is delicious, with amazing, soft, and creamy milk foam. The price is also reasonable considering the high-quality ingredients; it's definitely worth it.
review_4_text: So delicious! Today I tried a new menu item, Matcha Chocolate, not too sweet, and I really like it! 💖
review_5_text: I highly recommend the taro milk tea!! It's delicious. The cha thai is also worth trying. Kai Muk is free♡ The owner is friendly, and the drinks are cheap at around 30 baht😍

name: Minimali Cafe
review_1_text: Delicious coffee, delicious tea, delicious drinks
review_2_text: Cute shop

name: Chakuma Tea : ชานมไข่มุกไต้หวัน สาขาสีแยกสนามบินเชียงใหม่
review_1_text: Taiwanese bubble milk tea is very fragrant and delicious. It is worth the price, only 19 baht. Add pearls for another 5 baht. There are many other beverage menus to choose from.
review_2_text: The Mala sauce with the cat carrying a chili pepper logo is really delicious! It can be used in a variety of dishes, especially grilled food – it's fantastic!
review_3_text: Delicious and inexpensive, this is the place to go.
review_4_text: Very delicious, can be used in many dishes. Buying it to keep at home is very worthwhile.
review_5_text: Can make many different menus, delicious taste, can also be made into a side job.

name: Rich D' Cafe
review_1_text: If you want to know how great this place is, you have to experience it yourself. Words can't describe it. The food is amazing, the atmosphere is perfect, it's incredibly relaxing.
review_2_text: Fresh coffee, delicious, fragrant, the taste of coffee lovers

name: The Coffee Leaf
review_1_text: The Coffee Leaf is a café that feels like a “reset space” for working professionals and those seeking a slower pace of life. The interior is airy, spacious, and well-organized, making every corner functional without feeling cramped. The coffee is distinguished by its aroma and smoothness, with a clean, easy-to-drink taste that clearly retains the unique characteristics of the beans. review_2_text: The cafe has a great atmosphere, perfect for relaxing and enjoying a cup of coffee.

name: Brekkie Rolls
review_1_text: The atmosphere is relaxed and not chaotic. It is a small homemade cafe, delicious food, coffee is okay. It is an outdoor seat, but these days in Chiang Mai, the weather is not very hot. There are cute cats. If you are around here, I recommend coming.
review_2_text:
Brekkie Rolls is a lovely little spot.
Both savory and sweet dishes are freshly made, well balanced, and easy to enjoy.
Cozy, relaxed atmosphere — a nice place to sit and chill. Definitely recommended 🤍
review_3_text:
If you’re looking for homemade food, delicious pastries, and good coffee, I’d definitely recommend this place! There are fans provided, and it’s not too hot since the tables are surrounded by trees. The owners are incredibly friendly, helpful, and polite — and most importantly, they speak English 👍.

Don’t forget to bring cash or be ready to pay via QR code. I really enjoyed the cozy, homey vibe of this café, and I’ll definitely visit Brekkie Rolls again when I come back to Chiang Mai in the future. ✨💛
review_4_text:
Brekkie Rolls is an all around fantastic spot that nails every aspect of the experience. The food was delicious and clearly made with care and quality ingredients. Everything I ordered was fresh, well prepared, and full of flavor. It is the kind of place where you can tell the kitchen takes pride in what they put out, and it shows in every bite.
The service was excellent as well. The staff was super friendly, attentive, and made sure everything was taken care of without you having to ask. It is always a pleasure to visit a place where the team genuinely seems to enjoy what they do and treats every customer with a warm and welcoming attitude.
A lovely bonus is the cats hanging around the place. They are friendly and add a charming and relaxing touch to the whole atmosphere. If you enjoy the company of cats while having your meal, this is definitely a spot you will appreciate.
One thing that might sound like a small detail but honestly makes a big difference is the toilets. They were spotlessly clean and well maintained, which is something I always notice and appreciate. It says a lot about how a place is run when even the restrooms are kept in great condition. It shows that the owners care about the overall experience and not just what ends up on your plate.
If you are in Chiang Mai and looking for a place that combines great food, wonderful service, cute cats, and a clean and well kept environment, Brekkie Rolls checks every single box. Highly recommended and I would happily come back anytime.​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​
review_5_text: New cafe and coffee. Good vibe and delicious Shio-pan with the fantastic smell of they premium butter. Pair really well with coffee. Lovely patio. Worth to try!

name: The Great Escake
review_1_text:
A real French pastry by a real French pâtissier.
I ordered 2 espresso, chouquettes, and financiers. I enjoyed this place.

Everything was delicious! I will come back for sure 😋❤️
review_2_text: A pleasant surprise. A coffee bakery in a village. Quiet perfect for work. Good coffee . Does sandwiches n bakery too.
review_3_text: The best French bakeries in town! Nice coffee and friendly service 👏
review_4_text: Ho...ly...cow! This is likely the best pastry shop in the entire city. The chef here is a trained pastry chef and it shows. Our genuine French friend said this is top tier stuff worthy of a real Parisian’s praise and he wasn’t lying. Chef’s kiss after each bite. The owner is sweet too: we ordered two croissants and they could only give one (these delicious morsels were nearly sold out) so she gave us her best selling sweet for the price of a croissant! This level of decadence isn’t cheap (70-150 Baht or so) but it is 100% worth it.

name: เนี๊ยะงัยกาแฟโบราณ
Light Beverage and MORE
review_1_text:
Cocoa Latte 70 ฿ (2026)

Has English menu.

A hidden gem!!

Just look at the view, and the greens in the cafe, they are so relaxing and beautiful.

The owner/staff very friendly and smiling. It gives good vibe.

There are many different types of seating and the design is very good as not cramp so it won’t get noisy.

And the Ping river is the main protagonist, peaceful, calm, murky.

And the sun, best supporting actor of all time, shining thru the trees on my seat, on the river, making it glistening from time to time.

And best cameo goes to occasional boat passing by, making ripples, just like witnessing time passing in slow motion and dance right in front of my eyes.

I stare at it for the longest time, while enjoying my coffee, didn’t realize time passing in un relative sense.

I had my AirPod on, with Debussy playing for me, this could be one of the best moment that I need to remember how wonderful to be alive.

I am just another ordinary human, quietly living, but I awed at my blessing, the beauty of my surroundings.

The feeling is wonderful.

And I wish you could feel that too.
review_2_text:
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

Such a cozy and peaceful coffee shop by the river.

Beautiful greenery, wooden deck seating and a very relaxing atmosphere.

Perfect place to slow down, enjoy a coffee and unwind.
