name: Art Eat Drink at Pongnoi ชมศิลป์ กิน ดื่ม ณ โป่งน้อย
review_1_text:
Food are great here! Khaosoi soup is delightful and not overpriced 🤩 Additionally you can enjoy the arts while waiting for foods, even though I don’t have the sense of art mind it can still widen my experience.

Please try here if you have a chance!
review_2_text: A quiet, uncrowded place. When we arrived, pleasant music was playing, and the owner invited us to stroll around the exhibition while we waited for our order. The pumpkin soup was delicious, and the curry also had a rich, spicy flavor. Thank you for the atmosphere, and I wish this place continued prosperity.
review_3_text: This is one of my favorite spots in Pong Noi. Have kept it to myself for a while but now it’s time to share 😉 Great menu with a wide variety, all of which they execute perfectly. Prices are ridiculously low for the quality of food and ambiance you get. Secluded garden area to dine in and an art gallery with a steady rotation of exhibits and showcases. Staff is fantastic. Owner is very cool. Every time I am here it’s lovely. Could not recommend more.
review_4_text: What a wonderful, wonderful restaurant! The food is incredibly fresh and natural, prepared to perfection and served beautifully. The spring rolls were easily the best we've ever had, as were the thick, flakey roti, but the pumpkin soup and tonkatsi khao soi are at another level - subtle, complex and revealing more and more flavor with each bite. Any 1000-baht-a-plate Chiang Mai restaurant would be proud to serve food like this, but somehow Pongoi's prices are as low as any local place. Highest recommendation!
review_5_text:
We came from Baan Kang Wat and saw this restaurant on google maps so we decided to come. The place is beautiful and we were the only customers there so we had the place to ourselves which was a very nice experience.

Their food is amazing too! We got green curry with pita and beef khao soi for a good price.

Loved everything about the place. Cute cat and doggy.

name: Huan Kaew Coffee
review_1_text: A beautiful place with lots of dolls and figurines. Behind the restaurant, there’s a large garden that feels like stepping into a Hayao Miyazaki fairy tale. The decorations are gorgeous, and the food is also very delicious.
review_2_text: Coffee is nice, quiet atmosphere. The food is good too.
review_3_text: Yummy! I love pad kra prao here so much! Whenever I came to these areas, this’s the must location to visit for having the nicest food with friendly prices.
review_4_text: Family run the business. Food is great and price is great as well. Nice and peaceful garden area to eat. I highly recommend this restaurant.
review_5_text: Chill ambiance and delicious food

name: More Craft
review_1_text:
This coffee shop serves really good quality coffee! The owner is super friendly and genuinely passionate about the craft, and it shows in every cup.

They also offer non-caffeine drinks, including matcha sourced from Chiang Rai.
review_2_text:
This is not just another coffee shop.

It's a wholesome place which reflects the owner's joy of serving people. He is a happy man happy to serve you.
I watch him make each drink with the same level of focus, never multitasking or doing too fast- measuring each time so it's the perfect balance.

The coffee is very good! Great Quality beans are used - you can get medium or dark.

The iced matcha is so smooth and dreamy. Not bitter, not grainy. You can choose Japanese matcha for the better experience!

If you want it a certain way feel free to ask him, his English is great.

Outside oat milk option available.

Mr Ko is amazing.
I end up spending hours here.
review_3_text:
This is a little hidden gem….worth a stop off as the coffee is considered, very tasty and a great price!

The staff are warm, kind and generous! A really great coffee shop and what Chiang Mai is all about :)
review_4_text: A hidden gem making truly excellent espresso. When you drive by you might just assume this is any other standard coffee shop but it’s more than that. The owner is really passionate about finding delicious local beans and pulls a truly excellent shot of espresso. It’s a great place to try if you want to get a taste of the beans that are grown and roasted around Chiang Mai. The owner speaks English so if you’re serious about coffee just let him know and he’ll tell you what beans he has available and what will suit your taste preferences. They also have a nice selection of Matcha as well, if that’s your cup of tea! Definitely give this place a try!
review_5_text: Wonderful coffee shop. Delicious coffee made with local beans and a really friendly owner - made my day :)

name: สุขภิรมย์ Coffee
review_1_text: Best coffee ever. Delicious and you can order a range of different milks for a low price. I love my coffee lady 😄😍
review_2_text: Good Taste. 👌🏻
review_3_text:
Sukphirom Coffee: My Daily Coffee, the Perfect Start to a Great Morning
For me, Sukphirom Coffee is more than just a coffee shop; it's like the perfect starting point for a great workday! It's become my go-to spot for coffee almost every morning because their coffee provides the perfect energy for work.
What I love about this shop:
Consistent aroma and quality: The coffee here is consistently aromatic, fresh, and has a perfectly balanced taste every day. No matter what I order, I'm never disappointed.
Full of energy: Sipping my favorite coffee in the morning helps me feel refreshed and focused, ready to tackle work all day long.
Affordable price: Although the coffee quality is comparable to famous cafes, the price here is very reasonable, making it affordable to drink every day without worrying about the cost.
In summary: If you're looking for a high-quality coffee shop with delicious coffee at a friendly price, and want coffee to help energize you every day, I highly recommend Sukphirom Coffee!
review_4_text:
Fresh, fragrant coffee.
The vendor is patient and the coffee tastes good.
Recommended: Opposite the Wat Pong Noi gate.
review_5_text: Thai tea is very delicious and the price is good too 👍🏼

name: 23 coffee
review_1_text: Pin this shop! Delicious food and reasonable prices. Coffee menu has a choice of light, medium, and dark roasts. Matcha is also delicious. 👍👍
review_2_text: This is a small coffee shop with delicious food and quality that exceeds its price. I recommend the matcha latte. It's not too sweet and very delicious. 👍🏻
review_3_text: Excellent service! The Thai tea was delicious 👍🏻👍🏻
review_4_text: The iced tea is very fragrant and delicious.
review_5_text: It tastes delicious!

name: กาแฟสดสังคม
Coff-Cac : คอฟแคต
review_1_text:
The coffee tastes great and is very aromatic, so much so that I had to go back for more. Plus, it's not too expensive, making it great value for money.

The shop might not be ideal for sitting and enjoying your coffee, but if you love delicious coffee, you have to come!!!

I only recommend the coffee. I also ordered Milo, but it wasn't good. It was very bland and lacked flavor and aroma. I think they should add more Milo powder to make it stronger.
review_2_text: This coffee shop, which includes the owner's home, is run by adorable twin sisters 👶. The owner speaks English and I learned that most Thais prefer dark roast coffee beans, while the younger generation is starting to embrace light roasts. The beans in the shop are carefully selected by the owner and are very delicious!
review_3_text: The coffee is good. It's located on the main road and has parking.

name: ENOUGH FOR LIFE
review_1_text: We were quite disappointed with the drinks. Both the vanilla and cocoa lattes were average but at a very high price. The cocoa was literally Meiji milk with store-bought cocoa but it costs B100. The prices are premium, but the quality it not. The space is cute, but there are thousands of cute coffee places in Chiang Mai with better drinks.
review_2_text: Charming place with plenty of homeware for you to shop. There’s also a cafe space for you to chill. Walking distance from baan kang wat so would recommend you to come when you’re visiting the area
review_3_text: Very picturesque and whimsical cafe. The Passionfruit Ade is one of my favorite drinks ever.
review_4_text: 100% worth the visit. One of the most beautiful shops in Chiang Mai. The cafe seating outdoors and indoors is impeccably stylish. Spacious and calm, the perfect place to relax. The iced latte and mango smoothie were both made with care.
review_5_text:
I will give here a 8/10.
ENOUGH FOR LIFE not only decent cafe shop that is trending online, their beverage and service also nice!
We ordered four beverage, personally really recommend the strawberry cream one.
I usually don’t eat the cream but this cream was so fluffy, really amazing! And the strawberry jam not only the jam also can eat real strawberries in it.
I need to say, they combined very well.🥛🍓
We going out of our way to visit this shop, and it’s worthy!
If you plan to go to Baan Kang Wat, these two places can be together!

name: graincafe.cnx
review_1_text: Special blend what they have it’s amazing! 😻 Since the barista start to make coffee smell incredible, that’s I need every day please!
review_2_text: This small coffee shop, tucked away in corner building near the gym, offers a quiet atmosphere perfect for relaxation a bit, less people. The coffee is well made. You can choose from a variety of roasts to suit your taste preferences, and the cocoa drink is equally delightful.
review_3_text:
They are next to my favorite Gym in CNX : Speed Gym.
They have adapted to that situation by making a special coffee with peanut butter : perfect for a pre-workout.

So most of my afternoons are :
95 baht peanut butter coffee + 100 baht entrance fee for the gym + 10 baht water bottle.
My routine has become so common that I don’t even bother ordering anymore : I just hand the barista a 100 baht and she knows.
review_4_text:
Good coffee. Good service. Good atmosphere.

It felt a bit annoying that the vacuum cleaner was started after every grinding to clean the counter. Use a brush and it’s noiseless…
review_5_text: Nice taste of coffee with full selections of light, medium and dark beans at very reasonable price. The place is beautiful, quite, cozy and clean with spacious car park. Highly recommended.

name: กาแฟ&พิซซ่า
review_1_text: delicious
review_2_text: Delicious!

name: ร้านกาแฟสด หน้าวัดร่ำเปิง
Sun to the Moon Cafe
review_1_text:
Honestly one of the best meals that I had in Thailand. Super delicious and healthy!

The café is very cute and is located in a small village. They have a cute white dog and stickers of the cafe and dog 😊

Service is amazing. I think it was the owner who served me, and he was very nice and had really good English. They have pictures of the food so you can visualise what you're ordering.

I still think about this cute café and would 100% visit if I am back in Thailand!
review_2_text:
I really liked this cafe overall 👍 The owners are very friendly and welcoming. I also appreciated that they serve water for their guests in addition to breakfast 👍👍

The only points I would mention are that, in my opinion, the prices are a bit high, and the portions are a bit small for that price. It feels like it’s hard to get full with dishes under 300 baht. The “add-ons” (extra menu items) also seem rather expensive (in my opinion).

I think if the owners slightly adjusted either the portion size or the price, it would make the cafe close to perfect in my view. The coffee, priced at 90 baht, also seems quite small.

Overall, it’s probably one of the best cafes in this area. But if you live in Nimman, there’s no real reason to come this far - you can find something quite similar around your neighborhood 🙏

Overall, I enjoyed my breakfast today and appreciate the friendly owners. Thank you - your cafe is a nice and pleasant place ☺️
review_3_text: This breakfast spot in Chiang Mai is the cutest! Not only is the food delicious, but the atmosphere is so friendly and welcoming. Plus, they're pet-friendly, so you can bring your furry friend along for the fun! 🐶 Highly recommend checking it out! ✨
review_4_text: Not often to meet places where they do cafe food right here. And this is the place !💫 had a salad and they nailed it along with the perfect pesto 🤌🏿 coffee also great 👍🏽 loved the porch situation,  nice vibes.
review_5_text: We love this cafe! You are greeted by the cutest sunbathing westie as soon as you enter. The owner of the cafe is very kind, and talented. The coffees and food (burger, salad and cookies) were 10/10! The atmosphere is also very relaxing. Highly recommend for when you’re in Chiang Mai!

name: ร้านกาแฟในสวนมะลิ สาขากองบิน41
ร้านกาแฟเฮือนหอมรฏา สาขา2
review_1_text:
the high-end restaurant that dominates that street corner does not make their own coffee; they get it from this small shop just a few meters away;
i had it and it was pretty good, wanted to re-order but the folks at the high-end restaurant said they closed at 5
review_2_text: Coffee shop, small shop, friendly atmosphere with customers, no complaints when charging, fast internet, overall good, recommended.
review_3_text: From branch 1 in Mae Wang to branch 2 at Air Force Base 41, the coffee still tastes the same. Delicious and affordable, along with fresh and tasty cakes and pastries.
review_4_text: Charge your own battery, recharge yourself sometimes.
review_5_text: The coffee is delicious. Very convenient.

name: Café Amazon คาเฟ่ อเมซอน สาขา ปตท.กองบิน41
review_1_text:
This cafe chain is everywhere in Thailand, and though it may not have the best drinks, its presence is appreciated when one needs a place to chill and/or cool down.

Like the case when foreigners need to spend hours waiting at immigration across the street 😄

High ceiling, mostly quiet, good ambiance.
review_2_text:
Honestly, it's one of the worst Amazon coffee in Chiang Mai.
Vietnam definitely has this place beat.
So much for my order inside. The latte is simple, and you have to oder 2 if you want a full cup. You can do better at 7-Eleven and cheaper.
The pastry is well. Go to a local cafe and get everything.

This was a choice waiting on immigration to open. This is a last choice.  😒
review_3_text: just another amazon, right ? this one a small cut above the others,homier feel, supply phone chargers and a little more pastry than most, decent parking ( of course it is in the ptt gas station complex at the rear )
review_4_text: The immigration office is close to this eatery. So I always sit there when I go to the immigration office. lovely, quiet, very private, and pleasant to work in. Likewise, full with plants, as suggested by their name.
review_5_text: They need to have oatmilk alternative for hot coffee, not everyone wants to drink a hormon induced cancerogenic-proven secretion of a very likely maltreated animal lol. Other than that, I love this franchise, good vibe and good priced.

name: FWBcafe coffee wing 41
review_1_text: Good
review_2_text: Very good
review_3_text:
The coffee is amazing! So well made, and the price is incredibly reasonable.
The prices are super friendly, I even wondered if they were selling it for the community.
Definitely adding this shop to my list! 👍🏻👍🏻👍🏻
review_4_text:
The great friendships I've gained from this shop are "excellent" 😚
Good coffee, lovely staff, and a relaxing place to sit… 🤩
review_5_text: The coffee is delicious and the staff provides good service.

name: Cham Chaa Coffee
review_1_text:
The worst Matcha Latte I've ever had.

Avoid this Cafe at Chiang Mai
Immigration. You will seriously regret it. The price isn't even cheap for something this bad.

The worst part is that, even at the first sip, I can feel they might used the expired matcha powder or smth, as I am a big matcha fan….

When I said the drink was not tasty and asked them to fix it, the staff got angry, poured it into the sink right in front of me, and walked away. No apology at all.

(“No refund and no renew, cannot” the staff even about to yell at me!!!!)
review_2_text:
Can I give “zero star”???

The worst cafe at all!!!

The staffs are rude and aggressive!!!

Please avoid this place, don’t buy negative energy with your own money !!!

Pls
review_3_text: Nice place and when you go there i recommend to wear a nice dress.

name: Coffee by JinJu
review_1_text: Great coffee in the morning when you have an appointment at immigration... much better than Amazon at the gasstation... nice guy, deserves your support! ☺️🙏🏻

name: Eat In by Jinju กาแฟสด สาขา สนามบิน
review_1_text:
Very nice women opposite the immigration office
The coffee is very nice
I. An recommended to come here while you wait for your visa ♥️♥️♥️♥️
review_2_text:
I came here to renew my visa and grab a coffee. It's right across from the immigration office.

Free parking is available.

It's cheap and delicious, only 40 pesos a cup!
review_3_text: I love and miss you so much, Meng Jinju.

name: Starbucks
review_1_text:
Not best Coffee ☕️ you get better coffee on street by other vendors.

High priced 🛑

You pay price like 3 times more that in other places, and you can sit by table but coffee will be not bring to your table where you resting. You can pickup self from order desk…
review_2_text: We ordered 2 chai tea. The wifi connection took very long time and it'svery slow.  Every Starbucks should have an easy & fast connection. Customers expect that. In the process of log-in, I had to provide passport number & phone number!  This is unacceptable. Also, the chai tea came on a plastic net!  It's the most unhealthy way to drink tea! Like I need more plastic in my body.  Here's a recommendation to the management, change the tea & log-in method & speed, or you will lose a lot of customers. In our 9 months in Thailand visiting numerous Starbucks, this is the worst Starbucks in Thailand so far.  You should set the standard, not lag at the bottom.
review_3_text: The service was disappointing. The staff member named Fai (the one who pregnant) was busy talking with another staff instead of focusing on customers. She asked me to scan to pay but didn’t create the QR payment because she was talking, which caused delays. My coffee also took longer than necessary for the same reason. I hope the service can be improved.
review_4_text: Love how this Starbucks isn’t too crowded in the morning. Perfect spot to get some work done! Bonus points for the friendly staff. 💘
review_5_text:
As of 2024, there were over 40,000 Starbucks coffee shops operating worldwide. Odds are, you have been to more than ten of them.

If you are looking for power outlets they are generally located on the floor or a nearby wall, not integrated into the table or seating.

Plenty of branded gifts on the right as you walk in. Sofas are located on the far left.

Unless you are sensitive to cold temperatures, you probably won’t need a sweater.

Bro, it’s a Starbucks.

name: 289 Coffee
review_1_text: 289 Everyday Coffee at Chiang Mai’s Airport Business Park is a fantastic café with a relaxing vibe. Nestled in a peaceful campus by a pond, it’s an ideal spot to enjoy quality specialty coffee. Their flat white is superb, rich, smooth, and perfectly balanced. The service from Form and Aom is exceptional; their friendliness and attention to detail make every visit special. Whether you're working or simply relaxing, the tranquil setting and excellent coffee create a wonderful experience. For anyone in Chiang Mai, 289 Everyday Coffee is a top choice for great coffee, a serene atmosphere, and outstanding service. Very much recommended!
review_2_text: Very good dark and medium roast, got a free babychino for the youngest
review_3_text:
"กาแฟดี ที่ไม่ต้องเสี่ยงดวง"

Here, you can savor special coffee as your everyday brew. Enjoy high-quality coffee with a consistent taste!!!!!! No need to leave your satisfaction to chance. And most notably, the pricing is a testament to the ultimate in friendly generosity.

When in Chiang Mai, this is an invitation to a taste adventure you shouldn’t miss.
review_4_text: They know how to make a great specialty coffee🫡.keep it up guys👍
review_5_text: Very tasty coffee, absolutely lovely place and staff 😊

name: ROASTIV
review_1_text: Craving homemade ice cream? This place is a must-try! My favorite flavor was Yakult Pipo 😋light, creamy, not too sweet, and seriously addictive. 🤍🍦
review_2_text: Roastiv is a great spot to start your morning with a good cup of coffee. They offer a variety of coffee options, along with delicious bagels from Volks, all in the same space. The staff is friendly, and there’s also outdoor seating if you prefer to enjoy your coffee outside. A solid choice for a relaxed breakfast or coffee break!
review_3_text: A small place but bring a very solid game with coffee and bagels. The latte was perfect, not too bitter, a generous portion and at a super affordable price. The bagel was very good quality too, although a bit pricy for the portion.  The bagel and coffee stands are in the same shop but they take separate payments. All good and very pleasant atmosphere and service.
review_4_text: Came here based on google reviews when wife and I came to One Nimman for some shopping. Coffee was ok. nothing so extraordinary. I think it really depends on your taste. for me I like a mocha with a very rich cacao taste. this did not have the taste to my liking. the place is nice and service was good. not my favorite coffee.
review_5_text:
I went to the Roastiv coffee shop that is in Neimanham. I think it shares a space with Volks bagels and is near Terroir.cnx.

Roastiv coffee and vibe is great. I am from Seattle, and love me some good coffee. I will always go here when in Chiang Mai.

I like their cups with the cyclist, and they also have some bike theme stuff in the cafe. It made me happy.

Baristas are experts, too.

name: Elm House of Coffee
review_1_text: The cutest place I've stumbled upon, the owner is so so nice and made sure I had something sweet next to my coffee, power for my computer. Everything! I would make this a regular place of mine if I lived here. Thank you for a great morning!
review_2_text:
Please, do yourself a favor and get coffee and Thai tea here. Best drinks we had! The owner is so sweet and friendly and the coffee shop is so cozy and cute!!!!

Let husband and I went back twice!
review_3_text: This humble looking coffee place has some serious espresso and cappuccino. The best in town, I would say. Although not in the menu, their 'signature' drinks are something not to miss. Talk to the barista and you will be presented with a host of creative drinks. Just under the giant DHL sign, opposite to Robinson/Central Airport, very easy to find and park your cars/motos, unlike most places in the inner city.
review_4_text: Best coffee is Chiang Mai! This spot is sooo cozy and the owner is the absolute sweetest 🥹 It’s nestled in a shopping center and she made it such an oasis. This is definitely a must stop!
review_5_text:
Cozy coffee shop with great coffee and very nice owner. It's near the airport but it's a really calm place to have a drink and chat with someone. Prices are very reasonable and the quality is better than average.

There is also homemade focaccia that I didn't try but it looked good as well

name: Minimal coffee - Nimcity daily
review_1_text: Wow, this place is slow. I noticed alot Grab deliveries. I’ve been waiting for 20min plus for one cappuccino. But this place does make a good cappuccino + they have light roast. I’ll try a different location next time.
review_2_text: It is a must-visit for coffee enthusiasts. The ambiance is cozy and modern, offering a peaceful environment to enjoy your coffee. They serve high-quality coffee, and the baristas are clearly skilled, making each cup with care. Love it. The only thing I didn’t like was coffee delivered in a plastic bag.
review_3_text: Very good coffee at 40-60B at an excellent location.   Very comfortable under some big trees with ample seating. Excellent rec from a  barber.
review_4_text: Ordered cappuccino with panda. And lucky for 1/2 cup of coffee
review_5_text: Great value. Yummy coffee

name: Peerapong Coffee at Rimping Supermarket Nim City Daily
review_1_text: Flavorful, full bodied taste.  Great spot for a coffee before shopping in Rimping Supermarket. Before having coffee stop at the bakery counter first and pick up & pay for a pastry or custard tart.
review_2_text: I've tried a bunch. Here, you get the best coffee in town from the skilful, heartful, attentive barista. Highly recommended!
review_3_text: I give the coffee 1 star because... well I can't get a coffee since the staff "went to the toilet". Been sitting here for around 20 mins now but nothing.
review_4_text: Best coffee in Chiangmai. Peerapong is my favourite barista.
review_5_text:
What a really good coffee!
Expert service.
My best surprise for a while.
I'll be back
Thank you Mike!!

name: Koji Nakama Cafe & Bistro
review_1_text: One of my best local food experience. It's delicious and well prepared, even the fried egg was differently good.
review_2_text: I ordered food through Line Man and found worms in it. I would like to ask the restaurant to please double-check their food before preparing it for customers.
review_3_text: Good service, very delicious food.

name: Burkta ABP
review_1_text: Nice coffee van in front of the airport business park. The iced latte was made just the way I liked it. Service was friendly. A couple of tables available to lounge at while sipping your drink.
review_2_text:
# Good services
# Ambience is good
# Good coffee
review_3_text: Good coffee 😊
review_4_text:
Great coffee, lots of places to chill.
No straws for the environment. Oh my!

name: Da.i cafe
review_1_text:
Beautiful and refreshing drinks and cakes, adorable cats, good vibes.

Unfortunately the music was too loud the second time I went.
review_2_text: I had a good time here. The baristas were kind, friendly, and always smiling. The presence of two lovely cats added a charming touch — it was a pleasure to spend time with them. The atmosphere is comfortable, with good air conditioning, making it a great place to relax. I highly recommend it.
review_3_text: I like this place 🤗
review_4_text: Unexpectedly good coffee. Two cute cats.
review_5_text: Amazing place

name: The Xym Cafe
review_1_text: I love the quiet atmosphere and calm music. The plants and mist outside are a nice touch too. It’s not crowded and the staff is very friendly. I ordered a coconut iced americano (they were out of orange) that was refreshing and sat down and used their free wifi which was quite fast. I would definitely come here again
review_2_text:
This place is really cozy.
Around with plant and tree.
Interior design is mix classy vintage and industrial.
When you come in you will feel relax because of tree and place have high ceiling.
Price is reasonable.
And taste is acceptable.
They use a good material.
( peach soda & coffee )
Waitress and waiter have a good service mind.
Place look always clean.
Im satisfied with this place.
review_3_text: Beautifully decorated coffee shop with chill jazz background music. Open nice and early. I had a hot latte, which tasted great with nicely done latte art and the 70 baht price was very nice.
review_4_text: Good vibe. Big space many seat. Good Coffee
review_5_text: Iced Americano coconut is good, chicken wrap is not a good choice, very dry. The atmosphere here is very good, light music and quiet. Can stay for long time.

name: The Volcano II
review_1_text:
Cool little dessert and coffee restaurant, kind of Japanese style. Went here a few times after dinner to indulge in something sweet.
The mochis are very delicious, so is there new matcha cheesecake. The bread and cheese are also classy and very tasty.
The service is ok, they can speed it up a bit but, the staff are very kind.
The restaurant is very cool, well decorated, and cozy.
review_2_text:
Japanese dessert
We tried various menus and i love their creme brulee toast
The sweetness juz alright and the bun very soft
We also tried their famous soft pancake
Surprisingly the size of the pancake smaller than usual 🤣
review_3_text: The coconut pancakes and iced latte were delicious however we waited a long time before receiving our order - otherwise the place looks nice and feels homely
review_4_text: Variety of menus and all is very tasty. Crème brûlée is a must try menu. We ordered chocolate lava and thought its a chocolate fondant but its a chocolate pancake with chocolate lava but still delicious. Another must try is mochi, we oredered matcha, melon, and peach yoghurt. Staff is attentive and supportive. Place is clean but quite packed with many ppl during 8 pm (after dinner will be packed.)
review_5_text: The staff were very nice and helpful here. They were kind and gave a good service. The Thai tea got the tea power in the cup but made the drink not smooth like usual. The butter bread was great. No need to buy for three here. They can serve one if you dine in. The room was hot cuz of the position of a/c but understand that outside was hotter.

name: Black Swan Cnx
review_1_text: Excellent café! The owner is extremely polite, friendly, and welcoming. You can really feel his passion for what he does. The coffee is very good and high quality, and the atmosphere is relaxed and pleasant. The owner also speaks good English, which makes the experience even better. Highly recommended — I will definitely come back! ☕
review_2_text:
Good atmosphere
Good price
Matcha latte is really good
Highly suggest
review_3_text:
Chilling Vibes
Very nice coffee
Easy for car parking
Quite good for a daily quick good coffee but not expensive
review_4_text: Local friendly barista , nice coffee easy praking - very nice & relax vibe
review_5_text: Great coffee and chilled atmosphere. The owners are really friendly and take time to chat with us and speak perfect english and helped us with speaking Thai. The price is good for the quality of coffee they offer and they get their beans from another great local cafe three coffee. Definatly recommend

name: Mingmitr Coffee - ถนนวัวลาย
review_1_text:
Chilled atmosphere and nice staff.
The drinks are good and this location is easily walkable to the airport.
review_2_text: A great cafe. I like this place for the ambience. We'll designed. Good air-conditioning, friendly staff. Coffee prices are typical, not extraordinary. Ordered an iced Black coffee which is hard to screw up. Can't comment on the other drinks yet. WiFi seems good enough. Not overly crowded but a lively atmosphere in the late afternoon.
review_3_text:
“Perfect for locals/residents and visitors (tourists or those who happen to be in this area).”  Those were my thoughts when I came here for coffee for the first time even though I had lived in Chiangmai for several years.

The Xym Café is modeled after Starbucks and for the most part they get it right, from the airconditioning to the light upbeat instrumental music to the incredibly luxurious comfy seats and spaciousness of the place to the availability of Cold Brew, Nitro, Drip, and other coffee options, to the sale of mugs and desserts.   But with an exception:  all of this available at a fraction of what you’d pay at Starbucks.  Oh, and they have plants with watering mists that keep the plants looking green.

Opens at 7am for you early birds who want to seize the day and get a head start on life.  There are also Chang and Singha beer options, just like any self-respecting Thai establishment. Heineken is represented too.
And local Thai snacks to accompany your coffee / beer or other beverage choices in this garden-like setting.  There’s the floral/plant motif that runs through this whole cafe.

Perfect all-around place to come solo, bring someone special, and just have some private time away from the bustle of the world.  This cafe has parking, and is located next to a 7-11 if you need to pick up a few items before/after your coffee.

Pro Tourist Tip:
The Xym Café is also located directly right across the “Old Chiangmai Cultural Center” (which has nightly food and cultural performances, depending on the season), so it’s great to be at Xym Café in the late afternoon and pop over to the Old Chiangmai Cultural Center in the evening for their activities.  The cultural center grounds is nice for a walk too, and there’s a famous Japanese restaurant within its vicinity, along with also a famous malt whiskey drinking place for aficionados.  There’s also the Ma Nee night market (which has a galore of food stalls) just a mere 2 minute stroll from the cafe.  So, all in all, this Café is perfect for an afternoon relaxing stopover before the evening activities just right across from it.

Kindly give me a thumbs up if you found this review helpful.  It encourages me to keep doing this.  Thanks.
review_4_text: ราคาหลักสิบ บรรยากาศหลักล้าน . Nice place and great coffee. I had Burberry cheese cake and my hot cuppuchino with Jazz music....WOW👍
review_5_text: Obsessed with this place!!!!!!! All I had in chiang mai was mingmitr coffe

name: The Oasis (Community Café and Co-working Space) by Bulls Coffee
review_1_text:
This was a great little find. It’s got nice outdoor seating. I think the indoor seating is probably good too although I didn’t really go inside. My pork burger was delicious. The coffee was good and all for a very fair price. So many cafés coworker spaces in Chiang Mai will overcharge you. This place has found a great balance of quality and cost.

I was too hungry and forgot to take a picture of my burger, but it looks just like the other pictures I’ve seen on Google
review_2_text:
I thoroughly enjoyed my breakfast at Oasis Community Café and Co-working Space. They have a fantastic menu with fresh, delicious options – perfect for starting the day right. The atmosphere is welcoming, and it's clear they've created a great space for both food and work.

Highly recommend Oasis if you're looking for a tasty breakfast in a friendly and productive environment. I'll definitely be back!
review_3_text:
☕ Chiang Mai's Newest Hidden Gem 🥐

Located near Rimping Supermarket Nim City Branch, this place is a perfect spot for spending your day working in a prime location and air-conditioned cafe/co-working space.

Besides their wide selection of coffee and non-coffee drinks, The Oasis also offered a range of breakfast, brunch and desserts. I would recommend the Thai-style grilled bun with Nutella topping - so tasty!

Plus, having been told about this new giveaway campaign, I decided to write them a review here to get a free house-blend iced coffee, what a treat!
review_4_text: The food was fresh and tasty, and the service was friendly. A great spot for a satisfying brunch.
review_5_text: Hidden  great place!

name: Bulls' CAFÉ
review_1_text: fav coffee shop in town.  the staff very friendly. always come to get the coffee in weekdays. thanks for making a heart too.
review_2_text: Very friendly staff, great coffee, nice prices, and good promotions. In addition to having the regular types of coffee and tea, they also have a selection of creative and adventurous flavours!
review_3_text: I've ordered via Grab many times. It's really nice. Especially the Coconut flavoured Coffee.
review_4_text: The owner operator is very knowledgeable coffee lover.
review_5_text: Good quality beverages, reasonable prices and kind services.

name: Day off house
review_1_text: We stayed a few weeks and want to stay again after becoming friends with the host and her family. New coffee shop she just opened is amazing the manger tony is a lifelong friend now as well. Night market is close by. Good restaurants are close and old city is an easy walk. The area of the city had a pretty serious flood last year but the owner and house keeper have kept things together. This is a storage container build so keep in mind it's not fully soundproof and you should be respectful of other people no partys! We wanted to meet people and make friends so this was the perfect place for us.
review_2_text: Favorite place in Chiang Mai. I come to Chiang Mai quite often and always return to the Day off house. It’s located in a cute and quiet area of Chiang Mai run my the sweetest ladies. Rooms are always clean and super comfy.
review_3_text:
Beautiful home in the heart of Chiang Mai, real family feel, a peaceful, warm, friendly place. Really great distance from the city whether walking or driving. The host and her family are so friendly and kind. The concept of staying in a converted shipping container is so cool, it had a lovely atmosphere.
Great price and location, would definitely recommend ✨⭐️
review_4_text:
Spacious, clean and modern en suite with a comfy double bed and balcony. Exactly as shown online
Great location between the old town and airport with tasty restaurants and a 711 in walking distance.

Also lovely owners who gave me sandwiches, fruit and homemade yoghurt which I really appreciated and made me feel right at home during my stay.

Room cleaned every ~3days/ on request , well equipped kitchen area

10/10 would recommend this experience to a friend❤️⭐️
review_5_text: I stayed at Day Off House for a month while taking a Thai massage course, and it was the perfect place to call home. The rooms were spacious, impeccably clean, and thoughtfully designed for comfort, and having a small kitchen was a great bonus for preparing snacks and quick meals. However, the best part of my stay was the incredible hospitality of the family running the guesthouse—they were always around, eager to connect, and truly went above and beyond to make me feel welcome. They took my friend and me to a cozy local coffee shop, helped me find a place to get a haircut, and made every effort to ensure we had an amazing experience. Their warmth and generosity turned my stay into something far more meaningful than just accommodation, and I left feeling like part of their extended family. If you’re looking for a place that offers not just comfort but a genuine sense of belonging, Day Off House is the perfect choice—I can’t wait to return!

name: Gurkha Chyia
review_1_text:
Very nice little restaurant and take away shop. The prices are fair and not expensive and the food is decent and very good. It's good to find a nice place like this for Indian / Myanmar / Nepali food in the city that has reasonable prices. I hope they manage to keep the quality high as the price low for a long time.
I'll go again for sure
review_2_text:
Amazing taste and authentic flavors!
Gurkha Chyia has the best puri bhaji, Gurkha chai, and noodles — all so delicious and freshly made. The food reminds me of real Gurkha home-style cooking. The place is clean, cozy, and has a warm atmosphere. Highly recommended for anyone who loves authentic Gurkha food!
review_3_text: Nice Burmese/Nepali/Indian food. The Burmese noodle salad, tea leaf salad and roti are especially good. The masala chai is the best I’ve had so far in Chiang Mai.
review_4_text: Very friendly owner. Tasted good & reasonable at 50 baht. Pani puri was not the usual mint coriander, but I still enjoyed it. Vegan friendly.
review_5_text: A really nice mix of Burmese, Nepali and Gurkha food. I had a range of dishes but the tea leaf salad, Mohinga & Gurkha chai were standout dishes. The prices are really reasonable and the owners are all really friendly. Ill definitely be coming back!

name: Boy Slow Bar Coffee ศรีปิงเมือง
review_1_text:
One of the best coffees we’ve had in Chiang Mai, especially for the price.
My favourite was the coconut flower water coffee.❤️
review_2_text: Very cute little coffee shop and great coffee/latte!! It’s run by a lovely couple. We came here every morning for breakfast during our stay in Chiang Mai. Thank you for making us the best coffee every morning!
review_3_text:
This is the best coffee in Chiangmai (and I think the best espresso I ever had - yes better than the Italy).

The barista is a proper artist of the art of making coffee, really a must visit if you are in Chiangmai!

The couple running the place are super nice!

You can also work from the laptop here as there’s a small room with solid WiFi.

Just fantastic.
review_4_text:
Wonderful and delicious little café in Chiang Mai!
I highly recommend it if you’re staying nearby. It’s run by a lovely couple, and it’s such a joy to come here every morning for a delicious coffee or matcha, made with so much care and heart.
Also, their waffles are amazing!
Thanks to the owners for their kindness and beautiful energy !
review_5_text: We stayed at an Airbnb down the street and came here every morning for coffee. The owner was so friendly and the coffee was amazing. We also enjoyed the waffles! Highly recommend this gem. Some afternoon we even went back for a Thai tea.

name: All Day Coffee Food&Beverage
review_1_text: This place is simply amazing. My partner and I were lucky to find it close to our homestay! We would have come everyday but the owner/chef took a well deserved vacation. It’s a one man show, with a cute lil pup guard dog and a homey atmosphere inside. The food is very affordable (50-80 baht a dish) and usually comes with a yummy broth on the side. We repeatedly got the pad-see-ew, pad-ka-krow, tom kha gai because they were the best dishes of our trip. Seriously don’t miss out on this spot!
review_2_text: Amazing food and great portions! It’s a really small and cozy place, with freshly cooked food and very friendly and nice owner. it’s also very affordable! A must visit if you are in the area!
review_3_text: This place is a gem! The restaurant serves tasty and healthy dishes, very good quality and good prices. The chef is really nice and prepares the food outside. The eating area is a cozy place that feels like home. The adjacent Café is run by a very nice lady and offers tasty drinks that can also be ordered in the restaurant.
review_4_text: So happy we found this hidden gem just a few steps away from our place! Food is amazing and the chef basically runs the place by himself! Come here and support this business, each dish is worth a try!!
review_5_text: It’s definitely more like a restaurant than a cafe. You wanna try their red curry with crispy pork because it’s very good. It’s a small yet good AC space especially for the price.

name: Paper Plane Haiya
review_1_text: Beautiful  house , friendly owner  🌼 will come back again
review_2_text: Loved the jice japanese-mininalistic touch.
review_3_text:
The air conditioners in each room aren't very cool, and the bathroom fan is noisy.
But the house is beautiful, clean, and comfortable.

name: JOYLIDAY Coffee - เลือกคั่วได้
review_1_text: Amazing coffee and lovely people - this place was my hidden gem in Chiang Mai! It’s next to the Muay Thai gym where my husband trained and I enjoyed many Thai espressos while I waited - so delicious and they take so much care with every drink. Highly recommend!
review_2_text: Good Coffee, Good Price, Nice Place to sit and relax - Iced Americano with Orange Medium Roast
review_3_text: The coffee is delicious and great value for money. The shop isn't quite finished yet, so it might be a bit hot sitting inside.
review_4_text: Good coffee quality, good packaging, reasonable price. Good✨👍

name: Honey Berry Slowbar Coffee
review_1_text: Just a small coffee truck on the side of the street. You can choose the roast level and the prices are the same for light, medium, and dark. It’s a good coffee pick up spot.
review_2_text:
My favourite spot in Chiang Mai.
Relax with the drink under the trees.
review_3_text: Great!❤️
review_4_text: It's good, give it a try. You can sit and watch the red cars and pigeons under the big trees; it's nice and cool. The coffee is good and reasonably priced. I didn't get a chance to take a picture before I finished it all! The matcha green tea is also pretty good. Come try it!
review_5_text: Very good street coffee, close to the Saturday night market, next to a wild golf course, the uncle is very cute, the coffee quality is also good, better than my moka and wood wood, very cost-effective, a friend who passed by here recommended it to have a cup

name: RYO リョウ coffee
review_1_text: This is one of the few shops that serves a really delicious dark roast mocha that suits my taste. The barista is lovely, always smiling, and very friendly.
review_2_text: The caramel latte was not too sweet and had a wonderful caramel aroma. It was delicious! It's a small shop that just opened under an apartment building. The price is affordable. I highly recommend it. 🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟 I give it 5 stars. I'll definitely be back :)
review_3_text: The coffee is fragrant and tastes great. The staff are kind, polite, and lovely.

name: VP Coffee at VP City Park
review_1_text:
This is an adorable coffee shop and cafe.

The coffee is delicious! There is also a selection of light meals that are great for breakfast or lunch.

You will be sitting in the middle of a beautiful park filled with trees, exercise paths, and an assortment of structures for exercise or use by  special events.
review_2_text: Very green and best landscaping. Friendly atmosphere and helpful staff. Good food and lovely coffee.
review_3_text: A truly wonderful spot! The staff here are so warm and welcoming, and the atmosphere is just beautiful — surrounded by trees, calm, and peaceful. It’s the perfect place to relax with a good cup of coffee and enjoy nature. Highly recommend!
review_4_text: Wonderful chill place for coffee & food in the City surrounded by trees and flowers. Great for your pets also.
review_5_text:
Really like this place. The outside environment is beautiful, being a park, and the coffee shop itself is stylish and modern with great outdoor seating

Coffee: 4.5/5
Price: 5/5
Atmosphere: 4.5/5
Service: 5/5

name: Ongsa
review_1_text: Looks good but it's not 24h open as it says
review_2_text:
Drive by, there's parking at the food court.
I ordered a 25% sweet Thai tea. It tasted good, smooth, and had a nice tea aroma.
The price was reasonable.
The atmosphere was nice, with bright white tones and a nice view outside. I enjoyed reading a book.
Recommended.
review_3_text: The Thai tea is delicious. It's a small shop with a nice atmosphere and is very chill. If you're lucky, you might see a cat in the parking lot behind the shop. 😺 It's very cute and noisy.
review_4_text: Newly opened coffee shop. White shop, clean, beautifully decorated, good coffee, cool air conditioning, normal price.
review_5_text: Delicious coffee, great atmosphere.

name: 2 WAY Coffee & Drink
review_1_text: It is currently under improvement.
review_2_text: This shop is very delicious.

name: After Sunrise ศรีปิงเมือง
review_1_text: Absolutely loved this place! The coffee at After Sunrise is smooth and flavorful — you can tell they really care about quality. The staff were incredibly friendly and made the whole experience warm and welcoming. Perfect spot to relax, enjoy a good cup of coffee, and start your day right. Highly recommended!
review_2_text: If you’re around here, this is a great spot for good coffee and a chill vibe.
review_3_text: Best coffee shop in town! Friendly staff and atmosphere! Good selection of coffee and tea! I would recommend!
review_4_text: Cozy atmosphere cute cats delicious drinks and food
review_5_text: Loved the drinks and the cozy intimate bar seating. Relaxing music and friendly baristro.

name: Achi@Cha Coffee
review_1_text: Hidden Gem that we stumbled upon! Great vibe, super yummy coffee, we had a cappuccino, an Iced Latte and our child had a treat drink called coco mint! The family that runs the shop is so kind. It’s a great place to chill out!
review_2_text: friendly.  nice coffee.  chill
review_3_text: Stumbled upon this friendly place when I was cycling around, it appeared exactly when I needed something refreshing!
review_4_text:
Delicious drinks
Great prices
Amazing atmosphere under the trees

The coffee is very fragrant and rich, and the green tea is strong. The shop may not be large and there aren't many seats, but the baristas are very attentive.

There's enough parking in front of the shop for one car, but it might be more convenient if you're traveling by motorcycle.

If you're passing by, I highly recommend stopping by and giving it a try.
review_5_text: The lemon tea is not very good, it is a small cup and I finish it quickly. The price is 35 baht. You can also drink coffee here. There are two semi-automatic coffee machines, the price is about 50 baht.

name: Yadana cafe (ยาดานา คาเฟ่)
review_1_text: Good coffee, great price! At first glance, you wouldn't even know it's a coffee shop ^_^ I initially thought it was a small hotel lounge or restaurant, but it's actually a surprisingly good coffee shop! I was quite surprised. The location is a bit hidden in a side street, so parking might be difficult. You'll need to make a U-turn to get back out as it's a dead-end street, but you can find parking along the side of the road. The decor is a blend of vintage, luxury, modern, and Western styles – hard to describe, but I personally liked it because it's quite spacious, has limited tables, and is comfortable and cool inside because it's air-conditioned. The coffee tastes good; you might need to ask the staff to make it less sweet or unsweetened. The best part is the price! A dirty coffee is only 60 or 65 baht (I can't quite remember the exact price 😅). The milk is creamy, the coffee is strong and aromatic, and not sour. Give it a try! It's a hidden gem, I can't quite describe the style, haha.
review_2_text: So beautiful.
review_3_text: It looks like the shop is closed.
review_4_text: The coffee tastes good.
review_5_text: I don't know, I've never been there.

name: Mom’s Coffee & Beauty
review_1_text: Big fan of this place. Cozy find. Good prices. Air conditioning and free water. Very nice staff. Totally a local place.
review_2_text: Delightful. Like so many Thai people, great ambassadors for the country.
review_3_text: Great pastry.
review_4_text: A small but very cute shop. The prices are not too expensive. They play good music... The drinks and snacks taste good. Please come and visit.
review_5_text: Cozy, great coffee and food at local prices. Good service.

name: อารย - Araya de café
กาแฟมิราเคิล เชียงใหม่ By ดาว
review_1_text: Very nice small cafe and wonderful service. Good coffee with lots of options. Will visit again.
review_2_text: Kind owner and tasty iced cappuccino for 40b.
review_3_text: Good
review_4_text: Affordable prices and delicious taste. Anyone passing by this area should stop by and try it! 👍👍👍
review_5_text: Delicious coffee, cheap price, highly recommended.

name: ตราบุญ Coffee Station
review_1_text:
Hidden Gem small coffee shop in Chiangmai city
Amazing price compared to the taste and quality of coffee.
Cozy atmosphere.
You can park car or motorcycle on the road nearby.
Be back for sure.
review_2_text: Hidden gem in Chiang mai with delicious coffeee!!! And such cheap prices too! Highly recommend! Vegan milks available too!
review_3_text: My new favorite coffee place in Chiang Mai!!! Super friendly owner and good price with delicious coffee that makes us come back every day😍 Plum Americano is 🔥🔥🔥they also have plant based milk available for vegans 💚
review_4_text: Owner was quite fluent with English and was great to talk all things culture with him. Coffee was good and nice to sit in the sun in an informal environment. And just chat .
review_5_text:
Great coffee on a quiet little Soi near to our apartment. Lovely yard set back from the traffic.
Fabulous fresh coffee from Chaing Rai.
Fresh hot or cold coffee 35 baht.
Kind and attentive host and Barrista.
Highly recommended.

name: Khom Kik!!
review_1_text: A cozy coffee shop decorated in a beautiful vintage style.

name: Beans Yard Coffee Roaster
review_1_text: I really like the coffee here! And the coffee beans! They are very good coffee roaster! I I must come here every time when I come to Chiangmai ❤️❤️
review_2_text: Organized and clean little place. Convenient and quick. Very friendly and nice.
review_3_text: The shop is so cute and the owner is so friendly. I happened to stop by while passing by, and the coffee here is so delicious, it's definitely worth a try. ☕️✨️

name: กาแฟ ออนเดอะเวย์คาเฟ่เชียงใหม่ สาขากาดก้อม
review_1_text: The staff have no service mind. They don't care about taking orders from customers. When they see customers approaching to order drinks, they walk away. They don't care about customers. They don't have a service mind. When customers want to order drinks, they scowl. They don't care or are willing to take orders. They don't prioritize service. When they see customers approaching, they must greet them first. They can't just walk away and ignore them when they want to order drinks. The coffee tastes a bit poor. That's enough...the only time I'll go to this branch.👎
review_2_text:
This roadside beverage stall offers a mildly sweet Thai tea.
The young staff speaks excellent English, is friendly and helpful.
review_3_text:
This coffee shop offers incredibly cheap prices and amazing taste. A light-roast Americano for only 35 baht has a sweet, fruity aroma and a great balance…plus the flavor profile is complex, with a lovely, fragrant aftertaste.

I highly recommend trying it!
review_4_text: Whenever I go to buy something, the staff is never in the store. I don't know where they've gone. Every time.
review_5_text: This shop has great-tasting tea and coffee. The staff are lovely, always smiling and greeting customers warmly.

name: เกรียงไกรกาแฟโบราณ
review_1_text: The mocha is delicious, I love it. They give so much cocoa that there's always some left at the bottom of the glass. It's my regular shop. I bring my own cup for a 5 baht discount. It's a shame they close early, around 3 or 4 pm. I work late and always come to buy it in the evening, but I'm always out of luck.
review_2_text: visit

name: ร้านหนึ่งศูนย์แปด(๑๐๘)
review_1_text:
The Khanom Jeen Nam Ngiao (rice noodles with spicy pork broth) was delicious!
It's made by Auntie Noi, Teo's mother.
review_2_text: A really nice local evening market. It's a bit strange for Dutch people, as you walk along a canal with picturesque bridges. You can eat, get massages, and be entertained. Oh, and there are lots of great souvenirs to buy.
review_3_text: The atmosphere is very chill, the beer is delicious, and there are many types of mixed drinks.
review_4_text: A small shop at Khlong Mae Kha. The owner is cute. The taste of the black-hearted dog smoothie is delicious. ^^

name: ร้านมักชา กาดก้อม
review_1_text: The coffee is delicious and the seller is lovely 🥰
review_2_text: Delicious tea and coffee, reasonable price, with coupons to collect points. Jasmine tea is very fragrant.
review_3_text: Fast, friendly service and good Red Thai Tea

name: Libera Coffee
review_1_text: Little bit expensive but the cappuccino was excellent and a good size
review_2_text: Good coffee shop next to Astra Condo
review_3_text: The coffee there is not good but the price is high. 80฿ for an Americano I expect more. Seems their main customer is guests in Astra condo. You can find way better coffee with cheaper price across the street.
review_4_text: 75 baht for a tiny cappuccino, I wanted to throw it in their face, but I am nice and I wouldn’t do that, although I still had that feeling. Please owner of this business, do not rip people off, if you charge this much money make sure the size is at least double of this. YOU LITERALLY GAVE ME A BABYCINO. Rip off
review_5_text: Decent atmosphere but pretty mediocre coffee

name: ชายงชาเย็น (ชาใต้) สาขาเชียงใหม่ the best of southern thaitea in chiangmai
review_1_text: The taste was great! But I'm giving it 4 stars because it's a bit far from home. The shop is easy to find, a small, minimalist shop opposite Montfort Primary School. 🤩👍🏽
review_2_text:
Made with tea leaves from the south, the tea has a rich aroma and flavor.
Sweetness can be adjusted: 25%, 50%, 75%. The shop has some comfortable seating.
review_3_text: The tea is so good. It's delicious and the shop is chic. The owner is very friendly and kind. 🥰❤️🫶🏻
review_4_text: The atmosphere is very good, especially in the morning. It's very chill.

name: Roar Cafe
review_1_text: I absolutely love Roar! Great coffee, especially the iced coconut americano. They serve fresh bakery and breakfast (American - English style, eggs, sausage, etc) but also Greek yogurt. Nice staff, quiet, nice space, excellent WiFi, AC, great to work (laptop friendly) and super honest prices. Highly recommend it :)
review_2_text: Was staying nearby at the Astra and this little coffee shop saved the morning. The baristas are sweet, and the flat white was smooth with cute art :) Calm and open air environment .. you won’t freeze of A/C 🙏
review_3_text: Only bought coffees here but it’s amazing, they started to remember our order. It was just downstairs from where we’re staying and went everyday for 2 weeks! And tried other places but not as good coffee!
review_4_text: Highly recommend, delicious food. Free wifi provided too which is a nice bonus. We ordered the scrambled egg sausage and bacon on rice bowl - yum! Definitely hit the spot. Coffee is on point too. Thank you!
review_5_text: Stumbled here by accident & the matcha & caramel machiato were amazing as were the chocolate danish & almond croissant

name: On The Way Chang klan
review_1_text: Not much to say: a great place to start the day - just along the road, but so friendly with great coffee. Will be back, best to start the Chiangmai mornings…
review_2_text:
If I could give 100/10 I would do it.
Criss really has the best service, coffee and we love coming here every day.

We bring our own oat milk which he keeps and we order 2 drinks every day.

For me a cold cappuccino oat and a lemon lychee. 😍  my boyfriend always drinks his hot cappuccino’s and has NO energy crashes during the day. (Thats says how good the coffee is)!!
review_3_text:
This is one of my favorite coffee places I’ve come across in all my travels.

The owner is the friendliest guy and always has a smile on his face.

Coffee is dialed and on point, every time. In the early AM there isn’t many people here, but once the day gets going there are always people lined up.

Really a great find and worth making a stop at!
review_4_text: Go to this coffee stand! Delicious coffee, great prices, and the barista—who seems to also be the owner—is the sweetest! He also speaks excellent English and will tailor the coffee to your taste preference. Thank you for your yummy coffee and kindness ❤️❤️
review_5_text: Chris made this place great. Excellent priced, great tasting coffee options in cute boutique stand with seating and music. Chris was very friendly and informative about the area while serving a delicious morning cappuccino and mocha that tasted excellent. Going to come back here every morning for the rest of our stay in Chiang Mai.

name: โรตีมุสตาฟา&มุสลิม ช้างคลาน
review_1_text:
Another recommended rotee shop in the city.
Price is reasonable. And the taste is good, edible.
A bit disappointed with a young lady who served the customer, seemed she is the daughter or the owner or something. She didn’t perform that well in her job. NO SMILE at all. Hope she gets better soon 🔜.
review_2_text: Good vibe and delicious!
review_3_text: Pleasantly surprised with a piece of cheese and crispy roti or prata  for only 20 thb. Black coffee and ginger tea only 15 thb each and comes with a free tea. So sweet.
review_4_text: One of the best rotee and coffee shops in town. Went here for a late night munch and was not disappointed. Went for the milk hot tea and banana roti. Definitely recommend.

name: Little Shelter Hotel Chiang Mai
review_1_text:
Such a lovely hotel, perfectly located along a curve of the Ping River with a really peaceful and scenic view. It’s a great spot to slow down and enjoy Chiang Mai in a calmer, more relaxed way.

If you’re into architecture and art, you’ll definitely enjoy staying here. The design is simple but thoughtful, and everything feels well put together and comfortable.

The staff are super friendly and welcoming, always happy to help. Don’t miss the bar—great vibes, nice drinks, and a perfect place to hang out and unwind after a day out in the city.
review_2_text: I’ve been attracted to this hotel by its design. Very impressed by the warm hospitality from the owner who would be transparently present. The staff always give us sincere service. The foods are delicious. I stayed at the hotel once, really love the room & the breakfast . Having home in Chiangmai, I often visit Little Shelter Hotel for several creative events & very much enjoy and love the vibes here. Shout out to gin lovers, you would find various kinds of local & import gins at the hotel’s beautiful restaurant & bar. Sipping a lovely drink with some yummy snacks in the cosy garden by the Ping river is also a must.
review_3_text:
Don’t be fooled by the pictures — please come knowing what to actually expect.

I was really disappointed with my stay at Little Shelter and want to share my experience so others can make an informed decision.

1. No communication from the hotel
I emailed weeks in advance asking about airport transfers because Agoda said it was included. I never received a reply. My husband even called the morning of our arrival and still heard nothing. For a hotel claiming 4 stars, this is unacceptable.

2. Inconvenient location + difficult access
The hotel is over 3 km from the city center, meaning you’ll need to Grab or taxi everywhere. The road leading to the hotel is under construction — very dusty, bumpy, and dirty — and this was not mentioned anywhere.

3. Nice river view, but lots of mosquitoes
The river setting is pretty, but there are many mosquitoes, which makes sitting outside uncomfortable.

4. Room size and upgrade issue
We booked a Deluxe King room, but it was quite small. We tried to upgrade, but the hotel was fully booked and couldn’t offer anything else.

5. Cleanliness and maintenance issues
This was the biggest disappointment:
•	Plastic mirrors on the walls looked cheap and were dusty.
•	The ceiling images were pixelated and low-quality.
•	Slippers were worn and dirty.
•	Bathroom had grime, and even the lotion bottle looked unclean.

For a hotel claiming design awards, the maintenance and attention to detail were extremely poor.

6. Pool is not functional for swimming
The pool is pretty shallow — it looks more decorative than usable. Not very clean and very narrow

7. Breakfast starts very late
Breakfast only starts at 8:00 AM, the latest I’ve seen in any hotel. Not ideal if you have morning plans.

Overall
This felt more like a 2–3 star experience, not the 4-star hotel it’s advertised as. The design concept and river view are nice, but poor communication, cleanliness issues, small rooms, and an inconvenient location make the stay disappointing. Don’t be fooled by the pictures — set your expectations accordingly.

Well done💕 definitely will come back again❤️‍🩹 Thank you so much!

A Distinctive Boutique Retreat in Chiang Mai!!

Little Shelter Hotel offers an exceptional stay that blends thoughtful design with serene riverside charm. Each room showcases a unique architectural concept, reflecting both creativity and local heritage — a true celebration of art and space.

Adding to its character, the hotel features an on-site art gallery that showcases works from various local and international artists, further enriching the experience for design and culture enthusiasts.

The atmosphere is calm and refined, complemented by genuinely warm hospitality. Breakfasts were a delight, beautifully plated and paired with locally roasted coffee of superb quality.

Tucked just outside the city bustle, this is a perfect sanctuary for those who appreciate design, comfort, and a sense of place. Highly recommended.

Found this place because our Airbnb was right next door, ordered two soups and the pork gyoza for takeaway which was ready super fast… my husband and I couldn’t stop raving about the food while eating it, especially for under 100 THB a person. They also have ample off the street parking for both cars and scooters. What more could you want? 👍
review_3_text: I left my brown goodr sunglasses there today, they have a wire attached. I can't find contact info for the restaurant, can you please respond with contact info so I can reach out? I can't go back to the restaurant soon but I'll explain. Anyway, today my family and I ate here. Lovely atmosphere, great service and food, affordable prices. Would definitely come back!
review_4_text: I really enjoyed food in this restaurant which was more tasty than I expected, also nicely served and some small aperitifs were included in menu. I ordered grilled salmon menu and the fish was grilled accurately that it was tasty, but not dry. I will definitely come again to this restaurant.
review_5_text: One of my favorite northern food. Lots of menu you can choose both noodle, rice, soup. Also have roti for dessert. Parking lots available. Good environment with fresh air. Delivery also available. Must try if you come to Chiangmai.

name: GRAPH Coffee Baankangwat
review_1_text:
Coffee 'fine dining'!

I was absolutely amazed by the menu in Graph coffee - techniques used (cold brew jelly) and flavor combinations (coffee with tomato and lime) are unique. I've been to various specialty coffee places across Europe, never encountered anything like that.

This is a must try when you're in Baan Kang Wat, perfect place, located in the heart of the village, giving you the outlook on many craft shops.

Super friendly and helpful staff and a quick service. Would love to see more places experiment with coffee like that.

11/10, highly recommended!
review_2_text: Loved the setting of this branch.  The market itself left a very good impression.  I ordered some orange coffee and it was good.  Will come back to this brand next time in thailand.  There was a long line so drinks took a while.  Happy for their good business.
review_3_text: Went during the cooler season in Chiang Mai so it was not too hot and stuffy. The shop has innovative coffee menu just like a bar. I really like the Graph No.29, slight hint of pineapple and the margarita like salt added a new flavour  combination.
review_4_text:
The most crowded spot in this area, so we had to drop by for a coffee. Unfortunately, only bills above ฿300 are accepted for credit card payment.

Orders are placed at the counter, and you’ll be given a small tin with an alphabet on it. The staff will then bring the drinks to your table.

The Volcano Latte was one of the popular picks. It uses oat milk, and I was pleasantly surprised that there was no usual oat milk aftertaste. The drink was very smooth, slightly sweet, and served mildly chilled.
review_5_text: Place is nice and “Trendy” , this come with a ln extra price tag … me living in Chiang mai long enough , prefer not to pay. Coffe was good , not something that I cannot get in Many other local shops with half price tag. It’s kind of place that young crowd are willing to pay extra in order to have a nice capture for social media. Or maybe I’m not their target audience.  You can try and see.

name: Por Phu Cat Cafe
review_1_text:
We loved this cat cafe. It wasn’t crowded when we went and we got to hang out and pet with lots of super cute cats. The treats they sell were popular among the cats and attracted many of them to hang with us. The environment is clean and chic and the cats looks like they’ve been taken care of. The 150 baht entrance includes a drink and wifi. We felt it was good value.

Tip: the ship is located at the end of a small plaza so you’ll need to walk to the end to find it. There is a bathroom nearby as well.
review_2_text: Beautiful simple cafe with a lot of sweet cats. Entrance fee is 150 baht per person which includes a free drink. The time limit is two hours. It was a peaceful and fun time for our daughters - cat therapy. Many of the cats were cuddly and affectionate.
review_3_text: Had a great time at this cozy cat café! The entrance fee is just 150, and it includes one free drink, which is a nice touch. They have 10+ adorable cats roaming around, all super friendly. It’s a chill spot to relax, especially for cat lovers. Bonus points for free parking, which makes getting there super convenient. Definitely worth a visit!
review_4_text: Amazing place for cat lovers. The cats are pretty lazy and don't do much though. They lie around. Most of them don't like to be carried. It costs around 150 bhat per person for entry and you get one free drink. You could play with a few of the baby cats they engage.
review_5_text: A delightful 2 hours 🐾 for 150bht (drink & socks included) there were so many cuddly, adorable cats to hang out with.

name: The Old Chiang Mai Cafe' Espresso Bar
review_1_text:
The food here is definitely enjoyable, though it leans towards the pricier side, likely due to its location in a tourist area. The café offers a wide variety of food options, and I appreciate the concept that blends seamlessly with the natural surroundings.

One downside was the slightly slow service after ordering at the counter, probably due to the crowd. However, the fresh fruit juice stood out as a highlight, far from the typical packaged alternatives.

Overall, this place is worth a visit for anyone looking to enjoy a meal in a charming setting.
review_2_text: Stopped for a cake and coffee while my visit to the amazing handcrafts village. The terrace decoration is quite nice with cute little corners. We choose two cakes: basque cheesecake and coconut pie. Both were delicious.
review_3_text:
I had a very unpleasant experience at this café.
Even though there was no long line, ordering took an unusually long time. I patiently waited, assuming the staff was simply slow or inexperienced. However, when it was finally my turn, I was rudely dismissed.
There was a very small handwritten sign on the counter saying “NO COFFEE,” which was not clearly visible at all. Instead of apologizing or explaining politely, the staff member aggressively pointed at the sign and repeatedly said “no coffee” in an unfriendly and dismissive manner.
No apology. No explanation. No basic courtesy.
I understand that cafés may run out of items, but how you communicate with customers matters. The attitude here was rude, unprofessional, and completely unnecessary. It ruined what should have been a relaxing visit in an art village.
I would not recommend this place unless they seriously improve their customer service.
review_4_text:
Was exploring Baan Kang Wat and came across this cafe. The place is very inviting because of the aroma of their cooking and also it has a lush interior with greeneries all around. It’s the place to unwind and has some photo spots as well. They also use mix match furniture which gives that eclectic vibe.
Tried out the Chocolate Mousse Cake which has layers of different chocolate mousse. Also got their iced chocolate & juice (which i forgot the name but it’s one of their recommended menu).
Overall the cafe is ok and service is good.
review_5_text: A cozy café thoughtfully designed with an assortment of plants and flowers, providing a peaceful escape from the crowds of people in the market. It's a lovely spot to sit down with a friend and enjoy a coffee and slice of cake after walking around Baan Kang Wat. I enjoyed an Iced Hazelnut Coffee and a piece of apple crumble pie.

name: ขุนเดช TATTOO & CHANIM CAFE
review_1_text: Really relaxing and peaceful cafe with a tattoo studio on the upper floor 🫶🏻 The cafe owner is really sweet and has very good taste in music :)) + cute cats !!
review_2_text: A great spot to have coffee and buy unique souvenirs. The prices here are very affordable. The staff were friendly and welcoming. There's a workshop for accessories and even a tattoo studio. Definitely coming back! :)
review_3_text: Fantastic tattoo and coffeee shop the coffee was divine the owners equally divine and very friendly great English speaking too ! I particularly liked the hand made unique crafts so much I bought quite a bit 😀 the tattoist art is unique, quirky and definitely worth checking out. I was so tempted to have a tattoo but my partner said no more 😞 very clean shop artistic and very trendy
review_4_text:
Good Coffee
Friendly Owner
Nice Atmosphere
Recommended..
review_5_text: Really great cocoa and nice owner.

name: TechSpace Cafe'.CNX
review_1_text: Anyone who want nice place I like to recommend this place good food, good mood so authentic staff really friendly and have really good service feel like home when come here and the price is really reasonable not too expensive if compare with quality Let's come!💗
review_2_text: Come here almost everyday. The staff are cute, always smiling, kind, the shop is very clean. There are a lot of photo spots as well. Even taking a photo of the ceiling is beautiful. The croffle is delicious, I like it the most. The caramel croffle is so delicious that light comes out of your mouth. I like to eat matcha at this shop the most. Pure matcha 9/10, delicious but a bit bitter. The shop gives strong matcha. Matcha latte 10/10, delicious, fragrant, creamy, fragrant matcha. Matcha coconut 9.5/10, ordered unsweetened, it's still delicious. It's a pity that the real coconut water is a full 10. Cocoa 10/10, if you like it strong, you can add more, it's perfect. Thai tea 8/10 Caramel croffle 100000/10💖 Chocolate croffle 10/10 Original croffle 10/10 The croffle is very buttery!! Leave it until it's delicious. You can collect points. Collect 10 points and get a free glass of water. Very marketing. For those who don't drink cow's milk, oat milk can be substituted for an additional 15 baht. There is a lot of parking in the Lan Din project. Parking costs 50 baht, but you can use the coupon to get a 50 baht discount at the shop. Summary: Caramel Croffle✅ Great for social media users, great photos✅ Great staff!✅
review_3_text: The atmosphere is nice and shady, with plenty of photo opportunities. Parking is limited. The drinks are delicious!
review_4_text: I came here to check out the phone. The service is good, the device is beautiful, and the service is good. But the shop is beautiful, and the coffee is very delicious. I'd like you to come and try it. The price is very good. I'll come and support you again.
review_5_text: The shop has a shady atmosphere. It's a phone shop with a cafe inside. So cool! 👍🏻

name: Kessi’s Brunch
review_1_text:
Amazing sandwich breakfast,the portions size is bigger enough filling your stomach.
Coffee also in good quality bean.
Wonderful ,the best breakfast we had in Thailand CNX.
🌞 nice job.
review_2_text: Very friendly and kind staff, they offer oat/soy milk for lattes and have tofu options for food. They're vegetarian/vegan friendly! Really cute vibe in there and I've always been well taken care of, definitely recommend!
review_3_text:
Perhaps the fish filling wasn't enough; it was a bit dry and there was a lot of focaccia, but the chicken and pesto version was good. The coffee was okay.
The staff was friendly and the cafe design was nice. Recommend to visit.
review_4_text: Take it from an Italian living in Thailand for a decade! I come here, I eat, I close my eyes and I taste my childhood! The quality of the products and the presentation are amazing! A RARE GEM 💎 specially in this area! Lucky enough I live near by! The management is very nice and the venue is also stunning! Highly recommended!
review_5_text: I’ve been looking for good bread in chiang mai for a long time and finally found it

name: Farmstory Baankangwat
review_1_text: Really good iced coffee! Asked for an extra shot because otherwise it doesn’t taste that strong. Not the cheapest coffee was around 80-100 baht. Note that it takes 10 minutes to make the coffee! It’s really worth it
review_2_text: ☕️ Excellent variety of coffee beans to choose from. 😊 aromatic beans, freshly ground, prepared by hand with care.  Loved it so much.
review_3_text: We picked this cafe for lunch as it was much quieter and more reasonably priced than others in the area. The thai basil rice and omelette was so tasty we went back for a banh mi and coffee as well. The staff were sweet to us explaining the different coffee and bringing us some cold water for free.  Would highly recommend if you are in the area!
review_4_text: Lovely place. Food served with a smile. The Banh Mi was delicious. The bread was super crunchy! Would definitely come back to try all the coffees!
review_5_text: Filtered coffee was good and big range of beans to try off. You can choose which beans you’re fell in to. I choose Mae Sui

name: ลุงหมานคราฟต์
review_1_text: The uncle provided excellent service and even gave me a discount. I really liked the flower arrangements he made. I'll definitely go back again.
review_2_text: Beautiful work, good quality, I really like it✨

name: Yeedora Cafe
review_1_text: I am always impressed by craftsmen who prepare with care, passion and attention to detail. And of course more importantly is the result and the coffee here at Toki is exactly it. Enjoyed my drip coffee and the shop is really unique and the perfect place to chillax as you get through your insta stories of Baan Kang Wat.
review_2_text: Nice drip coffee and special experience of craft cola, very similar to coke but more sour
review_3_text: If you like drip coffee like me, you will enjoy this 😺
review_4_text: Well, I enjoy drip coffee, but for my taste, I only feel the acidity rather than the body, and the beans don't quite suit me, but the atmosphere is good. I think I'll drink drip coffee in Korea~~

name: Maepoon Moosatay
review_1_text: Lovely place for photos, smoothie is good

name: Lamour Cafe & Restaurant
review_1_text:
Attended a wedding here where a Thai ceremony was conducted in the afternoon and a more western style dinner was held at night. Layout and decor is beautiful, and I hear plenty of such events are held here.

The owner is very hospitable and all staff were very friendly and accommodating.

Food was delicious and service was excellent. Highly recommended, especially if you wish to have a romantic meal.
review_2_text:
2026.1.14 (Thurs)

What a lovely find by 2 of my friends when we were visiting Bang Kang Wat artisanal village. You are transported to Europe and forget you are in Chiang Mai. They literally hibernated here while I went gallivanting at BKW.

The range of drinks is extensive and creative. This cafe is a destination in itself. Especially for weddings 💒 think. Many instagrammable  spots.
review_3_text:
⭐ Google Maps Review for Lamour Café & Restaurant (ลามูร์คาเฟ่ เชียงใหม่)
📍 Suthep, Mueang Chiang Mai District, Chiang Mai 50200

Tucked away in the quiet Suthep area, Lamour Café & Restaurant is a hidden gem where elegant presentation meets heartfelt Thai flavors. 🌸🇹🇭

Every dish feels like a celebration of Thai culinary tradition — crafted with balance, color, and care. The plating alone is stunning, with banana leaves, gold trays, and fresh flowers enhancing every detail.

🍴 Highlights we loved:

ไข่เจียวฟูกรอบ – light, crispy, and fluffy, perfectly golden and paired with sweet chili and tomato sauces.

ไก่กอและ – Southern-style grilled chicken marinated in rich coconut and curry paste, smoky, tender, and full of flavor.

แกงฮังเล – a deeply spiced Northern curry that’s rich and comforting, beautifully paired with fresh vegetables and crispy roti.

ผัดสะตอกะปิหมูสามชั้น – bold, spicy, and fragrant; the combination of stink beans and pork belly is absolutely addictive.

ออเดิร์ฟเมืองเหนือ – a full Northern appetizer platter with nam prik, sausage, pork crackling, and fresh vegetables — a true Chiang Mai classic that brings together the best of the region.

🌿 Ambience:
