Refined and tranquil, with a Lanna-style touch that feels luxurious yet homey. Perfect for families, gatherings, or anyone looking to enjoy authentic Thai cuisine in an elegant setting.

💬 Service:
Excellent hospitality — warm, attentive, and knowledgeable. The team takes time to explain dishes and ensure guests have the best experience possible.

⭐ Verdict:
A perfect blend of Northern charm, authentic flavors, and refined presentation. Every dish tells a story of Thai culinary heritage, elevated with grace and heart.
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ Highly recommended!
review_4_text: It is a nice place, with Garden and big Trees. A bit old and used and not very clean. The Staff is different, but friendly. The Food is mostly Thai, well presented and okay, but completely overprized for what you get, no value for money.
review_5_text: This place is so beautiful.  The care put into the esthetics and ambience is so apparent.  You really feel like you're in a palace garden. There was lovely live music playing and you're surrounded by lush greenery. Very authentic feeling and great menu. I highly recommend this restaurant.

name: Pangfan Coffee
review_1_text: Christmas Vibe Cafe. Really enjoyed the croissants as well as the dirty coffee I had. In fact I think the croissants are some of the best I've had in Chiang Mai. Extremely fresh and they do toast them which is really good. Owner is very nice as well I've spoken to him a few times and his English is very good. They don't have much of a restaurant menu so mostly what you can order is what you see in the front display.
review_2_text:
One of the best chilling cafe around here. There're many things that I'm fond of..

- Clean air : The smog in here is almost free (6-10) while outside is around 200. The temperature is just nice as well.
- Friendly with customers : They provided free pillows and blankets which are cleaned really well. You're free to nap, leaning, chating or whatever.
- Spacious, many type of tables, chairs, and sofa

The price is average. There's some discount on the cakes sometimes.

I'd suggest you give it a go if you want to chill around in the smoke-free cafe.

Updated : provided free printing
review_3_text:
Great coffee spot with plenty of parking and ample space for anyone who needs to do work. Lots of comfortable chairs, including the big plush loveseats you see in tv shows.

Really delicious north Thailand coffee on offer here, very good to start the day! Highly recommend!
review_4_text: A cool Coffee Shop with nice atmosphere. Friendly Staff, Carpark in the front of the door
review_5_text: Very good coffee shop both for working or just hanging out, it has an incredibly comfy seating area with many different options: couches, comfy chairs, regular chairs, bar chairs etc. Part of the coffee shop is also colder so depending on preference you can choose what temperature you like. Very relaxing and cozy jazz music, super friendly staff. Tons of places to charge devices. Also oat milk only costs 15baht extra so cheaper than most other places ☺️for my needs I’d say it’s one of the best coffee shops in Chiang mai

name: Sensation Coffee Roasters
review_1_text:
Revisited one of the best coffee roasters in Thailand.

They just have moved to a new location, around 300 meters away from the previous setting. I just edited the location, hope Google Maps will fix it soon.

The roasters offer ultra-premium bean selection. Upon my visit, they have Deborah, Ethiopia ALO, El Salto.
review_2_text:
BEST Breakfast Sandwich in all of Chiang Mai. Don’t miss the bacon egg and cheese roll.

Coffee also top notch!
review_3_text: Absolutely sensational cafe. While it might be on the higher end price-wise, you certainly get what you pay for. The high quality beans create a coffee experience that is unlike most other cafes in the area or even city. I particularly appreciate that they were able to really bring out the chocolate notes of their drinks. At the same time, the atmosphere of the cafe makes it the sort of place that you could easily catch up with a friend or read a gripping novel.
review_4_text: Very good house blend roast coffee; they can extract the finest taste from coffee beans. We ordered the orange espresso and house blend beans cappuccino. This is the top coffee spot in the area. The bakery also offers good options to go along with the cup. The staff is very nice and can provide detailed information. We confirm that this shop is recommended.
review_5_text: A great coffee shop with top of the line local beans. It’s rare to get this high quality. The matcha tea was delicious. The atmosphere is smooth with a lot of trees and greenery. Fitting if you want to enjoy the nature.

name: Kindred Studio
review_1_text: Great space with magical art. There’s poetry reading here every month. Cozy, friendly warm people. Events on all year round. I would come here each time I visit Chiang Mai.
review_2_text:
Nice and cosy atmosphere for the show of Tall Mark

I recommend this place to watch events

PS: you could add a bit of sugar in the ginger lemongrass though
review_3_text: A chill, comfortable space in the middle of a food-centered marketplace. Refreshments are mostly homemade. It really comes into its own as a literary and small performance space hosting readings, open mic and performance
review_4_text: Went to the open mic, the talent and variety was excellent. Staff were lovely and friendly. I'll definitely be back 🧡🙏🏻
review_5_text: I went with some friends to an art and bass night. Its a cozy space with everything we needed. Everyone was friendly and it had a nice atmosphere.

name: MaliPai Roastery & Cafe
review_1_text: Very lovely place to sit still and let time pass by.  Very nice garden with huge Tamarind tree spread its branch cover.  The coffee shop that put a lot of thought and effort in it.
review_2_text: Love this space but more for their space than the refreshments. There are 2 outdoor spaces...each on either side. One has a water element (pond and such) and the seating is super cute, but there's not much coverage and can get very hot. The other covered in greenery and has fans and misters. The seating is super cute and spread out...super comfortable element out here and my preferred seating area...and they're open an hour later than the other cafes in the area. This allows me to hang out just a bit longer.
review_3_text: This is one of my favorite cafes in CM, and I live here. It has a lovely garden, is quiet and peaceful. The people are kind, coffee is excellent, and they have the sweetest golden retriever you’ve ever met. Highly recommended!
review_4_text: Many boutique coffee shops have opened in Chiang Mai recently, selling what is claimed to be high quality coffee at a hefty price. However, the coffee at Mali Pai is superior in quality and a good deal less expensive. The coffee is locally grown and roasted at the shop.
review_5_text:
Garden themed coffee shop - cool without air conditioning on a warm day. With the garden you can expect some mosquitoes.

There is a focus on detail and a desire to please that you will feel. The building itself is quite beautiful.
As usual with these shops iced drinks are served with 90% ice / 10% beverage. After paying 80 baht for their “Signature” drink I left feeling thirsty.

I had:
Iced Orange Expresso 80 baht
Slice of Apple Pie 70 baht

Nice staff and location. There are better overall experiences out there.

name: SoulHouse — Self-Discovery Playground
review_1_text:
I love this creative space and community. Very chilled cozy atmosphere, the owner Good and the staff/tutor are super friendly. I was made to feel so welcome there.

There are many events and workshops. I tried out the Chinese ink painting and clayground all day Saturday workshop with some friends. It was fun, relaxing and playful. Suitable for anyone who wants to do something creative but having fun at the same time.

They also sell coffee, pizza and pastas there. My favourite was the truffle pizza.

Highly recommend if you’re in Chiang Mai and want to do something different and creative
review_2_text: Such a warm and welcoming café! The food and homemade bread, especially the bagels, are super delicious. They have many creative workshops like pottery and bead-making, which are both relaxing and fun. The staff are very kind, the atmosphere feels like home, and it’s pet-friendly - our dog was so happy in the air-conditioned room. Truly my favorite café!
review_3_text: Wow I had the best time here for my birthday!! Lovely teacher, she helped us when needed, it was SO fun. Fun thing to do with a group of girls. They also brought out a cake for me 😇 thank you ka
review_4_text: A lovely place where your beautiful soul will be empowered and uplifted. I love this homemade Begel and cream cheese. They just serve new food menu, mainly pizza and pasta. The price is average.
review_5_text: A friend and I did the Christmas wreath making workshop and we had so much fun! The staff were very kind and helpful and everybody's wreaths turned out beautifully. It was also very reasonably priced. 10/10!

name: FINE HOMESTAY & Local crafts shop
review_1_text:
The service by the owner left us feeling uninvited, even when purchasing items. Firstly I enter the store and ask if I need to take off shoes and she just points to her shoes, with a blank expression.

There’s no changing room so you need to try items on top of your clothes, which we did respectfully. The whole time we are admiring clothes and giving them a go on top of our clothes- she continues being blunt and uninviting. The only time she speaks is after my friend puts the dress she tried on back on the rack,  she finally talks to us saying “ is that not good for you”. My friend politely responds they are nice but not as much on her body. She doesn’t respond or smile and we are left leaving that they just have a pay and go away attitude.

We end up buying hand made side bags (three of them) despite her acting like our presence was a burden. My friend grabs a pair of pants to try and she bluntly and in a tone says shoes off twice even though my friend hadn’t even began putting them on. Mind you, we are being so friendly with smiles despite these interactions trying to make up for the tense energy. After paying, my friend asks to use her cafe bathroom and she says no.

I don’t know what her problem is but you can communicate if something is wrong, we asked about shoes, tried over our clothes and admired everything without trying to disrupt anything. Although items are cute I could not endorse others to spend their money over other places that actually want to make potential customers feel welcome.
review_2_text:
Feeling safe & satisfied of my staying here. Public area’s clean and free to use.
I love the lychi coffee very much.
And thanks to Pui’s treat!
review_3_text:
My first time in Chiang Mai and Fine Homestay & Pui gave me a warm welcome.
- Location is great, somewhat in more local & less tourist area. It is surrounded by nature, many great restaurants in walking distance. If you love the green, the nature, then this is the best location in Chiang Mai (after Fine Homestay, we tried other areas to experience and we realized that Fine Homestay's the best when it comes to being close to the nature). Get up early and take a walk around the neighborhood, it feels so greattt!.
- The room is super cozy and clean. Strong wifi for online working. Just feels like home. Just some noise at night as the house is on the street, but just put on the earplugs (provided by Pui) and you will be fine.
- Pui is a super host. She is caring, attentive, kind and so helpful. She gave us lots of recommendation for good restaurants. She also surprised us with tea and fresh fruits sometimes
review_4_text:
We stayed at FINE Homestay for a month as a couple, and it was an absolutely delightful experience. The house is warm, welcoming, and incredibly comfortable – we slept so well every single night! The host, Pui, is truly one of a kind. She is sweet, caring, and always ready to help with anything you need. From offering great local tips to surprising us with fresh fruit as a welcome gift, she made sure our stay felt special and hassle-free.

If you’re looking for a cozy and relaxing place with a host who genuinely cares about her guests, we can’t recommend FINE Homestay enough. We’d happily stay here again!
review_5_text: Beautiful cozy clean homestay in a great location. The owner is such a nice attentive person. During my stay I was even given many little surprise delicacies like a homemade yogurt. I can only recommend! It’s definitely a homestay I would return to next time.

name: Mo.cha cafe - โมฉะ คาเฟ่
review_1_text:
This is a great little chill coffee house near the art show. The patio on the back is very relaxing & there was a nice cool breeze the afternoon I went.

Wonderful service and a really great iced mocha!

10/10 nice!
review_2_text: A great place to chill near the busy art marketplace, nice and quiet, I love their matcha latte, the taste is just nice!
review_3_text: Lovely place with lots of space indoors and outdoors, great to work on a laptop there! The coffee is delicious and BIG, staff was friendly and attentive :) will be coming back!
review_4_text:
The place’s signature menu seemed to be match latte. I ordered and loved it!! It was very quite and peaceful place as well as nice staffs.
Match latte was just as perfect, not too sweet, not too milky. But there’re not many seats available in the cafe
review_5_text: Delicious drinks & cool atmosphere with lovely staff.

name: Baan Rom Mai Bali
review_1_text:
Nice atmosphere
Food is average
service is average
Price is too expensive
review_2_text: Services slow in the day time. Staff playing phone while working , taking long time to make a food but it’s tasty.
review_3_text: This place really surprised me. Amazing band on Thursdays. Food was fantastic. The staff were helpful although there is very little english spoken. Its private and quiet most days a week and then all of a sudden its packed to the brim with locals and travellers. Check it out. You won't be disappointed.
review_4_text:
The food was poor and expensive. My dinner genuinely smelt like wet dog. By far the worst meal I’ve had in Thailand in 6 weeks. Staff were pleasant but I would seriously avoid coming here. Not sure why the reviews aren’t worse.

I’ve had a stomach ache all night and next morning.
review_5_text: very good thai kitchen, very tasteful, god place for a nice dinner, live music, parking space available....

name: Beanbag coffee
review_1_text:
☕ The Ultimate Cozy Work Cafe in Chiang Mai! 🥐

This spot is absolutely perfect for a working day. They completely tick all the boxes: convenient parking and a comfortable working area with great vibes.

Their many seating selection makes it incredibly comfortable while enjoying their excellent drinks and fresh bakeries.

Beyond the great space, the staff truly stands out. Their friendliness is the first thing you notice and instantly makes the place feel welcoming.

Considering the high quality and comfortable vibe, the prices are definitely affordable and offer great value. If you need a cozy and wallet-friendly place to chill or work with your laptop in Chiang Mai, you can't miss this one! 👍
review_2_text: A place worth visiting. The coffee is delicious and the people are very friendly. The gravel road at the entrance is a bit slippery, so other people coming here must be very careful. I fell down by accident lol But the owner of the store is very good and provided me with basic medical care. I am very grateful. Thai people are really nice. I love Thailand!
review_3_text:
Consumer Advice.

The atmosphere, the staff and the drinks are good. I wanted to update my review as I feel I had been a bit too harsh in my previous review.

While the ice is a bit too much, I would recommend people to ask about the ice levels of their drinks first before ordering as it can be quite a lot. Really other than this there is nothing wrong with this cafe. Simply an issue of ice level.

This review is for others to consider before ordering their drinks.
review_4_text: A lovely place with great coffee and friendly staff. Huge carpark is a plus as well
review_5_text: There are three sofa seats for more than three people in the store, while the others are double seats. The environment is very good, with many green plants. The waitress is also very friendly, but when we went yesterday, the coffee machine broke down and we didn't drink freshly ground coffee. It's a pity that the bread is very soft and delicious

name: City Camp
review_1_text: The food is very delicious and unique. It was such a convenient place, people can dine outside in the spacious patio while the kids can also play in a mini playground.
review_2_text: Charming and unique place. I don’t like mala spice,so it was unpleasantly surprising that they spiced the chicken wings with that.
review_3_text: I really like the atmosphere and food at this place—it’s usually a great experience. But this time, the mala skewers were quite salty. Also, it was a bit difficult to get the waiter’s attention when we needed something.
review_4_text:
That'ld be a nice choice for a date at this Romantic Camp vibe restaurant...
You have to order the foods&drinks with scanning the QR Or have to ask the waiter& waitress...
The Mala BBQ and Hotpot are the popular menu of the restaurant.
You will come again if you wanna avoid the typical live band playing Bar& Restaurants...
review_5_text: Good atmosphere to chill with friends. Good for party and functions at night time. Will come and again. Love to visit here

name: What the COFF Chiang Mai
review_1_text: The best hot cappuchino 40 baht can buy. It came back just for the coffee.
review_2_text: Coffee shop in the city center. Hey!!! I didn't think it would be this delicious. The taste is good. The coffee is fragrant. The atmosphere in the shop is also good. Although the shop is a bit small, the price per cup is about 45 baht if it's iced coffee. I recommend this shop.
review_3_text: A coffee shop with a great atmosphere. Strong and delicious coffee. There are many menus. Iced tea, green tea, both green tea with milk and matcha green tea. You can choose. I really like it. Cocoa, soda. The music in the shop is fun.
review_4_text: Affordable prices, delicious taste, and they even have a vehicle inspection service! Friendly baristas, great-tasting coffee, and a beautiful shop.
review_5_text: The taste is delicious. The green tea is very good. The price is also cute. It's also a car inspection station. Very convenient.

name: Fact Cafe
review_1_text: I would like to give more stars, but I can't. The meal was very slow coming out to us. Maybe my fault, was we were in the cafe and not the restaurant itself. No napkins on the table or anywhere in the restaurant was surprising. Did I mention slow? I was in a hurry to get somewhere else and that may effect my score a little. We did get the corn spicy salad that was good, although not spicy like I like it.
review_2_text: Omg. One of the worst coffee I ever had in chiang mai.  A good example of the nice place but the core business is not good.  Coffee quality is bad. 60 baht with bad bean.  Ur profit margin must be huge.
review_3_text: I like latte and latte art there. There are seats you can spend time on working or taking photos.
review_4_text: Good place to relax. Coffee/Cake was ok with ambience great. Price was also good for location.
review_5_text: Nice coffee clean and quiet

name: Ragdoll
review_1_text:
Best Butter Croissant I have had in Chiang Mai. Worth coming by if you enjoy expertly made croissant.

Spacious seating area with the typical soft, calming music and pleasant air conditioning. Set a bit off of the road I felt separated from the usual noise and busyness of life.

I would have liked more coffee choices - there are very few. Is there a bathroom available? A sign would be helpful.

I have no idea how they stay open with four
employees and so much space.

I will be happy to return and can easily recommend you have a visit. Yummy. 😃
review_2_text:
Very new cafe’ drink and cake really good
Iced americano is recommended menu
review_3_text:
The place is simply decorated, nice but not a place for those photo frenzy.
But seem they are more focussing on the bakery and the taste is worth trying.
A plus is hospitality of the owner/person in charge, very kind.
review_4_text:
Amazing pastries. Definitely the best Pain Au Chocolat you could find in Chiang Mai! So happy that Chiang Mai finally has decent croissants and Pain Au Chocolat. Again, I am a HUGE fan!

P.S.  The First time that I was there, I had an issue with one of the staff about her hygiene knowledge. She gave me change with her bare hand and after that she pick up my chocolate cake with her bare hand... I was furious and made a complain here. The owner apologized and said they will have this problem solved. When I was back again everything went well and they never did that again! thank you for the improvement of your service. I am a royal customer now!
review_5_text: Every time I've been here, I've only ever ordered the iced mint americano. It is surprisingly delicious...and quite refreshing. They also have cold brewed coffee but always run out before I get to try it. I'll have to go earlier. My favorite item though, is their croffle (croissant waffle). I've had about 3 flavors so far and they're all amazing. My fav at the moment is the gruéyre and honey.

name: Chim Chill Coffee & Food
review_1_text: Love the environment. The boss is super chill and friendly. Food is amazing. You might not want to miss Thai green tea and avocado shrimp scramble toast there as it’s a great choice for your afternoon tea time. Incredible experience!
review_2_text: Cheap, amazing food and the owners are so so cute! They made changes for my allergy and came to check up if I liked it! Also a cheaper stop before going to the artist village!!
review_3_text: Absolutely love this place. It’s run by a super friendly married couple. The vibes are really chill and relaxed and all the food I’ve had has been great. Perfect spot to eat authentic Thai dishes in a nice setting and at a good price! Oh and the homemade lychee soda is 🔥🔥
review_4_text: Closed. Sunday 15:25 and it is closed. Imagine our disappointment. We came here especially to visit this cafe. Maybe it is nice. But we don't know. Because IT IS CLOSED. And at the same time Google maps shows that it is open. Why you do it? I don't know. People are loosing their valuable time and efforts because of such issues.
review_5_text:
Best coffee I've had in Thailand!
Nice little brunch menu, with lunch options- executed very well. Sourdough bread was a treat!
Service was thoughtful, friendly and quick. 10/10!

name: MaLee เครื่องปั่น
กาแฟมิราเคิล กองบิน41
review_1_text: The taste is delicious and really suits my taste.
review_2_text: Delicious coffee, strong flavor, affordable price👍👍👍

name: KOBION CAFE WING 41
review_1_text:
The coffee shop at Air Force Base 41 (outsiders might need to exchange their ID card ^^).
The shop is spacious, with plenty of seating, and the air conditioning is nice and cool. It's not crowded, and it's great that you can get oat milk for free. Nice!

name: Inthanin Coffee
review_1_text: So I stopped in here to wait for a friend ordered an Americano. I was expecting bitter harsh taste. Instead I got a smooth almost cold brew like cup. Really great surprise. They have WiFi couches and seats. I didn't see any outlets though. Prices range from 35  to 80. Smoothie 65 and have prepackaged pastries and what not.
review_2_text: Lovely place, great staff and great coffee.
review_3_text: Good coffee good price but no free water !!!
review_4_text: Again something that said open but unable to make coffee.
review_5_text:
Intanin, a coffee shop located in a Bangchak gas station,
at a branch in Chiang Mai near the airport.
The shop is large and spacious, with chairs, a bar, and tables. It can accommodate about 15 people inside and another 4 people outside in a garden setting.
I was visiting Chiang Mai today, so I stopped by this cafe to meet up with my team. They have everything.
I ordered a hot Americano for 40 baht (members get a discount, so it's 35 baht).
I also ordered a croissant for 40 baht. It was incredibly soft and smooth, and delicious.
The shop is open from 6:00 AM to 7:00 PM.
If you're passing through, stop by and enjoy a meal. The staff are friendly and helpful. They also sell souvenirs.

name: Minimal coffee แยกสนามบิน
review_1_text: This is my 2nd visit to a Minimal coffee shop and is now my ‘go to’ place in Chiang Mai for a hot dark roast cappuccino!! .  Nice size of cup, great price, open early, clean, modern, AC, and lovely attentive staff. Well done in a saturated market,
review_2_text: Very good coffee, different roasts available, reasonable prices, enjoy
review_3_text:
The shop is clean, the air conditioning is cool, and the coffee is delicious.
Parking is difficult, so you'll have to find street parking. The coffee is standard for a minimalist shop, and prices start at just 45-50 baht. If you're looking for coffee, stop by and enjoy a cup. You can collect points and get a cup of coffee from this shop. It's great!
review_4_text: The shop is small and cute, with cool air conditioning and plenty of seating. The drinks are delicious. The staff are cheerful, agile, and provide excellent service.
review_5_text: The staff at the shop are all very friendly and provide excellent service. The coffee tastes great, absolutely delicious! You have to try it!

name: เทลเลอร์คอฟฟี่
ป่าแดด Cafe
review_1_text: Pork hot pot, grilled intestines, mala sauce... so much fun! ❤️😘😋

name: หอมกลิ่นชา
Alchemy Vegan
review_1_text: I had a great experience at Alchemy Vegan. I ordered the Burmese tea leaf salad and the hummus pesto on toast, and everything was fresh, flavorful, and beautifully prepared. The atmosphere is warm and welcoming, making it a perfect spot to relax and enjoy a delicious vegetarian meal. Highly recommended!
review_2_text:
Was searching for a good veg restaurant at chaing mai and finally found this out.  had Buddha bowl bursting with fresh, vibrant flavors 🥗,  then comes the Rich, nutty sesame milk that’s smooth and comforting 😋
my fav Fried rice perfectly seasoned, churros crisp and indulgent 🍚🍩Cozy ambience with limited space, but staff are super helpful and friendly ☕✨😊 but Green Thai noodles were a bit too spicy for our taste 🌶️
review_3_text: I ordered in churros from this place, which were really good! It came with two dips - Chocolate and Caramel. Both really good but the caramel was insanely good. I ordered the cinnamon sugar churros - I don't don't think they are always available but if you do get a chance, order it! Also, they gave me 6pcs instead of 4😄which were huge and good enough to share.
review_4_text: I’ve eaten at Alchemy Vegan a few times now, and it’s one of my favorite vegan restaurants in town. Every visit I get the Thai milk tea with oat milk — it’s creamy and delicious! The green salad with avocado and lime dressing is fresh and pairs perfectly with the sourdough. I also love the cheesy olive toast — the vegan cheese is rich and satisfying. And don’t skip the chocolate cake! It’s decadent, definitely big enough to share. The space is calm, the staff are kind, and it’s always a great spot to relax and enjoy a good meal.
review_5_text:
Ticked all the boxes for clean and well-prepared vegan food. Hummus toast was particularly well done and the Burmese salad was unique in its subtlety. Moderately priced for the size and quality but “restaurant prices” still. My three dishes and cake and tea came to around 600baht.
Good representative of well made vegan food that can find something for everyone.

name: Artisan Café
review_1_text: I had the best matcha latte with oat milk here since I came to Chiang Mai. I ordered one hot matcha to drink in their charming and comfortable seating and took an iced matcha to go in my travel mug. Both were equally delicious. My partner ordered a house made cold brew coffee. He said it was delicious too and came with a single, huge round ice cube in a low ball cocktail glass. Nice touch. This place is classy and quirky with nice tea cups, glasses, couches, and other interesting furniture.
review_2_text: I had iced coffee and it was very good.  However, I came here mostly for the beautiful decor and comfy chairs.  It’s a good place to sit and work for a while.
review_3_text: Another good coffee shop to try in Chiang Mai. Their coffee is good and made very well. They have good desserts, a couple of different cookies and some croissants. We chose one of each. The one near old town has a bit more seating than the one near Nimman, which is why we chose this location. This coffee shop has a bit more choices than some of the other coffee shops we have rated. This is probably our second favorite shop in Chiang Mai. Highly recommended.
review_4_text: My husband and I came here many times during our stay in CM. This place is perfect for breakfast. Great coffee, great Bagel, great environment and the owner and staff are all very friendly. If we come back to CM will definitely visit again 🙏
review_5_text: Reduced rating for the coffee as very small cup for 75 baht. It's tasty but nothing great. Very nice cafe setting with a couple of people working online.

name: THREE CHIANG MAI
review_1_text:
Great coffee place.
Found this cafe accidentally by passing near it.
Tasty coffee, professional serving, calm music, stylish interior.
Highly recommend! ✨
review_2_text:
If you’re in the mood for a good cup of coffee, this place is worth checking out. It’s a bit pricey for Chiang Mai, but totally fair for the quality. Their house blend already hit the spot for me.

Good vibe. Good-taste cafe.
review_3_text: After three weeks of trying well-reviewed coffee shops, this is the first place I'd recommend if someone asked me where to go for good, interesting coffee. Both the flat white and the pour over were excellent, and really interesting beans too. Tasting notes appeared really clearly in the cup
review_4_text:
Date of Visit: August 24th

I visited because I heard this place has won many awards. The coffee had a bit of acidity, but the taste was not bad. It's cool and quiet, making it a good spot to get some work done. Since there's a Saturday market nearby, it would be nice to take a break here before heading to the market.
review_5_text: Great coffee in a comfy little hipster environment.  Coffee is a little on the pricy side but it’s not excessive.  Really cool decor and interior, there’s a table and several individual desks with power points if you want to come and work.  There’s a bathroom and super fast WiFi in house. I love the lighting and choice of lighting. #BeatTheGrind

name: นราชาชัก ถนนวัวลาย เชียงใหม่
review_1_text: I picked up thai milk tea and it was cheap and good.
review_2_text:
Very kind, helpful people.
We as backpackers were asking directions to the Taxi and they took all the time out of their day to help us. He even booked us a Taxi, as we couldn't book one.

The Thai coffee with milk was delicious.

Thanks again!

Mike and Mia 😁
review_3_text: The service at this shop was excellent! There was a slight problem with my order from another branch, but the Wualai branch helped resolve it. The drinks were delicious! I will definitely be a regular customer.
review_4_text:
I usually order Thai tea with milk and tea leaves.
But recently, they've been offering fresh coffee, which I don't get very often. It's bitter.
review_5_text: A small but warm shop

name: Earnt Daw Coffee @ Wualai เอิ้นดาว กาแฟ @วัวลาย
review_1_text:
We are not digital nomads. We are a couple on their honeymoon and I am Italian. Thus said, we probably came on their unluckiest day, ad we decided to pay and leave after one sip at our cappuccino (too liquid and way too much bitter coffee tasting) and one tiny taste from our pre baked, low quality croissants.
Not even a question or concern for our untouched breakfast and insanely over priced too, as we paid 237 baht for nothing.
review_2_text: I just got a simple iced Americano and it was really delicious. There is a lot of seating available & they have AC & free wifi. The lady who made my coffee was very welcoming and friendly. Affordable prices & great tasting coffee. I think it would be nice if there was plant milk alternatives available. :)
review_3_text: What a great local shop with amazing staff! Natthanit made us her favorite mango slushy and some fresh coffee. If you’re in the area stop by! The prices are great too!
review_4_text: Excellent coffee. Staff are friendly & professional. Love the relaxed vibe and convenience of this establishment. I love Chiang Mai & The Land of Smiles 😊 . Thank you, guys x
review_5_text: A very nice coffee and food shop. If you are in the mood for a great experience you will not be disappointed in the customer service as well as the drink and food selections. I was pleasently surprised with the Spinach and Cheese  Croissant which was amazing. The staff is very well trained and were very pleasent and had a great conversation with them. If your driving feel free to park in the large adjacent parking lot. I love walking in this area and I is the location of the saturday nite market. Make sure you stop in to say hi and take a mug shot!

name: Weave Artisan Society
review_1_text:
Weave Artisan Society has become one of my favorite places in Chiang Mai. It is this big, open warehouse style cafe that feels trendy yet still a bit off the beaten path for most digital nomads, so you get a really nice mix of locals and entrepreneurs. It is usually not overly busy, the vibe is relaxed, and the coffee and food are good.

It is also a great and somewhat unexpected place to invite clients or partners for meetings, because the space feels professional without being stiff. Me and some friends have also hosted events there recently and the venue has been very accommodating and easy to work with.

They recently opened the new coworking space upstairs, which I am renting on a monthly basis, and I absolutely love it. The team is very accommodating, the layout never feels overcrowded, and there is a lot of flexibility for how you want to work or meet people. They keep making thoughtful improvements, and I am genuinely looking forward to seeing how the space continues to grow.
review_2_text:
Very good vibe. Coffee was decent, kept me aware for the meet-up I came to attend.
Can improve on more comfortable sitting arrangements though, but not a big deal.
review_3_text: The place is lovely and WiFi is super fast (400mbps upload and downs load). When you order something at the bar, they’ll give you the voucher for the WiFi which last 3 hours. We had an almond latte and didn’t really like it, I think in some way they burned the milk hence the strange taste.
review_4_text:
Lovely space - great location in the old town and the coworking space is beautiful and the cafe is great with awesome coffee and pastries. Wifi is fast, chairs are nice, everything is brand new.

Unfortunately,  there are a couple of things that need to be sorted before it can compare with other spaces in Chiang Mai.

The first is that there is no free water (I have never seen this at any co work space in Chiang Mai), secondly,  the day pass only allows you to stay until 5pm. That doesn't make sense for most people.

I asked if it were possible to stay until 6pm as a one off, that wasn't an option, I was told to go down to the cafe at 5pm, even though there was just 2 people working in the large space...
review_5_text:
This is a good art space for sharing.

There are art exhibitions from time to time.

Even when there is no exhibition

The coffee here is also good.

Treat it as a place to rest or communicate.

There is also a chocolate shop inside.

It is a relatively famous restaurant in Chiang Mai.

A branch was opened here.

This art exhibition is average.

But it made me like this place.

name: INDIAN Bites Cafe & Vegetarian and Vegan Restaurant
review_1_text:
Great veggie food. Lovely service. The recommend (their specialty) dish is excellent.

The garlic nan is very good.

Indian restaurants in Thailand are on the pricey side.. which I don’t know why.. so we would go when we crave for Indian food!!!

Highly recommended!
review_2_text:
Our first Gujarati and Indian restaurant in Chiang Mai so we were excited. The staff was nice and friendly and took us in right away. The restaurant is located on a tourist friendly street. Here’s what we ordered:

Poha: texture and flavor on point! There’s a ton of ways to make poha and the way it was made was just right. Potatoes were soft and the sev on top gave a nice crispy texture.

Omlett sandwich: my wife absolutely loved it - the toast was crispy and the omlett on point. Very well made.

Franky paneer: filled with a lot of spices and boy was it amazing! Fist time having a Franky paneer and I was not disappointed.

Dabeli: my favorite dish on the menu! The masalo was on point and bread crispy. It’s also one of my favorite Indian dishes so I was happy to try such a dish here.

Ragda samosa: one of the least favorite dishes because the dish was soggy. However, the samosa itself was great.
review_3_text:
Genuinely some of the best Indian food I’ve ever had.

We had the vada, samosas, chapati, palak paneer curry, puris. It was all fantastic!

The waiter was friendly and the owner/cook came out after and asked how our food was.

We had no issues getting a table and rocked up around 7pm and got seated straight away.

This is one NOT one to be missed.
Thank you for the delicious food!
review_4_text:
Yup! What a nice place: the service is really friendly (and the dishes are vegan-friendly)

I had the channa masala, chapati, garlic naan, and bhajji.

Finished off with a soy indian tea :) very cardamom-y (but not overpowering). I asked for a little bit of sugar and the sweetness was perfect for me. They provided a sugar pack on the side if I wished to add more.

Thank you!

🙏🙏🙏✨✨✨
review_5_text: We had a wonderful dinner here! As beginners to Indian food, the very kind owner took the time to explain the dishes, which made the experience even better. We shared the combination platter and every bite was full of amazing flavour. Modern, clean interior with comfortable air-conditioning. Highly recommended!

name: Beam&Col. coffee bar
review_1_text:
Suitable for remote work! Prices are reasonable for beverages, less than 100 baht. They have coworking space on second floor: 180baht per day or 250baht with coffee included. But, in general, the first floor offers decent tables and seats for work. Internet connection is unstable but if you have your own router, should be fine! Definitely recommend it!
Obs: they accept payments using Moretta!
review_2_text:
hidden gem!
Stumbled across the place, a giant hall/garage type of house renovated into a space, very chill and cozy, love to spend a whole afternoon here.

Coffee not cheap, I remember my flat white is 85B, comparing to normal small cafe. But understandably as the space and atmosphere, it plays nice music too.

totally recommend to come, experience and chill.
review_3_text:
Beam&Col. Coffee Bar, located inside Weave Artisan Society, has the charm of an old warehouse with a spacious and comfortable atmosphere.

The large space offers good distance between tables, making it ideal for working or using a laptop. While the drinks are decent, the environment is perfect for productivity and relaxation.
review_4_text: Internet speed is so fast around 250-300 mbps. Creamy marsmellow latte was exceptional. Architecture and atmosphere on point. Perfect place for remote working. Only problem is that their internet credit seems to limited for 3 hours per order. So it seems you have to order regularly but that’s okey for what you get
review_5_text:
This review is for the coffee shop inside Weave Artisan. The coffee is just ok, taste is not so nice and the temperature was a bit confused. But every time I visit I find the staffs attitude sucks. No hello, no thank you, no smile. Today I picked up 2 waters and was about to place a coffee order when the server just barked “40 baht” at me.
I won’t be going back - even road side coffee stalls give a nicer service and they don’t charge 85baht for a latte.

name: ma lune (มาลูน) Thai Specialty Coffee Roaster
review_1_text:
I was thrilled when I realized Ma Lune was located across the street from the hotel I stayed at for 11 days. The owner, Ja, roasts local beans and serves them alongside a limited food menu with the help of one or two others. He’s a coffee enthusiast sharing his passion with whoever drops in - make conversation with him, try his incredible light roast espressos or drips, he may give you a taste of his latest roasts. The all day breakfast is a hearty, delicious meal but I only had it once, choosing to explore Thai options for food instead.

Recommend going before 9:30am or it might be 20 minutes til your order is made - this place gets busy with expats remote working in the mid morning.

Thank you Ma Lune for making such a lasting impression on me. I hope to visit you again in the future!
review_2_text:
Great coffee, made with clear passion and enthusiasm by the owner. Getting to taste such nice examples of Thai specialty-grade coffees is amazing.

This is clearly a place operated by someone who truly loves coffee. The DF60 grinder, with an 1zpresso handgrinder sitting next to it, a pair of fellow stagg kettles, and some fresh brew dripping from the v60 - behind the counter is someone who wants nothing more than to share the coffee they've roasted and offer the absolute best way of experiencing it.

Their tasting notes are right on the mark, too, which speaks to the experience and palate of the owner.

Every specialty coffee lover passing through Chiang Mai should go and experience this.
review_3_text: Trendy place in Chiang Mai. Good selection of local coffee beans to serve in drip. In meniu big variety of breakfast/brunch options. Worth to try.
review_4_text: Vibe is comfy and adorable, service is great and staff greeted  us welcomely with a smile. Matcha was perfect and ginger lemon drink was refreshing. Would definitely recommend this peaceful relaxing cafe
review_5_text: Had cacao and all-day-breakfast and was not disappointed! Very tasty, good interior design choices and the scent of roasted coffee is so enticing 🤤🤤🤤.

name: TJ Coffee Roaster
review_1_text:
Hidden gem found !

Great environment
Order mocha + 1 more shot (not very sweet)
Compare to Starbuck (sugary drink)

I assume u know how to choose a more healthier coffee 🤭

I believe it very newly open

Seat at bar counter drink coffee new style it's very refreshing

Modem theme with old school vaspa design
👍🏻👍🏻

Traveller from 🇸🇬
review_2_text: TJ Coffee shop is a small cafe serving a variety of coffee and non-coffee drinks, including beer.  I had an espresso made with beans from the Chiang Mai area.  The flavor was excellent.  I went back a couple of days later for another one.
review_3_text: We google Beam&Col, but run into TJ by a beautiful mistake.  The coffee is amazing with rich & various aftertastes, and the vibe is relaxing.  No food and desert is served, so guests could taste and enjoy coffee purely.
review_4_text: Nicest coffee in Chang Mai and cool atmosphere. Treat yourself with an iced caramel macchiato and thank me later !
review_5_text: They do not have coffee beans for sale....disappointing

name: บุญปั๋น คาเฟ่ Boonpun cafe
review_1_text: If you reading this post, please try to noodle soup right next to it. local Mama noodle soup with pork rib. you wont find it anywhere in Chiang Mai. it taste so good and yet no information could be find. it makes me wanna go back for more!!!  BTW coffee is good here.
review_2_text: Very good thai tea. Cozy place. Nice barista but with bad english. I’ve ordered green tea and got thai tea but everything was tasty and nicely presented so I don’t mind.
review_3_text: We stumbled upon this cafe during the city walk. It was a great experience. Friendly barista, good coffee, decent price.
review_4_text: Neat little cafe that opens early morning, with fragrant coffee, attentive owner and cozy atmosphere.
review_5_text: Great coffee at a really great price. I definitely recommend it.

name: Poon Coffee & Restaurant
review_1_text:
I've been eating there almost every day for the past 6 weeks. Everything is good: Thai food, European food, coffee, breakfast.
Mike and Poon are the best hosts, always welcoming you with a smile.
It can be very busy sometimes, so don't be in a hurry. Take your time and give them a chance, you won't regret it!
review_2_text:
Best coffee shop in the whole of CM🥰
Mike and his beautiful wife and staff are super helpful and friendly
The presentation of the coffee is incredible ☕️
Value for money great for reading a book or doing a little remote work all the juices and food are very reasonable.
You will not regret coming to this lovely chilled coffee shop 🫶🏻
review_3_text: The lady and gentleman are both very nice. I have been there several times. The breakfast or lunch are all delicious and served beautifully. They have European food , Thai food , and drinks. Definitely will be there again.
review_4_text:
You can live abroad for years, eat like a local, learn the rhythms, and swear you don’t miss a thing.

Then one random morning your brain whispers, not in Thai: tuna sandwich.

I’ve had plenty over the last couple of years, chasing that simple, salty, familiar bite like it’s a postcard from another life. And without a doubt, Poon Coffee & Restaurant (พูนคอฟฟี่) makes the best tuna sandwich in all of Chiang Mai.

It starts with the bread. Toasted just right, that sweet spot between sturdy and tender. Light butter. The kind of toast that makes a quiet crunch and then gets out of the way.

Then the tuna. Not a polite little smear. A real amount. Seasoned well, stacked between three slices of bread like someone decided you deserved a double-decker moment.

On the side: crisp lettuce, tomatoes, onions, plus a slice of watermelon and dragonfruit, like a small edible reminder that you’re not back home at all, and that’s kind of the point.

I washed it down with an Americano, the way I always do. Ice water alongside. A small cookie, because Thailand is generous like that.

“Heaven” is a big word, but breakfast like this earns it. If you’re in Chiang Mai and you get that sudden craving for something that tastes like memory, go see the good people at Poon Coffee & Restaurant. They’ll take care of you.

P.S. they have lots of Thai and Western food too!
review_5_text:
We ordered the rice soup from the Thai breakfast menu. It was delicious - especially when I added a little spiced vinegar.
Also the chocolate shake with blended ice was so nice we went back in the afternoon for another one.

name: Forty One Cafe’ (41 Cafe’)
review_1_text:
I love hanging out here with my besties.
It’s such a chilled vibes to have.
Great Thai food and delicious coffee.
Good Pricing, easy to sit and relax.
I enjoy coming here in the late morning for my happy brunch. Perfect place to be 💕
review_2_text: Very nice coffee and a relaxing atmosphere. The price is great too only 45 THB. I’ve paid more elsewhere for coffee that didn’t taste nearly as good as it does here.
review_3_text: This quiet little cafe has decent seating spread around the place, outlets and wifi available, and friendly staff. The coffee and cake I ordered isn’t bad :) It was a great place to get work done today, and the neighborhood is nice for a walk!
review_4_text: This cafe is bang tidy so comfortable seating very air and spacious but cozy to great for a coffe, tea, snacks Thai food etc smashed a top notch breakfast, lady served me is dear, super cheery all stars
review_5_text: I love this little place and came here almost daily to drink coffee and work on my laptop when I was in Chiang Mai. The setting is cosy and modern and the owners are welcoming and friendly. They even offered me traditional sweets they had made for a special occation. The coffee is great, both hot and cold, and so affordable, and the wifi is fast and free. Would recommend the Forty One Café to anyone!

name: DoReTea Café & Studio
review_1_text: Absolutely amazing! The best doughnuts I’ve ever had – fresh, soft, and perfectly airy. We tried the coconut, cinnamon, and glazed ones, and each was delicious. The coffee and smoothie were fantastic too. Highly recommend! ☕🍩
review_2_text: Really lovely, chill cafe with great donuts, food and drinks. The owners are really kind and lovely. I know Khun Noom who is a talented guitarist, guitar teacher and music producer. Noom also teaches guitar and can produce any sort of music in his home studio at reasonable prices.
review_3_text:
Really cosy café with nice owner! Inside of the shop is decorated as a living room, so we felt so comfortable and chill there!

Donuts have amazing taste and are good priced. So soft and fluffy that you cant stop eating 🤣🤣
review_4_text: Quiet cafe that also has recording studios and guitar lessons. Nice donuts and thai tea and matcha
review_5_text: This place is great. We were there in the middle of a weekday and it was pretty quiet. It has a calm and peaceful feel to it. We had three donuts (strawberry, coconut, and chocolate). They were very light and fluffy. We also had a coffee and and a Thai tea. I know you can get Thai tea everywhere but this one was so rich and creamy. We had all of that for 170 baht.  The service was quick and very nice. I think this place will become one of our favorites.

name: สหบาน (SAHABAAN.COFFEE)
review_1_text: Nice Place, not so crowded. 5 min from Chiang Mai Gate market by foot. You can choose bean for  your coffee from light to dark roast. Very enjoy :)
review_2_text: Very smooth and nice coffee in reasonable price. Peaceful and cozy environment with lovely cat, Mocha. 😇 Perfect place for coffee lovers and cat lovers
review_3_text:
Coffee was good,

You can choose your coffee roast (medium, dark)
Nice and cozy atmosphere
Good prices
review_4_text:
A cozy coffee spot, this place  is definitely worth a visit.

👍🏻⭐️Quiet and peaceful setting,high-quality drip coffee, good matcha-Matcha good ,affordable prices and near Chiang Mai Gate.
review_5_text:
Great coffees, amazing hospitality!

This cosy cafe is a passion project to a very friendly host. The coffees here are brewed using moka pot and aeropress using beans roasted from their own plantation. Definitely worth a visit if you’re in the area!

name: Chiangmai koi by AE
review_1_text: Delicious food and good service.

name: มิราเคิลคอฟฟี่ สาขากาดก้อม
review_1_text: Wonderful place for coffee lovers. Reasonable prices, fast service. Payment in cash.
review_2_text: I picked up caramel macchiato here and it was a bit too sweet.
review_3_text: The best coffee we had in Thailand so far! Also the place has good vibes and it is just nice to sit here and chill.
review_4_text: It is a really cozy and chill cafe with plenty of choices. Cold to hot coffees, fresh teas. Really friendly owners and reasonable price
review_5_text: Delicious coffee's and coconut smoothies.

name: Olive Cafe Chiang Mai
review_1_text: Cute little shop. Very cozy. The lady there was very kind. Easy to talk to. The food was delicious. I had breakfast. It was delicious and huge. The coffee was great too and a good size!
review_2_text: Yummy carbonara and coffee. Good owners and staff. I pictured the khao soi
review_3_text: This morning I enjoyed a western breakfast with coffee and brownie with soft served ice cream today. Everything was prepared to perfection and the taste was unmatched. I look forward to enjoying other items on the menu to include Spaghetti, sandwiches, and delicious looking cakes. Cafe was clean and the service was excellent.
review_4_text: The staff has served me well even when I arrived at closing time. They are very friendly and warm. Since I found it, I haven't missed a single day. Thank you. I forgot to ask for the photo I took with the staff, but I have one with my girlfriend enjoying the place. See you soon!
review_5_text: This small cafe is located opposite the Chiang Mai College of Dramatic Arts. They serve food, snacks, and drinks. The food is delicious and generous, and the prices are reasonable. Recommended dishes include the Tom Yum Shrimp Spaghetti, Caesar Salad, Nachos, and Strawberry Smoothie. They're all delicious!

name: A Day In Chiang Mai Coffee Brew
review_1_text:
They made delicious coffee.
We found this randomly, a small & cozy coffee shop. I tried their signature coffee, which included 4 types of milk (as i remembered), very very delicious, truly memorable.
Their staffs are also very nice 😆.
review_2_text:
The atmosphere is nice and relaxing. The service is good, and the staff are friendly. The coffee is good. The coffee prices (latte 70฿) are higher than local coffee shops, but in line with local "specialty" coffee shops. The prices for desserts are not listed until you choose the dessert in their electronic ordering system. The dessert prices are on the high side compared to other comparable coffee shops. The chocolate mousse cake was rich and good, but was a little small for the 150฿. The cheesecake (140฿) wasn't bad, but the center was frozen and the taste was similar to what you would get from a frozen cheesecake at the supermarket.
I'm summary, the coffee, service, and atmosphere make this a nice place to relax, but the desserts felt overpriced.
Note: The restroom is behind the coffee shop.
review_3_text:
Nice little coffee shop on the side of the road we spotted by accident, and I'm so glad we did. The staff welcomed us instantly with a smile and helped us choose. The coffee and hot chocolate were very good, and the cakes were fresh and delicious.

Definitely recommend to anyone to go and enjoy a fantastic breakfast in the morning.
review_4_text:
TRUST ME!!! ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

A Day in Chiang Mai easily serves the best coffee in Chiang Mai — and I don’t say that lightly. I had their flat white with both the Culture and Panama Geisha beans, and each cup was exceptional in its own way. The Culture bean brought out a beautifully rounded flavor, while the Panama Geisha was delicate, floral, and truly memorable.

The balance, texture, and aroma were spot on — clearly crafted with care and skill. The café itself is calm, stylish, and welcoming, perfect for a quiet coffee moment or slow afternoon.

If you’re serious about coffee, this place deserves a permanent spot on your Chiang Mai list. ☕✨
review_5_text: This place do amazing coffee - one of the best that we had in Chiangmai! Love how passionate they are in creating every single drink. It’s tucked away in the neighborhood close to where we stay. Highly recommended if you’re visiting Chiangmai!

name: Heartwork the Sharing Space
review_1_text:
Great spot for WFA. I require Wi-Fi, power outlets, a large table, a clean restroom, and air conditioning. It meets all my needs.

The cost is the price of a drink plus a 20 THB top-up.
review_2_text: Great coffee and good space with some good working chairs. It’s more like a very good workable cafe with good drinks than a coworking space. If you are sitting here, then they charge you 20thb extra, which is totally ok given the quality of the coffee by itself already and you get good tables, chairs, fans, AC. It’s well worth it if you wanna get some work done especially. My hot cappuccino was great.
review_3_text:
Workplace - Good and quiet
Coffee - Good
Food - A big NO!!!

I ordered the "pork omelette with rice," but I only received an "omelette with rice." Even though I didn't get what I paid for, I was charged the full price.

This place is only good for working, not for ordering food. The food isn't even made here. They order it from outside. I realized this too late when I saw someone bringing in food from another place.

Bad service!
review_4_text: Cute little cafe serving food and drinks. They have space upstairs with tables and chair for working but it gets crowded so if you want to secure a seat I suggest going early. Everyone is friendly and recommend if you need a quiet spot to work.
review_5_text:
I come to Heartwork multiple times a week to work. You can find very comfortable chairs, food is delicious and you only pay 20 baht on your order to be able to work.
Best coworking place for me!

name: Berries Cafe & Bar
review_1_text: This was the only breakfast spot we trusted and kept coming back to during our entire stay in Chiang Mai. It’s a cozy hole-in-the-wall place with great food and a clean, pleasant atmosphere—no weird smells at all. Even the bathroom is spotless. They have books you can read, sell amazing cookies (which I brought along on the loop), and the staff are polite, friendly, and speak English. Highly recommended!
review_2_text: Just lovely,  friendly cafe within 5 minutes walk of the Old Town.  Really good coffee! Small food menu done really well! Oranges for my orange coffee were sqeezed in front of me! Delicious!!!
review_3_text:
Superb little restaurant close to town. The atmosphere is calm and relaxing. I went there for lunch and ordered the beef plate, shrimp toast with homemade sauce, fish n chips and shrimp pasta. Everything was very good and well presented.
The owner is super friendly and speaks perfect English.
I really recommend this restaurant for lunch or brunch, with the family, as a couple or even on your own.
A big thank you to the owner for his dedication and politeness to his customers ❤️🥇
review_4_text: My girlfriend stumbled upon this place and we decided to give it a try. And gosh were we glad we did. Besides the fact that this little cafe/restaurant looked really clean and cute, the food and drinks were absolutely phenomenal! You can really taste it was made with love. But what made this place special in particular was the owner Tim. He made us feel like home. Such a warm and humble person. He had a chat with us about our stay in Chiang Mai and even made us a list of things to do during the rest of our stay without us even asking for it. Absolutely a great guy and great place with great food and drinks. Highly highly recommend this place to anyone and everyone visiting Chiang Mai!
review_5_text: Something really went wrong, we arrived at the store and the owner was really nice, only after an hour we received 2 omelettes out of 3 dishes, and he told us that he didn't have ingredients to prepare the 3rd dish. That is - a whole hour without food and without certainty. The eggs were not cooked.. not a good experience to start the morning

name: Slow bar on the way @คลองแม่ข่า
review_1_text: Absolutely love this cafe and prices are super affordable. Peach tea for just 30 thb is incredible. Also the view is sooo pretty!
review_2_text: A really good coffee shop in a quaint neighbourhood. The service is great, with the barista knowing what she is selling and being able to communicate it! I had the classic "es yen" here and even though that's like a Spanish Latte, it just tasted great! Definitely a must visit in Haiya.
review_3_text: Lovely little Cafe with a lot of options to choose from. The Barista Lady was friendly and lively and made delicious drinks. I ordered a Rose Thai Tea which was refreshing! The drinks didnt take long and the scenic view was beautiful. I would recommend this place!
review_4_text: cheap drinks and very lovely girl serving them. i had a coconut matcha foam and i didn’t love it, i wish it was real coconut juice as i always think the bottled one tastes pretty different.
review_5_text: 30฿ for a coffee? Yes. Awesome. Amazing little place to relax. Not top of the line coffee but absolutely awesome for a quick pick me up. Super friendly staff. I recommend the Thai teas and flavored sodas. We got the ice latte Moka and it was decent!

name: ริมคลองแม่ข่า
review_1_text: “The atmosphere and view are great, and the drinks are delicious, but the staff are not very friendly. !!! When I asked about the price and was ready to pay, the staff were busy on their phones
review_2_text: good place to sit down and people watch , good beer selection
review_3_text: Good beer and drink selection, staff should improve in politeness and service.
review_4_text: Lovely place for a drink by the canal.
review_5_text: They are extremely kind

name: Maajoy Cafe & Tailor
review_1_text:
Thai tea and americano were really good 👍
The staffs are friendly and welcoming too 🙂
review_2_text: Found this gem of a cafe near our hotel! Coffee is amazing and the food absolutely delicious!! Have dined here two days in a row, the food is that good!! Nice cool setting and excellent service, highly recommend!
review_3_text: It’s so nice here! I was surprised that they served such delicious and cheap Thai food (50b for a good sized lunch portion). The drinks are a bit pricier relatively but still reasonable and good quality. Service is good, and the decor is cute-grunge-chic. Really nice quiet spot to grab a bite or hang out for a couple hours.
review_4_text:
Stumbled on this gem after a bit of searching but it's AMAZING. Had a terrific Thai style iced coffee which was perfect for a hot day, and we also got a matcha iced latte. Also perfect. The pad see ew noodles we got (not really explicitly stated on the menu) were terrific. All for super cheap!
The place is very small, but no one was there around lunch time so we had it all to ourselves. Good Wi-Fi for working. So overall, a terrific spot that deserves far far more business!
review_5_text:
UPDATE Sept 2025: We are back in Chiang Mai after six years away. The drinks business has moved inside off the porch and it’s a lovely, relaxing place to stop for a glass of the best cha yen in town. Still cannily priced about ฿5 below the normal price.

ORIGINAL: Best cha yen in town! The two sisters who run this place in front of their family’s tailoring shop turn out perfectly made drinks for a fraction the price charging shops in the center of the old city. All the drinks are excellent, but the cha yen, brewed strong and finished off with a topping of foamed milk, is positively elegant. Perfect drink for a hot day. The sisters also offer packaged wafer cookies and simple sandwiches.

name: Anatolia Cafe&Bistro, Grill Turkish Restaurant+Rent Motorcyle
review_1_text:
Food was incredible! We had the beef and the chicken kebabs. The salads were quite tasty, too.
We will be back and bring friends.
review_2_text: A bit of a wait — 45 minutes to an hour for two meals — but it was totally worth it. Food was flavorful and quite literally, perfect.
review_3_text: I’m eating breakfast at 4:00 pm. A little late but delicious. Mediterranean focused with Thai as well. Very friendly family.  My third visit.
review_4_text: Food was so tasty! We really enjoyed our meal 🙂 would recommend
review_5_text:
It's a big chance to find a place like this far from home. This place offers both Turkish and Thai food. The portions are good, the atmosphere is warm, and the staff is friendly. It's a great stop if you're nearby - don't miss it

There are plenty of budget-friendly places to stay and rent a scooter in Thailand. The restaurant owner also helps with that, just ask.

name: The Lion’s Crown ライオン
review_1_text:
Very nice cute friendly cafe, the bubble tea is amazing, beautiful and good authentic taste.
They also serve Thai food, like khao soi, Nam ngiao, Ga-pao, with local price👍👍👍
review_2_text: one best random late night food to go. chicken massana curry was delicious ✌🏻
review_3_text: Small, very clean, and quiet restaurant with polite service. Simple menu (white rice, pasta, fried rice with a choice of meat: pork, chicken, beef). A variety of drinks (matcha, latte, milk, various teas, sparkling water, etc.) and very reasonable prices.
review_4_text:
The bubble tea is incredibly fragrant. This is a super hidden gem. The cute decor is perfect for taking photos.
A hidden gem! The brown sugar boba is so fragrant and authentic. It tastes just like the original in Taiwan.
review_5_text: Stir-fried basil pork and garlic pork are delicious, clean, and generous portions. Comfortable seating and a kids' menu are available.

name: Thai Thai Hostel
review_1_text:
Absolutely loved this hostel - simple but good breakfast, friendly staff and cosy beds! We were able to check in early, the showers were clean and hot.

Only complaint is that the curtain didn't go all the way around the bed but overall such a great stay!
review_2_text: Very good place for hostel. The stay was overfilled my expectations. The hostel is close to the market and silver temple. The over is very nice
review_3_text: I am staying here for one week, and this hostel is an amazing place to stay. It’s very clean, the temperature is perfect, and the hospitality is top-notch.
review_4_text: I really enjoyed my time here. I stayed for 2 weeks and then another night while passing through. The staff are very nice and speak English well. AC in the room was super nice to get away from the heat as well as the privacy curtains. It’s kept very clean as well and is quiet so it’s easy to get a good night of rest. Also… the hostel cat is super cute!
review_5_text: Staffs are kind and very helpful. The whole building was cleaned. I love the neighbors nearby. Therr is a washing machine and you can dry ur clothes on the roof top. It makes save time and money:)

name: Rywin Cafe
review_1_text: Very nice and clean restaurant with excellent food and service. The family running it were very welcoming. We ordered the khao soi, masaman curry and mango sticky rice. The khao soi was very good but the masaman was really exceptional and one of the best we’ve had in Chiang Mai. The mango sticky rice was also exceptionally good. The only issue is that everything is somewhat more pricy than many others serving the same foods. But again, when the food is this good, it’s worth it!
review_2_text:
We found this gem via Google "restaurants near me" and found out the great reviews are well-deserved. It's a small mom& pop cafe featuring excellent coffee and home-made Thai food. Moo was our host and server while his wife made the food.

We both chose Khao soi, a regional dish specialty in northern Thailand and were happy with our choice. It was very delicious!

Overall, it's a friendly and welcoming atmosphere, with great food at a decent price.
review_3_text:
This place was on point for dinner.  We both had the Massaman Curry with tofu and rice and Rywin Cafe stepped up.

The food was great, the owner is a character and the restaurant itself was nice.

To note, we waited almost an hour for our food to come which is pretty ridiculous.  We sat down seconds after another group did who got their order in before us. Luckily the food was delicious and the owner apologized profously but an hour long wait is pretty stupid.
review_4_text: Terrific little cafe!! Highly recommend coming here. I have had 7 mango sticky rices in Thailand so far and this one was the best I have had in my entire life. The caramel macchiato was perfect, not too sweet. And the peach soda was fizzy and refreshing. If you are in the area, please come in and support this small business. Our waiter was so sweet and accommodating!
review_5_text:
This place!!! I came by on a walk one day and ended up eating luch here almost every day after that for a month. Their Khao Soi is to die for, not chicken on the bone, just the white meat and they adjust spice to your liking. The spring rolls are another favorite.
I recommend this place to everyone I know and I can't wait to be back myself. This is my first stop out of the airport!!

The owners are the sweetest elderly couple, they cook everything themselves and will go out of their way to help you.
12/10 will always recommend!
Khop khun kaa 🙏🏽

name: Signature coffee
review_1_text: We ordered sodas. It was so good! We walked a lot and were very hot, but this place saved us. A perfect spot for stop, and everyone here was really kind.
review_2_text: I only went to the cafe and did not stay there. I ordered an iced vanilla latte and it was delicious! I would definitely come back.
review_3_text: Great spot for coffee. Baristas are really nice. This has become my go to morning spot for a fresh latte. Highly recommend.
review_4_text: Room was perfect with 2 toilets and 2 shower rooms.Free coffee in the morning. Perfect place .
review_5_text: Marzocco coffee machine , two selection of beans. They make good coffee ☕️.

name: Trailer Coffee Changklan
review_1_text: I recently visited Trailer Coffee and had a great experience overall. The coffee was smooth and flavorful, offering a nice balance of richness without being overly bitter. However, I found that it wasn’t as strong as I typically like my coffee to be. If you enjoy a lighter brew or prefer a more subtle taste, this will be a great choice for you. The vibe of the place was cozy and welcoming, and the service was friendly. I’d definitely recommend it for those who appreciate good coffee, just maybe not if you're looking for something with a bold kick!
review_2_text: Best coffee I’ve tasted in Chiang Mai (and I’ve tasted quite some coffee here). Owner has won awards in a national championship and also sells professional coffee machines and offers barista training. Super kind service.
review_3_text: I like the lighter brew, so this shop is perfect for me!
review_4_text: Really delicious latte, this is excellent coffee from a nice unassuming cafe that is better than most coffees from specialty coffee shops in European cities
review_5_text: The peach iced coffee is amazing! I actually visited their Jing Jai market location and had to go back to have another iced coffee the next day.

name: Mosaic Market & Cafe Chiang Mai
review_1_text: Lovely secret gem! This place is decorated will love, care and style. I went there during their Christmas Market fair and it was really nice to enjoy the atmosphere, Christmas music and browse around their handmade selection of products and then enjoy a nice tea while chilling in their living room area. Very quiet, super friendly staff, they also have delicious cakes and very affordable prices. If you're looking for crafts, handmade souvenirs and presents, this is the place to get them. They're so conscious and eco-friendly, and sell many natural skin products, essential oils, creams, candles, clothes, bags, jewelry and much more. I'll definitely visit this place again!
review_2_text:
I stumbled upon this spot when I was on the hunt for a clothing shop. The staff were so welcoming and patient and I instantly felt comfortable finding a table to get cozy and make some art!
Highly recommend the Thai Milk Tea! Affordable and delicious. Cafe takes both card and cash payments. There is also a second level for more seating too.
Will be definitely bringing my friends back here soon!!
review_3_text:
This place is wonderful! Open until 6.30pm which is a bonus.

Such a lovely quiet space to work or meet a friend. They also have an upstairs with bookable meeting rooms and more space to relax. Comfortable sofas.

Lots of light from the big windows. Drink selection is great, cookies are yummy!
review_4_text:
I love the co-working space this beautiful social enterprise has! Two floors of seating, delicious cookies/cakes and lunch pies 😋

Ill definitely come back again soon. 🥰
review_5_text:
This place is a true hidden gem in Chiang Mai.

I stopped in for coffee (and the world’s best home made cookie!)… loved the laid back atmosphere, friendly people and the space is beautiful.

Was a nice change of pace from a typical coffee shop.

They also have lots of interesting things for sale.

If you’re looking for a unique place to relax, I highly recommend it!

name: Green Queen - Cannabis Shop
review_1_text: Mint is very friendly & professional, they have a great variety of selections and the best prices I’ve seen in Thailand, I would highly recommend this business to anyone.
review_2_text: ↖(^ω^)↗ The boss is a warm-hearted handsome guy. The products are great and he gave us a discount and a small gift
review_3_text: Good weed good prices the most expensive one is 299 baht for 1g and its very good
review_4_text:
Best coffeeshop with best manager !! 🤠
Some Bubble 🍌 Gummy 50% +
Crazy stuffs here !
review_5_text: Best place I have came across! Worth the visit! Good quality and great customer service

name: Outside In Cafe & Studio
review_1_text: Lovely little coffee shop, with great coffee and pleasant service.  The front windows are open and there are fans and a nice breeze. I went every day of my trip.
review_2_text: Great coffee it’s Cool, beautifully decorated, spotlessly clean a lovely little cozy spot just a minute walk from the Empress hotel.  Lovely helpful people working here
review_3_text: Very friendly people and very delicious coffee!
review_4_text: Really cute place! But just know that they don't have food here. Just coffee and cakes. (Some photos on their Facebook page might lead you to believe otherwise! Coffee was nice and the place is rally comfy!
review_5_text: Very good service with great vanilla lattes. Good price, but lost a star because there's no AC. Open wall and fans allow for good air flow to make up for it though.

name: Cafe De Le Bis
review_1_text:
Stayed at Le Bis Hotel for 2 nights, I couldn't miss this opportunity to spent my dinner time at the cafe. I have to say that the experiences were really impressive. The staffs are friendly, polite, helpful, and cooperative. The cafe's atmosphere itself is calm and cozy granting me to enjoy my peaceful and relaxing evenings. The drink and food were freshly made and served within 10  approximately. I have ordered Carbonara Spaghetti, Apple Soda, Double Chicken Burger, and Green Tea which tasted really good.

So far, this cafe is the one that is worth to visit.
review_2_text: The food was delicious and quality, but very strange way of decorate Krapaw chicken with rice like burger very difficult to eat.  The coffee machine very loud and took long time for one hot cappuccino while am the only customer in the shop.
review_3_text:
Trust me guys I've tasted so many green curry around Thailand and Singpore but nothing is compared to this as it's the finest for me.

Even their drinks are top class it's really nice.

Price wise is very affordable too for a restaurant.

Hats up to the owner of this restaurant you guys are really passionate 🫡🫡🫡
review_4_text: Wonderful small cafe with delicious coffee and non-coffee drinks. Lovely and quiet location, we will we back for sure!
review_5_text: Website says it's open on Saturday for lunch,  but it's closed when we walked there in the heat!  very unprofessional

name: Craves Cafe' Coffee&Dessert
review_1_text: Really cute shop. Great drinks at an affordable price. Staff was super kind and welcoming and even got me to write a little note for their Christmas tree! Hospitality 10/10
review_2_text: Nice chill vibes for an afternoon treat! Good selection of teas, coffees, smoothies, etc.
review_3_text: This coffee shop is a hidden gem that offers exceptional coffee, delightful treats, and a warm, welcoming atmosphere.
review_4_text: Waited over an hour for 4 tiny waffles and 2 toasts (and toast wasn’t even what we ordered). Thought this would be a quick grab-and-go breakfast before our day trip out to Chang Rai. If the food was good, would have been worth it, but the food wasn’t even tasty. Waffles were very salty and part of our order was wrong. You can see time-stamp chat with hubs that this order literally took an hour lol.
review_5_text: Very cute café with good food and good drinks! I personally recommend the Thai Milk Tea :)

name: Improvise coffee
review_1_text:
Wellmade coffee served in large cups.  Nice selection of croissants, baked goods & cookies.

Delicious steamed buns ... mushroom is my favorite.

Calm atmosphere with modern jazz in the background.
review_2_text: In a city full of small coffee shops, it’s not easy to stand out—but if you’re into strong yet balanced espresso drinks, Improvise is worth a visit. They offer a range of roasts, from light to bold, and the very reasonably priced strong roast cappuccino, served in a small cup and perfectly prepared, really hits the spot. With AC, WiFi, and a relatively spacious setting, it’s a winner.
review_3_text:
A good place to stop if you are around and need a coffee and some ac to cool down.
It is the best coffee shop on a 1km perimeter 😅

Coffee is good, 8/10
But it was too strong for me and the barista didn’t know English to be able to give him the feedback. They do have croissants and that is nice. Didn’t try them though.
review_4_text: Cakes are not eatable, they do not serve your dish even you are the only guests and seats are very uncomfortable.
review_5_text: Nice barrista. Reasonable prices.  Thought the place was next to the Ping River. Too bad, no. But comfy enough to lounge around and chat. You can also take yr coffee out to sit in the adjacent lobby of Jira Residence. BTW, the piano counter seating talked about in reviews a year ago is probably gone. Didn't notice any or it was out of my focus? :)

name: Roastniyom Coffee - The Astra Condo
review_1_text: Great variety in the drink menu and tasty croissants. Lots of good seating space to work or a quiet visit, spots to charge your devices, and wifi. Unsure of the other reviews complaining about staff.. We stayed at the Astra and came here daily for a week and had no issues.
review_2_text:
Nice little coffee shop for condo dwellers with many types of seating options around, some have power socket so ideal for recharging while having your preferred dose of caffeine. They also offer many types of cookies, brownies and cheesecakes. Plus four basic types of croissants - pure, ham&cheese, almond and chocolate. Good place to start a day.

EDIT: After one year of regular visits I simply have to give the fifth star. They added more types of pastries and have many special drinks during events and holidays.
review_3_text: The lady in the morning is so rude if you are a foreigner. 7:10 am being yelled at "no coffee" not a great way to start the morning when it says it opens at 7, the people across the street are very kind. I suggest to give them your business.
review_4_text:
I come to this café almost every day since it’s in my residence, but the service has become really unpleasant because of one staff member, Tang Mo. She never says hello, never smiles, and barely answers when you ask for something.

Today I tried to buy a cake displayed on the counter, and she pretended not to see which one I meant — apparently because she had kept it for herself. It was extremely unprofessional and disrespectful.

I’m not sure if she’s the owner or just has a problem with foreigners, but her attitude is very rude and makes it uncomfortable to even grab a takeaway coffee.
review_5_text: Great spot to work or just enjoy a good coffee! The place is calm, cozy, has reliable Wi-Fi, and the staff are super friendly 🙏

name: Monkey Coffee
review_1_text:
My favorite place to go for coffee in Chiang Mai.

The coffee is great and the owner is friendly and a great local guide.

Highly recommend.
review_2_text: A very high quality coffee shop offers several types of coffee, I chose Brazilian coffee was really delicious and very different from other stores using high quality coffee, the store owner is really friendly and helps with information and tips and information to travelers, thank you 🙏
review_3_text: It’s a small place but with really good coffee. I mean, you can even choose the coffee bean you want👌
