review_4_text: Monkey is a great place to relax on the comfortable couch and have a nice cold coffee. You can choose from  different coffee beans, i had the Brasil one and it tasted great. While drinking your coffee you can have a nice chat with owner. She can also give you a lot travel information in and around Chiangmai.
review_5_text: Lovely shop ,Selected coffee been,Great service. Friendly owner.

name: ร้านกาแฟ Perfect blend coffee
review_1_text: Great coffee. Really good blend. What I like about the location is the chilled non touristic atmosphere next to local restaurants and shops. And the price is reasonable at 50 for. Capoucino (vs 120 at Starbucks)
review_2_text:
It has been my favorite cafe before and even after COVID19. It seems the surrounding business has gone down after the pandemic. It is a pity. Hope that the economy will rise again soon.
The Americano and cappuccino are nice and cheap. The environment is chill and has a local relaxing ambience.
review_3_text:
Very good americano and fair price!
I sometimes have other drinks too, but I mostly come in the early morning for my breakfast coffee ☕ and she opens at 6h30am !
Like her Perfect Blend it's a Perfect time!
Not directly in the busy Changkhlan Road, I love to sit outside enjoying my morning coffee ☺️
review_4_text: Good place to chill and have some coffee and small snack. The ice lattee was about 40 baht and it had a lot of ice, half coffee, and half condensed milk. Not too expensive and it is relaxing place but could be better with more amount of coffee. For the distance wise, it is close to some hotel area, you can walk a bit and relax before you start your day (or at the end of day relaxation).
review_5_text:
One of my favorite coffee shops in Chiangmai. Others are bigger or have fancier decor but the coffee in this place is quite good and the prices are outstanding.

They have their own roaster so locally roasted beans are for sale as well. I’ve had their Americano and their Oreo Coffee Smoothie, both are excellent.

Not far from the Shangra-la this is one of Chiangmai’s hidden gems!

name: At Ta Rote Coffee with Ping River View
review_1_text:
​This special place is a wonderful find,
A lovely retreat for the body and mind.
With a wide, leafy yard and the river nearby,It's the perfect spot as the hours go by. ​Beneath the big tree where the shade is sweet, The best coffee and moments you'll meet. A peaceful escape with nature's own gleam,This coffee shop truly is a beautiful dream.
review_2_text: When in town and time allows it, I always stop here for coffee. The girls are fantastic l, have known them for years and also we go here in Loy Krathong in the little park run by the army
review_3_text: Very nice riverside coffee place. Easily took my time there over iced drinks in the afternoon.
review_4_text: Good place for chilling , along the river, refreshing drinks and wind.
review_5_text: Nice place to relax nice staff good coffee and ham and cheese sandwich.good prices,wee worth a visit nice surroundings.

name: Minimal Coffee - ป่าไม้ Charoenprathet
review_1_text:
This is my favorite Minimal Coffee location. The service is always excellent, friendly, and smooth. You can choose to sit comfortably inside with air conditioning or outside under the umbrellas, which is great depending on the weather.

The coffee is consistently good — I’ve never been disappointed here. It’s also a perfect spot for parents who are picking up their kids from the nearby school. Relaxed atmosphere, good drinks, and reliable quality every time.

Highly recommended! ☕️
review_2_text: Such a nice coffee to start off the day with — rich, smooth, and exactly what I needed before my brain decided to work. Grabbed some takeaway for my coworker too, and it was a hit. This place deserves all five stars. ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
review_3_text: On Charoen Prathet Road, just before Wat Chai Mongkol, there's a small coffee shop with warm service and a wide selection of coffees. The atmosphere is quiet and perfect for relaxing or working.
review_4_text: Nice place for relaxing, they either got some snacks and nice created coffee, very refreshing ! The price is affordable too !
review_5_text: Great addition to the neighborhood.  Perfect for a stop before or after a visit to Charoen Prathet Public Park.

name: Duomo coffee house ร้านกาแฟ ดูโอโม่
review_1_text:
Diocesan coffee shop, maybe the cheapest price fresh coffee in the urban area. They also sell coffee beans from rural missionary’s farms. Air conditioner area is provided and normally people grouped here are catholic.

Btw, their frappe cappuccino is very similar as Canadian iced Capp, or even better!
review_2_text: Inexpensive coffee while still great quality. I liked how they've improvised sewing machine tables as seating. Good service. Special place. I loved the writing on the wooden board outside.
review_3_text: Very comfortable cafe. I could enjoy an iced cafe latte with only 40 THB. This place is a hidden treasure!
review_4_text: Great atmosphere, very cheap but high quality coffee and you’re supporting a great cause.
review_5_text: love the cofee, and the staff is nice

name: Aristo Cafe by Mon doi luang coffee
review_1_text:
1 dollar for hot coffee is real!

I founded this place via google map.
First I think they might be small coffee booth and takeaway only. But turn out it’s a coffee shop and restaurant with table. Hot coffee is 35 baht per cup! I can’t believe they sold coffee less than 1 dollar!! They use coffee machine and real coffee bean! OMG you should try!
review_2_text: Lovely little cafe with delicious coffee! Best cappuccino we've had! Better than Starbucks!
review_3_text: Good coffee, friendly barista and calm atmosphere. Thank you so much!
review_4_text: Really cute and nice little place with traditional Christian level service; lovely.
review_5_text: Great coffee!

name: KONG Presso
review_1_text: Nice coffee with river view. Freshly grinded americano was very good!
review_2_text: This is a beautiful quiet cafe. Hand made coffee! Hand Ground. Hand pressed.
review_3_text: Nice coffee ☕🤌🏻
review_4_text: Relaxed coffee bar by the river. Lovely location and very friendly service!
review_5_text: Relaxed coffee bar by the river. Lovely location and very friendly service!

name: อรรถรส
review_1_text: Good coffee, great location
review_2_text: We only  have coffee and snacks there...
review_3_text: Coffee shop with a view of the Ping River. Prices are reasonable, 40-50 baht.
review_4_text: Strong coffee, delicious cookies, nice atmosphere, cool breeze. Tea and coffee are priced at 45-60 baht.
review_5_text:
I went there to relax, have tea and coffee, and chat.
If it weren't for the smog, the atmosphere would be amazing! Very natural, with the sounds of insects and cicadas chirping loudly 🤣 The coffee and tea were delicious, I really liked them.

name: Coffeetime.ได้เวลากาแฟ
Chanom Arom D (ชานมอารมณ์ดี)
review_1_text: very good

name: School Coffee
review_1_text: Great coffee shop, cozy with good coffee. Loved the vibe and the staff are very friendly.  I had a dirty latte nicely presented in a small glass, you can tell the shop cares about the coffee experience. Will definitely go back and look forward to bringing friends here.
review_2_text: How delightful to get locally grown coffee, brewed and filtered, hot, just the way I love my favorite morning beverage. The lesson about coffee fermentation and curing blew my mind! Some 30 years of this drink and I'm just now understanding how it is created. Unforgettable experience. You must stop in and taste.
review_3_text: The affogato that they made is different but is the best, they use coconut milk is more like a latte, definitely good to try :)
review_4_text:
If you want to try Thai coffee beans while you’re in Chiang Mai, you have to come check this place out.
It’ll open your eyes to a whole new coffee experience.
review_5_text: Delicious coffee and tea (hot and cold) and other beverages plus assorted tasty pastries in a beautiful shop decorated like a schoolhouse. Baristas are friendly and knowledgeable. They roast and sell coffee beans too.  Located about 550 meters south of Chiang Mai’s train station in the Wat Ket district (east side of the Ping River).

name: A-ME cafe “อะมี คาเฟ่“
review_1_text:
Good standard coffee. Super helpful staff. Certainly one of the finest coffees in Chiang Mai.
Will come again.
review_2_text:
Friendly, high quality coffee, good Service.

Local loves here
review_3_text: Real good coffee, pastries and friendly staff. Can recommend!
review_4_text: INCREDIBLE coffee. A really cute little cafe with great tasting coffee and friendly staff. Definitely worth a visit.
review_5_text: amazing flat white! ❤️ it’s not often that cafes know how to prepare it properly and they do. also coffee blend was superb!

name: OH MY CUP
review_1_text: Best Coffee in Chiang Mai. Amazing cookies and brownies.  Must go to place when here.
review_2_text:
I was really intrigued seeing such a nice and cute place in a more industrial area. They really looked to create a nice brand and branding.

Besides the really tasty milk tea I've got, the owners are sooo friendly!! I ran out of gas on my bike and I didn't know what to do and so they brought me a canister of gasoline and helped me fill my bike. They were incredibly helpful and I'm really grateful for this!! Thanks
review_3_text: Lovely coffee in a relaxed happy environment.
review_4_text: The best coffee and smoothie in town
review_5_text: This small shop has a great layout, plenty of seating, and excellent coffee. I was a casual customer who had planned to visit another shop, but I unexpectedly stumbled upon this one. I was completely won over; the prices are very reasonable, and the quality far exceeds the price. I'll definitely be visiting often; it's definitely on my list of favorite shops. And the cheese toast is truly delicious, exactly as pictured.

name: ร้าน หอมดิน กลิ่นกาแฟ Coffee & tea
review_1_text: Delicious! Highly recommended. The owner provides excellent service. The drinks are delicious ❤️❤️❤️
review_2_text: It's delicious.
review_3_text: moderately
review_5_text: delicious

name: Kai cookies & tea
review_1_text: good place to visit, good food and tasty
review_2_text: The coffee is delicious, and the owner is lovely and fun to talk to.
review_3_text: What kind of khanom jeen nam ngiao is this? It's a truly northern Thai flavor. Anyone who comes to see it must come and try it.
review_4_text: Khao Soi, Nam Khiao Wan Kai, and Hang Lay Curry are all delicious. I recommend them.
review_5_text: The tea is fragrant, not too sweet, and inexpensive. It's a small shop.

name: ร้านกาแฟป้าหล้า
review_1_text:
The shop offers hot and cold drinks, snacks, and ready-to-eat meals for those visiting the hospital. I personally like their savory crispy snacks; they're delicious and have a nice peppery aroma.
The shop uses coffee beans from the Royal Project, Faculty of Agriculture, Chiang Mai University, which is considered one of the first producers of roasted coffee beans in Chiang Mai. It's a classic, original recipe.
I ordered a hot cappuccino and it came with a sweet taste from the syrup. It seems to be a flavor that customers prefer. If you prefer it without sugar, don't forget to tell the barista.

name: 5Dimensions Coffee Roaster
review_1_text: Great specialty coffee and a beautiful atmosphere. The owner is super knowledgeable and passionate, even giving us a complimentary piccolo to taste while we chatted about brewing. A must-visit for coffee nerds and casual drinkers alike!
review_2_text: Lucky to try their very first roast using the new roaster machine — and it was absolutely impressive! The house blend and Single O both delivered full, balanced flavors even though freshly roasted. Each cup was rich, aromatic, and perfectly crafted. Highly recommended for passionate baristas and café owners who appreciate quality coffee and precision roasting. A must-visit spot for true coffee lovers in Chiang Mai!
review_3_text: Exceptional choice. Multiple single origins and a house blend to choose from. The cafe is in a peaceful setting and has a lovely atmosphere. Is by far the best coffee I’ve had in CM and it’s less expensive than all of the other speciality shops I’ve visited.
review_4_text: Absolute must go if you enjoy specialty coffee. A number of single origin coffees to choose from and the milk coffee drinks are incredible too. The owner is very knowledgable and friendly and you can truly taste that he is an expert and loves his craft. The place is located a little outside of the core of Chiang Mai, but you are rewarded with a great atmosphere (the garden around the cafe is beautiful), amazing coffee and a friendly owner. Can't wait to go back!
review_5_text: Great dishes and excellent drinks. Highly recommend for the food as you would get a decent amount of food for westerners and a little too overwhelming for Asian like myself. BUT THE QUALITY IS JUST CHEF-KISS! 😘 I had smoke pork sandwich and it was huge! You will love it here. Not only do they offer great quality for food but also premium drinks. Their specialty is, of course, coffee as the owners have lived in Australia for 5+ years. If you are looking for Australian style coffee, I highly recommend you coming here. The house is open between 7.30AM - 3PM. No worries, they have a parking lot for your cars and motorcycle as well. Great value for the price and quality.

name: Sweet dream coffee and baker
review_1_text: Good

name: หอมชากาแฟ&อาหาร
review_1_text: It's delicious and smells like tea.

name: เครปอั่วลั้ว เมกาโฮม
review_1_text: There's so much ice, I thought I was buying a glass of water for 20 baht.

name: Chilled Coffee
review_1_text: Good coffee, beautiful seller, good service, located in NT.

name: Lawan Coffee ลาวรรณ คอฟฟี่
UHOUSE
review_1_text: I can't contact to hotel. What is phone number ?
review_2_text: Very comfortable house
review_3_text: Cosy place
review_4_text: The shop is very beautiful, the desserts are delicious, the atmosphere is good, and there are a fair number of people.
review_5_text: Very beautiful teak house and garden. I heard it is 80 years old.

name: TODA coffee & co. | CNX
review_1_text: Cool working space in the midst of nature. Big glasshouse lead to a forest is stunning. Coffee also beyond expectations
review_2_text: Only place open on a Monday! Great service
review_3_text: A quiet, natural, and delicious coffee shop
review_4_text: The shop is beautiful, charming, and modern.
review_5_text: The shop has a beautiful and unique design. The matcha is delicious.

name: Whales Kave
review_1_text: Nice cafe located in a room of well-designed condominium. K.Ann, owner and barista, is friendly. This cafe is open by reservation only, so it's very private. Many coffee beans for you to choose. Tell Ann what you want to drink and enjoy your cup.
review_2_text: Great coffee
review_3_text:
First of all, I have to say that it was a very special time. It was my first time experiencing a slow bar. Everything was great, from the location, the atmosphere, and the taste.
The owner is so lovely. Upon opening the door, she looked like Cherprang. She's very chatty and friendly. It felt like visiting a friend's house, just chilling and relaxing. Today, I tried their drip coffee and soy cold brew. I give them a perfect score, but since we went in the evening, I might have to try other brewing methods next time. As for the taste, I won't go into detail, as everything I tried was delicious. :)
review_4_text: Delicious coffee, nice atmosphere, I recommend you come and try it.

name: โพมงมาชิ คาเฟ่
Reiz Meet
review_1_text: Great chill atmosphere with great coffee. Also had signature chocolate with some jam at the bottom, super special and taste really good.
review_2_text: A pretty chill place for a short fresh picnic with coffee in the morning.
review_3_text: It's a relaxing and impressive place to stay. It's clean, private, and surrounded by trees with great views. The natural atmosphere blends in perfectly with the surrounding mountains. It's also close to nature learning centers like the Suthep Open Zoo, making it ideal for families with children. There's also a coffee shop on site.
review_4_text: The Black Forest menu is very delicious. I went during the winter and the atmosphere was very good. I could hear the birds singing. I will definitely go back and support you again.
review_5_text: The owner is very kind 👍🍂

name: No.39 Cafe
review_1_text:
Atmosphere here is great - the pond in the middle is cool and the seating is nice.

Did feel a bit impersonal with the self serve for everything, but I suppose this is the practical way to get it done.

Food was more pricy than other places, not amazing quality or quantity.

Worth a visit, but nothing to rave about.
review_2_text: Ordered the Tom yum pasta and comes with 5 juicy and big prawns. Really nice atmosphere, a little confusing collection processes but just collect the drink at the entrance and then collect your food in the middle and youre good. I came here alone and I find it very relaxing and peaceful. Would recommend coming here 👍
review_3_text:
No.39 Café is such a beautiful and relaxing place to spend your day. The atmosphere is amazing — a peaceful lake with bright blue water, surrounded by greenery, perfect for chilling with friends or just enjoying quiet time. The food and drinks are really delicious, and the ambience feels so refreshing.
I also love the “amplug” area; it gives the café a cool and unique vibe. The staff are friendly and provide very good service, which makes the experience even better.
If you're looking for a cozy spot with great food, good music, and a relaxing environment, No.39 Café is definitely worth a visit!
review_4_text: Looking for a pretty café with chill vibes? This place has so many photo spots, great drinks, and yummy food. I loved the mango coconut cake, and the Thai tea with cheese foam is also a must-try!
review_5_text: Nice vibes for taking pictures and videos. The drinks are all well done. We ordered a tiramisu, strawberry shortcake and strawberry cheesecake. The cheesecake was below average so I would not recommend it. As for the visitors, lots of tourists mainly from China.

name: Paper Spoon
review_1_text:
This cafe was a truly wonderful find. It’s very quaint, set in a beautiful lush garden full of tropical plants. The owner is very kind, and there’s a shop with heaps of handmade goodies at reasonable prices.
The Nutella toast is absolute yummers!
review_2_text: Magical spot! Beautiful ambience, loved the decorations and details, food & coffee was delicious, high quality, and service friendly. (No laptops.)
review_3_text: Paper Spoon is one of those cafés where time naturally slows down. I especially loved the atmosphere on the second floor—quiet, airy, and perfect for sitting with your thoughts or a good book. The passion fruit lassi was refreshing with just the right balance of sweet and tangy, and the scone with homemade strawberry jam felt simple and comforting in the best way. A lovely place to pause, breathe, and enjoy small pleasures.
review_4_text: The second floor is really cozy. I recommend their toast with butter and Nutella. So tasty!
review_5_text: Hidden coffee gems in Chiang Mai. Open more than 10 years and the quality is still very good. This is a quiet place where you can stay calm and enjoy your day-off with a good coffee.

name: Mini Juice Bar
review_1_text: I can’t say enough good things about this beautiful juice bar. The owner is present and pleasant to be around. The environment is calming and thoughtfully arranged for comfort. The drinks are amazing. We sampled a ginger turmeric drink and purchased a Gingy juice which was very very good. A small cup of fruit was presented with the drink free of charge which was a nice surprise. We went back after a hectic couple of hours at Baan Kang Wat and painted mango seeds while we watched time slip away in the most peaceful way. Grab and Bolt both service this area so there is no excuse to not try this place.
review_2_text: AMAZING experience! Best juice and smoothie I’ve had in Chiang Mai and the kindest owner and best energy and vibes to sit and enjoy slowing having some fresh ingredients and beautiful fruit!
review_3_text: It’s no surprise they receive full scores you can truly feel the passion behind every dish. Each menu is amazingly crafted, with great quality at very reasonable prices. It may take a bit of time, but everything is 100% worth it.
review_4_text:
I was walking along the road from Wat Umong to the arts centre and happened to pass this place. I almost didn’t walk in but the style of the place caught my eye.

I ordered a smoothie and I don’t say this lightly when it was the best smoothie I’ve had in my life. Not only that but Gap brought out some fruit on a platter to accompany my smoothie.

Truly a fantastic experience, i would give it 6 stars if i could
review_5_text:
Mini Juice Bar is a place where you can get fresh juices and more, made from a wide variety of fruits with many different combinations.

Everything tastes genuinely fresh. He offers ginger shots and special juices like the “COVID juice,” which is great if you’re not feeling your best.

The owner is exceptionally friendly and clearly cares about his customers. He always goes out of his way to make you feel welcome and often adds something extra, which gives the place a very personal touch.

Absolutely a place worth visiting.

name: M&M Coffee Club
review_1_text: Relaxing black themed indoor air conditioned cafe , perfect place to get away from the heat over some coffee . Ordered cappuccino , big volume and  taste was great , price was considered cheap for this big cup ! Shop uses single origin Thai local arabica medium roast beans. I like it ! Taste much better than some overrated cafes out there . Definitely a place for coffee lovers . 👍🏻
review_2_text: Quietly tucked back from the busy road, this coffee shop is a great spot to relax in. The staff are so friendly and went above and beyond to help me and provided excellent drinks. Thank you!
review_3_text:
Organic coffee bean, rich and smooth taste.
Competitive price with Air con and wifi
review_4_text: A newly opened cafe. Served with high quality coffee beans, tried their mocha love the nutty taste of the coffee. The customer services are really good, you’ll be served with a friendly greeting and smile and the prices are affordable. Definitely will be back again!
review_5_text: Good coffee with very cute prices

name: Chalala Hostel & cafe
review_1_text: We stayed here as the hostel guest. It’s just above the ice cream shop. We was the only ones there in a 6 bed room. So plenty of space. Cute food stalls across the road. Little bit out of the way but a 10 min bike out of the centre. The owner Gone was the sweetest person, made it feel like home 10/10 would stay again
review_2_text:
The shop's cute decor and warm atmosphere make it perfect for relaxing and taking photos. The homemade chocolate ice cream we tried was absolutely delicious! The chocolate aroma was just the right amount of sweet, but not too much.
Besides the ice cream, the cold cocoa drinks we ordered were well-balanced. I personally ordered the 100% sweetness level because I like it extra sweet. It was absolutely amazing.
I give it a 10/10. You have to try it!!!
review_3_text: This ice cream cafe has a great atmosphere. The seating is comfortable, and the ice cream is delicious and varied. The flavors are distinct and not too sweet. The price is also reasonable. I will definitely come back again if I have the chance :)
review_4_text: The ice cream is absolutely delicious! The shop is beautifully and cutely decorated, and the prices are affordable.

name: NAKAMA Café @ Headquarters
review_1_text:
A lovely place, calming design.
Very friendly staff.
The bubble tea is the best, would recommend this place to anyone. Enjoy 🙏🌸😍
review_2_text: I've been here many times and really enjoy royal milk tea. Other drinks also good but recommend royal milk tea.
review_3_text:
We came to check out the place because of the good reviews about it but a bit disappointing with the taste of the bubble tea. We feel that it’s about an average bubble tea.

We tried 2 different tea—Taiwanese Bubble Tea and Midnight Cacao Brown Sugar Bubble tea. The Taiwanese Bubble Tea was just average like we mentioned earlier although the bubble are quite nice, soft but with good texture. The other one, Midnight Cacao Brown Sugar Bubble Tea was overpowering with the cacao flavor competing with quite sweet brown sugar bubbles and it didn’t taste like anything special about the cacao flavor actually.

Price wise, it’s quite expensive, except for the plain Taiwanese Bubble Tea. We have tried different bubble tea from other places and there are places that make better bubble tea with reasonable price than this.

What we like about this place is it has a potential to make you feel cozy with its minimal Japanese style of decoration. But, we only give actually 2.5 stars for this place because the place feels cluttered with many employees working behind the counter and yet, work gets done quite slowly. From our experiences traveling and visiting many places, small place like this would probably need not more than 2 people working in one shift. They had 5 people working behind a small counter at the time we were visiting the place and it makes the place feel so cramped and loud inside and like we said... it takes time to get your order. So, it wasn’t a pleasant place to sit and relax. The place lacks friendly vibes actually.

So, the best part about this place is its plain bubbles.
review_4_text:
Interesting choices on the menu, all very Japanese, and unusual options to customize for a bubble tea shop, with soy or almond milk, stevia as sweetener and low cal bubbles. Out of curiosity I tried the latter with brown sugar bubbles although they were a bit disappointing, no trace of brown sugar. Maybe it was only forgotten to be added but I'd advise to go with regular bubbles, I think they'd be more enjoyable. Houjicha latte was flavorful. Warm option is not available at all times. The store git busy after around 11am on a weekday for both take out and dine in. The interior is cute same as the entire design. Friendly staff, pick up is with a buzzer.

Update to 4 stars. Hoijicha was a bit chalky this time and chockfull of ice only. Staff is still charming but might need some training, it took me 10 minutes from ordering to paying for a simple order.
review_5_text: Nice cafe. Beautiful interior design. Food / drinks are also good, a bit  pricier compared to the area. But worth to give a try, can experience the interesting interior.

name: Hippo & Pineapple
review_1_text: The best hot coffee in town (I would say in Thailand) and delicious food (you should try their homemade brookie, it’s really tasty). We were there twice. There is a laundromat nearby, so you can do your laundry and have breakfast at the same time. The perfect place.
review_2_text: Wonderful brunch spot with great ambiance, fantastic coffee, and clean, delicious food. Homemade English muffins and bagels, a vinyl record player, and full English breakfast here!
review_3_text: Today we had Breakfast in this cool Bistro with a bit nostalgy and a warm welcome from the black house cat. Our Sets where delicious, same as our Hot Latte and Hot Cappuccino.
review_4_text: Came here for sweet treat o’clock. Time was telling cause these desserts were tasty. The carrot cake was our favorite. It was moist with the perfect amount of buttercream frosting. Our next favorite was the brookie. Get the milk ready cause it’s rich. Our third favorite was the scone. While it was super good tasting, it was very crumbly and I would dare say a little bit dry. The jam tasted awesome BUT the strawberry chunks were too big and practically the only part of jam so it just needs a little more!
review_5_text: This is an exceptionally good confectionary and cafe! The pastries and cakes are very generously sized (basically like anything you’d find in the U.S.) and priced for Thailand - any other cafe would be selling their offerings for twice the price and certainly wouldn’t taste half as good. The WiFi’s good and they’ve got comfortable seats to relax in, though you can tell some of the furniture is past its prime. The cafe itself is nice and spacious. Good place to do some work if you don’t mind the somewhat busy intersection it bumps up against!

name: น้ำผลไม้ปั่น
review_1_text:
We live near Wat Umong and go there often, in part to enjoy one of the delicious smoothies that she makes.  She uses fresh fruit and is careful to make it according to your preferences whether it be in degree of sweetness or in a multi fruit blend mix.
The price is very inexpensive and quality very high.   Enjoy your drink at one of the seats adjacent to the area or at the pond.
review_2_text: the juice had a really bad taste.
review_3_text: It was like an oasis on a hot day~ The avocado shake was not too sweet and so delicious that I really wanted to leave a review ^^

name: CRATE
review_1_text:
Dayum. What a cute find. Their menu is also great and the staff is super hospitable. The atmosphere is killer. You do not notice that you’re on the side of the road.

Come come 🤗✨

Edit: this hot cacao is one of the best I’ve had in Chiang mai 🥰
review_2_text: The place has a really nice atmosphere with a cozy wooden and green vibe. The chocolate blended drink was really good. I had the Larn Kua as my main dish — it didn’t taste super traditional, but it was still delicious. If I get the chance, I’d definitely come back here!
review_3_text: Really nice place with different areas. Food is always amazing and good value. Staff are nice . Only note is the back patio area could do with some renovations eg if they added another dining area there or fixed it up abit.
review_4_text: What a great Restaurant and Coffee Shop. Beautiful Yard, great design, super Food and amazing Coffee. Friendly Staff
review_5_text: Love this place!!! So chill here a big garden, cold inside with a good menu with great breakfast/ coffee. This is such a rare combo for these kind of prices. Normally a place has good coffee but not good food, or good food, not good coffee. Crate has good both, friendly staff, and beautiful garden. Happy to just chill, or work here as wifi is plenty fast. Keep up the good work team!

name: Please,Darling Studio
review_1_text: I love this shop so much.
review_2_text: The salmon salad is delicious, I recommend it.

name: UniqueCafe'byMook&Mom
review_1_text:
Cafe called Unique Cafe but how unique?  Not big, I would say rather small however rather cozy.  Also they have outside seating.  No pastries available.

Nice place to take a rest if u r nearby.

name: เมียงมอง Coffee & Drink
review_1_text: The atmosphere is good. The owner is kind and friendly. There are free snacks to go with your coffee. You can sit and relax all day.
review_2_text: Good water, good atmosphere, very good service.
review_3_text: The coffee tastes good.
review_4_text: delicious

name: PARADOX
review_1_text: Lovely little coffee shop tucked away in a corner just off of the highway. Friendly staff, quiet environment. Had a cappuccino which was delicious. I would definitely return if in the area.
review_2_text: Nice airy space, Good coffee for a good price. 55B for iced espresso ... worth a stop off.
review_3_text: We came 11am on a Tues. We were the only people, so lacked a bit of ambiance. However, delicious coffee, good Aircon, and they gave us some sample brownie for free. The art is also cool, with an optical illusion for the sign board on the back wall. See photo.
review_4_text: Dark, medium or light roast coffee beans are available. Nice ambience both air-condition and outdoor.
review_5_text:
Ordered a matcha latte

The cafe has a shy but adorable cat.

name: Thank You Teacher & Warrior club house
review_1_text: Ordered a waffle and the waitresses forgot even i asked two times. The drinks are average.
review_2_text: Lovely location, friendly owners.
review_3_text: A lovely shop with good service, offering food and drinks. 🫰
review_4_text:
A cute and comfortable coffee shop with a spacious interior. The coffee is strong and aromatic, and delicious.
To get to the shop, enter the alley next to the PTT gas station. Parking is available.
review_5_text:
A stylish coffee house has opened next to the first hole at the Star Dome. 
You can relax here while overlooking the course and practice range.

name: กระต่าย ชานมไข่มุก
review_1_text: Nice stand with friendly people
review_2_text: This small shop is located in the area of ​​the Thai Post Office. They have a wide variety of drinks at reasonable prices, starting at 20 baht. Free pearls are available for regular drinks. Fresh coffee costs 35 baht and up. They have seating and a loyalty card: buy 10 cups, get 1 free. The taste is sweet and delicious. The vendors are nimble and quick. You don't have to wait long. The service is good.

name: Smile Lanna Coffee & สมายล์ ล้านนา คอฟฟี่
review_1_text:
Always driving by, but this time we purposely went in for a lunch.
The location is on a busy intersection of the moat going to Airport Plaza and KAD so blink and you pass the entrance.
(Don’t blink go in!)
The owners are extremely proud of their hotel and this cafe, and so they should be.
It’s a very beautiful setting in a busy city.
The drinks and meal we had were well made and delicious.
Ample seating inside and out.
With great photo opportunities.
Gardens are maintained to a very high standard.
review_2_text: Beautiful little coffee shop at the entrance to Smile Lanna Hotel. Prices are rather fair and the garden is beautifully done with several small waterfalls and lots of flowers. Several places to sit with old world charm in each setting. Also several interesting artisan coffees week with a try. Need to come back to try more. Not a popular place so no crowds but just as nice as many of the “in places” right now.
review_3_text: A beautiful Café with a great Landscape and Koy Pond. Delicious Coffee
review_4_text: Fantastic espresso with strong fruity notes, some of the best I had in Thailand. Great smoothies. The place offers a calm atmophere even though it is right by a main road, allowing you to relax and forget time.
review_5_text:
Very disappointed.
I had breakfast at the coffee shop. There are 3 different sets. This is what I had, 'set c'.(Breakfast set, but not included a drink) Small portion of rice soup, 2 cold boiled eggs, and not fresh fruits. The food looked like they brought from their breakfast buffet. ( The buffet area of the hotel is right in front of the coffee shop.) The fruits were very dry, not any fresh. It looked like they were 'left over' which nobody wanted to take from the buffet.

I used to come here for a coffee, sometimes see friends for lunch and drinks. EspecialIy I like the coffee with coconut milk here very much. I maybe come back here for the coffee and lunch, but not for the breakfast.

name: Intend coffee cnx
review_1_text:
Lovely little coffee shop on the south of the old city! The owners are welcoming and friendly and felt so relaxed at an ease. The coffee tasted divine! I chose the Chiang mai bean (dark roast) but they also have a medium roast too from Columbia but yet to try that.

Ive been 3 days on a row! When you find good coffee on your doorstep, it’s a no brainer! ☕️👌🏻
review_2_text:
LOVE this cafe! Coffee is incredibly delicious and smooth. Although my hotel has included coffee, I skip it to go here!

The owner is very kind and knowledgeable about his coffee. I asked about his drawing and he gave me a little coffee lesson! He also roasts the coffee beans in-house.
review_3_text: The coffee here is so delicious and flavourful - the best I’ve had in CM so far! I had the oat milk latte with medium roast. The owners are really friendly too. I would definitely come back ☺️.
review_4_text: The americano dark roast is one of the best I've drank. Prefer it to be non acidic and not so bitter. Perfect! Nice ambience and owner!
review_5_text: The food was super refreshing and prepared perfectly, i didn't have an issue with the ripeness of the fruit or the temperature of the hot food with the set breakfast which is often a worry. It was all delicious and the dark roast coffee was amazing. On top of it all the service was great and everything arrived quickly!

name: MEVA Icecream & Smoothie
review_1_text: My friend enjoyed her taro ice cream and I enjoyed my coconut ice cream and we both love the passion fruit sorbet in this sweet little ice cream shop - lovely lady and old gentlemen serving great selection of cold treats, a variety of complementary toppings, water and tissue pepper are provided too
review_2_text: Well worth the visit. We tried the coconut milk ice cream and loved it! The free topping station is such a lovely little detail to customise the ice cream too. There are chairs to sit and enjoy inside and outside the shop
review_3_text: Really lovely wee icecream shop. Meva makes all the icecream her self. There are many very yummy vegan options. Everything is very reasonably priced. Definitely a must visit for sweet treats in Chiang Mai
review_4_text: Amazing place! They opened a few minutes earlier for us, the portions are big and the ice cream is delicious! This place also has free topping bar with a huge variety of add-ons, so that's cool as well!!
review_5_text: A bit disappointing considering the good review. Free topping is great if you like lots of extras with your ice cream. Coconut ice cream was decent, vanilla choc chip was almost identical to cheap stuff you can get in the supermarket

name: Coffee at Come-on Place
review_1_text: Hidden gem, this place is incredible. The hosts are so kind and generous. The iced green is one of the best I've had here. To top it off they have 5 beautiful corgis. Definitely worth a visit
review_2_text: amazing amazing amazing cafe!!! Lovely waitress and a beautiful area to sit in. Like 8 stunning corgis running about the place being beautiful and stunning and cute. One came and sat on the table and the waitress asked if we wanted him down but we absolutely did not. He kept us company as we played cards and drank our tasty drinks around him.
review_3_text:
The nicest cafe surrounded by greenery and trees. Seats are outside and there's cute corgis running around, the cutest and friendliest dogs you can pet!
Very cute off the beaten track cafe if you like quirky, greenery and dogs!
review_4_text: CORGIS CORGIS CORGIS also there is coffee which is quite nice, don't mind the barking they're very friendly
review_5_text: It's a coffee shop that doesn't looks like a coffee shop, It's feel like a someone house, but it's a lot of fat corgis.

name: BRB Cafe
review_1_text: Stopped in for brunch, what a pleasant discovery. Both orders were generous, fresh, great value and this venue is a color party for the eyes. Loved finding yet another treasure in Chiang Mai for future visits. 👍❤️🙏
review_2_text: The staff and food were very good. I ordered the pan eggs and a single waffle. The atmosphere of the cafe was great too since it was connected with a nice hotel.
review_3_text: We've been sitting here waiting for our smoothies for over 20 minutes. There's an unpleasant smell coming from the kitchen in the dining room.
review_4_text: Coffee was terrible, tasted like instant or robusta. The English breakfast was an ok facsimile. But german sausage had cheese in it like the awful US brats. Beans were the real deal. 'salad' with nothing on it (not even a lemon). Bacon was ok. But ham was just the standard thin 'wet' processed meat but fried.
review_5_text: How is this place not packed with customers? Perfect ambience, excellent location. Oh, did I mention the poached eggs on avocado toast was truly exquisite!!!

name: ธาราคอฟฟี่
review_1_text: good coffee and delicious snacks. And good staff there
review_2_text: Ok
review_3_text: The food is delicious and there's a wide variety. The view is beautiful by the water, and there are many great photo opportunities.
review_4_text: The coffee is fragrant and delicious, the service is fast, the place is clean, and the staff are very helpful.
review_5_text: Affordable coffee

name: คาร์แคร์ทิพเนตร & กาแฟสด
review_1_text: Good service, polite staff, clean wash, fast service, and affordable price. I'll definitely come back for another wash. Highly recommended.
review_2_text: I always come here to wash my car whenever I have something to do nearby. It's very clean and the service is great.
review_3_text: The price is cheap, the washing is clean, and the service is very satisfactory.
review_4_text: The car wash is very clean.

name: NADA COFFEE "ณดา คอฟฟี่"
review_1_text: Goods
review_2_text: Last year I discovered "NADA COFFEE" and this year we've seen Dada again. She's a wonderful person, very kind, and this year the location is perfect and peaceful. There are plenty of places to eat and shops nearby!
review_3_text: I'm not sure if the coffee is good or not. It tastes ordinary, like the coffee from a roadside stall. It's not special like other shops. The coffee is bitter and has no other flavor besides bitterness. They should improve the taste.
review_4_text: The tea is delicious. Come and try it!
review_5_text: Not tasty

name: Chuan Chong coffee
review_1_text:
I just passed by this coffee shop shop!
Owner was very pleasant to buy a latte from and super friendly! You all shall go try her coffee which taste really good and was professional done with the hand drawn flowery sign on the top of the latte ❤️👍😊! I will definitely go back and the shop is easy to sit in also !
review_2_text: Lovely quiet and comfortable, best mango coffee I ever had
review_3_text: Lovely and nice services with thai chill music 90's, my order is cocoa no milk no sugar 28TH its very nice
review_4_text: Great place to stop for a coffee, tea, or juice. Great price & lovely people working there
review_5_text: Dropped by to get a cold Thai tea. The price is cheap and the tea was very tasty!

name: Mellow Cat Coffee (Coffee Shop. Not a cat cafe and not a hostel.)
review_1_text: Not the best I've tried but still good

name: Meo Cafe’
review_1_text: Cute little cafe! Great coffee, great service.
review_2_text: I really liked this place.  It was right around the corner from where we were staying.  Nice quiet atmosphere off the main road.

name: kohicha.cnx - coffee x matcha
review_1_text:
I almost didn’t post this review since I don’t want to blow up this spot, but after going here multiple times within the two weeks we were in Chiang Mai, I felt like it was my duty to share how magical this place is.

As someone who drinks matcha everyday at home I was craving  quality matcha spot and kohicha is quite literally the best matcha experience I’ve had. Their menu has a wide variety of strains with tasting notes listed as well as a guide to which ones make for good lattes and which are best drank just with water. Oat milk swap is free and there are other alt milk options!

All the staff is really knowledgeable and have great recommendations.

The wifi is great for working and there are a few larger tables and outlets. It does get busy so these spots are not always guaranteed. It’s also a dog friendly location which has been a welcome distraction in my experience.

I’d also highly recommend the daifuku strawberry mochi. I get it every time! The chocolate cake is also phenomenal. The Nutty Yama has been my favorite so far out of the ~10 I’ve tried but it’s also a limited edition option.

Bring cash as card is not accepted.
review_2_text:
A newly opened spot that’s likely to become very popular soon.

The drinks are excellent, the staff is friendly, and the desserts are really good. The air conditioning is extremely cold, so it’s best to bring something warm to wear. The place looks great inside, and the prices are reasonable.
review_3_text: A hidden minimalist gem in the heart of Chiang Mai. KOHICHA offers such a peaceful and calm atmosphere—it’s the perfect place to slow down. Every drink is crafted with so much care and the flavors are truly exceptional. Highly recommended for anyone looking for a quiet, high-quality coffee/tea break! ✨🍵
review_4_text: excellence. huge thoughtfully selected menu of ceremonial grade matcha with free oat milk option. absolutely loved it, the staff were so nice and welcoming. definitely recommend!
review_5_text: Premium matcha and great coffee. Nice atmosphere - close to the city but quiet and relaxing. Definitely worth a visit in Chiang Mai.

name: TENTEN SUKIYAKI & CAFE
review_1_text: Hidden upstairs near our hotel we found this Japanese gem. The quality of the food was excellent. Every dish was flavorful and well presented. The restaurant is a quiet and comfortable place to have a delicious meal, a few beers on tap and some sake. Service is very attentive and detail oriented. A perfect spot for our last night in Chiang Mai. We are amazed at the quality they can offer at this price point. Do not hesitate to visit if you want an alternative to Thai food.
review_2_text:
Excellent beverages. Superb coffee and service was excellent. The establishment was spotlessly clean, cool, relaxed and friendly. Another 'gem' in Chiang Mai. I will definitely return for a meal next time.
Thank you so much for adding to my memories ❤️ of Chiang Mai. Thank you 😊 🙏
review_3_text:
Taste: ★★★★★★★
Price: ★
Service: ★★

The taste is well worth the price, and it’s truly the best beef in Chiang Mai. Our bill came to nearly 4,000 baht, but due to a mistake in the calculation, we almost ended up paying more. I’m not sure if it was just an error or because we are foreigners, but it’s important to double-check the bill.
review_4_text: The place's main thing is serving a proper sukiyaki with high quality Japanese beef. If it's your first time trying sukiyaki, they will explain everything and show you how to cook it. To accompany it you can order some good sake or Japanese beer. The place accepts card payments which is rare in Thailand.
review_5_text: This is the best japanese restaurant in Chiang may! The food is fresh and good and the service is Great!

name: Carrot coffee cnx
review_1_text: Nice cozy café in the middle of the city. Relaxed atmosphere, interesting drink options. Carrot cake is delicious! Good place to chill and take a rest. Staff is polite. Unfortunately they do not accept credit cards.
review_2_text: Great, roomy cafe along a quiet street, spanning two sizeable yet cosy floors and an airy patio out back, contemporarily inspired with old-school finishes. Fantastic for chats and work alike. Great coffee with bean/roast selection; cakes look swell as well. Service is bright and cordial. Not busy on a weekday morning, with plenty of comfortable seating to choose from.
review_3_text:
One of the best cafes in Chiang Mai.
Fantastic carrot cake, a great selection of beverages, and a beautiful, laid-back interior with a very prominent Korean vibe.
The music is great, the staff are super kind, and the toilets are clean.
It’s also set in a lovely neighbourhood full of greenery.
review_4_text:
Another nice little underrated cafe. Very cozy interior, cool but somehow cozy. They got kinda everything. From very good coffee to nice healthy freshly pressed cold juices. 🥤
I had the 🥕+ 🍎 + 🫚 = healthy and good👌🏻
Definitely worth a visit
review_5_text:
Cool place with a lofty feel - minimalism, concrete all around, bold graphics, great food presentation.

This small bakery has a good variety of pastries for its size. We had a pastry with blueberries and fresh cream - extremely delicious!

Friendly staff. Some seats to enjoy your food and do some work on your laptop.

name: Sunday Baker
review_1_text:
This coffee shop is conveniently located on the main road of old town, has an outdoor sunny space to have your breakfast under the sun.
Large selection of breakfast and good coffees to choose from. Cappuccino is not state-of-the-art in term of latte art. Staff is attentive.
Probably they need only to pay more attention to the outside tables cleanings. Anyway is worth to try.
review_2_text: Came back two days in a row. Food is delicious and they have so many options. Their scones are delicious as well as the corn flake crusted French toast. They have tons of pastries and cakes that all look delicious. Coffee is decent, they have a very large matcha menu which I have yet to try but they seem to be well versed in the matcha dept. Great atmosphere and has great AC.
review_3_text: It was so lovely I had to eat here two mornings in a row! Such a cute little cafe with many options for food, pastries, and beverages. The latte was good, but nothing too special. They do have an extensive selection of matcha, which I’d love to try one time. The French toast and scrambled eggs were absolutely delicious. If you order a side of bacon, be prepared to only get about 2 pieces. The almond croissant was decent. It was tasty but veryyy buttery and a bit messy. The atmosphere was great, they play some good music, and the AC is perfect.
review_4_text: Loved the experience and the food. The place is tastefully decorated and the staff is kind. This is totally a gold selection for brunch ❤️
review_5_text: Came here for breakfast. The muffin was lovely. The avocado and toast was okay. The coffee was just okay. It wasn't great. It was quite expensive as well considering other meals we have had in Chiang Mai.

name: Bloomin' Moon Hostel, Chiang Mai Old Town
review_1_text: Came here with my toddler and had such a delicious lunch! Really tasty fresh noodle dish with crispy chicken and my little one enjoyed waffles and cream. All so beautifully presented and a really lovely atmosphere. Nice, clean fresh and lovely attentive service. A great selection of desserts and drinks. A must visit :) highly recommend!
review_2_text:
I paid more by accident, and the kind waitress gave me my money back — I really appreciate the honesty!
Thank you so much! By the way, the coffee was delicious. The lunch portion was generous, and the quality of the meat was very good.
They offer free water refills and always ask if we are okay, so you can see they truly care about their customers.🥰
review_3_text: Review for the coffee shop attached: Cutest little coffee shop with an incredible variety of hot/cold matcha/coffee options. Staff was the absolute friendliest with nothing but smiles as they helped us decide what to order. Went for the fresh coconut iced americano and the moon drop. Both were spectacular. The moon drop is a super unique blend of textures, temperatures, and flavors! Definitely will stop back by.
review_4_text: I had breakfast with my family here and it was one of the most beautiful meals I’ve ever had! The food was delicious and fresh, served in an amazing way! The staff is also super nice and the serving time quick! Strongly recommend!!!
review_5_text:
Came back 3 times! worth it, even tho a bit pricier compared to other restaurants. Their coffee and staff are very good, and we tried their fruits and salads.
Only suggestion is portions could be a bit bigger for the price.

name: Friend Coffee & Bar
review_1_text: Very clean and good mood. Until late time, coffee is available because it’s running with bar together from 6pm. Kind staff. I just feel outside space is too small but very good for computer works in day and good drinking sun night.
review_2_text: A little more expensive, but good coffee & nice interior. Peaceful and cool. Nice break from the main streets!
review_3_text:
Love the vibe of this place, very minimal interior and clean. Spacious enough to do some work, though a lot of the seating is not conducive to doing extensive laptop work.

Coffee was top notch. I got the Double Black which is 2 shots of espresso and orange. It was good if you like that sort of thing.

Shout out to the music curator, I loved the music. It was a soulful deep house kind of vibe. Exactly my cup of tea (or coffee rather 😉)
review_4_text: This a good place to read, rest and good taste of coffee . 👍👍👍 Canada visitor.
review_5_text: Solid matcha latte and excellent atmosphere! I would skip on the pastries here though, nothing outstanding

name: Garage Café
review_1_text: Cozy café with the best Pad Thai I have ever had in town. I’ve come here so many times. Whenever I crave Pad Thai, this is always my go‑to spot, with warm service that makes every visit special.
review_2_text: We stumbled into this place totally by accident. But it turned out to be a great experience. There is not a lot on the menu but their Pad Thai is definitely on the top tier that I have had. Not to mention, the Thai ice tea is also a must try! We have devoured the food so much before we took a picture. Highly recommend this.
review_3_text: Kind, welcoming and relaxed atmosphere. We stumbled across the cafe and loved it. Pad Thai and mango sticky rice, the only menu items, were perfect. The owner told us he opened the cafe to serve the Thai iced tea but added other options just because. The cafe offers bananas for free while we wait and he prepared the pad Thai fresh. It was like eating in the patio of a family friend who also makes really delicious authentic Thai food. Thank you 🙏
review_4_text: Really good Pad Thai for only 50 baht. The drinks are amazing and the owner is really nice. He offers bananas for free and puts on the ventilator when you sit down at the table. We really liked it here so we even came here a second time.
review_5_text: I’ve been all over Thailand, can say hands down this is one of the best Pad Thai’s out there! This guy can cook!

name: Nok Kafe / Home Cooked Vegetarian and Thai Food
review_1_text: Highly recommended for vegetarians! Auntie is super nice and welcoming, she’ll customize each dish for you. Ate here four times, the food is delicious! Tried the spicy thai basil fried rice, tom yum fried rice, tofu curry, mushrooms stir fry, broccoli stir fry, and the ginger tofu stir fry! Every dish on the menu can be made vegetarian with eggs/tofu. They have a very loving dog as well, don’t forget to play with it when you’re there. I’ll miss this place.
review_2_text: Amazing Khao Soi soup! The best I had in Chiang Mai. I am not the fan of fish sause so either here was very little or none. I went for veggie option and my partner ordered veggie plus tofu.
review_3_text:
Home cooking haven. If you wanna have a meal that feels like your aunt and granny are cooking for you, this is your place.

Food is fresh, tasty, with some herbs hand-picked on the spot right before preparation, and gets ready swiftly. And the menu is very affordable.

The atmosphere is lovely, full (like, full!) of plants, on a not so busy street, with a home vibe whose only downside is the maker space next to it which 1 out of 3 times we've eaten here this far has had some loud noise.

The ladies who run this are so very kind. I can definitely feel the love they put into the food, and have come here almost daily during my stay.

I'd 1000% recommend it!
review_4_text: The food is amazing, lovely homemade food, definitely worth the wait! Relaxing, serene restaurant with friendly, smiley owners! Hopefully be back in the future!!
review_5_text: This is a hidden hole in the wall that we discovered the last day of our stay of 10 days! To increase the irony, we stayed at the hotel right next to it, but the tendency is to walk towards the action and main street... We wished we had discovered it before because this was by far the best meal and dishes we had in Thailand! Atmosphere is quiet surrounded by nature and the owner served us with grace. The food was literally spectacular. I wish Michelin would discover this place because the food is high quality and to the level of the highest quality restaurants with prices of any street food quality... Seriously you must try this place! Thank you so much for this last meal before our flight. The highlight of food of our 2 weeks in Thailand.

name: Pangkhon Coffee
review_1_text: Cute local coffee cafe. Serving locally roasted coffee. The Americano I ordered was very good. We also ordered a vanilla lattes with oat milk and it was not good. It was still black and we asked if it had oat milk and they said no. It was not creamy at all.
review_2_text:
Cappuchino tasted really bad. Was given a replacement but still tasted strange.

Places used old milk or old beans. Will not go again.
review_3_text: We ordered a hot latte and a iced hazlenut latte for 120THB! The coffee was amazing and we will definitely be back. We didn’t order food but the table next to us did and it looked really nice.
review_4_text:
I had fried vegetables with rice. It had a twist of garlic and chili, very delicious. Good value as well, only 65 baht.
Not busy at all. I might return for copy paste this dish.
review_5_text: I came to have a massage and as it is connected to the coffee shop, it was a bit noisy. The lady that gave me the massage had a cold, and not only she was wiping her nose while she was giving the massage, but also she was sending text messages. You could improve your respect for your customers.

name: Le light cafe'
review_1_text:
A yogurt bowl cold Summer case, was quite good. The bottle contains plain yogurt, oats, honey, apple, mango, banana, flux seeds.(hopefully I mentioned all.)
It was more than I expected for its price!!

It was actually to find the place to work on my lap top more than to have meal or drink after the cafe I was staying before reached to their closing time. But it was a such a nice encounter that I randomly picked this cafe. Table and chairs were right to work on computer, the bowl was tasty and right size, the waiter was sweet😌
review_2_text:
If you find yourself in Chiang Mai and are looking for a place where you can not only have a great meal but also have a nice time, Tsuneki Ramen is the place to go. The name of the place may not be too well known due to Google Maps misunderstandings, but trust me, it's worth it.

Stepping inside, you will immediately feel the welcoming atmosphere, thanks to the wonderful staff and cozy ambiance. The interior is complemented by comfortable furniture and a huge collection of graphic novels, which will especially appeal to fans of reading and Japanese culture. Despite the fact that the cafe is located next to the road, it is surprisingly quiet inside, allowing you to completely relax and enjoy a delicious meal.

Speaking of food, Tsuneki Ramen's menu will delight you with a variety of flavors. I stopped in here for a coffee but couldn't resist their culinary offerings. Everything I tried was simply delicious and the prices were quite nice.

This place deserves to be much more popular. I wish Tsuneki Ramen a huge success and I am sure that everyone who visits here will be satisfied with their visit. Don't miss this gem of Chiang Mai
review_3_text:
Great breakfast and super tasty Matcha Latte.

My god, there is even the Berserk series and Vagabond manga in japanese with Hiragana for those who cannot read kanjis.

You're pretty good
review_4_text: Absolutely loved my experience at this coffee shop in Chiang Mai! The staff was incredibly friendly and attentive. Their 100% fruit juices are an absolute must-try – no added sugars or ice !!, just pure goodness. And the bonus? A shelf full of classic manga, including Berserk, for some delightful reading while sipping on those amazing juices.
review_5_text: The atmosphere and service was good, maybe a bit slow, but we didn’t mind. However, the food quality was not what we expected. I had avocado egg sandwich and it had more mayo than avo and egg, the smash was more white than green, and to top it all the toasts were buttered, quite a heavy breakfast. My husband had americano and he said it was okay.

name: Jomkwan Coffee Café @Wualai
review_1_text: Although the shop is currently under renovation, I think I'll definitely be back to this coffee shop next year. Today I ordered an iced cappuccino. The flavor was well-balanced and not too sweet. The owner was very friendly. I like this place.
review_2_text:
Really lovely coffee shop with great coffee on silver street.

Lovely calm vibe instead and great tasting coffee.

Lovely staff.

Would recommend
review_3_text: Such nice lovely owners which are taking care of their customers. We ordered several times different smoothies with no sugar added for 35 baht each and all of them were delicious (cantaloupe, Orange, lychee…). Thank you 🙏
review_4_text: Excellent smoothies and lovely service. I asked for less sugar and she adjusted it to exactly my taste by making try a few times. So thoughtful.
review_5_text: Best smoothies in Chiang Mai - and the owners are so friendly! We have come here every day of our month-long vacation in Chiang Mai!

name: Family Home 2 Chiang Mai
review_1_text: ‏ stayed at this hostel for three nights and had a fantastic experience. The beds were very comfortable, which ensured a good night's sleep. The best part was the atmosphere; it was incredibly welcoming and social, making it easy to meet and connect with other travelers. The staff were friendly and helpful. I would definitely stay here again and recommend it to anyone looking for a great hostel experience.
review_2_text: Love how social this hostel is. Even when you don't stay with them, you can book their daily sticky waterfall tours! I'll definitely visit this place when I'm back in Chiang mai. The staff are so friendly and helpful which really makes you feel a part of their family too.
review_3_text:
I stayed in the dorm and had a really good experience. The place has a warm, home-like atmosphere that makes you feel comfortable right away.

The dorm was clean and well maintained, with a relaxed vibe that made it easy to rest and meet other travelers. The staff were very kind and helpful, always happy to assist and share local tips.
review_4_text: Loved this place. Incredibly social hostel without any of the “free shots at the bar” forced fun type stuff. There’s just a really nice social area where everyone chills and makes friends. They also have daytime and nighttime activities organised every day with loads of people going on them. Staff really lovely too
review_5_text: One of the best hostels i have stayed at so far. Highly recommend booking here on here on your trip to Chiang Mai if you want a social hostel with a chill vibe, quiet rooms and SO CLEAN. Also staff very friendly and helpful 💖

name: MINTNIMAL
review_1_text: Absolutely wonderful banana chocolate cake, and the Thai iced tea is made fresh and is wonderfully roasted tea leaf-flavored. Cute little shop, too!
review_2_text: The smoothie I got was frickin great and chunky. There’s a nice vibe to the place as well.
review_3_text:
Very cute place to take a break, a great selection of ice-creams and sorbets, as well as a few baked treats too.

Went back a second time, the apple cake was delicious!
review_4_text: A mint lover’s paradise! We had a Mintnimal cocoa, mint ice cream and a slice of apple cake with salted caramel sauce - all were amazing. We will be returning!
review_5_text:
I went here for something cold to drink during another hot, Chiang Mai day. A friend recommended I get the wild honey lime drink. The person running the shop was nice and engaging. I orders the recommended drink, but when I saw the banana cake, I couldn’t resist adding it to my order. The drink was cold and refreshing and not overly sweet (maybe I asked for not much sugar. I can’t remember). The cake was, WOW! I didn’t expect it to be that good. It had a caramel sauce with it that was magical. Note: There was only one person working there, so make sure you’re not in a rush.
Pt. 2 I went a second time and got the apple dessert. Wow! Magical.

name: GAAD Coffee/Bar & Conversation
review_1_text:
Flat White 75฿ (2026)

Has English menu, also accepts card.

Friendly staff. The cute girl who took my order also made my coffee, she is very careful when pouring foam milk into the cup.

There are at least 2 floors up, I went to the second floor, with a charging port for my phone and facing outside, so is a nice place to sit.

It is nice environment, some nice music, and quiet. And nice coffee.

I think is good to have some chat with friends, or quietly enjoying the day, reading a book, or listening to music, or just watching the outside busy street.

Nice place for me.
review_2_text:
One of the best cafés I’ve visited in Chiang Mai. I could feel that beloved sour-tangy flavour in the Americano — exactly how I like my coffee. The flat white was also exceptional.

The ambience is simple, elegant, and really calming. Coffee that truly hits the spot and makes you want to come back again.

A perfect place to hang around, relax, and enjoy great coffee in Chiang Mai. Highly recommended!
review_3_text: Such a good coffee and very nicely place They use north Thai coffee beans ,The shop is near Chiang Mai Gate Market. Makes you see the lifestyle of local people. Sourdough tuna pesto sandwich is delicious.
review_4_text: Good coffee, staff are friendly, working space with a good vibes but I don’t see any food menu and bakery
review_5_text:
Good place for a quick refresher. Alcohol and coffee in one place. Nice ambients. Nice renovation. Look at those wiring
..above you

name: Breakfast & brunch for healthy chamalay café bistro @Chiang Mai
review_1_text: They open at 8 AM. In Chiang Mai, being able to enjoy such a hearty breakfast so early in the morning is a real treat. The food and drinks were delicious, giving me the energy for the day. Although the prices aren't exactly cheap, the ingredients are incredibly high-quality, and I highly recommend this restaurant.
review_2_text:
Nice place, cool, good atmosphere
Good mix of western style food & drinks but no full English breakfast. No thai food either. Good presentation, but bland.  Sourdough spinach cheese & mushroom very bland without salt. Advocado, spinch & egg toast also bland without salt.
Special 'jaguar' coffee mediocre even with two shots. Shakes and smoothies are on the small side.  Tables & benches are smallish. Overall style over substance. Quite pricy too.  Will not return.
review_3_text: So many avocado options in the menu that i just want to try them all. lol The place is quiet, calming, and no wonder it has great reviews! Their Matcha Latte tastes good too! Avooolicious. 🥑💯🫶🏻
review_4_text: Only open 8am - 12.30pm and normally a wait for a table. Extensive breakfast menu. We had an Acai bowl which was yum. Coffees were delicious too. Service was on the slow side but only because each order is made fresh to order. Worth the wait.
review_5_text: It’s nothing like you see in the pictures ;) so don’t expect something extraordinary. I got a smoothie bowl with a few bits of fruit and a spoonful of seeds. Of course it tastes nice, cause it’s fruit, but it’s not worth the price 🙏

name: Koff & Things
review_1_text:
Koff & Things offers a truly refined experience for those seeking a peaceful start to their day. The establishment boasts a unique and thoughtfully designed interior that creates a warm, welcoming atmosphere. It is an ideal sanctuary for focused thinking or enjoying a book in solitude.

Both the coffee and matcha are prepared to a good standard, reflecting a commitment to quality. Whether you are a connoisseur or a casual visitor, the serene ambiance and excellent beverages make this a must-visit destination in Chiang Mai. Highly recommended for those who appreciate a quiet, aesthetic space.
review_2_text:
One of my favorite coffee shop in Chiang Mai!! I came here twice during my vacation.
The dirty coffee is very good, just like my standard.
And the place is sooo nice, it decorated with an old Japanese style / more like Kyoto style with wooden wall, windows, and floor. I can sit an hour there just to enjoy the place, the music, and my coffee.
review_3_text: Not my favorite coffee, but one of the most beautiful cafes. Traditional style lanna teak house with cozy upstairs. Natural light filters through the big windows. You can watch the moat traffic at the nearby gate outside. Great chill space. Also has a small meeting room.
review_4_text:
Stunning exteriors and interiors with a cozy furnishings. There are seating for singles, small groups and there even is a private room for larger groups.

Drink selection is wide with both coffee and non coffee. There are several signature drinks and seasonal drinks too.

There is no Pour Over option tho.

I had the flat white and the blooming flowers.

The flat white is decently thick with pronounced flavors from the beans. The milk pairs well with chosen beans but this is not the best milk we have tried. However, I like it overall.

The blooming Flowers is refreshing and even tho it has hints of sweetness, we never got tired of it. It’s a nice change of pace on a hot day and you’ve had too much coffee.

I recommend the place for your next coffee crawl.
review_5_text: Well worthy of five stars. Probably the best caramel macchiato I’ve had, ever. Peach tea was very good and the cookie 🍪 was also really delicious. Love the Japanese style decor and the staff were friendly 😎 oh yeah and that’s a Pegasus in the coffee 🤩☕️

name: Cozy Cafe Chiangmai
review_1_text: Such a cute and truly cozy place to relax, have a chat, or read/write/doodle. Theres both indoor and outdoor spaces. I got an orange strawberry smoothie and it was super tasty and looked beautiful! ✨️ I didnt order any food but everything looks amazing!
review_2_text: Delicious Lattes with pretty designs.  Had a bacon cheeseburger and fries.  Was Craving bc all the rice and noodles we've been eating.  Pretty good.  Hubby had English breakfast and he really enjoyed it.
review_3_text: Really good food both Thai and western. Best fried chicken in town. Lots of tree and outdoor dinning area is recommended. Parking is available.
review_4_text: Food was absolutely delicious and our waitress was very sweet. I got the French toast and it was the best French toast that I’ve had in a very long time. It did take a bit for our coffee and food to come out. The inside is pretty cute, we sat at one of the two outdoor tables and there were quite a few ants at my feet. I would go back and just sit inside next time.
review_5_text: Cozy and very relax. We have been there in the afternoon try to find the place to escape the sun. The waiter is kind enough to turn on the air con for us. We ordered cold pressed and yogurt drink. They are very nice and fresh.

name: Rei coffee roaster
review_1_text: I love the atmosphere! And coffee is sooo delightful! Highly recommended
review_2_text: Best espresso I‘ve had on my trip so far, perfectly extracted light roast. Roasted in-house. Beans from thailand are available as hand brew.
review_3_text:
Rei Coffee Roaster – Specialty Coffee in Chiang Mai

Rei Coffee Roaster is a specialty coffee shop located at 5/1 Phra Pok Klao Road, Phra Singh, Chiang Mai. The café offers a minimalist and stylish ambiance, providing a cozy environment for coffee enthusiasts. Their menu features a variety of specialty coffee blends and delicious desserts. The café operates daily from 8:00 AM to 6:00 PM.
review_4_text:
One of the best coffee in Thailand—I missed this coffee so much while I was abroad. The blend of Brazilian and Laotian beans is incredible. The caramel custard paired perfectly with the coffee. 🍮☕️

The service was outstanding, and the owner, who roasts the beans himself, is not only kind but also highly knowledgeable about coffee. If you're a coffee lover, I highly recommend this place. Plus, the prices are very reasonable!
review_5_text:
Great spot to take a break. Had a delicious iced matcha and my husband had an iced coffee. They also have Australian MilkLab almond milk and Japanese Oakside oatmilk available.

Great music too.

name: NU NU NINI's CAFE'
review_1_text:
Great view… if you’re skilled at mentally photoshopping out the forest of power lines.
As for the coffee — let’s just say the scenery ended up being the stronger part of the experience 😅
review_2_text: Very good location. Nice coffee shop. I had coffee with apple pie, it was tasteful. Friendly staff.
review_3_text:
This little corner coffee shop is absolutely one of our favorites in Chiang Mai!
The owner roasts her own coffee every day (which sometimes smells amazing) and grinds it fresh for every coffee drink.
They make some amazing lattes and cappuccinos, but also have a wide variety of other choices.
There is seating on the street level that is open, but if you prefer a quieter place to relax or work, there is a large, air conditioned room upstairs with couches and tables where you can sit and enjoy your time.
Free WiFi is available.
They have coffee and tea drinks, milk drinks, sodas, water, and smoothies, as well as really great danishes, croissants, and desserts. Ice cream is available, too.
Prices are really reasonable for the high quality.
We will keep recommending this little place to all of our friends!
review_4_text: This nice coffee shop is amazing! Tasty coffee, and delicious cinnamon roll and carrot cake.
review_5_text: This Coffee shop is located at a busy street (going along the canal). They have a great selection of (various) coffee drinks and cakes. The ground floor has only fans (as it is open to the street, also bit loud) but you can sit upstairs (with AC) if you want to. Coffee was very good. The lady at the counter (who is doing multiple tasks) was very friendly and efficient.

name: จักรพรรดิ อารมณ์ดี Coffee
review_1_text: There are three cats that guard the coffee house/temple. Inside there is an Oni that guards the kingdom as well. It's like a little Buddhist temple coffee house. They welcomed me and fed me. Most grateful 🥰🙏🏼🔥
review_2_text: Americano here is really good. Service is 5 star!
review_3_text: There's delicious coffee, peace, and a sacred atmosphere. Everyone can come and join in the chanting. 🙏
review_4_text: Clean, bright, and peaceful. Enjoy delicious coffee while listening to chanting. You can also make merit by purchasing sacred objects directly from the temple and the abbot. The second floor is suitable for meditation and chanting. Followers of Luang Pu Doo and Luang Ta Ma are welcome. The Chakraphat chanting for karmic adjustment is available at any time. Located in Chiang Mai city center, it's easily accessible. There is limited parking in front of the shop, but you can park across the street on the inner sidewalk near the temple and walk over to buy coffee.
review_5_text: A place to sit and sip coffee and other beverages. You can sit and pray in peace on the second floor and pay homage to sacred objects from Wat Phuttaphrompanyo (Wat Tha Muang Na).

name: P.J. Coffee & Food
review_1_text:
Pretty nice breakfast spot that also allows takeaways.

An open air restaurant that feels warm and cozy. The shop owners are very friendly, attentive, and speaks good English.

I got their omelette rice which is simple yet delicious, the portion is pretty big too. Also had a pad thai as a takeaway for my family, they enjoyed it as well. Loved the texture of the noodles especially, the taste is above average.

Also got a cappuccino with sugar, a bit on the sweeter side but it still tasted good.
review_2_text:
Wow! What a little slice of heaven. Delicious coffee, even more delicious food, all with friendly service and in an adorable atmosphere. Had the best time and ate every bite of my Pad See Ew - Khao soi was also perfection!

Come here if you want a quiet, peaceful meal with a great family serving you.
review_3_text: “Found this place by accident and had the best Pad Thai I ever ate! I came back two more times. The owners are so friendly and kind. Highly recommend!”
review_4_text: Had ice Americano & a chicken basil- server substituted the rice for veg for me. I appreciate this spot for its v lowkey simplicity that hits the spot to quench an on the go craving for something to eat or drink while also being cheap
review_5_text: The food is amazing and in great price. But most importantly the owner is such a lovely person! Very helpful and kind. We will definitely come back! :)

name: Brown Coli Cafe
review_1_text: This is such a gem of a cafe. Well air conditioned, relaxing atmosphere, strong wifi for working, lovely workers, delicious food, and very well priced. I asked for little to no sugar in my mocha and it was excellent. The banana cake with caramel was surprisingly moist, warm, and absolutely delicious (coming from a chocolate lover)! This is tucked away along a busy main road. I hope more people discover them soon so they get more patronage.
review_2_text:
We enjoyed our drinks: coffee with oat milk + Camomile tea.
A cute cafe with cute clay work that you can buy.
Wouldn't recommend the cake though, I chose the chocolate cake and it wasn't tasty at all.
review_3_text:
A nice little two-storey cafe, a few minutes walk from the Chiang Mai Gate Market. It faces the road and is tucked away with a small entrance. You need to look out for it.

The drinks are reasonably priced and the aircon + wifi is great. There are some charging points but not around all the tables. Suitable for work.

You can buy some artistic clay souvenirs here too. If you like a good view, sit on the second storey.

The owners are very friendly and welcoming. Worth a visit.
review_4_text: My friend and I loved this café so much we visited three times during our stay in Chiang Mai! They have a gorgeous selection of coffees, teas, and sodas, all beautifully presented. The staff are so kind and friendly as well. Definitely add this hidden gem to your Chiang Mai bucket list! ❤️
review_5_text: Amazing and delicious hidden café in Chiang Mai. We stumbled upon this cute little café and have been going there every day during our travels in Chiang Mai. The staff is very friendly, the drinks are cheap, delicious, fresh and homemade. It has a calm atmosphere and upstairs theres a shop with handmade ceramics made by the owner. Definitely stop by and grab one of the coffees or sodas, one of the best cafés in Chiang Mai!

name: Coffee Tid Doi / e-Cin Cafe
review_1_text:
2009 Thailand Indy Barista Champion! Located inside the Chiang Mai Gate Market, near the main entrance. Great coffee! Smooth dark chocolate smokey woodsy flavor taste. Exceptional service with a smile and friendly welcoming! She also sells desserts as well. Highly recommended visit 👌

Scale 1-10:
Food/drink-10
Price-9
Service-10
Atmosphere-8
Cleanliness-9
review_2_text:
Best Thai Iced tea that we had so far.
Coffee is also exceptional!

Loved it and the owner is kind and heartwarming!
review_3_text: I saw the raving reviews here and I had to come here to try. As expected, the coffee is really great and you get a great amount in a cup. It is definitely one of the best place to get a to go coffee. I will be a regular and will come back to try different coffee on the menu. It’s located in the food court area in B1.
review_4_text:
She is hidden in the alley of the morning market , but still open when I went around 5:00 pm today.
Coffee latte was excellent and love her friendliness and big smile on her face when telling me her story of moving from a big shopping center to this booth. I admire her spirit and customer service , I rated her number #1 in the coffee taste and her service 👍
review_5_text: Lovely friendly shop owner! And great coffee in the market. Grab a cup and walk around.

name: Big&O's Cafe
review_1_text:
60 baht for a very small cup of coffee. Breakfast food mediocre. Omelett very fatty. Club Sandwich was okay.
Lots of hungover people (hostel guests) sitting around.
