review_2_text: it's part of the hostel, just down the Soi, opposite Baan Bakery. There's free WiFi. An iced latte was 50 baht. They do food as well but I wasn't hungry. Pleasant relaxing background music.
review_3_text: Coffee is too diluted. It tastes like water. 50baht is a bit pricey for watery coffee. Club sandwich is 99 baht. Fair.
review_4_text: I went to eat and it was delicious, also I noticed that they had tours and transportation, so after booking my minibus to Pai through them I also booked a tour to Maerim elephant sanctuary that they recommended to me and it was amazing! Great family run business!
review_5_text: Loved this hostel! It was small but the staff were so lovely. The beds were slightly uncomfy though

name: Bear Hug Cafe'
review_1_text: I went here when I first got to Chiang Mai many months ago, and decided to take a friend who visited last week to show her the cute aesthetic of this shop and their fun latte art. Highly recommend this place, and the egg drop sandwiches are really good, too. 🤭
review_2_text:
I was really excited to visit Bear Hug Café after seeing photos online, especially for their latte art, but unfortunately it turned out to be a disappointment. When I ordered, they told me they couldn’t do latte art, which was surprising since that’s what the place is supposed to be known for.
The café felt dusty and old, with an atmosphere that was a bit uninviting. The food options were limited, and the quality didn’t impress me. Overall, it was not the experience I expected, and I left feeling disappointed. I wouldn’t personally recommend it based on my visit.
review_3_text:
Amazing drinks and food !!! Staff are nice service is great. Atmosphere is super cute with vibey music playing softly in the background.
Great spot to pop in for a lunch or to bring your laptop, chill out and do some work.
review_4_text: Amazing food and cafe! Vibe is super cute.. staff is nice and service is very very quick. Highlighly recommend the frappe and the sandwiches.
review_5_text: Bacon toast was pure perfection! Among all the coffee shops I've been to in Chiang Mai, the toast here has a unique charm that makes me desperately want to come back for more. If I get the chance to visit again, I'm excited to try other items on their menu. Highly recommended

name: Ma-chill Coffee
review_1_text:
What a cool and cute place.
I felt like I was in Europe for one hour 😊
The chocolate croissant was really tasty, and the cold brew was just how I like it.
review_2_text:
You love coffee?
Your needs might very well be satisfied here.
Very good coffee and super tasty pastries.
Unfortunately the place is a little small.
review_3_text: Best roastery and coffee in town. Very chill vibes with great taste of music all day long. I love it. I’ve been coming here since many years, and they did a great effort to make the place better and keep up with quality coffee beans and delicious home made pastries 😋
review_4_text: One of the best espressos in chiang mai. You can choose the coffee you want too. You enjoy every sip. Never burnt. Perfect flavor. Iced coffee never tastes watered down because the espresso is rich. Great milk alternatives (extra 10 baht). Also always has really good music. Cool people work there
review_5_text: Lovely oat lattes, cakes and pastry were really tasty. Bonus is they have a sweet doggie who is super friendly.

name: Coffee waf
review_1_text:
Found this cafe with a good review while looking for a place to get some work done, and yes, the reviews were all correct. I really love this place.

First of all, the weather was cool that day, so it felt so nice with a good morning vibe in the open-air area, and they even have charging spots. The staff are really nice and give warm hospitality.

The coffee is not bad and I enjoyed it, though the ice was a bit too much and made the flavor fade a little. Still, it is cheap and definitely worth trying.
review_2_text: Coffee Waf is such a lovely little café! The owner makes every cup of coffee with so much passion and care. You can really taste it. The prices are very reasonable, and the coffee tastes absolutely delicious. Whether it’s a cappuccino or any other coffee, she puts her heart and enthusiasm into every single one. A real hidden gem! ☕
review_3_text: The hand pressed coffee both hot and cold were excellent! The banana nut, muffin spectacular. And even better, the hospitality. Sweet, warm and welcoming.
review_4_text: Perfect spot for coffee chillout with pleasant atmosphere, nice people/visitors and very kind coffe making lady.
review_5_text: Very good coffee and the way they extract is hand press and looks very nice. It is relatively a small cafe without any good tables, but their coffee is very good and cheaper than many other good coffee places around. The bathroom is super old one, so you don’t wanna use it here.

name: 1st For Coffee (CO1FFEE)
review_1_text: A lovely coffee shop! The inside cute and has a calming atmosphere. We ordered an es Yen and a caramel macchiato - both were fabulous. We were able to pick our roast, which was an unexpected nice touch. We will definitely visit again!
review_2_text:
Best coffee in Chiang Mai!
We came here every day during our stay – a cozy, small, locally owned coffee shop with a relaxed and calm atmosphere. The owner is incredibly friendly and clearly passionate about coffee.
You get to choose your own coffee bean roast – light, medium, or dark – which makes the experience even more personal. The coffee and tea taste amazing, and you can also buy beans to take home with you.
The prices are also very reasonable for both hot and cold drinks. Highly recommended!
review_3_text:
Very positive experience. Only 45 baht for a delicious Americano, and they did not charge me extra for oat milk.
You get the choice of 3 coffee beans with different roast levels and origins.
Staff speaks great English and is very friendly and welcoming.
They have some seating with a relaxed vibe and tasteful music.
This seems to be the sweet spot for price and quality.
review_4_text:
I love my coffee and this place does excellent coffee! Reasonably priced, excellent set up, I love that you can choose between light, medium and dark roast.
Great service with a smile!! I will be back for more 🙂
review_5_text:
yummy coffee at a cute, small shop! 55 baht for an iced hazelnut macchiato plus 10 baht more for oatmilk (totally reasonable, some places upcharge 30+ baht!!)

They allow you to customize roast (light, medium, dark) and ask about the sweetness level you’d like!

One of my fav coffees Ive had in CNX 🥰☕️

name: La Friandise Restaurant & Coffee Shop
review_1_text:
This restaurant is the best French restaurant I’ve ever been to. The food is amazing!!! I could not even manage to describe how I feel when I have the first bite of the beef, the juice like exploding in your mouth —— and you feel like you are in heaven, and I’m not exaggerating!
I’m not a gourmet, I took a long time thinking how to describe the taste? I just think the taste is very complex and complicated, but the magic is: everything is in perfect balance. All the ingredients are in good complementary relationships with each other, like the beef’s meat flavor with sweet and sour pomelo, the fragrance of salmon with fresh green vegetables… all I can say is amazing and could not find other words. No wonder it is made by a professional French chef with 20 years of experience.
My only question is: How come such a wonderful place with relatively little people found that? It should be known to the world haha!
Me and my husband would definitely come twice when we are in Chiang Mai again. You will definitely like here and this place is especially good for dating because the vibe is really romantic!
review_2_text:
Great hidden gem a bit outside the Old City walls. The restaurant is both: restaurant and coffee shop. It‘s run by a young French-Thai couple. He‘s the chef and she‘s the boss - taking care of everything else.

The restaurant‘s vibe is modern yet warm. They have a nice back yard with a few tables too. The menu is very small so they specialize on a few things and make those really well. I had the grilled mackerel. It was delicious! Value for money is good too. Will definitely be back.
review_3_text:
La Friandise in Chiang Mai is truly a hidden treasure that deserves every bit of attention. From the moment you arrive, you are warmly welcomed by an exceptionally friendly team that speaks several languages with ease – this instantly makes you feel comfortable and appreciated as a guest.

The cuisine is nothing short of outstanding. Each dish is presented with the finesse and creativity you would expect from star-level dining, combining exquisite flavors, perfect textures, and a clear passion for detail. It is rare to find such high culinary standards delivered so consistently, and every plate feels like a little work of art.

The atmosphere is just as impressive: a modern, stylish, and elegant interior design that creates the perfect setting for both a relaxed dinner or a special evening out. It strikes a great balance between sophistication and comfort, so you can fully enjoy your meal without feeling rushed or out of place.

Despite the top-class quality, the prices remain very fair and reasonable, making La Friandise an incredible value compared to many other fine-dining experiences. This combination of excellence and accessibility is what makes the restaurant such a standout.

All in all, La Friandise is not only highly recommended, but a true insider’s tip in Chiang Mai. If you love fine dining, welcoming service, and a modern yet cozy atmosphere, you should absolutely not miss this place.
review_4_text: My boyfriend and I just happen to pass by after our spa and went in for a treat! The chef and his wife also are the owners, and the staff are so welcoming and nice. I was looking through the reviews and wanted to order the lasagna, but it was not in the current menu. The chef was so accommodating to make me a lasagna with river prawns as a special. My boyfriend got the braised beef shanks and it melted in our mouth! (I had to try because it looked so good!) We enjoyed every food we ordered, no complaints! The desserts were also amazing!  We savored every bite. Truly a french cuisine. We loved the food and the service. Funny thing is, this was our best meal in both Chiang Mai and Bangkok! (We did like some authentic Thai cuisine too but for our last day this experience took it up a notch). Thank you both for the warm welcome!
review_5_text: Very nice restaurant! Live music at that night! Food is authentic and delicious! Service is very good, very patient in explaining! Cheif is very friendly! Recommended!!!

name: Roastniyom Coffee - มณีนาราคร
review_1_text:
Roastiyom 60 ฿ (2026)

Has English menu.

I actually don’t know what exactly is Roastiyom but since it is its signature so I give it a try.

It is nice, like latte but somehow tastier, maybe sweeter.

Good environment, with charging port available. Small but cozy.

Many locals.

Not sure if there is a toilet but it is not at the premise.
review_2_text: What a great place - with polite and friendly staff, tasty coffee that comes with a glass of water and a mini-jar of condensed milk, tasty cakes and relaxing atmosphere. The location is great too: just between the mall district and the old town. A must for a break in exploring.
review_3_text:
Open from 7am, it's a great place to relax after a morning stroll
The place is relaxing, calm and the soft background music helps to feel that sensation. As well as The gentle and polite staff :)
My brownie and cappuccino were also good !
review_4_text:
We had Iced Matcha Latte and Croissants for Breakfast. Everything was good and I can really recommend the Matcha Latte (we had 50% sweetness)!
Nice seats indoor and also to sit outdoor.
review_5_text: Very nice and calm cafe to do light work in. But be aware their WiFi blocks many websites. I couldn’t connect to company VM to connect to the desktop.

name: Brecht.
review_1_text: Very cool cafe. Dark theme. Love the Americano (not acidic!) the soda is aesthetically pleasing. Fried chicken and pops are decent. The egg avo toast is good! (it was dark and aircon wasn't switch on when we arrived - save electricity I suppose) we were the only table there at 11ish
review_2_text:
Pros: 1. Beautiful decorations & ambience; 2. Friendly server behind the counter; 3. They serve my almond croissant fresh out of the oven.

Cons: 1. They covered my croissant with powdered sugar.  A little sprinkle would have been enough; 2. Cappuccino not as good as other coffee shops I had tried in CM; 3. I paid California price in Thailand.

Overall, it was a pleasant experience and I will return, cos the almond croissant I had was amazing, sans the excessive powdered sugar.
review_3_text:
Great pastries. The donut was maybe a bit too sweet for my liking and the croissant a bit dry. They were semi reasonably priced but the drinks were quite expensive. Felt like I was paying Sydney prices which kind of brought the experience down.
But! The interior and exterior design is absolutely stunning. Not much in this area with that level of design.
review_4_text:
This place really hits the spot.

The croissant is crispy and flakey on the outside, just the right amount of baked. Buttery and soft on the inside, but not chewy.

The cute barista suggested a dark roast for my hot latte and it didnot disappoint. Really good cuppa on a rainy day.

For me the place  is a little too edgey and strange and the seating isn't that cozy. It didn't matter once I had a sip of coffee 😉
review_5_text:
Visited on 2 December 2023, 0820.

Ordered a triple chocolate croissant and a latte for 185 baht.

The good thing is that the croissant is not overly sweet and with the chocolate, it wasn’t overly dry. Perhaps due to the type of butter or flour used, the croissant wasn’t fragrant. It was light and fluffy but lacks the making of a quality croissant.

Latte didn’t have the wow factor.

Should be at best 3.5 stars. But rounded off to 4 for the not too bad service and the music was not overly loud at the point of time I was there.

name: C.U. CORNER Bar and Cafe
review_1_text: I love this international friendly place. Nice people. Nice music by visitor musicians. You drink, sing and dance. Just spend a very happy time.
review_2_text: What a great find. Great and friendly open mic/jam. Every day except Sun? can’t remember. When they’re closed. Lovely staff also.
review_3_text: Tiny little bar on Moon Muang soi1. Wonderful live music too. Definitely worth a visit
review_4_text: A very small bar hidden in the alley of old town. I stayed in old town and went out at night walking around and looking for somewhere to have a drink, I saw some guitars on the wall when I passed by there, so I thought there might be some live music. As I expected that there were some cute British grandpas jamming some English songs. I had 2 bottles of beer and had a chill and relaxing time there.
review_5_text: Great little bar with brilliant live music when we visited. Great service and they serve dry cider.

name: Bella Goose Cafe at the Hill
review_1_text:
Bella Goose Café at The Hill is a charming little escape tucked away in the hills of Thailand. From the moment you arrive, the peaceful atmosphere and beautiful greenery invite you to slow down and enjoy the moment. The setting is calm and refreshing, with lovely views that make it perfect for a relaxed morning or afternoon.
The café itself is cozy and tastefully designed, offering comfortable indoor seating as well as outdoor spots to soak in the scenery. The food and drinks are thoughtfully prepared, with fresh flavors and beautifully presented dishes. The coffee is especially good—smooth, rich, and clearly made with care.
What truly makes Bella Goose Café special is its warm, welcoming feel. Friendly service, great food, and a serene location come together to create a place you’ll want to visit again. It’s a true hidden gem and well worth the stop. ☕🌿
review_2_text:
Love this place! While in Chiang Mai for my trail race I ate here twice.

The first time was just before their closing time so it was practically empty. The second time was lunch time and most of the tables were full, but you can still find sitting outside.

The place is located on a corner of a busy intersection but once inside you can barely hear cars and motorcycles outside.

The waitresses are super nice and friendly. They pay attention to the customers and quickly respond if you need them.

You don’t have to wait long for your food to be served. Both times I had a coffee and a cinnamon roll. They are so good!

If I ever return to Chiang Mai I’ll definitely eat here again.
review_3_text: Coming from Atlanta, my bar for biscuits and fried chicken is high. It's even higher for gluten-free iterations of both as we have a number of great options outside my own kitchen. This restaurant did NOT disappoint! The chicken was flavorful, crispy, and juicy, and the biscuit was proper- not mind blowing, but more than good enough. My friend loved her gluten-full biscuits and gravy, but I didn't get a pic of her food. Living in Singapore, great gluten-free food is hard to come by with very limited options. I'm thankful for more awareness and inclusion in both the Thai and "western" restaurants here🙏🏽
review_4_text: After a delightful discovery experience at Bella Goose at the Pond, we had to check this one out and it was well worth it! Loved the genuine vibe, especially the original style café doors. The Beetroot Scramble was amazing and the PB Mocha was yummy. I couldn't resist the presentation of the Good Morning Smoothie Bowl, so we went back for it later. It was legit and did not disappoint!!
review_5_text:
Food - Healthy & the taste just nice.

Service - Friendly helpful with lots of smiles.

Atmosphere - Clean, tidy, modern chill cafe.

Lots of choices in the menu, scratching head which to pick. Overall the drink & food is awesome.

Found this Bella Goose randomly & not regret to be here. Keep it up 💪🏼

name: Butter is Better Diner & Bakery
review_1_text:
We visited Butter Is Better while craving a proper western brunch after weeks of travelling Asia, and it completely exceeded our expectations. The food is excellent value for money and so good that my fiancé and I came back a second time.
There’s a great variety on the menu, everything is freshly made to order and easy to customise. The homemade yoghurt is a must, they serve real butter (not margarine), and the portions are huge (by British standards). The meat in the cooked breakfasts tastes like it’s straight from a local British butcher.
If they had a branch back home, I’d be a regular — highly recommend to any travellers in Chiang Mai looking for an amazing brunch.
review_2_text: Nostalgic 1950s Americana style restaurant.  Western breakfasts at a bit higher price than some but food is fresh. Service is limited after you are served, they never come back, even though one free coffee refill is mentioned,  good luck getting it.
review_3_text:
Amazing place—this became our favourite spot during our stay in Chiang Mai.

The service was exceptional and the food was splendid. Everything from lax bagels to scrambled eggs, eggs Benedict, crepes, juices, and smoothies. It really felt like it was done with care and love. You can find this gem in town. Be mindful that they are closed on Tuesdays.
review_4_text:
Great breakfast and a fun atmosphere! We went at lunchtime and ordered breakfast. The blueberry pancakes were delicious, and one was already filling. The bacon was also very good.
I wasn’t sure about the pasta, but it was great for breakfast!
The workers were kind, and it was not too far from the walking area(Mae Kha Canal คลองแม่ข่า).
review_5_text: In my 14 years of living in Thailand, this is about the most American breakfast place I have had. It tasted like back home. If you are hankering for an American breakfast in Thailand, this should definitely be on your list.

name: Art Farmer Cafe
review_1_text: Great coffee spot. Cute decorations for Halloween. Was my go to place while I was in chiang mai. Staff is very friendly and greets you with a smile. Coffee is very good. Go with the medium roast. Try their specialty drinks. I enjoyed a mojito espresso every morning.
review_2_text: This was by far one of the best coffee I had. Medium roasted latte just masterful. It has a rich taste, very creamy texture and fruity notes. I took two bags of these beans to brew it myself!
review_3_text:
The coffee was excellent. The service perfect. The only thing I would do here is refresh the interior. The trouble with the nearly all white interior is the maintenance needed to keep it looking good. It only really needs someone with a pot of white paint and an eye for decluttering and using the space better. There are some merchandising stands in the wrong place and the DJ kit could be designed into the space much better. The tiles you probably have to lay again. They are toast.
All this is forgiven because the coffee and the music are very nice.
review_4_text:
Awesome coffee and dessert.
🏖️👍☕️🍵🍰🧁

Iced Americano, latte and cocoa all have a fruity aroma and a strong coffee flavor, which is delicious. The icy cheesecake is super delicious! The staff here are also very polite and the service is very good. 👍
review_5_text:
The coffee was too good and of high quality. This was our go to place for morning coffee during our chiang mai stay.

The barista girl was cool and friendly. Would definitely visit again.

Highly recommended for your caffeine fix. Definitely visit if you’re around the neighbourhood, you won’t be disappointed.

name: คาเฟ่วัดใจ Escape room in Chiang Mai Thailand 泰国清迈密室逃脱
review_1_text:
The staff were very accommodating and friendly. They explained everything nicely.

It is definitely not for the faint-hearted. This is my second time trying this out and not finishing again.

The props and experience was very thrilling and scary. The actors were awesome.

Check the prices and promotion first too.
You will also get 50% off their food and drink menu once you choose a package.

The location is very convenient, close to the heart of the city.

There are 4-5 games to experience lasting 60-90mins. There is 5 levels of scary with zero for the easily scared.

They also have pictures and videos for your memories at the end. =D
review_2_text: It's definitely the best escape room I've ever done. It is more of an experience where you follow a story than working out puzzles and clues. We didn't even do the scariest level, and my heart was racing the entire time. The staff were absolutely amazing and really put on a show. With student discount it's only 500baht and lasts over an hour, I'd highly recommend.
review_3_text: What an experience!!! Great service by all the staff. Great acting and support crew. I’m a bit of a softie when it comes to horror, so I’m happy I managed to finish. Definitely worth an hour or two of your time on a rainy Chiang Mai evening. Thanks guys! ขอบคุณครับ
review_4_text:
One of the best and definitely scariest experience I had in Chiang Mai.

We had five levels of difficulty to choose and one scary experience.

I was literally shaking.

If you’re looking for an escape room that combines an horror experience in the best way possible -

This is the place!
review_5_text: This place was great!! Very scary, for my family (I never get scared), I strongly suggest this. The staff is really nice and make it a very enjoyable experience.

name: Savor Society
review_1_text: Savor Society is a very relaxing place for a strong cup of coffee. I got the Iced Coconut Latte and cannot recommend it enough. The coffee flavor did not get diluted at all! I wish I had time to come back and get it again.
review_2_text:
Very cool coffee shop and cafe.

The coffee choices cover a wide range of serving styles and coffee beans that are roasted in house. Savor Society is serious about coffee! Be prepared to state the serving style, the temperature (hot or iced), and type of beans. Enjoy the high quality coffee.

The are nice food choices too. Many of the breakfast meals include freshly made bagels. The attractive selection of sweets will surely tempt you.

Have a seat and enjoy sitting in a shop that is thoughtfully and a bit eclectically decorated.

You’ll find this shop is well patronized morning, noon, and afternoon.  Join the friendly crowd and enjoy the Savor Society!

Feeling down and visiting the Bangkok Hospital? You can grab a coffee from the Savor Society location there!
review_3_text: So good! The latte (I selected Laos beans dark roast) is delicious, I could taste the unique notes. The cake is perfectly lightly sweetened and the fluffy cream balances the denser (but soft and moist) chocolate base.
review_4_text:
Best coffee and best value in Chiang Mai.
The Basque Burnt  cheesecake is not too sweet just perfect with the coffee.👍👍😋😋
review_5_text: 5/5 stars! We're so lucky to have this amazing coffee shop just around the corner from our place. The perfect spot to start our day with a great cup of coffee and delicious drinks. The service is top-notch, and the upstairs seating area is cozy and comfortable. It's the ideal spot to relax and catch up with friends and family. Highly recommended!

name: Trailer Coffee
review_1_text:
Trailer Coffee is part of the Suriwong bookshop, so easy to find.  It has two entrances, inside and outside seating with tables and some interesting and amusing decor.  Right now centred on Halloween.

My coffee was delicious, but very small -  and they don't do a large cup or mug.

Breakfast snacks are available and seem very popular.  There are live bands in the evening sometimes.  I will return and check the music out.

I particularly liked the low ceiling - which was well decorated.
review_2_text:
We stopped by while doing laundry across the street at Super wash. Excellent coffee and a good price. Great value for the quality. Really nice decor and tasteful music. The noodles looked great. We may come back to try while our dryer is going.

Yes the ceiling is a little low. No biggie. Coffee is Excellent.
review_3_text: Delicious coffee. They also serve a noodle soup breakfast. A traditional northern Thai little soup. A great way to start your day. Plenty of seating and also near a self service laundromat. It’s a great combo lol
review_4_text:
I had an iced matcha latte; it was pretty standard. What makes this place great is the fact that during the middle of the day, it's possible to sit outside under the shade without getting exposed to the sun, enjoy a drink and listen to the music playlist they put on (at a reasonable volume). Very chill.

I believe this used to be a bookstore, so there's plenty of space both indoors and outdoors.
review_5_text:
Consistent Good favor Kanom-Jean (domestic Thai noodle)

Coffee nice as always,

Now Open Till night with beer.

Please update shop photo and location .

name: Cafe de L'Amour
review_1_text:
Came into this quaint little cafe in Chiang Mai for some Aircon and a rest. Nice and cosy that just does a limited selection of food and drinks (primarily coffee) but that is fine.

I ordered the mocha-banana-frappe, my wife had a mocha-mint-frappe and my son had a hot latte.

All perfectly tasty and reasonably priced (THB180 in total). Limited seating but that’s part of the appeal.

My only gripe is they don’t accept Apple Pay - only a local banking QR code or cash.
review_2_text: Very cool little spot and Chiang Mai. Has indoor and outdoor seating with a tree growing through some of the sitting area. Servicewas very polite and everything was made from scratch grinding beans for every single order.
review_3_text: Small cafe with a lovely vibe, fine coffee and delicious cakes. Plenty of different seating options although I liked the most the ones inside around a living tree that gives the place soothing atmosphere. Sometimes there are offered locally grown fruits in the basket next to the entrance for a bargain price.
review_4_text: Very cute cafe with good drinks. I tried the rose tea latte and my friend tried cocoa latte pearl (bubble was out so we replaced with pearl). Both were great. I liked the atmosphere of the shop - not a big place but plants were all around, felt cool even in a hot afternoon. Had place for parking.
review_5_text: Brilliant little coffee shop near Chang klan area. I’ve been coming here for nearly 15 years. Great coffee, fresh juices, smoothies and good little club sandwich if need a change from Thai food. Friendly happy faces, parking and good vibes. Small quaint place to stop and sit outside or inside. I love to come here when I go to my favourite massage shop Aree Thai massage near Anantara. Come down and support local business on Si Don Chai Rd just around corner from night bazaar…

name: 𝙋𝘼𝙐𝙎𝙀 𝘰𝘯 𝘵𝘩𝘦 𝑯𝑰𝑳𝑳 Coffee and Rooftop bar
review_1_text:
I really dug the 'raw' industrial decor as you head up to the rooftop bar, it gives the whole place a cool, unfinished character.

The vibe is super chill, especially when you’re just sitting back with a couple of cold Singha beers. Watching the sunset from up there is gorgeous and easily the best part of the evening. Also, keep an eye out for the two resident cats; the ginger one is a total character and pretty cheeky!

The food was just okay for me, but you’re really coming here for the relaxed atmosphere rather than a gourmet meal. My only real gripe was the music, it was a bit loud for such a laid-back spot, so lowering the volume would be a huge plus. Definitely a solid choice for a low-key hangout.
review_2_text:
Cool spot! Great coffee (and good value at only 60 baht for a latte!), cool retro vibe furniture, and stylish barista.

Opens early at 7am, has cute cats wandering around and a chill outdoor terrace right opposite the Shangri-La.

Trendy café by day, rooftop bar by night — what more do you need? This place is a hidden gem.
review_3_text:
This place is a great hidden jem with lots of tasty appetizers that they make fresh in house. Unbeatable prices on local beers.

When it's not raining sitting upstairs is a very relaxing atmosphere and the staff are very hospitable.

We were here during slow season so it was not very busy at all yet the staff was still running around to make sure we were comfortable and having a good time.

They accept music requests aswell which is nice.

We mostly dealt with Posh (unsure of spelling of his name) and the other two employees Simba and Nala are pictured below.
review_4_text:
Very nice roof top bar with friendly staff and surprisingly good food. The beer selection is the usual suspects + Asahi, which are reasonably priced (Chang is 88 bhat and the rest are only a little more).

Would highly recommend visiting if you want a chill location with some live DJs
review_5_text: Lovely little bar and coffee shop. We almost missed it and walked past as it is so well hidden. A little sign outside indicates that it is open and that they have a upstairs balcony. The balcony upstairs is very spacious and open with a lot of ambient lighting. Nice view of the Shangri la hotel opposite. The bar serves food as well as a variety of flavoured beers that are locally made in Thailand. Good place to have a chilled drink.

name: Sinners N Saints Kafe and Pool Bar
review_1_text:
"Sinners N Saints Kafe and Pool Bar" is a bit of a mouthful but that's its name and you can find it on Kampangdin Road about 2 minutes walk south from Sridonchai Road, the intersection where you find Gekko Restaurant.

It is known for its good pool tables and playing there, but we went for another reason, it's a bar specialising in 'kava' drinks. I won't go into that here but check it out on the internet if you don't know kava drinks.  They are non-alcoholic but give you a bit of a soft buzz.  Sinners N Saints Kafe offers a good range of mocktails using kava and I tried a couple of them, finding them very tasty.

Another feature that marks this establishment out is that the owner Kevin has worked hard to open it out at the back where there is the new Mae Kha Canal wooden walkway, that runs along the back of his establishment.  Kevin has provided a delightful place to sit with a drink and enjoy the sun going down, bearing in mind that you will need protection against the mosquitoes.

A really great place to chill out and enjoy.
review_2_text: Best place in Chiang Mai to catch a a friendly game of pool on solid tables. Drinks are cheap, and there’s tons of great non alcoholic options if you don’t feel like drinking. Tables are free just have to spend 100 bhat and can play as long as you like. The owner Kevin is a super chill guy who will join you for a game. The crowd is also cool, some good players but not an overly competitive environment. Also, only kava and kratom bar I’ve found around. 10/10 recommend this place.
review_3_text: Great food. Very relaxing place to hang. There's seating out back and the newly installed boardwalk by the city. Friendly staff.
review_4_text:
New pool game focussed Bar in Chiang Mai.

3 Pool tables
4 Aircons
Little relaxed garden / outside seating.
Great coffee
Opens early which is a huge plus!

Amazing yet affordable food.
Got a very experienced Thai chef!
Ask for the tamarind chicken and the asparagus chicken. Small but really worth it!

What’s outstanding as well is that they make their own burger Patties from fresh meat. Chicken, Pork, Beef in exceptional quality!
review_5_text: Thank you for the cava mojito cocktail with no alcohol!  At last an health and tasty alternative to alcohol when you don't drink They have a bunch of classic cocktails with alcohol too.

name: C9 CAFE
review_1_text: Really nice little find, charming little restaurant. The food was really tasty and fresh. I just forgot to check for no Garlic, the menu did not express garlic was in the avacado. Avacado and coconut smoothy was delisious. The prices were really inexpensive, some items cheaper than eating in the market. Nice decor and clean.
review_2_text: Our second time here for breakfast! Food is delicious and there is a good selection from western style breakfast to Thai breakfast. Coffee was also great.
review_3_text:
Really delicious food. Great, off the main road atmosphere.  Friendly waitstaff.
Highly recommend.
review_4_text: Best breakfast we had in years! Delicious food and cafe. Very friendly service and nice setting.
review_5_text: Amazing pasta close to Astra Condo! Good thaifood, very good breakfast. Nice decoration food and affordable prices

name: Magokoro Teahouse by มีใจให้มัทฉะ
review_1_text:
We discovered Magokoro Teahouse by coincidence while walking through Chiang Mai and decided to stop in for some tea - what a great decision. The place is beautifully designed in a traditional Japanese teahouse style, with a calm and peaceful atmosphere. There’s also a lovely garden area outside, which must be even more beautiful during the day (we visited after dark).

The matcha selection is outstanding, with several grades and varieties to choose from. The staff was incredibly friendly and knowledgeable, and the presentation of the tea was elegant and authentic.

We enjoyed the experience so much that we even bought some matcha to take home. A truly serene and authentic spot - highly recommended for any tea lover visiting Chiang Mai.
review_2_text: Love the real Japanese vibe and the matcha taste was great! I ordered the usucha set with wagachi and loved it. Want to order the second one, but have to stop myself 'coz I still have a lot of matcha selection in my freezer 😊 If I lived in Chiangmai, I guess I would find myself come here quite often. Thank you for having this beautiful matcha house in the city center like this so, people can come here and experience peace! Hope your business will always do well.
review_3_text:
Very disappointing experience for a place with so much potential. On a positive note, the Kokoro matcha was really good. Unfortunately, that was the highlight.

The service was poor, and communication with the waiter was difficult due to a language barrier. The place was extremely crowded, which completely took away the calm, quiet feeling you’d expect from a Japanese matcha tea house. It felt like they were trying to squeeze in as many people as possible, making it anything but relaxing.

We asked for a bit of extra milk, and only after checking our bill were we told we could get a small amount — just once. While we were still drinking our matcha, the waiter brought the bill, took our credit card, and didn’t return it. About 10 minutes after we could see the payment had gone through, we had to ask for our card back. This was uncomfortable, especially with how packed the place was and the card left unattended.

This place has all the elements to be something special, but unfortunately it fell short. It felt overpriced and underdelivered.
review_4_text: Came in for a late dessert and was blown away by the quality of food and beverage, gorgeous tatami room, also the friendly service from the wait staff. By far the best place for Japanese style parfaits. The Yuzu parfait came with sorbet and yoghurt gelato, a perfectly balanced dessert with all the trimmings. The hojicha parfait came with hojicha gelato that's smokey, rich and decadent, perfectly paired with mochi and red beans. We also ordered sencha tea that came in the most beautiful artisan teapot, the best quality ceramic I've experienced in a tea house outside of Japan. The Japanese garden is simply zen and a delight. Definitely coming back for more!
review_5_text:
Definitely a place of tranquility. 🫶🏻

I love their Kokoro Matcha - I had it warm, no sugar and with Almond Milk - LOVE it! Certainly my favorite Matcha in Chiang Mai. 💚

Its a great place for self reflection, chit chat with friends or partner - but with or without companion, this place is an absolute gem. ✨

name: Malee Bakery & Ice Cream
review_1_text: The coconut cake here is delicious and a must-try. It’s perfectly sweet with light, well-whipped cream that doesn’t feel heavy. I bought as take away so will no comment about the atmosphere when eat there. The store is little cute and no noisy.
review_2_text: I got the blueberry cheesecake. It’s cute but bad, especially that purple cream and the cheesecake had a weird consistency. Not a fan of cute desserts that don’t taste great. Expensive and extra calories
review_3_text:
Awesome bakery
The coconut cake was delicious as was the tiramisu.
Must go back for the strawberry shortcake asap
Service was amazing and although it’s a small shop it’s just cozy enough to enjoy!!
review_4_text: Really cute cakes. Lemon cheesecake was excellent, but I wish they had better coffee. Drip coffee would go really well with cakes like these, but unless I missed it, I don't think they currently have any drip coffee.
review_5_text: Loved this tiny little ice cream and cake shop. It only has a handful of covers so be mindful if you want to eat in. I ordered two scoops,  blueberry and the Hokkaido milk... Both were well made but the milk ice cream was amazing. If you fancy ice cream, this is the place to go. Very good value too.

name: Going up cafe
review_1_text: Fresh sandwiches homemade which has a good taste and clean. Friendly staffs and reasonable price. Seating is available for eat in and balcony. Breakfast menu is interesting and please try sandwich and wrap. Coffee and drinks  is available Must try
review_2_text: Had breakfast in Going Up Cafe for 4 days from Jan 12-15, 2026.  Menu includes breakfast sets and many varieties of sandwiches at very reasonable prices.  All are freshly prepared on the spot.  Great service and ambience.   Staff were very efficient in their service of customers in the cafe as well as online / phone orders for takeaway.  Clearly a very popular cafe with many Thai locals dining in the cafe and also order takeaway.   A gem in Chiang Mai not to be missed if one wishes to have freshly prepared sandwiches instead of paying over-priced breakfast in the hotels within walking distance from the cafe (eg Melia hotel, Anantara and others).  Highly recommend.
review_3_text: Small cafe making expert toasted sandwiches 🥪 great prices- around 70-80 baht each. A nice selection of smoothies and drinks also on offer. The staff were very polite and welcoming. Thanks guys keep up the great work
review_4_text: Up early and this place was open.  Great breakfast, coffee and vibe.  The sandwiches look delicious.
review_5_text: Nice little cafe around the corner. Enjoyed my ham and cheese french toast with generous amount of cheese and ham. The staffs are also pleasant and service with smiles which makes you feel comfortable to be here. Definitely a must for those wanting a simple breakfasts and quiet. I would definitely come back again next time.

name: Buncha’s slow bar
review_1_text: Atmospheric place, good people, coffee and prices. However it’s very hot inside and if you would like to work with your laptop - there’s  no tables
review_2_text: Really nice coffee to start your mornings with, you can even choose your preferred beans. Also quite affordable :)
review_3_text: Really cool coffee spot! Friendly service, great cappuccino. You can choose which roast you like- light, medium, dark. They gave me some cute stickers as well ;)
review_4_text: I go to another branch which is at Jing Jai Market very often, this is my first time at this one. Coffee is pretty good and affordable!!
review_5_text: Very nice speciality coffee, super friendly staff and chill atmosphere ☕️

name: farmer's house Coffee
review_1_text: This is a very nice spot to just have a drink and enjoy the view. I have also taken the river cruise they provide and it a very good way to have a two hour relaxing time. The boat stops for around half an hour at a nice cafe where they provide ice cream and drinks. Definitely try this place out when in Chaing Mai
review_2_text:
Lovely Simple coffee shop on a boat.

I love the narrow bar facing river.
Coffee Is served in cute fashion on decorated steel plate with Tiny shoot of tea on a side.

Boat also servers as station for small boat tours up the river

Access is via temple .
Everything super charming
review_3_text: Lovely, quiet place to have a morning coffee. There is plenty of space to sit on the boats and enjoy the peacefulness of the area. It is shaded and cool but with spots that get warm morning sun, too.
review_4_text: Came here for coffee with amazing river view. Peaceful and soothing to the heart. You have to walk through the temple to get to this coffee.
review_5_text: Coffee shop has some nice busget conscious meals..Khao Soi example 59baht... Coffee is OK... the place is part of the Wat Chai Mongkol complex. The cafe is absolutely on the river front... the whole complex is interesting.

name: The ripple at klong mae kha
review_1_text:
The Best in town for salted egg lava Chinese pastry
A must try definitely.  The pastry is so soft and the lava stuffed tastes super smooth 😋
review_2_text: Perfect !!
review_3_text:
The pastries were delicious.

The croissants were excellent, with a rich buttery aroma.
The crème brûlée was soft and chewy, and the cream filling wasn't too sweet, greasy, or rancid.
The caramel danish—I've been hooked since my last visit—was incredibly fragrant with caramel. The crust was excellent, crispy on the outside and soft on the inside.
The sausage buns were soft and the sausages were good.
Unfortunately, the coffee machine was broken on the day I went, so I couldn't have any. I had to take some home in a box.

The staff were all lovely, polite, and had excellent interpersonal skills.
review_4_text: The shop is cute and very minimalist. The air inside the shop, which is in the fan zone, isn't too hot, just right. The desserts are delicious, not too greasy. The cream filling inside is just the right amount of sweet. The dough is soft and firm, and the drinks are delicious. The atmosphere is nice. I really like it. I'm lost in this kind of atmosphere. But if the seats had cushions in the same color tone as the shop to lean against, that would be even better. The overall composition is good. The staff are cute, and the shop owner is cute as well.
review_5_text: A famous dessert shop from Lamphun has opened a new branch in Chiang Mai, near Lan Din. Great! Now I don't have to drive far to buy them. Recommended desserts: Swan-shaped mooncakes, Dragon-shaped mooncakes, Osaka cake, and lava croissants. Finish off with freshly squeezed orange juice. Pure bliss!

review_2_text:

review_1_text: This cafe is absolutely adorable, the desserts are delicious, and the staff provides exceptional service. I love the cool and relaxing atmosphere by the Ping River. One visit is never enough; I'll definitely be back!
review_2_text: This is a brand new cafe, a two-story wooden house located next to the Ping River with a great view. The menu prices aren't too expensive.
review_3_text:
This cafe has a wooden style interior with cool air conditioning, while the outdoor area overlooks the Ping River – a great vibe both inside and out.

The coffee is delicious, with both dark and medium roasts available.

There's also a very large parking area, accommodating many cars.
review_4_text:
Looking for a peaceful cafe with great views in the city? I highly recommend trying this one. You're guaranteed to get some beautiful photos! 📸

Located by the river, the cool breeze makes for a relaxing view all day long. The evening light is especially beautiful, making every corner perfect for photos.

The drink menu includes coffee, non-coffee options, and craft beer.

review_5_text: The restaurant is beautiful, the atmosphere is great, and there's plenty of parking.

name: good coffee

review_2_text:

review_2_text: Great cafe with pool table, cool decor, and chill vibe. Lots of space to relax.

review_5_text: Good coffee chill out . Easy parking.  Nice train view

The decor is quite modern, featuring striking concrete chairs. The minimalist aesthetic successfully creates a unique atmosphere, reminiscent of an industrial, post-factory setting. The staff members are clearly well-trained, and I found myself lingering until their closing time at 6:00 PM.
review_3_text:

I charge my phone.

I read and having a good time.

Clean toilets too.

8 Reasons Why This Cafe Is the Lowest Rated in Chiang Mai
1. They tell you you can't stay more than an hour before you even sit down.
2. The air conditioning is on, but the room temperature is barely 30 degrees Celsius.
3. They prohibit the use of fans (including a sign prohibiting the use of power).
4. It costs 20 baht to charge your phone.
5. A cup of hot Americano costs a whopping 60 baht.
6. The coffee is bitter and tasteless.
7. They don't even offer water.
8. The owner is playing a noisy PC game by himself.

The only reason I recommend this place is because:
1. There are no customers, so you can spend your time quietly as long as you tolerate the owner's gaming noise (but only for an hour).

review_3_text: I recently visited ROUND N ROUND, and it was a great experience! The café has a chilled zone where you can comfortably enjoy salted breads. Their fresh bread, straight from the oven, is definitely a highlight—soft, warm, and delicious. The overall vibe is relaxing, making it a perfect spot to unwind. Plus, the café offers plenty of parking space, which is super convenient. If you’re looking for a place to enjoy fresh food in a cozy setting, this is a great choice!
review_4_text:
Round n Round is a charming bakery that’s definitely worth a visit if you’re in Chiang Mai. The highlight here is the bread—freshly baked, with a wide variety of choices ranging from crusty loaves to soft, sweet pastries. Each item looks thoughtfully made, and the quality is impressive.

The shop atmosphere is cozy and homey, with warm wooden decor and a relaxed vibe that makes you feel comfortable the moment you walk in. It’s clear that attention has been given to both the design and the customer experience.

There’s plenty of parking available, which is a big plus especially if you’re driving. However, one thing to note is that the dining area is located separately from the main selling area. While this setup helps keep the bakery space organized, it can feel slightly inconvenient if you’re hoping to enjoy your food on the spot without moving between areas.

Overall, Round n Round is a lovely place for quality baked goods, a calm atmosphere, and a nice little break from the city buzz. Highly recommended for anyone who enjoys fresh bread and relaxing spaces.
review_5_text: The best place for Shio Pan in Chiang Mai offers an exceptional experience. The original shio pan is perfectly crispy on the outside and delightfully soft on the inside. The venue provides ample parking space and comfortable seating, making it a great place to relax and enjoy delicious bread. I highly recommend trying the bread with their dipping sauce – it’s absolutely amazing!

review_4_text: Nice & friendly hotel 😊
review_5_text:
Real guest review:

The accommodation is very cute, clean, and convenient.
The decor is beautiful and minimalist. I stayed near Christmas, the atmosphere was great, cool and comfortable, no need for air conditioning.
There are few rooms, so it's not crowded. The price was excellent, great value!
It's a 100-meter walk to Wat Umong, a tourist attraction. There's a 7-Eleven, convenience store, and delicious restaurants near the temple.

There's a cafe in the hotel with a slow bar. You can enjoy fragrant coffee in the morning.

There are no staff at night. I talked to the owner, and they gave good recommendations for places to visit. I called to ask for extra pillows and water, and they had someone bring them to me (though it took a while).

I made new friends who were also staying there, it was fun.

I'll be back next year!

*Note
- Convenient, clean, comfortable, and cute decor.
- Has a digital door lock, good security with a time-limited code.
- Close to tourist attractions, Wat Umong, Baan Khang Wat, and not far from Nimmanhaemin.
- Good service, lovely, easy to talk to, and accommodating. Love it!

- No staff on duty at night, so you have to call and wait a bit.
- No refrigerator in the room, but you can ask them to chill something.
- The curtains aren't blackout, so you'll need to wake up early to go sightseeing.
- The rooms aren't very soundproof. You can hear people coming and going, and the noise of the cafe during the day, but the area is quiet at night, only the sound of crickets can be heard.

TEDS is a pet-friendly café with a calm, quiet ambience—I fell for it as soon as I walked in. It’s peaceful yet welcoming and lots of people work here with their pets. No pet smell at all—there are multiple air purifiers throughout the shop.

There’s a nice selection of coffee beans; my iced latte (medium roast) was aromatic and smooth. The carrot cake wasn’t too sweet, which I loved.

They also have a meeting room (just ask the staff), plus plenty of seating: work desks, a second-floor counter bar, cozy couches, a four-seat corner and outdoor garden tables.
review_2_text:
Coffee, Cuteness & Chill Vibes

My first time here. A cozy pet-friendly café just a 10-minute walk from Haan-Tueng Chiangmai, the Michelin-recommended spot. Run by two adorable “owners” — Teddy & friend 🐾 😆— usually napping like café mascots.

Coffee’s nice and reasonably priced, with a few homey bakes. Gets busy with teens and locals on holidays, so if prefer to a private and peaceful vibe - better avoid peak times.
review_3_text: Visited during the day and really cool place with dogs wandering around (the small one is cute . )Great work vibe with lots of powerpoints and fair prices. It does get busy, though, and seating feels limited. The outdoor space could be improved honestly it’s underused and lacks atmosphere. Still worth visiting.
review_4_text: A very cool Bistro with Workspace. Great Coffee and Cakes, friendly Staff and a great atmosphere. The 2 Dogs are also lovely.
review_5_text: It is cozy and quiet coffee shop with a calm, relaxing atmosphere. The two dogs are super friendly and adorable. They really make the place special. You can see they are even on the logo. The toilets are clean, and it’s a lovely spot to work or study inside, or to hang out with friends outdoors.

name: Kyoto Shi Cafe เชียงใหม่ キョウトシ カフェ
review_1_text:
The parking lot is so huge...
The cafe is huge. There is a giant teddy bear.

These were funny to look at, and I knew the food won't be great.

It's a place for those who love spending hours taking photos and who love average sugary treats.

The staff are cute.
review_2_text:
A Cozy Japanese-Style Café with Kyoto Charm

This café offers an authentic taste of Kyoto with its signature Japanese dishes and delightful sweets. The variety of doughnuts and beverages is impressive—each one worth trying! The staff are kind and welcoming, adding to the overall pleasant experience. The café isn’t just great for a casual visit; it’s also perfect for mini-group meetings or a relaxed work session. Highly recommended for anyone looking for a calm, comfortable, and delicious spot to unwind.
review_3_text: This place is Instagram-designed (not in a good way). Filled with accessories and photogenic frames for pictures, but unfortunately, it's too crowded with people who come just for the shot. They offer some Japanese dishes and sweets too
review_4_text: Great drinks and such CUTE decorations all around for kids and photo ops. Available Wi-Fi and outlets. Huge spacious and quiet not that many people come in, which makes it very peaceful.
review_5_text: Good atmosphere ,good soft serve, good food, the drinks were good the price is alright (but It is mall prices) LOTS of places to take photos really pretty is like a tiny taste of Japan ❤️❤️

name: Trailer coffee khunklong
review_1_text: A little bit of jungle and a great cup of coffee just off Canal Road!
review_2_text: This cafe' is besides of the road. Coffee is good. The cafe is decorated by old wooden doors or school desk and chair. Some area of floor has big hole that your foot may fall into.
review_3_text: One of the best options for coffee around the area. The only place where I don’t add any sugar to my cappuccino. I love this place!
review_4_text: Honestly it's one of The Best coffee in chiangmai. Quality of coffee is amazing, it's so creamy and smooth! Thank you alot! Visiting this place for around 2 years, and every time having great experience!
review_5_text: Good test with Amemericano and traditional noodles

name: Belcarra Bistro & Caffe
review_1_text: Really cool and chill place . Staff super nice and even help me order food from across the road. They don’t serve food here but will happily accommodate to order from across the road. Serve protein drinks too which is a big plus for me . Thanks Temp 😉
review_2_text:
We were looking for a nice coffee shop to sit and chill while on vacation in Chiang Mai and we found this little gem.  It was a short bike ride from our Air BnB but well worth the trip.  The coffee, food and service are all top notch.

It was a little difficult to find at first as you need to turn down the side road beside the main highway but once you follow the small road you will see the cafe on the right just past the bicycle shop.
review_3_text: I like coffee here, especially dark roasted one. And I like this place with a green atmosphere. All trees/plants are around. Such a good place to chill out all day :)
review_4_text: Nice, simple, and clean. A refreshing break, just off the main road. Located with other shops, for the biking/cycling community. Definitely worth a visit or two or three….
review_5_text:
Really good Thai tea!
The best we had try in Thailand!
Nice Café and perfect to rest!

name: COCOA CHA
review_1_text: Relaxed place in a very calm area. Super friendly and attentive owner. The drinks are good and inexpensive. Drop by if you want to make a short stop to refuel your energy :)
review_2_text:
cute small cafe at the side of the road.
Very kind owner and nice drinks!

Would visit again :)
review_3_text:
The food is delicious, and the owner is very kind and friendly.
The price is also reasonable. I will definitely come again. 😊

name: Transit Number 8
review_1_text: Very beautifully decorated like a tiny Japanese town during winter. Met the lady owner, very sweet lady. The coconut cake is a must try! Will need to pay an "entrance" fees to enter but can take the ticket and exchange for food/drinks. Only downside - the staff within the cafe could be more cheerful and prices inside the cafe are touristy priced. Overall, enjoyed our 2hr stopover at this cafe ❤️
review_2_text: Been meaning to review this place for years but never got around to doing so until someone asked me where was my most memorable coffee experience and I have to say THIS !! Hands down!!  Everything from decor, service, coffee selection, taste, smell, even temperature is a perfect 5star+ The coffee was brewed perfectly and the infused milk was NOTHING I’ve ever tried before. The rose/ orange/ whatever else they used were paired amazingly well with coffee. Who would have guessed. This was such a random find on my trip to Chiang Mai but it’s moments like these which stays with you for a long time.
review_3_text:
I ordered 2 cups of coffee for take-away, which were Transit Number 8 (Dirty Latte) and Soft Latte. The Transit Number 8 was good enough, but the Soft Latte was quite a fail because I felt that they didn’t use ice cream / soft serve but more likely whipped cream.

The price for a cup of coffee is little bit above the average cafes in Chiang Mai.

I didn’t go to their dining area, which was in a unique design (as many people reviews), but I very much liked their front store set-up and design. Really felt like I was in Japan.
review_4_text: First, they charge you 70bht/person at the entrance. Then you find out there's no empty seats on Sunday. Girls just save a seat with a drink, then go to another seat to make pictures. Some laptop users also were there. The coffee tasted ok. Maybe come on weekday.
review_5_text:
Ticket fee for entrance 70 THB, require customer to order 1 drink/dish a person.

Roti is crispy and sweet. The coffee is so so.

name: POND Bakery
review_1_text:
Give 5 star for strawberry shortcake.
Light cream. Not too sweet.
Parking not convenient.
You have to buy tickets 70 thb /person.
But this coupon can use as money in shop.
review_2_text: Cakes look good and different options, but it tastes just not that good as it looks. Too much cream and the cake dough tastes cheap. Atmospheres just ok.
review_3_text: Absolutely delicious cakes baked with love. Very tasty and sweet. Friendly people and fast service, super fresh selection, be early before all sold out.
review_4_text: All the fruits were rotten and in a terrible state, so I threw them all away.
review_5_text: Small and cute cafe. Wasn’t expecting much for the taste due to the reviews but the cake was actually good. Service was good too.

name: THURSDAE
review_1_text: Spent the whole day here- reasonable prices, amazing coconut matcha, and honestly the best cheesecake in Chiang Mai I’ve had . Super friendly staff even lent me a rain jacket when I was about to leave . Definitely returning
review_2_text: Very impressive with design and decoration, a lot of aesthetic area to take photos, but a little bit unsatisfied for guava drink, quite expensive but not delicious, light taste. Also, Thai milk tea and honey lemon were so so.
review_3_text: Amazing Granita! 100 for mood too! Sweetness and freshness from guava brightens you well, plus sweetness and saltiness from plum powder makes it even more delicious!
review_4_text: Good Vibes on Christmas and December vibe. Greatest granita and Friendly person
review_5_text: The Thai iced tea is sooo good — perfect for chilling out and doing some light work. 🧡🧡

name: Elite cafe’ ร้านกาแฟหลัง มช เชียงใหม่
review_1_text: Went to the cafe van. Had a latte and a Thai tea. Both were perfection
review_2_text: good!!
review_3_text: The place smelled strongly of cigarette smoke. The staff were rude and didn't smile. I was confused about what made them so irritable. I just walked out.
review_4_text: The smell of cigarette smoke is very strong. It's an open-air shop where customers can smoke, but not everyone wants to smell cigarette smoke. If smoking is allowed, there should be a suitable area. Also, there are other restaurants in the vicinity, and not everyone wants to breathe in cigarette smoke.
review_5_text:
The smell of cigarette smoke is terrible. Are these students? It's ruining the atmosphere.
I feel sorry for the students living in nearby dorms. Smoking shouldn't be allowed; it smells awful.

name: Rogu Roti at Transit no.8
review_1_text: The desert here is special. Recommend the banana roti. Food options are varied.
review_2_text: This is the first time we eat at this place! The dessert is delicious, well presented, and full of flavor. Staff are friendly and attentive, and the atmosphere is cozy and relaxing. Definitely one of our favorite places — we’ll be back again soon! 🍽️✨
review_3_text: Loved the vibe here! Totally worth paying a visit 😊 Also, this place is not just “aesthetic” but they also serve really good food ☺️ Garlic fried rice with pork is a must try!
review_4_text: I came to the small restaurant again. I like the food, staffs, service and the atmosphere.
review_5_text: Came here for the roti, and left very happy! Good food, great ambience and service! Chill cafe to hang out at

name: Café Amazon
review_1_text: Great coffee Hot Decent size cup Reasonable price
review_2_text: Love there coffee and cappuccino.
review_3_text: Good standard coffee
review_4_text: ok
review_5_text: Ok

name: บ้านมีชา มีชัย
ลุงแอ๊ด Coffee House
review_1_text: What a great find. A real hidden gem. Tucked away in lush urban garden surroundings. A great place to relax with friend. Warm welcoming staff. A little off the beaten track but well worth the relaxed atmosphere.
review_2_text:
The atmosphere is quiet and chill. Uncle Aed is friendly and kind.
It's a great place to enjoy tea or coffee and chat with friends.
review_3_text:
I recommend this place. Great atmosphere and delicious coffee.
The owner is kind and the baristas are lovely.
review_4_text: This cafe has a great mood, music, and coffee—everything goes by so smoothly, the day flies by. The owner, an elderly gentleman, is also very kind.

name: New Batch Suthep
review_1_text: Great new coffee on canal. Much needed in this location. Baristas and coffee are both  legit
review_2_text: Great coffee for cheap price!

name: Twenty Plus Grams
review_1_text: This coffee shop is one I found while walking from my hotel to the temple. From the outside, it doesn't look like a coffee shop. The exterior is all black, so it's hard to tell if it's a coffee shop or a hip-hop joint. Step inside and you'll find the interior, of course, decorated in black. The staff are friendly, and you can pay with GNL. Cold drinks are 5 THB more expensive than hot drinks. I had the Thai milk tea, and it was delicious. You can sit down and enjoy your drink, and the air conditioning keeps things cool. Hahahaha.
review_2_text:
The dark roast coffee is good (though I didn't take any photos of the coffee).
The shop is located on the roadside, just before Shabu Ood. Parking is available on the side of the road. From the outside, it might not look like much of a coffee shop. The window film looks dark. Inside, the atmosphere is simple and uncluttered. There's plenty of seating, and the air conditioning is cool, but not too hot. You barely notice the glare from the outside. The owner is friendly. The coffee is good, and the fruit tea is good. They also sell drinks from the vending machine.
review_3_text: I recommend it. It's really excellent.

name: Inbox Coffee Bar สาขากองบิน41
review_1_text:
4.5 / 5 (but ill give it a 5star) - Inbox Coffee Bar
A quick food fix after jiu-jitsu training, just a few steps outside my gym. I swear, every time I walk out after rolling, the aroma of grilled meat hits me like a flying armbar. 😅 While I was standing outside waiting for a delivery, the smell was so good it made me question all my life decisions. And because I am fragile and vulnerable after training (and also very hungry), I gave in. I ordered the Grilled Pork because honestly, who can say no to grilled pork, and the Grilled Beef Picanha with chili sauce (phet nit noi). The flavors were straightforward but full of character: Thai aromatics, savory richness, and just a touch of sweetness that doesn’t try to steal the spotlight. It sits quietly at the back of your tongue like that one friend who doesn’t talk much but completes the group. Even the rice surprised me. It was mixed with Northern Thai sausage, which added more depth and made the whole meal feel like a complete experience. Great food, great smell, great timing. 4.5 because perfection is impossible, but they got pretty close. Value for money #nocokezero
review_2_text: The food was passable... but the service was incredibly slow. We finished all the dishes before the rice even arrived; we waited at least 20 minutes. To make matters worse, some dishes were missed and forgotten.
review_3_text: A couple of soldier friends brought me here.  It's next door to Wing 41 military base.  Wasn't sure what to expect bud had a good evening that wasn't expensive.
review_4_text: I had a fantastic time at this bar! It's super nice and cozy, and they've managed to create a spacious atmosphere with tables in every corner. The food was delicious, especially if you're a fan of hot pot, and they offer a variety of mouthwatering appetizers. I highly recommend this place for an evening dinner with friends, where you can unwind with a chilled beer. It's the perfect spot for a memorable night out!
review_5_text: Good place to enjoin with friends. Food is right taste. Staff is very friendly.

name: Coffice Coffee Roaster
review_1_text: Had a morning visit and honestythis has become one of my favourite spots in Chiang Mai. The matcha is top-tier — balanced and not sweet at all. The bagels were incredibly fresh showing real quality. There’s enough seating inside plus a few outdoor tables, perfect for a calm start to the day. I also love the peaceful residential setting away from traffic. Can’t wait to return :)
review_2_text: Great place right by the airport. Super chill part of town. Great coffee and prices. The scone was very delicious!
review_3_text: Love Coffice near Wing 41! Their iced cocoa is a must-try—so rich and delicious. They've got a solid range of bakery items too, and everything is very reasonably priced. Perfect for a quick and tasty stop. 🍩🍪☕️🍵
review_4_text:
The coffee and toffee cake are excellent, and there’s a wide variety of cakes to choose from. The staff is friendly and welcoming.

However, it’s not an ideal for working with laptop, as the tables are small and electrical outlets are limited.
review_5_text:
Its a hype new cafe in town
The cafe is quite packed since the cafe quite small from what i thought
They provide breads and non coffee drinks too here.
The sweet potato bread taste quite nice , its full of sweet potato filling inside
The tomato bagel looks cute too
They provide a small air-con seating area
Their outdoor seating area much more bigger
And its not recommended for a big grup to come since its quite small
They also provide a car park next to the cafe
One plus thing for me is their toilet superbly clean
They probably need to provide a cover for their  pastries and bread since its unhygienic coz its not separated from the seating area

name: The cofreze
review_1_text:
Dirty coffee is a must! Just the right amount of sweetness for the espresso shot.
Iced chocolate is also very good.
review_2_text: This place is even better than we expected! The coffee and matcha are really good. The shi-o pan and the red beans with toasted bread are super delicious. So sad I only got takeaway for one — I’ll definitely come back next time. Highly recommended!!!
review_3_text:
The coffee was great, no complaints.
The staff was also friendly, and the ambience was nice.

My only issue was when I decided to buy the coffee beans, Strawberry Kix blend, I was informed that at first by the staff for 500 gram, the price is 600 baht, which I agreed and I waited for 15-20 minutes because the 500 gram pack was not available, then when I was about to pay, the other staff told me the price was actually 820 baht for 500 gram. I just pay because I dont wanna prolong the issue there and in a rush.

I just hope next time the staff wouldn't give incorrect information that's a bit misleading, because it's not like I didn't clarify at first.

Thank you.
review_4_text: Cool n friendly. Good chocolate and matcha drink. Minimal interior
review_5_text: The cofreze This cafe is both spacious inside and out. They have so many varieties of coffee beans. They have like a fridge or something (I don’t know), but it can keep coffee beans really well. Before giving the coffee beans to the barista, you pick them out of the fridge, then give them to the barista. He or she will make coffee for you.

name: Also Cafe Chiangmai
review_1_text: Visited in the morning and nice home-style café with small rooms. My drink and food were both great and the staff were super kind letting me sit quietly during closing time. I did notice one of the staff member seemed unwell — hope they’re okay and get rest soon. Really fair prices overall.
review_2_text:
Chill vibes all around 🍷
✅ Great service / Reasonable prices / Perfect for photo lovers & cafe hoppers. The desserts are delicious—not too sweet!
review_3_text: I came here without any plans, but was pleasantly surprised by the tasty food and relaxed atmosphere. For me, this place is perfect for creating meaningful memories with special people.
review_4_text:
The store has good mood. Musics playlist is nice.
The cafe also provide Photo booth.
The store interior is cozy.
Many seats in cafe is comfortable.
There is no parking lot.
The price is fair compare to other cafe near by but the taste of drink is good.
I order iced Americano and I love it.
You could find free time reading or relax here during the day.
review_5_text: Here is the small chic coffee cafe where you can enjoy with good coffee and take photos to your social as well.  One bad thing if you want to visit here is parking lot.   It is good for bikes and walking if you want to come.

name: Piang Cafe Chiang Mai
review_1_text: Cute vintage cafe with delicious drinks! I had the roselle coffee 😍
review_2_text:
Tasty. Cozy with tg
he atmosphere around modern Lanna building style.
review_3_text: My favourite cafe in Suandok ❤️ It's a bit hard to find if you don't live nearby, but you'll love it when you find here. The place has an antique style interior and is cosy. Love their scone and tea!
review_4_text: Possibly the best coffee I've had in Thailand. And the red velvet cake was unreal.
review_5_text: Just the perfect place for me, love the decoration and the building, peace and some green plants indoor. In the heart of the city, 5 mins from Nimman, you can escape and chill.

name: หอมรัญจวน เชียงใหม่/อบอวล คูซีนObbouan Cuisine
review_1_text: Cozy spot with delicious food, reasonable prices, and plenty of parking for convenience! Loved the less sweet latte – it was perfect. The Thai dessert was fragrant and tasty. Highly recommend!
review_2_text:
- The design and theme color of the shop is very attractive.
- Staffs are friendly and welcoming.
- Plenty of parking lots.
- Tum Tim was full of flour, little water chestnut.
- Ginkgo was hard and bitter.
- Actually, their savor is less sweet therefore no need to order less sweet. Otherwise, it is quite bland.
- Price is reasonable.
review_3_text: Chicken and soy noodles was way over cooked and the noodles were gelatinous. Latte smoothie was week to my taste. I would say very average, low prices, lovely place and cool.
review_4_text: Nice place nice Thai dessert.
review_5_text: Good

name: WARI ワーリ COFFEE
review_1_text:
Sometimes i get my coffee using Grab, it is lighting fast! It surprises me usually 🤗✨

Latte is my go to here, offers different varieties of beans.

would like to try thai tea as many ppl recommend.
Thank you for your very quick and kind service. 😊🙏🏼
review_2_text: One of the really good Thai Tea and the price is very reasonable. Recommended!!
review_3_text: Love Kame as always! Good to see new branch here. Have a limited spot. Quick grab & go are recommended!
review_4_text: Good Vibes Good Life
review_5_text: It’s nice

name: CHANG THONG CHU NGUANG
review_1_text:
I ordered kale and crispy pork, but the pork was exactly as pictured. I asked the restaurant if it was crispy pork, and they confirmed it was. I ate it all because I felt bad about spending money. After I finished, I went to pay and told them it wasn't crispy pork. They said it was their signature crispy pork, and they also told me that each restaurant makes it differently. Oh my god!!!! I was so confused by this idea. I paid as usual. I'd like to tell anyone thinking about ordering crispy pork from this restaurant to think carefully before ordering.
The taste of the food was average, basic, and nothing impressive.
First and last time.
I don't recommend this restaurant.
I don't recommend this restaurant.
review_2_text: It's a small restaurant between two roads. The food is delicious and the portions are small, just the right size for women, but maybe not enough for men. The complimentary water has a nice coconut flavor. They also have a wide variety of drinks, so I'd like to order one next time.
review_3_text: The food is decent, the drinks are great. On a hot midday day, an M150 blended with Pipo jelly is really refreshing.
review_4_text: A small shop, but the food and coffee are very good, exceeding expectations. The owner is very cute.
review_5_text: The owner is lovely and kind, the prices are affordable, and the basil chicken is delicious.

name: Hopp
review_1_text: Very chill, delicious water, cool air conditioning, very enjoyable to sit in ~
review_2_text: The iced Thai tea is delicious; creamy and well-balanced, with just the right amount of sweetness. The iced Americano, medium roast and unsweetened, has a lovely aroma and taste that I really enjoyed. ☺️
review_3_text: It's a very chill working space. Every drink on the menu is high quality. It's clean. The owner is handsome and super friendly. Hahahahaha.
review_4_text: The shop is beautiful, you can sit and relax. The coffee tastes good.
review_5_text: Good coffee, friendly staff, very enjoyable.

name: Phadee cafe พาดี คาเฟ่
review_1_text: The coffee is delicious and the atmosphere is lovely and cozy.

name: Thong-Urai Cafe & Paw Made Painting
review_1_text: Nice little cafe. Good way to spend an afternoon with your friend. P Nook was really helpful. She taught us some painting techniques to make our paints look more beautiful. Only 450 baht for a small canvas.
review_2_text:
Art studio cafe with great signature iced chocolate!!! I ordered basque cheesecake and it get along together very well. Also many choices of desserts and comfortable foods.
Next time I will try foods and coffee/matcha.
The place very peaceful, staffs are friendly and helpful.
I ,very much, enjoyed my visiting, eat&drink while reading.
review_3_text:
We had coffee and participated in the workshop! No need to reserve but better to check on weekends- coffee was absolutely nice, nutty with a nice aroma.
Workshop was very fun, with the instructor helping us to sketch and for the last touch;)) all the paints and canvas is provided. Just have to pay for drinks and canvas based on the size u choose! Certainly a memorable experience to enjoy during ur stay in chiangmai
10000% recommended!
review_4_text: I had a lovely time today participating in one of the painting workshops. Our host was wonderful and helped me set up my canvas and offer guidance on canvas selection, improving my painting and offering encouragement when I didn't know what to do. There was great music in the background which helped to relax into the process. The coffee I had there was great - I didn't sample the food but it smelled amazing.
review_5_text: Cozy and pretty space with relaxing atmosphere and delicious coffee. Enough space to get Chiang Mai on canvas. Recommended for everyone!!!! Called in the morning and visited by walk-in, relaxed. Cheaper than booking through tour site

name: The Barn Eatery And Design
review_1_text: Nice place to stay for the day. Matcha i ordered  was good not great. Quality could be a little better. Food also nice and good value for the price. Atmosphere is cool but little crowded and close.
review_2_text:
This cafe is smaller than I thought.
Pictures made me think of here quite spacious.
So many students are studying here.
Here is like a more for local students studying cafe.

Coconut pie is well known here, and it mostly consists of layered cream.
Coffee is not bad... and not amazing...
review_3_text:
Chill vibe done right. Usually packed with students for a good reason. If you're looking to sit quietly, this is a good spot in the area. I prefer the outdoor seats. Except for the occasional plane noise, there's hardly anything bothering your senses except for maybe birds chirping and soft playing music. Oh, and maybe when the kitchen is cooking up something spicy 😋

My go-to drink here is the peanut butter choco, because it's rare to find in the gazillion coffee shops in town but also because it's damn good.
review_4_text:
Cute cafe perfect to get some work done. There are some students also which adds a good vibe. The drinks are good. Capuccino, coffee and even matcha are good. They do have oat milk. Coconut pie is to die for - the best I tried in Thailand! (I’ll miss it!)
The brownie was good but coconut pie even better.
review_5_text:
A hidden gem hide away from busy location like old city. This is more likely a local neighbourhood area and this cafe seems popular among the people live nearby as well as some tourists as you can see during the day time. Many student/local will just chill with a drink there and starts using the laptop for hours! They offer cheap and good lunches and coffees but personally I am a serious coffee drinker... I will say their coffee just average.
The Barn green plants decorations of the exterior seems became the main selling points of the cafe. The interior of the cafe seem simple and the decorations seem little disorganised and such as cleverly using the space and some of the plants already dried up but still on the pots and it's really look miserable!

name: EVERGREEN CAFE HOTEL
review_1_text: Very nice owners. And the hotel is so pretty. The room was clean. Got 1 free drink per person each day, they make it fresh it was really good, also the cakes homemade and really nice. Location is walkable to One Nimman like 20 mins but with Grab or bike you are there in no-time.
review_2_text: Thank you for providing such a wonderful stay! The drinks were great every day, especially the siu mai (steamed dumplings) they were delicious! We'll definitely come back next time, and hopefully we can book a room then. Thank you!
review_3_text: Amazing stay! So so so nice our best in Thailand so far. Highly recommend! The service and staff are excellent. They have free snacks and water for you self serve. The room is beautiful - has everything you need and is situated in a quiet side street. We had a great sleep on a comfy bed!
