review_4_text: Had an absolutely amazing stay here. The rooms are so clean, comfortable and spacious. The staff are so friendly and helpful and the cafe downstairs is great. I would definitely recommend for your visit to Chiang Mai!
review_5_text:
This is my second time in Chiang Mai. This time, my friend and I stayed here for three nights. The hotel owner and two staff members were very friendly, which I think is why I love Thailand so much.
by the way the drinks here are delicious.
🩷🩷🩷🩷🩷

name: First Officer Coffee Roasters
review_1_text:
great spot for quality coffee at a very reasonable price. It’s one of the few cafés in Chiang Mai that opens early, making it the perfect place for your first cup of the day.

it’s an ideal stop to kick-start your morning :-)
review_2_text:
◽️Highlights
•Tasty coffee, both hot and iced
•Medium-roast beans for the hot latte are especially delicious
•Eco-friendly cups & lids for takeaway
•Cute touch: every cup comes with a smile written on it 😊
•The “CEO” (a dog named Latte) greets you at the door — adorable and well-trained!

◽️Atmosphere
•Small, cozy café with a friendly vibe
•Digital-nomad friendly with limited space

◽️Parking
•Best to come by motorbike
•Street is narrow with limited parking for cars

◽️Tip
Say hi to CEO Latte 🐶 — a highlight of the visit!
review_3_text: This is the best coffee shop in Chiang Mai. It's open at 06.00 AM, absolutely, I like it so much.
review_4_text: Very nice shop. The atmosphere is excellent, the coffee is very good, and the staff here are luxurious. Very friendly people. They are very welcoming. The sessions are quiet. If you want to drink coffee in Chiang Mai. You should try this. the place is beautiful.
review_5_text: Very nice specialty coffee and refreshing craft cola

name: Full Of Happiness Coffee.RB (สาขา สวนดอก)
review_1_text: After finishing my work, I found a small Japanese bakery. I had a hot American coffee ☕️. Everyday's blend is my favorite flavor, with a good balance of sweet and sour. The music in the shop 🎵 is also quite nice. I read a book 📗. I was full of happiness 😊☀️❤️
review_2_text: Amazing with coffee, Java plum smoothies and also vibes, impressive with music taste ;)
review_3_text:
Visiting from Seattle,  USA!
Beautiful shop with great coffee and great taste in music! Had a cappucino and a latte, both were lovely. Staff were very sweet.
review_4_text: There are about 4 different types of coffee beans. The coffee tastes very good 🙂👍
review_5_text: Really nice place for a coffee! Very friendly staff and cool vibes with chill music inside. Highly recommended!

name: Onuma Green Rabb กาแฟและอาหาร ย่านสวนดอก เชียงใหม่
review_1_text: I love the vibe + the coffee quality and baristas skills are great. The only thing I wish was different was the opening hour, 10 seems a bit late but that only means I'd just love to have my morning coffee there :) food options are rather limited, perhaps adding fresh pastries like croissants would be a good idea!
review_2_text:
A nice place with great greens and environment to have a cup of dark roasted americano. The coffee is well balanced and strong in taste but yet not too acidic.
Nice environment for a quiet afternoon enjoying your sip of coffee.
Friendly barrister and staff even though I speak a foreign language.
Got 300g of roasted beans for self brewing and making.
review_3_text: Cute and comfortable specialty coffee shop with a small selection of good Thai beans. We tried two pour-overs, and both were fantastic. The space is filled with plants and has a relaxing feel. We got to connect with the owner, who is really kind and knew we were interested in specialty beans, so he showed us a variety of beans and gave us recommendations for a couple really good ones.
review_4_text:
The coffee is very good and served in lovely cups. Beautifully presented.

We didn't eat there, as we only wanted coffee.

The most sad thing is that lone fish are kept in sad conditions in vases. They can't swim due to the plant roots and it is no life for a poor living creature. There are many fish in small little vases.

They would do much better to release the fish and keep the plants only.

🙏🙏I hope that the owners will read this and make a change. 🙏🙏

The shop is really lovely and books are available to read or flip through.

The coffee as I said was excellent 👌
review_5_text: A very cosy cafe where you can have a nice cup of coffee and relax after visiting the nearby Wat Suan Dok temple. The staff is very friendly and the atmosphere of the place of relaxation invites you to come back again.

name: EVERGREEN COFFEE Suandok
review_1_text: The Matcha original japan comes to your hands. After taste is guaranteed by high quality of matcha. This place suites with people who require a peace and calm. Owner is very nice and mindful.
review_2_text: I love the vibe of this place. It’s study-friendly, has a clean bathroom, and amazing matcha lattes. They serve high-quality matcha and I’m always there for it. 🍵
review_3_text: Amazing coffee, amazing staff! Very nice and peaceful cafe to sit and chill!
review_4_text: Cute coffee shop, great matcha!
review_5_text: The matcha was fantastic, and the staff were very friendly.

name: บ้านมะพร้าว สวนดอก (ถนนสวนดอก) - SDCoconut Smoothies SUANDOK
review_1_text:
Very good coconut-focused smoothie place with very friendly staff. Half of their huge menu items are coconut based so it's just a matter of mixing your favorite fruit(s) or drinks with 🥥.

I've had several different mixes here and was not disappointed. Maybe not THE best place for fruit smoothie in town, but the coconut part is certainly good.
review_2_text:
We walked over from the Wat, needing something cool. We both had mixed Berry smoothies. Young lady making them was pleasant.  Mine with milk and yogurt was very good.  Walked back to the Wat and drank them while sitting on a shady bench
Recommended
review_3_text: The SD Coconut House in Chiang Mai is an absolute gem and the perfect oasis on a hot day. Whether you're strolling through the city or seeking a refreshing break, this spot delivers in every way. Their smoothies and coconut ice cream are simply divine—creamy, flavorful, and sure to cool you down in the most delightful way. What makes it even more special is the kind and friendly staff who greet you with warmth and genuine hospitality, making you feel right at home. Don't miss a visit here; it's a must-stop for anyone wanting a delicious taste of refreshment in Chiang Mai!
review_4_text:
Coconut and Blue Pea ice cream
Very smooth and creamy taste. Not to be missed if you are in Chiangmai. There's are 3 outlets in Chiangmai.
review_5_text:
This place is very simple however has some of the best coffee in town. I would recommend espresso and coconut milk.
Staff are knowledgeable & friendly. I will be coming back to this coffee shop.

name: Stella Coffee
review_1_text:
Roast and Roll in Chiang Mai is a hidden gem that captures the perfect blend of ambiance, comfort, and quality. The staff here are exceptionally friendly, welcoming you with warm smiles and a genuine eagerness to make your experience enjoyable. They go out of their way to ensure you feel right at home.

The seating is wonderfully cozy, especially their comfy couches, which make it a great spot to settle in and relax. Whether you're catching up with friends or enjoying some solo time, the seating setup invites you to linger. It's the kind of place where time slips by as you sip your coffee and watch the world go by – the people-watching here is a treat, with a lively mix of locals and travelers adding to the charm.

The coffee and food are excellent, with rich flavors and careful attention to detail. Roast and Roll strikes a perfect balance between quality and a laid-back vibe, making it a must-visit spot in Chiang Mai.
review_2_text: Lovely little café for takeaway coffee. I’ve been coming here for a few days now and the coffee is delicious. The lady is extremely kind and welcoming. Highly recommended!
review_3_text: Great coffee, cake was delicious. Staff are so friendly. Recommend!!!
review_4_text: Very chill  and good coffee
review_5_text: The coffee is delicious. When visiting Chieng Mai, I loved to start my days with my coffee and butter cake, and I enjoyed the great service and charming attention.

name: Kyodo Coffee Roasters
review_1_text: Great little place for coffee, quality and have also oat milk :)
review_2_text:
my new fav cafe in chiang mai :)
super friendly staff and owners
review_3_text: really good coffee, nice interior and super friendly staff :)
review_4_text: Super cute/quaint little cafe. Carefully and expertly made, balanced coffee. What a nice surprise! Highly recommend.
review_5_text: I stopped by here on a whim after walking by while staying nearby. I was very pleasantly surprised by the atmosphere and quality of the drinks. There isn’t a lot of space inside, but I pulled up a chair and had a couple drinks while planning out my visit to the city. I also chatted with the owners, who were very kind and welcoming. Their excitement about coffee was very evident and came through in the drinks they served. I will likely be back during my stay in Chiang Mai!

name: เมลคอฟฟี่โฮม MeL's Coffee HomE
review_1_text: Feel good
review_2_text: Delicious and clean, with a lot of rice, very delicious. The vendors are very cute. 🥰
review_3_text: The staff are friendly, the food is delicious, and the green tea is also tasty! Overall, it's a feel-good experience.
review_4_text: The green tea is so delicious!
review_5_text: Very delicious. Open every day. Sell every day.

name: น้ำอ้อยน้ำหวาน
inestinct25 cafe
review_1_text:
Inestinct25 is a small quiet cafe near Suandok hospital. It’s a one man show with mainly coffees & teas. The food choices are minimal such as the occasional brownie, muffin or cake
However the coffee is consistently good & inexpensive. It’s my local favourite.
review_2_text:
Very good hot latte, best scone!!
Plus, if you eat-in, they make nama-cream (fresh cream) to go along with it.
Superb!👍🏻✨
review_3_text: I always sip here with the fresh baked patisserie.
review_4_text: Incredible coffee, great local vibe. Scones an absolute gem.
review_5_text: It's really peaceful here, but there are lots of students during lunch break. Taste of coffee and scone is great, everything is perfect.

name: ร้านคุณลุงกาแฟ
review_1_text: The coffee is delicious, the prices are reasonable, and the owner is friendly.
review_2_text: Smells like coffee, especially pea berries.

name: Nara Coffee
review_1_text: A small shop, a small cafe under the trees, shady, cool, delicious drinks.

name: Deep green @ Deejai Garden
review_1_text: This is definitely my favorite spot in Chiang Mai! It’s a true hidden paradise, where you can relax with a joint and take a dip in the pool while listening to some amazing music. The fried rice was one of the best we have had on the trip, thai iced tea as well as peach iced tea were also fabulous! Can’t recommend this place enough, make sure to add it to your itinerary!
review_2_text: Just passing by and popped in for a quick coffee + toilet break, but wow – turned out to be an incredibly cool space! Amazing visual art all around and even a proper smoking area. Ended up chilling and enjoying the vibe for over an hour. Totally unexpected gem! ☕🎨
review_3_text: Cool, friendly spot for some drinks and smoke with your mates. Simple food, great cocktails on offer. Nothing more, nothing less.
review_4_text:
Really friendly bar with swimming pool you can use when you spend 100 baht minimum.
Nice chill out and smoking area, great djs at night. Great hang to start or close the day, hippie traveler vibes with a 90’s feel.
review_5_text: Beautiful place. Good music. Awesome Swimming pool. The only problem for me was that they just accept cash.

name: Matchi Matchi
review_1_text: Enjoyed the matcha soft serve. Chilled at the cafe for a while after check out to pass the time. Great ambience, especially the songs played. Would return to try more of their menu.
review_2_text: The matcha pudding was too bitter, and the dessert portion was too small for the price. The place is cute and unique, and I love the vibes.
review_3_text:
Checked out this popular matcha café in Chiang Mai and it did not disappoint 🍵💚

We got the classic + matcha choux, soft serve (cutely served btw), and my forever fave — rare cheesecake 😍

The whole place is super cozy and cute. Totally in love with the vibe! ✨
review_4_text: first time in chiang mai and so first time in this coffee shop! my family and me spent a lovely time there, where we tried different deserts and drinks that were all really good! plus the staff was really nice and the atmosphere is just the perfect amount of calm :) highly recommend!
review_5_text: I’m so glad I stopped here for some ice cream. The food was delicious and well prepared, and the vibes are fun. Come here when you want something cute and to feel good. The staff is very friendly. I highly recommend!

name: 9 Siblings Restaurant
review_1_text:
I’d added 9 Siblings to my list before my trip to Thailand. I think I’d seen it mentioned by a YouTuber previously.

Either way, I was not disappointed. I ate there twice during my few days in Chiang Mai. I’m 100% sure I’d have ended up back there again if not for being caught out by the 8pm closing time.

The decor was nice and their vibe was nice, chill and casual, perfect for a solo traveller. The staff were lovely friendly too.

For breakfast I had one of the set menu choices and on the same day, I went back for dinner and got their beef khao soi to takeaway. Unfortunately I got there close to closing time so I took it back to my hotel room to eat. It was SO unbelievably good!!

It was my first time ever trying khao soi so I have nothing to compare it to but wow, the flavours, the tender beef, the broth, the onions adding a extra zing, the portion size, everything about it was chefs kiss. And to think it only cost 100 baht.

If I’d had more time in Chiang Mai, I would’ve gone back to try the chicken khao soi as well as many other things on their menu. Yum.
review_2_text:
I really liked this place!
Loved the atmosphere and the staff, especially the elderly people working there are absolute sweethearts! 🫶🏻 The food was good and we paid a total of 260 baht for food and drinks for two people.
review_3_text: This restaurant was a 30 minute walk from our hotel, but I feel it was worth it. It was one of the best Khao Soi I have had in Chiang Mai. Friendly staff, and a quaint clean atmosphere. Would eat there again.
review_4_text:
The food was more suited to foreigners than authentic Thai. The Pad Thai was edible, but not very good. The flavor wasn't very intense (I'm not talking about spicy).

The place is cozy with Lego elements (there's also a display), although the name doesn't suggest it. The downside is that the staff doesn't clean the tables regularly, so you have to eat in an atmosphere of dirty tables.

My visit was at the end of October.
review_5_text:
Lovely little Khao soi place hidden 5mins away from the gate market. Very tender chicken drumsticks and flavourful broth.
The stirred pork was also very tender.
Worth a visit if u are in the area.

name: OWL brasserie
review_1_text: A great fusion experience. You'll love the place when you enter the front gate and walk through the courtyard, inside the restaurant it's nice, spacious and cozy. They change menu every 4 months and you can tell from the menu and the food that the chef knows how to cook cuisines from all over the world, I only ordered 4 dishes and I can taste Asian, Italian, Spanish and French, everything was cooked to perfection and the service is also very good, I'd love to come again for sure!
review_2_text: Been here twice in a week.  Cooking was excellent. We had the Akami ceviche, beef tartare, coq co vin, and risotto. You can tell the care and passion they put in to it. Ten out of ten. ❤️
review_3_text: Food is creative and flavourful. After an amazing dinner we had to come back for lunch a few days later. Second visit did not disappoint. I am surprised they don’t have a Michelin Star.
review_4_text:
This is truly one of the best Western restaurants in Chiang Mai.
We had originally booked a table for dinner, but due to a change in our schedule, we visited earlier in the afternoon instead.
Although the lunch menu offered fewer selections, the quality and flavor of the dishes remained outstanding. Highly recommended.
review_5_text:
Very impressive dinner at Owl Brasserie on 15 February.

We booked over their website in advance and had a glance of the menu beforehand.

The restaurant is located in a quite neighborhood the old city but just a few minutes walk to the main road. It was renovated from an old house with a spacious indoor which also can view the operation of the kitchen and a large patio that have a giant old tree. The whole ambience from the first step to the restaurant is tranquil.

I love their deco, furniture and all the table ware, especially the clay, wood & shades of blue.

Lady owner was friendly & kind, she's very warm & love the share the is history of the heritage house as well as the background of head chef.

We had a very enjoyable dinner from the friendly service team, the lovely live music and of course the food we had.

All the food we had from welcome canapes, appetiters, warm bread, main course to dessert can see, taste & feel how much efforts behind been made. Presentation is great and I found they put the details in little aspects even on the side dishes & gravy which most appreciated.

Owl Brasserie is one of the best restaurants I've been to. The time i was having dinner, already told myself I have to come back again on next trip to Chiangmai. The only regret was I came too late for the dinner so it's a bit rush.

Thank you very much team Owl.

name: Gravity Cafe’ & Bistro
review_1_text:
We went for breakfast at Gravity Cafe and really enjoyed it. The food selection is very good and everything looks great. They also have a huge selection of coffees, juices and other beverages. I had an açaí bowl, a caramel macchiato and a watermelon juice. My husband chose an avocado toast with a poached egg and a watermelon juice.

The juice was fresh and very tasteful. The açaí bowl was delicious with a great variety of fresh fruit and nice crunchy granola. The avocado toast also tasted good and the egg was perfectly cooked. Overall, it was a really good breakfast and I would definitely come again and recommend it.

The only reason I considered taking away a star is that they offer a 5 percent discount for making 5 star reviews, which feels dishonest. That said, the breakfast itself is honestly close to a perfect 5 out of 5, so for now they are forgiven.
review_2_text:
Note: The place gives 5 % off for 5 star reviews.

I don't like that review practice at all, so we did not take the 5 %, but the place is undeniably a 5/5 place!

The avocado toast had crisp bread, a delicious smash and a perfectly poached egg. The watermelon juice was flawless and so was the acai bowl and coffee. They also have some fun instagram items like the smoothie or tea with a white bubble on top (didn't try it).

We will be back for more in the coming days.
review_3_text:
A good spacious place
A lot of options on the menu
Credit cards are accepted
The prices are a bit on the high side for food and drinks.
Good place for tea, coffee and drinks if you don't mind paying extra. Croissants are fresh and delicious.
Good service
review_4_text: Breakfast is okey but nothing super special, like european style. Coffee is of course sweet so you need to say first if you don’t want it sweet. Banana bread is little bit to fat and too banana taste
review_5_text: My girlfriend found Gravity Cafe on the internet so we went for brunch as we were hungry. Yes, it is pricey… but thats understandable given the location and target customers. The quality of the food reflected the price (in my opinion). We enjoyed our toasts with eggs, avocado, halloumi, etc…

name: Weekday Coffee&Bar
review_1_text: Cute, modern facade slyly hides a large, airy patio out back. Great drinks to go along with the space, served up by a real friendly group of staff. Not busy on a weekday afternoon, lovely spot.
review_2_text: SUCH A CUTE GIRLY COFFEE SHOP. They have nice drink items and sweet treats. They played girly songs. It was suchhhh a vibe. Plus you can make bracelets and paint plates. It was so cute
review_3_text:
Korean style of cafe that sounds accidentally?... It was clean and quiet. I was able to see the room, but it is a space that is large even if I use it with my family, and I am looking forward to opening a new one on the second floor bar soon. Coffee also uses Arabica beans, so I think I thought about the taste and aroma.
Just be careful when you go out to the backyard, tall people
review_4_text: Came by for 2 ice coffees at 9am o. A Friday. Only a couple before us who ordered coffees and dessert. Waited at least 20 minutes before I got impatient and lost track of how long we waited. If in a hurry I suggest this isn't the spot. Nice decor and coffee was decent.
review_5_text: great atmosphere, amazing service, good prices, good quality and quantity, had a great time painting plaster plates and eating yummy food and good drinks

name: yield coffee
review_1_text: Great newly opened modern cafe that gives you a different vibe than most others and it feels a bit like a bar sort of. The drinks are great and reasonably priced for the space and there are some comfy chairs. I like the vibe and there is a few good tables. Since this place is fairly new, everything is clean and nice.
review_2_text: Cool oldies music. Trendy and relaxing. Enjoyed a nice coffee (for me) post lunch. Not busy when we visited.
review_3_text:
Cute little café with reasonable price.
Love the vibes here so much it’s super instagenic !

Plenty of parking spot as well.
review_4_text: A nice coffee shop near the old town. The coffee tastes great, the prices are reasonable, and the owner has great taste in music – the playlist is really good！Love it!
review_5_text:
Good coffee made to order.Light roast blend of Thai and Ethiopia.
Looks like a good work space.

name: Mom and Me
review_1_text:
This place is really popular, so expected a short wait for a table - it's a small place.
The menu is good and has some Thai dishes and western style breakfast too.
Our dishes were great and the atmosphere and ambience is cute.
review_2_text:
A nice breakfast retaurant.

Its very small, with only a few tables, so recommend getting here early.

The service was great, coffee strong and food tasty. A nice way to start the day.

We had avacardo on toast qith scrambled egg.  Two coffee's and a ginger tea.  It came in less than 200b per person.

The portions were very generous.
review_3_text: I absolutely loved this place!! We came here for breakfast and while the service was on the slower side, the food, lattes and juices were incredible. I could smell her cooking the garlic chicken in the back and the taste of that crispy garlic is still making my mouth water. The vibe in the restaurant is also really cool and very peaceful. Highly recommend for some good coffee and breakfast.
review_4_text: If you’re looking for good chicken, this is the place to go! A lovely family run restaurant tucked off the a main Street - super quiet and peaceful in the garden. Also incredibly cheap - what’s not to like!
review_5_text:
My canteen!
I've been coming here every lunchtime for a month now. The food is excellent and lovingly prepared by Li and her daughter.
The setting, filled with flowers and plants, is also very soothing and relaxing.
I highly recommend it !

name: Maison Maison
review_1_text: This spot is a gem, it’s very yummy and great atmosphere. We were 8 people and we sat upstairs for breakfast, the food was really good but not cheap. I took the waffles with strawberries and blueberries and they were really pretty and good. Everyone liked the food and the service was really nice. The only thing is that some of the chocolates are kinda bitter just so people know
review_2_text: We came here because a popular spot down the street was too busy.. and we are so glad we found this place! Absolutely delicious. It’s very quaint, quick service, and nice people. The best breakfast we have had in Chiang Mai. Would definitely return and recommend to anyone. We LOVED the waffle with berries. The all meat breakfast was great as well as the flat white (with oatmilk).
review_3_text:
Absolutely delicious, it’s next to Sun Ray’s which is really popular and everyone is going there. We have been there too yesterday so we could compare. Maison Maison has more options and food is absolutely delicious and healthy! Besides that it’s als bigger and the places to sit is perfect and more comfortable!

The people who are working there are also really nice and respectful. I would recommend it. For us it was 10 out of 10
review_4_text: I ended up here by chance because the place I initially wanted was too crowded and it turned out to be a great discovery. Calm atmosphere, excellent bowls and smoothies, friendly staff and really good quality. Highly recommended.
review_5_text:
Well plated acai bowl. warm and cozy environment.

The owner should give the two staff a raise. they were both so friendly and did their best to recommend meals and answer all my questions!

name: Area 41 Coffee&Cafe
review_1_text: The ice coffee latte is not bad, with a bit sweetness. Also provides special menu allowing people to experience something different.The shop facing the main road, traffic is busy on weekdays, but bright and ok soundproofing as long as the music broadcasting or customers talking too loud.  Seems like local people like to chill here too.
review_2_text:
Made from the help with the blind.Good quality Coffee. Carefully made drinks and cakes were exceptionally good taste too, especially Young Coconut Cake.
Price friendly cakes here too and the quality are exceptionally good.
Clean and good seating.
Highly recommend.
review_3_text:
This is in conjunction with the blind people education. I feel great to have found this and support it.

It has cozy sitting, inside and outside. Beautiful and quiet and clean.

Latte 50B comes with a beautiful foam deco, it is a flower, can you see?

I really enjoy this place. Thank you for keep the maintenance hard work!
review_4_text:
Nice coffee with very aesthetic vibes!

Aircon was crisp, prices were fair (~50 THB per drink) and it’s very cool to see they have their entire menu available in braille! Plenty of both indoor and outdoor seating available.

Highly recommend anyone coming here before/after the Shabu Buffet next door like we did ☕️
review_5_text: Good place to rest and have a coffee after hhot day outside

name: Phordee Bistro
review_1_text:
I like Phordee Bistro a lot, I keep going back for brunch or lunch.
Good food, nice people, a cosy and comfortable air-con place.
Today I went back again for lunch; I had Kaeng Hang Lay (northern pork belly curry) , Kai Dou (fried egg), Khao Suay (plain rice), washed down with a soda.
And then chilled over an hour nursing a capaccino, and had a durian ice lollly before I tore myself away.
Good job, Phordee Bistro!
review_2_text: This was a wonderful place to have a delicious meal. I ordered the green curry vegetarian, which included oyster mushrooms. The owner added eggplant, per my request. The plating was divine, the details with the flowers and the leaves made the presentation of the food much better. The papaya salad was delicious as well. I’m definitely coming back.
review_3_text: Absolutely delicious! Ordered Green Papaya Salad (spicy) and Coconut Chicken soup (not spicy) with LOTS of fresh veggies, lemongrass and ginger. The soup is worth the trip alone. The fries were great. Everything was proper temperature. Service was super and server was very nice. Will definitely go again.
review_4_text:
Delicious food in reasonable price. I recommend the"Deep fried pork intestines with Garlic Server with spicy dipping sauce". This should be the best pork intestines I've every tasted. And owner ( so as chef) are really friendly. The Thai Coconut chicken soup is amazing as well.
Definitely will promote this restaurant to my friend who will come Chiang Mai.
review_5_text:
Wow! The best meal I've had in months. This place is amazing. Flavor that just grabs you by the taste buds and takes you on a journey.

The pad Thai was easily the best I've ever eaten. I have a whole new appreciation for what I considered to be an overrated dish.

The pineapple fried rice was so smokey with a subtle sweetness that we both loved.

The som tum with the fish was freakishly good. It paired so well together. Easily the best som tum I've tried in Thailand.

Last was the shrimp cakes which were crunchy and exactly what I wanted.

Seriously, don't miss this place!

name: Main Wall Climbing Gym
review_1_text: Very modern and nice climbing gym. Both bouldering, lead climbing and few auto belay routes. Price was 450 baht for person and 100 baht for rental shoes. Shoes are quite new and decent. For grading system they use V scale.
review_2_text:
I have climbed at many gyms within Australia eg: Sydney, Brisbane  Perth and Adelaide and now I'm attending the "Mai Wall rock climbing and bouldering complex in Chiang Mai. I must say it's extremely well set out, with fantastic climb selections from beginners to hard-core climbers. There's a separate wam-up room with finger racks and a -45 degree bouldering warm up as well. Lockers for your valuables are available and they also sell a small range of climbing essentials on site.
If your a beginner or just haven't bought all your gear yet, you can hire the equipment as well.
Very happy to recommend this climbing gym to anyone. Cheers Van Moore
I rate this gym up there with the best I've experienced in Australia
Also it is kept very clean and tidy which is a credit to the management...thank you!
review_3_text:
Me and my partner have been climbing for 11 years now, and we always make a point of going to local gyms whenever we travel.

Main wall is clean, relatively cool and well staffed. It is perfect for a visit once maybe twice during a holiday visit to CM.

Setting wise (Bouldering only!), it's definitely angled at the more intermediate climber which is understandable. My partner climbs ~6b/v4 and I climb ~7b+/v8/v9, and there was a lack of harder climbs there for me.

From what I could see there were no bouldering problems set for the two higher v grade colour tags, with ~5 blue tags at v5-6 which was a shame.

We both still had a good 2 hours climb however, and enjoyed our time there. If you are an advanced boulderer, it's a perfect gym for a good stretch and to hold onto some plastic for a bit, but don't expect a hard project session.
review_4_text:
Very good climbing gym. I tried only bouldering, and although routes are mostly easy/intermediate (I found only one v7) they are still fun to climb. The only problem is that they don’t have AC so it can be quite hot

Gym also has a separate training room with 2024 Moonboard, campus board, and plenty of climbing training stuff.
review_5_text:
This place is super fun climbing center of Chiangmai. If You want to enjoy both of lead & Bouldering on same time then You can pick this to the best. Even this place is super cool & trendy accommodation for indoor climbing.
Even if You have your kids or you don’t know how to climbing then Don’t worry about it
They have lots of skilled coachs for the guest.

name: GORD CHIANGMAI HOTEL
review_1_text: Absolutely loved my stay here at this hotel. The service was amazing. One morning I had an early pick up for a tour they, made me a sandwich to go. So unexpected and so sweet. They were very helpful with locations and recommending various activities. Would stay here again. Central location as well, so lots of options with food, Sunday market etc.
review_2_text: Outstanding...great location (get bottom floor room if you can).  Its peaceful, its clean, very friendly and a great location....really love this town, Gord hotel is very close to everything you need, will def be back, ty to the staff, especially the nice guy who is from the Cambodia border area
review_3_text: Amazing place. My family stayed 5 days in the loft. Location is great, cozy and quiet and staff is very service-minded!
review_4_text: It is the second time we come, the first to eat and we loved it and we have had breakfast again. Everything is very good, they are very fast and friendly when attending to you and the place is beautiful. The price are very good
review_5_text:
We had a very pleasant stay at this hotel. The rooms were spacious and comfortable, providing a relaxing atmosphere. The reception team was very welcoming and accommodating, allowing us to check in early as a room was available. After check-out, they also kept our luggage safely and even helped us book a taxi, which was really convenient.

The breakfast had 5-6 options, and we could choose one, which was decent, though a bit more variety would have been nice.

Overall, a great experience with excellent hospitality. Would definitely consider staying here again!

name: Sweet Home coffee -A little Corner
review_1_text:
●●●Sweet Home Coffee is a,Chiang Mai top pick●●●
Everything about SHC is top notch 👌
The coffee quality is great.
Service by everyone is excellent.
And the space is cozy and super welcoming.
Unfortunately,  the owner has lost her lease by the the end off December 2025. She has not found a new space as of end November 2025  please stay tuned.
Handicap doable and recommended
Inexpensive
Restrooms NO
Final take....Highly recommended for all of the above.  ....but hurry!!!
review_2_text: If there’s one place you need to visit in Chiang Mai, it’s this cafe!! The staff are truly the kindest people you’ve ever met — so happy and helpful in the most authentic way — and the food and drinks are as delicious as they are beautiful (see photos if you want a spoiler, but seriously, you will not be disappointed)!! It’s a little hole in the wall spot with just a few tables, but we went twice and they had room for us both times. And it’s perfect with little kids, as they had kid-friendly treats and a bag of toys! Our favorites were the mango sticky rice, fruit platter, and fresh coconut, but their entire menu looks absolutely incredible. This is by far one of our favorite cafes in all of Thailand, we wish we lived here so we could be regulars!!
review_3_text: The passion they put in preparing the food and drinks is INCREDIBLE!! They have the best mango sticky rice I’ve tasted, the iced latte was also amazing, better than in overpriced coffee shops. The muesli and yogurt bowl with fruits was to die for and we came back every morning! We have a 3 year old and they brought her toys to play with and prepared her a bowl of oat milk like she was royalty.
review_4_text:
What a perfect place! The staff are so lovely, and it’s the best mango sticky rice I’ve ever had!!! I came here three times and I definitely want to come back again. You order a dish and receive a piece of art, everything is made with so much care!
Highly recommend! The prices are also very fair.
review_5_text: This is the most amazing coffee shop. All the drinks are beautiful and delicious. Everything is covered in flowers. The owner is the sweetest human i have ever met. And the mango sticky rice is out of this world. I could now recommend this place enough.

name: HappyBlue Coffee - the neighborhood cafe
review_1_text:
Such a nice little café tucked away from the crowds it’s a perfect spot if you’re looking to escape the hustle and bustle for a bit. The location feels calm and minimalistic, with very chill background music that makes it easy to relax and enjoy your time.

The cappuccino with oat milk was the real highlight for me. Creamy, smooth, and absolutely delicious this was easily the kind of coffee I’d come back for again. The croissant was served warm and nicely flaky, exactly how it should be.

I also tried the coconut matcha, which was really well balanced, not too sweet and not too bitter, making it very enjoyable. The only downside for me was the signature lemon cake. It wasn’t as spongy as I expected and leaned a bit dry and too sweet for my taste. Not terrible, just not my favorite.

Overall, a great spot for a quality cappuccino with oat milk and a peaceful atmosphere. Definitely worth stopping by if you want good coffee in a calm, tucked-away setting.
review_2_text:
Cute, kind of hidden cafe with good cappuccino and delicious Matcha (especially the Matcha Coconut drink). Adding oat milk costs only +5 THB, and there are also other plant-based milk options. And there is an option to use premium matcha instead of regular for +30 THB

The croissant was delicious even though the baked goods are a bit overpriced

The atmosphere is quiet and calm, which is just what I wa looking for
review_3_text: Quaint cafe perched in a deceivingly quiet back street given how central it is. Tended to by warm and welcoming folks who speak great English. Serves up solid drinks, and the pastries look equally swell. Sees decent foot traffic on a weekend morning.
review_4_text: Delicious coffee! We got a latte and the Coconut Thai Tea Cloud, and both were great though the tea cloud was the star! The atmosphere is very calming and quiet, tucked down a side street near the main walking street. Id recommend it to everyone!
review_5_text: This is a gem, located in a back alley of Chiang Mai. Customer service is top notch, very conversant in English, extremely clean and beautiful little nook. Quality of the coffee and deserts is top notch

name: PIMM'S CUP : Roastory Lab
review_1_text:
We are always on the lookout for great coffee and authenticity. You definitely can find that here. I’ve had a lot of coffee in my life but this is the first time I’ve had farm to table.

Pim, the owner and farmer, happened to be in the shop and made two wonderful coffees for us. Despite her costs doubling over the last few years she’s kept her ristretto, espresso and doppio at 50 THB.

If you’re into coffee, you have to give the place a try. Btw, there is a great wine bar, Cru, across the street.

Pim recommended visiting the nearby night market as well as Wat Phra Singh to catch the sunset behind the gold stupa.
review_2_text: Honestly, best drip and americano we tasted in Thailand. Simple atmosphere where you understand - all is about coffee, no additional gake vibes. In Chiang Mai is a must place to try coffee. Thank you and best of luck!
review_3_text: Top-notch Thai and Laos coffees sourced by Ms. Pimm - the Thailand coffee gurus' guru. (She's the "invisible hand" behind many well known local roasters, cafes and baristas.) Pimm's Cup is her own little hideaway where you can enjoy amazing coffee from friendly staff - and if you're lucky, see some of the many giant bags of green coffee that pass through as they make their way from farm to roaster...
review_4_text:
One of the few no-nonsense coffee spots in Chiang Mai with a clear focus on the coffee rather than fancy aesthetics—and it delivers.

Tried their dirty coffee, which was very well done and nicely balanced.

Definitely worth a stop if you’re serious about coffee and exploring Chiang Mai’s café scene
review_5_text:
The staffs were very polite and welcoming. I had a really good coffee here, and bought a bag of beans back. They farm and roast their beans to be sold here. It is worth my money to support the local roasters.

I will definitely cone back again when in chiang mai. Thank you!

name: Gord Chiangmai Kitchen ครัวกอดเชียงใหม่ - Breakfast, Brunch & Lunch in the garden
review_1_text:
Was so fortunate to stumble upon this gem today! The food is delicious, healthy and inexpensive. All the tables are surrounded by tropical greenery and there is a carp pond next to some comfy leather sofas, making for a lovely atmosphere.
What really stood out was the wonderful staff, who helped me with my sleeping baby. They provided an extra fan for him and moved the entire sofa further into the restaurant when it started pouring down with rain to make sure he wasn’t splashed 🥹 Thank you!
review_2_text:
We stayed at this little resort for two nights, and I’d definitely recommend this place if you come to Chiang Mai for a short visit. The location was spot on, we enjoyed are walks around the old down, it’s cute little streets. The food at the hotel was tasty and not expensive.

🌴 If you enjoy discovering hidden gems in Thailand , come join me on Instagram: @tanya.hanoff
review_3_text: Very cosy and nice food (also quite cheap). The chocolate chip with banana was one of the best things I’ve eaten in a while
review_4_text: If your living for a place to relax and a full belly. This place has a great atmosphere and vibe. Plenty of fans for a hot day and many koi fish swimming freely.
review_5_text: This restaurant is located in the garden area of a hotel. Their menu covers from local dishes to western brunch and dessert. Their yogurt smoothie was pretty big and heavy and good. The tuna sandwich was ok. The space is very nice and it is a nice stop while you explore the old town area.

name: Konjohn coffee 2
review_1_text: Great coffee shop in the bottom floor of the Jomkitti Hotel, plenty of tea options and coffee and cakes! Staff is great. The lemon honey tea is so very refreshing! Lemon cake is good too!
review_2_text: This cafe has a very relaxing nice vibe and a few comfy chairs and ok tables available. The prices of their drinks are pretty fair and a bit cheaper comparing to similar cafes with AC. My light roast americano was not good as expected though.
review_3_text: Chilled vibe with the ambient instrumental music and comfy seats and sofas. Other customers are silent so we are talking quietly ourselves! Choice of roast level for the coffees of light, medium or dark. Choice of sugar level in the iced mocha. Basque cheesecake was really similar to those I've had in Andalusia! 100% recommended. To note - cash only.
review_4_text: This cafe is perfect with high quality coffee🩷friendly staffs, cozy environment and outlets to charge. Also the chair is so comfortable! Definitely a good place for studying or working. Honestly it’s one of the best cafes I visited in Chiangmai
review_5_text:
March 2025
Still a great place to enjoy coffee and cake!
Brazil Santos light roast very good

Best coffee in chiang mai!!!!!
The best coffee shops in chiang mai!!highly recommended
A favourite coffee slowbar near home!!
Same great coffee and service.
A must visit if you love coffee

O9/23
Perfect to take on a trip to the capital.👍😎

name: Kalm Coffee
review_1_text: Nice big cafe inside Kalm village. Latte was on the stronger coffee side so just ask for sugar syrup if you want your coffee sweet. Can get crowded or noisy at the bottom floor but you can always go up the 2nd floor which is more like a co-working area and its quiet there. im not really a cafe person but i would go back again here!
review_2_text: This is an amazingly cool space that is very inviting for just about everybody. It has a nice calm, feel to it. You can sit here and relax, enjoy editing to photos, reading some emails and just getting a great vibe, this is a very one of the kind place that should be in many places, not just here.
review_3_text: We visited this cafe that is located in Kalm Village. The ambience is very nice and there is a library upstairs. Staff were friendly. We tried the latte and local tea drink. Both were very good. We enjoyed the relaxing atmosphere here.
review_4_text: Nice and quiet spot to read, chill, or simply do nothing. Ordered an iced latte and enjoyed the peaceful silence in the café.
review_5_text: A cute coffee shop cafe with a variety of teas and coffees. They also had dessert, though not many of it - only around 4 options to pick from. The brownie was good! Lovely interior.

name: Café de Siam @Le Naview Hotel
review_1_text:
Could not fault this place. Attractive and classy looking but the food is moderately priced and was all very good. Very pleasant and relaxed atmosphere.
I had a stir-fried seafood dish + a mango sticky rice, both very good.
I was a little surprised that even the cafe latte was good.
It felt very well run, a smooth and efficient operation.
review_2_text:
There lives a rat running between the tables and customers. The waitress saw it too, but didn't care... must be normal.
But the food is good, both european and thai.
review_3_text: Fresh and tasty. They have both indoor and outdoor seating. The wait was a bit long considering Thai food is typically super fast. It’s inside the moat with lots of tourists and adjacent to a hotel
review_4_text: It is a beautiful place. Better to visit this at night. More beautiful at night than daytime because of the lantern/ lamp decor.
review_5_text: Excellent food in a nice restaurant with A/C and reasonable prices. It looks more upscale than other restaurants nearby.

name: Cafe'de Maross
review_1_text:
If I could put 6 stars, I would.

I have been eating my breakfast/lunch there every day for 1-2 weeks.
The food is delicious, the place is cozy and they play jazz music in the background.
The service is always on point and the two people (that I have seen) working there are always incredibly nice.
The price is also attractive for the quality that you receive.

Go there and see for yourself!
review_2_text: There was not a lot of people when i came. Nice athmosphere, really calm, nice is super friendly, i took the ceasar salad that I was dreaming about for two months and I was not disapointed !! Also took the lemon tea and it was good.
review_3_text: Definitely caters more for tourists at slightly higher price points, but it was clean, comfortable and had more Western options if you want some variety from the usual Thai fare (although they also offer Thai food).
review_4_text: Delicious breakfast, fruit is so sweet and fresh, if you are in old town, you need to try this one.
review_5_text: I came here to get something to eat for lunch. The service was great and the food was pretty good as well. The honey milk was really good. The place is clean and they have free wifi as well.

name: Coffee Lovers
review_1_text: At Coffee Lovers they have a great selection of coffee and breakfast. I wanted something simple with just eggs and avocado, but it was quite difficult to get a good overview of the menu as it is very complicated and detailed, with no pictures. I would suggest a much simpler menu to make it easier to decide. In the end I chose the avocado toast with scrambled eggs after seeing a picture on Google, and I also had a cappuccino. Everything tasted very good. The bread was just plain white toast and could have been more interesting, so I mainly ate the avocado and eggs. I did like that they served a bit of fruit on the side.
review_2_text: Lovely quaint cafe with mostly outdoor and some indoor seating. Ordered 2 eggs, sausage and toast with black coffee. No complaints. My friend ordered BLT and it was nothing special. Excellent service.
review_3_text: Quiet and peaceful restaurant with many american and asian food and drink choices.  Found this place randomly close to the hotel. Was great food and peaceful
review_4_text: My favorite beautiful little cozy place to get my morning started everyday I am here in Chaing Mai 🤍 I highly recommend the Thai tea latte banana pancakes. The staff is wonderful and you can sit and relax with the fans blowing on the front patio and people watch and enjoy all the good energy you need to start the day.
review_5_text: We stopped in just for a quick drink and were very happy with the decision. Cafe is very quaint. Decor is eclectic and the menu is great. We had iced drinks and they were great. Worth a visit.

name: Thaan Aoan
review_1_text:
A absolutely perfect breakfast! It gave me all the energy for the day.

The staff were incredibly friendly, always smiling, and happy to answer any questions.

Before 8:00 AM, the environment was very quiet with few customers, and the food came out very quickly. After 8:30 AM, it got busier and busier, haha.

I highly recommend this restaurant; as long as you avoid peak hours, it will be a very enjoyable meal.
review_2_text:
I had a pleasant meal at Thaan Aoan Restaurant in Chiang Mai. The food is good and generally well prepared, with flavors that reflect traditional Thai cuisine without being overly adjusted for tourists.

The menu offers a decent selection of local dishes. What we tried was tasty and made with fresh ingredients, even if not particularly memorable. Portions are fair and prices are reasonable for the area.

The atmosphere is simple and relaxed, suitable for an easy, no-frills meal. Service was polite and efficient, nothing exceptional but perfectly adequate.

Overall, Thaan Aoan is a solid option if you’re nearby and looking for straightforward Thai food in a calm setting. Not a standout destination, but a reliable choice.i
review_3_text: By far my favorite place to eat in Chiang Mai for a sit down (or to-go) restaurant.  You can eat in comfortable air conditioning or out in a beautiful outdoor rain forest type/patio setting. I have only had the breakfast (several times) and the food is delicious. I am very picky about how I like my hashbrowns and they were not only done perfectly as I requested, but they were the best tasting too! Atmosphere is wonderful, staff is so friendly and polite, especially Sky - he has been a wealth of knowledge for me and has provided so much valuable advice regarding the area. The prices are very good, portions are excellent...I would get a taxi from miles and miles away just to eat here!
review_4_text: Everything is made fresh and in house. The cinnamon roll was near perfection! It had substance. A rich deep cinnamon and the glaze added just enough sweetness. Staff friendly. Efficient and the prices were great 👍
review_5_text:
Was pleasantly surprised with the meal I got here. It was next to a main road and even though I sat outside with all the planting and lights it was actually very atmospheric.
Pretty standard Thai meal of spring rolls, pad Thai and mango sticky rice but it was my last night in Chiang Mai and you can't go wrong with these classics.
Really lovely food and impeccable service and not expensive for what I got.
Very tasty and super impressed.

name: Garden to Table Chiangmai
review_1_text:
Soooooo good! Found this place because of the reviews and so glad we went! Excellent experience, waited around 20 minutes for a table, was served super quickly as we’d had plenty of time to look at the menu while waiting and food came within about 10 minutes. Every dish was delicious & beautifully presented. Staff were attentive and helpful!
I’m not a veggie but i love vegetables! they veggie khao soi was amazing and had such fresh delicious veg, i’ve found some places i order veggie and just get cabbage! There was plenty of yummy veg!
review_2_text:
Arrived 30 minutes before closing time but were seated rather quickly despite a queue infront.

The concept is so great, fresh and quality ingredients and the taste matches!! The dumplings were some of the best I’ve ever had and the Koh Soi was delicious. Well worth the visit!
review_3_text: Incredible food, fresh, full of flavour. We came back to eat here 3 times because it was so good!  Enjoyed every bite. We always came at an odd time (4-5pm) so never had to stand in a queue. Fast and very attentive kind service. Very cozy atmosphere.
review_4_text:
This has quickly become one of our favorite restaurants in town. We first discovered it through Google Maps, decided to give it a try, and ended up completely falling in love with the place. From start to finish, the experience was so enjoyable.

The food was absolutely delicious—every single dish we tried was packed with flavor and beautifully presented. The attention to detail in both taste and decoration really stood out, making each plate not only satisfying but also a feast for the eyes. What we especially appreciated was how the restaurant provided clear and thoughtful information about the sources of their ingredients. It gave us confidence in the freshness and quality of the food, and you can really taste the difference.

The staff were also wonderful—friendly, attentive, and genuinely welcoming. They created such a pleasant atmosphere, making us feel comfortable and well taken care of throughout the meal.

Overall, it was one of those dining experiences where everything comes together perfectly: great food, lovely ambiance, and warm service. We can’t wait to come back again soon and try more dishes from the menu. Highly recommended if you’re looking for a place that truly values both quality and hospitality!
review_5_text:
When we came for close to 7pm there was predictably a queue. But we only had to wait 20 mins or so before we were seated. We happened to be close by and decided to try this. I saw the 4.9 reviews and I would say 98% of the time they are accurate.
So we came along and were blown away by  how fresh and tasty it all was and how the meat dishes were accompanied by a generous variety of vegetables. I felt so healthy eating it. More importantly everything was delicious and lip smacking good. It made me happy that such a fantastic eaterie exists. Love the ethos and brand. Great service as mentioned by the others. And incredible value. Will come again if we can while we’re here.

name: Lazy Lemon, Old City
review_1_text: Great brunch spot in the Old City. The avocado toast and pancakes were fresh, well made, and nicely presented, and the coffee was good. The atmosphere is calm and cozy. Staff were a bit cold, but service was efficient. Overall, a solid place for breakfast or brunch.
review_2_text:
I usually don’t distrust reviews, but in the case of Lazy Lemonn, it’s impossible not to wonder how this place has achieved such a high rating. The only plausible explanation is that the reviews are seriously inflated, because the real experience falls far short of what is promised.

There were two of us, and we arrived at 8:29 a.m. As soon as we walked in, a girl told us they weren’t open yet, in a rather dry manner. I asked if we could simply sit and wait, since there was less than a minute to go and there were already other customers sitting outside. She reluctantly agreed.
What’s striking is that while we were waiting, the staff were calmly preparing things behind the counter, yet the menu wasn’t brought to us until 8:45 am, fifteen minutes after their supposed opening time. A first sign of disorganization… or indifference.

The latte was disappointing: it tasted almost entirely like milk, with no balance or character. The iced Thai tea was fine, nothing more.
The ham and cheese bagel was a complete disaster: chewy, clearly defrosted, with visible cracks on the surface. A low quality product whose appearance already warned you that the taste and quality would not justify the price.
The pancakes with tropical fruit were good, but by no means exceptional or memorable, something you can easily find in dozens of cafés around Chiang Mai without paying an “Instagram premium.”

If the food was underwhelming, the service finished sinking the experience. With the exception of one male staff member who was genuinely kind and service oriented, the rest of the staff, especially a girl wearing a hat and a black-and-white sweater, had a rude, unfriendly, almost confrontational attitude, as if serving you were a favor rather than their job.
From the moment we arrived, the feeling was clear: we were not welcome.

No one asks how the food was, not even when they see plates left half untouched. There is zero interest in customer feedback or improvement. The unspoken message is simple: pay and leave. Preferably as quickly as possible.

To make matters worse, they only accept cash, something that is not mentioned on any sign nor communicated when you arrive. In 2026, for a modern and far from cheap café, not accepting cards is simply unacceptable.

First and last time.
Don’t waste your time or money on this place with inflated reviews. Chiang Mai is full of cafés that are infinitely better, with honest products and, above all, warm and respectful service. Lazy Lemonn offers neither.

I regret writing such a negative review, as I don’t enjoy doing so, but the experience was so uncomfortable and disappointing that if it helps other customers make a better decision before coming here for breakfast, it’s worth being clear:
walk past it, it’s absolutely not worth it.
review_3_text: Amazing breakfast spot in the middle of city center. Service is a bit slow depending on the rush, but the wait is worth it. The weather in mid-November was bliss-if you’re lucky you’ll get one of the 5 patio tables. Reasonable price for excellent quality western-style breakfast. Everything we tried from the food to the coffee was on point.
review_4_text:
Encore Lazy Lemon!
So disappointed Avocado on Toast SOLD out. No Avocado.

However, scrambled eggs with cheese on toast EXCELLENT! Must Order!

Strawberry and banana smoothie also 👍🏼 GREAT!

Must come again 🥳🥳🥳
review_5_text: love it so much I came back two times. Pancake is great, yogurt is also great. Good coffee, but my favorite is the ginger honey lemon tea. Staff are super kind and patient.

name: Pegasus Café & Roastery
review_1_text: Such delightful silky velvety espresso served here. Bright and balanced without feeling boring. The owner/roaster was super friendly and told me about the farm he sourced the coffee for his espresso blend from. Nice patio seating tucked away from a main road. No signs saying so but it's a shoes off situation.
review_2_text:
My wife and I stayed in Gord Nuea for a week, and this adorable little café was literally right downstairs from our place. To be honest, I didn’t check any social media or Google reviews before walking in — I just stumbled upon it — and I was absolutely blown away by the quality.
As someone who’s been drinking at least two cups of coffee a day for the past 8 years, I can confidently say their Americano is better than 95% of the coffee I’ve ever had anywhere in the world. Their pour-over (hand-brew) is straight-up boutique level: incredibly rich, layered, clean, and with that unique character that comes from locally sourced Thai beans. If you truly love coffee and appreciate the good things in life, you will fall in love with this place.
We ended up coming here every single morning of our stay — nothing starts a Chiang Mai day better than a cup from here. On the very last day, we found out the owner roasts the beans himself (we felt so stupid for only discovering this at the end!), so of course we immediately bought 3 bags to take home. It’s one of our most precious and happy memories from Chiang Mai.
We’ll definitely be back. Thank you to the lovely baristas and this lovely café — see you again soon!
review_3_text:
Very very delicious cappuccino. Can taste the quality of the roast and preparation.

They're a little bit busy around 1:30pm but it's good vibe and great cup
review_4_text: Had a flat white and it was easily one of the best coffee we have had during our stay in Thailand. The medium roast beans they used tasted very good. There was a hint of sweetness, and apparently it comes from the milk produced here. It was an interesting surprise.
review_5_text: Lovely coffee roast, very calming space with relaxing water tricking down the made water sculptures. Only downfall they didnt have coconut milk but we got oat instead and enjoyed it. Would return again.

name: Mitt Studio
review_1_text: Such a great place to do ceramic work. The studio is clean, well-organized, and really relaxing—perfect for focusing and enjoying the process. The staff are friendly and helpful, and they explain everything clearly without hovering. Materials and tools are well prepared, and the overall vibe is calm and inspiring. I’ll definitely come back again!
review_2_text: Had a fantastic time here again, this time I learned wheel throwing. My wife and I have been coming here for over 3 years. Great teachers, great personalities, great art! Lovely place to relax and create some art, really bright and welcoming. Highly recommend.
review_3_text:
Took two hours, one day of hand building and one day of turning. Very nice staff with lots of good feedback. If you like coffee they offer that too.
And if you not hear long they ship it international!
review_4_text: Had such a great time here - such a unique, cozy, welcoming studio for anyone who wants to do some crafts 💗 would recommend to everyone who wants to just relax and make art!
review_5_text: Affordable first time pot throwing class! You get a couple hours to practice on the wheel and then keep a few pieces you make. The instructors speak some English so it was easy for us foreigners to understand the instructions very well. Friendly and easy to follow, just takes practice.

name: Khum Cafe
review_1_text:
This place got some great vibes!
You can have either a seat in the very cozy little cafe, where you have AC.
Or you can sit in their wonderful little garden which is absolutely worth it!
You can grab some coffee and have a great time in their garden, definitely recommended!
review_2_text: This place is an oasis in the center of the old city. I've been searching for quiet green spaces and this is the best spot. It's located within the architectural center and has cute souvenirs inside the cafe. The Thai style coffee and banana muffin were delicious.
review_3_text:
This is a very cozy garden cafe, a hidden spot in the Old Town. I had peach tea with honey and lemon which was really nice and refreshing. Nok also offered me a muffin, which was very sweet of her.

It’s quiet and away from the buzz. Highly recommended for reading or working!
review_4_text:
coconut pie and latte were delicious. Coconut pie was not too sweet, creamy and filling.
There seemed to be an art event going on, there were many people with easel and paint. People seemed happy and at ease, which is lovely.
review_5_text: Really cute place tucked away from the road in a garden in front of the architecture centre, but right in the heart of the old city! Super nice staff! And nice attention to details!

name: The Little Moon Lifestyle Cafe
review_1_text:
An hidden gem in Chiang Mai!
We found this cafe because it was right next to our hotel.
And we discovered this beautiful designed cafe.
The owners are so lovely and welcoming !
The coffee is amazing, they have so many options, and the food is really good!
Highly recommended!!
review_2_text:
Great coffee, music and atmosphere! Perfect to chill and have a coffee break!
The owner was really nice and kind also :)
review_3_text: Nice coffee, good people and relaxing ambience.
review_4_text: Lovely place! I just visited and got the iced cafe peanut butter. Coffee was delicious. The cafe itself is a great space with air conditioning and Wi-Fi, and the staff were all very friendly. I hope this place does well since it just opened :)
review_5_text: A cozy and fun cafe. Lovely owners and delicious food! I came back several times. Recommend!

name: Mrs.Clean Laundry café
review_1_text:
I loved it there.
Came there every morning to start the day in this beautiful atmosphere. There are so many Breakfast and dinner options to choose from. I tried something different every day and every single dish was made with pure love and one could taste that. The owners are the sweetest.
The laundry service was also really great.

If I will ever be back in Chiang mai I will 100% be back at your place.
Thank you so much for the lovely food and time.
review_2_text: An amazingly friendly and tasty breakfast and laundry service! The most fantastic Thai tea and home made jam - truly wish we had found this gem earlier in our visit to chiang mai as we would come daily. 10/10!
review_3_text:
Genuinely one of the best meals I had in my two weeks of traveling Thailand and, without a doubt, the best Thai tea. I ordered the massaman curry and spent the rest of my trip thinking about it. Highly recommend for anyone looking for a genuine taste of Thailand at an affordable price. If you're having a hard time with the heat, just nite that the building does not have AC -- though the fans inside proved a pleasant breeze.

They also run a very efficient and affordable laundry service. Best of both worlds
review_4_text:
The best thai tea we had in 2 weeks in Thailand! If nothing else, you need to stop by and try the thai tea. I also had the wonton dumpling soup and my friend had the massaman curry and both were incredible. Well priced, perfect portion size, and friendly owners. Can’t ask for much more!

Cash only and no AC, but they have fans so it wasn’t too hot.

Also dropped some laundry off and was very happy! 50 baht per kilo for wash and dry and everything was returned folded very nicely. I would use their laundry service again.
review_5_text: Best muesli in town! All the food is fantastic and cooked fresh. You can tell she only uses high quality ingredients to cook everything. All the food is a decent portion and filling! Smoothies and coffee are also great. Highly recommend!

name: The Cozy Caffè
review_1_text: Great little cafe near Chiang Mai Gate - good coffee.
review_2_text: I chose a bad hotel with a horrible breakfast, and I came here for breakfast. The dishes were wonderful, the staff were super friendly, and the food was delicious. A great choice! Greetings, fellow travelers!
review_3_text: The coffee is delicious, and the breakfast is fresh and tasty. If you live nearby, it's worth a try.

name: Single Origin Store Tha Pae
review_1_text:
I'm a coffee nut. This was actually my third cup for the day. Still ready and willing to try and find a good coffee ☕ place.  I had an Americano Berry floral. We also tried the coconut thai and the coconut matcha. All very good. My only complaint which is true for any beverage place is that they always put too much ice in your cold drinks. Like 90% ice 10% actual drink which lasts not more than a couple of sips.

The atmosphere and setup is  relaxed There's actually a second floor but wasn't available for us at that time. Service is really good. The attendants are attentive.

It's quite a variety retail as well as an ice cream shop. Great place to chill and relax.
review_2_text:
So for all coffee enthusiasts and snobs, this is the place. I’m a very passionate home barista and annoying as hell as a customer because the coffee almost never meets my expectations. This was the first place in ages to deliver more than expected!

The vibe is immaculate, the staff friendly, chill and attentive, the music is a vibe and fits well, the cookie slapped and the coffee…
well I had one and immediately after, ordered a second.

Especially the Chiang Rai Saenchai Estate was brutally good as a flat white.
What awaits you are first class beans, kind of the best machine on the market (Kees van der Westen Spirit- if you know, you know), Mahlkönig EK43 OG Grinder and other MK grinders + even one from Ditting.

And the homies know how to use the gear. So you’ll get what you pay for!

They also offer beans to buy, drip bags, ice cream, apparel and more. Amazing place for enthusiasts.
review_3_text:
Came here for our last day in Chiang Mai while we waited for the train. Was a great chill space to sit and watch the busy road outside. Great location. Little bit of calm in amongst the hustle and bustle of old town.

Really cool selection of drinks. We also got a bunch of food. Was hearty and filling. Spent just under 1000 baht but it felt worth it for the food, aircon and place to relax before the  trek out.
review_4_text:
I found this place when I made a visit to Tha Pae Gate, tried out their americano orange and it was perfect!

I also love the coffee presentation. They really put effort in presenting the coffee just the way it is pictured in the book menu.

Nice ambience, especially in the afternoon and evening while enjoying the view of Tha Pae Gate and its surrounding.

If you're looking for a good coffee with a nice atmosphere, I highly recommend this place!
review_5_text: I ordered the coconut matcha, coconut Thai tea latte and americano. All of them were so good and they have an assortment of beans to select from. The flavours are so interesting and taste so good. I only got to try the almond honey financier but I wish I could try more! I’ve already been here twice in the three days I’ve been in chiang mai. I highly recommend to anyone looking for a nice relaxing spot to unwind.

name: STORIES
review_1_text:
Stories in Chiang Mai is a solid choice if you are looking for a meal that feels both fresh and indulgent. Also, the staff were so nice and friendly. The burger is a standout. It arrives well-assembled with a juicy patty and a generous amount of melted cheese, all balanced by crisp lettuce and pickles that add a nice crunch. The seasoned potato wedges served on the side are a highlight as well, providing a satisfying texture that beats standard fries.
The smoothie bowl is equally impressive and clearly prepared with care. It is packed with a vibrant mix of toppings like sliced bananas, dragon fruit, blueberries, and a hearty portion of granola and seeds for texture. The presentation is beautiful, even featuring a small decorative flower that makes the dish feel special. It is a great spot for a relaxed meal where the quality of the ingredients really shines through in every bite.
review_2_text:
A very modern and stylish cafe.
They offer a wide variety of foods and drinks.
I got their cappuccino for 75 baht which is a bit pricey but it was a very good cappuccino. Italians would approve.
Besides that the staff is very friendly and their seating inside got AC. Outside you can take a seat and observe the streets. Great cafe.
review_3_text: I came across this spot this morning while exploring Chiang Mai, it’s a cute little restaurant. The vibe is nice. I ordered the mixed berry French toast which I enjoyed very much. I’m not entirely a fan of the service style, or walking up to order your food but I will say the food didn’t take very long. French toast were 10/10 not too sweet and the fruits were perfect!
review_4_text:
If you’re looking for a cozy spot to sip your morning coffee and enjoy a hearty breakfast, this place is a gem. They’ve got plenty of vegetarian and vegan options, which makes it easy for everyone to find something delicious. And the best part? It’s not one of those overly “experimental” cafes. you get comfort food done right.

If Chiang Mai is your last stop in Thailand, this cafe is the kind of place you’ll be glad you wrapped up your trip with. Sure, the staff can come off a little snobby, but honestly, my breakfast was so good it completely made up for it. One of those meals that just puts a smile on your face.
review_5_text: Just flew into Chiang Mai, checked in, and stumbled into Four Stories — it instantly felt like a home away from home. Exceptional in every way, from the atmosphere to the care and comfort. Exactly what you want after landing in a new city. Highly recommend.

name: SukiShake Café
review_1_text: We came for breakfast around 11am. It was quite busy and there was only one table left. The menu had lots of options and was pretty affordable. The food was delicious and took around 15 minutes to come. The food was fresh and the portions were great. The staff were friendly and the service was good. Everytime we walk past here it is full and I can see why! Would recommend.
review_2_text:
We arrived in Chiang Mai at 7am after a long ride from Bangkok. I went to Google maps and found this breakfast place was close to our accommodation. We waited until it opened and had the most delicious breakfast. They have lots of healthy freshly prepared meals. We have been here 5 times and order different things each time.
Everything tastes unreal and at a very good price. We have been traveling Thailand for 2 months and this is definitely my favourite breakfast/ lunch spot.
The negative reviews are not accurate at all.
My favourite is the sourdough bread with cream cheese and fresh tomato 10/10.
review_3_text: Super yummy breakfast I got an omlet and it was really good and the passionfruit smoothies are a must try !! My friend got the bowl shown in picture and that was super tasty aswell it was reasonably priced too, if your In Chiang mai you should come here for a yummy breakfast 🍳 🥞
review_4_text: A lovely spot for health lovers! The prices are super affordable, and everything tastes amazing. I tried the Combo Set for only 200 THB, which includes a rice bowl and a freshly pressed juice. I chose honey + ginger + lime + cinnamon, and it was perfect refreshing and flavorful. Highly recommended for anyone who enjoys healthy and delicious food. Lots of menu options to explore!
review_5_text: I came here three years ago and had a great experience,but this time was even better. I am happy to see they expanded the team and how the things have improved. The food as usual is delicious and went there every day of my stay in Chiang Mai. Congrats and see u on the next visit .

name: To The Moon Guesthouse
review_1_text:
A typical Chiang Mai vibe hotel. We had one of our best holidays. For the whole 7 days, never got tired of staying here doing nothing but relaxing. We saw many other guests staying like us for hours. All felt relaxed.
A unforgettable cozy vibe here, with breeze, birds, 8 puppies, swimming pool, soft music and the whole decorations. No need to walk out for cafes. Here it's enough.
The location is also good. Near Tha Phae Gate. Easy to walk within old city and to eastern markets out of old city. Easy to find good juice bar and Thai boat noodles within 5-minute walk.
One other best thing is, it's quite with such good location. Barely no noise of motor bike.
Would definitely come back next time.
review_2_text: I absolutely adore this hotel. Honestly, out of my six weeks traveling across Thailand and Vietnam, this has been my absolute favorite stay and how lucky I am I to have found this gem 💎! The place is newly renovated, lovely rooms and the atmosphere / vibe is great! Super nice outside area and pool to chill and relax. Plus they have 8 puppies! 🥹 highly recommend this place - 10/10 and nearly forgot, the owners are lovely and super sweet!
review_3_text:
What we liked:
- great location
- really nice exterior
- dogs but unfortunately not sterilized (puppies around)
- laundry service
- staff ladies and young gentleman super nice

What we did not like:
- room was not ready at point of check-in (especially as we asked for an early check-in before arrival after 20h flight) -> we had to wait for additional 30 minutes and we did not get any offer such as a soft drink while waiting
- room 16 was on top floor with steep and narrow steps. We asked for a room on ground floor as we are not that mobile but was not possible
- room was small which is ok but what we did not like is that the bathroom was super tiny, mouldy, smelly and without window and the bed head was directly next to it
- room 16 is next to the washing machines and generator which can be quite noisy at night

So in short, pleasant stay but we were hoping for more and more customer centric service (especially by reception) e.g. making a room switch possible due to mobility issues or helping bring the suitcases up or down or having a drink while waiting until the room is ready.
review_4_text: Fave place. Very quirky design. Great for a day by the pool. Great food and drinks. I stayed in a tent on the second floor. Great experience. Ideal location for temples bars and restaurants. Plus there's 6 gorgeous puppies that just wander around loving attention
review_5_text: Literally come here every day lol. Heaven on earth and they have the cutest puppies ever. (The owner took in three strays and one had 8 adorable puppies). HIGHLY RECOMMENDED!

name: กาแฟพันธุ์ไทย สาขาประตูท่าแพ
review_1_text: I ordered a drink via delivery and paid an additional 10 baht to have the ice separated, but the restaurant refused. I requested a refund through the app, but was refused, citing insufficient evidence. They shifted responsibility to the customer. The restaurant should thoroughly review the order and verify its accuracy. 10 baht isn't much, but it's money. How much will this cost to multiple customers? The comments are full of people who haven't received the ice separated service. If they're not going to separate the ice, why would they charge extra?
review_2_text: I ordered through a delivery app, but I'm confused why it's so difficult to just not want ice. I mean, don't put it in a cup. And you're not wasting the store's ice anyway, so there's no need to include it since I'm not drinking it immediately. Usually, when I order without ice, it's fine, but why have they included it these past two days?
review_3_text: It's just a storefront located at the entrance of the Im Hotel; there's no seating area. There's one long bench in front of the shop for customers to sit and wait for their drinks. However, it's the branch closest to the moat.
review_4_text: The staff were friendly and smiling, the service was good, and the coffee was made to a high standard. It's a shame there aren't any proper tables to sit at.
review_5_text: The two female staff members were kind, friendly, and provided excellent service, even bowing respectfully.

name: Dada Kafe
review_1_text: Aw man…really want to give this place a higher rating because the staff were so friendly & liked the atmosphere, but the food (pineapple fried rice) was just average. Perhaps I ordered the wrong thing. Coconut shake was decent.
review_2_text:
Its a nice place to hang out, super friendly staff. After a day cooking thai food in a course we took a western salad and some bruchette with yogurt on the side. Olive oil allowed us to dress salad ourselves whichbis how we prefer and the bread was surprisingly good. I saw thai food options as well so something for everyone.

On a subsequent visit we tried the thai options and a smoothie and both eete exellrnt.
review_3_text: I found this place on my first night in Chiang Mai and had to go back for the next 2 evenings for dinner. The food was AMAZING and so FULL OF FLAVOUR - freshly cooked! The staff were very friendly and the low price point was a bonus. I had Sweet & Sour Pork x 2 nights, Red Curry, Berry rice x 3 nights and Smoothie Lassie #2 on the menu x 2 nights! Highly recommended!!
review_4_text: Calm place, nice people and healthy food. A must in Chiang Maï. Energy smoothie based on avocado + mango + coconut milk + honey is to take if you want a pause in the old city and restart 😀
review_5_text:
Breakfast.
Good food.
Fresh Passion Fruit Juice -> Fantastic

💴 CASH ONLY 💴

name: Meilleur Wine Coffee
review_1_text:
Walking through the streets of Chiang Mai, my wife and I found this Wine Oasis. The first  proper well curated selection of wines from around the world.
Its nice interior, and music, mixed with friendly attitude, at the correct room temperature, made our visit delightful. My wife had a glass of French  rose wine, I ordered a premium local lager beer, and then we shared a bottle of La Vieille Ferme white wine which drenched our curiosity to try new things in a town not very used to serving wine.
Feeling grateful, Sam Zesati and Bárbara Ortega
