review_2_text: Very small but perfectly formed! A great selection of bottled wines, only a couple available by the glass but they were lovely. The owners are super friendly and the service excellent. Highly recommend for anyone wanting something more relaxed and refined to drink in Chiang Mai!
review_3_text: Small, cozy wine bar. Well curated selection of wine from around the globe and some things to nibble on while enjoying your wine. Nice little terrace, if you prefer to sit outside. Professional coffee maker available as well.
review_4_text: Great selection of wines (for Asia) and fair prices. Really enjoyed my Montepulciano red wine from the Abruzzo region. Probably the best place for a decent glass of wine in Chiang Mai Old town.
review_5_text: Very nice ambiance and stocked with good wines. The layout is excellent. My wife & I had a very relaxing glass of Italian wine, before buying a french Pinot Noir for the hotel. We will return.

name: Rumpair รัมแพ - Thai cocktails & Foods
review_1_text:
We sat there today after searching where we can eat thai foods for good prices and not be disappointed.
the pad see ew was amazing!
It was so flavorful, the sauce and noodles were very very good.
The atmosphere of the place is very chill, nice acoustic songs and you have a nice view on the street.
The service was also very nice and food came quick
We will be back
Thank you :)
review_2_text:
We came as soon as they were open as I was excited for their pizza. Their service was excellent and here’s what we ordered:

Cheese balls: sweet but delicious - perfectly fried.

Garlic bread: house made tasty bread! It’s our first garlic bread in Thailand and it did not disappoint.

Pad kra pow: my wife truly enjoyed this dish as it was one of the best pad krao’s we had.

Cacao bowl: our first bowl in Thailand and boy was it amazing! Can’t go wrong with fresh milk and fruits.

Pesto pizza: best pesto we’ve ever had because the Thai basil leaves are just super rich and fresh. My wife doesn’t usually like the crust but she killed it this time.

Overall, great brunch location and perfectly located on the main street for tourists.
review_3_text: Amazing little cocktail bar with great food. You really can't go wrong here, they serve incredible (and I MEAN incredible) cocktails using local Thai spirits and liqueurs. Slightly on the expensive side but definitely worth it. Ive almost tried everything on the menu and still have not had a bad experience 🙏
review_4_text: Fantastic craft cocktails that utilize local Thai liquors and ingredients! Plus a fantastic environment right on the canal. It’s perfect for hanging out and chatting with friends- good music you can still talk over and friendly service. We’ve been two nights in a row!
review_5_text: Great service, exceptional craft cocktails using the delicious power of Thai spirits and flavors. Tom Yum cocktail was so creative and delicious- very friendly staff & prime, comfortable location! Would definitely return!

name: Coffee and Relax
review_1_text: My husband and I stopped here for a cold matcha latte and a hot cappuccino. The cafe served the matcha latte unsweetened, so I had to add the sugar myself. However, because the drink was cold, the sugar didn't dissolve well and leaving the matcha still bitter. Meanwhile, my husband felt that the hot cappuccino at a coffee shop near Waroros Market was much better and more affordable than the one here. It was a bit of a disappointing experience for us
review_2_text: Nice spot for a drink or a meal (they have breakfast options). I’ve only had drinks, but have seen many plates of food that looked delicious. Last time I was here I ended up getting a brown sugar fresh milk, which was refreshing and not too sweet. The women working here are friendly, and it’s nice to relax (as the name suggests) and have a drink to escape the heat for an hour or two.
review_3_text: Honestly, this might be the best matcha I’ve ever had in my life. You can feel it’s made with care, not just prepared and served. The sweet older lady who owns the place is an absolute gem, so warm, kind, and genuine, it feels like being welcomed into someone’s home. The matcha was insanely good, deep, smooth, perfectly balanced, just pure joy in a cup. Everything about this place feels right. Total gem. Absolute must-visit.
review_4_text:
I was looking for a coffee shop that had comfortable sitting area and found this to the perfect place. I ended staying for over 2 hours and it never got packed. The staff is very friendly with everyone and seem to know many of the customers who stopped by. I also had my lunch and some yogurt too. If I’m ever back to Chiang Mai I’ll definitely come here again.

Food was delicious
It’s a small shop but enough sitting area inside and at the entrance.
review_5_text: Delicious breakfast (on the photo: musli-yogurt with fruits) and coffee. Very friendly service!

name: Travel Cafe
review_1_text: I have tried their Khao Soi, Pad Thai and mango sticky rice. Everything was tasty and it's very close to Thae Pae Gate. Coffee was solid too.
review_2_text: Wow the food is so good and good prices too, if you are staying near tha phae gate you have to eat here
review_3_text: High quality meals and not small portioned, as well as reasonable price (only 99 bhat for a whole meal unlike other places nearby that offer the same for 200+) and friendly-English speaking staff
review_4_text: I had beef khao soi and it was amazing, not too spicy and very tasty. Ice cold coffee was nice too.
review_5_text:
Nice little cafe restraint. Had air-conditioning. They do little European food and most classic Thai food.
I thought the Thai food was well done.

name: Zalux Coffee Cafe
review_1_text: I love this place! The owner is just the sweetest person and the food is great! Ordered myself an iced latte and a club sandwich for 95 baht and they were simply divine! I'd highlyyy recommend this cafe for everyone looking for good food and vibe!
review_2_text: This is a little quiet oasis and slice of heaven away from the main drag. Expect top notch coffe and kind service. A hidden gem ❤️
review_3_text: A delicious coffee with soy milk and a beautiful location that is peaceful and relaxing. I can’t have regular milk and they happen to have soy milk and made me a delicious latte. Highly recommend.
review_4_text: This place was a hidden little paradise. The birds singing across made for lovely morning. Great prices and good food!
review_5_text: Not easy to find but lovely when you get there. Very serene environment. Family owned business. Great place to spend an hour or two sipping a coffee and reading a book or whatever. Had an iced cappuccino which was delicious.

name: Alley Caffe
review_1_text: Cute little hole in the wall cafe with good coffee. Honestly the best coffee I’ve had in Thailand and they have alternative milks (inc. oat). Definitely worth dropping in for a coffee and a cookie!
review_2_text: Perfect if you want a handmade, affordable, instagramable place just inside of the old town. This place has a lovely iced Thai tea and matcha however the actual shop is a little small which makes it more like a takeaway cafe. All in all I would definitely recommend. :)
review_3_text: A small cozy cafe in the peaceful alley in old town. They have an oat milk option, which made me so glad! Matcha latte with oat milk was nice, good music and good vibe for saturday afternoon.
review_4_text: Super cute little alley cafe with delicious coffee and friendly baristas. Worth the visit for a nice cup of joe.
review_5_text: Good coffee and very cheap too. Unfortunately not a lot of space inside so it's more of a takeaway shop.

name: Cafe Chungdam
review_1_text:
It was a very bad idea to come here. After a long flight, I was extremely hungry. We ordered a Hawaiian pizza that was advertised on the menu board and two salads.

The salads took more than 30 minutes and were brought only after I mentioned the waiting time. The pizza arrived after about 40 minutes in total. It was absolutely not worth the wait — it tasted like a cheap store-bought pizza. I honestly don’t understand why it took so long to prepare. The dough was completely dry.

The only positive thing is that the salad was actually tasty.
review_2_text:
Great matcha and big selection of smoothie bowls that come generously topped.
Nice place for laptop work too (wifi, chargers, comfortable sitting).
review_3_text: Not a good place if you want to Work. To sit and use your laptop you have to buy food/drinks for 150 bath per hour. Coffee was good.
review_4_text: A vibrant and cozy place to dine. Their menu has a variety of options, they have Thai cuisine and western. I was delighted that they have alternative options for dairy milk such as oat/soy milk.
review_5_text: Friendly, attentive service, with a modern, airy ambience right across the moat. Good coffee. Good wifi but no power outlets available (the ones next to me were covered with tape). Called Moats Moment Cafe outside (?).

name: Starbucks
review_1_text:
I really like the Starbucks it’s easy and convenient to the night bizarre market and the service is really fast and good and I also love that you can get sweet tea in Thailand. If you order a black shaken iced tea with five sugar pumps, you’ll have sweet tea like you have in Texas. You can adjust accordingly to your taste. I don’t like mine super sweet so if you’d like it super sweet, maybe seven or eight pumps

it’s right across the street from the Marriott and right on the street with the night bizarre market

I hope this helps and I hope you enjoy your time in Thailand
review_2_text: Spacious little but plenty of tables starbucks. Great plates and beverages that i have not seen in other starbucks not even in Bangkok. Very clean and the coffees are made very well. It has all the great taste as it should be and its location is incredible.
review_3_text:
The staff here are polite, friendly, and helpful. The prices are standard for Starbucks in Thailand. My chai tea cost 95B. They also have a good selection of merchandise available, including the Christmas range.
The cafe is big with lots of seating available. They pull the blinds half down when it is too sunny 😊
review_4_text:
Went in to grab a souvenir mug.
The clerk was extremely friendly and helpful.
review_5_text: Not a good representative of Starbucks - and I've been to hundreds of them in many countries. Not only does my starbucks card from Indonesia not work here (how is that possible?), they don't have a bathroom (astronomically rare), and the Starbucks internet wants you to register name, passport ?? etc. That's quite bizarre in itself, I go to a lot of cafe's out here in Thailand, I can't remember needing to give a bunch of personal details to use the wifi - data collection anyone? This is a extremely poor representative of Starbucks stores.

name: Somewhere Espresso Coffee Roaster
review_1_text: A small and cozy café with amazing coffee 10/10, no doubt! They roast their own beans, so the flavor is super fresh and aromatic. The homemade cookies are also delicious, and coffee starts at just 45 THB, such a great deal for the quality. It’s a cute little spot that I always come back to whenever I’m in Chiang Mai. Must visit for coffee lovers! ☕🍪✨
review_2_text:
This is my favorite little “hidden gem” coffee shop in Chiang Mai. Super-friendly owners, amazing coffee and non-coffee drinks (their Thai iced tea) was one of the best I had in Thailand), and some tasty pastries to go along with it!  They sell some fantastic local beans as well, which I can highly recommend. For the quality, it’s amazing how reasonable the prices are as well.

When the weather is moderate they open up the front of the shop to be open-air, but during the heat of the afternoon they close it to keep it nice and cool inside with air conditioning. Very convenient location to grab-and-go, but they have a surprising large amount of seating for such a tiny little place: 2-3 benches/tables inside, as well as 3 tables outside. Really recommend for a getting a drink and people-watching for a wee bit outside.

Edit (August 2025): was back in Chiang Mai and wanted to stop on again. The shop has changed a bit and became better! They had added a much larger indoor seating area now (you can comfortably sit with your drink), and they also have a list of single origin and house blend coffee beans you can choose from to have as a pour-over or in your coffee drink of choice. I am adding the pictures below to show these changes. They’ve also got a few more creative coffee concoction, as well as some desserts (cookies and cheesecake) to choose from. The couple who own this place are still lovely, and the woman’s English is excellent for talking about coffee, so if you have an questions please feel free to ask! I cannot recommend this spot highly enough - in a city filled with awesome coffee shops, this one is my favorite.
review_3_text: Amazing small coffee shop with a great Cappuccino and Late. Owners are so friendly and welcoming!!! We went every morning for a coffee. Not pricy and very cozy.
review_4_text:
Just purchased 2 coffees this second and they were divine.
iced caramel latte with oat milk and a Thai style coffee

Both were so flavourful and refreshing, I've found my local whilst where in Chiang Mai!!
review_5_text:
Excellent coffee, lovely selection of
cakes and friendly service 😋

name: แอ่วดี คาเฟ่ All Day Breakfast and coffee
review_1_text:
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
American breakfast was super delicious. Fresh ingredients, solid portion of veggies. We ate there two days in a row. Great value for money.
Highly recommended 👌
review_2_text:
Amazing breakfast the lady is really cool and the food is perfect and cheap. I enjoyed it so much.
Just one thing, waiting 40min is a bit too much , she was preparing everything by herself so it’s understandable but don’t stay if you need to go quick.

Again very good place/food/person
review_3_text:
Lovely ambience with really friendly owner! The place is ready at 7.30am and you can sit outside to enjoy the morning sun!!

The breakfast is simple and nice, not to mention the wonderful perk-me-up coffee! A good place to relax and chat.
review_4_text: Super fresh, simple tasty and cheap! 3$ only for a nice breakfast/lunch
review_5_text: Coming here, I recommend the green tea menu because it is very delicious. Good service staff Room services and car rental services are also available. And I will definitely come back again.

name: GoGreen Bar - Weed & Cannabis
review_1_text:
Zada was incredibly helpful and
knowledgeable during my visit. She took the time to listen to what I was looking for and made thoughtful recommendations based on my preferences. Her friendly attitude and professional vibe made the whole experience super comfortable and easy. You can tell she really knows her stuff and genuinely cares about helping customers find the right products.
review_2_text: Great shop with an awesome vibe and super friendly staff. Whether you’re in the mood for a unique cocktail or looking to enjoy some quality medicine, this is the perfect spot to check out. Highly recommend!
review_3_text: The staff is really nice. The drinks are really good and decorated so lovely.
review_4_text: Upscale dispensary that also serves drinks too. This is the best place to buy, smoke & hang out. My go to place for bud in Chiang Mai. They have flower for every budget. Employees are very friendly & they roll for free (please tip)
review_5_text:
Selection kinda sucks and 450-500 baht for just ONE gram of good weed sucks a lot
Almost every other dispensary in chiang mai sells at least an eighth for 450-500

name: AREA 27 DRIP COFFEE & ROASTER
review_1_text:
Spectacular local organic single-origin beans from nearby farms. Pour-overs with multiple beans to choose from. All paired with a lovely small shop with great atmosphere and a passionate owner.

EDIT: NEW LOCATION! Beautiful new atmosphere with the same great coffee & vibes. If you’re a fan of quality, hand-roasted, organic drip/pour-over coffee, this spot is a must try.
review_2_text:
This is the best hand-made coffee shop I've ever drunk in Chiang Mai.

There are a lot of beans in the bottle.

You can smell it one by one first.

Choose the one you like.

I chose two.

They are all single beans, lightly baked.

Like it a lot

The structural acidity is appropriate, and the sense of balance is also strong.

In the micro-acid architecture

It also has aroma and layers.

It's the best coffee I've ever had in Chiang Mai.

The price is also good.

80 a cup of single origin

Highly recommended

Full score💯
review_3_text: To be honest, I rate the philosophy of life here rather than the coffee - not that the coffee isn’t excellent, you can read about that in other comments. When I saw this small place and the wonderful man in it, heard his story, and saw the love he has for coffee and its preparation, I was truly amazed. He’s the perfect example of enjoying life’s pleasures alongside work, being open for just two hours a day, doing it out of passion, and then going to work. It’s a beautiful philosophy of life and work. I’m thoroughly impressed.
review_4_text:
Nut loves his coffee and you can tell. Super warm and friendly, and coffees great. There’s a wide variety of locally sourced beans (most are I believe), which you can smell. He sells beans too. He also has non coffee options like soda (with homemade fruit syrup) and coconut flower juice (it’s really sweet and refreshing! Would also recommend)

Small and cozy, love the fish decor especially. Lovely to sit outside and chill.

Made a random pit stop here and ended up staying for 1 hour lol. I’d definitely come back when I’m in Chiang Mai, thanks so much for the chats and drinks!
review_5_text:
Hidden coffee-lovers-gem tucked in the heart of Chiang Mai: instantly became my to-go spot for a perfect coffee experience.
Coffee is locally produced, Tuma, light-medium and dark roasted.
The aroma of freshly brewed coffee mixed with the friendliness of the staff craft each cup with calm, precision and passion.
Linger on the clay and terracotta art by the sculptor Nat and don't forget to taste the super delicious coconut flower juice as well!
♡♡
Hiiiiiiiighly recommended 👌

name: Moody Cafe & Hostel
review_1_text: Small hostel with two 8-bed rooms, mixed on 2nd floor, female on 3rd floor. Bed is spacious, with own light and powerpoint, blackout curtain. Shower, toilet, hairdryer, huge see through cage type locker for each bed right outside the room. But no mirror, except in common area on 1st floor. Clean overall.  Good coffee from the cafe attached to the reception.
review_2_text:
Best hostel in Chiang Mai. The owner is very helpful and kind, gave us few recommendations about attractions around the city. Very clean and comfortable beds, each resembles private capsule, 8 beds in dorm. Great localization, not far from Phae Gate. At the entrance you can also drink one of the best coffees in Chiang Mai.

Only thing I can complain about is lack of mirrors in bathroom, but overall I recommend the place very much.
review_3_text: This is a cat cave! the cats are so friendly and welcoming. The barista, he's as cute as his cats. Coffee is nice and well-balanced. Cookies are french -ish sweet(pretty sweet). Overall the place is relaxing. feel like home. back of the shop is under construction including toilet. They might open the hostel area soon. I'm looking forward to visit the café to cuddle with their cats again.
review_4_text: Great cat cafe. Good host good coffee good cats. It’s not as commercialize like other cat cafe that will force you to buy cat treats. The 3 cats here are calm and easy going. Highly recommended
review_5_text: Its a really awesome place with LOVELY owner who makes also really good coffee:) The dorms are really nicely built, you can have a lot of privacy there. You can feel a lot of heart that owners puts into this place.

name: Mooncafe by fon
review_1_text: Best smoothy I have buy in my life, completely impressed for the quality, the smoothy is concise not just water
review_2_text: The coffee here is delicious and not too sweet like other places. They use good quality beans. Easily a daily morning pick-me-up before exploring the city.
review_3_text: Nice small cafe serving coffee, smoothies and soda. The passion fruit soda is refreshing. The vibe is chill and relaxing.
review_4_text: She was kind enough to make a drink of our choice and it tasted amazing! Lovely lady
review_5_text: 100% recommend. Nice cozy place. Owner is so genuinely friendly.  Had to make it a point to stop again and visit before I left Chiang Mai. Smoothies and coffee are great.

name: The Plaii Eatery Cafe & Bar
review_1_text: Love this little bar. I only went for drinks so that’s all I can really speak to but the service is amazing. Atmosphere is more upscale and the prices do reflect that. Their drinks are very creative and yummy. They bring you a couple complimentary snacks to go with your drink which I found to be a nice surprise. We did also get the red velvet croissant which was delicious. I would 100% recommend I have no complaints.
review_2_text: Pretty simple to find accessible from the parking lot and the main hotel had myself a black coffee girl had an oat milk latte. Both of them tasted pretty great. They gave you this little biscuit thing. I’m not exactly sure what it is. Didn’t really eat it but all in all pretty great place to stop to grab some coffee.
review_3_text:
A really nice addition to the hotel.  Very stylish, clean and comfortable.

Friendly staff and interesting promotions.  A good range of cocktails and wines.
review_4_text: Awesome little spot in a very busy place in Chiang Mai inside of the hotel area so very premium seating in selection coffee taste very good. That was the black coffee that I just tasted about to taste. The latte latte is good, but prefer it with vanilla great place to stop
review_5_text: Love the vibes and atmosphere with fresh coffee and delicious pastries. Highly recommend to chill out @ChangKlan and old town.

name: Khagee
review_1_text:
A hidden gem in Chiang Mai. Everything was perfect: the lemon tart had the right amount of sourness and looked beautiful, the scones were excellent, and the coffee was great. The environment was lovely and quiet, though they only accept cash.

Definitely worth a visit!
review_2_text:
Khagee never disappoints. Calm relaxed atmosphere.

Delicious well made coffee served a variety of ways.  Fresh baked goods & food.
review_3_text:
A lovely spot in Chiang Mai. The atmosphere inside is calm and cozy—. Their pastries are delicious, especially the carrot cake (highly recommend!).

Coffee is well made, and the hot chocolate/cocoa is rich and tasty. The whipped cream is a bit dense, but if you like it creamy, you’ll love it 100%!

The only downside is there’s no dedicated parking, so you’ll have to park along the street. On rainy days, getting in can be a bit messy. But once inside, the warm smiles and kind service from the staff make you forget the hassle right away.
review_4_text: Classic Chiang Mai coffee house with wonderful patisserie. Coffee and bagel were taste very good and fresh. Staff had very good attitude. The place looks clean and inviting, simple yet interesting.
review_5_text: Great atmosphere. Staff are attentive and helpful. Drinks are above par to me. Lemon tarts is quite good, it is sour dominant. Unfortunately not quite lemony as I expected.

name: STORIES Ping River • cafe&bistro •
review_1_text:
I am writing to express my disappointment with my recent visit to your restaurant during the New Year’s countdown event. Unfortunately, this was one of the worst dining and countdown experiences I have ever had.

The food quality was extremely poor. The dishes were served cold, bland, and tasteless. We waited an unreasonably long time for our food, and when it finally arrived, it was not worth the wait at all. At one point, we only wanted to ask for the bill, but even that process took a long time.

In addition, there were serious problems with the service. Our order was forgotten, and communication with the staff was very difficult, as they did not seem to understand what we were asking for. Everything felt chaotic and unorganized. What was most unacceptable was that a female staff member openly argued with customers, which was very unprofessional.

Moreover, for such an important event as a New Year’s countdown, there was no manager or supervisor present to take responsibility or manage the situation. This made the overall experience even more disappointing.

This was my first time visiting your restaurant, and it will definitely be my last. It is very unfortunate that my first New Year’s countdown experience of the year turned out to be so unpleasant. I felt extremely disappointed and dissatisfied with both the service and the management.

I hope you will take this feedback seriously and improve your service and staff management in the future, especially during impor
review_2_text: Great location by the river and friendly accommodating staff. We ordered 3 dishes and only 1 dish actually taste good (the rice with fluffy omelette and prawns) although a bit too spicy (I requested for reduced spicines). The pasta with soft shell crab comes with white sauce (taste a bit like cloying beschamel sauce) which doesn't go with the crab. The sour pork entree is too salty and too sour, unbalanced flavour overall. The live music outside clashes with the live music from next door restaurant (this is definitely not their fault) but staff are happy for us to chose to sit inside. Price point on the mid-upmarket scale.
review_3_text: Beautiful setting with a fantastic view of the Old Bridge and the lively bars and restaurants across the Ping River. This place has so much potential, though it feels like it could do a bit more to match the beauty of its surroundings. The atmosphere comes entirely from the location - not from the setup or the music. I came around 5:30 pm for sunset and was surprised to find it almost empty, despite the stunning scenery. Hopefully, they’ll refine the experience in the future.
review_4_text: The food was all very very good! The service was nice and accommodating the food didn't come super fast, but this isn't a fast past vibe it's a place you go to relax and enjoy atmosphere. My kids love the the playground and there were kid friendly items on menu. We spent the evening enjoying music and food. I almost didn't go because of recent bad reviews but I'm very glad we did
review_5_text: This place quite calm and has delicious food. Stuff are very kind and prices are acceptable. Best place for calm, dinner and drinking

name: SELF
review_1_text:
Lovely coffee. I had one of their signature called ‘Citrus Boy’ which is milk coffee with orange syrup. It was so good.

The place is perfect for hiding away from the afternoon sun to sit back and relax with good music.
review_2_text:
Hidden gem doesn’t even begin to describe it, after countless cafés around Chiang Mai, this one stands out as unforgettable.
When coffee is done right, it demands your full attention. No distractions, no extras, just you and the cup, completely absorbed in its flavor and aroma.
review_3_text: This quirky coffee shop, with its small sign and retro minimalist design, offers unique but limited coffee options. The citrus coffee with milk blend, surprisingly delightful, is a must-try. The service is excellent, transporting you to an oldies feel coffee shop. However, the price may not be the cheapest for coffee, it’s worth for trying
review_4_text:
Exceeded all expectations — truly a hidden gem, even after visiting over 50 cafés in Chiang Mai.
A truly great cup of coffee makes you only drink coffee — nothing else. You’re fully immersed, surrounded by the aroma and flavor.

Started with the Citrus Boy. I love citrus-based drinks, and this one nailed it — a beautiful blend of citrusy sweetness, vanilla, milk, and espresso. Topped with a slice of orange soaked perfectly in espresso.

Immediately ordered a second — the Black Amber. I’m a big fan of truffle, so this was a no-brainer. It came with a passionfruit crisp on top, and right before serving, they sprinkled fresh black truffle over the coffee — the aroma and depth it added were incredible.

The vibe and music? Spot on. Whether it’s sunny or rainy, this place just makes you feel calm, cozy, and safe.

I drink and drunk here👉ig：OneCupWithYv
review_5_text:
Creative cold brew coffee variation.

We order the signature drinks - Black Amber and Warmness.

Feel like drinking cocktails

name: Issara Coffee Space
review_1_text:
Issara Coffee is one of those rare places that instantly makes you slow down and appreciate where you are. Tucked away in Chiang Mai, it perfectly captures the calm, soulful charm of the city while still delivering coffee that easily rivals some of the best cafés anywhere in the world.

From the moment you walk in, the atmosphere feels intentional and warm — minimal without being cold, cozy without feeling cramped. There’s a beautiful balance between modern design and local character, and it feels like a space made for conversation, reflection, or quietly enjoying a really good cup of coffee. Whether you’re stopping by for a quick espresso or planning to sit for a while, Issara makes you feel welcome.

The coffee itself is outstanding. You can tell there’s real care behind every cup, from the quality of the beans to the precision in how everything is brewed. The flavors are clean, smooth, and well-balanced, with none of the bitterness you sometimes get at more touristy spots. If you’re someone who genuinely appreciates coffee — not just caffeine — this place delivers. Their specialty drinks are thoughtfully crafted, and even the basics are executed perfectly.

What really elevates Issara Coffee is the attention to detail and service. The staff are knowledgeable, friendly, and genuinely passionate about what they do. They’re happy to explain different beans or brewing methods without being pretentious, which makes the experience feel personal and relaxed rather than intimidating.

Issara Coffee feels like the kind of place locals return to again and again, which says a lot. It’s not trying too hard to be trendy — it just focuses on quality, atmosphere, and consistency, and that’s what makes it special. If you’re in Chiang Mai and looking for a café that combines excellent coffee, thoughtful design, and a calm, authentic vibe, Issara Coffee is absolutely worth your time. It’s easily a standout and a place I’d go out of my way to visit again.
review_2_text: Dirty Coffee is one of the best that I’ve ever tasted, with the cozy lounge and some workshop space, here is a must visit cafe when you visit CNX 🥤
review_3_text: Such delicious single origin coffee! Their anaerobic washed beans were super clean and fragrant - can’t wait to try the others!
review_4_text:
Good post cards, really special and unique design, you can find something you like here.
Coffee is ok, just have a cup of hot latte, to be honest most coffee shops in Chiangmai are very good.
Pretty little store.
review_5_text: Very cute coffee shop + misc store. Mainly writing to say that they have oat milk because I couldn’t find it in any other reviews lol. Iced latte is 85 baht and +15 for alt milk. Highly recommend! Also, the staff is super sweet :)

name: Zeit Roaster - Brewing Lab Cafe&Coffee shop
review_1_text:
I did the coffee farm tour that partnered with Zeit and the guide asked if we would like to try out the coffee shop on our way back to the hotel and as a coffee enthusiast I had to take them up and I’m glad I did. I would also like to take a moment to recommend the coffee farm tour they offered as it was a fun experience and the guide was great!

Easily the best coffee I’ve had during my stay in Thailand. This shop is a true specialty coffee shop and very fairly priced for what you get. Not only did the drinks taste great but they were presented nicely as well.

The space was comfortable and had lots to look at. Personally was a fan of the wall of coffee brewers behind the counter.
review_2_text: They have beans with flavour notes I really like here (Chiang Mai single origin) - barley, brown rice, cereal - so this has been my go-to place in Chiang Mai for pour-over coffee. On one visit, they kindly let me try their cold brew cream and it was nice! Oh, they also have the comfiest chair for reading.
review_3_text: Nice coffee roasters and brewers in an old house restaurant compound. Common Parking 🅿️ for 12 cars and great lawn sundry area. Coffee and non-coffee drinks were up to the point.
review_4_text: For all coffee lovers this is spectacular. Cold brew coconut cream. They also serv it with Madeleine home made in different flavours. You also get to sniff the different coffee Ben's and make your choice. The staff know so much about it and they helped us choose based on type and roast. A great experience that should never be missed if you are in Chiang Mai. We meet the owner who was so friendly and explained the concept behind every and each blend. They even gave us the recipe of the coconut sweet brewed coffee. So kind place and every thing is served with love and passion.
review_5_text: This cozy coffee shop is a haven for coffee enthusiasts. It’s the perfect spot for those who love engaging in light conversation while exchanging knowledge about coffee. The shop boasts an impressive selection of beans sourced from various regions around the world, catering to diverse tastes. The menu primarily focuses on drip coffee, as there’s no espresso machine, which adds to its charm for purists. If you’re a coffee aficionado, this place is a must-visit for its unique offerings and welcoming vibe.

name: LAZY LEMON BREAKFAST CLUB
review_1_text: This place is amazing. Food is delicious and like art. We got tea, which had fresh herbs, compote pancakes and avocado toast. Every single thing exceeded expectations. Highly highly recommend especially if you are craving western food
review_2_text: Amazing amazing experience at the last lemon breakfast at club!! Saw this place in a Chiang mai YouTube video and had to come because it’s super aesthetic pancake + tropical fruit plate and it’s beautiful menu 🙏🏼 did not disappoint!! I got an egg and bacon with pancakes and added sourdough in the side (iykyk) and my girlfriend got the tropical pancakes! Everything was delicious, pancakes with syrup were a highlight! 10/10 recommend this lowkey spot 😭❤️
review_3_text: Food here is delicious, beautifully presented and very reasonably priced! We got the tropical fruit pancakes, they were light and fluffy as a cloud and came with so much fruit we had to take them in a to-go box because we weren’t able to finish them all. Service was perfect as well! Recommend this place for breakfast.
review_4_text: Getting breakfast here was exceptional! I got avocado toast. My husband got pancakes with bacon and eggs and my brother got pancakes with fruit and each dish was a work of art and also extremely well plated and cooked and of course delicious. Would definitely come back here for breakfast again
review_5_text:
Very cute place and the food is amazing. I like their menu design and the outdoor sitting area. Their logo has a cat and a lemon on it. It really goes well with the colors of the table and the rest of the set up. 🤭 I really liked this place. Will definitely be back next time I’m in the city.

Affordable prices
Food amazing
Friendly staff
Fast service

name: Sultan harlem
review_1_text:
I have been a regular here for quite some time, and have always had a great experience. Staff is friendly, service is always A1 and the shisha is always great too. The pricing is very good, and there is something at the shop for everyone food, drink, shisha.
The atmosphere in the shop is great and the vibe is friendly, there are board games and card games at all the tables too, and music playing at a reasonable volume so that you can enjoy conversation with your friends.

I’d definitely recommend to anyone in Chiang Mai to come past and spend a night out here
review_2_text:
Sultan’s Harlem offers a welcoming atmosphere, excellent service, and delicious drinks.
The space is clean, air-conditioned, and designed for comfort — perfect for relaxing with friends over smooth baraku in a stylish and laid-back setting.
Highly recommended for those looking to unwind in a cool, cozy spot.
review_3_text:
Was looking for best Shisha spot in Chiang Mai and then came across this.

Hands down best Shisha in town + the brands they use.

Vibe is cozy and makes you stay longer.

If you are a shisha lover, you must visit here.
review_4_text: Shisha was great, always happy to find a lounge in Thailand. Will definitely be back when in town.
review_5_text: I go to this shop often and the shisha here is really good. They have different grades and qualities for you to choose from depending on what you prefer. The shop owner is very friendly and the people there are really welcoming. The service is great and the music they play in the shop is my favorite because it matches my style. I’ll definitely keep coming back!!!

name: Pick a Bowl
review_1_text:
Our favourite place for breakfast in Chiang Mai. The smoothie bowls are the best I’ve ever had (I love the way of ordering as well, creating your own bowl with your own toppings ((berry & banana base is my fave)). The owner can also recommend loads of excursions & activities in Chiang Mai (often at a reduced rate).

If you’re in Chiang Mai and don’t come here - you’re missing out 😎
review_2_text: The atmosphere is incredibly relaxing, and the music is fantastic. Just looking at the menu reveals a deep sense of expertise. Ordering is a bit complicated, but the friendly owner explains everything clearly. The food is delicious and makes you feel healthy. I definitely want to come back with my family.
review_3_text:
I arrived it Chiang Mai early this morning, without being able to book into my hostel until the afternoon, I took a 30 minute walk over to pick a bowl especially from reviews I’d seen on social media. I was absolutely not disappointed!
The order system was super easy to navigate, and it was lovely to be able to pick, mix and match your ingredients and toppings. It was absolutely delicious, and so fresh!
The staff are very kind and welcoming and Dang even gave me recommendations for activities and temples to see around the city. Thank you! Hopefully I will be back soon!
review_4_text: The best smoothie bowl I’ve ever had! I dream about this place when I’m back home in California and always return when I visit Chiang Mai. I’ve visited the past 3 years and always make it a point to get a bowl multiple times. Make sure to add the homemade peanut butter and homemade granola as well. Made in house daily. Sweetest staff, and Dang is so warm and friendly. A must visit when in Chiang Mai!
review_5_text:
This place is an absolute gem for smoothies and smoothie bowls. Everything is custom made, and the owner is incredibly nice, friendly, and takes the time to explain all the options. The selection is huge, and you can mix and match so many different ingredients, which makes it really special.

At one point, I arrived close to closing time and was desperately craving a smoothie—and he kindly stayed open a bit longer just for me, which I truly appreciated. I used to live in Bali, where smoothie bowls are everywhere, but honestly, nothing beats this one. The texture was perfect, the flavors were amazing, and I still can’t stop thinking about it. Highly, highly recommended. 💭😍🥣

name: Chaiyee Coffee
review_1_text:
Excellent Stay at Chaiyee Coffee!

My stay at Chaiyee Coffee was excellent. I stayed here for about two and half weeks and really don't have anything to complain. The location is perfect, within walking distance of many food markets and just few mins from the famous Sunday Night Market at Thaphae Gate.

The accommodation itself is very clean and well-maintained. I really appreciated the comfortable bed, reliable WiFi, and handy basic kitchen utilities. The owner, Winn, ensured a smooth check-in with clear instructions, and amenities like free towels and room service were great touches.

While it's next to a main road and can be a little noisy in the evening, the sound subsides quickly and was never very disruptive. The shared bathroom was kept very neat.

I highly recommend Chaiyee Coffee for a convenient, comfortable, and well-hosted stay in Chiang Mai!
review_2_text: Great value for money. The room was spacious and clean, the accommodation was cozy, and the location was unbeatable—very close to the night market, where you can eat really well. Highly recommended.
review_3_text:
If I could sign a three- or six-month lease here, I would!
I stayed at Chayinee Coffee during my time in Chiang Mai, and it was genuinely one of the most convenient and comfortable stays I’ve had in the city. The rooms are always impeccably clean, the service is consistently warm and welcoming, and the location couldn’t be better. It’s clear the team here takes great pride in maintaining the space. I only wish they offered long-term stays—I’d absolutely sign up for a monthly contract in a heartbeat. Highly recommend for travelers looking for a calm, cozy spot with great energy and even better hospitality.
review_4_text:
Returned to stay at this place in Chiangmai on 26Dec- 31 Dec 2024 after a superb experience stay with my friends in Nov24.

Excellent location; easy access to amenities. All within walking distances.

Stayed with my 2 kids without any safety issue although I was regretful about my conduct towards Mr Win on the last day.

Mr Win was gracious and generously kind and forgave me. Thank you

Super thumbs up to this hostel.

It was Price, Location, Comfort all stacked in the tenants favor.

Child friendly, I don't know if it's pets friendly because It is just too troublesome to bring your pet overseas.

Nice place, nice people, nice recommendations.

Love it!
review_5_text:
Very nice room in a very good location to experience Chiang Mai. All the amenities you could wish for were available.
Amazing staff, we were able to have a shower the day we checked out, they preserved our towels for us which they absolutely didn't have to do.
Fully recommended!

name: Iron32 Hotel Bar and Bistro
review_1_text: Great location, great staff, everthing is great, location wise is good, walking distance for night bazaar..
review_2_text: We stayed here 3 nights on the top floor. We spent pretty much a whole day drinking on the very spacious patio overlooking the city. The room could get hot, but AC works well. Very clean with modern amenities. The staff is friendly and the restuarant downstairs is tasty and super convenient for breakfast. The location is close walking distance to many things including the night bazaar, restaurants, bars and massage parlours. We really enjoyed our stay here and are really pleased with our selection of Iron32
review_3_text: This hotel was fantastic and clean and comfortable.  The owner was helpful finding us another place to stay as well when we wanted to extend our stay but he was booked solid. Had the green curry chicken for lunch as well and that was also fantastic. This hotel is in a great location with plenty of nightlife as well as authentic shopping from the local market. There is also a great security entrance to the building and rooms as well. This place was all pros and no cons. Would definitely recommend to a friend or family member!
review_4_text: I stayed in the hotel, the room was comfortable and clean. Great location. But being on the main street you get street noise which you can't do anything about it. I also had most of my breakfast /lunch there ,food also good. Very nice and friendly staff. No parking here though. If you rented a car, there might be street parking but don't count on it.
review_5_text:
Loved our stay here at iron 32. We had a party of ten stay here and we had the entire hotel to ourselves. It was a perfect location for us, right around the corner from a busy night market! Everything was walking distance with cute little spots to eat at.

Turbo was amazing host and his staff was extremely friendly. This place was run very well, trustworthy host and staff I might add. The place was extremely clean and well decorated.

Iron 32, won't disappoint! Especially of you have a large group of friends travelling!

name: O.M.G. Coffee
review_1_text:
Last Sunday I went to OMG and had their famous Sunday Roast.  I usually find a meal of this size too much and that is why I haven't had one previously.  Well - it was delicious, and beautifully cooked and served - a truly outstanding meal.  I was well stuffed!

My second review:
Tonight I went along to OMG's third anniversary party.  And, OMG (pun intended) - is it really only three years that OMG has been in Chiang Mai.  It seems so much longer - they have established themselves as a superb restaurant and bar, with many loyal customers.

The food and drinks are excellent, the staff are friendly and efficient, and on top of that, the owners have organized many events to support local charities and orphanages.  Long may they remain a successful bar-restaurant here.

My original review:
OMG - a new pretender to claim the crown of "best fish & chips in Chiang Mai'.

This well positioned site on the eastern corner of Loi Kroh, just prior to the Iron Bridge, has proved a graveyard for previous restaurants, having seen about 3 fail there in the past few years.

I sincerely hope this new one survives; it should. It has been thoroughly modernized and is clean as a new pin. The hostesses are divine and the owners very friendly.

Lots of dining and bar space, the cleanest toilets I've seen in a long while, a pool table, big TV screen and comprehensive menu. One could ask for nothing more.

I would hope to try some of the other dishes, but with 'fish & chips' this good, I won't be having anything else for a while. "OMG" uses only Atlantic cod (as does Kelly's, the previous holder of 'best fish & chips', but that's out of town).

Very highly recommended.
review_2_text:
Went to the restaurant rather than the coffee.
Superb, just superb.
Great staff, service, clean, efficient and the food, so very very good.
The best fish and chips I can imagine here in Chiang Mai.
review_3_text: New and very nicely designed coffee shop and soon restaurant.  Perfect location on the corner with limited motorcycle parking. Excellent coffee with great presentation. Friendly staff and good attention to details. They also have very attractive prices... I will be back
review_4_text: Great mix of food especially for Aussie’s and Brit’s craving some western food. Plus sports bar and pool table
review_5_text: Great quality, well-made coffee and, although I didn’t have it, the Full English looked banging too.

name: GRAPH contemporary
review_1_text:
A vintage yet stylish cafe. You may miss the entrance when u pass by the cafe but it is a different world when u goes in. The cafe is very spacious with 2 floors. The upper floor is without ac, so it can be quite hot.

There many special drinks for this cafe, but the price is quite pricey and the taste is not particularly outstanding.

Good place to chill around or if u wanna try GRAPH as this branch is far less crowded than the other branches of GRAPH.
review_2_text: Just amazing coffee in beautiful surroundings. The menu was so creative and both our drinks were sublime. They have a few branches in the city but this felt the most relaxing and interesting.
review_3_text: Good vibes. Great spacious design. Good, creative coffee. Friendly and helpful staffs. Down side, there’s only 1 mixed toilet which is really annoying. If you want to spend your time here, maybe an hour chat is cool, over the afternoon when things aren’t busy. My personal view, best to take away. Chairs aren’t comfortable. It’s really for quick chat, photos and nicely presented coffee. Still give it 4-star for product quality and services.
review_4_text:
Pricey but unique and delicious coffee.

Perfect air conditioned escape from the outside heat and hidden away from street view behind a wall creating a lovely secret hideaway.

Recommend: Sompetch and Overland (did not disappoint and left us wanting more. Our absolute favourite was the Sompetch).

DON’T Recommend: Greenland and Woodland (they’re nice but not worth the price and are really just desserts in drink form and you can get much better desserts and drinks like this elsewhere for a fraction of the cost).

If I’m not mistaken there are 4 locations around Chiang Mai (we went to 3 locations) so check what is closest to you and you may want to try other locations if one has run out of the flavour you want.
review_5_text: This graph is very cozy. Has a ton of good vibes and very beautiful. Today I had a flat white and it was okay. I think they excel in their specialty drinks, which have always been outstanding!

name: Flo Coffee Brewers
review_1_text: This specialty coffee shop truly lives up to its reputation. With many awards under its belt, the quality of the coffee is excellent — well crafted, flavorful, and clearly made with care. The staff are friendly and knowledgeable, which makes the experience even better. I also loved the space: spacious, comfortable, and open to natural air, making it a great place to relax and enjoy a good cup of coffee. Definitely worth a visit.
review_2_text:
A coffee experience to remember!

The place is all about the coffee. Wide selection of drinks, from standard espresso/americano to pour overs, high end equipment and skilled baristas. You get to choose which beans you want, staff is also super friendly and helpful if you need assistance.

Located 10 mins from Wat Ket Karam, interior is very raw, yet cosy. At the back there are workshops with some wooden sculptures, which makes the experience even more unique.
review_3_text: Amazing coffee omg!! We had the medium and dark roast and both were really good. Finally a good flat white. Prices are not too expensive and the vibes are really cute!
review_4_text: This wonderful cafe is worthy of its awards, and it should get one for its welcoming service too! It really feels like a coffee lab and the antique atmosphere only makes the coffee taste better. Pop in for a cup and stay for two!
review_5_text: An Americano made with lightly roasted beans is priced at 120 THB per cup, which feels a bit expensive compared to the taste. Aside from that, the atmosphere and service are both excellent.

name: สุขพอดี simply happy coffee
review_1_text:
Best coffee shop. Such beautiful atmosphere here, with astonishing trees, great coffee and artists. They have lovely and tender performance here.
I found this magic little place, makes my Sunday happy.
review_2_text:
Good place to get a coffe and relax.

Not ideal for working with laptop cuz no proper sits with charger.

They have a big tree in the garden that make the atmosphere very nice 👍

Coffe not expensive.

Service was great. They are very nice and friendly!
review_3_text:
Nice cafe with small outdoor garden.
Nice place to hang out with friends.
Quite a lot of seats hiding in the garden.
review_4_text: Iced Americano, Honey Aroma Berry Taste. Relaxing Garden Atmosphere makes guests feel  cosy like home. Bakery, Toys, Books and Souvenirs available. The price lit a bit high. This Coffee  Shop, I will be back again.
review_5_text:
Another Chiang Mai cafe gem. Love the name, the place, and the atmosphere. Did not try the coffee but the tea was decent.

They sell books for adults and children as well as cute toys and decor items. But the winner here is absolutely the tasteful blend of greeneries and chill vibe.

Two major points to consider:
1. Mosquitoes
2. Dirty, basic toilet

name: Building A
review_1_text:
A spacious cafe and eatery  located on the second floor. The lower floor is selling clothes and accessories.

The place is spacious and well kept with the antique house style.

I ordered a Matcha Coconut which I preferred Matcha tea powder + Coconut water, but turn out it is Matcha cream top + Coconut water. This makes me a little bit disappointed. They better state it more clearly on the menu.

My second complaint is the toilets are located outside the cafe and is on the ground floor. Toilet paper is not provided which is unusual in Thailand.
review_2_text: Well designed. Old heritage meets modern architecture. Matcha coconut is really nice.
review_3_text: This place is so relaxing and slightly hidden. The only thing I would say is the coffee wasn’t hot enough to my liking but overall a good vibe
review_4_text: Amazing space to eat, chill, relax, meet friends… excellent Thai tea, I’m sure their coffee is great too. Perfect vibes. Loved it!
review_5_text: A unique and pleasant coffee shop hidden on the second floor of an old building. Coffee and a special selection of non-coffee drinks and bakery are offered at a reasonable price. Don’t miss it if you are in Chiangmai. 🤩

name: คัลท์ คาเฟอีน (Cult Caffeine)
review_1_text: The owner only allows employees to serve coffee in single-use cups, said the employee. I do not support a business that chooses to create more waste. The world will benefit from businesses making small choices to reuse instead of throwing out. I hope this invokes positive change. Lots of love.
review_2_text: Cool coffee shop! Cool name! Love the vibe
review_3_text:
Good drinks, but even better vibes! The shop is decorated so beautifully and it’s super peaceful inside. Highly recommend for anyone who loves taking photos.
you'll get amazing shots here.
review_4_text: Perfect spot for coffee. Good service decent coffee n chill ambience. Can work too.
review_5_text: Good spot ✅ good vibes ✅ goor price ✅

name: Love At First Bite
review_1_text: I've been spending my winters in Chiang Mai for over 10 years. This café is everytime a must for me. The coffee, tea, and desserts are simply superb. What I also particularly appreciate is the lovely outdoor seating area. It has a jungle-like garden, a terrace, and a beautiful waterfall, all in a peaceful and relaxed atmosphere. There's also an air-conditioned room. The staff is very friendly and helpful. The real stars are the freshly made desserts. They're among the best in Chiang Mai. So do yourself a favor and stop by for a nice cup of coffee and try a dessert. You won't be disappointed. There's a dedicated parking area.
review_2_text: This is a beautiful little cafe with a large selection of cakes and a smaller menu of delicious main courses. I loved the cheese cake and the chicken dish I ordered here. Definitely a place if looking for a cake too
review_3_text:
A pleasant green oasis in the heart of the city with fantastic staff and a refreshing mist to cool you down on hot days.

It might be a few Baht more expensive than other places, but you get what you pay for.

They serve coffee, smoothies, cakes, pastries, lunch...
review_4_text:
So I ordered online.  I walked in the door, and the ladies working was having a good time💃💃

As soon as I walked into the door, I was met with the display refrigerator holding all the cakes and dessert.

I got the big carrot cake with walnuts. It was worth the 200 baht.
It's worth the value of what you would pay for a single slice.

It tasted so amazing.  😋
I'm a foodie at heart, and I'll be back for that rum bread pudding
review_5_text: The coffee here is very good with A very nice out door seating area.there is also a air-conditioned room if you like.the staff really try to make sure you have everything you need and are quite friendly.plenty of off street parking. But the real stars  are the fresh made deserts. Some of the best in Chiang Mai. So do yourself a favor and stop in for a nice cup of coffee and try a desert. You won't be disappointed.lots of variety to choose from. I would recommend this to a friend.

name: la.moon cold cafe
review_1_text: I got a dirty coffee and seriously, it's the best one in Chiang Mai. I had the best in Shanghai, but this one also has that flavor that changes with every sip. The only thing is the glass should be chilled, the milk should be cold, and the ice is a bit of a problem, but everything else is really well made. I'd totally recommend it.
review_2_text:
The outside of this store doesn't look big.

As a result, I didn't know until I went in that there was another cave.

Three areas are connected together.

It's a spacious cafe in Chiang Mai.

Due to my coffee shop bad habits

I directly ordered medium roasted hot American coffee without thinking.

Test the level of each cafe shop with very basic coffee

It's about 80 points. No surprise there but satisfied

I also ordered Brown Clouds.

Chocolate with vanilla cream

The chocolate is very rich.

Try the signature cold-extracted coffee next time.
review_3_text:
La.moon cold cafe is a pleasantly satisfying spot for coffee lovers. The aroma and flavor of the coffee are both impressive, with a wide range of options to choose from — whether you’re into classic brews or something a bit more adventurous.

Their cakes are a delightful bonus — rich, well-balanced, and clearly made with quality ingredients. The overall vibe is cozy and inviting, making it a great place to relax or catch up with friends.

Highly recommended if you’re looking for a cafe that takes both coffee and dessert seriously.
review_4_text: Wonderful place for coffee lovers - serves classic coffees, six varieties of cold brew, signature coffee and teas. The place is clean, tidy and cozy. The staff is welcoming and friendly. There's a lovely selection of desserts to complement the coffees. The mini croissants are the blast!
review_5_text: Really rich deep flavored coffee, in a very minimalistic but clean white ambient cafe on a corner. I loved how you could choose different types of roasts and the prices were really approachable. Definitely will come back.

name: The Toys Club
review_1_text: Great place for a nerd! You can get a coffee here, play some video games or board games and admire the collection of Japanese pop cultural stuff.
review_2_text: Absolutely loved the vibe at Toy Club Chiang Mai! Fantastic drinks – especially enjoyed trying the [mention KOSAPAN or TENDO if you remember which one you liked better, otherwise keep it general]. The attention to detail, like the perfectly stacked ice
review_3_text: One of the coolest cafes in Chiang Mai that turns into this retro Japanese style bar at night where they're straight up mixing vinyls and serving epic cocktails. You can play you childhoood favorite games in the back and are surrounded by some of the best nostalgic characters in the stands and walls that Japan has to offer. Places like this usually only exist in the movies, we're lucky to have it in real life.
review_4_text: This place makes you travel and go back in time!! Insanely well decorated and there’s also a coffeeshop and a DJ inside, all in one! Everything is there for you to have fun and enjoy the quirky space. Truly unique!
review_5_text: Hidden gem in Chiang Mai. Amazing cocktails, warm service, and surprisingly reasonable prices. Such a perfect find.

name: KUMBO MATCHA
review_1_text: The shop itself is nice and well-designed, but there were lots of customers and not enough tables, which made it a bit uncomfortable. The matcha was okay — enjoyable, but not particularly memorable.
review_2_text: A-Must Try Matcha Cafe on the 2nd floor of Anusarn building, also our first time visiting here☘️ We order Coconut Matcha and Basque Burnt Matcha Cheesecake😋 in which we really love its taste so much cause it's so flavorful and less sweet🍯 The Cafe atmosphere inside is Perfect with the sound of soft music playing🎷and minimal decoration🎨 200% Recommended to absorb the well-balanced in sipping flavorful Matcha beverages amid Comfy atmosphere👍👍👍
review_3_text: Good quality matcha that’s smooth. Calm, low-key space that’s easy to hang out in.
review_4_text: Good matcha but waiting for 30 min after order
review_5_text:
The atmosphere really reminds me of some cafes I've been to in both Taiwan and Japan. Love the design of the place and they really serve amazing matcha!
The only thing that was a letdown was the matcha tiramisu, I felt like it was a rip-off...the portion is way tiny and you have to wait a bit for the ladyfingers(savoiardi) to soften and the taste is really so-so, I don't think it's worth the price.
I'd recommend just going for the drinks as they also have a good selection and made with care.

name: es•pe•cial Coffee Bar
review_1_text: Small beautiful coffee shop but fully of coffee quality. Mostly of Signature menu are served with cold but hot coffee was amazing too. Taste of coffee was really nice that they served with warm water on bronze plate with shop logo. If you have no idea which coffee you want, you can ask for suggestion from staffs.
review_2_text: Very nice coffee. Delicious breakfast
review_3_text: Stunning with the decoration in the café especially the antique Lion Sculpture from India. Light roast arabica coffee beans extracted from one of the hi-end espresso machine brand, La Marzocco. Great coffee. Good vibe and great ambience. Very friendly staff.
review_4_text: My family and I have been traveling the world for 6 months; three of which were in Europe.  We serendipitously discovered this little oasis because we were in the Bridge Hotel (next door and somehow connected) and they served us a latte from es.pe.cial.  It was one of the best lattes in our travels so far and then we were hooked!  Amazing flavor with gourmet beans, very tranquil atmosphere, friendly service, and a cute little garden in back where you can sit and drink your amazing drink. We spent a lot of time hanging out there when we needed to get business/email done.   The internet was good at about 120Mbit/s (I test this everywhere we go :). It is also right next to the Nawarat Bridge, which is a great place to visit along the way.
review_5_text: A wonderful little coffee shop! This coffee shop has extremely tasty and innovative coffee you’ll be hard-pressed to find anywhere else. I am so happy I came here! The barista behind the counter was really happy and friendly, and the shop is decorated very well. I got the Fig Me Up cold brew coffee, and it had actual figs inside, alongside some other interesting syrups that made it so, so good! Definitely one of the most unique (and best) cold coffee drinks I have ever had! I can’t wait to go back and try all of the others. So many looked incredible. Awesome place; highly recommend!!

name: ร้านกาแฟ McClanahan
review_1_text: McClanahan Coffee Cafe features unique decor, as it was converted from an old hospital or operating room. This unexpected, clean setting is quite interesting and makes the cafe a memorable place to enjoy excellent coffee.
review_2_text: Here is calm and comfortable Cafe next to ChiangMai Community Church, end of Nawarat bridge. We are here twice caused it's not too far from the hotel we stay. We order non-coffee beverages like Iced Creamy Coco Matcha 🍸 and White Peach Apple Tea🍹both are so flavourful and aromatic😋There're several corners within the Cafe for us to choose 🪑🍽️ 🚙🌳🌲100% Recommended if you like Cafe which is not in the popular lists, not too crowded but feeling Relax and Silently Happy ☘️💚
review_3_text:
mcclanahan -

Just a few months in business as of March 2023, the lovely renovated building is like two coffee places in the same location. Downstairs and upstairs. I like them both. Not really a coffee guru, can't really say how good it is. If I pay a bit over 100 baht for a signature drink, it's still mainly for their pleasant ambience, cool air, and friendly staff. Pay a visit and enjoy the old photos and the historical feel of the place.
review_4_text: Drinks are good and coffee delicious. This place has the best barista material in the town. Coffee shop so clean and relaxing as well. Big free parking in the garden behind the store. This place is definitely a gem ❤️
review_5_text: I really like the atmosphere, good coffee, good dessert and nice interior. This is a good place to chill with friends. It has a car park

name: DÉJÀ Brew Café and Gallery
review_1_text:
What a hidden gem!

I came here to do some light work but ended up staying a couple of hours and I didn't even notice. The place is so warm and inviting. Amazing staff, great drinks, good cookies and 100MBs internet.

What more can you ask for 10/10
review_2_text: Very cool cafe and gallery-a place of style and substance. Serious art and superb coffee etc in an uber stylish setting. Located just outside the city center. Great place to chill away from the throngs of people in cm. My new favorite spot.
review_3_text: Flash back memories when it was still a wooden house.  Wondered the cafe name is after the owner’s name.   Fragrance hot latte and delicious cold latte in a nice vacuumed glass.  Friendly staff.  Pet friendly is a big bonus.  We need to keep the area clean.
review_4_text: Great space for an afternoon coffee. There’s a gallery behind the coffee shop that is worth checking out as well. They hold art events and presentations. They’ve also got a tattoo studio with a great artist and Airbnb on the property. Very English friendly and worth checking out 👍🏼
review_5_text: I really like this place!! I like some artworks in this gallery and the coffee is great!! :) If you are interested in art, and If you are traveling in Chiangmai, you have to come here! :)

name: ตี๋นมสด Tee Nom Sod 小弟鲜奶
review_1_text: Toast with cream and grated custard. The amount of whip cream was excessive, but the combination off eggy custard and toast is really good
review_3_text: love toast sweet milk
review_4_text: This local milk bread shop serves delicious bread at affordable prices. Parking might be a little difficult. Their Milo toast and milk cocoa are particularly tasty.
review_5_text: I really like eating at this shop. The green tea has a real tea aroma. I like the bread, milk, butter, Milo, and whipped cream. But I have to criticize the staff. They treat me like I'm asking for free food. They treat me like a beggar. But overall, I like it. ^^

name: P E A N U T . P A T T E R Cafe
review_1_text: We waited there for out train and it was the perfect spot. Very reasonably priced, good wifi, clean toilet. We ordered the signature coffee drink and later a cocoa and thai tea and all three drinks really tasted sooo good. Absolutely recommend stopping by!
review_2_text: Google maps says its open today from 8am.  Im standing in front of the cafe at 10.15am and its closed.  Typical.
review_3_text: Just outside of the Chiang Mai train station. Fantastic drinks at more than reasonable prices. The environment is great for getting some work done before catching a train. The toilet is very clean.
review_4_text:
Comfortable place to chill on a hot afternoon.
3mins walk to the train station
review_5_text: Such a vibe here 😌 I like this café so much.

name: Roastniyom Exclusive เจริญเมือง
review_1_text:
Excellent Ethiopian light roast oatmilk iced latte!! Several beans to choose from.

Very friendly staff.

Great light & airy work space downstairs and up with a large meeting room.

Falang approved!

Short walk from train station.
review_2_text:
Cool spot, delicious coffee, good ambiance.

Well made Flat White served with a fresh flakey almond croissant.

Great spot for pictures.  During the day they have fantastic natural light.
review_3_text: One of the hidden place in Chiangmai. Recommend to visit. Good coffee taste. Good design space and friendly. Multifunctional cafe. Backyard was so nice. You can have a time to rest or work here.
review_4_text: Well decorate the shop both inside and outside.  There are many types of coffee beans to choose from.  mid price  The overall atmosphere is fine.
review_5_text:
I’ve only tried the premium matcha late for 135 baht. It was decent. Hard to get a tasty matcha that actually taste like matcha — pleasantly surprised.

Would come back if in the area.

name: DWBH
review_1_text:
The place has prominent use of steel, concrete and glass. With unique art pieces for furnishings.

They offer mostly espresso based coffee drinks with creatice concoctions.

Popular with the locals for pick up and delivery.
review_2_text: We just walk in on our walk from train station and it was the best decision. The atmosphere and designe of café is really modern. The service is amazing, nice gentleman behind counter gave us description of their beverage options depending on what we wanted. The coffees were really tasty, croissants and croffle were delicious. I truly recommend to step in if you nearby. There is no toilet in the building but we were told we could use one across the street.
review_3_text:
Great coffee and very nice and modern place. Found it in our way from the station, took a break, charged our phones and relaxed. The lazy Monday drink is soooooo good.

They speak well and replied to some of our Thai questions. The lady offered to take a picture of the two of us together :)

Thank you!
review_4_text:
Cool place.
I like Dirty Latte, they call it a Lazy Latte for 70 baht. Okay. I am alright with that.
Might have a club feel if your imagination is wide, broad and unfocused like mine.
The seats (concrete) won’t let your hard a** get no relief but you are a busy person so that should be a minor thing. A minor thing when you consider all the other real problems sprouting up in your life at this very moment.

I recommend this coffee shop for a few air conditioned, caffeinated moments.

Go get em’ champ!
review_5_text: Absolutely delicious - their Brazilian/Thai bean espresso is a perfect blend with milk. We got the piccolo, espresso, and an americano & would definitely come again! Not many big tables, but a perfect chill/photo spot & DELICIOUS coffee offerings!

name: Limsakdakul Sanpakoi
review_1_text: Vibrant meeting place. Interesting art and antiques at the back of the cafe.
review_2_text: Best coffee in town, period 👍
review_3_text: Good place, friendly people.
review_4_text:
A coffee shop that blends the charm of Chiang Mai's past, with a familiar and nostalgic feel. Good vibe, good coffee.
There are photo opportunities for social media check-ins.

It was quite crowded the day I went; all the tables were full, even from the front of the shop. It's becoming a trend, so I recommend visiting in the morning.

Street parking is only available until 3 PM; otherwise, your car will be towed.
review_5_text: The shop is cute and very stylishly decorated. There are many photo spots, a corner for collectibles and antiques, and a cute shop inside. The coffee here is really good, fragrant and delicious. The only downside is that there are a lot of tourists, so you might have to wait a bit for your partner. Take the opportunity to walk around and take photos while waiting, but it's worth it.

name: F Cafe cnx
review_1_text:
Good friendly cafe out of touriat area. Walking towards the train station and stumbled upon this nice quaint cafe! Coffee is good, iced americano for only 40 bahts, good flavor and a good courteous customer service with a smile!! Highly recommended 👌
Scale 1-10:
Food/drink-9
Price-10
Service-9
Atmosphere-8
Cleanliness-9
review_2_text:
Passed it on our way, and happy that we decided to go in for a matcha.
They are using a nice quality powder, making it from scratch and you can have it with oat milk.
If you love matcha, then this is your place 😉
And btw, it's very affordable
review_3_text: Our first coffee in Chiang Mai and also the best! It is definitely worth a stop!
review_4_text: best damn cup of capuccino i had in chiang mai. 40 baht a pop. perfectly balanced ratio of coffee to milk. prestine 5/5
review_5_text: Nice place with a great coffee. They use 100% arabica dark rost. Highly recommend for hipsters especially:)

name: Minimal coffee Sanpakoi
review_1_text:
Delicious coffee drinks at this always reliable chain of coffee shops.

Great break before or after shopping at San Pa Koi Market.   Large picture window is great for people watching at this popular market.
review_2_text: The strength is the coffee, the weakness is the service. I never have high expectations because it's always the same every time I come here. 😅
review_3_text: What a great find. I'll definitely be back. 45 baht hot latte with a choice of light, medium or dark roasted coffee grown here in Thailand. Friendly staff, great seating indoors and out.
review_4_text: Good quality for affordable price coffee. 😍
review_5_text: Delicious cappuccino, friendly service, great prices and atmosphere.

name: Pour&Purr Home cafe
review_1_text: Excellent coffee with local beans roasted by the owner on site.
review_2_text: A small but very nice café. Owned by someone who moved from Bangkok to Chiang Mai, and it shows. It has a great urban feel. Really good music. Beautiful decor. Very friendly, open-minded people. Great homemade coffee and iced tea.
review_3_text: Good coffee with a well-rounded flavor. Coffee lovers shouldn't miss this place. The owner is cute, friendly, and speaks politely. The atmosphere is chill and cute. I highly recommend it. ☕🍵 The green tea is also well-rounded and delicious. ☺️
review_4_text: This is a very cozy shop. The owner is lovely and friendly. The coffee is incredibly delicious, and most importantly, the price is very reasonable – you can afford to drink it every day. Don't hesitate, come here, it's amazing!
review_5_text: The shop just opened. The coffee is delicious and the price is very good. There is no parking but you can order through delivery.

name: Bus Coffee
review_1_text: A very cute little coffee shop, where we got to drink delicious coffee each morning for a few days 😌 Best coffee in town for a fair price! Very friendly and warmhearted owners - you should definitely try them out! ☀️
review_2_text:
25B for coffee latte. (Actually it seems everything is 25B)

This is a home cafe, nice.

It’s cozy and relax, and coffee is good.

Good to come and enjoy.
review_3_text:
Nice change of pace.

Refreshing blue lemon soda.  Crispy and delicious seeded cookies.

No smoking.
review_4_text:
Great coffee,friendly staff well worth a visit coffee 25 Baht
Now they only do takeaway drinks.
Still good quality coffee at a reasonable price and nice owners.
review_5_text: Friendly staff,  cheap local coffee place with good Gaffey(coffee in Thai) Could use a better fan system and a toilet

name: อินไวทช์คาเฟ่เชียงใหม่
review_1_text:
My boyfriend and I absolutely love this café in Chiang Mai!
The lemon soda and cakes are excellent.
He orders them all the time, haha.
You can’t go wrong with anything on the menu.

It’s a clean, delicious, and affordable café.
Truly the best café in Chiang Mai!✨✨
review_2_text: In the same compound as the Otteri laundry place, the cafe & bakery newcomer on the block (about 4 months old) offers affordable cofffee and non-coffee drinks plus great smoothies as well as home-made cake. Seats available both inside (air-conditioned) and outside. Closed Mondays.
review_3_text: We ended up here by chance, as we tried  to go to a nearby place but it was closed. Very nice surprise and very nice coffee place! Great cakes and frappes! Recommended.
review_4_text: Great lychee soda! Went to do laundry and saw they were still open at 6 pm which was nice to stay cool while our clothes became clean
review_5_text:
Everything was great, but I'd like to suggest fixing the cake box. It wasn't securely packed, making it very easy for the cake to be damaged.
The cake arrived upside down; please fix that.
From the rider: Instead of receiving payment, I ended up losing money on that, so the rider didn't actually receive the cake.

name: น.อนุสรณ์ กาแฟนวล
review_1_text:
Coca cola collectors will love this coffeeshop . Cabinets full of coke and other soda cans.

Simply seating but good vibes overall

Parking : Kerbside only

Seating : indoor , non- air-conditioned
review_2_text: Stumbled into this coffee shop while exploring this street. It’s looks so unassuming but once you step inside, it’s like a Coca Cola museum 😂 delicious coffee at half the price charged by other hipster coffee places in town (40 THB for a great cup of hot latte) and even though I didn’t get to try any of the pastries, they were all decently priced and looks delicious. Owner is friendly too!
review_3_text: Cozy neighborhood coffee shop with classic vibes. Good coffee at great prices, this shop is like a small step back in time. Nice to sit outside and watch the street go by, and if I lived in the neighborhood I imagine I'd come here often. Owners are very friendly. Some small pastries available.
review_4_text: Really nice atmos. The owners are super sweet. Coffee is great. Recommended!!!
review_5_text: good coffee at affordable prices. fun collections of books and stuff to look at and bring back the old days to my mind.

name: LA-MOON COFFEE
review_1_text: Amazing service and great coffee, the Italian sodas are so refreshing. A gem of a coffee stop, we kept going back while in Chiang Mai
review_2_text: Very nice coffee. And very friendly people.
review_3_text: The orange coffee is delicious. The seller is very pretty.

name: โซบาร์
review_1_text: Just visit during weekday
review_2_text: This was fantastic! My train was at 9:35, and I arrived by motorcycle taxi at 9:31. Immediately, a staff member asked if I was taking the 9:35 train, directed me to the counter to buy a ticket, and showed me which vehicle to take, ensuring I caught the train on time. The service was amazing!
review_3_text: OK
review_4_text: Cool, relaxed

name: Half.cnx
review_1_text: Nice spot for coffee with a view of the park
review_2_text: Good vibes, but coffee is not really good. and seats are not comfort
review_3_text: Feeling good
review_4_text:
This shop is very clever in its marketing and advertising. The facade facing the garden is illuminated with striking orange lights.
Great location near the garden entrance/exit.
Beautiful view.
The drinks are okay.
The decor uses raw materials, exposing the surfaces of the old building.
There are air-conditioned rooms on the 1st and 2nd floors.
The 3rd floor is open air.
This was a shop I visited at the perfect time.
You can scan to view the menu before entering.
And you can scan to order drinks.
review_5_text:
Who would have thought there'd be such a great cafe next to Chiang Mai train station! This is 𝗛𝗮𝗹𝗳.𝗰𝗻𝘅. I love the cool design of the cafe. It's a three-story building with a raw, loft-style feel, but when the large windows open, you get a full view of the lush green railway park. The atmosphere is airy and spacious; it's very relaxing and not at all cramped. 😌🌿

For those who love taking photos, 𝗛𝗮𝗹𝗳.𝗰𝗻𝘅 has tons of chic spots. The coffee is good, the pastries are delicious, and it's perfect for working or just taking a break in the afternoon. This is another must-visit spot in Chiang Mai that I highly recommend everyone experience! ☺️💓

Hard to believe there’s such a vibe right next to the Chiang Mai Railway Station! 𝗛𝗮𝗹𝗳.𝗰𝗻𝘅 is a stunning 3-story industrial loft that perfectly balances its raw, edgy design with the lush, green views of the Railway Park. The space is so airy and open—definitely a place where you can just sit back and breathe. 😌🌿

For all the photographers out there, this place is a goldmine for cool shots. The coffee is top-notch, the treats are delicious, and it’s the ideal spot to get some work done or just enjoy a quiet afternoon. If you’re in Chiang Mai, you’ve got to check this one out! ☺️💗

name: Minimal Coffee - สถานีรถไฟ
review_1_text: Great modern coffeebar with super friendly staff.
