review_2_text: Solid cup of Joe. Chill vibes, good spot to kill a little time if you're catching/getting off a bus around the corner, and want some good coffee and some AC.
review_3_text: Good coffee, lovely and friendly staff. Great place to exercise at the train park and then chill out afterwards. Perfect!
review_4_text: After getting off the train, I went straight to drink coffee and immediately turned on my computer to work. I remember it used to be a small shop, but now it's become very big.
review_5_text:

This cafe is open early, which is great (7:00 AM - 4:00 PM), but I'm a little disappointed that it closes a bit early.

name: Bogie Coffee Bar

review_3_text: The coffee is good and delicious, and the atmosphere is nice and relaxing.

name: VOLKS charoenmuang : bagels and coffee
review_1_text: I stumbled upon this place on a quick run to my school. I tried their americano - on the lighter side. But my favorite was the blueberry bagel with strawberry cream cheese. Everything was so delicious and a cute cozy shop to explore for breakfast in chiang mai
review_2_text: I love this amazing BLT bagel sandwich with egg added. Highly recommend!!!
review_3_text: “very friendly service and good breakfast/ brunch options” 🥰🥰
review_4_text: Wide variety of bagels with a unique texture. The crust is crunchy while the airy and chewy interiors make Volks bagels a great way to start your day. Limited seating for the pop up format.
review_5_text: Amazing Bagles in city 🤤

name: BIG Body Coffee เจริญเมือง
review_1_text: The best coffeeshop
review_2_text: One of my favorite coffee shop 🥰 great coffee here!
review_3_text: Good coffee and very friendly barista / owner
review_4_text:
I just visited BIG Body Coffee for the first time, and I can say that I was impressed from the moment I stepped inside. 💛

The shop is small but very cute. The atmosphere is warm and professional, yet not too formal. The walls are lined with SCA certificates. You can tell the baristas here aren't just playing around with coffee. ☕

I ordered an iced Americano in Omkoi—it was incredibly fragrant and had a full body, truly living up to the name "Big Body." 👍

The counter has a selection of coffee beans, including Nicaragua, Kenya, and Honduras. Perfect for coffee lovers who love to try new things. Every cup seems to have its own story.

Overall, this shop is incredibly attentive to every detail: the coffee, the atmosphere, and the decor.
If you enjoy good coffee with a touch of dedication, I highly recommend you give it a try. ❤️
review_5_text: A cute coffee shop with a selection of specialty coffee beans. The prices are very good and the quality is also very good. The owner is a roaster with a lot of knowledge and experience about coffee.

name: La Leng Kaffee
review_1_text: Look around the tiny little place and you can tell from all those coffee-related paraphernalia that they are serious about their hsnd roasted coffee. Very good coffee. Don't be surprised by non-coffee stuff. The place sells motorcycle spare parts on ebay. So I've heard.
review_2_text: It was fun to help you make your own coffee, and the taste was amazing! Above all, the cozy atmosphere and the owner were pleasant and friendly. It was the best :-)
review_3_text:
Coffee shop near Chiang Mai train station.

The coffee beans are roasted by hand, ground fresh for you, and the service is outstanding.

The coffee has a flavor that will surprise you.
review_4_text: Good coffee, hand-roasted.

name: วรพงษ์ กราฟฟิค
Sally's (Sandwich, Breakfast and Bakery)
review_1_text:
Beautiful scrambled eggs on sourdough toast, you can make your own breakfast so it’s good for vegetarians.
Nice chilled vibe and quiet music.
Yogurt is also very tasty.
review_2_text: It was amazing 😊 I love this cafe, my favorite kind of cafe. Clean, calm, nice atmosphere. They have a lot of options from western to thai and diy, price is reasonable, as a big breakfast like this in Bangkok can be like 350b. And it taste really good too!
review_3_text: This is a nice cafe for a delicious breakfast. I’ve visited many times for their signature Sally’s breakfast. The staff is super friendly and welcoming. The atmosphere is cozy and quiet. Their menu offers plenty of options to choose from. I also appreciated that they accept card payments, which is convenient since many places in the area are cash-only.
review_4_text: The Greek yoghurt was amazing! ordered it again. No added sugar, thick and creamy.
review_5_text: Wow the sourdough on toast was great super fresh and tasty beautiful eggs and great coffee and homemade Greek yogurt

name: Black Single Coffee Bar
review_1_text: A fantastic little coffee shop run by two talented baristas. I’ve been coming here for years, but I’ve never written a review before, this place deserves a good one. The guys that run this place have great taste, and take a lot of pride in giving you the best possible coffee at a very reasonable price.. what more could you ask for? I like a hot cappuccino and theirs is perfect for 55 baht. Most places charge almost 100 baht for a cappuccino that doesn’t measure up to theirs. These guys  take great pride in their work and it’s a pleasure to see and an even greater pleasure to taste their coffee. The atmosphere is nice, they played great music, but the coffee is the main reason for visiting this establishment. Give B.S.C a try, you won’t be disappointed.
review_2_text: Small place, good vibe, and great price. Most important, the coffee was delicious! Another place to add to my list of Chiang Mai coffee shops to return to
review_3_text: With only one week in Chiang Mai I set out to see and try new coffee shops but by day two I stumbled upon Black Single Coffee and fell in love with this beautiful little shop! The shop itself is smaller but maturely decorated, with unique black and white decor, a cozy but refreshing environment! The owner works daily to craft and design delicious, affordable, and beautiful coffee!!! No better way to start a morning then with a sunrise walk, adorable latte art, bible study, and a welcoming smile from our wonderful barista!!! The coffee itself is delicious and carefully crafted to perfection! If you’re looking for a sweet coffee this isn’t it, but if you want a genuinely amazing drink this is the place! The latte art is truly incredible and always brought a smile to my face, I’ll be admiring it forever! Thank you so much Pan for a lovely week of coffee and smiles!!!! 🤎☕️
review_4_text: This coffee shop provides an outstanding informative experience. The bartista provides you with 3 different coffee bean roasts to choose from. He will share a little taste and flavor information and you can select your bean.  You can also mix beans.  The dude who works here is pretty charming and it is nice to watch him chat about his passion. I recommend this coffee shop. There is No legal car parking here.
review_5_text:
This is a very popular coffee shop in Chiang Mai with the locals and tourists.
The vibe in this cafe is so cool. The decor is spot on. 👌
This is the kind of place you just want to sit and chill.

The seating is limited on the inside.  There is also seating on the outside.
The Barista is the skills. I was so impressed with his pour. It tasted great as well. He I the best Barista I've seen in my travels.  The menu for the coffee was great.

review_2_text: Nice staff,  good drink

review_5_text: Great coffee! ,Excellent service and a really good price.

name: Roasto - รสโต
review_1_text: I'm writing this review solely for the owners of this cafe and hotel, as I understand that Chiang Mai's tourism and hospitality industries have been struggling for the past years due to various reasons, covid, flood, negative news, etc. This cafe is affiliated with the hotel, and I happened to pass by and stopped in for coffee and breakfast. The cafe and hotel are beautiful, with a lovely atmosphere. The hot latte was good, and the set breakfast was regular and okay. However, when I picked up the strawberry jam to spread on my bread, I noticed it was opened and a corner had been eaten. I assumed it was recycled, presumably the last customer hadn't eaten it, but actually he/she did. I handed it to the staff, who immediately replaced it from the kitchen without even a word of apology. In my opinion, this is a serious management issue. I hope the owners will take note and make improvements. After all, such a beautiful cafe and hotel, I wish it'll have good business.

name: The Baristro Asian Style
review_1_text:
Baristro Chiang Mai is a beautiful café with a Zen garden concept and several seating zones to choose from. It’s quite popular, so it can be crowded, but the atmosphere is still pleasant.

There’s an entrance fee, but it can be used as a discount for drinks and desserts, which feels fair. They also currently offer a wide selection of matcha, along with a good variety of drinks and desserts, making it a nice spot for café lovers.

Parking is convenient with plenty of spaces available. It’s also a very photogenic place, popular with both Thai visitors and international travelers.
review_2_text:
This place is huge and features a beautiful Japanese-style garden. It was super crowded when I visited, likely because it coincided with the Chiang Mai University graduation. The crowd was a mix of teenagers and office workers, so it was quite bustling and not very peaceful. Luckily, my group managed to find a seat just in time!

There is an 80 THB entrance fee, but you can use the ticket as a discount for food and drinks inside.

The prices are standard for a cafe, and everything tasted good. The staff were friendly and provided great service. Since it was so busy, the drinks were served in order, so you might have to wait a bit. Overall, a lovely spot—just be prepared for the crowd on busy days!
review_3_text:
I have a suspicion that places like Baristro Asian Style are built mainly with the Instagram and influencer crowd in mind. Even so, it’s hard not to be impressed by this one. The entire place — the architecture, the garden, the layout — feels as if you’ve been transported straight to Japan. It’s a coffee and tea lounge that genuinely creates a sense of calm and serenity, and it’s a real pleasure to be there, at least when it’s not busy or overrun by people taking selfies.
We were lucky on the day we visited and found it relatively quiet, which made the experience much more enjoyable. What ultimately matters, though, is that the coffee is good. A nicely made cappuccino for 85 baht, enjoyed in such beautiful and peaceful surroundings, makes this a worthwhile trip out of town.
review_4_text: Great environment, seats at indoor and outdoor. Salted caramel cheesecake is a surprise for me, salted caramel lava in the middle of the cheesecake. Macha crepe cake is nice too, not very sweet just nice. Macha is best to drink it when it is still warm. Black coconut, is espresso with coconut juice and fresh instead of coconut milk, maybe coconut milk is better, to provide a little bit of saltiness and sweetness and with the bitterness of espresso. It is good to come early in the morning if you would like to avoid the crowds.
review_5_text: A very nice Japanese garden in Chiang Mai with a relaxing, laid-back atmosphere. The beautiful architecture really made for an enjoyable visit. The green tea served was rich and flavorful. The entry fee is 80 Baht, which can be fully redeemed against the cost of a drink. While the prices might be a bit high, the overall experience and vibe are certainly worth it.

I like stopping by here because of the donuts. Homemade, old school type with some meat to it rather than a modern-day airy light one. They're not special on their own but in the atmosphere of this bright yellow space, it feels special🌻
review_2_text: Great little cafe with such lovely and kind staff. During my stay in Chiang Mai I visited the cafe every morning for iced coffee and donuts and everything was perfection. The vibe is cosy and homely, I felt very comfortable inside.
review_3_text: a cozy place with a very nice owner who makes you feel welcome :) the donut and the drink were absolutely amazing, 200% recommend this place !!

review_5_text: So delicious!!! The cafe latte medium is incredibly fragrant! Hahahaha, I'm ready to ditch the coffee at our college and buy it here instead.

name: LUBE - Coffee & Special Drinks
review_1_text:
Lube Coffee Shop in Chiang Mai is an absolute gem nestled atop a picturesque hill, offering breathtaking views of a lush canopy of trees. This spot instantly transports you to a serene haven, making it the perfect place to unwind. My Monday morning visit was nothing short of delightful—sipping on a beautifully crafted coffee while gazing out over the greenery was a calming and rejuvenating experience.

The personal touch of having a heartfelt "thank you" message handwritten on the coffee lid added a thoughtful, warm touch that made me feel genuinely appreciated. The attention to detail, welcoming ambiance, and gorgeous natural setting make Lube Coffee Shop a must-visit for anyone looking to slow down and soak in some tranquility. Highly recommended!
review_2_text: reasonable price with great quality and atmosphere.
review_4_text: quite and peaceful
review_5_text: This cute coffee shop has a great feel-good atmosphere and plenty of photo spots. They also have mini cheese boards at cute prices. I really like it! 🧀🥞🥓

name: LingKung Jungle - ลิงกังจังเกิ้ล
Tantou Cha (ทันโตชา) - สาขาหลังมช.
THE VOLCANO หลัง มช.
review_1_text: The café has a lovely atmosphere, with a simple yet beautifully designed space. Both the drinks and the pocket cheese toast are delicious and made with high-quality ingredients.
review_2_text:
I've had The Volcano toast a few years ago in Bangkok but only recently found out that it's a Chiang Mai original! I love their cheese toast - legit has a pull to it (see pic) and the cheese is not sweet.

This branch has plenty of seating on the second floor - on each of my visits so far it was quite empty. Some tables have plug outlets. Some tables are designed to link with the table next to them so it was rather annoying to sit by someone who kept shaking the entire structure. There are some simple board games free to use.

The staff here are mostly young, don't speak English much, but are super friendly and accommodating.

Toilets are outside communally shared with other restaurants, so ask for a key from the cashier to avoid paying.
review_3_text: Abit old and outdated . Sort of reminds of a kids playroom in some way . Food was okay but ice cream had no flavour at all.
review_4_text:
We really enjoyed our toasts! Nice and fun to eat!!! The prices are not expensive. Seatings are nice.

Parking along side the road. Not limited space but quite a lot of cars too. Must try your luck.

Bathrooms available outside of the shop. Not that clean though.
review_5_text:
I visited Volcano to enjoy our family's favorite dessert.
I always went to Volcano in Central Airport, and this was our first time visiting there. First, it's on the second floor, so if you order on the first floor and wait at the table on the second floor, they bring you food.
When they're busy, you'll have to look at the electronic display and go down to pick it up yourself.
The second floor is very hot because it only has one air conditioner.
The weather is so hot these days that it feels hot. It's cool to sit in the direction of the air conditioner.
Volcano cheese toast and chocolate toast are always so delicious, and the staff were really friendly and so kind.

Really good iced Thai tea and latte.
The quantity is smaller but it's not diluted down by 50% ice.
Rich, smooth dreamy caffeine experience.

If you sit behind the barista it is a quieter place. You can watch the road and people go by from the front, although noisy.
review_4_text:
I’ve been coming here every morning for many weeks, and I can honestly say that Fav.Coffee Roaster is by far the best coffee in the hood.

The super friendly staff makes every visit a delight, and the nice atmosphere provides the perfect setting to start my day. The quality of the coffee and the warm vibe of the place have truly made an impression on me—I will miss it when I have to move on.

Highly recommended for anyone looking for a top-notch coffee experience!
review_5_text:
Wonderful little coffee joint in Suthep. Great coffee and vibe. Defo be back.

Just off the roadside, so can chill and watch the world go by.

name: Catopia Chiangmai
review_1_text: The lady running the place is really nice but I'm afraid it's my least favorite cat cafe so far. I wish they could make more money though to improve the place. They have under 10 cats, Persians and Thai cats. It's more like someone's house and they opened to visitors as long as you buy a drink. But the place is quite old and a bit too small for the amount of cats, I think.
review_2_text: Came here to relax in the A/C and pet some very beautiful Thai cats.  Had a blueberry smoothie, was good!  Nice place for travellers and locals alike to chill.
review_3_text: Poor cats. They look sick. Some of them have infections. They pee on the floor which is unusual to be seen like that. And the food is everywhere on the floor.
review_4_text: Tried coming twice and they were closed during hours they say they are open. Don’t waste your time and money to come here. This isn’t a business.
review_5_text: Good selection of cats, kept us entertained for a solid hour.

name: A Peace Of Cake's Baking Studio
333 MiNi House
review_1_text:
We really enjoyed our stay here!

The location is super convenient — few kms away to CMU and Ang Kaew Reservoir, which became our favorite spot for peaceful morning runs. It’s also close to the starting point of the Monk’s Trail. Near Lang Mor Night Market, so we had plenty of food options around. Even though it’s close to everything, the area is tucked away from the main road, so it’s quiet and relaxing.

The room was cozy with a big comfy bed and Netflix for lazy nights in. The bathroom is separate but still private because of the partition, so it wasn’t an issue at all. And huge thanks to Adel, the host — very responsive and helpful from start to finish.

Overall, it’s a great place to stay if you want comfort, convenience, and calm vibes in Chiang Mai!
review_2_text: The bed sheets are very comfortable and clean. TV can watch Netflix. Downstairs had coffee and bread and biscuits. Owner is very nice
review_3_text: The owner is lovely, the bedroom is very comfortable, just like home, very relaxing, the air conditioning is cool, and there's Netflix 🤍
review_4_text: The room was clean and the bed was comfortable. The hallway wasn't very soundproof, but the price was good. It was good value for money.
review_5_text: The room was clean. The owner was very helpful and took care of us like we were at home. We even got to eat seasonal lychees. There was a sitting area on the first floor with Wi-Fi and a TV. I will definitely come back again.

name: Monday Cafe
review_1_text: The coffee shop has been turned into a place to stay.
review_2_text: Colorful cafe with nice drinks near the Chiang Mai university.
review_3_text: Very chill out place. Good 360 view of doi suthep good and delicious menu of coffee. friendly weed smoking zone
review_4_text: It's a lovely cafe with several antique cars. It's beautiful to take pictures.
review_5_text: Good

name: Early Bird Korean Study Cafe
review_1_text: Very good study&work environment in Chiangmai if you think your hotel is too cold. Not many people there so it’s very quiet. The drink and service are all very nice. Internet is also good. Toilet is clean
review_2_text: Wonderful place to study with 3 floors and many tables! Would recommend 🥰
review_3_text:
Really impressive. Had i found this place sooner id be here all day while i stayd in chiangmai.
Havent felt this kind of vibe since i was a little kid in korea. The atmosphere is designed so that you can zone in and focus. If you cant focus here theres gotta be something wrong with you. Very clean too
Coffee is cheap and there are no people at the moment on early Saturday morning . There are three stories w ac and bathsrooms n lights n everything i wonder how they afford to pay rent n utilities because coffees relatively cheaper than other cafes too. Maybe its the location idk but one of the hidden gem for cafe bug digital nomad like me .
review_4_text:
The shop was under renovation and closed for a long time but now the shop is open again recently, from 11 am to 11 pm.
This shop is good for those who want to study.
Students can get some benefits from the shop though I don't remember what they are(Because I am not a student).
Somebody posted the menu but it is incorrect(A cup of coffee doesn't cost 80 baht!)
No music was played in the second floor(Good for people who want to study).
review_5_text: So fine, to study

name: Coffee77
review_1_text: One of my default coffee shops around the neighborhood to chill at mostly due to its quietness and decent coffee. Open air seating within a garden. During the day when it doesn't rain it's comfortable under the shades but inside or towards late afternoon there's definitely mosquitoes abound. Toilet cleanliness could be better.
review_2_text: Cute covered outdoor cafe.  Babe got an Iced Caramel milk and I got an Apple tea and they were both so delicious
review_3_text:
short review:
Excellent coffee a normal price, good cookies and chill vibe setting, don't miss this!

They offer 3 types specialty coffee in light, medium, and medium-dark roast.
For your milk based coffee they also have oat milk.
I tried the medium roast in espresso and it's a great acidic entry for anyone who wants to try something different, come and see how espresso can be something else than plain bitterness and dry after taste.
Good coffee beans is great, but they know how to pull a shot correctly, and espresso enthusiasts know it's not about pressing a button on an expensive machine.

As usual, not much food to go with it but they have exceptionally good cookies almond or chocolate, don't let their look fool you these are dense!
The pricing is really friendly too, usually this type places charge you "specialty money coffee" , and the setting is their garden with tables laying around, chill jazz music..

The street still has some traffic but very slow paced, not a major route so I'd consider this a chill place for South Asia 😅
review_4_text: Very cosy and quiet coffee shop with affordable coffee and different kinds of roasts. Nice surroundings. Highly recommended!
review_5_text: Really good coffee. Breakfast was ok, nice people.

name: Roslamoon Coffee - กาแฟรสละมุน
review_1_text: Great little coffee spot. Friendly staff, fair priced and tasty coffee.
review_2_text:
My Thai milk tea is very good.
It’s a small store with some chairs and tables.
In the morning there are many people come to buy take away drinks so I have to wait a bit long.
It’s cute that the staff writes ‘have a nice day’ on the cup.
review_3_text: Picked up Thai tea here. The quality of the drink was great, but I waited for 20+ minutes to get my drink.
review_4_text: Lovely place, great coffee and music. You can use as working place.
review_5_text: Friendly, Comfy, Chit chat with friends

name: temp.cnx
review_1_text: Here's another newly opened cafe near my house that I'd like to recommend. It's a nice place to sit, with a relaxed atmosphere, delicious desserts, and great drinks. I'll try the food next time and write a more detailed review.😊
review_2_text: nice place, very spacious and comfortable. the food is very good, especially the beef fried rice. such a memorable experience. there are also a lot of parking spaces.
review_3_text: Coffee is good. Atmosphere is so cool as well. The staff is nice. There is parking lot. The price is reasonable. Just come👍
review_4_text: Great coffee and brunch menus. Reviewers mention quality food and friendly service.
review_5_text:
Super friendly staff with great service.
Tasty food and drinks at good prices.
Perfect for a date or just chilling.
:):):) recommended

name: Favor Cafe' Chiang Mai
review_1_text: This is a quiet and lovely little cafe . Although the drinks weren't amazing, the cake was delicious enough! The staff were very warm and polite, and the atmosphere was great.
review_3_text: Quiet place and coffee is tasty.
review_4_text: Pad Thai is the best!!!! I recommend !!!! Also I ordered “Black Orange” which mean black coffee  orange juice that is so refreshing
review_5_text: Good 👍🏻

name: Maled Coffee Roasters : โรงคั่วเมล็ด
review_1_text:
Mae Jan Tai Chiang Rai flat white - 4 stars
Interesting white coffee that tasted like jackfruit.

WiFi is decent, the cafe is a bit on the warm side. Sparse interior, not crowded.
review_2_text: Great spot with a welcoming vibe. The barista Nook was super friendly and shared some awesome insights about the local coffee culture. Great coffee and service. Would revisit.
review_3_text: So many varieties of beans to choose from! I went with the Baristas recommendation as I found it hard to decide! The place smells amazing as soon as you walk in. Lots of seating available with decent music playing. Coffee was good, would be keen to return to try some more. The only thing I'd change is, when ordering a v60 I prefer it to be served in the original glass, with a smaller cup on the side. But this is me being picky.
review_4_text: I tried flat white and dirty for the drinks. Flat white is great, but the dirty feels too much milk and you can not really taste the coffees. I was recommended to try their blue berry crumble cheese cake, but it was not good sadly. The AC room is workable if it’s not crowded.
review_5_text: Coffee Lover must visit this nice cafe. Their coffee quality and taste are really good. Note that please tell them clearly about your order whether hot or ice coffee. I ordered hot coffee but I got ice coffee for the first time visiting. The staff service is excellent and friendly. I am probably realized that most people like the cold coffee rather than hot coffee in Chiang Mai.

name: Penny’s Sweet House
review_1_text:
Attractive setting in a renovated home.  Comfortable place to relax and enjoy excellent coffee.  Also offer multiple bakery items which we did not try, but looked great.
Convenient off street parking also.
review_2_text: Love the vibe here, but ordered a hot chocolate today and it was unfortunately lukewarm. Would love to see more consistency with drink temperatures. Still a great spot for a meeting!
review_3_text: We had such an enjoyable time here. Classic period setting. Peaceful place to sit and enjoy coffee milkshake and cheese cake. The lemon cheese cake was delicious. Friendly service tops the experience off. Fantastic 😊
review_4_text: not really bad, chill vibes for having a coffee
review_5_text: Wonderful, Quite, peaceful.

name: อ้อนนมสด
review_1_text:
Streetside vendor offering toast, steamed bread with kaya dipping, and different drinks ie. coffee, tea, flavoured milk.
It's been around for approx 20 years so that says something about this stall.
review_2_text: amazing milk ！ I love hot milk and milk smooth and must eat the green bread with green sauce. I always come here for dinner.
review_3_text: Aon Nom Sod in Chiang Mai is a must-try spot if you're craving fresh milk drinks! This place serves delicious, creamy fresh milk with a variety of toppings and flavors, making it a perfect treat for any time of day. The milk is super fresh, and the sweetness is just right—not too overwhelming. You can choose from a range of options, from classic flavors to unique ones, all prepared with care. The ambiance is cozy and welcoming, with friendly staff who make you feel at home. Whether you're a milk lover or just looking for a refreshing drink, Aon Nom Sod offers a great experience in Chiang Mai
review_4_text: Hot milk is good here.
review_5_text: Cheap toast and drinks. Always crowded.

name: Mainichi
review_1_text:
I think it’s a delicious restaurant, reasonably priced, and the ingredients are great.

The restaurant clearly care about the quality of the food, which really makes me want to write a review. I finished every bite, and i might come again in the future.

The only downside is the parking.
But if you want good food 😳, you’ll have to find your own way around that 😋
review_2_text: The whole food was AMAZING the rice was great and I sliced the omelette open and it was PERFECT you guys should try this.
review_3_text: A cozy, inspired little shop where I got a lot of food for not a lot of money! There's a theme here that reminded me of Japan by the designs and style. The big burger on riceberry with a Japanese omelette was just right. I'm full! This shop is a little hidden but it's worth going to visit to try them. The owner is lovely and friendly to chat too, great job I'll be back!
review_4_text: Best beef bowl in Chiang Mai💪🏽😊 I order from them almost every day.
review_5_text: Love this little store. Cozy, friendly, good food, what else you need?

name: Café Amazon
review_1_text: I like it. The price is cheap. The taste is the best
review_2_text: I have been to Thailand for a total of one year and can understand some Thai.  The waiter's attitude is too "good". I will use Thai language when I am bored. I will write an email to the company.  Never see again.
review_3_text: The coffee shop I usually go closed so I went here. the coffee is just as any other amazon coffee which is not that good. But the staff at this shop really has an attitude when he serves or talks to you. Nice one.
review_4_text: Cozy place to relax. Better not come during exam weeks.
review_5_text: Green tea is made of black tea with adding green coloring. Makes one wonder what all those smoothies are made of

name: Whoops ice cream gelato homemade cafe - ฮูปไอศครีมเจลาโต้โฮมเมด ร้านของคนรักไอศครีม
review_1_text: Very yummy ice cream with great value for money! 🍨 Portions are huge and there’s a wide variety of flavors. Highly recommend for ice cream lovers💕
review_2_text: Good gelato that come with a good price. I have ordered a small size sundae with only 63 bahts which is really worth it. But overall of this sundae I feel like it's getting a bit too sweet at the end. If the salted caramel can get a bit salty it would be better. Still definitely must try tho 🌟😋
review_3_text: The chocolate ice cream was tasty and creamy. Loved it.
review_4_text:
Best Gelato in Chiang Mai!
Whoops Gelato is hands down the best gelato spot in Chiang Mai! The flavors are fresh, unique, and perfect for the hot weather. Their signature Nam Dao Hu (Soy milk)  is a must-try—creamy, refreshing, and unlike anything else. Every scoop reminds me of the authentic gelato I had in Florence. I absolutely love this place and will definitely be coming back again and again! Highly recommended!
review_5_text: This place sells HOMEMADE gelato. Interesting flavors. Right amount of sweetness. Must try! The shop is nice and clean with AC, perfect for a hot weather in Thailand🍧

The staff are so kind and attentive.....hands down a worthy visit!!

review_3_text:
Tried this new coffee shop today. Seems to be a franchise from USA. The seating area is very comfortable with a touch of understated class. The coffees were exceptional, if you like a strong almost sour roast.
However, I felt the serving size could've been a bit more generously portioned. The pastries were a home run! Price for 2 coffees and 2 pastries 280 baht.
review_4_text:
Beautiful new coffeeshop with very modern interior. The coffee is really good, but don’t forget about the pastries! I especially recommend the blueberry cheesecake.

Plenty of seats inside, and you can buy some other snacks and drinks with merch from the machine
review_5_text: It’s a good place to take a rest, though the music is a little bit loud for working. They have sufficient place to charge. And open until 7pm. But they don’t provide free water, and a little bit too dark after 5:30pm. Sometimes people put their feet on the sofa. 75B for iced latte, overall, still has good value.

name: DeeNan Coffee
review_1_text:
One of the best ChiangMai cafe. If you looking for real coffee.

They make their own brand coffee from plantation to cafe.

Really recommend!!!! ❤️❤️❤️❤️
review_2_text: Nice setup with some bench tables and very affordable drinks.  It’s an open area with just fans to keep you cool so probably not a great place to work when it’s hot.  A latte costs 35 baht, I tried the Thai tea which was delicious!  There are power point but oddly enough I saw a sign on it that said it costs 5 baht an hour to charge from.  They sell their own brand of coffee here and you can buy the beans to take home. Th owner was very friendly and welcoming. #BeatTheGrind
review_3_text: Superb coffee flavour. The uniqueness of this coffeeshop is the owner has his own farm up north n also selects coffee bean from Lisu hill tribers directly. Unpretentious simple place that sell a lot of coffee.
review_4_text:
Really good coffee shop with passionate owner that will help you to choose the best coffee beans matching to your taste.
I took 10 min to talk with him and he explained me how he produces his beans, it was really interesting. He explained me about his roasting techniques.
Price is reasonable and I'm happy to buy my coffee locally !
review_5_text: Slightly underrated due to being in a less touristy side of Chiang Mai. Mainly locals near the area come by for a sip (medical professionals, students, coffee louvers). If you want to be surrounded by local Chan tribal people or try coffee beans grown from Doi Chang ... definitely come by. The beans you buy here are the cheapest you'll find by the gram (around 150 Baht for 150grams) and your choice of roasting process. If you speak a little Thai you can ask or tell them how you want your beans done for you takeaway souvenir. They also sell Cascara tea (the pulp of the coffee bean). Definitely souvenir material for last minute shopping at a local price.

name: Trofe.cnx
review_1_text: Amazing Barista!
review_2_text: The drinks and desserts were delicious! The atmosphere in the cafe was great, very comfortable. I highly recommend this cafe. The staff provided excellent service.
review_3_text: I ordered an Americano and a dark roast latte via Grab. The Americano was very sour, and the latte's lid wasn't sealed properly, so some liquid spilled into the bag.
review_4_text:
Good coffee, great atmosphere. They sell football jerseys.
If you like coffee and football, this is a great community!
review_5_text:
It's a football shirt shop that has very delicious coffee and cakes.
🍰 I was very impressed with the cakes at the shop. He baked the cake himself. The ingredients are premium. The price is not high at all. We bought Banoffee and it takes 2 days to run out.
☕️ Drinks are just as good.
👯‍♀️ Employees and shop owners provide good service.
😎Vibe at the shop is good.
We also got shirts from the store 😅 Even though I'm not a football fan, But I can't help it.

name: กาแฟพันธุ์ไทย สาขาถนนสุเทพ
review_1_text:
Thank you for opening a branch here! I'm a loyal Thai customer!

The staff are amazing! They kept saying thank you even after customers had left the store! 55555 But they should change their welcome phrase from "You can browse the menu while you wait," which makes it feel like you have to wait. It should be "Please feel free to browse the menu first." That would be much better.

I signed up for the membership card, it's the best deal in the world! Today I tried the Double Matcha Latte, 50% sweetness. It was so smooth and delicious! But I forgot to stir it first. The bottom was sweet and smooth, while the top was tea-flavored, very bitter and strong. I loved it! It wasn't bitter like coffee. After stirring it, it was perfectly balanced. There are so many other menu items to try, including some that support Thai products. I'm a huge fan of Thai products! The store is always busy!
review_2_text:
Thai Coffee Shop, located in front of the Faculty of Dentistry, Chiang Mai University. Delicious drinks, standard Thai coffee.
Clean shop, friendly staff.
There are about 5 tables.
Parking on the street.
review_3_text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ The Friendliest Punthai Branch in Town | Essential Stop for Daily Thai Tea & Coffee on Suthep Road🥤☕
.
Punthai Coffee, Suthep Road branch, is one of the few branches in Chiang Mai located outside a gas station and right in the heart of the city. What impressed us most about this branch is the friendliness of the staff.
.
As a regular (everyday) Thai tea drinker, Punthai's 75% sweetened Thai tea has a rich and perfectly sweet flavor. With a Max Card, the price is only 27 baht per cup, which is a great value (although limited to 10 cups per month). The shop also offers promotions pairing drinks with a wide selection of desserts, including croissants, sandwiches, and even dim sum items like buns and dumplings.
.
Note: Since I came to buy food in the morning to go to work, parking on the side of the road wasn't difficult. Even on weekend mornings, you can park in front of the shop or across the street. We usually didn't have to wait long, as there were usually 4-5 staff members working at the same time during peak hours.
.
In summary, this Punthai branch This is perfect for those looking for affordable everyday drinks. It's even more worthwhile with a membership card, but parking can be difficult during the morning or afternoon on weekdays for those driving.

📍Location: Located on busy Suthep Road, right next to 7-11. Easy to find and conveniently located near Chiang Mai University's Suan Dok Campus.
✨The Vibe: Clean with a minimal design. Offers a bar with three high chairs and a couple of tables.
🏆Strengths: Exceptional staff friendliness (the most friendly Punthai branch we've found in town!). They offer reliable taste and great value, especially with a Max Card membership (Thai Tea at THB 27). Excellent variety of bakery and snacks, including dim sum.
💡Parking Note: Easy street parking in the early mornings and weekends; challenging during weekday peak hours.

📝Highly recommended for international travelers who want to try quality coffee or non-coffee Thai brand drinks at an affordable price. Dim sum and Thai-style bakery items are also available.
review_4_text:
The new shop is beautiful and has comfortable seating, not cramped.
The staff provides excellent service.
review_5_text: The staff provided good service, the coffee was delicious, the shop area was not very large, and there was no restroom available.

name: Found
review_1_text: Lovely small place friendly staff
review_2_text: This shop is very nice, with a beautiful view. The matcha is delicious and worth the price. I would like to inform the shop that the smell of cigarettes from the shop's smoking area. As a customer who is allergic to cigarette smells, it spoils the atmosphere while drinking coffee and has to endure the smell all the time in the shop. I would like to ask the shop to consider changing/moving the smoking area away from the customer area and adjusting the direction of that area so that the smell does not enter the shop area. I personally like the shop very much, but I would like to inform you that if this problem persists, I may decide not to return to use the service again, which would be a great pity.
review_3_text:
I felt the Christmas spirit a month before.
It's small, but I like that I can stay for a long time.
I appreciate the outlets at the tables.
Coffee is a given.
It's a shame that there aren't many hot drinks besides coffee, but I enjoyed a refreshing apple tea.
review_4_text:
This small, relaxed shop, located in the alley next to Wat Suan Dok in Chiang Mai, exudes a cozy vibe. The white and wood accents are pleasing to the eye. There's ample seating both inside and outside, and it's not crowded. It's a great place to relax and get some work done.

They have a full range of basic drinks, including coffee, non-coffee, soda, and even dirty drinks. Stop by!

name: Fernpresso Flagship Store at Suandok
review_1_text:
Fernpresso is a great café to relax or get some work done in Chiang Mai. ☕ We ordered a hot cappuccino and an iced latte, both of which tasted excellent — rich, smooth, and well-balanced. The café has a modern and stylish interior with comfortable seating, making it a nice spot to spend some time reading, working, or chatting with friends.

In addition to coffee, they also have a selection of freshly baked goods. The pastries are definitely worth trying, especially if you want something to accompany your drink. The atmosphere is calm and relatively quiet, which is perfect for people looking for a peaceful café experience.

Parking is easy for motorbikes, but car parking is limited, so plan accordingly. The staff are polite and attentive, contributing to a pleasant overall experience.

Overall, Fernpresso at Suandok is a cozy, modern café with good coffee, tasty bakery items, and a peaceful vibe — ideal for both casual visitors and those looking to work or study in a quiet environment. Definitely worth a stop when exploring Chiang Mai
review_2_text:
Perfect Brunch! Everything you want to start your day!

I recently visited this cozy spot, hoping to start my day with some avocado toast, but unfortunately, they were out of avocados. As a vegetarian, I found their breakfast menu somewhat lacking in showcased vegetarian options, which was disappointing.

That said, their Thai tea with almond milk was frothy and absolutely delicious, and the fresh fruit juice smoothies were refreshing and flavorful. I also tried the breakfast sandwich on fresh whole-grain bread, which was excellent—hearty, flavorful, and satisfying. However, I wasn’t informed that the sandwich included cheese, which was an issue for me as I’m lactose intolerant. The staff were super friendly and warm, but they could benefit from being more knowledgeable about the menu and its ingredients.

The restaurant has a chill, laid-back vibe, with quiet music that makes it a great place to study or relax. There's both an air-conditioned indoor space and outdoor seating where you can enjoy the bustle of the busy street.

Overall, the vibe and drinks stood out, and the food was tasty, but a bit more attention to menu transparency and vegetarian options would elevate the experience.
review_3_text: I have officially visited all the fernpresso locations. The coffee is excellent.  Good customer service.  The cakes and sweet have a large selection.  Located across the street from the train station. I recommend this shop
review_4_text: Good price, nice latte and good service. It'll be good for working. It's spacious👍
review_5_text: I keep going back to Fernpresso! Great place!

name: Roastniyom coffee(Suan Dok)
review_1_text: This was a nice place to visit. Very quiet but vibrant. The coffee was good, the chairs were very  comfortable for seating and talking. The location has wifi for laptop working. It is right next door to the hospital so there are a lot of ppl that come in and out for business and pleasure. You must be comfortable with the traffic flow of customers to enjoy the location. Once you are inside and seated, the atmosphere is fine. I will visit again.
review_2_text:
Good place to work from if you have noise cancelling headphones. Well located if you’re living in Nimman.

Possibility to sit at the tables with regular chairs or to go for lower tables with more comfortable sofas or leather blanket.

Coffee is good. Air conditioning tends to be too high, so being a jumper with you.
review_3_text: This is a franchise cafe with good coffee. It definitely has franchise vibe, which is not my preference. Americano is 55thb here and it’s good
review_4_text: The best coffee shop around near Suan Dok hospital. You can come to chill out or working. There’s space for you to sit and have a coffee and work. Pleas come and enjoy your time!!
review_5_text:
Edit June 2023...
Recently renovated and really nice looking but the WiFi is still horrible.
AC and good coffee at reasonable prices.

Good coffee and comfortable environment but the last two times I've gone there the Wifi was not working so, 3/5 stars

name: Under Over Cafe
review_1_text:
This is a small cafe.

The atmosphere is very good.

A full set of tables and chairs of Snow Peak

It makes people feel very intimate.

Quiet, the decoration style is very Japanese.

It is suitable for a rest alone.

The coffee is good.

Medium-baked American style

The acidity is moderate, retaining a little aroma of deep baking.

Latte, ordered deep baking

It belongs to the upper middle level.

The cost performance is not bad.

The main thing is comfort and quiet.
review_2_text:
A charming, intimate café with limited parking, but the experience is well worth the inconvenience.

This small cozy cafe is owner-operated, offering freshly baked goods and exceptional coffee.
review_3_text: We had a wonderful breakfast! The service Is very good and food and coffee so special! Recommended!!
review_4_text: Very good coffee and bread. Recommend
review_5_text: Delicious coffee and so cheap too!

name: Café Amazon สาขาคณะแพทยศาสตร์ มหาวิทยาลัยเชียงใหม่
review_1_text: Amazon always offers good quality coffee and mostly can pay with cards. Prices are half the price compared to Starbucks
review_2_text: Good place to take some coffee
review_3_text: Cozy place to chill.
review_4_text: Good taste
review_5_text: The staff are very cute. The taste is standard, the same as other branches.

name: Beats Cafe and Bar
review_1_text:
A Must-Visit Cocktail Bar in Chiang Mai! 🍸🎶

Beats Bar and Café is an absolute gem in Chiang Mai! From the moment you step inside, you're welcomed by a beautifully designed interior that exudes warmth and sophistication. The leather seats add a touch of luxury, making it the perfect place to unwind.

The cocktail menu offers a well-curated selection of drinks to suit every taste. The bartender, Heart, is incredibly knowledgeable and crafts each drink with skill and passion. We had the best Gin & Tonic in Thailand here—perfectly balanced and refreshing!

They also have a food menu, which we didn’t try yet, but it looks promising. This makes it not just a great spot for drinks, but also a good choice for lunch or dinner with cocktails.

If you appreciate great cocktails, a stylish atmosphere Beats Bar and Café is a must-visit in Suthep Road, Chiang Mai. Don’t miss out on this incredible spot! 🍹✨
review_2_text:
BEATs  is a delightful spot nestled in front of Chiangmai neurological hospital. From the moment I stepped in, the warm ambiance and welcoming decor set the tone for a memorable dining experience.

The service deserves special mention. The staff were attentive, polite, and went out of their way to ensure everything was perfect. Their recommendations truly enhanced my meal.

Overall, this place  is a must-visit for anyone who appreciates great food, excellent service, and a cozy atmosphere. I’ll definitely be back!
review_3_text: Very nice hip hop bar. Hip hop classier and nice ambience, like staff. Food and coffee is available, it tastes very good. Price performance are good.
review_4_text: The barista was excellent and made a dang good coffee.
review_5_text: The location is convenient and the staff are friendly. The venue is really cool and comfortable. Seems to be a good place to work or study. Dark aesthetic looks great. And the price is decent for the amount of coffee you get. However, the coffee is very much just okay. Not bad but also not good. I was really bummed about this cause I wanted this spot to be my go to place but I’ll have to keep looking.

name: Black Canyon @ SuanDok Hospital
review_1_text:
Super cute little cafe. The place is very welcoming, spotless, and comfortable. Cha Thai Iced Tea and Iced Black Coffee Latte are delicious and filling, made with good products.

The owners/waitress are adorable and helpful !
I highly recommend this Café which feels like a relaxing bubble in Chiang Mai.

Already fall in love with you,
Black Canyon @ Suandok Park. ❤️😍🥰
review_2_text: Around B185 set including the special drink inside the photo. Taste reasonably good especially if you tried M Chick next door. This branch is definitely much better than one inside the boarding area of the Chiang Mai Airport.
review_3_text: I didn’t really like my food. It was kind of bland. The ceilings were leaking water everywhere. Presentation was nice and the people were nice
review_4_text: We love this coffee shop....it's relaxing quiet and the entire staff is the best...
review_5_text: I usually love Black canyon coffee since their food and services pretty darn good. However my visit the last two times to the Black canyon coffee next to McDonald's just off to Suthep Street, was pretty much unbearable. The reason being is their air conditioners have not been cleaned and so they're not effective at all with the very hot weather this week. I had to clean my air conditioners last week following the seasons smoke event and they need to do the same thing. It only cost 400 baht to have one cleaned so I can't believe they're not doing it.

name: Café Amazon
review_1_text: Nice place to get Good Roffe insider the hospital. Rally buss in the morsning.
review_2_text: It is okay to order here if you have no choice and need some caffeine for the day. Go for premium coffee to get the real milk. Coffee is dark roast and it is bitter.
review_3_text: Good coffee
review_4_text: Cafe Amazon is a chain coffee shop located inside Maharanakhon Chiang Mai (Suan Dok) Hospital. They offer seasonal flavors that you'll never get tired of. They serve high-quality, delicious coffee. It's located on the first floor of the hospital, near the blood collection room, across from the 7-Eleven and bakery.
review_5_text: All the staff were lovely and working hard against the clock, which was great. I really liked it. Even though there were many customers, they were still smiling and cheerful, and served quickly. No long waits.

name: Fresh & Mild since 1992
review_1_text: It is a coffee shop located in Chiang Mai University. It's a coffee shop in the university, so there are a lot of customers. The price range of coffee and ice cream is relatively affordable. The interior of the coffee shop is neat and cool, and the staff is very friendly.
review_2_text:
Located next to medical university this place offers a nice space to open laptop with very good WiFi speed.
Beverages are very affordable. I ordered a milkshake and the staff give me free packaged milk that was also taste good! ✨
Just a disclaimer that even though this place it beyond comfortable, they don’t have toilet.
If you need to go you have to borrow the toilet from another building that wasn’t so clean.
review_3_text: Fresh & Mild provides quality of drinks and snacks. It’s just next to Faculty of nursing, opposite to the canteen of Faculty of Medicine. It’s inside Chiangmai Maharaj hospital. I like a scone with jam strawberry and whipped milk. I like mild milk with whole grain, milk shake with strawberry. Homemade ice cream is fit for a warm afternoon.
review_4_text: Super-fast service. I just paid and got to my seat and my order was already prepared. Amazing coffee
review_5_text: The fresh milk/cream used makes the drinks taste really great. I like the iced orange cappucino and caramel frappucino. The bubble tea is also my favourite. Very refreshing!

name: Tumbler
review_1_text:
Delicious coffee, beautiful latte art. Very reasonable at 60 THB
Not many desserts but the soft cookie was excellent.
review_2_text: Chilled coffee shop. Very good coffee and a nice atmosphere. The staff were very friendly and our drinks came very quickly. A great place to shelter from the heat after seeing Wat Suan Dok. They have cool artwork you can look at and are selling cool canvas bags as well. Great cafe
review_3_text:
Nice aromatic coffee late.
The shop has a lot of drink menu to offer with   Choice of dessert. This time only have a chance to try to coffee latte.

The shop has a gallery mood :) it’s fun to look around.
review_4_text:
New place, new interior.
Particularly friendly staff (am I in love?).

Quality wooden and metal furniture. Separated area for privacy. Medical students, hospital staff and waiting patients abound.

Reasonable air condition, soft music.

A bit expensive. I paid 90 baht for an Iced Latte.

Their specialty is Black Lemon Honey (pictured below).

Some English language reading material available.

Clean bathrooms.
review_5_text:
One of the best drip coffees I drunk in the Chiang Mai.
The place is very cozy and there is a lot of space. Also as a fan of the Star Wars you can find some interesting art here :)
The price is pretty higher that in the other places, but it is worth.
Definitely recommend!

name: S&P สาขาหอพักคณะพยาบาลศาสตร์ มช
review_1_text: Fast talking question avoiding phone obsessed customer service. Unclear as to what and where to eat, changed his mind and will never go back . Customer centered  service   lacking .
review_2_text: Worst S&P ever dont come here
review_3_text: Good service and delicious food
review_4_text: Do not eat at this place.
review_5_text: The staff provided good service, even though it was busy that day and there was a long wait. The food was delicious. The weather was very hot at noon, but it was still a good place to escape the heat while waiting to do business at the hospital in the afternoon.

name: MOMO Shake ชา 20฿ ฟรีมุก รพ.สวนดอก
review_1_text: The water is delicious and tastes good. The shop is clean inside. However, the staff needs improvement. Their facial expressions and tone of voice were unwilling to serve. I only encountered one staff member who was ready to work, and they had a cheerful voice, a smile, and a polite tone of voice.
review_2_text: This was my first time buying from the physical store, and honestly, I've always bought through the app before and been a regular customer. But I don't think I'll be one anymore. The staff didn't smile, and that's one thing, but the way they looked at customers was like they were working for free. I politely asked if they had any jokes, and they answered curtly, "No." I'm not being picky about service, but if that's the kind of service you get, it ruins the experience for the customer.
review_3_text: I've been putting up with this for a long time because it's a place I buy from often and it's really delicious. But the staff are really unbearable. They act like they don't want to greet customers, they don't smile, and they act like they don't want to sell. I'm disappointed with this branch. If you could please warn the staff, I would really appreciate it.
review_4_text:
Having been both a customer and a delivery rider, I'll be honest, are the employees forced to work here? Service should be cheerful, but instead, they have gloomy faces and look down on the delivery riders. If you're not willing to work, just stay home. There are plenty of people who want to work.
I second the point: the employees are not ready to provide service.
review_5_text: It's cheap and delicious. They add pearls to drinks for free, and maybe because there are a lot of delivery orders, it's fresh and soft!

name: MINI STORY CAFE
review_1_text: Great small cafe.
review_2_text: New cafe in Suandok hospital
review_3_text: This cute little cafe is located within the Faculty of Medical Technology, Chiang Mai University. The shop is decorated in beautiful white. Drinks and desserts are average-tasting and cost 50-60 baht, but they also have some special blended coffees to choose from. During the day, it gets quite crowded, mostly with hospital workers and students. You can sit and relax, but it's not suitable for long periods of work.
review_4_text:
A small, worthwhile shop in Suan Dok Hospital, located behind the Medical Technology building. It's a good shop.
The coffee is average, but they have a variety of things to choose from.
review_5_text: This small coffee shop is located in Maharaj Nakorn Chiang Mai Hospital, next to the Faculty of Medical Technology. The coffee tastes good, and the Thai tea and green tea are good, but a bit too milky. You can also use the "Half and Half" program and there's also a cold drip coffee option. The staff is friendly and the prices are average.

name: Sook Son Coffee
review_1_text: I meant to take a picture of the choco banana muffin- but as you can see it’s gone- devoured. You can tell things are handmade, when I went to the loo I could smell the ingredients they were preparing- yum! Prices are good too and the coffee is delicious
review_2_text: There are different kinds of coffee beans, and cakes are very delicious
review_3_text: Really nice coffee! They have lots of cakes also, I got the honey muffin, was really good. Lovely spot to chill out and journal or do some work.
review_4_text: Matcha Latte has a strong flavor. I like this taste very much. The cafe's beverage price is not expensive and desserts are also delicious.
review_5_text: I had a great drink, however they've got low voltage so I couldn't charge my phone,kept 5 percent for an hour :(((

name: Na Wat Coffee
review_1_text:
This is a very chill coffee shop here in Chiang Mai.

What I love the most about each shop is that they all have their own identity.

You have space to relax and take your slide off and work from tour laptop.  Wifi is 5G Baby.

The shop is white and clean. The owner is super kind and speaks English.  We have to slow it down when we talk.

The latte was good. Was it the best I've had? No, but she can pour, that's for sure. Pastries are good.

Overall, this is a place where I would come and hangout without any reservations.  It's a solid pick on this side of Chiang Mai.
review_2_text:
A very nice coffee shop, very quiet and peaceful. Great place to get a coffee and do some work.

The place is clean and the staff are friendly. Service is fast and the price is good.

The only complaint is the waffle is a bit too hard. The cake is delicious but nothing outstanding.
review_3_text:
Amazing place to have Coffee, drinks and great food The northern style braised ham hock was delicious and the pizza as well.

The owner is super friendly and saved my day and my whole vacation. She was my personal translator to explain the policemen next door my issue.

Thank you!!! 🙏🏻🥰
review_4_text:
Madame Keow she's very nice take care and we can drink a very good espresso 😁
Somes Thais cakea
review_5_text:
Nice and cozy place for a coffee.
The crew is extremely kind and speak English very well.
Both americano and matcha latte were great!

name: MARS.cnx
review_1_text:
We had passed by this cafe several times before finally deciding to stop in, and we’re so glad we did. From the outside it already caught our attention with its unique style, but stepping inside was even better. The atmosphere was super cool and creative—something about the design and interior gave us this futuristic, almost “Mars-like” vibe. It’s definitely not your average coffee shop; every corner feels thoughtfully designed and Instagram-worthy.

We ordered their signature drinks along with coffee, and both were excellent. The flavors were rich and well-balanced, clearly made with care, and the presentation was just as impressive. It’s one of those places where you can tell the drinks are crafted to stand out, not just served.

Beyond the drinks, the overall experience was really enjoyable. The seating was comfortable, the music matched the vibe, and it was the kind of place where you can relax for a while—whether to chat with friends, read a book, or just enjoy the ambiance.

This cafe has such a cool personality that makes it stand out in town. We left already planning to come back again, not only for the great drinks but also for the one-of-a-kind atmosphere. A must-visit if you’re looking for something different and stylish!
review_2_text:
I ended up at MARS.cnx on a whim, and it instantly felt different. The space has this surreal, almost dream-like vibe — part art gallery, part cozy hideaway. The design is cool, and the music? Absolutely spot-on. It creates this perfect atmosphere that makes you want to stay longer.
I only had a cappuccino, but the place is definitely a hidden gem for a creative, laid-back escape.
review_3_text: Really like the concept. The ambience is great. Feels like that you are in a restaurant that’s on Mars. They have given effort to make it look like one from the walls, chairs, desks and everything. Staff looked friendly. Service was good. Just went there for a coffee and it was good too. Recommend. Love from 🇱🇰
review_4_text:
The space is modern yet minimal, with warm wooden tones and big windows that let in lots of nature light. Their signature drinks are delicious especially the cold brew and dirty coffee.
The staff are friendly and the vibes feel peaceful. One of definitely worth visit.
review_5_text: MARS.cnx gets very positive feedback overall — high ratings, particularly for its atmosphere, theme, creativity, and vibe. It seems to be less about being a serious gourmet food destination and more about the experience: décor, ambiance, drinks, photo opportunities. If you go expecting that, you’re likely to enjoy it a lot. If your priority is large food portions, a super quiet café for studying, or cheap coffee, there might be better choices.

name: Pran Cafe
review_1_text: I was looking at near cafes when I was temple hopping and found this place in maps. Cute and cozy cafe. Quiet enough to enjoy coffee and read a book. They take card (5% surcharge) and cash. Food, coffee and drinks were great. Interior and exterior were nice. Beside it is their hotel. Nice place to check out!
review_2_text: Beautiful little café. So quaint and the service was outstanding. They grow and roast their own beans and take great pride in the quality of the product.
review_3_text: This place was extraordinarily exceptional. A beautiful and aesthetically decorated place. Our experience  in Chiang Mai was enhanced due to this cafe that I found on Booking.com. Now this Cafe will be my go-to whenever I visit Chiang Mai again. The location is very close to the Chiang Mai gate where all the action takes place. The rooms were very beautiful, modern and very comfortable. Each room has a small balcony to enjoy the morning sun or the afternoon siesta. The cafe has very friendly and polite staff at check-in as well as the breakfast kitchen. The owner-Ms. Pree and her husband are delightful people who makes you feel you are home away from home. The morning breakfast is also very good with excellent coffee that you can buy from the cafe. It is locally grown and has a hint of the taste of the hills around Chiang Mai. The thai food selection for the breakfast was delicious and I am still craving for it miles away. They also had some very good vegetarian options. Moreover, they also helped arrange all the tours that I took at Chiang Mail with a 10% discount. Do not book tours at the airport, they were more expensive than the ones I got from Pran Cafe. We were there during the Loh Kratong festival hence the Cafe was fully booked. I wished we could have stayed longer..this place was one of the highlights of our incredible time in Chiang Mai. I came away feeling that I left my extended family back at this cafe. I was also traveling with my 83 year old father who was very comfortable and happy at this beautiful cafe. Also, did I say that the plants and flowers in this cafe makes one feel that they are in paradise. I will surely be back to this location. Book your whole stay in Chiang Mai at this place..you will not regret it. Wifi and all other modern amenities are great.
review_4_text: Cute cafe with tasty food and delicious cappuccinos! The owner is really sweet and brought her dog over to me so I could pet it. Good WiFi and air conditioning, so it was a nice place for remote work.
review_5_text: This cafe looks amazing! Such a cute decor and ambience! Food was sooo good delicious! Staff very polite and friendly. Loved everything about this cosy cafe.

name: Sunflower Smoothies and Coffee & Breakfast
review_1_text:
Everything was very clean and well maintained. The fruits were fresh and perfectly ripe with great sweetness which made everything taste even better. The shop itself is clean, bright, and nicely air conditioned. So it’s a comfortable place to sit and enjoy your food.

The portion is generous and reasonably sized for the price. I especially loved that they offer an açaí bowl.
review_2_text: Lovely breakfast spot with great selection of items. Has tables inside and outside. We were with 5 months old baby and had a nice spot with stroller inside. Today I ordered toast with avocado and mango salsa. It was delicious. Also the best coffee I drank in Chiang Mai. Really nice team.
review_3_text: Its the great place for breakfast i explored in chiang mai so far; I really loved the atmosphere and food in here as the presentation is top notch and food is delicious , staff is super friendly and prompt.
review_4_text: This cafe was a 2 minute walk from our hostel and we went every morning while we were in Chiang Mai. The staff were extremely friendly and even remembered our order. The food was delicious and the decor is adorable🌻. Their smoothie bowls are amazing and I will miss them. Overall it’s one of the best cafes we’ve been to in Thailand and I recommend for everyone to go!
review_5_text: Great experience here and very delicious bowls! Easy to walk too. Lovely staff. Glad I came by. I appreciate reading google reviews when I travel, so ensuring I give them too ✨

name: Native.Chiangmai
review_1_text: Amazing coffee made with locally grown beans 👌
review_2_text:
Warning: if you try the chocolate peanut cups…. You’ll want to eat them daily..

Insanely good
review_3_text: Coffee👍 Atmosphere👍
review_4_text:
Cafe & Co-Working Space
Newly opened, beautiful design, inviting.
The cafe area is quite small and airy, perfect for groups. The adjacent area is also available for use. Today, I tried the cold brew peach 🍑. The shop seems to use peach-flavored syrup, which was distinctly sweet. I was a little disappointed.
Parking is a bit difficult to find, so I recommend parking near the temple wall and walking over.
review_5_text: It's a coffee shop with a co-working space and accommodation. It's a nice place to sit, but parking is limited. If you work online, I'd recommend this place.

name: ทอฝัน Thor-Phan Coffee Roaster
review_1_text: Nice lil coffee shop where you can work. Just gets crowded when group of friends enter as there are only limited sitting. but wifi is fast enough for laptop work. Coffee was ok, a bit watery after few minutes but overall, cozy cafe. 65 baht for cappuccino
review_2_text: A true specialty coffee spot in Chiang Mai. You can genuinely taste the quality of the coffee (smooth, balanced, and thoughtfully brewed) unlike many places where the flavor is overwhelmed by a burnt aftertaste. Really good coffee, done right ❤️
review_3_text: I can picky when it comes to my coffee, and this place is one of the best! The espresso pulls are really smooth and not bitter. The coffee shop is simple but nice and chilled with two AC units. Combined with a few games it has, it’s a wonderful place for a coffee break.
review_4_text:
I've ordered a caramel latte (specifically asked for just a little sweetness)
Saying that it was amazing is just an understatement. This is by far one of the best coffees I've ever had.
Vanilla latte was also good but just a little below the first one in my taste scale
The taste is rich and smooth, the foam is not too thick which is good IMHO.
The atmosphere is nice and relaxing, not too many people during lunch time.
review_5_text: Good filtered coffee, great quality espresso based coffee, all the tasting notes mentioned were spot on. It is just the chair , not that good for my back if its a long time sitting. But overall very awesome place to get your daily specialty coffee that is roasted by their own in the same place!

name: CNX
review_1_text: Amazing drinks/cocktails at a great price! Perfect place to stop before the Sunday Night market. Great vibes.
review_2_text: Cozy rooftop, seats inside if raining. Worth a visit! Extra plus for the great plane spotting views from the northern departures. Cocktails are cheap and most were very tasty.
review_3_text: Lovely chill place to have a drink and watch the world go by. Music was great! We came back twice.
review_4_text: Cute authentic place for sunset drinks with a view and fresh air.
review_5_text: So disappointed that there is no food here anymore. I used to love the menu and the elevator that brought the meals up to the rooftop patio was such a fun quirk. Very quiet atmosphere now when we went too. Zero locals. I remember this place being packed. Things seem to have changed a lot since the pandemic...

name: Bella Goose Coffee at Alt_ChiangMai
review_1_text:
This spot was an awesome find, I have been to their other locations and this one, like the others did not disappoint.

This time I went for the Americano. Fantastic. Definitely a chill spot to catch up on some emails. The space is small but intentionally and thoughtfully designed. The barista working was incredibly friendly , which seems to be a common theme with Bella Goose, best team in Thailand.
review_2_text: Loved the coffee here. Only had a simple flat white, early-ish in the morning, so wasn't busy at all. We really liked it (of course this was for a bit of nostalgic Aussie coffee, not for a Thai experience!).
review_3_text: The only pumpkin latte except Starbucks in town, but it was too sweet…and expensive, the seat wasn’t comfortable, quite awkward to work from outside when people working inside the coworking space.
review_4_text:
Absolutely love Bella Goose! 🪿
I’m a big fan of their smoothies and cakes every item on the menu is a hit. My favorite smoothie bowl can only be found here, and it never disappoints.

Their smoothies are beautifully presented, taste amazing, and come with generous toppings. Best of all, they’re guilt-free and perfect as a healthy breakfast option.

What really makes the experience even better is the service. Special shout-out to Jaab, the barista at this branch always friendly, polite, and genuinely helpful when recommending menu items. A true gem!

Highly recommended for anyone looking for a delicious and wholesome treat to start the day right. ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
review_5_text: A small, cozy café, perfect for waiting between appointments or taking a break during your journey. Just sit back, sip a well-crafted coffee, and enjoy a moment of relaxation. Through the clear glass separating the café from the coworking space, you can observe people working with dedication—yet still finding joy in every moment of their day.

name: Greather Coffee
review_1_text:
Modern, spacious coffee shop with a clean and inviting vibe—plenty of seating to chill for a while or just grab a quick drink before exploring the area.
I had the iced matcha: refreshing, well-made, and exactly what I needed on a warm day.
They also sell small pastries and bags of coffee beans.
Great spot if you're in the neighborhood and want a comfortable place for coffee. Recommended!
review_2_text: Lovely owner, great service! The waffle sandwich has the perfect mix of sweet and savory. Loved it!
review_3_text: Very kind staff. Good coffee. It's worth the wait for the coffee. If you are gf, warn them not to crumble any cookies on your drinks!
review_4_text: Had a good coffee polite host. Simple clean ambience
review_5_text:
Great coffee selection.
Anaerobic Thai was very good.
Made perfectly to order.

name: .Werb Haus Coffee
review_1_text: Stumbled upon .Werb Haus in Chiang Mai’s Old City and instantly loved the earthy orange tones and retro art of ginger cats artwork on the coffee cups — it has a warm, laid-back vibe. The owner was super welcoming and helped me pick a drink. I ended up trying ES-Yen, a cold espresso I’d never had before — surprisingly smooth and very effective (kept me wired until 2 AM). Spent a good hour just chatting with him and soaking in the Songkran chaos on the street. Ended up staying for a beer and enjoying the moment. Great spot, even better people.
review_2_text:
Great coffee at a coffee shop away from the main road. Coffee prices are slightly cheaper compared to the other coffee shops. Quick service too, and the baristar is able to make the drink efficiently.

WiFi is available, but slightly unstable.

Many seats and plug points available.
review_3_text: The cappuccino here is very fragrant and delicious. Maybe it’s the best one I have tasted in Chiang Mai so far. However, the cake is a bit sweet. Great vibe with nice deco. Kpop playlists are often played in the store. It’s also my work playlist (⁎⁍̴̛ᴗ⁍̴̛⁎)
review_4_text: Nice two-floor cafe. Good price coffee, the place is quiet, has enough space and each table has their charger available, good for working on your laptop.
review_5_text:
Best café in the neighborhood 💪

Coffee is really good, with plenty of different options, and prices are more than reasonable.

Not many desserts options, that's maybe the only improvement I'd suggest!

name: Pa Rang Cafe & Art Stay
review_1_text:
Our favorite place in Chiang Mai! Thank you to Bora for making our trip so memorable.

Prime location, large rooms with comfy beds, great outdoor garden and balcony spaces. Hot hot water is limited but that’s common everywhere in Chiang Mai even in 5* hotels (just something to note). There is always something going on here, you just need to be open for it 😉

A stay that feels like you are living like a local, meeting other travellers and local people from all over the world who also live in CM. We didn’t want to leave, it’s somewhere that stays with you forever. This is not just an accomodation, this is a home. It’s exactly how we love to travel and we will 100% be back to drink with you to the early hours and enjoy the random little creative workshops in the day time.

A stay for the curious, open minded and the kind. Thanks for everything.
review_2_text:
Great accommodation. Very nice located. Quite atmosphere.

Great quality coffees and smoothies.
Music selection during the day is very well curated.

Friendly and professional staff.
Highly recommended !!
review_3_text: Lovely place to stay in a quiet neighborhood of the old city. Primarily an Art Stay, (visiting artists, artists in residence.. ) Parang also welcomes other guests. I spent 4 nites there and loved my spacious room and the overall chilled vibe so much that I almost didn't want to leave! Bora is a great host and she also manages Thapae East, a super cool bar with live music, not to be missed!
review_4_text: Great accomodation close to the center! Rooms are huge and freshly renovated - everything is brand new with modern amenities. Bathroom is fantastic, nice modern and refreshing design from higher end hotels - so much appreciated after couple of days on the road. Korean owner is an art curator and runs an occasional art cafe. Thanks to that the building has a huge patio with cool vibe. Great for hanging out. Highly recommended!
review_5_text: Amazing value for money. Spacious, stylish rooms and a great location. Simple set up - perfect for our family of four enjoying Chiang Mai on a budget.

name: Mix Kaffee
review_1_text:
Fantastic coffee experience, from the interior, service, presentation, coffee, pairing experience, and even just the water, you can feel the owner’s attention to details.
Would def recommend to come have a try, and remember to make a reservation in advance
review_2_text: did the top level of the craft coffee pairing/tasting and it was in the top 5 things we did in the whole country in a whole month. DO NOT HESITATE. Since its a custom type thing, id go 6 stars actually.
review_3_text: This café offers unique brewing methods like fermentation and nitro, with delicate and refined coffee flavors that really stand out. Definitely worth visiting if you’re in Chiang Mai and want to explore high-quality coffee
review_4_text:
I love the idea of this!

However I felt like it was too expensive. We paid 1500 thinking we would get multiple samples but we only got 3 sips of coffee and 2 tiny desserts.

I think that the different menus should be printed out so customers understand what they are purchasing.

I did like the experience and the vibe though! Just would recommend doing a cheaper experience.
review_5_text: Definitely my favorite coffee place in Chiang Mai! The owner is very knowledgeable, he know his stuffs and will give you a very thorough explanation of the coffee technique and beans he is using. Love the experience, if you are a coffee lover, you should definitely come! Remember to make booking via facebook

name: Tar Sawang Coffee At Suandok
review_1_text:
Wonderful hotdog and coffee set.
The hot dogs are surprisingly quite delicious.
Americano is nice.
review_2_text: Clean, minimal interior. They let you choose the coffee blend, so you can go with your preference. It’s cool and cozy inside, and even someone like me who can’t handle bitter coffee was fine with it.
review_3_text: Their bread is delicious. The service is great
review_4_text: You can choose roasting of beans, light jazz in the background, cute seats outside - my goodness... the coffee was delicious!!!
review_5_text: Great little coffee shop with delicious coffee and some great pastries too. Service is excellent.

name: Akha Ama Phrasingh
review_1_text: My first visit to this cafe on a Sunday morning, before 10am it was quiet and peaceful. After 10am the crowd started to fill up the place. My go to coffee has always been an espresso, no sugar. I tried the medium roast today and it was quite balanced and not overly bitter. I didn’t see a separate food menu, what was available right next to the cashier was banana muffin, which tasted warm and delicious. I liked the extra seeds in the mix. This place has an industrial feel to the design, spacious and yet warming with the lighting and furniture. They have a separate shelf selling coffee beans and other products, I will most definitely buy some before I leave town. They deliberately don’t provide any electric sockets, in a move to discourage people to linger. The balcony is closed, but there is one table outside by the entrance.
review_2_text:
Another must-visit coffee spot in Chiang Mai, set in a really beautiful café space. I stopped by around 4 pm on a Sunday, and the place was still packed—including the upstairs seating.

We ended up sitting outside, which turned out to be quite nice with the Sunday market setting up nearby—a great atmosphere if you don’t mind the buzz.

I ordered their dirty coffee, which was excellent and didn’t disappoint. I also picked up some coffee pods for my Nespresso, which I’m looking forward to trying at home.

A great stop if you’re exploring Chiang Mai’s coffee scene.
review_3_text: Good local Geisha - tried both hot and ice drip and taste different (hot: more fruity, ice is sweeter).  The banana muffin is also fluffy and yummy!  Oh and Not to mention, marvelous interior design.  Don't miss this if you are in town (and they close early at 1745 (Wed)
review_4_text:
This is probably the best Caramel Latte I've ever had 😍. And it tastes even better knowing that it comes from an ethically and locally sourced product. I bought so many packets of coffee beans to gift my friends and family.

The staff are also very lovely. Will be coming back here!

Thank you! And thank you to farmer Numwan for her amazing beans... I could actually taste the coconut notes! 🤩🤯
review_5_text: I have always wanted to try their coffee and it was no lesser that what I expected.
