Tried their piccolo latte; three different notes in one glass that has a unique taste to what i drink in my country. Apart from this, the ambience is good, bursting with aesthetics and calmness. Bought sachets of different flavours to try out at home. 🩵

name: The Old City Spa - Ice Bath, Finnish Sauna, Himalayan Salt Far-Infrared Sauna, Magnesium Hot Bath, Thai Herbal Steam Room
review_1_text: Place is tucked down a small ally. I came here for recovery from intense workouts. Place is phenomenal. They provide shorts, indoor sandals and a towel. Price is 450 baht for 2 hour use. The scenery makes it all better with a nice mini waterfall touch.
review_2_text:
An exceptional experience. The sauna is beautifully maintained, offering steady, relaxing heat, while the cold plunge provides an invigorating contrast that leaves you refreshed and energized.
The atmosphere is calm and refined, with meticulous attention to cleanliness and temperature control. I left feeling genuinely restored, both physically and mentally. A remarkable wellness spot that I look forward to visiting again.
review_3_text:
Solid Tranquility found within.

230PM on a Tuesday 6 people

Hot 🔥 Suanas and Steam

Cold 🥶❄️ Plunge colddddd

Magnesium 🛁🚿 Bath hot!

450 Baht

Good time will return
review_4_text: Had a fantastic guided breathwork session with Jason, followed by a cold plunge and a sauna. The facility is beautiful and the whole experience was incredible from start to finish. Thank you to Jason and the staff at Old City Spa for the great experience — and the food was super tasty too! Highly recommend.
review_5_text: Amazing experience so worth it! 2 hours of contrast therapy. I absolutely loved the infra red sauna. Complimentary tea provided. Super friendly staff, they provide a locker for your belongings. Great atmosphere and location.

name: Zohng Coffee
review_1_text: The avocado toast was fresh and creamy, perfectly paired with crispy bacon and a cup of latte. The Zhong breakfast was satisfying and well-balanced, with classic flavors done right. A comforting and filling meal to start the day.
review_2_text:
Really nice atmosphere
the new decoration makes the place feel more modern and comfortable.
There’s a good variety of food to choose from, especially the chicken breast steak and the beef burger, both were really good.
The coffee is great, and the service is friendly and attentive.
Overall a chill spot with good food and drinks. Would definitely come back.
review_3_text: We enjoyed having a light lunch there. Very tasty chocolate PB smoothie! The burgers looked very promising - I better be trying their burgers next time. Thank you for the quick service and delicious food!
review_4_text:
Decent coffee with a streetside funky atmosphere . good service.
Bombon is killer morning wakeup.
Lemon,ginger honey shot is a great standout!
Baked goods decent. Egg bagel breakfast sandwich was aroy 🤩
Handicap ♿️ possible but steps up to store could pose issues. SEE PHOTO
FINAL TAKE...Recommended
review_5_text: Very good meals, wide menu and tasty food! Had steak with egg for breakfast and the seasonal fruit mix, 10/10! The eggs benedict were missing the hollandeise sauce, but they had their own personal twist which was very good!

name: Baan Buri Café & Restaurant
review_1_text: Delicious food and drinks, quick service, cozy place. The staffs are very friendly.  Food decoration are beautiful. Tasty Tom Yum Goong set, delicious mango pancake and waffle. Especially coffee and matcha latte. We enjoy the restaurant.
review_2_text:
Absolutely Loved This Place!

We stopped by Baan Buri Café and were honestly surprised by how great everything was. The atmosphere is cozy and welcoming, the staff are super friendly, and the service is quick and attentive.

The food and drinks were fresh, tasty, and beautifully served. You can really feel the love and attention they put into every dish.

The café has a really positive vibe, perfect for relaxing, grabbing a light meal, or just enjoying a good coffee break.
Highly recommended for anyone visiting the area, this place definitely deserves more attention.

We’ll gladly come back again!
review_3_text: Ordered the Massaman chicken curry with rice and a mango shake. Both were good value for the price. The mango shake was refreshing, though the artificial flavour was a bit stronger than other mango shakes I’ve had in Thailand. The Massaman was tasty but only had one piece of chicken. Still decent considering the portion size and price. Presentation is excellent. 4 stars for atmosphere cause i think place needs a lil bit of revamping and better lighting. Service was great & lightning fast.
review_4_text: Baan Buri is both a café and a restaurant. The espresso 'Thai style', served with milk and sugar over ice in a large glass, is strong, slightly sweet, and ice-cold – a real find in Thailand! The muffin with soft chocolate chunks on chocolate sauce – here served with rosemary and two orange wedges – easily lives up to its name, "Chocolate Combo." The Thai service is good and friendly. The ambiance, with a touch of coffeehouse, exoticism, and Thai style – naturally, what else? – is somewhere between delicious, wonderful, and perfect. Sorry, couldn‘t resist to try before the shooting 😂
review_5_text: Loved the French toast—fluffy, lightly sweet, and not soggy at all. The American breakfast was hearty and filling, with well-cooked eggs, crispy bacon, and tasty sausages. A great choice if you’re craving a classic breakfast. The place has a calm ambiance perfect for a morning meal.

name: Nap’s Coffee Roaster CNX
review_1_text: Great place for coffee nerds to buy coffee beans! They offer a wide range of origins, from local Thai to Ethiopian, Honduras, Brazil, etc. they have these little tubes with ground coffee and perfume pump heads so you can smell the ground beans and choose the one you like. I got a light roast Ethiopian blend and came back for more the next time.
review_2_text: This is an excellent cafe with great tasting coffee with very affordable prices, especially given how modern and clean the aesthetics here are. You can pick the beans you would like, I went with dark smoky but will go for the medium chocolate one next time. They even serve in glass containers making it very easy to recommend.
review_3_text: Great coffee and pastry destination!  Went with the dark roast Cappuccino, very good.  The star of the show however was the Toast Brown Butter, yummy!!
review_4_text: 10/10 coffee is delicious. Can choose blend, milks, croissant and food for lunch. Nice large seating area. They clearly take pride in their coffee. Can also buy beans here.
review_5_text: The best coffee and service I seen in Chiang Mai. Very much recommend. Just one thing is their water feels containing chloride but maybe that’s just me. But the cappuccino is soo good with the tasty and thick cream that I still come here just drink water from 7/11

name: Gallery Drip Coffee Chiang Mai
review_1_text:
Nice coffee shop in a nice building/museum. They had lots of beans to choose, we picked affogato & cold brew.
To be honest, that's best affogato i tried in my life, seriously. It had coconut ice cream with coffee, and something fun on top (i guess it's made from sugarcane or something like that). Perfect in a hot summer day. Very calm & chill atmosphere that we still remember till now.
review_2_text: I‘ve been here for the second time. I can tell you that the coffee tastes very good. The price is also good. It is a shop that hidden in the Chiang mai culture centre. Good coffee and it’s worth to try even if you aren’t drinking coffee. There are many types of beans to choose. The staff can recommend each menu well. Both talkative, smiling, many seats, both inside and outside.
review_3_text: Love the vibes and the coffee ☕️ great hideaway spot with quietness and comfortable atmosphere. Outside sitting at a very cute garden set up inside the museum…can easily spend hours enjoying the coffee & vibes there!
review_4_text: Best coffee we had in Thailand. Drip coffee is so much better than americano. And we had a great table host.
review_5_text: Cafe culture is in its infancy in Thailand. However, this place demonstrates that the Thais are getting there. After touring, the Gallery, you exit by the cafe and as soon as I entered, I knew this place wasn't going to disappoint. I could see that the barista who was preparing to make drip coffee learned his technique properly when he carefully trimmed and foldted the filter to its proper size. I asked to see the beans and was told that the beans were locally sourced and washed and roasted by the Cafe. While I asked for robust beans, the Cafe owner said that she didn't have robust but favored medium roast and that I should try it. I did, and while the medium roast was flavorful and you could taste the hint of hazelnut, I still would have preferred a more robust bean. Overall, this place is for serious coffee afficionados. I think that if the Cafe wants to please more serious coffee drinkers, it must add a robust bean selection. I was happy and pleased that I found this place and I recommend that if you are in Chiang Mai and want to learn about the City and afterwards be rewarded with a good cup of coffee, stop by!

name: Inner Cafe & Bistro
review_1_text:
Wow!
Another amazing cafe in Chiang Mai. Great Tasty Food, Friendly Service, Welcoming Ambience and very Convenient Seating.

The campus includes a Hostel, 24h Coin Laundry, few other eateries and few shops.
review_2_text: Good brunch spot. A lot of options on the menu. In my opinion the avocado egg toast would have needed more salt. Mango bowl was delicious. Liked it.
review_3_text:
We had breakfast and came back the next day for lunch.  The drinks are amazing but I had the lemon soda for Lunch and it was very sour and I didn’t like it. But the smoothies and coffees were delicious.

Our breakfast was delicious. The Lunch was lovely too. Lots of options on the menu hard to pick what you want. Their menu is all day so you can get breakfast at any time.

The prices were very good too.

Definitely recommend coming here.
review_4_text: Good breakfast, cheap and fast. Coffee is rather delicate could be little bit stronger. Good smothies and juices
review_5_text: Came here for breakfast. Got avocado and toast beautiful. I got avocado and toast with bacon and the bacon was lovely as well. Highly recommended and the price was good as well

name: the butterfly effect - organic cafe
review_1_text:
The avocado chocolate cake seems to be sent from heaven - honestly the best cake I've ever tried. Just the right amount of sweetness and the avocado works wonderfully with the chocolate. Place has a fancy design with wooden elements. However, I sensed somehow a weird vibe inside the coffee, nobody talks and stares at their phones. If you talk the whole room listens which is why we decided to eat outside.

The cake is a full recommendation while the ambience might not be for everyone.
review_2_text: My favourite breakfast and lunch spot in Chiang Mai. Unbeatable chilled atmosphere, super friendly staff and don’t miss out on the Iced Oat Latte, flavoured Hemp Milks, Chia Pudding and Kimchi Sourdough Sandwich.
review_3_text:
This was a lovely cafe with great drink and food options. This was the first time I’ve had a matcha cortado and I loved the more matcha-forward tasted compared to a more milk heavy latte. The sourdough toasts and smoothie bowl were all fantastic as well. Everything is vegan, so no dairy and plenty of alternative milk options.

The space has tons of windows and feels so bright with the variety of plants and wood furniture. A great place to spend a little time!
review_4_text: This cafe is beautiful and a refreshing stop from the heat. The food is delicious, in taste, looks, and smell. The smoothies are must haves and served in cool flasks. This was the best breakfast my friends and I had throughout our entire trip in the country, I'd highly recommend.
review_5_text: I ordered the kimchi, pumpkin and cashew toast and WOW. It was outstanding. It’s been over a week since i’ve had and I still dream about it. Also the mango matcha 🤤 I would come back to Chiang Mai just to eat here. And the staff were very lovely. definitely recommend this place.

name: At All Café
review_1_text: Highly recommend! Cozy environment! Warmly reception n fresh smoothies! High quality coffee! Must come if u r in Chiangmai!
review_2_text: I tried Iced coffee and watermelon juice, both of them are so good ❤️owners are kind and also there’s cute dog who’s always smiling - I visited to this cafe to see this cutie 🫶 (first two photos & the last photo were taken by film camera)
review_3_text:
At All Café is an absolutely charming coffee shop that offers not just great coffee but an unforgettable experience. The highlight of this delightful spot is the adorable dog, who is both a well-dressed little companion and a beacon of joy for every guest.

As seen in the photo, this sweet pup, donning an irresistibly cute striped outfit, sits at the table with you, providing unparalleled company. While the dog refrains from drinking coffee—wisely avoiding any potential snout-burning mishaps—their presence makes the coffee-sipping experience so much better.

The café itself is warm and welcoming, with a cozy ambiance that pairs perfectly with their delicious drinks. Whether you're a dog lover or simply looking for a unique coffee spot to brighten your day, At All Café is a must-visit. Just don't be surprised if you end up staying longer than planned, captivated by the charm of this furry little host!
review_4_text: Delicious Apple 🍏 smoothies. Couple owners also owned the massage next door. I did 60 min full body and felt like waking on clouds afterwards 😀👍. I rented a motorbike with them for four days 200 baht a day with only 1000baht deposit. Cheapest around this area and the Honda scooter ran perfectly. Highly recommended!
review_5_text:
Was here for scooter rental!
Great people and very honest.
Scooter was not the newest but did a great job and for a great price.
Highly recommend

name: Durianism Cafe’ Phra Singh Chiang Mai ทุเรียนคาเฟ่พร้อมเสิร์ฟ 365 วัน
review_1_text:
This is a place for durian lovers. All sorts of durian inspired desserts, from sticky rice to drinks and ice cream.

They do serve meals too. But we didn't try. It has pasta and so on.

Shout out to the best durian ice cream I ever had so far.
review_2_text:
Our first stop after arriving and we all got the flavoured milks. Very tasty.
Food wise, 3 of us got the same thing, crispy back chicken with rice. Very tasty, but far too much garlic on it. Literally see the garlic. Vampires don't stand a chance tonight.
Great location and good for people watching.
If you use a debit or credit card, you'll pay 3% more no big deal, but cash is easier.
review_3_text:
If you are a true durian lover, just eat it from the fruit markets. I paid for the most expensive 5 star durian and it wasn't ripe. I know what good durian is and didn't come back here.

Saying that the durian sticky rice was good using ripe durian.
review_4_text:
Food is nice. They have shop which is nice. Got buy something nice for present.
Nearest to the temple, is nice area you seat outside eating while watching the people walking.
review_5_text: Being Asian, I always love durian. And to have a cafe with varieties are awesome. Staffs are friendly, actually most Thais are super very friendly. This is my 3rd time to the cafe & sadly last night here. Highly recommended. Will definitely come back if I'm visiting Chiang Mai❤️❤️❤️❤️

name: SEVEN • SLASH • TWO
review_1_text: Love this place! Seven Slash Two has a clean, modern, yet comfortable and relaxing atmosphere. Great oat milk latte and American Breakfast. The service is super friendly and it has become my morning go-to spot whenever I visit Chiang Mai.
review_2_text: Nice cafe sporting a roomy space with varied seating that's pretty quiet on a weekday morning. Service is cordial and the coffee is great.
review_3_text:
From the moment I walked in, I was greeted with warm smiles, a sleek cozy atmosphere, and the aroma of freshly brewed coffee in the air

What stood out most was the attention to detail in taste, in presentation, and in service.
Absolutely a place I’ll come back to. A new favorite!!!
review_4_text: Great latte. Big space inside not obvious from the road. Plenty of places to work for a few hours.
review_5_text: I found this cafe towards the end of my stay in Chiang Mai, but I returned nearly everyday until I left. The staff are super nice, and it’s a lovely place to hang out and enjoy a coffee. The barista practically convinced me to become a barista when I’m done traveling because of his enthusiasm for the craft and role in customers’ daily lives. It’s a special place! Both the coffee (iced americano was my go to) and the food were superb. The interior is very beautifully designed and was a calming getaway from the busy streets - like a protective bunker. Unfortunately I took no pictures because I was too busy enjoying the vibes here to even think about it.

name: Tomorrow Cafe & Bistro
review_1_text: Lovely clean and central place for food and coffee. I ordered a soy cappuccino and it was nothing to write home about. I was looking for a really good coffee place, walked around for quite awhile, saw some people out front, so thought this would be a good place to try. However, the coffee was lacklustre.
review_2_text: We came to Tomorrow because we were walking around looking for a place to eat. My boyfriend ordered the carbonara pasta and I had the Pad Thai. Honestly, everything was delicious. The service was good too, and the food came quickly. We also ordered some Spring Rolls, and they were really tasty. In terms of price and quality, it was definitely worth it. So yes, I’d recommend stopping by this place.
review_3_text:
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ (4/5 stars rating)

I recently visited Tomorrow Cafe & Bistro, and we enjoyed it overall! It has a cozy and inviting atmosphere set the tone for a pleasant coffee break. ☕️🪴 The decor was charming and modern, making it an ideal spot for relaxation or catching up with friends.

We ordered the coconut espressos, which turned out to be a refreshing and delicious surprise! 🥥☕️ It's not something you find everywhere, and I would highly recommend it to anyone looking to try something new. The coffee was perfectly brewed, with the coconut adding a subtle sweetness that complemented the espresso nicely.

As for the desserts, we indulged in both the cheesecake and carrot cake. 🍰🥕 Both were incredibly soft and flavorful, with textures that melted in our mouths. The cheesecake had a creamy, rich consistency, while the carrot cake was perfectly spiced, making each bite a delight.

While the overall experience was wonderful, the only downside was that the service was a bit slow. 🐢⏳ Despite this, the staff were friendly and attentive, ensuring that we felt welcome and comfortable throughout our visit.

In conclusion, Tomorrow Cafe & Bistro offers a warm and inviting atmosphere with unique and tasty offerings. With a bit of improvement in service speed, it could easily become a top-notch cafe experience. Highly recommended for anyone in the area looking to enjoy a relaxing coffee break with delicious treats! 🎉🍵🍰
review_4_text: Excellent Thai menu.  Delicious drinks.  Terrace seating. Value for money
review_5_text: On a stressful day I randomly found this coffee and decided to go in for a short break and that was one of the best ideas ever. Drinks themselves which I tried, were simple yet tasty. The interior decoration were modern yet kind of minimalistic. That combined with the calm music in the background, made me calm down a bit and I spent more time here than actually intended. Would definitely visit again and can recommend it to everyone.

name: Ratchadumnern Coffee and Food
review_1_text:
I've eaten lunch here every other day for about four weeks. I've tried almost everything on the menu, and I haven't been disappointed once.
There are two fish dishes in the Thai food section of the menu that particularly stood out for me.
Generous servings. Excellent service. The server remembered everything I had tried over the weeks, and helped me a few times to navigate the menu.
They also have a few excellent pork dishes, including an appetizer with the perfect garlic ingredients.
Highly recommend this restaurant.
review_2_text: Very cute Coffee Shop. The choices were great, drinks menu is extensive.  The food was tasty and staff were happy to make an allergy adjustment. A great experience
review_3_text: Small cafe that has indoor AC and outdoor seating. The atmosphere is cozy and cute! Drinks were so good, we had the coffee, green tea frappe and hot thai tea. The breakfast food was also pretty good, but I think the cakes, pastries and drinks are the best here.
review_4_text:
I’ve been a customer of this cafe for 10 years. Best food in town, especially Tom yum. There’s Thai and European food. Also great beverages (matcha and Thai milk tee are my favorite), yummy desserts. Atmosphere is quiet and friendly but not overly. Prices are fair for the amount and quality.
Thank you for the great service and delicious food 🙏🏻💓
review_5_text:
Great food and coffee, a range of Thai and western. Coffees with a range of milk’s (we wanted oat milk , and they had it) The breakfast here was far better than the buffet at the hotel and much better value.
Quick service, highly recommended

name: TWENTY MAR
review_1_text: The atmosphere is good, and the boss and the staff are very friendly. Of course, it tastes great. Personally, the coffee tastes the best in Chiang Mai. I said I would visit every day before returning to Korea, but unfortunately, today is a temporary closure...
review_2_text:
Amazing coffee, they really know how to make great drinks. A must visit if you are looking for unique drinks and an awesome overall experience. Had to buy some coffee beans as well because the coffee was great.

The service is also top-notch. Not a lot of seats and no kids allowed. So just a nice coffee drinking experience for coffee lovers. Absolute mist visit!
review_3_text:
This is place is a mood, like a coffee speakeasy.  They have a smooth jazz vibe with the music, and everything is about the coffee.

They have a couple variations of the classic Thai coffee drink “the dirty”.  We tried the “sense of dirty” and the “super dirty”. Both were unique improvements on the original. They really elevate everything.  High craft coffee.
review_4_text:
Good spot to enjoy your specialty coffee from Colombia. With a twist of Japanese look and feel. Kind of not for ‘kanji’ and ´kids’… but for sure ´adult only’

Highly recommended for the mood and vibes !!
review_5_text: Masterful! It’s a coffee experience. A coffee Michelin restaurant. No babies, animals, food, laptops. Adults only (coming with a baby was a shock first time in my life to see adults only coffee place) but! Exceptional coffee.

name: Blue Coffee At Old Town
review_1_text:
Absolutely loved Blue Coffee in Chiang Mai!
A cosy spot with really warm vibes, perfect for a quick caffeine fix or a slow morning. The coffee is smooth, fragrant, and well-balanced — you can really taste the quality. Staff were friendly and welcoming, making the whole experience even better.

The café is clean, comfortable, and a nice escape from the busy streets. Prices are reasonable too. Definitely a place I’d return to whenever I’m in Chiang Mai. Highly recommended! ☕💙
review_2_text:
I’ve had Blue Coffee in Maya Mall, and thus knew this would be a good time. I really enjoy the Blue Coffee, iced, that I got with no sweetness.

Wi-Fi is nice, seating is decent, and quiet enough to rest / talk. Would definitely recommend this spot - and full disclaimer got a 10 baht discount for writing this review.
review_3_text: Cozy cafe with outside seating area. Great coffee selection! Almost no waiting for my order to arrive. Cafe is shared space with the treasury museum of Chiang Mai.
review_4_text: I had a latte here and it was delicious. The outdoor seating is cool and airy, with a lovely street view. A really nice café in the heart of the Old Town — definitely worth a try!
review_5_text: Provided traditional coffee, some fancy cold drinks and simple bakery like ham and cheese croissant and bagel. Traditional coffee are very nice and good value for money.

name: North Gate Spirit
review_1_text:
The best cocktails bar so far!! We went there and tried some of the cocktails and described what we like, the bartender came out with our unique cocktails in our fav flavours without anything in the menu!! Amazing!!

The vibe was nice and the place was so cozy with the good service! Def be back if I go to CM again!
review_2_text:
They’ve got everything here from live jazz music, coffee and a speakeasy style bar in the evenings. The atmosphere was bright friendly and creative with a nice atheistic for photos. The staff all spoke perfect English and the cashier Pear-wa was really helpful in helping me decide on which coffee to have, I went with the coconut coffee foam and it was delicious! As a coffee lover this place is perfect for that unique experience and quality coffee and specialty cocktails.
Don’t miss this spot if you’re in Chiang Mai you would be missing out !
review_3_text: Very beautiful modern decor cafe. Initially curious as lot of young kids were taking selfie here. I had to ask them is this in a movie or famous? One told me this place has a good coffee. To my surprise they do have a very good tasting coffee. They offer it in medium or dark roast. I chose Iced Americano, it has note of citrus taste and tad bit sour taste, clean and refreshing!
review_4_text: Super aesthetic little cafe tucked in the neighbourhood that gives Japanese minimalist vibes! They also sell spirits (see photo) and an assortment of creative drink options. There’s also a cool mural right outside for more photo opportunities ✨
review_5_text:
Definitely very local jazz bar with tons of foreign tourist around. It drinks a little bit expensive. I think the number of people are too much so maybe the experience wasn’t very best.

But the band is really good . For me, I would prefer somewhere quieter.

name: Herb Basics
review_1_text: If you love Herbal products, this shop  is a “must go” place. Quality is great and price is reasonable. You can buy cosmetics and essential oil, balm made from herbal. There are also coffee and cakes inside. You can sit and relax inside. Every time I’m in Chiang Mai, I always go shopping in this place. 🤩
review_2_text: It's my second time in the shop. Last September, I bought some essential oils and cosmetics and had Thai milk tea to spend whole afternoon. Now, I take vacation with family and take them here. Soft drinks are good, staffs are kind, products are fantastic. I enjoy everything here!
review_3_text:
Very elegant coffee and perfume shop.  Coffee good.  Cosmetics good quality and well priced, at least the body lotion I bought is.
Certainly would come here again. 😊😊😊
review_4_text: Beautiful shop, bought the 雞蛋花 frangipani flavor body lotion and flower water, loves its light sweet flower smell.
review_5_text:
Good place to buy herb products and have  chill with coffee in old town of Chiang mai.
The goods they sell are somewhat expensive but not bad too much.

name: Baan Nintra Cafe and Restaurant
review_1_text: Beautiful place. Good choice of food. Servers and the owner speak English well. They were open on Songkran day morning as well but please check with the restaurant for holiday hours. Food presentation is good. The taste of the food is above average for the food I ordered.
review_2_text:
Had lunch after walking and visiting 3 Kings monument & cultural centre.
Prompt and friendly service. Clean and comfortable dining. Delicious clean food. And freshly made drinks and smoothies.
review_3_text: Simply heartwarming! We discovered the place by chance and were more than impressed! The atmosphere is very relaxed, beautifully decorated, the staff really make a lot of effort and do everything with love! We tried many vegan dishes and all of them are definitely recommended! We will be back! Thank you!
review_4_text: Enjoying our dinner here. Owners are very friendly.
review_5_text: Great veg menu and options. Owner friendly and prepared dish off the menu, replacing pork with tofu.

name: Coffee Telling
review_1_text: What an incredible place - I found it by recommendations, and well this is THE BEST coffee in Chiang Mai. I love coffee - my comparison level of great coffee is Italian coffee - and I must say the coffee here was just SUPERB. I was here every day for the coffee, and what cannot be missed is the atmosphere in the place - such chill & peace 😀, plus the Owner is truly amazing, kind and so expert on coffee making - always with a beautiful smile. Lastly, the crema on the coffee is out of this world 😊!!
review_2_text:
The best cup of coffee in Chiang Mai, and the kindest, sweetest owner.
Coffee is 50 baht, he doesn’t charge for an oat milk alternative, and he uses the best one there is- Oatly! Great banana bread too!
There’s plenty of seating available outside, and it feels like sitting in someone’s garden.
There’s also a cute cat roaming about :)
My husband and I are sad we couldn’t visit more often and wish we could have stayed in this neighbourhood.
review_3_text: This is my FAVORITE coffee spot in Chiang Mai. First of all, the coffee is so delicious and that's what counts the most.. and second it's not extra to have soy milk. The mugs have a decent size, perfect for me. And the owner is very friendly, the atmosphere chill, lot's of greenery and nice decorations. I enjoy coming here so much! Thank you :)
review_4_text: Awesome coffee, even regardless of the very fair price. Very limited menu, usually means really good quality since easier to manage, not the most expensive coffee machine, but everything maintained well, very cozy environment, and excellent quality of delivery!!
review_5_text: Nice little cafe here, so you can grab yiur coffee, tea, Matcha, or get in and try their cheesecake. Very pleasant with the hospitality here, the girls are amazing and always welcoming with a smile on their faces. I visit often when I'm around. Pop in and get yourself a latte or some refreshments. 🙏💪

name: Eleven Pillar Site Chiangmai
review_1_text:
This is a review of the cafe~

A great place to spend the day working!
Great coffee and delicious food with reasonable prices.
The place is quite with lofi music playing so it doesn't distract you. The WiFi is good and stable.
The staff are great!
They also sell handmade bags and other things
review_2_text: Such a lovely place to stay in Chiang Mai. The hospitality was warm and welcoming, with spacious and spotlessly clean rooms. Complimentary snacks and drinks were thoughtfully provided in the room, along with a cup of free coffee served every morning. The hotel is tucked away on a quiet street yet conveniently close to key attractions. The only minor downside was the weak shower water pressure. Overall, it was a great and enjoyable stay.
review_3_text: Beautiful cafe, owner makes amazing flat white and I love their food too, at affordable prices, great ambience, central yet quiet. People and service are great, they’re friendly but not fake, I appreciate that.
review_4_text: Such a pity that the space is great and the food is actually not too bad, but the service is always lacking. Came three times before I am finally giving this review - and each time it’s been a disappointment. Go next door, the staff working there will at least greet you, and are happy to serve you too.
review_5_text: Nice owner, great breakfast and early check-in. Stayed with my little family and definitely will come back.

name: Tyme.coffee (ไทม์)
review_1_text: The cat!! Coffee very good! But the cat is soooooooo cute! And we also joined a nice khratong class and everybody was very nice!!
review_2_text:
Stayed at the hostel attached to this cafe and both had excellent classy vibes. The cafe itself is very popular during the day to do some travel planning/computer work.
The ice latte is nice and strong.
But my favorite part is the cat named Jun who’s the little boss of the whole establishment.
5 stars all around 💫
review_3_text: Nice coffee and matcha super tasty and great atmosphere too place to see in town
review_4_text: Matcha latte was tasty but not hot enough. Place was nice.
review_5_text: This cafe is connected to the hostel we are stying in and we can definitely recommend both! We got a flat white and a November soda, they are delicious! It’s a perfect spot for a cosy afternoon reading a book or getting some work done! ☕️

name: Coffee Plus
review_1_text: One of the best coffee shops we have been! Owners are the kindest, everything is made on the spot and with love and care. The dirty thai tea: an addictive discovery! We ended up going 2 days straight, and the lady also gave us some recommendations for temples and things to see. Thank you for the coffee and the smiles! Hopefully we will be here soon again 🙏❤️
review_2_text:
My spouse and I stopped here for a slow start morning while in the city. We were greeted by the most warm and kind owners, an amazing vibe with indoor and outdoor seating, and delicious (and I mean delicious) food.
We got an iced latte (half sweet), and hot latte (they offer dairy and non-dairy milk options) and some of the best bites of baked goods yet (all on the menu because it’s a family favorite and baked by the owner’s sister!) the coconut crepe cake was absolutely one of my favorite sweet bites since being in Thailand (and there are a lot of sweet bites here!) and the almond croissant was delectable.
You should not skip this coffee shop!!
review_3_text: A lovely place to grab a coffee, breakfast and start your day in Chiang Mai. The couple that owns the place were so sweet and kind with us and gave us great recommendations for the city. The coffee and food is excellent and the atmosphere is quite peaceful. I highly recommend Coffee Plus!!
review_4_text: First time we were here and we found out this place have very delicious coffee and very friendly staff , comfortable and peaceful 😋😊👍🏻👏🏻🫶🏻✨
review_5_text:
It’s highly recommended for a reason! The couple inside were so sweet and made me feel at home.. I got the Thai style coffee with oat milk and the ham, scrambled egg with the croissant. All the food was very fresh and I was so happily surprised to find out my coffee came with a little cat spoon and coaster, it honestly made my day.

The couple also gave me recommendations of what I could do over the weekend!

Great place to stop for a light meal and coffee. The presentation was lovely, the vibe was great, and the whole place felt like a bit of a hidden gem. I left smiling the whole way back to my hotel.

name: Brewginning Coffee
review_1_text:
This is a must-visit.
If you like a strong, bold taste, this is the coffee you need to try. the outdoor area it’s super chilled and the staff is the sweetest.
I’ve been coming here for three years and the quality is always the same. I also love that they have a stamp card for regular customers.
review_2_text:
Brewginning Coffee is one of Chiang Mai's most popular coffee shops right now, and it’s easy to see why! It has a distinctly trendy social media photo vibe, drawing a large crowd of Chinese, Korean, Japanese, and domestic Thai travellers.
The staff truly elevates the experience; everyone was friendly and served with a warm smile. I ordered an Orange Espresso for my friend, and the presentation was excellent.
If you are looking for a beautiful, vibrant space to enjoy a coffee and capture some great photos, this is your spot. A definite five-star experience!
review_3_text: This coffee shop is famous for its IG spot which offers really great coffee made from great beans. The taste of coffee is strong and a good blend. They have a good inside room for working which is perfect if you work from home or work remotely and away from crowds outside. Staff are friendly and give you good recommendations, try cookies which go well with coffee. I would recommend visiting if you are looking for one of the places for coffee with great IG pics.
review_4_text: My coffee was 10/10. Service and atmosphere was so warm and friendly we would come here everyday if we could. Also really good Thai tea!! Thank you Brewginning!!!
review_5_text: this place is such a great find in Chiang Mai! We stumbled upon it accidentally, but it seems to be a popular spot for pictures and drinks! The people working here are so kind and talented. The coffee is delicious and the vibes at the shop are amazing. Definitely recommend!!

name: GRAPH Cafe
review_1_text:
This is definitely the most creative and innovative cafe in Thailand. I love their spirit and idea of “GRAGH”. Totally agreed their initial thought of naming this brand.

Coffee is just amazing and good mixture and combination with others. I really love this cafe. You can feel their soul and mind. It’s completely different from blue bottle or Starbucks.
review_2_text:
A wonderful cafe in Old Town Chiang Mai. Small and cozy. Super nice staff. Great coffee. The best we’ve had thus far in Chiang Mai. Price is the highest we’ve paid as well.

The space is small and refined rustic. We didn’t have to wait but previously we came and gave up as it didn’t seem tables were going to turn anytime soon. They are using a VBM Espresso Machine. Nice attention to detail.
review_3_text: Graph has to be one of the most innovative coffee shops in the world right now. The craft they put into the drinks - avocado cream in dirty lattes, somehow blending coffee and orange juice together PERFECTLY, it’s super exciting to know that there are people passionately engaged in their craft to this extent. The location in this craft market is also wonderful, chiang mai is one of my favorite places to visit because of this genuine spirit of creativity. Please support Graph, you won’t regret it.
review_4_text:
One of the best coffee experiences I’ve had around the world.
If I could, I would give more than 5 stars ✨
I tried the Lava and their matcha, and both were excellent. The staff is super kind and professional.
A must-try for any coffee lover.
review_5_text: Amazing coffee creations. Like a cocktail without the booze. Small and cozy, a true coffee aficionado dream. We had midtown, soul smith and monochrome. Expensive but worth it for the craftsmanship.

name: Bart Coffee
review_1_text: Bart’s Coffee in Chiang Mai is a gem! A perfect fusion of local blends with a touch of Australian flavor. The coffee is smooth and rich, and the atmosphere is cozy and welcoming. A must-visit for coffee lovers!
review_2_text:
Bartcoffee is a small coffee shop located under a tamarind tree in Soi Muang Mueang, Chiang Mai.

The shop has a cozy interior with seating available both inside and at the bar, and it is located close to a barista. When I visited, I had the Espresso Aroma, which was fantastic, with a fruity taste.

As I sipped on the Dirty Coffee, I was immediately struck by the rich, sweet, and creamy flavor. The homemade syrup added a unique sweetness and depth to the drink, while the chilled milk provided a creamy, refreshing texture.

Overall, I highly recommend trying the Dirty Coffee at Bartcoffee. It's a perfect example of the coffee shop's commitment to quality and creativity, and it's sure to satisfy any coffee lover's taste buds.

Parking may be a bit difficult to find as the coffee shop is located in a small alley, but it makes for a peaceful and quiet atmosphere. If you happen to visit on a cool day in Chiang Mai, it's even better.

Facebook : From The Earth To A Cup
review_3_text:
I had heard that their opening hours can be unpredictable, but fortunately, they were open when I got there
lucky me! They serve an excellent dirty coffee, one of the best I’ve had. I also noticed many Korean customers, which I took as a good sign, as they tend to take their coffee seriously. Overall, a great experience. Highly recommended!
review_4_text: Very very tiny coffeeshop! Cool for pics, good latte. It gets crowded with tourists taking pics just in front of the entrance though…
review_5_text:
Bart Coffee is a small coffee shop that makes some of the best coffee I had in Chiang Mai. The dirty coffee we ordered was smooth, creamy and refreshing! Loved the overall atmosphere of the place, with scribbles and writings from people all over the world.

The barista was really friendly and we could tell he loved his job!

There are some seats inside, but limited.
Great place, also to take photos.

name: Monday__attack
review_1_text: Roomy yet cosy joint with wavy vibes tucked down a small alley. The servings are solid, the service is cheery, and the ambiance makes the menu prices worthwhile. Not all that busy at noon on a weekend.
review_2_text:
Nice location and delicious drink. You can take plenty of pictures here as they decorate it very nice. There is also a photobooth as well, i forgot how much it was but def give it a try.

The only thing i wanna complain was that i bought a drink but my friend wanna use the washroom. They didnt allow her to use it but requested her to buy a drink first. I found it unusual for a coffee shop like this.
review_3_text: Great interior. I really like old TVs showing noice as a design choice! Coffee is alright, the variations are better than the classic choices.
review_4_text:
Thick taste of iced Latte/ Matcha latte. Love it. Can’t miss the vintage deco and chill musics.
btw visit on Thursday, no heart attack by now though
review_5_text: Lovely little café tucked away on a quiet street, decor is great, music and overall ambiance are cool. Coffee is good

name: Starbucks (Thapae)
review_1_text: This Starbucks is in a great location. You can see Chiang Mai's famous ancient buildings from the second floor. No tickets are required. There are flocks of pigeons in front of the door, but I still recommend that you come at night.
review_2_text:
If you’re looking for one of the only places in Chiang Mai that DOESNT have a bidet in the men’s toilet, THIS IS THE PLACE! Even the worst hostels in the city have them installed.

What a disgrace for an international coffee chain!!! Friends don’t let friends drink corporate garbage coffee anyway. Do yourself a favor and get better coffee literally anywhere!
review_3_text:
It’s too crowded to stay.
The drink warms in my hand,
with nowhere to sit.
The restroom is closed,
a sign reads Out of service.
Some people stand on the narrow stair landing,
setting their drinks down to eat.
Only the counter
keeps selling.
review_4_text:
I would like to thank Bell for his kindness and professionalism. What a polite and helpful young gentleman. He actually made my and my wife's visit to Starbucks a real pleasure. This branch overlooks Tha Phae Gate. Its cool, clean and spacious. A great branch 👍.
I actually wanted to get a selfie with Bell but it was rather busy due to Yi Peng festival. Hope you dont mind my capturing your imagine for this review. Thank you 😊 🙏
review_5_text: Great location, right opposite the Thapae Gate. Pleasant staff, happy to please, there does seem to be a lot of people with bags, hogging tables and sat for hours enjoying wifi and cool aircon waiting for checkin time at their Hotels.

name: Ministry of Roasters - Chiang Mai
review_1_text: Really like the coffee here. It is very good. I ordered a Hot Americano, the Director blend (Medium Roast - Honduras). The serving cup was unique. It was deep with enough space to allow the notes and aroma to come through clearly while drinking. Nice!
review_2_text: We had a latte and caramel popcorn and omg, both were sooo good. The coffee itself is just amazing. Team is nice and WiFi is good. They also have a cute back garden where you can take few nice pictures and enjoy a coffee if isn’t too hot. If you’re a coffee lover, this is the place for you!
review_3_text:
Exceptional and complex flavours. These guys have it dialed in….
Can choose your blend of coffee.
Fun space
—it’s the price of eating two local Thai dishes but a treat and experience —
review_4_text: We’ve been spoiled in Thailand for good coffee but this is the *best* cold brew I’ve ever had (and one of the cheapest!). In Dublin I would regularly spend 150 baht or more for a coffee that wouldn’t come close to how good this was. Staff are fantastic, there’s free coffee tasters available as a welcome drink and the design could be something from Copenhagen. A beautiful cafe to spend some time.
review_5_text: very premium beans, good environment but slightly sterile environment. it isnt your usual cosy hipster coffee joint but a highly technical and scientific one - quite different and can be a bit intimidating to those who arent on the deep end. But the beans were really really good! you can definitely trust them for a good cup/ roast

name: millilit cafe
review_1_text:
Do not miss this place! Super cute interior retro decor.

Great coffee and the banofee pie was yummy!

They also sell brand merchandising of their cute dog logo.

They play some chill background music. Good for a working afternoon.

My only issue with this place were the plethora of young, overdressed Gen Zs with too much make-up on treating this place as a studio for their social media photoshoot.
review_2_text:
Absolutely loved Millilit Cafe! It’s got that perfect cool, vintage vibe that makes you feel like you stumbled on a secret spot in Chiang Mai.

We had an iced mocha, flat white, strawberry soda, and a chocolate cookie that did not last long (because… delicious). Drinks were spot-on, the cookie was heavenly, and the little stickers they gave us were such a cute surprise to take home.

Great atmosphere, great coffee, great treats. Millilit Cafe is an easy yes if you love character-filled cafés with personality.
review_3_text: Great coffee shop. Always nice to find a spot where the coffee is solid & the atmosphere feels intentional. You can feel the care behind the experience.
review_4_text:
Vibes are immaculate!

Came by to grab a drink with friends and we love the themes! Great place to relax and catch up & enjoy the design!

Note: make sure each person entering the cafe makes an order — there is a sign outside that says “1 person 1 drink” so just bear that in mind b/c they might remind you when inside.
review_5_text: I love this cafe so much!!!🫶🏻  Aesthetic! Cool! Pls try apple cream soda here, it's so nice 🥤

name: CoolMuang Coffee
review_1_text: I never realized that the tiny building was just where they made the coffee. There are several other areas... all with very comfortable seating ❤️❤️🙏🙏. A very relaxed and comfortable area right in the middle of busy Thae Phae Gate. Good coffee too 😎👍👍. Free parking for bikes and cars too. Wow!
review_2_text: Awesome little coffee shop that serves amazing lattes!! The vibe is really cool with a small outdoor area. Got 3 lattes and 2 water bottles for 260 baht.
review_3_text: Coffee was average. Kinda touristy. Not much to mention. They have indoor and outdoor seatings which was great.
review_4_text:
Absolutely loved this coffee shop! The atmosphere is cozy and inviting — perfect for working, reading, or just relaxing with friends. The staff are super friendly and welcoming. They even offered great recommendations.

I also appreciated the clean space, soft music. Will definitely be coming back again. Highly recommend for anyone looking for quality coffee and a chill vibe!
review_5_text:
CoolMuang is probably on of the best cafes of Chiang Mai.

The coffee is great, the food is fresh and well spiced.
The location and interior is wonderful. You can stay here for some hours, despite its very central location and just enjoy the day and your company.

Nothing is outstandingly wowing, but everything is good.

name: Neighborhood Community
review_1_text: The place to hangout with different food section, bar, soft drink, local beer and many more
review_2_text: Great foodcourt, should get more visitors. Live DJ, several food’trucks’, great pizza, plenty of choice for drinks. Atmosphere is great but even better if more tables would be occupied. One piece of advice, ditch the plastic cutlery and replace with a bit more sturdy cutlery
review_3_text:
This is a typical renovation plan for new old houses.

It's very similar to those small renovations on the Charoen Krung Road in Bangkok.

Re-plan the space of the old house and attract investment

There are many shared spaces in the middle.

It really makes people feel: openness, community, inclusiveness, freedom, relaxation

I like spaces like Bangkok and Chiang Mai very much.

You can sit in it all afternoon.
review_4_text: Came here for Adirak and it is AS GOOD as the Adirak restaurant in Suthep. This place comes with a DJ and other food options. Crazy how quiet this gem of a place is on a Saturday night.
review_5_text: It’s like a community inside with many restaurants combined together. At first I thought you can buy food anywhere inside and use any table there but some seems like they aren’t shared🤔🤔🤔. The restaurant (I forgot the name 😣) near the balcony where we had drinks said we can’t buy food from other shop inside. But some areas I saw they seems to be sharing so I not really sure, I think it’s quite confusing🫨🫨. Not cheap tho…. And no air conditioning here

name: Aob-Sook cafe & restaurant
review_1_text:
Tucked away in a small Soi near Thapai gate.
A small café restaurant which has a good selection of western dishes and croissants.
The shakes are wonderful. However the food though wonderfully presented and cooked felt a little bland. They just needed something more. (taste wise)
Maybe I'm just used to Thai food too much.
Great if you want a quiet place to eat. No car parking. It has motorcycle parking. WiFi
review_2_text: This was probably the best breakfast I've had in... all my life? & I've had a lot of good breakfasts. The bread is AMAZING, both the croissant and the sourdough. The crispy potatoes were heavenly. Drinks amazing. I'm VERY impressed with this place.
review_3_text: A favorite cafe in the old city for delicious fresh baked pastries and superb sourdough breads.  Offering an extensive range of very good coffee drinks, tasty brunch options and many pasta choices as well.  Very lovely staff, talented friendly chef, and an easy atmosphere with inside AC seating and shaded outdoor seating.  Everything we tried was perfectly prepared and plated.
review_4_text: This cafe is awesome, like ABSOLUTE AWESOME! Came here for breakfast & tea time. They have a number of delicious food & drinks. Staff team are really nice people and their service is top notch.
review_5_text: Delicious! This place is so lovely. Great food, atmosphere and service. I feel like a lot of places don’t do food and coffee well, but they sure do! So considerate of allergens as well!

name: Spice Garden Cafe
review_1_text: We discovered the Spice garden while wandering around the back streets. And we went back the next night. It is just such a beautiful place to sit and enjoy the amazing cocktails and food. We felt our children were very welcome and the garden is big enough that there is plenty of space for them to play safely. Gorgeously kept gardens and atmospheric lighting in the evening with lovely indoor-outdoor spaces. A Special mention should go to the lovely staff, especially Pun - an absolute star.
review_2_text:
The coffee tastes like dark roasted bean. Usually I prefer light roast more.
The scone with jams is good.
Food is delicious.
Service here is excellent. Staffs are very nice and supportive.
Seats in the garden or indoor are both comfortable.
review_3_text: I stopped by here for coffee since I saw a very nice garden. I tried cappuccino and latte and both are below average quality. The space is very nice and vibe is good, so you may wanna try something else on the menu. It’s still a well located nice spot to chill though.
review_4_text:
The setting was lovely and the staff very friendly and polite. However, I was sat waiting to order a drink for about ten minutes when I arrived. We tried to start ordering food and kept being asked to wait until all the group had arrived. As one of the guests is notorious for turning up late we didn't want to wait, we also didn't want to bombard the kitchen with 14 orders at the same time, Thai restaurants are never able to serve all dishes at once in any case. In the end, our latecomer was served his food first, despite arriving after the rest of us had ordered.
The prawn salad was actually 2 prawns and a little bit of yellow pepper in bone marrow. It was very nice, but the word salad is misleading and several people thought the combination of prawns and beef marrow was odd. The seabass was delicious and the espresso choux pastry got compliments from everyone who tried it. Overall, the set menu was good value.
We were given a round of mocktails to celebrate my birthday, which was a nice touch.
I can't fault the attitude of the staff, they were all very pleasant and it's not easy dealing with such a large group. The food was interesting and well-presented, I think we would have spent a lot more on drinks if the staff had been more attentive, but as it was our bill was reasonable.
review_5_text:
New Find Dining restaurant in Chiang Mai,
"French Indochine concept"
Taste of food is super!! with very nice selection of wine.

name: Eurana Cafe & Restaurant
review_1_text:
We went to this place for lunch and dinner on separate days, and the food did not disappoint. We had different local dishes such as Khao Soi, and everything tasted great. The fried noodles on top of the Khao Soi were very crispy and the curry tasted great (although a little spicy for my tastebuds, but nothing I couldn't manage).

The atmosphere was relaxed and we even sat down to play cards before leaving.

The price for food and drinks were most reasonable - quite inexpensive actually.

This is also the place where I've hands down have had THE best Italian soda in Thailand. My favourite is the one with peach and butterfly pea. It comes with small bits of gelly (which:at first glance seemed a little odd, but I actually really liked it). The syrup used for this Italian soda just tastes better and more like actual fruit than the synthetic syrups used in many other places. We would absolutely come back if we are ever in Chiang Mai.
review_2_text: A great quiet place with very calm environment and very good food. Great for remote workers. Great for those who want to sit down and have not entirely street food. Good for groups who are divided on food choices - here you will get both Thai and international dishes. One of the photo - club sandwich. Or, more precisely, leftovers - my partner ate it faster than I took a photo.
review_3_text: I was staying at the hotel and decided to try the cafe. The food was excellent, pad Thai was one of the best I've had in Thailand. My only issue is the container for the soup. It was in one of the square containers, I don't even know if it was food safe plastic. A bowl would have been much better.
review_4_text: Came here to use the self service laundry as I only had a few hours before my bus. 40 baht for a 14 minute wash, 10 baht for washing powder, 40 baht for 90 minute dry. There are signs up stating that clothes may need two cycles to be fully dry and that there are no refunds. I thought after 90 minutes my clothes would be mostly dry with some damp bits which would have been fine but most of them were still soaking wet. I didn’t have time for another 90 minute dry as they don’t offer anything shorter so I had no choice but to pack up my wet clothes. The cafe itself is nice to sit in while you wait and they have free wifi and nice coffee.
review_5_text: The best breakfast restaurant I have ever been to. The food is fresh, generous, and beautifully served. Their hot chocolate is absolutely amazing: rich, sweet in the perfect way, and truly addictive. The atmosphere is calm and pleasant from the moment you walk in. Pang is a lovely woman who gives service from the heart, with a warm smile and real care. A perfect place to start your day. Highly recommended.

name: Na Pia Cafe & Restaurant (Halal)
review_1_text: The atmosphere is very peaceful and the food is great. The owners are Muslims so you can feel assured that the food is halal. The owner is really kind and gave us information about the food we ordered as well as information about the area. The prices are very fair. 100% recommended especially if you are looking for halal food in Chiang Mai in the old town. There's also a masjid within walking distance.
review_2_text: We ventured to Na Pia for our first meal in Chiang Mai and were so pleased with the food and the service here. We ordered chicken tom yum soup with rice, chicken panang, and avo toast with egg and we thoroughly enjoyed all that we ordered. The coconut smoothie was also very fresh and delicious.
review_3_text:
Na Pia Cafe & Restaurant (Halal) is in an excellent location right near Tha Phae Gate, making it a super convenient stop while exploring Chiang Mai’s Old City. Easy to walk to, quiet enough to relax, and a great break spot between sightseeing, temples, and markets.

The food is halal, tasty, and well priced for such a central area. Portions are solid, prices are reasonable, and the atmosphere is relaxed and comfortable. Friendly service and a dependable option if you want a good meal without overpaying in a tourist-heavy area.
review_4_text: Quiet and friendly family-run spot within Vieng Mantra hotel. Great value delicious Thai and western food for breakfast, lunch and dinner.  Takeaway available. Highly recommended!
review_5_text:
This restaurant is inside Vieng Mantra hotel and offers AirCon upon request. It’s clean but a little non-descript.
Several choices for breakfast /lunch/ dinner, the old menu shows pictures of each food which makes it easier to decide.
Korean chicken came out hot and flavorful after about 10 minutes.
Overall a pleasant experience but a bit expensive at close to THB 200 pP.

name: de forest @ NIDHRA CAFE
review_1_text:
I came here for breakfast and had a really pleasant experience. The food was nutritious, fresh, and delicious — a great way to start the day.

Highlights
• Well-balanced and tasty breakfast
• Fresh ingredients and light, clean flavors
• Quiet and comfortable atmosphere in the morning
• The owner is very kind and welcoming
• We were even given a small elephant pouch as a gift — such a thoughtful touch

Overall
If you’re looking for a cozy and quality breakfast spot, this place is definitely worth a visit. Good food, relaxing vibes, and warm hospitality made it a lovely experience.
review_2_text: The food was amazing - beautiful and tasty! We were 5 people, we tried everything: French toast, waffle, eggs, yogurt, smoothie…everything was delicious
review_3_text: Such a cute cafe with very attentive staff. The food was very reasonably priced, delicious and fresh and we were provided complimentary alphabet biscuits and ice water. Come hungry, because the servings are very generous! I mean take a look at the photos of the plates - loaded with fresh fruit!
review_4_text:
The French-toast and fruit is very pretty but hardly has any flavor.
Better for instagram picture than a culinary experience.
The seating is outdoors next to an extremely busy road so the noise is a problem.
review_5_text: OON Cafe is absolutely delightful! It felt very cozy, and the staff were very hospitable to boot. The owner checked on me to make sure I had enough water, had condiments for my meal, and talked with me.  The cafe was decorated with a cute design. The food was extremely delicious and well presented!!! 5 stars!!!

name: Café de Chill in CNX
review_1_text:
Egg-cellent!!! I got the bacon sandwich and added a fried egg. The egg was cooked beautifully. Presentation lovely. The owner is so sweet and accommodating. Coming back to try her pancakes.
Atmosphere is cozy, a little warm, but there are some fans. A lot of art to look at.
review_2_text:
Had an amazing breakfast here!
The coffee was very nice, and Bas gave one of the best fruit pancakes I’ve ever had!
And she topped it off with extra fruits she had!
It’s a very cozy place with a lot of options for a nice quick breakfast!
And extremely well priced (underpriced for the value she gives honestly!)

Bas runs this place alone and she also paints!! The place is full of small paintings she’s made over the last couple of years! A very personal touch that makes it feel like home!

10/10 would recommend going there for a few bites!
review_3_text: My favorite cafe in Chiang Mai. The food is made fresh and SO delicious, and the coffee is really good. You will love the lady who runs the place. She is so nice and will make you feel so welcomed.
review_4_text: Amazing food! Very good price and you can chose the toppings of your sandwich. The lady that works there is so sweet and nice!!!! Really loved this place :)
review_5_text: The café is definitely the nicest one in Chiangmai. We came here almost everyday on our trip. First of all, it is super lovely decorated with amazing paintings painted by the owner and many many cute pandas. The food is super nice and the Coconut Latte is a must try if you come here. And as if this wouldn‘t be a reason to come here already, I should mention that the owner is one of the nicest and warm-hearted persons ever, we talked to her a lot while we were and enjoyed every bit of it. Also she speaks English, German and Japanese on top of Thai which is super impressive.

name: Coffee & Snack by Zeam & Gain & Gail
review_1_text: Nice little cafè that also serves a lot of craft beer options. You can sit inside, but there is also nice seating facing Tha Pae Gate which allows you to just sit and watch the atmosphere around. The prices are good and the staff is friendly. I can recommend this place.
review_2_text:
Nice restaurant, a lot of foreigners,
prices are higher than other local restaurants, but the food is good.
Only thing that bothered us were the non-fresh Croissants in the morning.
review_3_text: Absolutely rude staffs, never had this kind of experience in Thailand
review_4_text: Avoid this place that treats customers extremely bad, they don't even give you a glass of water even if you need to take a medicine. The service as well it is disappointing and unorganized. Food is not bad, but there is plenty of nicer places around, cheaper as well and attended by human beings that care about yourself
review_5_text: The staff at the cashier counter is bad customer service and rude.I’ll never come back to your shop again .

name: IN TOWN Cafe 2 - อินทาวน์คาเฟ่ สาขาท่าแพ
review_1_text: I ate earlier and I like the vibe. It’s a good place to eat if you wanna take a break with Thai food. delicious and the shake was refreshing. The people serving were very nice too
review_2_text:
We happened to stumble upon this cafe while killing time before our Airbnb check-in, and it turned out to be a highlight of our trip.
The space is small and charming, with a cozy atmosphere that instantly made us feel at home. The staff were incredibly polite and welcoming—their genuine kindness was exactly what we needed while waiting with our luggage. It’s a peaceful little sanctuary, and I’m so glad we found it. A perfect spot to slow down and enjoy the moment
review_3_text: Wow wow!!!! Amazing dark roast coffee. Food was a pleasant surprise. Amazing value. The staff was so amazing. Hom provided great service. My new regular coffee shop in the old city.
review_4_text: I absolutely loved this place. The coffee is super delicious ☕️, and the breakfast sets are great — everything is prepared quickly and tastes amazing. The music is nice, and I loved the lively street atmosphere in the background. It was a perfect spot to enjoy breakfast with my family.
review_5_text: Great spot for breakfast - they do oat milk with all their drinks. We had the egg sandwich and coconut toast with mango and both were great. Definitely recommend.

name: Vigie Sist Cafe
review_1_text:
Best breakfast in Chiang Mai. Beautiful rustic cafe where all bread and cakes are homemade. Staff were extremely polite and accommodating.
Food is also very reasonably priced and cheaper than many nearby breakfast places while being of much higher quality.
Homemade chocolate shokupan bread with cream/ ice cream and homemade focaccia breakfast plate. Even the jam was homemade!
Total meal including a coffee, fresh smoothie and brownie to go came to just over 400 baht.
review_2_text:
Overall a very nice cafe with some very cozy seating!
The staff is very friendly and outlooking. The cappuccino is 60 baht, which is a very reasonable price. They also offer a wide selection of breakfast. Seems to be good!
review_3_text:
stopped by Vigiesist by chance, and I’m so glad I did! The place is super cozy and charming. I had a bagel here - honestly one of the most delicious bagels I’ve had in a long time, and it’s homemade! You absolutely have to try it.
The staff are also incredibly kind and friendly. Highly recommend!
review_4_text:
Vigie Sist Cafe is truly a hidden gem in Chiang Mai! A lovely cafe owned and run by a wonderful mother and daughter team — they are always so warm and friendly, and they make you feel right at home the moment you walk in.

The space is cosy and filled with personal touches, charming decorations, and artworks that create such a comfortable atmosphere. I had their spinach omelette with toast for breakfast — healthy, tasty, and made with so much care. The toast and jam are homemade by the lady boss, and they are absolutely delicious!

I enjoyed my breakfast here almost every morning during my last two trips to Chiang Mai — that’s how much I love this place. Highly recommended for anyone looking for a homely, heartwarming cafe experience. ❤️🍳☕️
review_5_text: A place to relax and chill. Their coffee is great as with their brownies. There are many good Cafe in Chiang Mai, this is one of them. Most importantly, their staffs very friendly and helpful.

name: Again.cafe
review_1_text:
Coffee, vintage treasures, and cozy vibes ☕✨

I discovered this lovely café that combines two of my favorite things: really good coffee and stylish second-hand fashion. While enjoying a delicious cup of coffee, you can browse through unique vintage clothes, rings, earrings, and sunglasses, all at super affordable prices.

The atmosphere is warm and cozy, perfect for spending a quiet afternoon, reading, getting some work done, or simply unwinding. Every detail is thoughtfully curated, and it truly feels like a little haven for vintage lovers.

Definitely a place you’ll want to come back to again and again 💫
review_2_text: Great little cafe with AC. Chill vibe inside with 2 charming Hostess and Barista. Service was warm, friendly, and quick. Prices are good, iced Thai milk tea for 55b.
review_3_text:
Good atmosphere and seemed very clean.
The coffee and food options need to improve
review_4_text: Cute cafe with cute interiors and friendly baristas.
review_5_text: Very cute cafe and a welcome respite from the heat during the day. Inviting atmosphere and super friendly staff, tasty yuzu soda that came just right in sweetness when ordered less sweet. Some sweet treats available.

name: I Coffee
review_1_text: This has become my go to coffee shop while in Chiang Mai. Great coffee with fair price. It is a stall on the street in the Lanna market so plenty to watch while enjoying their excellent coffee. The staff is super friendly.
review_2_text:
Top quality coffee for a super cheap price. They've got all the equipment like a barista does.

I was pleasantly surprised to see how well they prepared my iced cappuccino. Great espresso shot topped with milk & milk foam. They even added a pinch of coffee grind on top for decoration.

It's an ideal place for takeaway coffee. Loved this place.
review_3_text:
This is my husband and I's favorite cafe in ChiangMai so far.🤣

Owner here is so friendly and welcoming, she will remember your preferences and adjust your drinks accordingly. We stopped by almost every morning during our week-long stay in ChiangMai this time.

The cappuccino and Thai tea are amazing! (remember to ask for less sugar). It's incredible to be able to enjoy such good drinks at this price.🤤
review_4_text: Amazing coffee in Chiang Mai for a fair price. The barista here knows exactly what she's doing, and besides she's super nice and friendly. If you like and appreciate good quality coffee, you should come here!
review_5_text:
There are 3 super cheap (below 40 baht) coffee stall nearby: Hom coffee, Prem coffee and I coffee.

Tried all of them and I would say I coffee is the best and smoothest coffee I ever had in cnx.

Supported them alot of time and never get disappointed, I recommended you to do the 'iced green tea with milk', that's a hidden gemin the shop!

The guy owner can speak English and very polite and friendly to talk with.

You may visit or take a lunch in the market opposite then stop for their perfect drinks 💯

name: Rich Homemade Cake Changmoi
review_1_text:
The BEST coconut pandan cake I've ever tried in my life (and I've tried many - I'm southeast Asian). Bits of coconut flesh in the custard cream is the cherry on top. No notes.

It was so good I bought the Thai tea brown sugar cake and a coconut cake to take-away, but it doesn't come close to how good the pandan cake is. Still definitely worth trying if you love coconut or Thai tea.

Everyone NEEDS to try the pandan cake here.
review_2_text:
Such a cozy and beautifully designed café! The atmosphere is warm and relaxing with its wooden interiors, soft lighting, and clean minimalist layout. The space feels very open and comfortable — perfect for studying, working, or just enjoying a quiet coffee break.

The pastry display looks amazing and everything is neatly presented. Staff are friendly and welcoming. I really like the attention to detail in the decor — simple but stylish, with a nice mix of rustic and modern touches. Definitely a great spot to chill or meet friends. Highly recommended!
review_3_text:
A cozy, minimalist café with a calm soul. Warm wood everywhere, soft light and that peaceful atmosphere where time seems to slow down 🌿
I ordered a coconut coffee and it was really good: smooth, well balanced, with a subtle tropical touch that fits Chiang Mai perfectly 🥥✨
A lovely place to sit, think, read, or simply enjoy the moment.
📍 Chiang Mai
💭 Would definitely come back ☺️😍
review_4_text: This was my second visit, after my first time in April 2025. This place serves the best dirty coffee I’ve found in Chiang Mai so far. The coconut pandan cake is a must-order and, in my opinion, the best item on the menu. The cake is fragrant, not overly sweet, and has pieces of coconut meat in the cream, which adds a great texture. I recommend visiting on a weekday or at a time when most people wouldn’t usually have dessert, as it can get quite crowded.
review_5_text:
Such a cozy little spot with a beautifully warm, wooden interior and soft natural light.
The cakes are excellent: not overly sweet, well-balanced, and genuinely delicious. The coffee is just as good

name: MITTE MITTE Chiangmai - Cafe & Brunch
review_1_text:
A really nice café with a warm, welcoming vibe and super friendly staff. The coffee was good, and while the food was decent, it wasn’t particularly memorable.

There were five of us, so we ordered a variety of dishes to share—overall solid but nothing that really stood out. The smoothies were quite good though and worth ordering.

A pleasant spot for a relaxed coffee or casual brunch, especially if you’re in the area.
review_2_text: Almost everything here is exquisite, but my true favorites are the pavlova, the bagel Chang Moi katsu, and the smoked salmon sourdough. Every time I return to Chiang Mai, these are the flavors I crave. It’s more than just good food, it’s the familiarity and quiet comfort of coming back to something you love. Each visit feels a little like coming home.
review_3_text:
I decided to visit Mitte Mitte cause it was right next to my accommodation and I'm glad I did! I had a Chang Moi Katsu Bagel and it was really tasty. The waitress kindly informed me that the sausage in it is a bit spicy and - as a person who avoids spicy stuff - it was indeed :D but definitely bearable, especially with a glass of cold drink.
The waitresses were all really lovely and I have to appreciate the music there too - when I was there they played covers of popular songs, but in really pleasant, soft acoustic versions. Overall a great experience  🤍
review_4_text: Great place for brunch! Not a lot of people but food is superb. What we ordered: wonton nachos, lemony angel hair with crab meat (pasta), avocado smoothie, big brekkie, spring salad. These all are great and all are recommended.
review_5_text: Fantastic brunch spot. Really great friendly and knowledgeable service. Cool twists on classic western brunch favourites. Drinks are delicious. It's cheap considering the quality of the food and beverage. Can't wait for next weekend. Thanks Mitte Mitte!!!

name: The Story 106 Co-Working Space &Cafe
review_1_text:
Very quiet café, perfect for working or reading. The atmosphere is calm and cozy, ideal if you’re looking for a place to focus without distractions. Right next door there’s a lovely shop selling wooden accessories and small handcrafted items, perfect for home decor or as thoughtful gifts.
The staff is very friendly and welcoming. I ordered an organic cacao and it was delicious. Definitely a place to come back to 🧋☕🍪💕😊🫶
review_2_text:
Got the whole space to ourselves on a Saturday morning at Level 1. Started the day with their bakes and coffee.

Presentation of food when served was nice, but the food was so-so. WiFi credentials are only provided after payment is made. Latency is fast!

Credit cards are accepted, though there is a 3% surcharge for card payments.
review_3_text: A charming, quiet, and private co-working space — perfect for boosting productivity and creativity. The coffee is excellent, and the breakfast is a great bonus. Highly recommended for anyone seeking focus and inspiration.
review_4_text:
My favorite cafe for work!
The second floor is mostly a co-working space! You just need to buy a drink and they give you the Wi-Fi password.
It’s very comfortable, silent and the internet is pretty good.
review_5_text:
Really enjoyed .. Good Coffee and nice place
The upstairs space is calm and quiet, ideal for working, with comfortable seating.
A great spot to sit, focus, and enjoy a good cup of coffee.

name: Makad Rooftop
review_1_text: Beautiful rooftop terrace with lovely views to watch the city sunset. There is a wide variety of drinks at very good prices, which makes it even better. The atmosphere is relaxed and pleasant, perfect for enjoying a drink while the sun goes down. Definitely a great spot to spend the evening 🌄🌅🌜⭐✨
review_2_text:
We visited Makad Rooftop to watch the sunset 🌅
There are a few flights of stairs to reach the top, but my mum—who has mobility issues—was able to take them slowly.

We ordered our food and drinks downstairs before heading up.
The outdoor area was lovely, with plenty of space and a mix of tables, chairs, and comfy sofas to relax on.

The food was fine—just what you’d expect for some light, picky bits—and the atmosphere was great. We really enjoyed watching the sunset, even if a big block of flats was right in the way 😂
review_3_text: This cafe offers a truly magical atmosphere. The beautiful rooftop provides an exceptional view, and the weather here is just perfectly cool and breezy. It’s the ideal escape for a relaxed, intimate conversation with your significant other. The soulful background music makes everything feel fresh and utterly delightful. A breath of fresh air!
review_4_text: This hostel is so amazing I really love the rooftop area the best. The vibes are so comfy and at night you can see the starts for perfectly. And then if you go out on a night out coming back to watch the sunrise is a bookmark worthy moment for your travel stories ☀️ also get a soju bucket from the bar ❤️ also the location of this hostel is in the perfect area for the old town of chiang mai to walk around and explore the town.
review_5_text:
such a great hostel to stay at, cheap prices, great atmosphere and the rooftop is the best.

and the owner GARY, he’s the best guy. He made sure everything was perfect, even provided extra towel and water for my trip, I’ll be surely staying here again.

name: The Goodcery
review_1_text: Stepping into this restaurant felt like entering a different world. The live violin music added such a beautiful touch to the atmosphere. Truly enjoyed my time here, especially as it was a wonderful escape from the heat outside.
review_2_text:
This cafe and restaurant is a charming, cozy spot offering a delightful selection of food and high-quality grocery products from various regions in Thailand.

The coffee is exceptional, and the food is truly outstanding with good portion. It's not easy to find a restaurant that excels at preparing dishes from different regions, making this place a rare gem. The staff are not only friendly but also attentive and well-informed.

Additionally, the restaurant boasts an extensive array of exceptional products sourced from many provinces. I was particularly impressed with the quality of the honey lip balm and sea salt I purchased.

To top it off, in the evenings, they host enchanting live music performances featuring instruments such as the violin and guitar. It adds a wonderful touch to the overall experience.
review_3_text:
A shockingly impressive discovery!   The menu is Burmese known for dishes with salty, sour, bitter, and spicy.  The watermelon w/ the Burmese sauce was spicy bitter salty and sweet a unique and powerful combination making it a must try.   The others we tried was the smoked eggplant dip w/ cucumber again a powerful tasting dish absolutely loved it.  Their meat is meticulously picked out from only one approved vendor to ensure quality and value.  The item is their flank steak and again w/ an exceptional Burmese flavorful sauce.  We ordered another one being it was so amazingly tender and good.
They also try to specialize in offering only organic wines that use very low sulphites sparingly. A+.  We questioned why Michelin hasn’t uncovered this place yet, but being their fairly new it would probably likely explain it.  The sauces make it a gem of a find, really incredible highly recommend!
review_4_text:
Had low expectations for the food but we were genuinely surprised how good it was. Think they're going for traditional Thai dishes, beautifully presented and served in a slight upscale way.

Portions are decent, and the flavour is amazing. The pork jowl was well cooked, nice and soft with a torched exterior. The underlying sticky rice was quite spicy and flavourful. The fried chicken was salty and crispy but a small portion.

The place also serves as a shop for local products from Whisky, Rum and Thai Spirits to honey, spices and rice flour.
review_5_text: Nice modern space that looks newly built. The sailing is high and the vibe is great. There is also a large terrace area inside. They bake their bread here and their food also looks great. It is a very nice cafe, but it would be also nice to have a brunch. The bathroom is super clean as well. There are many workable tables, but the power outlet is very limited.

name: JAI LOY CAFE & ROOFTOP
review_1_text:
Poor Value Accommodation! READ the negative reviews...
