I don't know how this place can be rated so highly on Agoda, Booking and Google. I suspect this place has paid an internet company to boost it's ratings by giving fake high ratings. I observed 3 or 4 high ratings put in within 1 minute on google reviews most likely by the same person on the evening I stayed there.

The staff are so unmotivated and take hotel guests as intruders when we want to go back to our rooms. There are so many things wrong with this place ...rooms with no windows, super hard beds, dark and dim rooms resembling a jail cell!

The rooftop bar had only 1 table occupied at 8pm on the Friday/Saturday that i went up to take a look. There was a couple in the same lift as me coming down probably deciding the rooftop bar was not worth their baht...

To be fair some of the staff do try to make yr stay more pleasant but the systemic issues with the place are too extreme.

The owner should really take a hard look and stay in the "hotel" to understand the issues or maybe he/she doesn't care and just wants to keep the place afloat.

This is the worst accommodation i have ever stayed in Thailand and I felt so deceived by the high ratings to stay here!
review_2_text:
Jai Loy is our favorite hangout place in Chiang Mai. Amazing and friendly staff which makes the rooftop bar an extraordinary experience. Food and drinks are priced cheaply with high quality.

We, especially, are always enjoying the sunset at around 6 to 7pm when the sun decends behind the mountain: priceless!

A must go place when in Chiang Mai enjoying a relaxed and chilled atmosphere.
review_3_text: Had a pleasant and  Satisfying evening with a Mountain and city combination view . The Pad Thai with shrimp  I ate was super delicious and remind me that’s the way what the real taste it is . The most important for me is where the music goes incredibly rhythmic matched right to  beautiful evening with a hint gold  of sunset 🌇 🌄✨💡🛟🚤⚓️ was feeling Right choice of music and rolling my one fine evening while i’m  there. ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
review_4_text:
At first I was thinking if the place will be noisy because there is rooftop bar on 5th floor and cafe on the 1st floor, but surprisingly the room was quiet! Room also clean and smells good. I stayed in a private room on the 2nd floor with shared bathroom, and the bathroom was clean.

Location is perfect, many good places that we can reach by walking distance.

Only 1 small feedback, because we have to take off our own shoes or slippers, it will be great if the accommodation can also provide slipper in the room or for us to walk around the communal area 🙏🏻
review_5_text:
Mixed review.

We booked the same day as we were quite limited on places available in our budget, they kindly let us check in early for no charge which was great. The only room available was the standard room with no window, at £25 a night. The bed was comfy but the room was quite dingy and smelt musty. The bathroom as well had the typical sewage smell that is all too often here. Plus the A/C spat out smelly air. I think these things wouldn’t have been a problem if we had spent maybe £10 less per night, but as Thailand has so many budget stays this was one of the more expensive budget rooms but it was not reflected in the quality.
This is not to say don’t stay here it’s just a reflection of the standard room with no window, as for the price you can get better (if you book in advance not like us).

Apart from that the staff were nice and there is great seating areas down stairs and on the rooftop with a sunset view. The prices were quite expensive on the rooftop though, I suppose due to the view.

name: Blue & Teak eatery. Stay. Space
review_1_text:
I absolutely loved the time I spent here! The vibe is so positive, especially with the large glass windows looking out onto the street. It feels very peaceful with the minimalist wooden decor.

The menu is varied and reasonably priced. I ordered the Caesar salad, and as a baker and pastry chef myself, I have to say the sourdough bread was excellent! I also had the overnight oats with fruit and honey. It was delicious and packed with vitamins and fiber to start the day.

The service was impeccable: fast, and the waitresses were incredibly kind and kept smiling the whole time. The place is spotless. I highly recommend it!
review_2_text: Visited this place three times during our four day stay in Chiang Mai. Absolutely loved it. Staff super super friendly. Very nice vibe. Food was fantastic. My regular one was the creme cheese salmon croissant. My family had a few sour dough options - tried them all and absolutely fantastic. Highly recommended!
review_3_text:
This is a really lovely cafe with excellent food and warm service! It is run by really nice and hardworking people who serve with high quality standards in mind.

The food was overall really delicious and of good quality! A special mention for the Thai Basil Aglio Olio! I was craving for a good aglio olio and Blue & Teak’s was perfect with a special hint of local flavors. The penne was a little overcooked for my liking but the tomato sauce and sausage was super yummy! I loved everything I ate here and even went twice so I could try more. Their menu was well-designed by the chef and the food was of high quality.

I highly recommend Blue & Teak if you need yummy food with great and friendly service and a cosy atmosphere to people watch or to chill. The location is really great too as there are cute streets and shops nearby!
review_4_text: Wonderful experience! We had the French toast and the egg bacon croissant. Everything we ate was delicious and the staff were so kind and attentive.  I wish I could remember our servers name, she was so sweet and kind. Definitely recommend.
review_5_text:
I had such a lovely experience at Blue & Teak Café. The vibe is cozy, bright, and welcoming — the kind of place that instantly makes you feel relaxed the moment you step in.

I ordered their yogurt bowl and hot chocolate, and both were amazing. The yogurt bowl was beautifully presented with fresh fruits, crunchy granola, and a generous portion of yogurt. It tasted just as good as it looked. The hot chocolate was rich and smooth, with the cutest floral latte art on top — such a thoughtful touch.

The café itself has this charming, homey atmosphere with a mix of wood, greenery, and soft colors. It’s perfect for a slow morning, getting some work done, or just enjoying a peaceful moment alone. Staff were friendly and attentive without being intrusive.

Overall, Blue & Teak is a hidden gem — simple, delicious, and full of warmth. I’ll definitely be coming back. 💙✨

name: Tar Sawang Coffee At Tha phae - กาแฟ ตาสว่าง สาขาท่าแพ
review_1_text:
Great little cafe near Tha Phae Gate.
Very friendly staff and good coffee!
Nice decoration and great outdoor seating. They also offer some bakery goods and other snacks. Not to pricey as well.
review_2_text: The carefully brewed coffee here is truly special. With its bright atmosphere featuring wood tones and orange accents, it’s a popular spot where many people gather for a coffee break!
review_3_text: Cozy little coffee shop! ☕️ 85 baht for a yummy iced oat milk caramel macchiato. I enjoyed working on my laptop here - fast wifi and trendy coffee shop music.
review_4_text:
we got the canele, and breakfast sets for food and strawberry latte & orange espresso for drinks.

they offer four types of blends & you can choose a blend for your coffee! we picked the "santa lucia" blend and there was a very fragrant, pleasant floral scent to the coffee. we loved how it paired with the orange flavour. the strawberry latte was really great too, and i loved the subtle taste of strawberry in my coffee.

Overall we loved the atmosphere of the cafe, and the two cats that they have are very entertaining and lovely!
review_5_text: it's really lovely cofe shop, the colour of the furniture very relaxing .the coffee was taste good.I like studying here.

name: Chapter 2WO
review_1_text: What an incredible hidden gem. Its down a little side road. Its a little jungle/forset setting. Very welcoming and green. The music is great. The coffee flavor is bold but not bitter. The atmosphere makes me want to sit here forever. They also have big turtles!!!!! Like alive turtles doing turtle things in a big pit. 12/10 recommend oh and the prices are great and the coffee art is beautiful
review_2_text: Best iced latte Ive had in CNX. Lovely garden-industrial hipster flaired area to sit. Flowering vines, zebra doves, squirrels in trees, collared petable cats- and even a good-sized tortoise who gave me a look as I went over to him. Friendly staff, nice chill ambiance. Reminds me of coffee places back home.
review_3_text: I’ve put this coffee shop on my Google map for a long time, but didn’t get the chance to go. Today went there with friends and we really enjoyed the atmosphere! The cats were very cute, I’ll definitely go there again!
review_4_text:
Peaceful green heaven.  I am not sure if a 5 star review and attracting more people here is a good idea but it is just beautiful.
Don't confuse with the neighbours... this place is better 😂
review_5_text: Cozy and quiet café with a lovely green space surrounded by plants. Good coffee and friendly staff. Perfect place to relax with a coffee and read a book 🫖☕🍰🍮

name: SipSpot
review_1_text: A very good coffee place with good vibes but also: the owner’s attitude to the clients. It’s like coming to someone’s home. I liked the details there and the taste. The only suggestion would be to make espresso as the last drink in the queue cuz I came with a friend who ordered flat white and when my espresso arrived it wasn’t hot but warm. Anyway, I’m extremely happy to visit this place and wanna come again!
review_2_text: Highly recommended. 1. I asked before ordering if the cold brew is light roasted, she said yes, but it turns out to be dark roasted and too bitter for me. She immediately made another coffee for me without any hesitation for free. 2. The new coffee, which is the lab sip, it’s good. 3. It’s very chill, sitting by the roadside but it’s not hot at all
review_3_text: The Arabica coffee roasted just nice and perfect taste with flavourful aroma... Just happened to walk by this shop and the ambience and the smell of the coffee captire my attention...  try out whenever you around this area...
review_4_text: One of the best flat whites that i have had in a while… and its open late which is nice for me who drinks coffee even at night
review_5_text: I ordered affogato and the espresso was perfect!As a coffee consultant from the Philippines who also advocate supporting local farmers, it's good to know that SipSpot used 100% local beans  from Thailand.

name: 選品衣服Lyke&Lia
review_1_text: One of the million ice creams I really like. The ice cream is delicious, the bread is even more delicious, you can feel it. The shop also has a delicious breakfast. But as I said, the small comment is that their desserts have a lot of variety and almost every menu is delicious. The shop has cute clothes and home decorations. The clothes sold in the shop and home decorations are from Chiang Mai, they are Chiang Mai brands. You can park at Wat Duang Dee next to the shop. It is decorated and is another shop that is recommended.
review_2_text: True authentic craft ice cream. I’m a big fan of homemade ice cream and I love trying all kind of flavors from classics to creative seasonal ones. This ice cream parlor has mastered all the flavors! I love the hockey pokey, pistachio(with homemade pistachio sauce!) and the yuzu ones. They also have really good coffee and seasonal refreshing drinks. The cafe also offers cute handmade clothing and ceramic goods. If you are walking around Chang Moi area, this place is a must. You won’t be disappointed (I went back three times in two days)
review_3_text: A charming craft ice cream shop offering refreshing drinks and unique ice cream flavors. A lovely place to sit, relax, and escape the heat for a while.
review_4_text:
Such a cool little place and even better ice cream.

They will even give you a taste test before choosing your perfect scoop. My daughter loved it.
review_5_text: Everything made here is to a high quality. Beautiful textures and harmonious flavours. If you're looking for a high quality Thai Western dinner, come here after indulging at Paper Butter on the Roof.

name: sripingbar coffee
review_1_text: Found this quiet coffee bar that’s definitely a hidden gem near the local market. I ordered double brown macchiato and my partner tried the tamarind bomb and they went beyond our expectations! Price is also super amazing. Will definitely return to this place!
review_2_text:
Very good place to have a hot or cold drink.  I strongly recommend it!
Original drinks too.
The owner is very nice!
review_3_text:
Tucked away in a quiet corner of Chiang Mai's bustling Chinatown, Sriping Bar is a hidden gem. This cozy spot serves excellent coffee, a perfect refuge from the vibrant streets.

The owner's warm hospitality made us feel right at home. He kindly allowed us to enjoy our outside food on the premises.

Although the space is compact, the owner's background as an architect shines through in the thoughtful design and unique touches throughout.

A must-visit for coffee lovers seeking a tranquil oasis in the heart of Chinatown!
review_4_text: Good coffee at cheap prices. Just one min walk from Warorot market. Great place to stop by and enjoy a good cup of coffee.
review_5_text:
Enjoyed this place for the smoothest coffee I’ve had in a long time.  I ordered a mocha and an orange juice while my husband had a cappuccino honey pickle and a tamarind bomb.

All were very good, although the tamarind bomb was sweeter than expected.

name: Stations cafe'
review_1_text:
Beautiful place with beautiful ladies.
Very enjoyable 😌🙂

name: Kadluang Cafe & Roaster
review_1_text:
I honestly can’t say enough good things about this place. The coffee is consistently excellent, expertly roasted, beautifully brewed, and always fresh. On top of that, the prices are incredibly reasonable, especially for the quality you’re getting.

The staff are warm, welcoming, and genuinely care about every customer. Service is always fast, friendly, and professional, which makes every visit a pleasure.

And as if the café wasn’t already amazing enough, the massage upstairs is fantastic. It’s clean, relaxing, and the therapists are highly skilled. It’s the perfect way to recharge after enjoying a great coffee.

I’ve been here at least five times now, and I keep coming back for a reason. This place has become one of my absolute favorites. Great coffee, great value, great people, and a great atmosphere. Highly recommended to anyone in the area.
review_2_text:
Excellent selection of local beans, through different processes and roasts.

The light roasts from Chiang Mai are out of this world ✌️
review_3_text: Such a great coffee shop with lovely atmosphere and very good service. Staff speaks excellent English and is so incredibly friendly and warm. Young people doing their work with love and passion. Very good coffee that they roast themselves, excellent cakes and sandwiches, and all this at very reasonable prices. Bought some of their beans and will be definitely back when in Chiang Mai again.
review_4_text: Located near the flower market.  This coffee shop has a special second floor for chilling.   Good coffee. Car parking is difficult.  Good service.  Downstairs No Ac. Upstairs yes has AC.
review_5_text:
first time in here. first time in Thailand 😊

coffee is great. affordable. vibe's good like you are in a not-so-urban place. subtle white noise coming from the vehicles passing by.

first time visit here, hopeful that there will be next 🥰

hi, Chiang Mai (Moi)! 😁

name: Eternity Coffee Thapae
review_1_text: Nice coffee place with a wide variety of coffee choices for all tastes. Super friendly and helpful staff who make coffee to taste. It may take a little time but it's worth the wait. Nice inside area and also has a few seats outside. The staff speak limited English but as we're in Thailand this isn't an issue for those who have been complaining in previous reviews. They also gave a few pastries options as well. Many different coffee offerings with a very expansive menu not really overpriced for what you're getting. Would highly recommend the signature coffee selections.
review_2_text:
Seriously great Decaf Latte.
I've enjoyed a couple here lately and they just seem to get better.
Today's, 25/03/21, coffee was perfect. 👌☕

I've been to other Cafés and asked for a Decaf and am greeted with a blank stare of non comprehension. 😶
I walked in here and they just smiled and said, "sure". 😊

Coffee is ground fresh.
Presentation is great.
Staff are friendly and polite.

I'm glad to be a customer.

The new renovation is good.
There's a bathroom.
There's drinking water.
There's room to enjoy a moment to yourself.
review_3_text:
I came to this coffee shop for the first time in October 2023 and visited it three times the entire week because of how good it was.

I came today in 2025 just to make sure it was still good. I think they got better!?!??

I ordered the emerald and it was one of the tastiest drinks I’ve had in a while. Highly recommend!!
review_4_text: Great coffee. Very smooth and level of strength can be choosen. The barista know how to make them right! Mot much option for food but enough. Most customers take away while we sit n soak in the 🎶 in a slow morning
review_5_text: Great coffee! Ordered a drip coffee using their local beans. It was served in a wine glass! I'm sure the glass helps with the aroma and taste. They also sell their own blend of beans and some from around the world. Very friendly staff.

name: Yourproject_
review_1_text:
One of the most inspiring hidden spots in Chiang Mai!
Yourproject_ is a beautiful blend of a vintage boutique and a cozy coffee shop. You can sip a well-made cappuccino while browsing through curated vintage pieces - from fashion to unique home decor.
The space feels artistic and relaxed, with a touch of Tokyo-style aesthetics. Every visit brings something new.
I included it in my Chiang Mai recommendations - check it in profile!
review_2_text: Tip for coffee enthusiasts! The coffee is of high quality and the owners are very knowledgeable and friendly. Had a great conversation on coffee!
review_3_text:
Great Vibe, lovely weird combo of interior design and coffee place with nice music, nice owner and last bn least: great coffee.
Loved the Tonic Espresso (will take that one home)!
review_4_text: I recently visited this coffee shop and I must say, it was a true gem. The coffee was amazing, and I was pleasantly surprised to find out that they also offered oat milk. The small corners filled with vintage furniture gave the place a cozy and unique atmosphere, reminiscent of Berlin. The music selection was also fantastic, with a great mix of hits. While the prices may be a bit higher than other places I've seen (100bts latte with out), the overall experience was well worth it. I highly recommend this coffee shop for its delicious coffee, charming ambiance, and excellent music. It's definitely a must-visit spot for coffee lovers.
review_5_text:
another cafe well hidden as it looks just like a normal residential house.

The coffee is very good, I got flat white 80B, and it has lovely music, one with good sound system. the seating area also has different kind but limited, totally good to have space and not crowded.

name: Chez Nous Wat Ket
review_1_text: What a special, cozy place to enjoy an extraordinary treat and delicious food. We look forward to returning soon.  Everything on the menu looks so delicious.  The atmosphere here is like a warm hug and the food matches that perfectly. The staff are extremely sweet and welcoming.  We look foward to our next visit and recommend this to all who visit beautiful Chiang Mai 🙏☺️
review_2_text: Authentic French goodness in Chiang Mai; their croissants and quiche my faves. Beautiful cafe setting, indoor & outdoor seating .. with a friendly service team.
review_3_text:
Hidden gem in heart of Chiang Mai. The signature cuisine Spaghetti with salmon was highly recommended. The bakery shop and quiet restaurant were separated.
The great stuff Ms. Nanny answered all my questions not only menu but history and culture about Chiang Mai. I'll try to visit again next year.
review_4_text: Experience exceptional staff, delicious food, and passionate ownership. Make sure to add this gem to your must-visit list when you're in Chiang Mai!
review_5_text: Great experience and chill vibe. Thanks for the awesome swan latte art and milk froth. We ordered the pandan coconut croissant and black truffle were both absolutely tasty. Highly recommend.

name: Take a Break
review_1_text:
I visited during one day of my long and happy New Year holiday. I understand there was some chaos with the orders; however, the staff were very kind and polite. They sincerely apologized for the long waiting time, which I found very humble and endearing.

For parking, you can park at Wat Ket Ka Ram (Wat Ket) and walk through to TAKE A BREAK.

The prices may seem a bit high for a basic menu, but the taste is reasonable and definitely worth it.

Dear all staffs,
Please don’t give up—keep going and keep improving! You’re one of my favorite places, and I’d love to come back whenever I travel to CNX!
review_2_text:
Such a cute place!

The Eggcelent Melt toast was fantastic. Also ordered super delicious Mango Sticky Rice with the sweetest mango ❤️‍🔥 I could get the Thai milk tea in my travel mug, all items for take away.

Everyone is very inviting and friendly here, great staff.
review_3_text: Breakfast place with variety of food and drinks. Chill atmosphere. Staff are friendly and polite. Plenty of parking in the temple nearby and short walk to cafe.
review_4_text: One of the best breakfast spot in the town. Food is good, service is very good. Also thanks for the cake it was very yummy also 😋 (special thanks to guy who served us was speaking very good English and nice)
review_5_text: great and cosy restaurant, they have delicious food and good coffee, very easy to order trough qr code and menu is in thai and in english. the staff is so kind, the young man serving on top floor is super kind, very helpful and his english is really good. great place to visit

name: ชาตรามือ สาขาตลาดวโรรส
review_1_text:
Cha Tra Mue is a must-visit tea shop with an impressively wide menu.

It’s the perfect place to stop by and take a break when you’re tired from walking around the city.

From the classic Thai milk tea to fruit teas and matcha variations, there’s something for everyone to enjoy.

Each drink is carefully prepared, and you can really taste the quality in every sip.

A great spot to recharge and refresh during your sightseeing.
review_2_text:
I love the brown sugar bubble tea!
The green tea was delicious too!
I bought a bunch of their products to take home.
review_3_text:
Cha Tra Mue is a classic Thai tea brand. This store was new looking, clean and most importantly, had air con. Lots of seating upstairs and had a toilet.

The ice cream had great tea flavour but was a bit lacking in milk - wasn't that creamy.  But then, this is to be expected in South East Asia, where dairy is very expensive. I didn't have cha yen this time but I've had it before in Bangkok, and it was good.
review_4_text: Had the famous cold thai tea very tasty and refreshing
review_5_text:
Best Thai tea while I visit Thai.
Very fragrantly delicious 🤤
The cafe also very comfortable

name: Kilim Coffee House
review_1_text: A lovely Turkish-style coffee shop with a beautifully rich and bold coffee flavor. The atmosphere is warm and inviting, The shop is exceptionally clean and well maintained, which makes the visit even more pleasant. A wonderful spot for anyone who appreciates strong coffee, great ambiance, and attention to detail. Highly recommended:)
review_2_text:
A very nice getaway from the noontime sun after shopping in the Warorot Market.

Turkish style decorations. Both indoor air conditioning and open air seating. Nice coffee. And the boss is very friendly. Reasonable price.

Carpet everywhere. So please take off your shoes before entering.
review_3_text: I visited the place from a friend’s recommendation, mainly to try the Turkish coffee, and I’m so glad I did. The place gives a delightful reflection of Turkish culture, not just in the drinks but also in the decor, ambience and honestly feels like you’ve stepped into another corner of the world. I’d happily recommend it to anyone looking for a café with a unique and culturally rich vibe.
review_4_text: I was on the hunt for a good coffee spot and came across this cafe on Google Maps, so I decided to give it a try. The place had a charming Turkish theme, and the barista shared that he had just returned from Turkey. He even offered a Turkish snack to pair with our coffee, adding an authentic touch to the experience. The cafe has a relaxed, comfortable atmosphere, perfect for lingering and chatting for hours. Highly recommend checking it out!
review_5_text:
I recently visited an amazing authentic Arabic-style cafe located in the Chinese Market area. From the first steps inside, you feel as if you are transported to another world - a world of oriental fairy tales, comfort and tranquility.

The interior is thought out to the smallest detail.

I would especially like to note the third floor - this is a real oasis. A relaxing atmosphere reigns here, where you can slowly enjoy a cup of aromatic Masala tea served in an exquisite teapot. The spicy, rich taste of tea perfectly matches the overall harmony of this place.

If you are looking for a place to relax your soul, immerse yourself in oriental culture and have leisurely conversations - this cafe is definitely worth a visit! Special thanks to gpt chat for choosing the words

Remember about a problem with parking.

name: attika studio Café & Workshop
review_1_text: Wonderful place to connect 🤍I've joined their workshops several times and it's so much fun! Ranging from dance, art therapy, natural colour art, candle making, midday sketch, all has been an incredible opportunity to meet and get to know likeminded individuals. The place itself is so homey and the staffs are kind and helpful! Looking forward to a soap making lesson next!
review_2_text: Absolutely love this cafe. The coffee tastes amazing. The mood and tone of the place are so cozy and welcoming, it’s perfect for relaxing. The owner is super friendly and kind, which makes the experience even better. She also offers a variety of fun workshops like candle-making and more, which gives the cafe a really creative and community-friendly vibe. Highly recommend stopping by if you’re in the area!
review_3_text:
One of my favorite spots to work in Chiang Mai! The cafe has a peaceful, minimal vibe with lots of natural light and well-designed seating. The Wi-Fi is fast and stable, making it perfect for getting work done or having video calls.

Tried their iced coffee with tiramisu cream super unique and delicious. Friendly staff, great music, and just the right kind of quiet.

Highly recommend for remote workers or anyone looking for a cozy corner to focus or relax!
review_4_text: My husband and I joined a bracelet workshop at attika studio and had a lovely time. Super cute space, good coffee and friendly atmosphere. Recommended.
review_5_text: I came here on a Wednesday,  to sketch. It was a terrific experience and a lot of fun (the food was excellent too). Every Wednesday ,  there's an art club.

name: Building A
review_1_text:
This coffee shop is so good! ☕️ The taste is amazing, prices are super reasonable, and the place has a cute minimal vibe with a small outdoor area. It can get a bit hot during the day, but in the late afternoon it’s perfect, great light, cozy atmosphere, and totally Instagram-worthy 📸

Located right inside Kad Luang Market, Chiang Mai, it’s a must-try spot for coffee lovers. Don’t miss this one!! highly recommended! 💛
review_2_text: A nice little café inside the market. The atmosphere is cozy and local. There’s no air-conditioning, but it’s airy enough to sit and enjoy a drink. There are only a few tables, but the location is very convenient — right by the market, easy to stop by after shopping or to grab some souvenirs. The coffee is really good!
review_3_text: After a little adventure following Google Maps through Chiangmai's narrow streets, we arrived at this charming coffee shop located in a small soi. *no parking car here
review_4_text: Coconut latte is absolutely amazing! Really nice coffee break in the market
review_5_text: Now that was an incredible coconut matcha ! 😍

name: 우 카페
review_1_text:
This cafe exceeded expectations in every aspect.
The decor is stunning from every angle; every photo is beautiful.
The lighting is gorgeous.

All the staff are incredibly attentive.
This is the best part; everyone is genuinely ready to serve, from the servers to the front-of-house staff.

I arrived early in the morning, right when they opened.
They were arranging flowers.
I loved it, especially the smell of fresh flowers.

The food presentation is gorgeous.
Every dish is beautiful, really.
You can tell they put a lot of thought into it.

It's so beautiful it almost overshadows the taste of the food! 555
The food itself is decent for a cafe.

The desserts and drinks are photogenic.
I loved the Citrus Americano; it was so refreshing.

I also loved the Caesar Chicken Tortilla.
If they could pay more attention to the refrigerator smell on the vegetables,
this dish would be perfect.

This cafe is definitely worth a try!

name: เก๋ไก๋ Café Coffee & Juice Bar
review_1_text: An amazing coffee shop located in the back of the market past the dried fish vendors.  Auntie and uncle are so welcoming and the Thai tea with coffee is a must try.
review_2_text:
Kaykai Café Coffee & Juice Bar located in Tonlamyai Market.

Cafe decorate as cozy and relaxing but taste of drinks ordered was Thai Milk Tea at 25THB which is reasonable price.

Taste is okay but other drinks might be good.

Must try up yourself. Thanks you.
review_3_text: The most wonderful fruit juice for an amazing price! With friendliest owner couple. A must-stop in the market!
review_4_text: A unique place to enjoy one of the many beverages. The barista is a very cheerful and courteous man. 👍🏾👍🏾👍🏾

name: Forest Bake
review_1_text: Forest Bake is a peaceful gem surrounded by nature. We enjoyed dining here weekly for the 2 months we visited Chiang Mai. Its a beautiful calm atmosphere, the owners and staff are so welcoming and kind. The food is very delicious and the bake shop is devine. Thank you for many delicious meals and enjoyable visits. We highly recommend Forest bake for top quality food, atmosphere and a all around wonderful experience.
review_2_text: This cozy café, hidden in a quiet alley near the temple, offers a peaceful, green-filled atmosphere that feels like a little escape. Their selection of desserts is not only varied but also beautifully crafted and absolutely delicious. The coffee is excellent,clearly made with quality in mind.
review_3_text: Magical space, inviting, warm, beckoning, welcoming all come to mind. Fabulous bakery and a nice restaurant for brunch or coffee. Great place to meet up with friends.
review_4_text: We shared a selection of cakes and pies.  They were all fresh and delicious. The garden was gorgeous to sit in. Very tranquil. Well worth the cheap tuktuk ride from the old city. ♥️
review_5_text: This morning I visited Forest Bake, a nearby café from my fiancé’s apartment. I enjoyed their Avocado Eggs Benedict on Toast and coffee. Special kudos to the lady barista and the staff for being attentive and friendly. The place has a lovely nature vibe with my favorite view, the black cat 😊.

name: OHB Cafe and Meal - Chiangmai
review_1_text:
We walked in and suddenly we were sitting in a little jungle oasis. The atmosphere is the main reason to come: lush greenery everywhere, warm natural light, and a calm pond with colorful fish (koi) right next to the seating. If you manage to get a table by the water, it’s incredibly relaxing—quiet, cool, and honestly feels like you’re far away from the city.

The space is also well designed. There’s a comfortable indoor area with beautiful woven hanging lamps and a clean, modern look, plus plenty of outdoor seating that blends into the garden. It’s a great place to slow down, have a long coffee, and take photos without it feeling “too touristy.”

Food and drinks were nicely presented and enjoyable. The coffee looked and tasted well-made (latte art was on point), and the breakfast-style dishes came out fresh and comforting. Overall, it’s a solid choice whether you’re coming for coffee, a light meal, or just to enjoy the vibe.
review_2_text: Nice cafe with greenery and forestry atmosphere. There is a fishpond and cozy garden furniture if you like outdoor seating (beware of mosquitoes) or air-conditioned inside greenhouse. Plenty of choice for healthy food and drinks, served with a smile.
review_3_text:
The environment here is undeniably elegant and comfortable—the "Urban Sanctuary" vibe with the waterfall and lush greenery is truly world-class. However, the service was a massive disappointment and completely ruined the experience.

The staff were cold and unprofessional. I wasn't even given a receipt after my purchase, and there wasn't a single "thank you" or any form of basic courtesy throughout the interaction. For a place of this caliber, such poor hospitality is unacceptable. I came here for a peaceful escape but left feeling disrespected. Great aesthetics cannot compensate for such bad service.
review_4_text: Beautiful forest atmosphere with outside dining and clean and cozy inside. The drinks are all well made and delicious. We also ordered the dark chocolate raspberry cake and the carrot cake and the quality of cake is the best so far for us in Chiang Mai. Will definitely be coming back.
review_5_text: A beautiful cafe. Great coffee and (they say) Thai food. Light, medium and dark roast espressos.

name: Johoney Ice Cream
review_1_text: A cute homemade ice cream shop with delicious flavors, even local ones. We tried the honeycomb, jambolan, peach and black plum, as well as strawberry sherbert. The flavors are on point and delicious. Highly recommend!!
review_2_text: An out-of-the way ice cream and coffee shop across the river. All ice cream is homemade with exceptional flavors only available in Thailand. Served in frosted bowls if you eat in. Make a point to visit, so worth it!
review_3_text:
Quality homade icecream in Chiangmai. Plenty of flavors to try, I've tried honey comb and their new mango menu. They serve it in a frozen bowl.
The paint point is no proper parking lot. But you have to find it near by this place and walk
review_4_text: home made ice cream with only 4-5 tables.  But the flavours are very impressive.  So many various selection to choose from.  only 50 thb per scoop. Will definitely revisit!!
review_5_text: Super tasty ice cream! There are many flavors of ice cream and sherbet to choose from at John Honey. Every time you go, there is something new to try because the flavors change with the seasons and new recipes.

name: Banviang Coffee
review_1_text: Had my best experience with coffeeshop owner / stuff in Chiangmai! Living here for 6 month, this is the best I had. The owner cares about his coffee and his customers. Yes. The care matters the most! Holding door to let me in, holding on to make coffee till my husband arrives, and speaking humblely about his coffee. But it's indeed terrific! We both ordered hot latte. It's definitely the best we had here. The shop have around 4 tables inside with AC provided and several seats outside. I love the atmosphere in the shop. Super friendly owner, and very nice lovely old customers. The owner even helped his customers with their Thai language. How thoughtful! I won't expect more in a coffee shop. So thankful for the afternoon time spent there. Made a sketch while talking with them. Will definitely go back to see my friends there!
review_2_text: The orange and coconut were crazy fresh and sweet — just perfect. And the coffee? So fresh with great body. This tiny café had that warm Thai vibe I love… smiles, kindness, everything. Out of my 10 days in Chiang Mai, this place made me the happiest for sure. 💛✨
review_3_text:
One lovely corner cafe in which I have lovely conversations and moments.
PLUS very tasty coffee ☕️
review_4_text: So nice owner Po. Coffee&cookies is yummy. Also unique hand crafted bracelets, anklets.
review_5_text:
Small coffee shop yet the drinks are good to give a try.
The shop has coconut americano, which is the combination of fresh coconut juice with a shot of espresso.
Mango smoothies without sugar still has the natural sweetness.
The shop owner is nice.

name: Wawee Coffee Kadluang
review_1_text:
Iced Thai Tea 60 ฿ (2025)

Has English menu.

Great cafe to rest after the nearby market strolling. It is almost empty when i arrived.

I could have nice AC, charge my phone and enjoy the quietness.

Normally those popular cafe are crowded with instafamous and other tourist, so i am glad to be here.

Spend a good couple hours to read and really enjoy myself.
review_2_text:
Dirty seats, dirty restrooms 🚻 but air conditioned
The only reason to come in here abuy overpriced coffee or tea is the crypt quality AC.
FILTHY, and I've been in Chiang Mai many times.
The cloth chairs were so dirty I actually moved to a non cloth upholstered seat. ( see pics ).
Restrooms were filthy.
Next to Ping River,  this place could be so much better for the price.
Service was adequate at best.
●●●●●NOT RECOMMENDED unless you need a dose of AC in the Chiang Mai heat.●●●●●
Final take....The 🍋 lemon iced tea was ok.
review_3_text: Super quaint coffee shop with an attached bookstore! Nice seating options by the river. As a heads up: their bathroom is out of service at the time of this review, so you’ll have to use the one across the street. Also, their AC is out of commission, though they are using portable AC units.
review_4_text: No A/C, place looks like it's about to fall into the river, the rear is basically a dump. No hello or smile upon entry, everyone wearing masks like they are afraid of breathing air.  Skip it.
review_5_text: No air conditioning but the place is five star with 100 hat drinks. The owner must have money issues, it's 39c outside and no Aircon. They do they just don't wanna turn it on. Place is failing for a reason

name: ซายูริ ค๊อฟฟี่ช็อป
review_1_text: This is a very good app.

name: Ploy Cafe Slow Bar
review_1_text:
Best Thai tea! Must try.
The food also delicious!
review_2_text: Variety of Breakfasts. Delicious. Nice Service 😃My favorite place in Chiang Mai!
review_3_text: Super friendly and relaxing little coffee stall along the road. Thanks for all the great coffee!
review_4_text: Super chill roadside slow bar
review_5_text: Amazing coffee and even better service!!

name: MABU craft space
review_1_text: This is a cute little cafe with drawing workshops, and they also serve drinks and small snacks. The staff are friendly and provide good service.
review_2_text:
📍 A painting cafe that's super healing for those looking for a fun activity. Highly recommended!
🤎 Drinks are available.
🎨 It's best to contact the page to reserve in advance, as seating is limited.
🚗 Spacious parking lot.
📍 Close to other tourist attractions.
review_3_text:
Every time I come here, it's closed.
I called the shop to check if it was open. They said "open."
When I actually arrived, it was closed. Terrible.

name: สมร Cafe Chiangmai
review_1_text: Such a cute cafe. I think the main entertainment is doggies. They are adorable, so well behaved and treated. I took Americano and mochi matcha cake. I like matcha, but I think the taste was super strong, so it was hard to finish a piece on my own. I would highly recommend to come and visit this cafe to cuddle with doggies. (And of course, they are pet-friendly)
review_2_text:
Very tasty and creative cakes.  We had two mochi cakes and a banoffee.  The cakes were beyond our expectation.

For coffee, I had a caramel biscuit coffee.   Very nice as well.

The icon of the restaurant, the Samorn family dogs.  Very cute and add a pet-friendly vibe to the cafe.
review_3_text: Amazing coffee with fun specialty flavors. They are decorated for Christmas and it looks unreal right now with snow and everything!! They have 3 gorgeous weiner dogs you can play with and the whole cafe is dauschand themed!! Amazing spot to hang out!
review_4_text: so happy to see the sausage dogs running around!! sweet and friendly little ones and apparently you can even bring your own pet dog here! otherwise this place was a bit hard to find on grab but the lovely furry friends made up for the company
review_5_text:
First impression there: I love these 2 dogs!
They are very well known for their cake. And it is amazing. The drinks were on point and the cafe gives off a relaxing vibes. I would love to stay longer so if you are someone who enjoy sitting in cafe and working or chilling, this is the place.

Overall: Cake&drinks 8/10, Atmosphere 9/10 the interior are to my liking so +1, Staff 8/10 Super friendly, DOGS: 10000000/10

name: Yardoo kids Cafe
review_1_text:
A very cute cafe with many different indoor and outdoor spaces. The toys and areas were clean and not worn. I appreciated that they allowed me in even though I didn’t have a method of QR payment, only cash. And, they gave my daughter a cute Pokémon gift upon leaving. They have the sweetest staff.

There was no one really monitoring the areas so parents of younger ones need to be somewhat vigilant at all times - with toys on higher shelves and a steep slide into the ball pit
review_2_text: Had my son’s 4th birthday party here and it was wonderful! It was a private party and I couldn’t be happier. The decorations were fantastic and the staff were wonderful. Really great toys, outside area and excellent slide. 100% would recommend. Coffees were delicious too. Thank you Yardoo 🙏
review_3_text:
Great family and kids space with both indoor and outdoor play spaces. Whole room with Plan International wooden toys. Another room with big slide and ball pit.

Food is adequate. Only downside is they use plastic cutlery in plastic bags and disposable bowls for all dining, creating tons of unnecessary waste.
review_4_text: It was good size for my 2yo toddler. Safe and clean toys and playground. Staff was nice and friendly too. Just one thing, there are TOO MANY mosquitoes (especially hiding in the indoor slide/ball pool area) in such a place for kids, the owner should consider to leave a mosquito catch during the night… Mosquitoes carry diseases and kill most human on earth 😬
review_5_text: The staff at the entrance are friendly and helpful, but the counter/cashier service needs improvement. The overall service experience feels inconsistent and below expectations.

name: Black basic coffee
review_1_text:
I ordered the 'Dirty Coffee' becauae the place had 5star rating and I wanted to try something new.
I was asked to drink the whole glass in 3 gulps.
It was truely amazing,  coffee,  vibe and Thailand.
review_2_text: New location near airport plaza. Cool cafe just off the main road coffee made out of the back of a car with nice seating area. Tried the dark and medium roast both really good and good price 50baht. They have other coffee flavours and non coffee options too. Recommend this place 👍🏻owner is super friendly too!
review_3_text:
This small cafe is really cute.

Park on the roadside of the highway

It's really hardcore hahaha

The boss is also very cute and warm.
He should be a coffee lover.

The jars behind the coffee machine are good beans brands

I ordered Latte.

Use deep-roasted beans

Rich and mellow fragrance

Not bad, high score

I can try Americano next time when pass by.

It should not be bad.
review_4_text: I went here expecting a great coffee experience to find out the shop has moved and the pin is incorrect. Disappointing, please update your Google maps location.
review_5_text: Met this guy and his truck/coffee shop on the street and I must say! Best coffee in Thailand! Gotten a flat white and it was amazingly tasty!

name: Penguin Coffee By Nuch
review_1_text: Very nice lady making great drinks.
review_2_text: The coffee is delicious, rich, and well-rounded. The price is reasonable. The vendor is friendly and very talkative. The menu includes fresh fruit juices and seasonal fruit smoothies. Delivery service is also available in the vicinity.
review_3_text: The vendor is friendly, super cheerful, and lovely... and the coffee is delicious! 💕
review_4_text: Nothing's tastier than this... except maybe Starbucks.
review_5_text:
The orange juice is so sweet!
Delicious and cheap...
I'm so addicted! 10/10

name: กับแกล้มยายแอ๊ว
review_1_text: The food was terrible, the noodles were the worst I've ever had. They were also smoking in the restaurant. It was awful. The price and the food quality don't match at all.
review_2_text: Good food, parking available, very cheap.
review_3_text: The food is delicious and very cheap.
review_4_text: The food is delicious and cheap. I'm delighted.
review_5_text: Very cheap, good beer, red banknotes with change.

name: ROTI DE VOUS
review_1_text: The way to the shop is very easy. There is a large sign at the entrance of the alley. The shop is like a house in a garden. There are seats outside and inside. Choose as you like. The atmosphere is good, not hot because there are trees. Inside, the air conditioning is very cool. Suitable for sitting, relaxing and working. Drinks are not expensive, not more than one hundred. Roti is very delicious. The shop owner takes excellent care of customers. Personally, I love this shop and will come again.
review_2_text: Shady and good atmosphere. Delicious Hindu style roti without oil that is harmful to your health.
review_3_text: The roti is delicious, the coffee is fragrant and tasty, and the shop is beautiful.

name: กรุณาเบเกอรี่
review_1_text: a cosy little place for coffee and simple orange, lemon, and coconut cake. reasonably-priced.
review_2_text:
They serve delicious orange cake.
This is a local shop run by a retired owner who combined his hobby with practical business. We had a pleasant time chatting.
review_3_text: The orange cake and lemon cake are delicious! They're incredibly soft and not overly sweet like other places. Most importantly, they're so cheap!
review_4_text: These delicious little treats are carefully made by the owner and are sold at relatively cheap prices.
review_5_text: The orange cake is so delicious.

name: Cha Lum Dee - Sanpakhoi
review_1_text: Great little coffee stall tucked inside the business center. The ice americano is strong, smooth, and hits the spot every time. Friendly service and quick turnaround — perfect for a workday caffeine fix. Highly recommended!
review_2_text: The price is friendly and the food is very delicious. ☕️
review_3_text: Fresh milk yogurt smoothie, very delicious.
review_4_text: It's cheap and delicious too.

name: Popo’s Cafe Chiangmai คาเฟ่แมว เชียงใหม่
review_1_text: Coming here before my flight back. No entrance fee, yet the price of drink and food on the higher side which is I expected. The place quite cozy, the iced latte and toast are good. Caution for those who order food, watch out because the cats seems eyeing the food or water 😂 Just, when i came in, there are strong cat pee odour. Overall, i think make a good choice came in here just before back to Bangkok. Might came back if going back to Chiang Mai again.
review_2_text: Cute cafe with adorable friendly cats. Clean and well loved.
review_3_text:
My favorite cat cafe! It’s very welcoming, the staff is so incredibly nice and friendly, the drinks are amazing and all the deserts are delicious! (my god, the nutella burnt cheesecake is to die for🤤)
But, most importantly, the cats are absolutely adorable, well taken care of, groomed and happy:)
Love love love coming here🥰 it’s my happy place!
review_4_text: A lovely small cat cafe, no entry fee, just order a drink is ok! Not many cats there, but everyone is cute!
review_5_text:
I sent my car for service at the Expat Auto and took a short walk down to this cosy Cafe with it's lovely people friendly cats. I ordered a cappuccino and lemon cheese cake which both were delicious. The owner of this small Cafe is a very friendly charming lady and this small Café is a welcome feature in the area.
You find it by going down the Soi between Thai Prakan and the Alpine car electronics shop and opposite Expat Auto take the small Soi on the right and almost at the end of the Soi on the left side is Popo's Café. Well worth a visit to cuddle with cute cats, but be careful, they might steal your cheese cake 😉

name: The Loft Cafe
review_1_text: Nice place, good service but espresso to milk ratio wasn't ideal. Hence our coffees were bland and diluted. Even for the hot caffe latte we ordered. Food is excellent on Tamarind side and will be back for the Khao Soi and Crispy Namtok Noodles.
review_2_text: The Loft Cafe in Chiang Mai is a gem! I absolutely loved the cool, industrial-chic atmosphere—it’s the perfect spot to relax or get some work done. The coffee is excellent, robust, and expertly made, and the pastries are delicious. The staff are friendly and the vibe is always chill and welcoming. Definitely a must-visit for a great cafe experience in Chiang Mai!
review_3_text: Chilled and relaxed serene coffee shop with great affordable food I had the chicken noodle soup for 50 chat and a frappe for 60bhat with crispy pork skin for 10baht. Great experience
review_4_text:
I love this café a lot.
You can have breakfast, lunch, or brunch there until around 3:30–4:00 PM. The place feels like a combination of different shops.
You order everything at the café first, then sit anywhere you like.

I didn’t see any air-conditioned indoor area, but the outdoor atmosphere was quite comfortable — the weather was slightly rainy, and the space is surrounded by lots of greenery.

It’s also okay to do remote work upstairs for around 3–4 hours. It’s not crowded at all, which makes it even better.
Plus, there’s a separate and lovely gift shop where you can buy some Burmese traditional products.

Highly recommended if you enjoy a peaceful vibe.
review_5_text: A lovely cafe with quiet atmosphere, the coffee Latte is just ok, but the price is very cheap, so we can’t complain!

name: Sawasdee Coffee
review_1_text: Great coffee. Very friendly and willing to make something new!

name: Adenosine Receptor
review_1_text: I personally really like the fruit coffee at this shop. It costs 55 baht per cup. The orange coffee is really good, unlike anywhere else. But my favorite menu item is the berry coffee. It's really delicious. If I can't think of anything else, I'll order an Americano. I admit that the coffee is really good. Prices start at 45 baht. Oh, and another thing I like is the cocoa. I think you have to try the cocoa. You don't have to wait for the ones at the Bai Mai gas station to have a sale. This one is no different at all.
review_2_text: A cute little shop with air conditioning. Very cheap prices and good taste. I hope you'll be with us for a long time.
review_3_text: The coffee is delicious, the owner is friendly, and most importantly, the price is not expensive. I can drink it every day.
review_4_text:
Cute shop with delicious fruit-themed coffee. Everything on the menu is delicious.
Orange, berry, peach!
review_5_text: Good coffee, but even better is the barista. Absolutely amazing!

name: เปิงชม
review_1_text: A mighty fine hot latte
review_2_text: The most reasonable price
review_3_text: i like this place and i like the latte
review_4_text: Excellent! The coffee is almost specialty, a very high standard. The foam is thick, the beans are rich, not over-burnt, the Arabica has a smooth flavor and medium acidity. Great price, very tasty. The design is attractive and the atmosphere is pleasant, the price/quality ratio is 10 out of 10. I'll definitely be back while I'm in the area.
review_5_text: This small coffee shop is not far from Big C Extra. They sell inexpensive drinks and have customers all day. They also sell sandwiches and snacks. I recommend the caramel macchiato; it's less sweet and delicious!

name: INTHANIN COFFEE SUPERHIGHWAY
review_1_text: An excellent example of a highway coffee shop.  Coffee service is quick and well presented.  Food is ok if you must.  They have a large selection of snacks as well.  There is a large and comfortable seating area with lounges.  Overall, better than average for this category.
review_2_text: A great place for good food and coffee which doubles as a coworking space. They have electrical plugs for your computer or to charge your phone. Very impressive coffee and other drinks plus you can have lunch. My new go to place for coffee and working on my digital art.
review_3_text: Clean coffee shop with large comfortable seating. Handy if getting petrol and needing a cool down. The only downside is lots of single use plastic, which is common really. I don't always carry a reusable cup with me (and during covid period many places don't allow this anyway).
review_4_text: Is a great place to hang out with friends and family, if you need a charging point, you can charge over here. The surroundings is very quiet and relaxing. A good place to relax and enjoy a cuppa in the morning.
review_5_text: Everything is good and reasonably priced. Staffs are polite and the restaurant is really clean. Menu are varied.

name: Black Canyon รพ.กรุงเทพ เชียงใหม่
review_1_text:
No matter the location,  always reliable for quality & service.

Food is always fresh and delicious.  Well made coffee drinks.
review_2_text:
Well, the food is... meh. BUT if you're really hungry like we were then you will enjoy it.
I understand that not every restaurant will be a 5 star rating.
This coffee shop/restaurant does the job.

I would say don't go out of your way BUT if you're getting your truck fixed nearby hungry and need to wait- then this place is PERFECT.

It is worth a stop by plus they have cannabis teas and coffee🤔
review_3_text: A very good quality Black Canyon. The food is all delicious and the staff are friendly. It’s right next to Bangkok hospital so we ate here while visiting the hospital. We were very hungry and this place hit the spot.
review_4_text:
I came here with a coupon from Bangkok Hospital that is next door.
There is a list of choices for that, a few drinks and a few food selections.
I asked about tuna sandwich and was pointed to a display (see photo 1) with a good looking sandwich and selected that.
As I was eating in they didn’t want me to take pre-packed but serve it on a plate… and all I got was a half can of tuna between 2 tasteless slices of white bread without crust.  No lettuce, tomato, or mayo in sight. Bland and tasteless.
Even worse than any school or hospital cafeteria.
2 tables sent their food back while I was there.

Maybe this is acceptable if your mind is worried about a loved one in hospital and you don’t taste anything or don’t care - but otherwise I’d strongly advise against going here.
review_5_text:
I wanted to like this place and the food, but unfortunately, it didn't meet my expectations. I ordered the Ribeye with Truffle sauce, cooked medium-rare. They seemed to focus too much on the truffle and not enough on the meat. When I first looked at it, I thought it was chopped meat; however, upon cutting into it, it turned out to be very dry and stringy. The truffle sauce was okay but nothing exceptional. The salad was fresh, and the potato was pretty standard. I also ordered the combo, which included the Thai Iced tea. It was better than what you'd get at 7, but not nearly as good as what Hand Brand offers.

Additionally, I had an iced Coffee from here in the morning, it was bitter and not very flavorful.

name: Inbox Coffee​ หนองป่าครั่ง
review_1_text: The owner is very kind. No matter what menu I order, he always asks for details. He is attentive and provides excellent service.

name: Starbucks Bangkok Hospital Chiangmai
review_1_text: This is a great Starbucks, they have a huge seating area and great customer service. I received my order quickly and it was delicious, as usual with a Starbucks. I don’t typically visit Starbucks but it is super convenient being right here at Bangkok hospital while waiting for tests, etc. it is a cashless store, but they take all other forms of payment, including my debit card from America so you don’t have to have a Thai bank account in order to pay here.
review_2_text: It is a cashless store. I hate these stores. What's next? Kiosk ordering like at McDonalds or KFC? Customer service going out of fashion I guess.
review_3_text: They refuse to accept cash. Ridiculous. It should be illegal to not accept cash.
review_4_text:

review_5_text: Today I was lucky enough to get a free coffee. The shop offered a free drip coffee. It's a special seasonal coffee. I really like it. It goes really well with the cheesecake. It's so delicious.

name: ออน เดอะ เวย์ คาเฟ่ เชียงใหม่ สาขาหนองป่าครั่ง
review_1_text: The service was excellent! The seller was very nice.
review_2_text: The coffee is very delicious. The staff are very friendly. I will definitely come back and support you again.
review_3_text: The seller provided good service, and the matcha was delicious.
review_4_text: The coffee is fragrant, tastes good, and most importantly, the price is very reasonable.
review_5_text: The barista was very friendly and the coffee was delicious.

name: ร้านชาอันอัน
review_1_text:
The milk tea is delicious and fragrant.
The cocoa is rich and the tapioca pearls are soft and chewy, I really like it.
review_2_text: This is the only fruit tea that doesn't cause heart palpitations when I drink it (I happen to have high blood pressure).
review_3_text: Refresh your body.

name: Gourmet Primo Cafe Chiang Mai
review_1_text:
Great distraction during a hospital visit.

Well made coffee and drinks. Large selection of fresh sweet and savory items.

Located off the ground lobby of Bangkok Hospital Chiang Mai.
review_2_text: Located on the ground floor at Chiangmai Bangkok Hospital. The best Coffee and pastry selections.
review_3_text:
The coffee shop at Bangkok Hospital Chiang Mai has delicious drinks.
The prices are reasonable, and they also sell inexpensive baked goods and pastries.
I often stop by while waiting to drop off patients. It's located near the checkout counter on the 1st floor.
review_4_text: The staff were so lovely, like they stepped straight out of Disney, super friendly. The snacks in the shop were also incredibly delicious – I was surprised there was a snack shop in a hospital! Very impressed.

name: CHAKAIMUK สาขาหนองป่าครั่ง (ชาไข่มุก)
Hug Him Doi Thai Coffee
review_1_text:
After hiking approximately 1 hour (we are Dutch, 29 and 24 and fit) we came here for a small lunch/snack. Visiting in April, so not in high season. Because of that they had limited options, but nice easy fried food. Fine drinks. Map of the trail next to the bar.
Toilets are close to Anagami Temple next door
review_2_text: Cute little coffee shop. Nice chilled atmosphere, and they do a pretty decent Thai tea.
review_3_text: Nice thai tea after climbing up in super hot weather!
review_4_text:
That is very nice place to stop on our road trip.
on this day 2019 Oct. 8.
we missed travel, forgot to give review on our road trip in Chiang Mai, hope to see there cat lovely cat and there nice coffee.
review_5_text: Excellent coffee! Very mountainous atmosphere! Euphoric experience!!

name: Basecamp Trail Cafe (Thailand)
review_1_text:
Great atmosphere chilling house vibes
Delicious smoothies and strong coffee!!!

Good weather.
Uphill location.

Amazing hiking starting off place. Parking spots available.
review_2_text:
Excellent selection of local Thai beans for sale or extraction.

I got V60 local light roast beans over ice, highly reccomend 👌
review_3_text:
Basecamp Coffee Club is a pleasant café with a relaxed atmosphere, good coffee and tea, and several comfortable seating options. The outdoor terrace is especially nice and a good place to sit and unwind.

Inside, however, the air conditioning is very cold, so it’s not really a place to warm up. Prices are quite high, particularly for pastries, cakes, and cinnamon rolls, which feel rather expensive for the portions.

A plus point is the small courtyard with convenient parking for scooters and bicycles, as well as a sports shop next door and a small kiosk downstairs. Overall a nice stop for a drink, but noticeably pricey.
review_4_text:
Great cafe in a beautiful and quiet spot surrounded by trees. I tried their dirty coffee which was fantastic, and ordered chicken rolls as a snack which was delicious. They have showering facilities and clean toilets too.

Just watch out for the falling nuts from the trees, and ensure you sit under the cover, as they were quite hefty and made a large thud when hitting the ground, can imagine how painful it'll be if it hit your head!
review_5_text:
Perfect place to start the day. Basecamp opens at 7am, so I came here early in the morning to work for two hours before going for a hike.

They kindly kept my bag during my the hike so I could walk light. Thank so much for that 🙏🏼

Internet is super good, so I could perfectly work and focus.

Their Japanese cheesecake is good, as well as their coffee.

I love the atmosphere there. By the jungle, with wood, trees and plants and green. Lovely

name: ห้ามจอดเดอะ คอฟฟี่ Hunjod the coffee
Dumnern Saduak Coffee Cafe Chiang Mai
review_1_text: We found this restaurant by researching and was not disappointed. It is a very local restaurant, where there is no english menu (also, no wifi). We have been in Chiang mai for a couple of weeks now and tjis was a GREAT surprise, food-wise. It is not a touristy place at all and we found the food to be DELICIOUS. By watching the plates that were being ordered by the tables around, we understood that there are some dishes that are the fav ones - like the one I ordered:  scrambled eggs with seafood on top of rice. And I was surprised by how delicious it was. My husband ordered the rice with fried fish and he also was very pleased with it’s flavores and quality. They offer a very unique selection of chillis/ sauces. Both our plates costed 70 bahts. And we would love to come back to try many other dishes from the menu.
review_2_text: Food was delicious and clean, huge portions. Highly recommend - great service. They have a name-calling system when your order's ready, which I thought was a nice touch. Will definitely be back.
review_3_text: There are coffee shop and restaurant with separate cooking areas, but with common dining area. I should say food was not great, but capuchino was fantastic. We enjoyed sitting under the tree with a cup of good coffee.
review_4_text: good coffee good food and cheap. staff can speak english well and someone can speak Chinese language. good location near Chiangmai university
review_5_text: Good for students lunch, reasonable price and quantity. Plain rice refillable.

name: Supattra x JourneyMan
review_1_text:
Hands down one of the best coffee spots in the area.

Chill music and crowd. Great service. they also speak good English which is nice.

And they have great beans hah
review_2_text: Absolutely love this cafe! The staff are so nice, the coffee and food is incredible (pad thai crispy pork and the sandwiches are the best!) and unbeatable value, and it's in a really nice part of town, at the foot of Doi Suthep. One of the best cafes in CM.
review_3_text:
After a decade, I returned to what used to be my favorite restaurant, now transformed into a charming coffee shop. The ambiance has evolved, but it retains a welcoming vibe that feels both familiar and new.

The variety of coffee beans available was impressive, even though many had similar taste profiles. The coffee I tried was excellent. Although the Pad Thai has changed from what I remember, it was still enjoyable.

Prices are reasonable and environment is cozy.
review_4_text:
Very positively surprised by how good and tasty the food was.
We stopped there a little bit by accident to have a bite before a long ride and it was really great. We had a caesar salad and then a pad Thai/ a chicken curry. Both dishes were delicious (the Curry 😍😍).
PS ; it was 2pm and we hadnt eaten since the day before. Portions are really ok.

In addition, the service is really nice and friendly, and we loved the music that was played.
review_5_text:
I would strongly recommend against visiting this place. I went there for a light dinner and ordered the chicken salad, which was supposed to include tomatoes and bell peppers. However, when my order arrived, none of these ingredients were present, and it cost $80.

To make matters worse, my partner ordered the Caesar salad, which came without any protein, Caesar dressing, or the advertised vegetables, yet it was priced the same as my dish at $80. When we inquired about the missing items and the price, the employee merely gave us an awkward smile and walked away.

Overall, this place offers a disappointing menu, terrible service, and false advertising. I strongly advise against visiting.

name: Bankha.cnx
review_1_text: homey cafe vibe👍🏻🏡 wifi available, good coffee and bakery, recommend for chilling with your friends (we’re have a lot of boardgame) or study/reading a book/working🥰
review_2_text:
Such a Cozy cafe.
Good drink
Good mood
Great VIBE!!!
review_3_text:
A new shop near the university.
Beautifully decorated, perfect for chilling out or reading a book.
review_4_text:
Delicious coffee, great atmosphere. Perfect for chilling out for a long time!
#The owner is so lovely!
review_5_text: A newly opened coffee shop in a hidden location, but the drinks are delicious! They also have games to play and the staff provides great service. 🤲❤️

name: ร้าน COCOA BLACK หลังมช.ฝั่งประตูวิศวะ
Minimal coffee - CMU
review_1_text: I visited Minimal Cafe CMU in Chiang Mai, Thailand, and was impressed. The ambiance is serene and inviting with clean lines, neutral tones, and ample natural light. The coffee and beverages are exceptional, and the menu reflects a commitment to quality and flavor. The staff is friendly and attentive, and the prices are reasonable. Overall, Minimal Cafe CMU is a must-visit for those seeking a good taste coffee in Chiang Mai.
review_2_text: Good coffee, reasonable prices.
review_3_text: Ordered a Caramel macchiato, love the taste. The cafe looks cute too.
review_4_text: Single shot for latte, but flavour good.
review_5_text: Every menu is delicious. This branch has a spacious shop with both an air-conditioned area inside and an outdoor area to choose from. I saw customers coming in constantly. You might have to find parking near the engineering faculty. Most of the customers are CMU students. The staff are cute.

name: เสพย์ติดชา สาขาหลัง ม.ช.
review_1_text:
It's good.
Very fast services.
review_2_text: A small shop in an alley. Visited on 21/7/2024. Parked in the university and walked there.
review_3_text: This shop is in the alley opposite the Chiang Mai University Engineering entrance. Walk in for about five to sixty meters and you'll find a small shop on the left. The front of the shop looks simple. The interior is decorated in the style of an old coffee shop with broken walls, providing some photo opportunities. The drinks are tasty and there's a wide variety of menu items at student prices. Those who drive should find parking near the entrance of the alley before walking in, as parking within the alley is very difficult.
review_4_text: Nestea bubble tea, 50% sweetness, was great. I used to drink it all the time when I was a university student (student ID 59).
review_5_text: It's cheap, the portions are generous, and there's plenty of seating. The Thai milk tea is rich and delicious.

name: ร้านจับนม (Since 2015) Jaabnom
review_1_text: Amazing cute little cafe. They have a study room as well which is chargeable. The scrambled egg with toast bread and northern pork sausage was the best. The hot Thai tea was so calming and is the best on a rainy day. Overall a nice place for breakfast they open at 9 am.
review_2_text: I had the cocoa husk tea, with bread, custard and chocolate dipping. I couldn't believe how delicious it was. I will definitely go back and try other flavors. It's worth the price. Owners very nice. Really recommend !! Check in !!
review_3_text: Good place for cacao drinks and beverages. Chill vibes, chitchat place with friends. But you can't bring ANY food in here. Even if you order a lot of things, you still can't bring and eat outside food. They gonna talk with you like "We not allowed to bring any food to eat here, you can eat them outside". For me, it's rude when you talk too loud to embarrass others in the restaurant. They talk to my mate like that, haha. But the food and beverages are still good to me, tho. I went to this place 6 times already. I can say that the cacao and food are good enough to come back.
review_4_text: This is a great place with a nice cozy atmosphere and delicious deserts. Especially their craft chocolate is amazing. Made of real cocoa beans. Drinking chocolate was 80 bhat and toast with chocolate, banana and condensed milk was 45 bhat.
review_5_text: This is the most gorgeous little place to sit and work, read or hang out! The family who run it are so lovely and the food and drinks are delicious. Such a wide range of drinks on offer and lots of flavours of sweet treats. The prices are so cheap too.

name: Roasto
review_1_text: Interestingly enough, this little gem carries one of the best hot cappuccino tastes in the area. Black orange is very decent, too. We tried the dark roast beans. You can grab a coffee to go and choose the seating on the campus, we prefer the river area. There is a toilet on the left (when you face the coffee shop) under the roof in a nearby building, where you can also sit comfortably at the tables in the shadow. Staff speaks English and they are very friendly, prices are reasonable as most of the things on campus.
review_2_text:
Nice Coffeeshop in Engineering faculty.
It's very comfortable to meeting or sitting for reading books or working.

There are in and out zoning for sitting.

The price is reasonable.
review_3_text: Iced Mocha with Uganda Beans and less sugar - best Mocha in Chiang Mai at this price range, bar none (50 Baht currently)
review_4_text: A chic coffee shop with delicious coffee. I like Dirty Coffee the most. The shop is near the engineering library.
review_5_text:
The shop is beautiful, with plenty of seating and the air conditioning is cool.
The coffee is delicious, with options for medium and dark roasts.

name: Fav. coffee. roaster - UniLoft
review_1_text: There’s really nothing to complain about apart from lack of parking space. I wouldn’t mind drinking from this place everyday.
review_2_text: Excellent coffee and lovely service. This is a small coffee booth with a few seats. The medium dark roast is just perfect - not too sour or acidic. The server is friendly and prices are great.
review_3_text: Great coffee in a good location (and very cheap prices). I strongly recommend!
review_4_text: This place makes the best cappuccino from the several places in the area that I have tried. I've also had an Es-Yen - my first - and it was excellent. They will have my business whenever I stay in this part of the area.
review_5_text: This place is amazing value for money. High quality coffee and friendly service.

name: GEAR Café
review_1_text: Nice food nice drinks nice vibes
review_2_text: Nice owner, quiet and perfect for work. Right in the forest, and wow the prices are perfect 30baht!
review_3_text: The atmosphere of the shop is great, cool and comfortable. It's located in the Faculty of Engineering, a good place to chill out.
review_4_text: It's a nice coffee shop with a pleasant atmosphere. I'll try their hand-drip coffee next time.
review_5_text: The atmosphere is good, not hot, you can sit and chill.

name: NEVER GIVE UP - Cafe
review_1_text:
This place has had several names in the past. It was called The Coffee Rich (Ritch), Never Give Up and now, NVGU. It was three floors now two with bathrooms on each floor. There is a classroom for rent on the second floor.

This place is comfortable for students to study and talk. Not a Instagram photo spot but there is plenty of room.

I ordered a Ice Latte and paid 65 baht.
review_2_text: Cute little cafe
review_3_text: The interior is calming, with a modern white design. However, 65 baht for a latte is a bit pricey, even though it's in the student area of ​​Chiang Mai University. The white base is nice, but adding some wood or greenery would create a more pleasant atmosphere. The music can be a little loud, but if you ask the staff, they'll turn it down. The coffee is generally tasty.
review_5_text: #EasyGuide

name: Behind 42 Cafe
review_1_text: Cozy and quiet little café near CMU, with a spacious second floor co-working space. Perfect for a quick refreshment or a comfortable spot to get some work done.
review_2_text: This cute little café is located at the backside of CMU. It has a cozy atmosphere, great coffee.
review_3_text: nice coffee shop
review_4_text: The coffee menu is delicious. I recommend the vanilla latte. The desserts are also delicious.
review_5_text: When in-store orders come in, we recommend that you serve in-store customers first. Customers will have to wait for orders after 3-4 delivery orders, so in-store customers will have to wait for their drinks for half an hour. 😊

name: SOFUTO CREAM หลัง มช.
review_1_text:
Very nice Japanese desserts. There’s a big variety.
The soufflé pancakes are delightful — I recommend trying them.
The matcha wasn’t really my favorite, but overall it left a very pleasant impression.
review_2_text: Yummy Japanese style desserts, and the kakigori is massive. Best to enjoy with your gang!🥞
review_3_text: Sofuto Cream, located behind Chiang Mai University (CMU), is a cozy Japanese-style café known for its premium soft-serve ice cream made from pure cow's milk sourced from Japan and Italy. The café offers a variety of flavors, including matcha, Hokkaido milk, and seasonal treats like Musang King durian and strawberry daifuku. In addition to soft-serve, they serve Kakigori, a finely shaved ice dessert topped with fresh ingredients like mango or red bean. With its minimalist and inviting interior, Sofuto Cream is a popular spot among students and dessert lovers seeking a peaceful place to enjoy high-quality treats.
review_4_text:
So good!!

I'm not an ice cream person but their matcha soft serve is delicious, creamy smooth, right amount of matcha, not bitter.

It was sweet for me but not as sweet as what other places offer.

The strawberry cheesecake Mochi was good too, didn't think there was ice cream inside, wasn't a fan, I don't like biting into the cold.

Inexpensive place with good standards
review_5_text:
So cute check-in restaurant. 👍
However, tasty is not good and very expensive. I ordered Original Soft Fancake and the cake flour still uncooked. 😡
Tried to writing the comments many times with ordered photos uploading but it's not work until today.

name: LAW COFF & CO ลอว์คอฟ แอนด์ โค หลังมช.
review_1_text: I hit up this cafe every time I'm in Chiang Mai. I still remember how the chef made the coffee. It's the best coffee in all of Chiang Mai; there's no better. The perfect amount of milk and coffee, the flat white tastes exceptional, the coffee is very intense, and it's always take dark roast. This December, I visited many cafes, but even those that promote great design can't compare to this tiny one on the corner. I love this place.
review_2_text: It is a tiny cafe, but is a great place to pick up to go coffee. There are some types of beans available and the service is very good and they explained to me really well. I tried ice americano to go and it was great and well priced.
review_3_text: My favorite coffee beans ❤️ I also like going to the other Law coffee shops at CMU.  Light roast R&B blend.  I buy 3 bags of these every month.  Thank you 🙏
review_4_text:
My fav coffee in town with a fair price!
I always buy coffee here 3 times a week!
It’s a small shop for take away drink but there is some seat for you if you wanna stretch your legs.

Price between 40-65 THB/ 2$!

Ps. The shop also sell postcard/sticker that I always buy as it was too cute!
review_5_text: Great little coffee shop on the bustling Suthep road. Prices and selection of roast is great. Really cool decor and lots of cool stickers and merch to choose from.

name: Sode Cafe
review_1_text: Fantastic cafe just across from Chiang Mai University. Beautiful park like settings. Super cafe with very reasonably priced and good quality coffee. Around the cafe area are lots of different food options from Thai regulars to pizzas and also a range of kebabs etc. Many different areas to sit under trees etc. All in all a really lovely cafe. Very busy during lunch times and frequented by many university students. We'll worth a stop if you're in the neighbourhood. I had a falafel kebab for lunch which was delicious and my eating partner said his Khao Soi was very good also.
review_2_text:
One of the nicest cafes in Chiang Mai.
Good coffee, tea and desserts.
Nicely decorated, as siting in the garden.
A bit far from the Old City, but worth an effort to visit, riding a bicycle or a motorcycle
review_3_text:
Dear manager,

I am really happy to discover your lovely place. The only reason I do not give 5 stars is because of the plastic cups…

I was so sad to see that all customers who ordered an ice coffee or tea got a plastic cup.  I understand when customers order take away... but why you don't have glasses for customers who drink in the cafe?

Thailand is one of the countries where most plastic is being used in the world.
In this time of global warming, we all need to take responsibility to keep our planet healthy for our children and grand children.

I hope I will see people drinking from reusable glasses in the future.

Warm regards,
Cat 🙏
review_4_text: I love this café. It's one of the best spots in CM for working and has great and cheap drinks. The sandwich is also very good. The whole atmosphere is amazing.
review_5_text: It is very near Chiang Mai university. So there are mostly young students and also few foreigners who live in Chiag Mai for years. This cafe is in a garden. In this garden there are 4-5 small restaurants for eating too. You can order your food from any shop and eat in cafe with your drink. Prices are reasonable. Cafe latte 35 baht.

name: Blue coffee at Agriculture CMU
review_1_text:
Blue Coffee at Agriculture CMU is a hidden gem tucked into the Faculty of Agriculture at Chiang Mai University. This spacious cafe boasts stunning glass walls, high ceilings, and wooden accents that create a warm, modern farmhouse vibe, all while overlooking experimental agricultural fields and greenery.
It's the perfect blend of cafe and co-working space—ideal for students, digital nomads, or anyone seeking a peaceful spot to sip specialty coffee, study, or relax. The drinks, from The Baristro brand, feature standout artisanal roasts and creative specials in a serene, nature-inspired setting.
Highly recommended for its photogenic interior, lovely views, and productive atmosphere. A must-visit if you're near CMU!
