review_2_text: Came here on a day of heavy rain. The place was full of students studying, and there were barely any seats left. If you’re alone, you’ll likely end up in a corner. Still, the environment is really nice a great spot to relax.The Wi-Fi has a time limit.
review_3_text: Really cute coffee spot. They have several indoor seating and also it’s perfect if you need to do a little bit of work. They have plugs and WiFi is decent. They give you the code once you purchase a coffee. The coconut latte was really good!
review_4_text: Nice and cozy space inside the Chiang Mai university. Love their cold brew and also try the viral soft matcha which surprisingly good. Can be a bit too crowded in the afternoon
review_5_text:
Blue Coffee: The Sanctuary of Dreamers in Chiang Mai

Tucked beside Chiang Mai University, Blue Coffee has quietly become a global sanctuary for the world’s wanderers  the digital nomads, the aspiring writers, the half-awake artists, and the traders living by the flicker of a chart.

On weekdays, the café hums with the gentle chaos of creation and pretense. Some type furiously as if they’re reinventing the world; others simply let the illusion linger, their screens glowing softly while the coffee cools beside them.
In this blend of workers, drifters, and curious travelers, Blue Coffee has cultivated a culture that’s part coworking space, part performance art.

But perfection never comes without a flaw. The restroom  inconveniently distant tests every visitor’s trust in humanity. Yet here, that trust feels oddly natural. If you need to step away, just ask the free soul at the next table to watch your laptop. They’ll smile and nod, as if sharing in a secret code of café civility.

Because at Blue Coffee, that’s not merely good manners.
It’s the unwritten law of the tribe.

name: นมเกษตร มช. @ KORINOMILK
review_1_text: Had soft cream in cup for lunch at the shop. Soft as the name but a bit too sweet for me.
review_2_text: Really nice little shop to try out delicious milky drinks, milk shakes, and ice cream🍦🥛🧋
review_3_text: This is a famous restaurant near Chiang Mai University. I've been a customer since my daughter was in grade 7 at the Chiang Mai University Demonstration School, and now she's in her fourth year of medical school at Chiang Mai University, and the taste is still the same – unique and delicious. There's convenient seating and parking inside the university. I encourage everyone to try it; you'll be hooked!
review_4_text: The staff recommended a 35 baht shake + ice cream, so we tried it, but it wasn't the kind of ice cream that tasted like milk; it was just fat and sugar. It was so sweet that we couldn't help but leave it behind. It was a calorie bomb. ^^;;
review_5_text:
You can eat delicious soft serve ice cream. 

The store has been renovated and is now beautiful. 

This is one place you'll want to visit at least once while in Chiang Mai.

name: Rotee Parataros
review_1_text: The roti and cheese we ordered wasn't great. The condensed milk used is so less. And the cheese was not spread evenly. Did not get a good vibe from the place either.
review_2_text: Unfortunately, they out of Indian tea. Roti is good.
review_4_text: Very delicious
review_5_text: Ok

name: ส้มถังหลังมอ.Thai Tea (ร้านน้ำผลไม้ปั่นซอยวัดอุโมงค์)
review_1_text: Delicious and refreshing fresh fruit smoothies at affordable prices. The taro bubble tea is rich and tasty for only 20 baht. They use Meiji milk too. Other places would charge at least 30 baht for this quality.
review_2_text: The iced cocoa is amazing! Deliciously rich and creamy, the best behind the university. And it's only 20 baht, such great value!
review_3_text: I ordered a lemonade and it was wonderfully sour!
review_4_text: Delicious! I highly recommend it. The cocoa is rich and flavorful, and the price is very reasonable at only 20 baht.

name: The Coffee Work
review_1_text:
The Coffee Work is in a quiet interior in a quiet neighborhood. Inexpensive to average prices for a good variety of drinks. Limited bakery items, Wifi, clean restroom, air conditioning at comfortable level, usual soft music, outdoor seating area for smokers.

A particularly nice spot for quiet times or study.
Owner is friendly and speaks English well.
review_2_text: Good place to have a coffee and work on your laptop.  The bench seats are padded and there’s plenty of room on each table with a Power socket next to you for charging your electronics.  The coffee was not bad, not the best I’ve ever had but still solid.  The place seems to attract a lot of local students and it was quite a pleasant working environment, quiet and cool just the way I like it! #BeatTheGrind
review_3_text: Many different beverage and snack in reasonable price, the toilet room is clean and wide also a shower inside.
review_4_text: Every time I've come here lately it's closed. I think it's out of business now. Either that or they keep very erratic hours.
review_5_text: superb coffee shop.

name: BM DIARY coffee
review_1_text: Very delicious. Must try.
review_2_text: The coffee is delicious.

name: กาแฟสดสังคม
review_1_text: You get what you pay for.
review_2_text: Coffee and other menus are cheap, starting at 20 baht. The iced milk tea, cocoa, and chocolate are very delicious. They are rich, fragrant, and extremely sweet. Whenever I come to this area, I have to stop by and buy some. I buy them from the branch next to Chaemfa behind CMU (I don’t have the location yet, so I’ll review this first). There are also bakery items to choose from. The taste is okay for the price. The cleanliness is good. There is definitely enough parking space. The staffs are quick. They cook in a short time. When ordering, make sure to write your order on a piece of paper because sometimes there are a lot of people ordering. Overall, this coffee shop is very okay, both in terms of the quality you receive and the price. Come and give it a try.
review_3_text: I didn't like it very much. They constantly look you in the eye to ask you to buy something. You can't sit comfortably and hang out at the computer. I didn't like the woman working.
review_4_text: The coffee is rich, sweet, and creamy, perfect for those who like sweets. The shop is located opposite Maharaj Chiang Mai Hospital. The price is reasonable.
review_5_text: The coffee is delicious!! It has to be brewed by P' Kai only!!

name: Taste Cafe
review_1_text:
I’ve been coming to Taste Cafe for about 8 years now, and I still keep coming back every time I visit Chiang Mai.

It’s one of those places I feel genuinely connected to. The coffee has always been consistent — rich, aromatic, and perfectly balanced, just the way I like it. Whether I order my usual favorite or try something new, I’m never disappointed.

The atmosphere is cozy and comfortable, great for relaxing, catching up with friends, or even getting some work done. The staff are friendly and welcoming, which makes the experience even more special.

For me, Taste Cafe is a must-visit spot in Chiang Mai — a place I’ll always return to. ☕
review_2_text:
Fairly crowded on a Sunday morning around 8:45am, but we managed to get a table for two. The crowd continued to build up shortly after.

Food options are limited, though there’s a wide variety of drinks. We tried the classic shiopan and the shiopan with pork and cream cheese. The classic shiopan was dense on the outside, hollow in the middle, and nicely buttery with a hint of salt — enjoyable.

We had a mocha and a latte; both were decent.

The music was a little loud, but overall it’s a pleasant spot to sit, relax, and people-watch.

Note: credit cards are not accepted — payment is via cash or QR only.
review_3_text: Taste Cafe has a great atmosphere and really good coffee. The must try is the Soft Latte. For non coffee drinkers, there are Soft Chocolate, Soft Matcha, and Soft Thai Tea. The cream topping is smooth, lightly sweet, and pairs perfectly with the coffee. I had been in Chiang Mai for 5 days I went there twice, REALLY LOVE HERE
review_4_text: What a lovely surprise. A contemporary looking spacious open-plan coffee shop with really great coffee, a relaxed musical vibe, prompt & friendly service from the staff and a huge tasty chocolate brownie. Cannot fault it. You must come and get some.
review_5_text:
Among the countless coffee shops in Chiang Mai, this one stands out as truly exceptional. I would confidently rank it in the top ten!

Great coffee and good vibes!
However, this cafe tends to be quite busy throughout the day. I wouldn’t recommend it if you’re looking for a quiet place.

Soft Latte is my fav!! I bet you try

name: Always LOAF U Nimman Soi.17
review_1_text: Such a cozy place! The staff is lovely, the coffee is great, and the selection of desserts is so huge that it’ll take you forever to choose. We tried the croissant, the lemon tart, and the strawberry cream cake in a container — everything was absolutely delicious! If you mix the warm croissant with the cream from the cake, it’s pure magic. The breakfasts are huge and look beautiful. We’re so happy with everything, thank you! 🙏
review_2_text: Delicious at first bite! We had the best experience eating at this quaint cafe. The pastries are light and delightful and not too sweet — very French! And beautifully decorated. The staff were very friendly  too. The cafe offers indoor and outdoor seating, and believe it or not there’s parking for cars one block away. As we were leaving we spotted the certificate from Le Cordon Bleu on the wall, which explains the craft and quality of both food and atmosphere.
review_3_text:
Always LOAF U at Nimman Soi 17 is such a great spot if you’re into good coffee and pastries. We tried the classic croissant and the matcha strawberry croissant, both served warm with a perfectly flaky, buttery crust. The matcha strawberry croissant really stood out. We enjoyed the tartness of the strawberry paired beautifully with the slightly bitter matcha. It was a well balanced and unique combination.

I also ordered a cappuccino with oat milk, and it was creamy, smooth, and generously sized, which I really appreciated. It is a bit on the pricier side, my cappuccino with oat milk came out to 110 baht, but honestly, it was delightful and worth it.

The atmosphere is very inviting, with soothing music and an amazing pastry selection. There were so many options that it was hard to limit ourselves to just two. Overall, this is a must-stop for a quality cappuccino with oat milk and a great pastry when you’re in the area.
review_4_text:
It becomes one of my favorite patisseries in Chiang Mai as it’s baked perfectly with great ingredients and smells so good. Owners and staff are so friendly and give a warm welcome. I had breakfast before (Sourdough with Salmon), which was good. This time I only take away croissants and croissant pops which are my fav now. Croissant is baked beautifully to have a crispy outside while inside so soft.
Located on Nimman Road which is easily walkable from my hotel. It closes on Monday.
review_5_text:
Incredibly delicious desserts and pastries. They often have seasonal collections, which makes each visit special and exciting — you always want to try something new.

We’ve been here three times already, and every time we’re absolutely delighted. The bagels deserve a special mention — truly delicious, some of the best we’ve tried.

Definitely a place you want to come back to again and again. There is a large table upstairs for 6-8 people.

name: Memorize Brownie
review_1_text: Tiramisu taste so bad... Only cheap cream not mascarpone at all. I want to give you 1 star but I don't want to be rude... Recommend You to change this. This is not for sale. Only look good and is big portion. I ordered two boxes and I gonna throw everything to the trash.
review_2_text: A nice little cafe to take a break from the hot chiang mai weather. Drinks are alright, as for the brownie, we prefer the original  as compare to the cheesecake flavour. Matcha is nice and the jasmine tea is refreshing.
review_3_text: I love this brownie kit. So far I have only tried the original brownie. The cream is really delicious so is the brownie. It really does taste like it just came out of the oven if you heat it up. I ordered it on delivery in Bangkok and then realized that my Chiang Mai hotel is right next to the store so I went to check that out. I will definitely order another kit.
review_4_text: Gosh, walked in, place was empty, thinking maybe this was a mistake. Ordered the standard memorize brownie anyway. Was warned the brownie takes ten minutes. By the time the brownie was ready, the place was packed. Then I understood: their brownie is outstanding! Warm, slightly gooey structure, with warmed milk cream... Paired with decent cappuccino. This is truly one of the best I ever had. Well done. If you have a sweet tooth and don't give a damn about calories, macro mix... this is heaven.
review_5_text:
Sis-in-law and niece visited Chiangmai last night. Kid strongly requested to try this brownie shots at this place.
They served 10 shots of small cube of brownies topped with fresh creme at 139 Baht.  The brownies were a little bit too sweet for three of us. However, the sweetness dropped a little bit with the help of fresh creme.
It is brilliant to serve brownies in this different way. It is exactly a value added brownie.

name: 4Seas Nimman Coliving Coworking Space
review_1_text: Perhaps one of the smartest loveliest coffee shops in the entire planet I’ve been to. It’s surrounded by builders of the future where they nurture the infinite garden. There is community events most afternoons and evenings and a great two floor coworking space. After you drink 4 sips of your coffee tea or smoothie at 4Seas you will understand me. The future we want to see is possible thanks to place like these. I’m looking into the future with an ice coffee and sunglasses for privacy. Google why I built zuzalu by a cool dude who built ethereum ;)
review_2_text:
4seas Nimman Coworking opened around 18 months ago and I have been there many times for meetings and events around blockchain, AI, social goods, bio hacking and many other topics.

It's a fantastic place to cowork from with all the best technology you might need, plus a good cafe and starting a food service for customers.

The team are dedicated to creating a community space for all to use. Check it out and see if it works for you.
review_3_text:
Great place.

This is not a cafe, thus is a coworking spot that is more quiet, it seems to have a thriving community, however I am just in for focusing on work.

No fees
At the time of writing this they only charge for coffees and drinks, no membership cost for using this space.

Tip
They have spare monitors around - first come first serve, if you bring your own HDMI cable you’ll likely get your own monitor, as there are cables missing!
review_4_text: I am here at 4Seas for ETHChiangmai. Just the right vibe to work and chill, and participate in events from the local tourist and crypto community. Highly recommend 4Seas
review_5_text:
10/10 recommend!

I really enjoyed my first day co-working at 4 seas. Here are some features you may enjoy here:
- Open 24/7
- Lockers
- Private individual and meeting rooms
- Clean bathroom (even has shower)
- Outside working space
- Bulletin board of advertisements (including for women desiring to learn AI and meditation group)
- Free wifi
- cafe to purchase cold and hot drinks
- host public events (in fact one was going on the first floor when I arrived)
- Comfortable desk swivel chairs
- Fridge for food storage (in case you are working here all day)
- Pure silence on 3rd floor
- Many charging outlets
- microwaves
- and more!

Compared to co-working spaces like Blue Coffee and CAMP nearby I love 4seas because it has all these features while the others only have some. Come check it out!

name: Subway - Sandwich Restaurants Burger ร้านอาหาร นิมมาน
review_1_text: Ate here once way back when I was living in Chiangmai and got the sad-looking thing in my picture. Never returned again.. but I read their standard might have improved since then.
review_2_text: Sandwiches are getting smaller by the day!! While being more expensive! Today, my 6" sandwich was about 4.5", this is borderline scammy !
review_3_text: The Turkey Breast sub is light but filling. Fresh lettuce and cucumbers make it taste balanced. Great for a healthy lunch.
review_4_text: Where's the tuna??? Looks like they only put one scoop of tuna (if that) instead of the standard two on a 6" sub. With that being said, everything else tasted fine.
review_5_text: Love that the staff always check if I want extra veggies or sauce. Makes the experience more personal, and the sandwich tastes just right.

name: ฮันกัง บิงซู
review_1_text:
Chicken was overpriced and only a small bite of meat. Small portion sizes except the gyoza, spend about 350b just to leave still hungry. The food itself was very delicious though. Service was non existent.

The vibe of the restaurant was not good either, but this was at night time. I have been here for bingsu in the day and that is very delicious and well priced, and the atmosphere was different then.
review_2_text: Good Korean shaved ice - bingsu. Wish you could customize flavors and toppings, a build your own. But the watermelon was very good. Kiwi one was alright.
review_3_text: Their bingsoo is 89thb to 99thb for a small size which is good for 2 people after a meal. The quality of the bingsoo is pretty good and I liked it. There are several tables in the AC room, so you can chill here for a bit comfortably as well.
review_4_text: Hands down the best Bingsu in town! Came back 2nd day in a row for another mango bingsu. Fresh, sweet mango cubes. Service is quick and friendly. Prices very reasonably and huge portion, 3 adults split one.
review_5_text: The mango bingsu was particularly good at this location so come here and get it.

name: October : Japanese Home Cooking
review_1_text: A cozy little Japanese fusion restaurant! Amazing food!! Highly recommended when you’re in Chiang Mai!!
review_2_text: Fantastic restaurant! The beef was very high quality and the service was amazing. Our food came so fast we were so surprised! I’d recommend coming here if you like Japanese food it’s excellent! 5 stars!
review_3_text:
If Google have 10stars, I will give all!
I’m a beef lover that’s why I love this restaurant. Almost every menu are so interesting. My friend and I selected the best 4 menus as the picture. I wasn’t remembered what’s the menu that we ordered but all menus are delicious!
I love beef soup and fried rice with garlic. Both menu are excellent more than I can say!
The restaurant have quite less seating. I think I may suggest you had better call to make a reservation in advance.
In totally I like this restaurant.
review_4_text: One of my most favorite restaurants to go to in Chiang Mai. The beef is so tender and delicious. The pasta was also very good and so was the mango cheesecake. So to sum it up, everything on the menu was great! The price is pretty high but it is really worth it.
review_5_text: Very nice authentic Japanese food. The place is cozy the decoration is simple but the staff is very friendly and they also have coffee and Japanese desserts. I eat here often and recommend it to everyone.

name: Cafe Kantary, Chiang Mai
review_1_text:
Beautiful and cosy cafe!

Tried their mango cheese cake and Thai tea. I liked the Thai tea, but the mango cheese cake was okay. I would have liked if the cheesecake had a thick base biscuit layer to balance the cheese taste.

Nice cafe to relax at and to enjoy some desserts as they have a variety of drinks and dessert options to choose from.

I also saw people working, editing, etc at the cafe.
review_2_text: Well made, flavorful & strong latte.  Delicious sausage roll (warmed in an oven, not a microwave, so the pastry was crisp and flaky).
review_3_text:
Every January–February, for almost 15 years now, this has been our little feng shui corner —
our place for peace, cool seats, and slow mornings.

Chiang Mai has countless beautiful, hip coffee spots.
But we always come back here.

Not because it’s trendy.
Not because it’s complicated.
But because it’s simple. Comfortable. Familiar.

And honestly… the staff are the main reason we return —
the smiles, the warmth, the way they remember us.

Good coffee and cakes are just the bonus.
review_4_text: I love this cafe! It is actually part of the Kantary Hotel but in a separate area. The pastries are really great, especially the almond enhanced peach tarte. It can get a bit pricy if you're not careful but the service is great and the ladies there are always friendly which makes it all worth it!
review_5_text:
Nov2025. We came here to chill and do some urgent work.
We had macha latte, americano, flat white and a lava cake. It was a nice place.

name: Yosniyom Coffee
review_1_text: Micro cafe/Hole in the Wall with limited indoor seating and footpath seating that has a cool corner breeze. Limited choices of coffee comparing to competitors but two roasts profiles available - medium or medium/dark . My iced americano was nothing extraordinary and non descriptive. No obvious signs of food available on display.
review_2_text: Good coffee. Nice little spot to relax and enjoy a cup of coffee🧋. But a bit pricey compared to the other cafes in the area.
review_3_text: Best coffee in town for single origins and micro lots. Also home made ice creams and non coffee drinks
review_4_text: Cheap and decent coffee. Workout at gym 30 m away ( the playground) the. Get ur coffee here 😁
review_5_text: Their vanilla latte is highly recommended to try. Make me feel active for every morning 😉

name: Nimman Forest Cafe นิมมาน ฟอร์เรส คาเฟ่
review_1_text: I had a thai tea and food:) They were delicious! I had a great time:) All the staff are very kind and friendly. Highly recommend:)
review_2_text:
Hello guys, welcome to everyone.
If you guys come at Chiangmai don’t know how to sleep and can connect this Nimman forest and cafe it’s very g beautiful hotel and sweet cafe..it’s cheaper and get free coffee😍😍
review_3_text: Great coffee, nice atmosphere.  The staff is very nice.
review_4_text: Hidden but worth finding great food and prices friendly workers.
review_5_text: The bedroom is clean, the bed is comfortable, and there are shared male and female bathrooms. The male staff member was helpful. Overall, it's good. It's close to Nimmanhaemin Market, with many cafes and restaurants, including some with live music. The atmosphere is nice, and the price is good. Breakfast is not included. The style is simple and chic loft. There's no parking, so you might want to ask the shops if there is any. There's a cafe downstairs with average-tasting food.

name: The 12 Cafe'
review_1_text: This is a hidden gem with beautiful greenery and open space sitting in a corner. Very peaceful vibes and all flowers in the cafe are fresh and well taken care of. Awesome for private conversations and working solo here.
review_2_text:
Very very good cappuccino, lovely environment and a great service. They tried to create a homely atmosphere and they absolutely nailed it. And I‘m gonna say it again: the cappuccino is fabulous!

Total recommendation from my side if you want to spend a little time working or just chatting with friends.
review_3_text: Food is served after 10:30AM. If you come earlier, only coffee and drinks are available.
review_4_text: Nice little cafe that seems to be run by the next-door Pingnakorn Nimman Hotel. The decor is pleasant, and my hot latte was nice.
review_5_text: Coffee was good and the interior is nice but I don't think I would return as it's part of a hotel.

name: Sonnen cafe
review_1_text: Super cute cafe tucked away on the busy road. Really attractive interior design, little office spaces you can sit off to the side in, and the friendliest staff. Best prices in the area!
review_2_text:
A perfect cafe that I was looking for! I didn't wanna go to modern cafes because I'm visiting Thailand and I'd like to visit places where give us local vibes. This is the perfect cafe that suits my needs.

The owner is very lovely, nice, and welcoming. Very very delicious latte. I ordered both iced and hot, great choices! Also very cheap price. Only 35 Baht for a hot latte.

It's a small local cafe, but it's got lots of seats. 5 tables inside, little terrace next to the main building. Outside smoking seats as well. I absolutely love the interior too. There's a massage shop close by so why not visit Sonnen Cafe! :)
review_3_text: I went to this café today by accident just because it was so hot outside. What an absolute gem. So chilled and the staff are so friendly. Drinks extremely reasonable. And even better on the tables were signs asking people if they wanted to use social media could they plug in their headphones. If I am in this part of town next year, I will definitely come back. The lady even helped me with my grab taxi when there was a problem.
review_4_text: Not a modern cafe, but delightful staffs and their drinks are cheaper than most of other cafes. I got dirty coffee for 55thb and it’s unique that the milk is frozen in a circular shape. They also have smoothie and other drinks and the prices are much cheaper than other stores as well.
review_5_text: Excellent coffee for the value and quality. Double shot is only 40Thb. Located on the side of a busy intersection but the atmosphere (two small enclosed glass rooms) though small, is quite tranquil. However, not an ideal place for group meetings because space is quite confined.

name: Roast8ry Coffee Flagship Store
review_1_text:
Santan Latte 100 ฿ , Walking Fox latte art 200 ฿  (2025)

Has English menu, can accept card payment.

Seems very famous place as many local and younger generations.

Dim lighting inside with some house or lo-fi music, it is quite noisy to me.

The latte art is very nice, but I feel maybe I pay 200 ฿ for the skill is not very necessary. I remember the cheapest options are also approaching 85 ฿ for Americano or expresso.

there is electric charge port, and free water.

The place is a hip and vibing, maybe suitable for IG photos.

Good coffee also.

It is a little loud inside but there are seating area outside as well.

Maybe I am just too old for this cafe 🤣
review_2_text:
One of my favorite coffee stops in Chiang Mai. The coffee was absolutely amazing with a large variety of choices. Lots of people at this location so come on off peak hours if you want seats. There are seats inside and outside.

The music may be a little loud if you plan on doing work or studying. Absolute great experience overall.
review_3_text:
Another good cafe in Chiang Mai!
Roast8ry got another store close by, but this is their Flagship store which you can tell.
Its a very fancy design and unique vibe here.
The Staff is very friendly, kind and generous.
My only minus is: the price.
I got a Machiato for 95 baht, which is the size of a normal sized espresso.
Of course this is more a lifestyle product than a regular coffee, tho for that price their coffee should be tasting next level, not average.
But besides that, a very nice coffee i recommend to visit.
review_4_text: Roast8ry Flagship is clearly designed to showcase professional barista skills, with a menu full of award-winning options and distinct latte art patterns. I ordered a pour-over from their selection, which was served with a nice scientific presentation. While the shop executes the technical side and the service perfectly, the experience focuses heavily on the "performance" of coffee. A solid stop if you enjoy a modern, showroom-style cafe environment.
review_5_text: Wow! This coffee art is awesome and all (when can you say you got coffee from a world champion?) but my god was this just the most balanced latte I've ever had in my life.  Great smoothness, flavor, and ambiance. The one taking my order pretty much walked me through the whole menu when it looked like I was studying the darn thing taking so long to decide 😀.  They also have many different coffee experiences that I have yet to see in other places so it's not just your standard neighborhood coffee place and the prices reflect that. I couldn't care less, definitely coming back to try the rest.

name: Charin Pie
review_1_text:
What a sweet and peaceful oasis in busy Nimman!   The staff are so kind and the espresso was delicious!   I liked that they offer light, medium and dark roast choices.  I had a medium roast espresso and it was perfectly smooth and chocolaty.   So many neat spots to sit and relax.   We chose the  inside back room which was cool and really quiet!
The Christmas hats everyone wore made it that much more fun.
Thank you for a great first experience after years of staying near by.
review_2_text: The desserts all look amazing, but need to try the coconut pie! The coffee is amazing as well. There are a lot of seats at the place, so great to stop by with friends for some coffee and desserts. The place is kept pretty tidy and the staff was friendly as well. Great stop to visit while in Chiang Mai’
review_3_text: You can’t go wrong with any of their pies.  My fav combo is lemon pie and coconut meringue pie that gave mw a good touch of sweet & sour. I also like its crust.  Was known the cafe was established for long and still continues baking and selling more flavors.
review_4_text:
Pie was great. I ate Lemon pie and coconut pie. Many people take out their pie. Many kinds of pies you can meet.
Coffee was soso. Tea was a little bit blend. I don’t recommend it.
Not many seat inside but there’s air conditioning. Atmosphere was cute.

But inside there was so many mosquitoes. So it was awful. If you're going, make sure to use mosquito detizer. I ran away because I was hit by a mosquito because I didn't have it.
review_5_text: This is my second time here! I love the coconut pie—the price is reasonable, and the latte art is great. If you order a drink with latte foam on top, they can make a photo of you on the foam.

name: Groon Bread & Brunch Cafe
review_1_text:
I had such a wonderful time here! I came yesterday because I wasn't feeling my best and really needed some good comfort food.

I ordered the bagel with scrambled eggs, chorizo, and parmesan. It was excellent and perfectly executed—the cooking of the eggs was spot on, and the chorizo was high quality. I also had the Greek yogurt bowl with muesli, honey, and fruit, which was delicious.

The atmosphere is really nice, perfect for those looking to bring a laptop and work for a few hours. Even though the prices are on the higher end for Chiang Mai, it is absolutely worth it. You can really taste that it's homemade and top quality. I highly recommend it and can't wait to come back to try the rest of the menu!
review_2_text:
Absolutely wonderful place to grab brunch with a friend loved one.

The atmosphere is incredible on a crispy November morning in Chiang Mai.

Good: The shio pan was most notable - perfectly enjoyable. Everything else was decent!

So-so: as a matcha lover, I would skip buying from here, nothing to wow.

Bonus: pet-friendly outside seating
review_3_text: A perfect café for breakfast or brunch. The menu offers a wide variety of options to choose from, such as bagels, sandwiches, pasta, coffee, and fresh juices. I ordered a chicken quesadilla and a “Good Morning” coffee — both were very good. The staff is gentle, friendly, and welcoming 🍪🥃☕
review_4_text: Amazing little brunch place with the tastiest pesto I’ve ever had, and à Wonderful ice latte. Beautifully cooked egg and omelette. A little noisy maybe but over all worth a visit just for the pesto! 😅❤️
review_5_text: I like cream coffee very much. The coffee is very mellow and goes well with the coffee. The shop has a variety of menus to choose from. The atmosphere inside the shop is warm, the service staff is good and friendly. Anyone who likes sandwiches should not miss it because the shop bakes bread itself every day.

name: 7 Senses Gelato
review_1_text:
I’ve been to 7 Senses Gelato many times, and it’s one of those places that I always find myself coming back to. 🍨 The shop offers a wide selection of flavors, from classic options to creative seasonal ones. Every time I visit, I try to discover a new favorite, though I have to admit that most of the flavors are quite sweet for my personal taste since I don’t eat much sugar. However, my company — whether my friend or boyfriend — always enjoys them a lot, so it’s a great spot to share something sweet together.

The shop provides free drinking water, which I find very thoughtful, especially after eating gelato. The staff are a bit shy but always kind, polite, and ready to help. The atmosphere is peaceful and quiet, perfect for sitting down to enjoy a slow afternoon in Chiang Mai.

The location is convenient but not ideal for car parking since the street is quite small; however, it’s easy to park a motorbike nearby. I usually order one or two scoops each visit.

Overall, it’s a charming little gelato shop that serves great flavors with a friendly vibe. Definitely recommended!
review_2_text: Great gelato, the best ever! Have the chance to meet the owner, Stefano and he is as good as his products, very proffesional. If you have ever thought of a flavor and haven't found it, tell him about it, he will make it happen! Highly recommended
review_3_text: Absolutely delicious gelato! There are so many tasty flavors to choose from — everything looked amazing, and the ones I tried were creamy, rich, and full of flavor. You can really tell they use high-quality ingredients. The staff were friendly and patient while I was deciding (which was hard because everything looked so good!). The place itself is cute and inviting, perfect for a little treat on a warm day. Definitely worth stopping by if you’re in the area! 🍦💛
review_4_text:
WOW!!!! Amazing gelato, owner is Italian and the gelato is excellent quality, really unique and delicious flavour combinations.

I was hoping to try the famous ricotta and caramelized fig but they had sold out. I had the ricotta and pear instead, which was excellent, as was the strawberry cheesecake. I also got the salted caramel (normally my favourite) but I thought it was lacking in flavour a little (compared with the amazing taste of the other flavours. They also had take away tubs available in a freezer.
Great environment, indoor and outdoor seating.

I’d love if they had small scoop options as I wanted to try lots of flavors but the scoops were too big!! I’ll just have to come back!!
review_5_text:
🍦 The ice cream is absolutely delicious – creamy, flavorful, and clearly made with care. I’d happily come back for the taste alone!
That said, I’m giving 4 out of 5 stars because it’s a bit pricey, and they don’t accept card payments. Only cash, Alipay, or LINE Pay are available – which isn’t ideal for everyone. Still, a great place for a sweet treat if you're prepared!

name: Free Bird Cafe CNX Donation Center and Thrift Store
review_1_text:
Amazing spot, down a nice quiet street. The food is delicious and varied, perfect for non meat eaters. They have a mini thrift store inside which has some really cool items and is very cheap, and best of all the money for which goes to charity. They also have a selection of English and German books for 20baht each.

We came three times on our trip, staff are friendly and polite.

Thanks so much!
review_2_text: We had a disappointing dinner there recently.  We ordered the lentil soup, chickpea curry, a potato appetizer, a roti, and rice.  The potato dish was not bad, and was the best value as the portion size was reasonable.  Unfortunatly, the rest of the food was not good.  We did not enjoy the flavors at all.  We rated the food low because the portion size was very small, and the cost was much higher than what we pay for larger portions of better food elsewhere in Chiang Mai.
review_3_text:
One of the best restaurants I’ve ever been to! The food was incredible and catered to my and my wife’s dietary needs. The restaurant and food told a story so not only was the food delicious, but it was also a great leaning experience. The staff was so kind and took good care of us. We were so full after eating!! Great sized portions and so many yummy choices.
We will definitely be back when we return to Chiang Mai!
review_4_text: We visited in October 2025 as a couple. The place has good vegetarian, gluten-free, and non-spicy food options. The price is decent for the quality and quantity offered. The service can be improved as we have to order and pay at counter, but the ambience is charming. Its located on a main street, and so there is easy access to taxi and parking. There are also games to play in indoor sitting area and shop to buy near the cash counter. It is a romantic family-friendly and cat-friendly place to eat authentic Thai food.
review_5_text: I just love this place, the vibe and the concept of merging it with a second hand shop! They have board games and the drinks are yummy. However, I would not come for the food that I found to lack flavor (although it’s vegan). For example I would not recommend the Mac n cheese.

name: CHARLIE (ชาร์ลี) Thai Tea - Nimman Soi13 (Grab&Go)
review_1_text:
Came by specifically to try their Thai tea and was genuinely impressed. The quality exceeded expectations, ordered less sweet, with well-balanced flavors that aren’t overly sweet — exactly to our preference. Standout picks were the Charlie (Salted Caramel Cold Foam Pour Over Thai Milk Tea) and the Soft Latte Thai Tea, both smooth, fragrant, and nicely layered. We went with the staff’s recommendations for type of tea and honestly, you can’t go wrong with any of them.

The outlet itself is small and minimal, quite cool inside, with only a handful of chairs available indoors and outdoors. There was no queue when we visited, making it ideal for a quick grab-and-go. Perfect for picking up a drink and strolling around the area. Definitely worth a try if you’re a Thai tea fan. I prefer this outlet compared others.
review_2_text: Cute store with a cozy atmosphere. You get to choose from their selection of tea leaves and if you order in they allow you to mix your own Thai iced tea as well which makes for a great experience! Smooth balance of flavour and if it’s your first time in Thailand then I would suggest getting 50% sugar as I’ve noticed their default sugar level is higher than normal.
review_3_text: My first time trying this one, in Chiang Mai. The place just simple, prefer for take away. The thai tea really delicious, yummy! Thick, sweet and you can choose kind of tea.
review_4_text:
A must-visit for tea lovers, especially if you love Thai tea! They offer a wide variety of teas from different parts of Thailand, and you can customize how dark you want your tea and the sweetness level.

I highly recommend the Satun tea (4 mins, 75% sweetness), it’s rich and flavorful.

They also have a great selection of coffee, but the Thai tea is the real highlight. If you’re a Thai tea fan, this is the place for you!
review_5_text:
This staff member at this bubble tea shop is an absolute disgrace to Chiang Mai's service industry. From the moment we started ordering, she was impatient and had a terrible attitude. The drink she made was almost entirely ice — there was less than 80ml of actual liquid in the cup.

When I tried to raise the issue with her, she remained unfriendly and unhelpful. She kept her back turned to us the entire time, completely unwilling to communicate. Another staff member had to step in to talk to us and then relayed our concerns to her. Her response? She couldn’t have cared less and said, “Go ahead and complain about us if you want.”

Absolutely unacceptable behavior and a completely disappointing experience.

I know it's impolite to post someone's photo publicly, but she also showed no respect to us as customers! As a tourist and a foreigner, I don’t understand why she treated us differently. So disappointed!

name: Ji Matcha Tea Time
review_1_text: A lovely Japanese teahouse with a Beautifully authentic decoration that creates a very calm and relaxing atmosphere. They offer a good variety of Japanese teas and matcha, all well prepared. The Japanese-style sweets are delicious and pair perfectly with the tea. A great place to slow down and enjoy a peaceful moment 🍵🫖💕
review_2_text: Beautifully decorated to give off a feeling of tranquility. Lots of unique and pretty matcha bowls displayed. The staff could speak English and patiently introduced their various desserts. I tried the matcha coconut milk and sakura ice cream which felt like I was eating white chocolate. They added a nice touch to the dishes as well, pairing the matcha with a sweet gummy.
review_3_text:
Beautiful and cute little cafe, extremely serene and peaceful. Great for enjoying real high quality matcha. Best matcha i’ve had ever!

Great high quality ingredients, desserts and tea.

They also have cats 🤗
review_4_text: Really lovely Japanese place, with a large area to sit. The seats are low down in true Japanese style. Food was really well presented and tasted good. Overall a nice experience and a break from the hustle of Thailand.
review_5_text:
I wish we had more photos but the place was so chill we just ended up relaxing, sipping drinks, and talking. Isn't that what cafes are for?
BONUS: THEY HAVE A CUTE GRUMPY LOOKING CAT!!!! *wasn't able to take a photo 😭

name: GRAPH quarter
review_1_text:
This palce is a beautiful café with a modern, well-designed space surrounded by greenery that creates a very calm atmosphere. The place is spacious, bright, and quiet, making it perfect for relaxing or working on your laptop.
The coffee is high quality, and you can really feel the attention to detail, from the presentation to the overall vibe. I especially loved the wooden terrace — a great spot to sit, unwind, and escape the city noise.
An elegant, peaceful café with great energy. Highly recommended if you’re looking for a nice place to enjoy coffee in Chiang Mai.
review_2_text: Graph is one of our favorite cafes, and just having one so close to our accommodation was a bonus.  We walked to Graph Quarter to have one of their most amazing specialty coffees.  This graph is very cute inside. Small but super tasty selection of baked treats, we got a blueberry cheesecake to share.  But their coffee list is amazing, and there are lots of different specialty coffees to choose from.  We chose Soul Smith and Graph No.29,  both completely different but both so delicious.  The staff here are friendly.  It was a very chill vibe inside, and I loved the chill music, too.  They have a cute little gift section too for little gifts you might like to buy and take home.
review_3_text: I loved this coffe place, in Chiang Mai there is a pleasant coffee culture. The coffee was great, great inventions, even the PAC and the canele were great (European standards). I have to say, the coffee is pretty expensive for the standards so I think the place is more appropriate as an experience rather than the usual coffee you take every day.
review_4_text: My top 3 favorite cafés! The coffee, cake, and vibes are just right. 🤎
review_5_text:
Love this place! I discovered GRAPH in a small coffee shop in Chiang Mai old city in 2017, and was happily surprised to see it expanded in 2023.

The nitro coffee creations are like nothing I've tasted before and are a mixture of lots of combinations to suit anyone.

My favourite was downtown! Refreshing with a hint of chocolate flavour and coffee.

The resident kitty is also another reason to come.

I think if there is one coffee shop to visit, GRAPH is one of them! You won't taste coffee like it.

name: Pai Yan Yai Coffee
review_1_text:
I randomly found that cafe on my morning walk, and i am glad i did! Its a cozy little cafe/co-working place with a decent menu and coffee!
The Cappuccino was great, 80 THB.
As you can see on the other pictures, they also have a lot of food, especially their Thai food should be very nice!
The Staff is very welcoming and kind. Overall a great and not to pricey experience, recommended.
review_2_text:
This has quietly become my favorite coffee spot in Chiang Mai. And I don’t say that lightly.
The service is genuinely stellar. Not the performative kind. Just kind, attentive, human. The sort of place where you feel remembered, even if it’s your first visit.
The atmosphere is calm without being sleepy, and it’s clearly a local favorite. I’ve had coffee sitting in, coffee to go, rushed mornings and slow ones, and it’s always exactly right. If you’re looking for a place you’ll end up returning to every morning without really questioning why, this is it.
review_3_text: Great place for breakfast, lunch, coffees and other drinks. You can also work from here. The staff are very lovely and friendly! Much try their signature coffee! We visit regularly and would definitely recommend.
review_4_text: Deliciously prepared fresh, healthy foods with freshly brewed coffees & teas. Lots to 💕 @ Pai Yan Yai. Friendly service team and totally fair prices!!
review_5_text: Fantastic place to work — I’ve been here at least 5 times over the past week. The food and coffee are great, but the real standout is the chocolate cake — absolutely out of this world. Most seats have power outlets, which is super convenient. The owner is incredibly friendly and welcoming. Thank you guys!

name: Sonday
review_1_text:
The café has a small and cozy space, with tables suitable for 2 to 3 people, making it more ideal for a quick stop rather than a long sit-down. They serve coffee only, if I’m not mistaken, which makes it a focused spot for coffee lovers.

The coffee is great for takeaway, and since we enjoy dirty coffee, we decided to give it a try. It was worth trying and didn’t disappoint.

Overall, it’s a nice spot to grab a good cup of coffee, especially if you’re nearby.
review_2_text: Fantastic coffee!!! This is a tiny shop with limited seating but great coffee for 60 THB. They sell a good variety of homemade, artisan cookies too- the chocolate chip and nut one I had was quite nice but not amazing.
review_3_text:
Easily the best Dirty Coffee I've had in Chiang Mai. They've got a special menu with different types of milk used in making dirty. I tried the first option with coconut cream and it was mind-blowingly smooth.

It's a cute little cafe with lovely decorations. But you'll probably not find a table there as there are only 3 of them.

I need to learn from them how they make their coffee.
review_4_text: The location is relatively small, but don't underestimate how tasty their coffees are. More specifically, their dirty lattes show a sense of creativity and innovation from their owners which isn't seen in many other cafes. I specifically liked the mango sticky rice dirty latte, but I'm sure the other ones would also be delicious.
review_5_text: At the barista’s recommendation, I tried the salted caramel iced coffee - it was delicious! I also snagged two of their cookies to go, and the lemon curd one I’ve eaten so far is tart and yummy. They have a small cafe (maybe 3 tables) and small menu, but several unique flavors of homemade cookies like tiramisu, carrot cake, chocolate with marshmallow, and gooey macadamia nut. The cafe was cutely decorated with Valentine’s decor, as was my cup. A great spot to grab a drink on your way to CMU or Nimman!

name: Sway CNX - Rooftop Artisan Coffee (No more smoothie bowls)
review_1_text: Super cute café! The rooftop view is absolutely stunning, perfect for relaxing or getting some work done. The vibe is cozy, the drinks are good, and it’s a really nice spot in Nimman to chill and enjoy the scenery
review_2_text:
We came a little before 6pm, the couple before us were able to order coffee but when it was our turn, the staff said we could only order alcohol now. My friends before me were able to order mocktails but when it was my turn, the staff said they did not have mocktails 🤨🤔
It was a very confusing experience. We did not see any signs about ordering time so I'm not sure what's the rule here.
The view was nice, the drinks were mediocre.
review_3_text: Great 10/10 coffee and even greater place to work on your laptop. 5 floors up, it’s a secret haven with a lovely team. Music is the perfect vibe to relax and work to.
review_4_text: There is no lift, you have to take the staircases to go up. But it's still worth! Perfect place for the remote worker.
review_5_text: Amazing view, comfortable space to work from, and the coffee is just on another level. Lovely place!

name: Gatone's Burmese Food and Teashop
review_1_text:
I tried the ginger salad and mohinga, both were absolutely delicious. The ginger salad was fresh, crunchy, and perfectly balanced with a light tangy flavor that felt very authentic. The mohinga was comforting and flavorfulbthat reminded me of true Myanmar home-style cooking.

The restaurant has a simple, clean, and Burmese traditional tea shop style sitting area,  the service was friendly and welcoming. It’s a great place to enjoy real Burmese food in Chiang Mai, especially if you’re craving something traditional and satisfying. Highly recommended 🇲🇲🍜
review_2_text: The fried ginger salad looks like an innocent mess but it’s sooo delicious! I also had the black bean steamed dumplings as dessert with the hot Chinese tea they serve for free - delicious. I’m vegetarian so I’m happy I found options here. At a great price and staff is so kind.
review_3_text: I love to eat here for breakfast and lunch. They do not have curry meals, but if you are missing the tea shop in Myanmar, this is the place for you. The food is good and clean, and I love the vibe in this restaurant. Myanmar green tea and water are free to drink here. You just need to grab one where you sit.
review_4_text:
Cute restaurant
Great food ,lot of variety
And tea is so rich and good
review_5_text: My 3rd time eating at Burmese restaurant in a week in this city after discovering I like Burmese food. This is not the best one so far, but it’s still very good. People at Burmese restaurants are much nicer than those at Thai restaurants somehow.

name: Wabi sabi coffee
review_1_text: Good coffee, friendly staff, good beans and cozy vibes. You can sit inside or outside. The prices are very reasonable and they got different cup sizes. One of the cheaper places but they still deliver awesome quality with a variety of 3 different beans, mild, medium and strong. ☕️
review_2_text:
A simple and cozy café in Chiang Mai with very good prices and excellent, flavorful coffee. The atmosphere is calm and peaceful, ideal for relaxing or spending some time working.
The staff is very friendly and welcoming, which makes the experience even better. A no-frills place with great quality and a nice vibe. Highly recommended.
review_3_text:
Short stop for morning coffee☕️
Medium roast is a bit too dark for my taste but overall is okay. The price is worth its quality. Quite crowded in the morning with food delivery and passerby🏃
review_4_text:
A new favourite coffee place.
A good flat white, a very nice young team and a relaxed, clean lines vibe.
Prices on the low side.
review_5_text: A modest little coffee shop offering standard sandwiches, waffles and delicious brownies. The place has a few tables and one clean toilet. It’s not a formal dining setup — just a straightforward spot to enjoy a cup of coffee without the extras.

name: ABK Art and Studio 1991 School
review_1_text:
Today, we booked and participated in a 3-hour program.

After the meal, there was a period of free outdoor play time at the end. During this time, some older boys—who seemed to visit this place regularly—created their own rules and imposed restrictions on how the children could play.

While this kind of interaction can be seen as part of developing social skills, once a few children start following rules made by older kids, those who dislike them are often forced to comply. My child did not want to follow these rules.
What was more concerning was that the older boys were seen getting angry at my child.

This is a situation where staff supervision is clearly needed, but we felt that this time period was left unattended for too long.

Depending on a child’s personality, this free play time can be either enjoyable or uncomfortable, and inappropriate behavior by older children should be properly managed.

Because of this disappointing ending, I am leaving a 2-star review.
review_2_text: Very nice for kids come to play and do activity class . Food also yummy :)
review_3_text: Nice shady outdoor area for kids to play in. Toys are dirty and worn out but my kid enjoyed them. The mosquito coil smelled way too strong and I had a bad headache after staying indoor for 10 minutes, not sure if the kids are ok with it. Music playlist could be kids songs instead of Bruno Mars imo.
review_4_text: My kids loveeeedd with the teachers and they played so happily! My kids loved it here bcs he can sing, draw and play anything what they want.
review_5_text: Teachers are so friendly and kids love this place. Recommend!

name: Coco Corner
review_1_text: This shop has a comfortable design, the owner is very friendly, and the aroma is intoxicating as soon as you enter. The desserts are also delicious; the coconut chips are just the right amount of sweetness, refreshing and delightful! 😋
review_2_text: Wonderful place, everything I’ve tried was super nice, ambient music, friendly stuff. Mango and coconuts very very yummy. The only thing is there is a commission if you are paying with card. So cash is better or the 220 BHT fee applies.
review_3_text:
There’s ac inside!

Nice clean spot with chill music, also sells linen clothes and small trinkets/coasters/artisanal Siamaya chocolate.

The coconut milkshake (99 THB) I got had a pleasant, fresh coconut taste that wasn’t icy as it was blended properly. Took maybe 10 or so min for my order to come out.

The older lady speaks some English and offered nice service.

They take credit card with an additional 3% processing fee.

Will have to come back for the pandan custard toast!!
review_4_text: I tried their mango smoothie with half mango fruit diced - take away. Really refreshing and the mango was super sweet too. What a nice dessert after dinner and something to enjoy on my walk back to our hotel.
review_5_text: Good drinks and dessert; very friendly service. Bright welcoming interior with clean washroom.

name: Jungle De Cafe Nimman จังเกิ้ล เดอ คาเฟ่ สาขา นิมมาน
review_1_text: Very large nice modern cafe/restaurant with a plenty of nice tables. It would be nice for group gatherings, working, and studying, or having meetings. This place also has a variety of food from Thai to western and pizza as well. It is really nice and relaxing, but it’s very empty so you wanna come take a look. Coffee here is around 70THB.
review_2_text:
Popped in for an iced coffee, and it was one of the best we've had!
The cafe is beautifully decorated, and there is plenty of space to sit whether you prefer inside or out.
The staff are super friendly, and the cakes looked scrummy!
The stars of the show were definitely the cats!
We left feeling so chilled and happy!
review_3_text: I was searching a cafe where I can lay down and rest. When I went there not lots of people on weekend. They kindly turn on ac for us. I ordered greentea(great smell like chatramue), lemon tea(brown lemon syrup). Price was reasonable to visit. Chair is comfortable to seat. now they have only one place to laydown inside. Outside have alot but hot. One thing that they don't care babies, it was very loud. Not recommend for people who wants to study or take a rest.
review_4_text:
Nice cozy place for coffee.
Looks like there is a bar on the second floor.
review_5_text: Brought my family here for lunch. Food is good. Reasonable prices. Very friendly staff. Most like is the lady boss.

name: Go Green Café & Restaurant
review_1_text:
We ordered the afternoon special Twin set - a meal and a drink each. The mince pork rice dish is so nice. I like the Pendan & Lemongrass tea, so freshing and '100% guilt-free'. A good place to relax for a while.

We like the restaurant so much so we are back the second day for a different dish on the Twin set deal. A bit chilli but we loved it.
review_2_text:
I have enjoyed the Khao Kra-Praw, roasted pork with an egg fry at reasonable price. My wife has enjoyed Khao Kra-Tiam, fried chicken . We both loved the food.
Strongly rcommend!
review_3_text: We stopped by accident and so happy we did. A small cafe restaurant with a fresh and friendly menu, especially easy for tourists. My husband had the omelette with pork which was light and fluffy and I had the Pad See Ew with mince and instant noodles. It was fresh and delicious with a good spice. They have a great selection of sodas and also cold beer. Definitely try this place when in Nimman
review_4_text: Been here a couple of times for coffee including to work. Very chilled environment with decent WI-FI. The coffee though is amazing. Flat white is up there with New Zealand or Australian quality.
review_5_text: Calm low key coffee shop that doubles as a small restaurant. The Thai lady at the back is a powerhouse with the wok. The food and coffee here is so reasonably priced and both were excellent. Everyone was really nice too.

name: FRIENDS CAFE
review_1_text:
A small, cute café located right in the heart of Nimman, just in front of Stay Collection Hotel. I ordered the coconut coffee and it was surprisingly good! My friend tried the Thai-espresso and it was also very nice and flavorful.

Even though the café is right by the main street and there’s a bit of noise, you can still talk comfortably — though it might be more suitable for a quick grab-and-go. Overall, I really enjoyed it and would definitely come back again!
review_2_text: The taste is good, and I like the slightly heavy texture of the latte. The large ice cubes help maintain the original flavor, allowing me to enjoy it continuously.
review_3_text:
Simple outdoor cafe, order a latte and boss just ask to pay whatever you want.
Nice way of doing business and customer will value it by the quality.

The latte was nice, accurate temperature, nice note, smooth. I almost finish it within 1 mins I have it
review_4_text: The best coffee we had in Thailand! The owner, a young Thai man who runs the place solo, is a true coffee enthusiast dedicated to brewing exclusively with Thai-grown beans. To our surprise, Thai coffee turned out to be exceptional. He has thoughtfully curated every detail in the shop, including a water filtration system designed to adjust the mineral levels for each cup. He also shared a fascinating explanation about the emerging trend of coffee cultivation in Thailand. Highly recommended!
review_5_text:
This coffee stand reminded me of my favourite one in my home country. And the owner is very nice and humble. His latte art skill has a room for development but the taste is super good.

I definitely prefer his coffee than those coffee place with perfect heart shape but without a character of the cup of coffee itself.
His coffee and himself got good heart.

Thank you for a great cappa for the first coffee ever in Chiang Mai.

P.S. The photo of coffee is after we tried some.

name: Krema Cafe
review_1_text: Good coffee shop with nice pastries. The place is quite small. Only a few tables inside and a couple more outside. It feels a bit odd sitting inside. Maybe just because I was by myself when I came here. And it was super quiet. But prices are fair and the guy who worked here was very nice. And I liked the lemon tart.
review_2_text:
We came here specifically for the pistachio tart, and left highly satisfied. While it's on the pricier side for its size, we found that the quality of the flavor was worth it. The flavor is rich and you can take your time to savor it.

As for the drinks, the cheese cream strawberry latte was really, really good too. It tastes like a strawberry shortcake in liquid form and had real chunks of strawberry. The coffee was just okay for me, but it worked well as a palate cleanser to help appreciate the sweetness of the tart.

For an upscale dessert, Krema is an absolute yes.
review_3_text: Absolutely lovely café with a calm, elegant atmosphere. The desserts are beautifully presented and taste just as amazing as they look—fresh, well-balanced, and not overly sweet. The coffee is smooth and perfectly crafted, making it a great pairing with the pastries. I really enjoyed the cozy, minimalist décor; it’s a perfect spot to relax, catch up with friends, or enjoy some quiet time. Friendly service and great attention to detail. Highly recommended!
review_4_text: This place is so good. I highly recommend the treats here, not too sweet and so fresh, but for the coffee a bit too light for me anyway, I can't wait to go back and try so many other treats
review_5_text: I ordered the Pistachio Tart — it was rich and flavorful. I also tried the Strawberry Latte, one of the shop’s signature drinks, and it had a wonderfully smooth taste. The atmosphere in the café is clean and relaxing, with a soft white-toned decor.

name: la.moon cold cafe (สาขาศิริมังคลาจารย์)
review_1_text: Love coming here in the morning to have my first cup of coffee of the day. Cold brew with coconut flavor is the best! Never knew black coffee could taste so delicious.
review_2_text: The best ceremonial grade matcha latte I’ve had in Chiang Mai! They call is premium matcha (they have two types) and it’s on the pricier side (155 thb) but I’d rather pay for good matcha than pay a lesser price for a not so good one. The umami taste is just perfect. Their recipe is on the sweeter side so ask for it to be less sweet or not at all if that’s what you prefer!
review_3_text: Nice modern cafe with good coffee and nice space with AC. The main thing here is the space that they have long tables with power outlets in the 2nd floor and it’s pretty optimized for working. Their lemon custard cake is pretty bad so you don’t want to get that though.
review_4_text:
Perfect for digital nomads. They have a lot of tables with outlets. Place is very quiet.

I tried their iced chocolate, it was good.

Staff are nice too!!
review_5_text:
- I live here for a long time but it’s it’s my first time to come here
- They have the second floor it’s really nice
- I tried that strawberry Matcha latte I think it is too sweet …

name: Brew Fact
review_1_text:
Very happy to find a café that opens as early as 7am, with a good variety of bakes available. We had the shio pan (salty butter roll) at ฿30, the ham & cheese bread, and two hot lattes — one medium roast and one dark roast.

The medium and dark roasts tasted quite similar; it was hard to tell much of a difference. The shio pan was really good — loved it. The ham & cheese bread was decent as well, and we added shredded pork with mayonnaise. I actually rank this after shio pan, as it reminded me of ba-hu (pork floss).

The only downside for me is that they don’t accept credit cards, only Thai payment methods or cash.
review_2_text:
◽️Highlights:
•Not just coffee — they also bake their own pastries fresh daily.
•Must-try: Shi-O (butter bun with salt) — served hot, soft, and addictive! Perfect match with a hot coffee. This keeps me coming back every time.
•Love the hot latte (medium-roast) — smooth and flavorful. Tried the iced latte but didn’t enjoy it as much.

◽️Atmosphere:
•Cozy and welcoming, with a friendly vibe.
•Staff are attentive (one even remembered my previous order — impressive!).

💡 Tip: Pair the hot latte with the Shi-O bun.
review_3_text:
The place is very beautiful and probably the best coffee that I tried. I was impressed with their minimalistic design and would like to be there a bit longer, but unfortunately I was in rush. Bakery is good and worth to try.
I took 1 star away in service because they don’t take credit cards which is not that convenient for tourists that visit this city a lot.
review_4_text: Very comfy little cafe. Its quiet, clean and got some good vibes. Also got good coffee with a variety of beans
review_5_text:
Brew Fact in Chiang Mai is a coffee lover’s dream come true. From the moment you step inside, you’re greeted by the warm aroma of freshly brewed coffee and a cozy, modern atmosphere that makes you want to linger. The attention to detail here is exceptional—whether it’s the beautifully crafted drinks or the inviting decor.

Their pour-over coffee is an absolute standout, showcasing their expertise in sourcing and roasting beans. Each cup is rich, flavorful, and brewed to perfection, with notes so complex you’ll savor every sip. For something unique, their signature coffee creations are a must-try, blending bold flavors with a creative twist.

The food menu is equally impressive, with thoughtful pairings that complement their coffee offerings. The staff are friendly, knowledgeable, and clearly passionate about what they do, always happy to recommend a drink or share the story behind their beans.

Brew Fact is not just a café—it’s an experience. Whether you’re a casual coffee drinker or a serious enthusiast, this is a spot you’ll keep coming back to. It’s a perfect escape in Chiang Mai to enjoy great coffee, great vibes, and exceptional service.

name: Light Brown Coffee
review_1_text: More than expectation! the coffee is really really good and many choices of menu. Not too crowded which is good. My light roasted Americano made the day.
review_2_text: Definitely my favorite go to coffee shop, reasonable price. The location is perfect between my gym and office, a lot of parking space along the street in the morning. Their coffee will never fail you, selection of beans and milk alternatives. Banana bread and cheese cake are also available if you feel like a little more than just coffee.
review_3_text:
Tasty tasty black smooth coffee. No fuss cafe. Space for laptops, good lighting and also some seating out the front for a more social group.
Cash only and some good looking pastries and sweets available.
review_4_text: High quality matcha latte with oat milk. They are very friendly and chill atmosphere. Highly recommend!
review_5_text:
There’s quite a lot of seating available both indoors and outdoors for a small sized cafe but we wanted to takeaway our coffee anyway.

My girlfriend ordered an iced latte and although they didn’t have decaf, we were able to get just the single shot of espresso in our latte instead of 2 to 3 shots.

My gf said her latte tasted good so we will be back again.

65 baht for a latte - really fairly priced

name: Third Place Coffee - Chiang Mai
review_1_text: We orders an Americano and a an iced cappuccino. Very tasty. The staff is friendly and work hard to make a good cup of coffee. The shop has free WiFi and plays relaxing piano jazz vibes.
review_2_text: This café is a gem! The coffee is excellent, rich, and smooth, but the muffin really stole the show, fresh, soft, and full of chocolate. The cozy vibe makes it a perfect spot to relax or get some work done. Definitely a place I’ll be coming back to!
review_3_text: Rather a small cafe. 2nd floor is like a small quiet space with only a few tables. They are open until 7pm, but 2nd floor is only open until 445pm. I got hot cappuccino and it was ok.
review_4_text: Dope cafe! Really chill vibes with great decor. Super friendly staff and selection. I highly recommend the orange cold brew (if you don’t like milk) and the ice latte (if you do like milk). Lovely
review_5_text:
Situation at the end of a quiet lane, saw this gem on Google map and decided to check it out.
Gotten their latte and it was nice and not too acidic. Prices were slightly lower than the other cafes I passed by too. They have more seats on 2nd level.
Free WiFi and great service too.

name: I Tim Baan Yaii - homemade ice cream
review_1_text: The cutest and absolutely delightful ice cream place. The flavor choices are unique enough to be fun to choose but familiar enough to make the right choices. I recommend the sundaes. Creamy and delicious. The interior and exterior are photo worthy.
review_2_text:
Cute place & good price I had Cocoa Bomb
was very yummy and not too sweet.
Love it! 2 big scoops in waffles 125-.
Only Matcha Biscoff +10baht (recommended) Btw, you can try it for free before ordering.
review_3_text:
Quaint cosy little shop with homemade ice cream and coffee/tea.
Ordered a chocolate strawberry ice cream which was really good.. not too sweet
They have flavors like yuzu sorbet, rum and raisins, choc bomb etc
review_4_text:
Homemade ice cream with a homely vibe. They've got a good selection of flavours, I tried their classic Thai Milk Tea flavour and really enjoyed it.

The portions of the ice cream scoop are also good and at a reasonable price. There's also free topping and sauces.

Ample indoor & outdoor space with WiFi & toilet. It could also be used as a space for coworking.
review_5_text: Amazing ice-cream, i ordered the rum raisin. The iced latte was soso though. Great vibes with clean environment, thoughtful decor and white themed design.

name: Tea of us
review_1_text: Really liked the taste of the Thai tea. There is limited space to sit, but the entire cafe looks really pretty. I enjoyed my time here, will keep coming back, and would definitely recommend it.
review_2_text: The tea is of exceptional quality, with an inviting aroma that greets you the moment you step in. Each sip is perfectly creamy and balanced, delightfully smooth without being too sweet. The store’s warm orange-brick décor creates a cozy atmosphere, featuring several photo-worthy spots that add charm to every visit.
review_3_text: Good taste , rich flavor, reasonable price for tea and cute atmosphere ☺️🧋
review_4_text:
The tea is smooth and rich in the flavor. The sweetness of the shop can choose from 0,25,50,75 to 100. I try at 25. It’s just nice and go very well with the boba jelly.

The Thai tea is very aromatic and not bitter. If you are milk tea lover. There are variety option available. Can come and try :)) the parking maybe difficult but there is a rider service. And I saw they separate the ice and the tea so that’s should taste the same when it arrived.

Do come and try :)
review_5_text:
Order: original Thai tea with 25% sweetness! It is delicious!!!

The right amount of sweetness. I find Thai tea too sweet but this 25% is just hitting my spot.

Really nice little tea cafe, it’s beautifully decorated.

nice to spend an afternoon.

name: Mingmitr Coffee
review_1_text: I tried the es yen and a chocolate danish, and I finished the coffee before I walked the remaining few minutes to CMU it was so good! The cafe is clean, modern, and spacious with free wifi and a water station. The indoor chairs are very comfortable, and there is also some outdoor seating. The staff were very kind and spoke great English. There was a decent variety of drinks and pastries on their menu. I walk past the cafe every day and only today finally decided to stop in - and I’m very glad I did!
review_2_text:
Mingmitr Coffee - Wonderful Drinks and Friendly Service

My group of 7 friends came here and we all loved our drinks! I tried the Hom La Mai Thai style coffee, and the staff were super helpful in adding some extra condensed milk to make it the perfect sweetness for my taste.

I also really enjoyed their clementine juice - it was delicious! And I have to say, I absolutely loved the store's decor and overall atmosphere. It had a really cozy, welcoming vibe.

Overall, a great experience at Mingmitr Coffee. The staff went above and beyond to customize the drinks to our liking, and the friendly service and nice environment made the visit even better. I'd definitely recommend giving this place a try if you're in the area!
review_3_text:
Edit: they renovated this place and now it's a comfy place to shelter from the heat or even work at.

I always get their signature Mingmitr iced coffee drink as it's quite decent.

In my last visit I felt like the staff could be friendlier though.

Small place, friendly service, great drinks.
review_4_text:
Super low prices (a latte and a croissant was ฿105), GREAT coffee, AC, good WiFi, plenty of seating, friendly service.  Hidden gem of a spot.
Highly recommend.
review_5_text: It seems to be a cafe that local people will grab a cup of coffee to start their day. I got a cup of iced Ming Mitr (65 thb) — less sweet. It’s well balanced and mellow. Nice coffee and affordable price. 5 thb discount for personal cup. 😉

name: Ombra Caffe Nimman
review_1_text: Amazing place. First impression of the decor and layout was superb. With both outdoor and indoor sitting available. Went in the morning at around 10am. There was no wait and only had 2 other couples. Food was equally good as well. Loved thier scrambled eggs, it was perfect. Had Scrambled eggs with ham, (with Salmon for wife).
review_2_text:
The breakfast portions were huge! We had Ombra’s Breakfast and the Eggs Benedict with avocado cream, plus an add-on of hash browns. The hash browns were really good and nicely crispy. The avocado cream, however, was a bit too much for our liking, and it would have been nicer if it were served warm.

Overall, it’s a nice spot for a quiet breakfast. The space is also very large, making it suitable for bigger groups as well.
review_3_text:
2026.1.10 Sat

We just arrived in Nimman area today to check into our Airbnb and was directed to this cafe by the owner, as we were unable to do an early check-in before 3pm.

Hard pressed for time, we decided to catch our lunch here. The latte is excellent. Just a bit surprised to be served in paper cups for dine-in service. All the food we ate is excellent.

Love the ambience and love the quality of the food here !
review_4_text: A lovely spot for breakfast or brunch in the beautiful Nimman neighborhood. The place has a charming terrace that creates a calm and relaxing atmosphere, perfect for starting the day slowly. Ideal for enjoying a good coffee, unwinding, and soaking in the laid-back vibe of the area ✨🌿🫶🌺🌿☕🌱
review_5_text: The place has gorgeous atmosphere. The menu offer plenty of choice but it’s not over complicated. And in comparison to many other places, they accept credit cards! What a nuance but it’s very important for tourists. My choice was Benedict eggs and hazelnut latte with waffles.

name: Creativitea
review_1_text:
[editing my comment below since Amy is referring to another person, certainly not me, since I am not entrepreneur, and I have been to only one meet up of her friend, which showed me her Xenophobic comment on WhatsApp, and I was hanging out with other random travellers not her "friends", I am surprised with the amount of lies she mentioned to defend herself, not surprised though, shame on your lies Amy, get better]

I came here to echo what other guests have already said about Amy and her "coworking".  When many unrelated people report similar bad experiences, it is worth paying attention. Please read the other reviews together with mine below.  As you can see in other comments, she systematically dismisses concerns by inventing a justification for each one and she will do it again, let's see.

I have travelled a lot, and this was by far the worst experience I have had , not because of the place itself, but because of the owner, Amy.

I ended up leaving halfway through my stay due to the way Amy repeatedly spoke to me in an aggressive, condescending, and hostile manner. From very early on, the atmosphere felt tense and uncomfortable. Every day felt like walking on eggshells. The energy in the house was chaotic and openly aggressive, making it impossible to feel at ease.

From the start, basic things that were advertised or reasonably expected were missing. I informed her in advance of my arrival time, yet when I arrived the ground was flooded due to defrosting, and I had to clean everything myself. There was no air purifier initially; she provided one only after I asked, and then I had to ask again once I realized the filters were dirty and unusable. Only after a second request did she replace it with a proper one. Throughout the stay, I constantly had to ask for basic necessities.

There were no cooking basics at all, no pots, pans, oil, salt, or pepper. When I asked about this, her response was extremely aggressive, and she explicitly told me, “You will not enter my kitchen.” As a result, any utensils she provided had to be washed in the bathroom. Her justification was that “cooking basics were not listed,” even though there was literally nothing available to cook with. I was also given a stained towel and had to ask for a replacement.

After these repeated adjustments, instead of addressing things professionally, Amy created a completely hostile environment. She would ignore me when I entered the building, refuse to greet or acknowledge me, and consistently made my presence feel unwelcome. No one should feel uncomfortable or emotionally unsafe in a place they are paying to stay.

At one point, I contacted Airbnb to explore changing accommodations. However, the prospect of having to face another aggressive interaction made me avoid further direct communication. I ultimately chose to leave early, and despite this, the host later sent a request demanding additional payment for my early departure.

I also want to highlight something deeply concerning. Amy made remarks to others implying that people of my nationality are entitled and exaggerate requests. This kind of generalization is inappropriate and discriminatory, and has no place in hospitality. Asking for what is advertised is not entitlement.

She frequently says, “If you need something, ask,” yet reacts aggressively when guests do ask, and then accuses them of being demanding. Most issues here could have been manageable if her attitude and behavior were not so unprofessional and hostile.

Amy should not be running an Airbnb. Again, If you look at other recent reviews of Creativitea, you will find similar patterns, which I am unfortunately here to corroborate.

I do not recommend any of the rooms in this place under any circumstances. There are far better, safer, and more respectful options in Chiang Mai. Stay away from this place.
review_2_text: My tour with Creativitea was canceled by the organiser less than 12 hours before the start, leaving me no realistic opportunity to arrange an alternative. The booking process involved copying a WhatsApp post about the tour, adding your name to the list, and transferring payment to the owner’s private account, without a formal booking confirmation or clearly communicated payment and cancellation terms. The communication from the owner, Amy, was aggressive and accusatory rather than professional. The organizer repeatedly shifted the blame onto customers instead of taking responsibility. Based on this experience, I cannot recommend this company.
review_3_text:
I recently booked to stay here for one month.  I left half way through my stay due to the way Amy regularly spoke to me in an aggressive and condescending way that was completely unprovoked, I couldn't even walk from my room to the door without her finding a reason to bereate me,  it was awful. I didn't even ask for a refund as I didn't want to deal with another of her outbursts.

It was very upsetting to see the way Amy treated her sweet staff, the staff members mentioned in the earlier reviews have all left.  When I stayed 4 new staff had just been hired, when I left 2 weeks later 2 had already quit, and I hadn't seen one other around so hopefully he got out too.

I wouldn't recommend staying here, every day is like walking on eggshells
review_4_text:
