I had an amazing time at creativitea, the room was super spacious, cozy, quit, clean and the bed is very comfortable. Felt very welcomed by the staff and owner. They have free laundry service, which is amazing! Very worth the already good price :)

The area is the best in town in my opinion, super quiet but very close to everything and only 10min away from the airport.
review_5_text: Poor coffee, poor communication from staff. The place looks decent but one of the staff shouldn't have been working and taken a day off to rest when I visited as she behaved strangely.

name: Biguri Sirimang
review_1_text:
Had breakfast here.
First, we were greeted very nicely.
The food and drinks menu is comprehensive and has lots of choice.
We had waffles with egg bacon, and an avocado bread paired with hot and cold lattes.

All in all the taste was great, the space to sit is a bit small. Outside seating doesn’t look too comfortable. However, considering the whole package including price I definitely recommend this place.
review_2_text: I know that this restaurant is known for it's donuts, but we came to fullfil my wife's craving for a tuna sandwich on sourdough and I have to say that this restaurant far exceeded our expectations.  The sandwiches were absolutely amazing. The restaurant was clean and the staff were very nice.  If you are interested in a tuna sandwich this is the place to come.
review_3_text: Perfect breakfast, delicious food and a huge choice (sweet and savory!). They have good European options too. The coffee and matcha are excellent, and the service is super friendly. Good prices compared to other places nearby.
review_4_text:
A Japanese-style donut outpost in Nimman. Bikkuri's offering includes ice cream, pastries, cookies, little cakes, and various coffee, tea and bubble tea options.

Fast and friendly service, upbeat and clean interior. The owner moved her donut shop here this Tuesday, following success at her previous location for several years. The expansive new location offers ice cream, cookies, espresso, and seating that wasn't available at the previous spot.

I ordered a dark chocolate donut and espresso. The owner cautioned me that their espresso machine was new, and to feel free to comment on the quality. Overall, a pleasantly sweet  and savory espresso, with no heavily discernible notes. I included a photo of their default espresso blend.

Baking isn't done at this location, but at the main bakery, "Mai Bakery". Donuts come out from around 0700 to 1500.
review_5_text: Delicious doughnuts.  We tried the lemon curd and the Burnt Sugar doughnut.  Both were delicious.  The doughnuts are fluffy and not too sweet.  The cream filling in the Burnt Sugar doughnut was sweet and creamy to balance with the bitter-sweet burnt sugar.

name: Sol Haus
review_1_text: The best coffee ever! Absolutely love this place.  If you haven't been try it!! Lovely staff and delicious coffee and snacks, the iced latte and chocolate cookie is amazing 🤩
review_2_text:
A lovely hidden coffee shop with high quality coffee and cookies.
Great atmosphere and very friendly service.🙏🏼💙
review_3_text: Arguably the best coffee I had in Chiang Mai. The interior is clean and cool, and the coffee has some personality to it. Staff werr friendly and accommodating to tourists
review_4_text: Sol haus “house of the sun” new coffee shop in Chiangmai. Pet friendly, Great coffee and good vibes. Strongly recommended ‘Dirty Coffee’ and  caramel popcorn for non-coffee menu. 👍🏻
review_5_text: Latte is so nice! Decaf is served here if you’re looking for. The decaf tastes & smell good. Decaf is rare in Chiang Mai

name: Fern Forest Cafe
review_1_text:
A Hidden Green Oasis in the Heart of Chiang Mai 🌿

Fern Forest Cafe is a true gem tucked away in the city. The moment you walk in, you’re surrounded by lush greenery and tall trees fresh, shaded, and incredibly peaceful. It feels like escaping into a secret garden right in the middle of Chiang Mai.

The atmosphere is perfect for relaxing and staying awhile. Many international visitors love spending time here, and it’s easy to understand why, it’s calm, charming, and beautifully natural.

I ordered the tiramisu and coconut cake, and both were excellent. The tiramisu was rich and well-balanced, the coconut cake light and fragrant without being too sweet.

The yuzu cold brew coffee was also fantastic refreshing, smooth, and a perfect pairing with the desserts.

If you’re looking for a serene garden café with great cakes and quality drinks, this is definitely a must visit in Chiang Mai.
Highly recommended.
review_2_text:
Delicious food, great ambience and very professional and polite staff.

The food came in a timely manner, seemingly fresh and perfectly cooked. We had the club sandwhich and pasta salmon with pesto. They got our orders right and it was prepared perfectly. The salmon was juicy and flavorful and cooked to perfection. I'm from Norway so I know salmon, and I was very happy with it.

The club sandwhich was also really good and presented beautifully. There could have been more fries, but it was good as is too.

We also ordered the mango/passion fruit smoothie and the berry smoothie. Tasted as expected, very good 🤗

The ambience is very calm, chill with smooth jazz playing at the perfect level. Of course they fern theme in itself makes it feel like you're close to nature and it's the perfect place to eat.

Staff was very polite and served all our needs.

All in all a good place to eat for a chill meal. Their desserts seemed amazing but we didn't order any.
review_3_text: This charming little restaurant and café is a true hidden gem, beautifully surrounded by lush greenery that creates a calm and relaxing atmosphere from the moment you arrive. One of the highlights is the peaceful pond filled with colorful koi carp, which adds a special, almost meditative touch to the place. The thoughtfully designed indoor seating is cozy and inviting, making it a perfect spot to slow down, enjoy good food or coffee, and simply soak in the tranquil surroundings. Also calculate some waiting time for a free table if you come in the afternoon.
review_4_text:
Amazing spot for a break from your activities and travels. They have coffee, pastries and desserts, as well as a full food menu with breakfast items as well as traditional thai food.

Ambience is amazing with a koi pond and you get to sit underneath the tall trees in the shade.
review_5_text:
A sweet little place making you feel right in the lap of nature with great food, ambient music and sound of water.

Food quantity and quality are both good with one of the best Caramel Milkshakes!
The tropical and fruit bowls are a little too cold (need atleast 30 min outside for the temperature to come down to being eatable). Hence one piece of advise will be to kindly keep them in a little less colder place before serving so that they can be eaten straightaway.

Loved the rest.

name: Versailles de Flore
review_1_text:
I visited Versailles de Flore one morning with a friend for breakfast and to take photos. My main expectation was based on the Renaissance-style decoration inspired by the Palace of Versailles in France, so I initially imagined a more refined, luxury like experience.

In reality, it is not a luxury place, but rather a lovely and peaceful café with beautiful decor. The setting is very well done and makes you feel like you are walking through a small European museum. It’s a calm place and perfect for taking photos.

The breakfast was good. I ordered fried eggs served in a pan, accompanied by fish sausage, minced pork, toasted bread with butter and a touch of garlic, plus a small salad with lettuce and cherry tomatoes. I also had a cappuccino, which was nicely prepared.

There is no table service; you need to order and pay at the counter first, and then the staff brings your food. When we visited around 10 a.m., there was only one waiter and the cook, so the service felt simple and casual.

Prices are not high or exaggerated at all, they are very reasonable and comparable to other cafés in Chiang Mai, even those with much simpler designs. Coffee starts around 65–70 THB, which I found fair considering the atmosphere.
Overall, my experience was good, even though it was different from what I originally expected. I would recommend this place if you are looking for a beautiful, quiet, and photogenic café, as long as you don’t expect a luxury dining experience
review_2_text: I went there for coffee, the place is well designed but you will feel very unwelcomed, indoor ventilation is very poor, I request them to on some air-conditioning but after about one hour they off it. Service is also poor as staffs are few and they are busy observing outsiders to make sure that nobody take photos without any purchases. They need to change their marketing strategy considering that business isn't good despite such a special place.
review_3_text: It’s a Must visit if you are visiting Chiang Mai. Amazing food with amazing photo location. Place is not too far from the Old city. I visited there for breakfast. The french toast is 10000/10 amazing Highly Recommended 🤩
review_4_text: Drinks are quite average and you need to buy one drink per person to take photos there. I would say the scenery is not as nice as Instagram (obviously not the place’s fault). Peach tea and coffee were both just ok. Worth it if you want to spend some time there and take a lot of photos, but I wouldn’t recommend this place.
review_5_text:
I ordered the pasta with chilli and bacon which was good if you’re into spicy food.
I did not like my chai latte on the other hand :( but the staff was very nice and the vibe was so nice that I forgive the drink 😅

name: Starbucks
review_1_text: I didn’t actually eat here.  However, I recommend this as the best place to work for a while on the computer.  Lots of comfortable seating, WiFi and electrical outlets.
review_2_text:
1. We waited and waited for our order. Finally I had to go to the counter to ask what happened... the sandwich was already cold... they had to warm it up again. It wasn't that busy, either.

2. I asked to have our table cleaned... the server cleaned the table and wiped the crumbs from another customer's order onto the floor!!! No sweeping up.

The service really needs to be improved.

Nice People, Bad Training.
review_3_text: Super comfy. Waiting in here for almost 5 hours (I got night flight) and everything in here is perfect. The ambience is very good. You can walk around the building which has pond and mini garden if you are boring. And you can also walk to 7 eleven, just 2 minutes walking to grab a snack
review_4_text:
This double story building is situated opposite the Suan Dok gate on the western side of the most in Chang Mai old town.

It has a convenient drive-in facility but inside you will experience a nice ambience even though the air conditioning is super cold. You can also sit outside.

Generally, the decoration is comfortable browns and wood and laid-back style. Check out the photos
review_5_text: Nice location with both indoor and outdoor area. Also have the drive trough service. There is a meeting room available on the second floor also. :)

name: Bird's Nest Cafe
review_1_text:
A nice place for healthy and tasty food. Everything feels fresh and well made.
The atmosphere is cozy, and the staff are very friendly. Prices are also reasonable, so it’s a good option if you want to eat well without spending too much.
I’d come back again🌺☕
review_2_text: I gotta say I've been to a lot of cafes in CNX and this place is by far my favorite one. The food tastes divine full stop. We got hash browns and scrambled eggs for our picky eater kids and they devoured it. It was so lovely of the cafe to serve clementines on the side for our kids. Then we ate a superb tom kha and a perfect grilled veggie wrap and topped it all with what they call a "local porridge" and Bird's Nest coffee (ie. masala coffee / coffee with spices). You can not beat this. Every single thing was cooked to perfection. We will frequent this place that's for sure. I'm glad my small kids made only tolerable amount of noise otherwise we'd feel embarrassed to go back but now we can't wait to eat there again and try new things! Kapunka!
review_3_text: The best breakfast/brunch place! They have a really big menu, lots to choose from. The quality is amazing, the fruit is so fresh and the portion sizes are huge! The banana pancakes and the set menu were great, the local porridge was super interesting and delicious. Would definitely recommend 🫶
review_4_text: What a lovely place & friendly staff. Had brunch there with my wife. Food made with love. Top notch Coconut Latte. Proper slow drip coffee. Wonderful rustic, cute, chilled & peaceful atmosphere. Well done team!!! xx
review_5_text: This is an absolute gem of a restaurant in Chiang Mai. It has such lovely cozy vibes with several seating options. It’s all open air (no A/C), but there are several strong fans and it never gets too hot. Also no mosquitoes. The food is absolutely superb. My go to order was usually the set breakfast with porridge. Well balanced, good portion size, healthy, and delicious. The iced cappuccinos are soooooo good too. They have tons of foam and are some of the best ones I’ve ever had. Choose the coconut milk option for a rich treat. FYI it’s cash only.

name: The Peaberry Cafe & Coworking
review_1_text:
The Peaberry Café offers super delicious and fresh smoothies and açaí bowls, along with good coffee. The staff are friendly and the service is quite fast, which makes the experience even better.
Just a note — it’s not a dedicated coworking space with desks and ergonomic chairs, but more of a work-friendly café. It’s a comfortable place to bring your laptop and get some work done while enjoying brunch, a smoothie, or a coffee.
Overall, a great spot for tasty, healthy food and a relaxed work-friendly environment!
review_2_text: We had the Nutella french toast and sunny side up eggs. For drinks the peach soda, chocobananut smoothie, Carmel macchiato and Thia style Expresso.  All were very delicious. 💯% recommend.  They even have an adorable and playful kat Luna.
review_3_text: Very nice coffee shop serving breakfast. I had the typical western breakfast. Scrambled eggs, toast and sausage. No complaints. We worked a little in the co working space and later split a Nutella French toast. So delicious. Excellent service.
review_4_text: I came here twice during my visit to Chiang Mai and the food was fantastic. I got the french toast, tuna salad, and beverages. It was also a clean, minimal, and quiet place to work on my computer.
review_5_text: Great atmosphere, delicious drinks/smoothies, they offer oat milk/dairy-free options which I appreciated. Staff was incredibly friendly and even let me and another person stay a little bit after closing to finish working on our laptops. Will be coming back here, had an awesome experience :)

name: LANN Cafe'
review_1_text:
You have to come eat here! So delicious and super cute vibes!

Their breakfast was top tier! The bread they brought to the table was so fresh and very delicious! I try to stay away from bread but I literally almost finished the entire basket! That’s how good it was!

very instagramable and cute for photos. The staff was friendly!
review_2_text: Great breakfast place in Chiang Mai center! I was desperately searching for a breakfast spot where I can have a nice meal before touring the center of Chiang Mai. They have a very nice menu and if the decor is very relaxed and beautiful. The service was wonderful! I had a breakfast platter with bacon,ham, eggs, sausage, and tomato. Fully recommended!
review_3_text: Had a wonderful experience at LANN Cafe’ in Chiang Mai. I tried their signature chili fried rice, which was full of flavor with just the right level of spice — absolutely delicious. The mango passionfruit frappe was refreshing, perfectly balanced, and a great match for the meal. The service was friendly and attentive, and the location is lovely, calm, and convenient (at the heart of the center area) for relaxing or enjoying a meal. Highly recommended if you’re looking for great taste, good service, and a nice atmosphere.
review_4_text: LANN CAFE is a charming spot on the edge of the Old City. The atmosphere is relaxing, especially in the garden area. The space is small and cozy, thoughtfully designed with a stylish touch. Prices are on the higher side for Chiang Mai, but still inexpensive compared to most European cities. Service was fast and the staff were friendly and attentive. The place is clean, and the brunch was delicious. Overall, I definitely recommend it!
review_5_text:
Walking by, we  saw pictures of smoothies.
Best ones we have had in Thailand, and very nice seating and setting
Recommended

name: Kum Jan Cafe and Thai Dessert
review_1_text: Nice little coffee, good place for relaxing after some hours Chiang Mai. Good music in background, friendly stuff and important -> the air-conditioning is perfect - not to cold like Starbucks. So we spent arround 2h and it was very comfortable. The coffee shop is open for anybody, not only for the hotel guests opposite.
review_2_text:
Lovely chilled cafe, tasty drinks, delicious sandwiches. The owner and staff were super friendly we got a complementary brownie and snacks while hanging out in the front patio. Highly recommend ☺️

While checking into the hotel you get a free drink ticket!
review_3_text: Love this place! The food is incredible tasty! It was the very first time someone taught me how to eat Thai food! The people are so lovely, I felt great here! I highly recommend you to come if you are in Chiang Mai!
review_4_text: Cute little place. Food was ok. The employees are nice, but they might have been a bit understaffed. Took a very long time to get the drinks we ordered. Food came out quick through. And more importantly they have AC
review_5_text: Very local to our hotel. Very friendly staff and the service was good. The menu is very varied and so able to eat all sorts.

name: Something on Mars
review_1_text: The  cocktails 🍸 🍸 here are really nice. I am not a big gin fan but the blend of gin with the other elements was great. The place is very Insta worthy as are the drinks. However they charge a 10% surcharge on all drinks which aren’t cheap to begin with. The place was pretty empty so  it didn’t have the best atmosphere. I think if they reduce some of their prices on their non signature drinks they would have more people coming in because it is a nice place to hang out . The staff were great and very friendly.
review_2_text:
Hidden cocktails bar that serves best cocktails. Tried all signature drinks and you will love them all. Nice service and atmosphere. Will definitely come back.

Highly recommended Autumn No. 9 , Pluto, Venus… all signature must try.
review_3_text: Super cool bar! And great drinks made by our bartender Art. Highly recommend if you’re looking for a unique and intimate cocktail bar
review_4_text: Having a blast now here. Must visit when in Chiang Mai Thailand… coffee is perfect and food is superb. Drinks are the best and we’re having a blast with the friendliest bartender “Nes” …
review_5_text: The most amazing cocktail, try the “Venus” it will not disappoint. The bartenders were very knowledgeable and friendly. Such a cool vibe!

name: Robert Bake & Brunch
review_1_text: One of the nicest places I've had lunch in Chiang Mai. Beautiful building with a large courtyard. The staff were very friendly and welcoming of our 2 year old son. He enjoyed stroking the puppies 🐶 🐶. Food was really yummy at a reasonable price.
review_2_text:
Really good food in elegant surroundings. Went healthy with the homemade muesli, homemade greek yogurt and fruit.

Also had a hot latte, both were superb. The total bill came to 278 baht which included a 10% service charge.

Service is friendly, prompt and efficient. Will return here and try other options on what looks like an extensive menu.
review_3_text: my second time come to here. They have two cute dogs. The prices are really low compared to Bangkok. Like the mushroom pasta . The staffs can still remember me after half year.makes me so surprised.Also like the cheese bread is extremely crispy and tasty.A wonderful afternoon in Chiang mai.
review_4_text: Love the food and the vibe of the place! Really cute aesthetic for the entire place. Good portion sizes. I would highly recommend their brownie. Portion size was also big lol. Can’t finish the whole pad thai that I’ve ordered. Overall a great experience
review_5_text: This is a great place to relax with your dog. We can sit and eat with our beloved dogs. There's a wide variety of delicious dishes to choose from, and the prices are reasonable. The food is delicious, and the wait isn't too long. The staff are impressive, help taking photos for us, and even holding an umbrella when it's raining. I'll definitely be back. Love this place 🐶❤️🌲🌿

name: Fahtara Coffee (ฟ้าธาราคอฟฟี่)
review_1_text:
An Enchanting Jungle Oasis with the Best Coffee in Chiang Mai!

If you’re searching for a truly magical coffee spot in Chiang Mai, look no further than Fahtara Coffee – this place is pure bliss! Tucked away in a serene garden that’s hidden from the main road, the chill area in the back feels like stepping into a lush jungle paradise. The highlight has to be the antique functioning water wheel gently turning beside a beautiful koi pond – it’s so peaceful watching the water flow and the colorful fish glide by. The whole ambiance is top-notch: tropical plants everywhere, shady spots to relax, and that perfect blend of nature and tranquility that makes you forget you’re in the city.

The coffee? Hands down some of the best in Chiang Mai – rich, perfectly brewed, and full of flavor whether you go for a classic latte or something more adventurous. And don’t get me started on the food and desserts – absolutely 5-star! From fluffy pastries to savory bites, everything is fresh, delicious, and beautifully presented.
It’s no wonder this place can get crowded – it’s popular for all the right reasons! The vibes are so inviting that I take all my friends here whenever they’re in town; it’s become my absolute favorite spot to unwind, catch up, or just soak in the beauty. If you want an unforgettable cafe experience that’s equal parts relaxing and Instagram-worthy, Fahtara is a must-visit. Can’t wait to go back! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
review_2_text: This place is gorgeous, relaxing with the best outdoor vibe. There’s a tree right in the middle, thoughtful decor everywhere, and a soft mist that makes it feel extra calm. We stopped in after a massage for smoothies, coffee, and a pizza, and everything hit the spot. The service was warm and  attentive.
review_3_text: What a lovely cafe. Its almost magical out back with the water mill, fog and koi fish. Music is perfect. Atmosphere 20/10 cappuccino 30/10. It was hot, great flavor, good size.   I didn't have the food but I saw some go out and it looked good. Also so the smoking coconut coffee drink they do. Looked stunning. I just don't drink cold drinks. 200/10 recommend this place. Also has strong wifi.
review_4_text: Stumbled upon this gem and so happy I found it. Atmosphere, aesthetics, vibe were all top tier. Strawberry matcha was also sooo good. If I ever come back to Chiang Mai I’ll definitely come again!
review_5_text: We both had eggs Benedict and they were superb. The atmosphere is relaxing and peaceful. It was one of the few places open and we are so thankful we stumbled upon it. We’ve been back twice already.

name: One life Hostel
review_1_text:
Amazing stay at One Life Hostel Chiang Mai!
I was warmly welcomed by Jenny, Fabien, and their lovely dog. they were incredibly kind and gave me great recommendations.
The hostel is very clean, calm, and comfortable. The breakfast and coffee are excellent, and the location is perfect.
If I ever come back to Chiang Mai, I will definitely stay here again. Highly recommended!
review_2_text: Had a lovely 4 night stay at One Life, it was the perfect hostel for my travel style! It was social in the sense that everyone I met was very friendly, but it is not a party vibe so I could sleep peacefully at night. Always kept very clean, and the owners are helpful to arrange tours if you'd like. Kawa, the dog, comes with the owners to work most days to hang out in the lobby and is a perfect angel! She's friendly, but if you're wary of dogs she minds her own business. They also offer a same-day laundry service that is incredibly convenient and affordable. One life is on the same street as many other hostels, so you can find lots of other travelers if you'd like. Also right along the center square of town, and down the street from a 7-11.
review_3_text: Couldn’t have had a nicer experience. Fabien and Jenny run such a lovely hostel. Free water and a breakfast area and fridge to store items. Huge lockers and comfy beds. The location is great close to everything and they do their best by everyone that comes through the door. Would for sure stay again.
review_4_text:
Probably the best hostel I've stayed in Thailand and my favourite one here too. Super clean and affordable, and they also have a drying area at the toilet for your clothes so that it doesn't stink the main sleeping area. The bed is really comfy, and even though the room can get cold, the duvet was so nice and thick enough that you definitely won't freeze at night.

The owners Jenny and Fabien are also super friendly and are willing to help you as long as you ask. Not to mention the hostel star Kawai (think that's how it's spelt) the Shiba who's really adorable and friendly too.

Really convenient location as well, with a night market just down the road and next to the old city. Not a party hostel, but still really social if you want to. Ended up having breakfast here at the cafe (which is also the reception area) every morning instead of going out even though it might be cheaper just because I could just sit there and people would appear for you to talk to.

Ended up extending my stay in Chiang Mai by 2 nights because I had a really good time here. I know many people who ended up also staying longer because they loved the hostel. Only downside is that it is almost always booked out for each day, so any extension, you would need to check with them early. Last minute extensions are almost impossible (although I was lucky because someone cancelled on the day I was supposed to check out). Jenny and Fabien also took us to the drag show on my first day, and they booked a whole songthaew for the hostel to fetch us over.

TLDR highly recommended hostel, good location, friendly staff, social but not party hostel, great vibes.
review_5_text:
I stayed at One Life Hostel and honestly, it was one of the best parts of my Chiang Mai trip. The hosts were incredibly friendly and welcoming, and they even have a super cute Shiba Inu (sorry, I forgot the name but she made my mornings!).

The rooms are unique and thoughtfully designed. They offer both private rooms and dorms, which is perfect depending on how you’re traveling. The common area is cozy and great for meeting other travelers, and they even provide free snacks and beverages which is a lovely touch.

Located in a great area with lots of restaurants and cafes nearby, it’s super convenient. I’ll definitely be staying here again when I’m back in town!

name: Snooze ChiangMai
review_1_text:
Very delicious smoothie bowls and also  breads with different toppings.
We were sad that we just discovered it shortly before leaving (it is hidden a little bit) otherwise we would have came more often. The location was so nice and relaxing sitting under the trees and the food very good. Perfect for breakfast or brunch :)
If we ever visit Chiang Mai again we will definitely come back!
review_2_text: Such a nice atmosphere. The dining área is outdoors and very beautiful and serene. I really enjoyed the hammock. The food was delicious i tried a small yoghurt granola and the tomato feta toast and it was so good i went back the next day to try the scrambled egg spinach toast (also delicious). You order and the counter and they bring the food over to you. Very relaxed environment and no smoking which is nice.
review_3_text: Lovely place, hidden in a courtyard among trees. Definitely recommend smoothie bowls - great quality! 🥭
review_4_text:
I loved the smoothies but disliked the avocado toast! It was lacking flavor and was bland, making it not really worth the price. I wish I had ordered one of the breakfast bowls instead as my friends were very happy with theirs.

You have to order at the counter and they bring the food to the table. The atmosphere is relaxed, the courtyard has a good vibe but the tables and service are basic. The reviews had me expecting more, but the food could use improvement. It looks amazing but lacks taste and it's overpriced.
review_5_text: The smoothie bowl was very mediocre. The acai was low quality and there's not too much of a difference in sizes. Not worth getting a bowl here but maybe something else.

name: BYB Club CNX
review_1_text: Great after hours club located near the big bar streets in Nimman. Their drink selection is adequate, with many different alcohol choices. They also sell weed as well if you are into that. They’re open from 10 pm until late, normally still open long after the other bars close.
review_2_text:
Yes for cool vibes, great techno and house music.

An eclectic group of people who head there. Weed, alcohol and nitric-oxide balloons. Enough to get quite inebriated pretty damn quickly.

Service staff were awesome and very welcoming. One of the owners (Val?) was chill and inviting, the other dude was arrogant and downright rude - [who the hell has a business meeting at 1am in a nightclub and doesn't want to be disturbed ¿] ... FFS 🙄😝

Anyway, definitely a very cool place to go dance and chill late into the night. Reminded me of my old days partying in crowded Hong Kong clubs like Drop and Homebase. 💥🎶

Parteeee CENTRAL!

🔊🎶🎶💥🤩😎
review_3_text:
This club is very nice, its tiny, it has super art inside, UV decor & string art is next level! The music also, from good techno into hard and melodic Psy trance!
Just the crowd is missing,i hope many people will come here!!♾🙏🕉💜
review_4_text: These are the droids you are looking for. Came for the music, stayed for the human connection. Will come back if I'm ever in CNX again.
review_5_text:
Great place to go very profesional DJs.
Love there cocktails great price and not skimpy.
The staff are chatty and friendly.
Be nice to see some professional  dancers sometimes in the cage. lol
I love to go there and unwind into the lights and beats.
Its just a great club to go if you like the nightlife.

name: Into the Woods
review_1_text: The second time I have come back here and we are only here for a few days! The food is so good ♡ and the atmosphere is relaxing and calm. They don't rush you and have a few great all day breakfast options. I love the mural on the wall and the decorations 😍
review_2_text: Lovely place for coffee, a chat, or an hour or so of focus. Mellow tunes, woody tones, great coffee, comfy chairs, and pleasant service. Solid! Pretty popular with a touristy crowd on a weekday midmorning.
review_3_text: Welcome to the lost woods in the old town Chiangmai. Loved their hospitality and interior. Good coffee and dishes.
review_4_text:
What a gem! The first day I came here I ordered the latte with chili honey - the coffee here is amazing! I also ordered the pork stew - no exaggeration to say it was one of the best stews of my life! So simple, yet so delicious.

I enjoyed it so much I came back the next day and ordered the glass noodle soup. They also have a dessert that looks just like a kitchen sponge! It’s so realistic I thought they were making a joke of selling sponges in the dessert window lol! I had to buy it and it was fun and tasty.
review_5_text: Super cozy cafe with amazing atmosphere 😍 Ladies working there were kind and friendly. Recommend trying the carrot cake ☺️

name: ASMR Cafe & Wellness
review_1_text:
ลำ! = delicious 😋

Must do cafe while in Chiang Mai!

Such a pleasant cafe to get the juices flowing... We ordered a Khao Soi which was the best we've ever had... also had a latte which tasted fantastic 😋

The atmosphere was great and the service was 10 out of 10. Prices are also great for what you get.

Highly recommended 👌

If you found this review helpful, please give me a thumbs up 👍 (it's free!) and follow me for more honest reviews 🙏 ❤️ 🙌
review_2_text: “Such a lovely find in this diverse food heaven. Authentic flavours made with heart. We tried the morning glory soup — what a wonderful surprise! The duck egg added beautiful texture. The décor is elegant, modern and stylish. It’s a pity we came so late. We’ll definitely be back for the drinks.
review_3_text:
Wow, such an amazing and aesthetically pleasing cafe! I enjoyed working on my laptop here with an iced coffee and their fast wifi. I love that they give you a glass of complimentary ice water on arrival!! 😍😍😍🧊

Seriously one of my fave quiet working cafes in CNX!
review_4_text:
One of the best coffees I’ve had in Thailand! The iced Americano had complex aromas and was just delicious. The hot chocolate was super comforting. All in such a peaceful and relaxing space. Chanced upon this spa cafe and really enjoyed it. Service is superb and highly attentive. We didn’t try the food as we had just eaten (legendary Khai Soi Khun Yai is just a few doors away!)

If I come back, I’ll definitely try some of the spa treatments!
review_5_text:
🤍Peaceful Escape in the Heart of the City

This café is a minimalist’s dream! The design is simple yet thoughtful, creating an incredibly comfortable and serene space. After strolling through the bustling streets outside, stepping in here feels like a much-needed escape to recharge and calm the mind.

The food is refined and beautifully crafted, but what really stood out was their hot chocolate😍😍😍 Absolutely divine! It’s rich yet not overly sweet, striking the perfect balance. Highly recommend it!🌟🌟🌟

-

We had a mantra singing session here that day, and it was such a perfect experience. The atmosphere, combined with the positive energy of the session, made it truly unforgettable.

I stayed behind afterward, working quietly until nearly closing time. During those hours, the owner and staff were so kind and attentive, making me feel incredibly welcome and cared for. Their warmth really touched me and added to the magic of the day.❤️❤️❤️

If you’re in the area, this place is a must-visit! 🥰

name: mountain view cafe Chiangmai
review_1_text: Great place to sit, work and enjoy a meal! The space is small but has great wifi so I was able to work on my laptop for a few hours. Eggs and toast were 89 baht, good but as is common in asia they were too sweet (I think its the butter??) the 100 baht small fruit plate was great! I’m sure they rotate but today came with pineapple, watermelon and mango 😍
review_2_text: We loved this place for our morning breakfast. Decent price, food was tasty and we enjoyed quite a lot the banana pancake. The patio is quite and lovely for a relaxing breakfast.
review_3_text:
What a cute and cozy cafe! Very nice staff, good sandwiches, decent cappuccino.
They also have a few handmade jewelry for same and some souvenirs made from an ngo helping women who went thru abuse. I actually bought a necklace as it was very nice and well made.
Give this place a visit. 😁

🙋🏻‍♀️ My travel tips & recommendations on insta: deea_journey
review_4_text:
This is a great cafe on Chang Pheuk gate of the walled old city of Chiang Mai. It has a lovely outdoor seating overlooking the busy road and moat and Chang Pheuk gate as well as a great garden outdoor seating behind the guest house (yes they also run a lovely guest house). Indoor air conditioned seating is there too.

Food is good, from breakfast to main course meals - both Thai and western. Coffee is good too.

Best asset is the staff of Mountain View. Very helpful and warm and hospitable,

Lovely maintained plants and water fountains
review_5_text: A cool small cafe on the opposite to chiang phuak market on the main Street. The food is great, usually there is no waiting. It's work friendly cafe, you can also meet other tourists. WiFi and water is free. Closes on 6 pm and sometimes 5 pm.

name: The Haus 224
review_1_text:
Really nice place with a great vibe. From the outside it already looks inviting, and once inside it feels cozy, clean, and well put together. The atmosphere is relaxed but still feels special, perfect for an easy dinner or drinks.
I tried the Summer Day cocktail and it was refreshing, smooth, and easy to drink. Very balanced and light, ideal for starting the meal.
For food, I had a classic Yum seafood soup, and it was excellent. Flavorful, comforting, and well balanced, with fresh shrimp and seafood cooked just right. The broth had depth and a nice kick without being too heavy, making it a great choice if you enjoy traditional Thai flavors.
Service was friendly and attentive, and everything came out at a good pace. Overall, a very solid experience with good food, good drinks, and a comfortable atmosphere. I’d definitely come back.
review_2_text:
Kaosoi was interesting the way of their own.
But looks like the owner was never greeting at all.
Even he was at front of the door he didn’t say hello (sawadikha) at all.
It was impressed in chiangmai people. 😢
If you don’t mind please say hello to the people in your area.
This is your local place with small business.
Don’t focus on the menu photo.
review_3_text:
I recently dined at Hausa 224 and had the pleasure of trying three dishes that truly impressed me.

1. **Pomelo Salad:** This refreshing dish was a delightful start to my meal. The pomelo was perfectly ripe, and the combination of flavors—crunchy vegetables and zesty dressing—made it a vibrant and invigorating experience.

2. **Fire Chicken Curry Noodles:** The star of the show! The noodles were cooked to perfection, and the chicken was tender with just the right amount of spice. The rich curry sauce was bursting with flavor and left me wanting more—I highly recommend it for spice lovers!

3. **Bread of Pork:** This dish was a comforting addition to my meal. The pork was juicy and flavorful, and the bread was soft and perfect for soaking up all the delicious juices.

Overall, my experience at Hausa 224 was fantastic, and I can't wait to return for more culinary delights!

---

Feel free to adjust any part to better match your experience!
review_4_text: Lovely building and who doesn’t love curves and high ceilings. The food was good enough and relatively tasty. It presents well.  It’s ok for Thai prices.
review_5_text: Wonderful cuisine! Impressed with all dishes especially Tom Yum Kung spaghetti and Khao Soi Mee Krob.  Good vibes for celebrating.

name: QUU HOTEL Chiang Mai
review_1_text:
⸻

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ Wonderful stay — stylish, comfortable, and full of charm!

I’ve stayed here twice and loved both visits. The first time was in a Junior Suite on the road side (room #302, if I remember correctly) — super nice, spacious, crisp, and clean. This time I stayed two nights in a Deluxe Room (#203) and loved it just as much.

All the rooms I’ve stayed in are beautifully designed and built with great attention to detail — simple but elegant, high-quality, clean, and very comfortable. It feels like staying at a small boutique hotel somewhere in Europe, with lovely greenery and stylish décor. I especially love the cool artworks from around the world displayed throughout the hotel.

The best part is enjoying breakfast early in the morning in the glass room overlooking the vibrant town — watching locals jogging by the old town moat of Chiang Mai. The hotel’s location is perfect too, just 5–10 minutes from all the nice spots and restaurants.
review_2_text:
Close to Old Town and a 7/11.
Rooms were clean and felt "new".
Good AC and a SMART TV!
No noise from nearby traffic at all.
Friendly staff, could communicate easily in English.
Very good price/quality ratio.
Would absolutely recommend or stay here again.
review_3_text: Love this hotel. Great for everyone—solo, couple, friends or family. Very clean, comfortable, good vibes, safe, delicious breakfast. We will be back and highly recommend!
review_4_text:
I booked a stay at Quu Hotel Chiang Mai from 22nd July to 24th July (2 nights), and unfortunately, our experience was extremely disappointing from the moment we arrived. There was no greeting or assistance from the staff, and we had to rely on our Grab driver to carry our heavy luggage in pouring rain. No one helped open the hotel door, and my wife even suffered a minor hand injury due to the heavy door.

Check-in itself went smoothly, and the room mostly matched the booking website photos, though some angles of the room and bathroom were missing. However, there was no standing shower, only a bathtub, which was inconvenient. The room was also very dusty, and we had to use our own wipes just to make it acceptable.

After discussing with my wife, we decided not to stay and requested a partial refund for one night. The staff directed us to Agoda, who told us that the hotel had to approve it. Despite our clear explanation, the hotel rejected our request and falsely claimed that they had offered us a room change, which never happened.

This hotel is unprofessional, unhelpful, and dishonest. I strongly advise against booking here, save yourself the frustration and disappointment.
review_5_text: Everything here was amazing! For a great price , you get a modern and fresh room, free room cleaning every day, a great location across the street from the old city, great service, and a filling and delicious breakfast.

name: Zmoy Cafe
review_1_text: Nik is the sweetest and Zmoy is a such a cute cafe. Definitely one of the cutest cafe’s I’ve ever visited. And the coffee does not disappoint. We tried the Zmoy Coffee and lemon cake and both were so good! Please add this place to your list.
review_2_text: Lovely and cozy modern cafe in the middle of old town and old temples. The drinks and snacks are unique and tasty but cheaper than similar options in the new town.
review_3_text: Great Latte, very friendly staff and nice to sit. Just the music inside was a bit too loud for my liking. All in all still a super great place to enjoy your coffee
review_4_text: I ordered their signature coffee. It was delicious, the atmosphere was great, and there was even a dog! The coffee was amazing too.
review_5_text:
Coffee was great so was the lemon cake. lovely little coffee shop.
Air conditioning inside. Staff were lovely.

name: Riflesso Artisan Gelato
review_1_text:
The best ice cream in Chiang Mai!
Super creamy, rich flavors, and made with very fresh ingredients. You can really taste the quality and attention to detail. Great variety of unique flavors, friendly staff, and a relaxed atmosphere. A must-visit for all ice cream lovers — I’ll definitely be back! 🍦😄
review_2_text: Giving this place 3 stars. The gelato tasted good, no complaints about the flavor, but it was nothing extraordinary to justify the price. I understand they use imported ingredients and I am not saying they should not charge premium prices, but 100 THB for such a small scoop feels a bit too much. It is decent ice cream, just not something that makes me want to come back again.
review_3_text:
Lovely little place with very tasty and refreshing gelato, perfect to cool down on yet another hot day!
The Chocomint was very mibty which I loved. Not so easy to find good icecream places in the city, so finding Riflesso was a wonderful surprise. I now know where to stop for an gelato icecream break when in the old city.
review_4_text: Tried their Pistachio Vegan and Dubai Chocolate — both were smooth, creamy, and a little sweet. The Pistachio had a rich, I personally prefer their Vegan version compared to the one with milk, nutty flavor that tasted authentic, not artificial. The Dubai Chocolate was deep and indulgent, with a hint of luxury cocoa and Kunafa. Perfect combo if you like balanced sweetness and real flavor!
review_5_text: We taste tested all of their vegan flavors and finally decided on the pistachio and chocolate ones. So good & so creamy! ❤️

name: R REE DOI CAFE
review_1_text:
Was nice experience
They had some special cacao mass for 80 thb
They make for us baby chino for 45thb... Was a bit surprising since a piccolo with coffee is 50th.
And the coffee was good
No toilet
Camping sitting
review_2_text: Everytime I come to Chiang Mai and need to have a coffee here. Such a cool and retro place and the coffee is amazing 😍☕️
review_3_text: Definitely the best coffee I had in Thailand! Baristas know what they’re doing. Appreciate the alternative milk option 🙏 So happy I stumbled across this hidden gem ☕️
review_4_text: Delicious flat white ☺️ Lovely small local place. For 50baht. You cannot go wrong here ✨💚
review_5_text: Small coffee place with great coffee for a good price. Nice selection of other drinks too. Oat milk available (+20, I think).Small but cozy outdoor seating area.

name: NOWHERE COFFEE BREWERS
review_1_text:
This cafe offers a high quality local coffee bean grown in Chiang Mai.
The tast is great with the best balance.
I enjoyed it in a relaxing cozy garden.
I strongly recommend the hot filter coffee to jave the best coffee experience.
review_2_text:
Hidden gem I could tell , i love the vibe and cattttttt 😼
Ps, someone who wear blue jacket so cool Unfortunately, I didn't ask for their contact ;-;
review_3_text:
Ramen - absolute masterpiece
Spicy rice curry - heaven on earth
Coffees - soul touching

Vibe - it's a serendipity that we got this place ! We chilled all the way and it was beautiful !!
review_4_text:
This cafe is located on the corner of an alley in the ancient city☕️

The environment is very comfortable.

It's a sitting in a daze for an afternoon.

Or an afternoon break

Where is the coffee?

Up to the middle

Latte is not good.

American-style medium-baked beans

Generally up

But the price is also above-middle.

Good environment, high score

Coffee is so-so. Don't expect high.

Just think of it as finding a place to sit.
review_5_text: Top tier coffee beans, cute friendly cats, tasty cake and the best community of people! Highly reccomed the masala chai or coffee and sitting in the beautiful green garden. Perfect place to make friends or sit with a drink for some alone time. DO NOT MISS THIS SPOT 🥰

name: mew.coffee.craft
review_1_text:
Chanced upon this cool quirky cafe with sleepy cat, cosy vibe, chill
music and friendly owner. Nicely located just opposite old town away from the crowd and noise.
review_2_text: The café is small but cozy, with good service. I ordered a hot latte, which was a bit too milky for my taste, but I still enjoyed it!
review_3_text: Lovely cafe! They serve amazing coffe, according to ur liking. We ordered two hot lattes and they were really affordable. The staff was so nice and the sweet cat was also a huge plus! I definitely recommend getting a coffee here!
review_4_text: I had a couple of beers here one night when there were some folks singing on acoustic guitar, was a cool night but they need to work on the sound.
review_5_text: Great place for a hip night out, indie alternative lovers this is the spot! Great staff and good beer options! Coming back again for sure ✌🏽

name: Good Shot coffee bar
review_1_text: Super chill place. Small but have indoor and outdoor seating. Only one server/ shop owner but she manages the drink order very quickly. A good stop for an early refreshment
review_2_text:
An unassuming place.
This was our best coffee in town CNX 2026! Amazing local coffee!
They have a pin board on the patio, one of the post-its summerizes it well, and this place embodies it.
We love this place! The seats on the patio are gold.
Best barista, her coffee makes everything right as rain!!
Thank You
🙏🫰
review_3_text: Cutest, cosy coffee bar - although I only had a Thai coffee, the cake options looked lovely. Beautiful viewing bar outside. Service was fab and drink tasted amazing. Would definitely recommend!
review_4_text: Nice place to chill with a great medium roast latte anytime of the day. Soft jazzy music playing with patio seats available and watch peoples and car, scooter, tuk tuk passes by. Such a relaxing vibe. Simple snacks and great espresso is the option here.
review_5_text:
My favourite every day morning stop! Best cortado ever! And sucha nice ambient with a lovely girl working there!
Happy I was a part of her big moment, the first successful decoration ❤️

name: IN TOWN Cafe
review_1_text: Our 2nd time visiting this location. The service is wonderful everyone is so friendly, the food is yummy especially the croffle and the chicken fried rice, so flavorful. They offer both Thai and western food and the prices are competitive. We will definitely be back. 🥳🥳
review_2_text:
Cute little cafe with great food and drinks! Situated right in front of the Le Canal Boutique Hotel.

Menu has many creative options for breakfast and lunch, including Thai selections. Fruit and waffle portion was large, easily enough to fill anyone. Presentation was superb, with high quality ingredients and very fresh.

Service was attentive, warm, and friendly. Food came out within 10 minutes, everything made to order. Atmosphere is warm and serene.
review_3_text: I love this little cafe and their staff so much! The food is great, perfect portion sizes (in my opinion) very well priced and the coffee is good! Always have a good playlist on (mostly smooth jazz from memory) as well, which I appreciate - especially seeing as it’s next to the road by the river.
review_4_text: Had a great experience at In Town Cafe. The food was fresh and flavorful, portions were generous, and everything came out quickly. Staff were friendly and welcoming, and the vibe was relaxed and comfortable. Solid spot for a casual meal in Chiang Mai 🔥🔥
review_5_text: Great spot to breakfast, brunch or lunch. Friendly staff take your order promptly and food comes out quickly. Relaxing, cool spot with a view of the moat with nice shady trees. Smoothies, bacon and eggs followed by fruit yoghurt bowl and espresso were all nice and tasty. Staff member Pai is a great host and she makes the best tasting coffee in Chiang Mai imho.. Highly recommended!

name: Idao Cafe&Restaurant
review_1_text:
Today was my first day in Chiang Mai, and I’m so glad I found Idao Café & Restaurant. The place has such a pleasant atmosphere – calm, cozy, and very welcoming. The service is great, and I want to highlight Champ, who was super friendly and made me feel right at home.

The food is delicious, the coffee is excellent (this is one of the best cappuccinos I’ve ever had. Perfect balance of coffee and milk), and the prices are really cheap for the quality you get. It’s honestly one of those spots you instantly feel connected to.

I have a feeling I’ll be coming back here every day while I’m in town. Highly recommended!
review_2_text: The food was delicious and the little tropical setting was the perfect way to start the day. The Fresh squeezed OJ was absolutely delicious along with the pork burger and the croissant with scrambled eggs and bacon on it. The surface was friendly and attentive.
review_3_text: Quite extraordinary and very tasty food and drinks, plus extremely friendly service 👍🏼😀
review_4_text: Lovely little coffee shop! We didn’t eat but the coffee is awesome. Such friendly staff and a really nice little place to sit and relax.
review_5_text: This place is lovely! The staff is super duper nice, the ambiance is peaceful with the beautiful fish pond by the patio, and they are always running food deals! I definitely recommend this place if you want a slow start to your morning and just want to chill out and enjoy the vibes👍

name: Oldtown Café
review_1_text:
Excellent coffee and a beautiful atmosphere.
Not cheap, but the interior is designed in a charming turn-of-the-century style.
Two friendly girls take your order at the counter.
Relaxing, comfortable seating, beautiful natural light, and a small, pleasant garden.
Seasonal Christmas decorations are tastefully and authentically integrated — unfortunately, the café is located directly on a busy main road.
review_2_text: Great aesthetic but that’s it! They use very very dark (bitter) beans (Robusta I think) for their coffee which does NOT pair with ANY milk based coffees! Then charging 90thb for it which for Chiang Mai is on the more pricier side: you are missing the mark completely! With better beans this has great potential risk but right now it’s something to skip as 99% of cafes in Chiang Mai do offer the perfect beans for that perfect cup!
review_3_text: This cafe has cool cafe vibes.  Good place to chill and do some work.  Nice relaxing piped-in music.  Breakfast semi-buffet at Thb 149 entitles you to one drink and free flow snacks, fruits, a Thai dessert and cookies.  It comes with free small mineral water bottle.
review_4_text: Great cafe located at the lobby area of a hotel. The space has AC and is very relaxing and has a nice long tables and some comfy chairs. This is definitely one of the better cafes if you are looking for a place to spend some quality time. My hot cappuccino was very good as well.
review_5_text:
🚨Avoid for breakfast 🚨
Well I was just looking for a drink, which is around 80-90 for something that doesn't look professional.
Then they propose the breakfast buffet option at 150. I tried and I'm disappointed 😞.
The fruits are not so fresh. The breads and croissant they propose are seven eleven like, and nothing is handmade. For this price we would except something a bit better.
Good thing : they give the wificode directly and it's a buffet so you can eat as much as you can even tho it's really not any better then the supermarket.
Also the music and decoration is cool, that's the good point.

name: Akha Ama Coffee ( The New Original )
review_1_text:
The branding and mission here are excellent. The menu highlights specific farmers (like Yongyuth and Ader) and details the processing methods, which adds a nice personal connection to the coffee. The shop itself is warm and inviting, with lots of wood and brick.
I tried their "Ader Geisha" and a standard drip. While it's great to see Thai single-origins being elevated, the flavor profile in the cup was straightforward rather than complex. It’s a good stop if you want to support local agriculture and buy some beans to take home, but the drink experience was fairly standard.
review_2_text: One of the the highest quality coffee place in Chiang Mai. We tried the dirty coffee and it was rich and creamy and not acidic, which we like. The interior of the place is very beautiful wood finishes with 2 storeys level. The seating took into consideration multiple seating groups of singles, doubles and families. They have a 2nd storey balcony view and a private garden seating at the back. A very nice and relaxing way to spend a quiet afternoon feeling like you're in a Japanese home enjoying their great coffee.
review_3_text:
Cozy coffee place nested in the north side of Chiang Mai old town. Wide selection of coffee products including local coffee beans.
Espresso was perfect. Chill and cool atmosphere with second floor seating option.
Recommended for your coffee fix.
review_4_text:
This coffee shop offers inside & outside seating and a true coffee lovers experience.
Inside various roasts and coffees are offered in preparation methods that will bring out the best flavors.
The immediate choice is light / medium / dark roast and through espresso machine versus drip coffee using the Japanese method.
We thoroughly enjoyed a flat white as well as a drip coffee with distinct flavor profiles.
Prices are average for CNX and service is fantastic.
A place not to be missed!
review_5_text: I tried the other branch this morning and then came here in the afternoon. This is the original location and it has upstairs with more seating, but still quite small compared to the Phrasingh location. I tried the strong roast espresso on the rock, again very smooth and balanced taste. I need to ask them where they buy their coffee beans. There is a small balcony which is quite nice. Very cozy space for reading or daydreaming.

name: Once in a Blue Moon Cafe & Hostel
review_1_text:
Very clean and calm.

Stood one night - very affordable prices for the small room with air con but no window. It's absolutely okay for a night.

Modern bathroom (super clean)

Negative:
You will get a disposable Towel for the shower/bath (?why?) - please use normal towels - less plastic and less waste

I totally recommend this place.
review_2_text:
Nice place, perfect location in the old city, staff nice. But I wish they would have explain more the door opening after 21:00. The button are all erased. But after 3-4 minutes i figured it out hahaha! I love the light and the outlet in my bed. Comfy pillow and bed cover. No toilet paper in the toilet 😕

I would stay here again.
review_3_text:
This cafe is really great, it’s giving the cozy vibes, the staff is so nice tho! What i can’t even forget to talk about is coffee. what a coffee!! the taste is sooooooo good. I didn’t know much what the coffee beans are. Didn’t have the knowledge in this fields tho, but you should try it. If you are a coffee lover, don‘t miss it!!!

Also I had the opportunity to stay at the hostel above. I can tell you that it is very minimalist. There is good management. The cleanliness is ten out of ten! Very quiet. And the location is in the heart of the city. You can walk around at night. There is a market not far away. and there are many restaurants around. Easy to go and easy to come.
review_4_text: The coffee here is sooo good ☕️ They roast their own beans and the aroma is amazing! There are different roast levels to choose from, and the place itself is small and cozy — quiet, not crowded at all. Perfect spot to sit back, relax, and enjoy a cup of coffee. Love it! ❤️
review_5_text: Did not stay at the hostel just went for a coffee, which is amazing! The cafe itself is not too big but has lovely decor. Definitely recommend trying one of their signature coffees, especially the “dirty”. Not to miss

name: Hey Bar @chiangmai
review_1_text:
A really great bar to sit back and chillax. All the staff are super nice and friendly, and make the vibe of the bar incredible. We were here for new years, and it was the highlight of our night.

The place is clean, toilets are good, and best of all, Kevin (one of the staff) brings the absolute vibe.
review_2_text:
Hey cafe/bar is very nice, cozy, and has a good relaxing vibe. If you are looking for a cozy bar, not too hectic where you can enjoy a drink with your date or some close friends, I highly recommend!

Drinks, food, and the service all were fantastic there! Highly recommend Frozen Peach crush cocktail!! 🍹
review_3_text: Great atmosphere and staff. The Frozen Peach Crush cocktail was delish. Highly recommend this bar. :)
review_4_text:
Such a hidden gem in Chiang Mai!
I tried the mango smoothie and fresh mango, and both were absolutely delicious. The presentation was beautiful, and you can tell they really care about the details. The staff were super friendly and welcoming, which made the experience even better. Highly recommend stopping by if you’re in the area. I’ll definitely be back!
review_5_text: it was a very lovely place to meet people and the staff there we’re so kind and welcoming. had the best time there and ill keep it close to my heart.

name: OON Poshtel x Cafe
review_1_text: I stayed here 4 nights. The good thing of this place is the location, super central, especially to the south gate of the city where tours pick up people. The room I stayed was simple and clean. The included breakfast was ok for the price. It's cheap. There is also a laundry service next door. But it's very noisy during the night as other guests can be inconsiderate with slamming doors and stomping. The place has no sound proof and you can also hear the scooters on the adjacent street. If you don't mind the noise this is a good place to stay.
review_2_text: Opinions are subjective, but to me Oon Poshtel was amazing. I rented a single room for 9 days. 7/11, laundry, money exchange, and scooter rental are all next door. Old town is right across the street.  This is a very clean establishment. Every morning this hotel is swept, mopped, and dusted. I fell in love with the family who owns the cafe. They all have warm smiles and are always eager to help.  The food in the cafe looks just the way it does in the pictures. Fresh, colorful, and tasty. This is a great place for a cute date with your wife. Thank You so much. I appreciate you all!
review_3_text: Only went for breakfast which was ok. Good size portion. Croissant was fine, I had worse in europe. Service fine.
review_4_text: It is really great, momeries and the staff helped us to have our 7th Anniversary day perfect 🙏🙏🙏 unexpectedly my husband shared our anniversary info and they tried to help us with the best surprises in a short notice period. Really feel amazing and lovely day to our couple. Thanks million 🙏 ❤️ 😘 ♥️  See you again, and we will  come and stay here again ❤️ 💙 ♥️ 😀 💕  Thank Oon Postel Owner and staff members really kind and share their hospitality.
review_5_text: I didn't stay here, but had breakfast here every day, as my hotel was just around the corner. It's a MUST to at least once, trying one of their incredible breakfast plates. Bring your camera!

name: The Cabin Backpackers Hostel & Bar
review_1_text: I really enjoyed my stay at the Cabin. Had some of the coolest community spaces I’ve seen in a hostel and the dorms were spacious and well-kept. The staff is incredibly friendly and ready to help and they offer laundry services as well as organize events! Although located next to a party hostel, I could not hear a sound on the third floor and had some of my best sleep here.
review_2_text:
Had an amazing stay here and came back again for a night!

Super small hostel so you see the same few mates everyday which is amazing and makes it so easy to make cool friends! U can join them for activities in the day (muay thai/waterfalls etc) and at night go to the myriad of amazing jazz clubs/nightlife spots.

I recommend northgate (go early), soi dog blues bar and thapae east (amazing movie set vibes)

Not so much a party vibe (more next door at stamps or sylvie and sometimes those folks come over so you can join them) but its very social. Staff rachel and kate (the manager/boss) are also v lovely. Also the peanut banana smoothie is divine.

I loved the semi private dorms (own bed and partition). U get ur own space for a dollar more a night which is super worth vs the bunks. Rooms are cleaned everyday and best part is no shoes in rooms.

One thing that i wished they could do was turn off the AC after 10/11am in the morning. Sometimes staff shuts it off at 9am and the heat makes you wake up which...after a late night out isnt so pleasant 😭 also as someone who is in construction/homebuilding the bath shower needs to be tiled on the right side or its a potential huge mold problem down the road (rn its a concrete white wall exposed to water.)

Overall great place will come back again!!
review_3_text: Had a great time here, great location and the rooms met my needs. Great atmosphere. Useful for booking tours. The staff were amazing, and very helpful. Pla, Om, Rachel (the male staff were great too but I don't know how to spell their names lol) all were very helpful and made my trip to Chiang Mai very special. Would highly recommend and I am ready planning my trip back already
review_4_text: Very lovely place! Pla and Rachel were so lovely and helped me with everything and made it feel very engaging, very kind people. Very easy location, chill vibes with more lively hostels next door but this was perfect as was more spacious, cheaper, and even the drinks were cheap. Will definitely come back when I am in Chiang Mai
review_5_text: Loved the people who were working at the cabin backpackers hostel! They were very friendly and helped us with al kind of things! The location was perfect everything was walkable from here and the rooms were clean! Only lesser thing is that your sleep wing in a staple bed that moves a lot of one of the two persons turns. Loved it!

name: ShaPel Hostel x Cafés
review_1_text: It’s clean, aircon is great and comfortable, beds are great and private with under bed drawers that lock. Bathroom facilities are nice and perfect location for a backpacker in Chiang Mai. Will note that it isn’t a very social hostel so if you’re looking for that wouldn’t recommend this place, but besides that I had an amazing time and experience here.
review_2_text: First time staying in a hostel! I booked this one as it appeared to be fresh, modern and clean. It was a really good experience and the hostess was amazing. I will 100% stay at the same place when I travel to Chiang mai in the future.
review_3_text: Had a great time at ShaPel Hostel. It's clean and quiet and well-located. A cute café is located downstairs. Recommend if you're looking for a friendly, safe environment. Definitely not a party hostel.
review_4_text: The room is clean and reasonably priced. There’s a nice café downstairs, and their Thai tea is really delicious! I highly recommend this place — it’s also close to Tha Phae Gate. 😍
review_5_text: The coolest hostel I’ve been to in the whole Thailand. I highly recommend super clean!

name: The South African - Cafe, Restaurant & Rooftop
review_1_text: Lovely place to grab a bite of Thai food or a large portion of South African food. Based on the menu we ordered the bunny chow, which looks like a manageable portion however, it came out in a whole sourdough bread bowl! No complaints just very filling. I ordered the pad krapao which was delicious. The fried egg was also cooked perfectly! We would defiantly eat here again!
review_2_text: A very nice, clean restaurant with friendly staff! I had the Chakalaka, which was served with Pap, a corn porridge. Pap tastes similar to Italian polenta and was very delicious! The restaurant has a few South African dishes on the menu, as well as some Thai dishes. I also really enjoyed the yummy Penang Curry. I highly recommend this restaurant!
review_3_text:
Spotless Cleanliness

The establishment gleams with meticulous care—tables wiped spotless, floors pristine, and restrooms impeccable, fostering a fresh, hygienic vibe that enhances every visit. I was so impressed.
Let me tell you about the desserts.
The desserts here are a real highlight: beautifully presented, generously portioned, and clearly made with attention to detail, and the desserts draw from African traditions, featuring many wonderful delights that will take many visits to sample each one. 🤭
I will be visiting ofter.

Cheers
GLT
review_4_text: We visited on a Friday night to try some of their South African offerings. We met with the owner who cooked us boerewors and pap, really tasty meal!The boerewors is infused with Thai flavours, almost like Thai Green Curry flavours- would definitely recommend! The staff were lovely too, very helpful. Wishing the owner all the best with his business🍀
review_5_text:
Really great.  Had lovely conversations with the owners– very passionate, and motivated to bring this cafe to life.

A friend and I came here to have a coffee and get some computer work done, and accidently wound up staying through lunchtime–! Very accommodating owner, willing to answer our questions (and put up with our continuous stay), with an eye tuned to possible improvements to his establishment.
Very clean place, the drinks were tasty and beautiful and the food delicious as well!

Excited for this business's future, as it is clear that a lot of care has gone into (and continues to) it♡
Their prioritization on natural and non-artificial ingredients really makes a difference!

name: Lecker Café & Bistro
review_1_text: We came in the night to chiang mai. And were so hungry and they made us food in the middle of the night. So welcoming and friendly. Much nice traveling ppl and ppl who stay in thailand. Owners are so nice. They have breakfast. Coffee. Lunch and dinner . Very thai style. But also European food. Karaoke also . Love to come and spend time here
review_2_text: While taking a walk, I happened to pass by this shop and decided to go in. I ordered a drink but wasn’t satisfied with it, so I explained the situation to the staff. They were very polite and replaced it with another drink for me. The owner was sitting at the entrance and talked with me for a while. Due to the street noise, I couldn’t hear clearly what he was saying and even thought he might be upset. Later, when settling the bill, the owner kindly offered us complimentary fries. I then realized I might have misunderstood him earlier—this is truly a wonderful shop with a very kind owner. I felt quite guilty for misjudging the situation. All in all, it turned into a lovely evening. Thank you so much, and I wish your business continued success! More importantly, I wish peace and love could always surround everyone.
review_3_text:
It felt right from my very first evening, which turned into a long and wonderful night. Singing badly, chatting with so many great people – and I found myself stopping by every day.

The owners are incredibly friendly, the atmosphere is warm, and the food is delicious at any time of day. A place I’ll happily come back to. Thank you for the great time.
review_4_text: Tasty food, reasonable prices, friendly and prompt service and a cozy atmosphere, they are open till late and you can even sing karaoke if you like. Highly recommended.
review_5_text:
I really like this place, not to expensive.
You can enjoy a relaxing atmosphere. There is karaoke for everyone can joy and it's free.
The price of mojito only 130 Thai baht, wine 120 and beer 70 (small) big one is 100 B.
I recommend the one who want to drink before go to another bar like ZOE or who travel alone and want some friends.
Can start here first cuz some day you will meet new friends there.

Important ! Owner very friendly.😉

name: Fringe.th - Cafe ad Restaurant
review_1_text: The place is nice, but for me too noisy. But I liked the whole atmosphere, for me it was more for a friendly session meeting than for a coffee break. You can find there also aj Dj set, nice for a couple of drink than a coffee spot.
review_2_text:
Fringe.th Cafe & Restaurant Chiang Mai is such a beautiful and cozy place! The atmosphere is calm and stylish perfect for relaxing, working, or just enjoying a slow morning. The coffee here is really good! ☕

A perfect spot for coffee in Changmai. Highly recommend stopping by if you want great coffee and chill aesthetics vibe!
review_3_text: Fringe Café is one of the best spots for coffee and breakfast in Chiang Mai. Their brews are consistently rich and smooth, and the breakfast options are fresh, tasty, and beautifully prepared. Surprisingly, their pasta is also really good—comforting, flavorful, and a great choice any time of day. A cozy and reliable café that never disappoints!
review_4_text:
Since I parked a car, This is one of the recommended cafes to visit in Chiang Mai. Mood and vibes are really comfy and sociable. I ordered an iced americano, The taste also great!

Suit with chilling out with friend and also for lovely couple.
review_5_text: We came as two people. The place was very nice, but the service was unpleasant and unfriendly. We ordered two omelets while the restaurant was empty. Only one omelet was served. After I finished eating, we asked about the second one and were told it was coming soon, but we waited a very long time. It seems they forgot the order. There was no apology, and they didn’t seem to care. We won’t be coming back.

name: Samsen Villa
review_1_text:
The food is decent but really it's just average for Thailand. I'm not surprised the last Michelin recommendation is from 2023. They've milked the Michelin rec as much as they could and are now selling snacks and whatever they can.
We ordered fish (usually takes at least 20min), soup and some other dishes and we're surprised that everything was on the table within 5-10min. They've maximized efficiency over the freshness, as the fish was definitely pre-fried and then kept warm. Everything was good but nothing special. The coconut shake was too sweet. The service was efficient again, but lackluster.
Good parking if you have a car.
Would I come back? No.
review_2_text: I had higher expectations for a place that has Michelin star rated plates. I had the red snail curry which was very tasty and flavorful whereas the fried squid was quite chewy and bland. I thought the prices were very high compared to other local restaurants. The service was just ok... not a whole lot of engagement or interaction. One of the benefits was that there was some live music which made the atmosphere a bit better. Overall, it was an ok experience.
review_3_text:
The food is delicious and full of authentic Thai flavors.
Portion sizes are very generous and satisfying.
The atmosphere is calm, peaceful, and very pleasant, with a beautiful riverside setting along the Ping River.
A great place to enjoy a relaxed and high-quality Thai meal.
review_4_text: Thai restaurant with a wide variety of dishes. Nice riverside atmosphere by the Ping River. A great place to relax and enjoy good food in Chiang Mai.
review_5_text:
A Hidden Gem by the River – A Perfect Evening Experience

This beautiful riverside restaurant truly exceeded our expectations in every way. From the moment we arrived, we were impressed by the charming atmosphere and attention to detail. Nestled right by the water, the setting is nothing short of idyllic — especially in the evening, when the outdoor area is gently illuminated and the reflections on the river create a magical ambiance.

Both the interior and exterior spaces are thoughtfully designed, offering comfort and elegance whether you choose to dine indoors or out. The terrace is particularly stunning at night, perfect for a romantic dinner or a relaxed evening with friends.

The food was absolutely outstanding. Every dish was prepared with clear attention to quality and flavor, showcasing fresh ingredients and a refined touch. It’s rare to find such consistency in both presentation and taste — this place delivers on both fronts.

What truly set the experience apart, however, was the warm and welcoming team. The staff was exceptionally friendly, professional, and attentive without ever being intrusive. You can feel that they genuinely care about their guests’ experience, and it made a lasting impression.

One highlight not to miss: the foamed beer. It’s a unique specialty of the house and adds an unexpectedly delightful twist to the usual beverage experience — creamy, smooth, and perfectly chilled. Definitely something to try, even if you’re not typically a beer drinker.

In short, this restaurant is a rare find — a perfect combination of stunning location, excellent cuisine, and outstanding service. We’re already looking forward to coming back.

name: Good Day Farm to Table
review_1_text:
Delicious Breakfast Spot in Chiang Mai

I recently visited Good Day Farm to Table for breakfast and had a wonderful experience. I ordered the eggs Benedict with smoked salmon, which was perfectly prepared—the eggs were poached just right, the hollandaise sauce was creamy and flavorful, and the smoked salmon added a nice touch.

My husband had the scrambled eggs with Parmesan cheese, and they were incredibly creamy and rich. You could really taste the quality of the ingredients.

The atmosphere was cozy and welcoming, and the service was friendly and attentive. It's a great spot for a relaxed breakfast or brunch in Chiang Mai. We'll definitely be back!
review_2_text: Hidden gem in Chiang Mai. Affordable, amazing menu, and I’ve never been disappointed even after multiple visits. Calm, quiet space with great vibes, incredible bacon and sausages, fresh and flavorful food, and excellent service. Perfect spot for brunch or lunch in a cool vintage area.
review_3_text: Great vibes and a cute location in a breezy alley, but the food was just average. The Eggs Benedict looked good, but the hollandaise sauce was off, and it wasn't a proper poached egg…the yolk was about 90% cooked. The side salad wasn't fresh either. Some of them were even starting to rot. On the bright side, the corn ribs were decent, and the bacons and smoked salmon were nice. The medium-roast Americano was a bit light but fine.
review_4_text:
A solid choice if you prioritize a quiet, pet-friendly vibe and a good location.

Great spot inside The Warehouse surrounded by shops. The atmosphere is cozy, peaceful, and not at all crowded. We went there around 11am on Friday a day after X’Mas.

The food is okay—standard breakfast fare that does the job for a casual morning meal.

Love the outdoor seating and the fact that it’s pet-friendly. A very relaxing environment!
review_5_text:
Breakfast is my forte, my simple pleasure in life. I look for the best Breakfast in any town around the world. Today at Good Day Farm to Table in C M my Breakfast was exceptionally delicious. The bacon,oh my the thick cut bacon was cooked to perfection. The eggs were moist and fluffy and complete with the caramelized onions . Sitting underneath was crunchy sourdough toast.
Sit back and enjoy your breakfast in a quiet and serene setting.
A perfect morning for sure.

name: SINC Cafe’
review_1_text:
We were there for lunch and the food was delicious. We had a dey kahp soi and minced beef with rice. The price is good.
Only the man who served us seemed to be rather bothered than amused. He did not reply a lot when I asked something and just looked very bored.
review_2_text: Such a cool place!! Every single detail of their interior is so cute!! The food was tasty too 🥰 I’d totally come again
review_3_text: Very interesting decor in this cafe. Lots of picture opportunities. Very English friendly with a mix of local and western foods. Their pizza was delicious and crust was crunchy, freshly made. Khao soi was flavorful and yummy as well. We enjoyed our food here very much. Nice place to chill
review_4_text: Very cool vibe, great lounge music, perfect to hangout. Good food. Coffee was average. Friendly staff.
review_5_text: A wonderful place with excellent food, great coffee, and warm, hospitable service. The decor is lovely.

name: Heartening Coffee.Bar
review_1_text: Amazing drip coffee (had the Honduras whisky) and very relaxing atmosphere and friendly service. Highly recommend.
review_2_text: The owner is very friendly, the environment is comfortable and quiet, the drinks are of good quality. Highly recommended.
review_3_text: Gorgeous, tranquil coffee shop. Has really comfortable seats and relaxing music - really enjoyed reading by book here with a pot of peppermint tea. The woman working there was kind enough to refill it so I could have another pot. Really recommend this lovely place!
review_4_text: I spent a really relaxed and chilled out evening here. The owners are lovely people and very creative mixing drinks. Loved it and as a local will be back for sure.
review_5_text:
I feel  cozy and comfy in here.
Coffee is nice and atmospere is good.

name: OWL Coffee & Bakery
review_1_text: The cake made me go: wow - audibly 😂 / what a great find! If you want coffee & cake this is the place!
review_2_text: Really nicely surprised by this little cafe.
