I only went because the TCDC wasn't open yet but I had a very nice Thai tea, less sweet, which came with a nice cap of foamed milk for only 25 baht in a very generous size. Seating is open to the outside but there are fans that kept everything cool. There's a wide array of cakes and they are super affordable but tasty based on one cheesecake I tried. Friendly service too. Really recommended when you're in the area!
review_3_text:
Very relaxing atmosphere, watching the world go by.
Latte was nice and strong, just how I like.
The cheesecake was so tasty 😋
All for 100 baht 👌🏼
Will be back.
Could do with a toilet though.
review_4_text: Great pastries and nice coffee. Small place with limited seating and no bathroom. However, the open air atmosphere is relaxing and the service is friendly. I definitely recommend this place, especially for the pastries.
review_5_text: Cakes are neighbourhood quality. Coffee beans are more on the burnt taste type. Pricing is lowest rung. Ambience is cosy and homely!

name: khna coffee brewers
review_1_text:
A charming specialty coffee spot in Chiang Mai's Wat Gate neighborhood, housed in a beautifully renovated old wooden house.
It offers a peaceful, homey vibe with natural light flooding through large windows, vintage furnishings, wooden floors, and a lovely garden area out back—perfect for slowing down and savoring the moment.
The cafe focuses on sustainably sourced single-origin Arabica beans from northern Thailand hills, micro-roasted in small batches for fresh, flavorful brews.  It's a cozy escape ideal for relaxing or light work, with friendly staffs adding to the warm, welcoming feel. A hidden gem for coffee lovers seeking quality and tranquility in Chiang Mai!
review_2_text: One of my to-go spots for coffee in the area. Quiet and cozy. Right across from a few yummy places too - that’s why I enjoy spending some time on this street with good coffee and food.
review_3_text: Serious roasters = delicious coffee. Lots to 💕@Khna:  a warm contemporary design, smart,  helpful service and coffees that will having coming back again and again.
review_4_text:
Decent coffee. Good vibes cozy atmosphere.

Sunny breezy cafe of Chiangmai.
review_5_text: I’ve been a regular customer at this café, but my recent visit left me disappointed. After parking as usual and buying a takeaway cake from a nearby bakery, I was unexpectedly lectured by the owner about not leaving the premises or bringing outside items. Even after clarifying that the cake was sealed to take home, I was further admonished, and the overall attitude felt unwelcoming. Additionally, needing a key for the restroom added to the awkward experience. It seems the owner has issues with other shops, but projecting that onto customers isn’t fair. Sadly, this experience means I won’t be returning.

name: Later on | cafe and bar
review_1_text:
A charming and quiet place with seating both indoors and outdoors. The décor is sweet, the staff is kind, and the desserts are good.

I didn’t personally love their signature drink, though.
review_2_text: Nice quiet cafe tuck in a corner of the rural street. Nice decor and lotsa drinks selection. Recommended if you have a lazy afternoon to read, work or chill.
review_3_text: The cafe is very cozy and a good place to take pictures. Staff was friendly and welcoming. The drinks had the right amount of sweetness and the baked goods were exceptional, especially the chocolate fudge cake. Best part, they have a parking lot.
review_4_text:
Friendly staff, good service(Accidently left 1 drink and the staff chase and brought to the villa where i'm staying(beside the shop), Nice deco, very Instagramable place of cos drinks are nice.
Should try out the ice mocha
review_5_text: Lovely and Cozy cafe! the croffle is my fav! the drinks are so good and the owner is so sweet. also there are parking spaces!! highly recommended

name: Ni-Yom Restaurant
review_1_text:
The authentic of Thai food, the variety is various and the atmosphere is  absolutely peaceful. I love the cafe in the middle of the restaurant which gave you a smell of cooked coffee bean. It would be better if the portion of the food comes a little bigger, because I feel like not completely full after finish one dish, probably have to order one more.

The staff also friendly and nice service.

The parking is only one minute away from the restaurant and cost 30฿ for 60 minutes, after that will cost more. (You cannot park in front of restaurant which next to the road)
review_2_text: I was surprised to find the food so tasty! One of the top Thai food places in Chiangmai. Well-balanced, good portions, good for the soul. I went to the place, took some home, and ordered Grab again the next day. It was equally as good delivery too! Bonus that it's located in such wonderful space with cool unique local products, cafe, and wine bar. Super chill place to be. Their signature "dry porridge" and spicy pickle soup are worth trying.
review_3_text: A cosy dining place in the heart of Chiangmai. All the dishes we ordered are so appertising and mouth watering. We truly enjoyed the dining experience here. The staff is attentive and will definitely recommend my friends to try Niyom when they visit Chiangmai. 🥰👍👏
review_4_text:
What a shame... Came because of good reviews... Hard to find, hidden in a closed grocery store, with an odd wine bar in the front. Apparently separate businesses, the only beverages available at the restaurant are pre bottle fancy ice teas. Not even the wine  menu, and they cant make a cup of tea.

Staff was completely unattentive. Better customer care from the street food vendors, or the run down Pad Thai shacks around the corner.

The food is smaller than the portions pictured on the menu and is under seasoned. The pork fried rice mostly tasted like flared oil from poor wok skill.... For such fancy presenting place I am very disappointed. Leaving hungry, needing to get some better flavors In my mouth.
review_5_text:
Very authentic Thai food restaurant in Chiangmai. Food tasty, reasonable price, clean and nice service. Owner is friendly. You will love here for sure, if you like Thai food. Must try!

Just revisit this restaurant in Jan 2024, still good as usual. Will come again when visiting Chiangmai

This restaurant sits in my Thai favorite top list easily.

name: Wake Up Coffee @ B2 Riverside Premier
review_1_text: A cozy place to stay while waiting for my hotel check-in. I arrived in Chiangmai at 5am and I needed to stay somewhere while waiting, good thing this 24 hrs cafe is along the way to my hotel. The staff speaks very well English and very accommodating. Their coffee is tasty and the vibe of the place is quite nice. Not too bright and not too dim. Not too cold either. Wifi available. Highly recommended.
review_2_text: Clutch coffee shop for overnight in Chiang Mai. Really is 24/7 with chill vibes inside. Only problem was wifi was down when I was there but It didnt bother me as I had stuff to work on offline. The wifi probably usually works too
review_3_text: I like this cafe because it's the only 24h cafe I found in Chiang Mai so far (but maybe there are others too). It offers wi-fi and tables with outlets, which is very convenient for working. The drinks are not very special, but they are good. And staff is very friendly and nice.
review_4_text: I came here a long time ago (a few years) while walking around and this time I wanted to stop in to get a coffee and wait before taking a bus to Bangkok, sadly they have gone cashless and I didn’t want to use my debit card and get an international charge so I had to leave. I remember before there were many people maybe students studying this time there was only one person. Maybe it was a bad time or maybe it’s not very popular spot. I like that it stays open 24/7 and that was also why i came here because I would need to stay past the typical coffee shop closing time of 6pm. I give it five stars because I didn’t want to rate low for something out of anyone’s control, I just felt like sharing that they are cashless now.
review_5_text: Poor quality food and drinks here, industrial grade food. No service, you have to pick your goods at the counter.

name: Somnuek Kopi
review_1_text: Cool to grab a cold tea straight from the bicycle stand 🚲. Pleasant music playing 🎶, light and friendly vibe. The iced Thai tea 🧋 is only 30 baht — tasty and refreshing on a hot day. Simple, quick and genuinely warm service
review_2_text:
The milk tea was oredy sugar made so even if order without sugar still a bit sweet for my liking, need to wait for the ice to melt then would taste better. Unless ofcoz u like it sweet. Recommend🇹🇭
Uncle looks awesome with his uniform on
review_3_text:
During our trip in Chiang Mai we heard about a mobile sales stand which offers special Thai coffee "Oliang" and classic Thai Tea. The stated location is conform to the saved maps place. The service was friendly and the coffee tastes really good. The 'Oliang" is a dark and slightly sweet, in my opinion strong ice-coffee. The Thai Tea was refreshing and have a classic, not to much, delicate milky taste. Try IT!
Don't forget , you can only pay cash!

Travel Tip: Explore the market nearby, its worth it!
review_4_text:
Hahaha not bad for instant coffee and Thai tea. Both drinks came in the standard (overly) sweetness level - just wait for the ice to melt slightly so that it’s not that sweet LOL

Uncle dressed in old school policeman outfit was such a vibe 🤣
review_5_text: The vegetables were fresh and tasty. I haven't had them for a while. They only cost $50B for 3 kinds of items. The places is small, likes two tables for seating.

name: Cafe Willow
review_1_text: Cafe has dark and classic decoration. It also has fish pound and garden. There’s no other guest when we visited there so we got the whole place yo ourselves The staff was very attentive, friendly and helpful. Coffee and cheese cake were good. Spicy seafood salad lack of spicy and sour punch. A good place to chill.
review_2_text:
I can't say enough good stuff about this place.   The decor is serene from the table placement to the decorative touches.  The view through the Willow garden and beyond to the Ping River.

Then there is the food and drink.   All thoughtfully prepared and presented.   An appetizer of crispy pork rinds, chicken Pad Thai garnished with Banana flowers, ending with coconut milk ice cream, black plum and banana (with a crisp sugar coating).

They also open for breakfast, it's a calm way to start the day.

Oh, and the staff ... excellent!
review_3_text:
The place is quite. A good place to work. They have charging station and free WIFI. The staff is really polite. Cool ambiance.

Had a hard time finding it because it's part of7 the hotel. If you find a brown and white hotel on the pinned location. That is it.
review_4_text: Wonderful wonderful food, awesome and friendly staff and reasonable prices!!  The carbonara pasta and Thai style fried rice were our favorites!  The sides with the breakfast sets were so delicious!!  We are gonna miss this place when we go home.
review_5_text: Delightful in every way. Signature Thai cafe style with a relaxed atmosphere and minimal but quality fittings. Food and service were top notch.

name: Baan 104
review_1_text: Baan 104 is a truly special spot! The atmosphere is incredibly warm and inviting, making it the perfect place to sit back and relax. A major highlight is the live piano music, which creates a beautifully serene and elegant backdrop for your visit. The drinks are delicious, and the desserts are absolutely fantastic! Highly recommend this cozy gem.
review_2_text: The cafe shop in old house... The matcha is good not outstanding... There is piano and has pianist..the shop is cozy and chill... Recommend if u like to chill or work here
review_3_text:
Nice environment with piano and cello to play.
The citrus Americano is great. Fresh orange juicy.
review_4_text: The best cafe in Chiang Mai or dare I say Thailand!!! This spot offers exceptional quality in both its bakery selection (waffles, scones, madeleines, cakes and cookies) and hand crafted coffee. Definitely worth visiting anytime of the day to savour in the vintage colonial-style setting. They also have brilliant live music in the afternoon on the weekends, simply a perfect place to relax and indulge!
review_5_text: A little (kinda) hidden cafe that hyped on social media as many local young people come here. The drink is nice, but just need some improvement in food variety. The atmosphere is perfect and calming, there was a jazz pianist performing when i came here. Worth to try 👍

name: ALong Cafe
review_1_text: A good place to have some coffee & relax. Friendly staff.
review_2_text: I love coming here in the mornings. I think she makes the best americanos and Es Yen. There is lots of comfortable and clean seating. Even though it’s by a road and outside it’s quiet and cozy.
review_3_text: Good iced cappuccino in a beautiful and quiet spot!
review_4_text: Lovely cafe with great coffee and homemade snacks. It's a pleasure to sit surrounded by trees on a hot sunny day. The owner is very nice!
review_5_text: This stunning cafe is a van outfitted to serve the tastiest beverages! Enjoy a relaxing moment in the warm sun, listen to the enchanting sounds of Thai music and be greeted with a smile as your barista slides your order across the counter.

name: Tanita Coffee House
review_1_text:
We discovered this wonderful family-run café and ended up returning every day of our trip. The coffee is really excellent - you can tell they know what they are doing. The food menu is not huge, but everything is freshly made at home and tastes absolutely delicious. The prices are very fair too, which was a nice surprise.

One thing we really appreciated was the outdoor area. They have water humidifiers set up, which makes it comfortable to sit outside even when it's very hot.

If you are looking for a good café with honest, home-cooked food and great coffee at reasonable prices, we definitely recommend this place. It is run by a lovely family and you can feel the care they put into everything.
review_2_text:
Tanita Coffee House is a true hidden gem in Chiang Mai! The moment you step into the compound, you're transported into a peaceful, traditional Lanna-style oasis. The coffee is excellent—they use quality, local Arabica beans—and the Thai cuisine is delicious. It’s the perfect, relaxing escape from the city hustle, wrapped in beautiful old-world charm. Highly recommended for an authentic and tranquil coffee experience!

Plus point it's that there is a Thai antiques store located at the back of the coffee shop. Some really interesting pieces and owners are extremely friendly and happy to talk about the history of the items.
review_3_text: Tanita Coffee House is such a charming and peaceful spot tucked away in Chiang Mai. The traditional wooden house setting gives it a cozy, nostalgic vibe that feels instantly relaxing. Their coffee is smooth and well-made, and the whole place has a slow, calming atmosphere that makes you want to stay for hours. A perfect hideaway for anyone who loves quiet cafés with character.
review_4_text: I really enjoyed this restaurant. The place feels cozy and friendly, and the food came out fast. I ordered Pad Thai and it was delicious, full of flavor and perfectly cooked. The cappuccino was also really good.
review_5_text:
A Hidden Gem in Chiang Mai !

Staying at Tanita House has been a designer’s dream. Every morning felt special — having breakfast in an antique furniture shop, surrounded by old timber homes full of character and charm.

The wooden houses are beautifully preserved, with rich teak textures and warm details. In the café, vintage sewing machines are cleverly used as table bases — playful, functional, and full of personality.

The food is clean, healthy, and homemade, and Aor and her family are incredibly warm and welcoming.

If you love thoughtful design and quiet, soulful stays, I’d highly recommend this place.

name: Wake Up Coffee @ B2 Riverside Colonial
review_1_text: This is the only coffee shop that I know of in chiang mai that is 24 hours open. The coffee taste is good. This is a simple small coffee shop that is consistently good.  It only has a few snacks.  The location is on the ping river. There are only a few seats inside.  This is more of a take away type shop.
review_2_text:
Super chill cafe located in a medium sized hotel. Most of the guests seem to be locals there to avail themselves of the very well lit and air conditioned coffee shop.

This is a nice little spot for locals with plenty of power outlets for laptops.

Some tasty pastries and coffee and Italian sodas were available they're a bunch of delicious looking bingsus on the menu but unfortunately were not available  during my visit.

I will definitely come back here again.
review_3_text: I asked for chocolate mocha he said no don't have . I said what is this Belgium chocolate mocha on the menu. He said ok,  I said large but only 8 oz. So I ask for 2 . Paid 160 baht and left. Got to my table, open the lid, and it was half full, 4 freaking oz. I was able to pour the entire contents of the second one into the first to make one 8 ounce mocha. This place is a good start for a coffee shop. Rite now it is nothing  but a hotel desk.
review_4_text:
This is an extremely overrated franchisee, misrepresented by multiple travel bloggers as a 24h co-working space. There is less than six tables, and barely enough room to squeeze in twelve people.

I waste a taxi fare to find that there was no space here to actually sit, machine would not accept wireless payments, and quickly left. The staff also seemed very tired, and was not particularly friendly nor helpful.
review_5_text: There are 1 staff always on the phone all the time and talking pretty loud, I used to go often, but I don't want to go anymore.

name: 39 Coffee House
review_1_text:
I'm a huge fan of this coffee shop. They offer drip coffee, reasonable prices, a variety of menu options, and friendly service.

The owner is welcoming, and there's even a counter seat available. My personal favorites are the Medium Roast hot Americano and their delicious sandwiches.
review_2_text: Very friendly staff. Good tasting coffee. I will return in a few days to taste the food
review_3_text: I enjoyed my americano very much.
review_4_text: Nice Coffee and friendly Service
review_5_text: I'm from Taiwan. There's only one stylist here. The shampoo and massage are very comfortable, and my hair is incredibly smooth afterwards. I recommend it.

name: LivingRoom Cafe'192
review_1_text: I love coming here. The owners are friendly and their menu is top tier for a local café. You would love a variety of coffee and non-coffee drinks. You can also have late “breakfast” here as well. Highly recommended!!! 🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟
review_2_text:
A Hidden Gem in Chiang Mai: Living Room Coffee Shop

Living Room Coffee Shop is an absolute delight and quickly became one of my favorite spots in Chiang Mai. Nestled away from the hustle and bustle, this café is a serene escape with a unique charm that sets it apart from the rest.

First and foremost, the coconut smoothie is nothing short of spectacular. It's rich, creamy, and perfectly balanced — an absolute must-try for anyone visiting. Pair it with their delicious snacks or coffee, and you’ve got yourself a winning combo.

The staff are warm, welcoming, and always ready with a smile. They truly make the experience feel special, adding to the relaxing and friendly atmosphere of the café.

But perhaps the most unique and delightful feature is the gang of four adorable bunnies that roam in their little enclosure! These furry companions add a whimsical touch to the café’s vibe. Watching them hop around is a soothing and oddly entertaining experience. It got me wondering — what is the difference between a bunny and a rabbit? And while we’re at it, what do you call a group of rabbits? (Someone tell me so I can stop calling them a “gang” — though it suits them perfectly!)

Whether you're looking for a quiet spot to relax, a place to work, or just craving a great coconut smoothie in Chiang Mai, Living Room Coffee Shop is an absolute must-visit. I’ll definitely be coming back for the vibes, the drinks, and of course, to visit my bunny friends!
review_3_text: Lovely cozy space. The shop offers both normal and fusion coffee. The lychee or coconut juice is a must try. The owner is very friendly. The shop is a good place to take a breath read a chapter in a book before moving on.
review_4_text:
Good cafe to spend chill time...
It's my first time to see Luk chup at a cafe (usually I see it at night markets or Thai sweets shops)
I like their cappuccino taste :)

There are outdoor seats in the back, around a pond. You may need mosquito repellent (They kindly let me use theirs), but nice atmosphere.
review_5_text: I loved getting my morning latte here because the staff are wonderful, personable people. The atmosphere is modern and tastefully appointed. The decor is chic and and the coffee is tasty and affordable!

name: R REE DOI ROOM
review_1_text: I enjoyed a great cup of coffee - a medium-roast Hot Americano for just 45 Baht. The atmosphere was perfect for relaxation, with a quiet and clean environment, plus air conditioning.
review_2_text:
A small but cozy restaurant. The shops decoration style is clean and cute. A nice place to chill out and enjoy your time.

They offer a variety of coffee beans both domestically and from aboard and offers light to dark roast. Small snacks are also available.

Opens daily from 7.30 a.m.
Roadside parking for cars. Small area parking for motorcycle.
review_3_text: The best coffee in Chiang Mai!!!! Highly recommend their dark roast beans! The es yen coffee tastes so great too! The vibe here is awesome! very demure very mindful 🤣Must try in ChiangMai!!
review_4_text: Nice little place with nice coffee and nice staff. Great to get my iced macchiato served in a real glass. No worries, to-go plastic cups are also available. Park on the street. They also do some cake and custard. Will try some next time.
review_5_text:
Cappuccino was delicious, temperature was spot on   Owner busy and still very friendly.
I was very happy to see the shop still alive and well after the great flood of 2024.   That same great coffee and friendly people   If you’re in the area well worth visiting

name: FAV FAV coffee
review_1_text: If you’re looking for a cozy little spot to brighten your day, FAVFAV is just perfect! The coffee is made with so much love, and every corner of the café feels warm and welcoming.
review_2_text: Excellent quiet corner. Fantastic coffee, Haru is the cutest fat (not pregnant) cat! 🙏
review_3_text: Amazing coffee and tea that comes with a great service, place atmosphere and an adorable cat 😺. Can't ask for more!
review_4_text: Professional Fluffy receptionist🐈.   Coffee + Cat = Good combination. Great Mocca 👍🏼
review_5_text: Delicious coffee, relaxing atmosphere and friendly cats 🐈

name: Green o'clock
review_1_text:
Casual mostly outdoor seating in a tranquil garden setting.  Reliable choice for inexpensive and delicious Thai foods in a neighborhood setting.

Frequented by lots of students sitting around in deep discussion.  It is not unusual to see one  strumming a guitar.
review_2_text:
It looked very run down and needed a good tidy up .
Only stopped for a drink,  the staff were friendly.
review_3_text: Very delicious food.and  very nice place, I will be back soon
review_4_text: there is something lovely in this place. the atmosphere is like you are invited to a family party but u also have your own privacy..a lot of youngsters are there for study, playing music, chitchat, and another group is middle aged people drinking beer. good environment. food menu is simpke but tasty. they have enough drink list for your selection. price is really acceptable. open air with green makes it great at any season. highly recommended.
review_5_text: A beautiful garden cafe. The food is mostly Thai and freshly prepared. Beer is available. A nice place to relax, read, write, chat etc. No live music. Mostly visited by young locals from universities nearby. Very few tourists/travelers know about this place. Not expensive if you order Thai food.

name: Pra-tuu Dang
review_1_text: A hidden jungle café in Chiang Mai Old City . The traditional Lanna wooden houses give it a cozy, authentic vibe,surrounded by trees and nature.Live music and a bunch of cute cats hanging around. A nice place to sit back and enjoy a slow moment. ☕🌿🐾
review_2_text: The most chill place for everyone in Chiang Mai, great coffee and smoothies, the kindest staff, many cute cats and such a beautiful garden and home to spend your time. Events happening sometimes. You can not miss it ❤️
review_3_text:
Spot with spacious garden and many cats🙂
Recommended for a nice atmosphere and good coffee
review_4_text: Cute cafe with a garden, cats, and live music :)
review_5_text:
For cat lovers and those looking to relax in a green space - delicious coffee, cakes, and especially try the croffles, a cross between a croissant and a waffle! Incredible!
The kindness of the baristas adds to the charm of this architect-designed house set in a lush garden. Only good vibes!
Best secret cat café in the heart of cnx 😻

name: UpperCrust Bakery & Cafe
review_1_text: Such a lovely place to eat, create and relax. Love the Laab tofu. It is the best I have eaten.
review_2_text: A cozy, quiet café with delicious food. The staff is very friendly, and the owner speaks English well. The prices are appropriate for a place of this level. The cashew chicken is outstanding! 👌 The cheesecake is also good, made with the right cheese. It’s not overly sweet (just make sure to ask for it without the blueberry jam if you don't like sweet).
review_3_text:
Usually good.
This time we have a bit of hair in the cashew chicken. Not wonderful.
Bon appétit!
review_4_text: They serve the best mango cheesecake in the world! This place used to be in front the train station, but has moved here! Enjoy!
review_5_text:
Disclaimer: I haven't stepped foot in their physical store and my review is based on their food alone.

Every time I go to Rimping to pick up groceries I wind up picking up at least two cookies for my husband and me. Their Red Velvet Cappuccino Cookies are the things dreams are made of. All of their baked goods (found in the fridges) are heavenly. My husband loves their Carrot Cake, and we just tried and raved about how good their Peanut Butter and Caramel Brownie is. I have yet to be disappointed in any of their creations. I discovered that they have a physical location last week and you better believe I am making my way in as soon as I can. Absolutely obsessed.

name: mosaic coffee
review_1_text: Such a cozy spot! The ambiance truly feels like home, warm and welcoming. Plus, I loved meeting Mocha the dog—so sweet and friendly. Definitely a place I’d love to come back to.
review_2_text: Among hundreds of coffee places of various ages in Chiang Mai, Mosaic has been here 17 years and counting. Enjoy coffee drinks and fruit smoothies here with mosaic tables and floors, legacy of owner's business earlier. The big table boasts of great iron works, made by owner's significant other in the back workshop. Cacti inside and out front look well-cared for. Spent an easy afternoon here over a hot cappuccino and a coconut with milk smoothie made more exciting with a shot of espresso.
review_3_text: Coffee was good, I tried the americano served with a side glass of water which is always welcome.  There’s an area out the front where all the smokers hangout next to the street if you’re French and need a coffee and cigarette 😝. Inside was comfortable and cool although I did notice a sign saying it’s 20 baht to charge your phone for an hour on the power point! #BeatTheGrind
review_4_text: I enjoy good coffee. Mosaic Coffee is a wonderful place to enjoy a good cup of coffee and relax. Great atmosphere and staff.
review_5_text: Favourite coffee shop in Chiang mai! The owner Ao magmde all the Mozaïc art herself, it's very arty, inspiring atmosphere! The coffee is peaceful and perfect for a quiet time. The coffee and brownies are delicious!

name: Roastniyom Coffee - Wat Ket Hotel
review_1_text: we had a good time there. The owner was so kind and can speak english! He lets us choose how sweet and how much ice 🧊 I highly recommend honey lemon chewy, which tastes so good and is suited for this heat in thailand 🇹🇭 if we have a chance to come back to Chiang mai i would be back here 😍 if you are a foreigner, just a heads up you can pay by only cash!
review_2_text: Good smell , taste. I recommend !!
review_3_text: Barely average coffee
review_4_text:
This cozy cafe is located on the way to Central Festival. I took shelter from the sudden downpour, and the coffee was delicious, and the air conditioning was cool, so I had a comfortable rest.

I vividly remember doing my laundry at the coin-operated laundromat across the street from my last visit to Chiang Mai 😀
review_5_text:
A coffee shop with delicious, standard flavors.

Great coffee, great atmosphere, spacious shop with cute furniture.

name: ทักว่า タクワ Coffee Stand
review_1_text: Lovely little coffee stand serving handcrafted coffee of all kinds, adjusted to your preferences. The owner is very kind and great to chat to - she told us a bit about the area and gave us a few recommendations for our trip. We will be back next time! 🐇🌿☕
review_2_text: It’s not just a stand — it’s also a small, cozy café. They serve excellent coffee in porcelain cups rather than plastic. Even for takeaway, they use paper cups and paper lids instead of plastic.
review_3_text: Great coffee shop in a peaceful area a short walk from the main road. Was originally going to get coffee to go but ended up staying! Staff was extremely friendly and accommodating. Great recommendations given for Chiang Mai. Definitely worth a visit!
review_4_text: Stumbled upon this cafe without any expectations, just looking to grab a coffee post-lunch at Habib. Surprisingly, the atmosphere is delightful, prompting me to relax for a while. The barista/owner is incredibly friendly, and my iced americano stands out as one of the best in Chiang Mai. Definitely worth a try!
review_5_text: A cute local coffee place with friendly barrista, using slow bar machine.  Coffee is lovingly made, using local beans and single origin Colombian beans.  Give it a try.

name: P&P Home Cafe
review_1_text: I have to say, I ordered coffee to try and was impressed with both the taste and the price. The atmosphere is relaxing and the service is friendly. They offer breakfast sets, drinks, and homemade baked goods, including apple pie, blueberry cheesecake, and chocolate cake, all delicious and at great prices. It was so good I couldn't resist ordering some to take home for my family to try! I highly recommend P&P Home Cafe; you won't be disappointed!
review_2_text: The atmosphere is great! It feels warm and welcoming, like visiting relatives. It's located in Chiang Mai city, near Maestro Hospital. ;)
review_3_text: I came here with 4 friends. The air conditioning is cool, the coffee is strong and flavorful, and the homemade bakery items are delicious. We'll definitely visit again next time.
review_4_text: Hidden World Coffee House is located in someone's back garden. It has ample space and air conditioning. The coffee and cakes are delicious. I spent a comfortable afternoon here and will definitely come back to try its savory food!

name: Grandma Presso
review_1_text: Lovely stop for morning coffee. Great taste Americano and we also got to try the Jasmin tea, delicious. I love the plants too!
review_2_text:
Very nice little coffee shop.
Good coffee. Nice ambiance! Very well decorated and good service!
review_3_text: Amazing coffee shop. The tea I had was delicious and the owner was really friendly and polite. Highly suggested :)
review_4_text: Very good coffee, inexpensive, and nice decor.
review_5_text: Such a cosy place, and the staff was super friendly.

name: Drink First Love Second
review_1_text: Good coffee. Car wash is awesome. Very friendly and detail very good.
review_2_text: A cozy little house, a quiet hostess, and delicious coffee. Enjoy a quiet afternoon while waiting for your car to be washed! P.S.: Both the coffee and the car wash are very cheap!
review_3_text:
A cute and cozy little shop with delicious orange coffee and pastries.
There's a car wash nearby, so you can sit and wait in the cool, comfortable shop.
🌞🏡💖🌻🙆🏼‍♀️🥰💕
review_4_text: Cute shop with a friendly atmosphere.
review_5_text: Good coffee and service

name: Perfect Blend Coffee Roaster(Sanpakoi Branch)
review_1_text: The vendor looks unfriendly, acting like a customer begging for food even though they already paid. The taste is so-so, adding an extra shot of coffee is 20 baht. How expensive. The sign says 10 baht. She talks incoherently. Oh well, I'll pay. I'll only sell it once. This is divine coffee. In short, it's better to go to another shop.
review_2_text: I'd like some coffee, please.

name: Good trip&Co.
review_1_text:
Homemade bakery&coffee ；chill ,cozy , comfy!
Three types of coffee beans!
Love it!
Recommend!
review_2_text: Matcha  so good !
review_3_text: The taste is good and the price is reasonable
review_4_text: Perfect cappuccino and latte art. Smooth coffee and fresh milk. Staff is nice and it's very affordable at 55 bhat for a cappuccino.
review_5_text: The coffee is delicious, the shop is cute, and the owner is friendly. I'll definitely come back again.

name: movo room
review_1_text: Such a cute little cafe in Chiang Mai! The owner (I believe) was SUPER friendly & made such good drinks. We had gotten the matcha latte & Movo latte (vanilla latte) and they were my favorite I’ve had here. I came back two days in a row haha. Recommend checking out this place for all coffee & matcha lovers! 🤍
review_2_text: This is a cute cafe with friendly service. I highly recommend you stop by!

name: แอบ คาเฟ่ - Aebb Cafe
StarWork Chiangmai
review_1_text:
1 day price 300 Thb/ person.
*No drink is included in this price.

In my opinion, a bit pricey for Thai minimum wage.
However, the environment is pretty clean but there are ppl walking around(not sure if they were customers or staff or residents).

Therefore, if you need a privacy, you can go in the office room (it’s already included in the daily price).

Overall I rated 4/5, 1 point missing is for the price (my opinion).
review_2_text: I bought a 1-day pass here for 199 THB (included 1 drink from "Café Amazon" ☕ There are about 15 working desks with comfortable office chairs. The people here worked quietly 👍 (I love it because in other co-working spaces I get annoyed of 20 people talking loudly all the time). At this place I can really focus on my work 👍 There is soft background music so it's not boring. (I hate loud background music at other cafe's). The staff was helpful and spoke excellent English 👍 They close at time 18.00 (like most co-working spaces) ☹
review_3_text: My workplace is wonderful! It's surrounded by greenery and even has a waterfall. We have free meeting rooms, and the people here are really nice.
review_4_text:
I bet this is a great place for co-working if you work 9am-6pm.

If like many remote workers visiting Thailand you have obligations during late evening / early morning hours - do note that the "24 hours access" on the front page of their website is for their "service office" offering only (quoted starting at 1000 THB / day when I visited).

Hot / cold desks and the relatively-cheaper co-working private offices are only available 9-6pm and there is no key card / key code / biometric etc. system for allowing after-hours access as offered by other co-working spaces in Chiang Mai.

4 stars for a beautiful space and a friendly, helpful representative who answered my questions when I arrived in person. -1 star for a wasted trip that could have been saved by a clearer menu of services (and their hours) on the website.
review_5_text: I recommened service office here is super private and cozy. Near 7-11 and cafe Amazon in area not far from Central festival easy to find. Staff are so nice and friendly.

name: Café Amazon
review_1_text:
Friendly service.  Calm space for a coffee.   Comfortable indoor seating, nice deck for outdoor seating.

Iced capuchino tasty, butter cake fresh.
review_2_text: Really nice coffee and friendly staff. A great place to kill time of you're hanging around the bus station.
review_3_text: Nice coffee shop for a quick stop. Small but ok!
review_4_text: I liked that there were power plugs for phones and notebooks. Not even seats though.
review_5_text:
Staff's good
Taste is up-to standard
Environment is great

name: กาแฟนิยม สาขาถนนทุ่งโฮเต็ล Niyomcoffee
review_1_text:
Great vibe & Great coffee!

Had an iced mint latte that was pretty awesome. The happy vibe in this shop is what happens when a proprieter loves what they do and take pride in how they do it.

Here's the extra good, since it's easy to find a great cup of coffee in Chiang Mai. It's the happy vibe.

While being relatively small in size, the walls of windows make the space feel open, warm & inviting. It is a clean, well lighted place.

The seating design has two couches, two countertops, and four tables inside, and two tables under a covered awning for coffee in a garden.

The way the indoor seating is arranged, the comfortable padded seats and tabletop provide islands of privacy in an open space. It's very well thought out. The decor also changes slightly in each mini seating area to further amplify a feeling of separation and privacy in this open setting.

The decor is also funny, happy, and bright. Kids and the kid in you will be moved towards a relaxing mindset to maybe share conversations and coffee with a friend, or doom scroll in search of the end limits of the internet. In either case, this place will add to the happy mood of your activity.

Plenty of parking. Laundry mat across the street, and  Lotus Fresh next door, as well as a wine shop to grab a bottle for later.

10/10 Fantastic!

Im going back for more.
review_2_text: Our favourite coffee shop of Thailand after visiting dozens of others across the country during our month stay. The man working here is a true obsessed barista, great attraction to details whilst creating his art. Atmosphere wonderful. We'll be back.
review_3_text: Just discovered Niyom Coffee in Chiang Mai and wow 🤩 — this place is such a vibe. The coffee is next-level (smooth, rich, and clearly brewed with love), and the café itself has that perfect mix of cozy + minimal that makes you want to hang out all day. The baristas are super friendly and actually take the time to chat about the beans, which makes the whole experience feel personal. Definitely adding this to my “must return” list whenever I need good coffee and a chill spot. ☕✨
review_4_text: I come here regularly. The coffee is well-balanced and satisfying. The staff provides good service. There is parking. The atmosphere in the shop is nice and inviting.
review_5_text: Nice coffee&tea, cozy atmosphere, friendly staff

name: สหายกาแฟ Sahai Cafe' สาขาทุ่งโฮเต็ล
review_1_text:
This is a great coffee shop in Chiang Mai.

The staff is friendly and speaks English.

I got the Ice Cappuccino.  It was delicious 😋

They have a great menu as far as coffee. They have plenty of breakfast snacks. Definitely have the cake and cookies to go with you beverages.

They have plenty of seating with the free wifi. This would be a great spaceto sit and work on the laptop.
review_2_text: Another good coffee shop in Chiang Mai not far from the train station. Many seats & tables available. Standard price. Car park & Toilet available here.
review_3_text: You can choose to sit in the airconditioned section in the Select shop or sit outside in the open air. Nice breeze and green decor but beware of the traffic noise though. Reasonably-priced coffee.
review_4_text:
Great location, very unique taste variety of Coffee & Bakery choices plus snacks, cozy atmosphere
***Affordable Price***

Highly recommended
review_5_text: Amazing place to chill and relax! The Thai tea is great 💖 and the people who work here are super nice! Totally recommend

name: Jiratcha cafe
review_1_text:
This is why you should walk around to find those good eats.

Found this place on my way to get some fried chicken 🍗. Don't judge me.

They are opened from 7am to 5pm. From sandwiches to brownies. From ice latte to fruit sodas.

They do catering and always have specials.

Now, to be totally honest, I don't do runny eggs. Well, I jumped in after a little hesitant.  But winner, winner chicken dinner.

It was so good. I went back today to get their "Signature Sandwich. "
review_2_text: I ordered their food via Food Panda. Their sandwich is amazing! Cream horn is also ideal style... I realized I don't have to give up delicious cream horn in Thailand by it.
review_3_text:
I arrived 9:00 when they should officially open. Almost everything sold out, no sandwiches at all, offered fried chicken (shopee driver help me translate Bc waiter can't speak English at all)
Waiting already 20min, since they processing delivery service first...
review_4_text:
No idea why or how the score on googlemaps is so low.
This place SLAYSSS. Everything I’ve tried here screams quality.
review_5_text: Great food and service, Highly recommended!

name: พี่เล็กกาแฟสด
review_1_text: Very good place to drink a good espresso or a thai coffee
review_2_text: The green tea is delicious.
review_3_text: The coffee is delicious, the Thai tea is also delicious, the price is not expensive.

name: สวักลี คอฟฟี่
ฮักก์ชา สาขา ทุ่งโฮเต็ล
review_1_text: great drinks, good price and friendly staff, next to Lotus so lots of parking space
review_2_text: They offer a wide variety of drinks at affordable prices, and the taste is surprisingly good. Today I tried the Taiwanese brown sugar tea with pearls, and it was incredibly delicious. The tea was fragrant and the pearls were chewy.

name: Coffee Jame Cafe in garden
review_1_text: Amazing place and full of positive energy! The dogs are adorable and very well looked after. They’re free to roam as they wish and quite happily come and sit on your feet if they want some attention. Please visit if you have the time 🙏
review_2_text:
Super friendly, chill and client orientation. Food is very good quality and different side dish day by day - avocado/apple. Very cheap price, and food super quality. Premium salt/pepper/Tabasco, orange 🍊 juice.

I so happy to visit every day.
Thank you for the team of this place

Peace. Big hello from guy who ordering extra bread, 3 eggs and +2 ham + orange juice.
review_3_text: Absolutely delicious! Coffee is great and foot as well. We had pancakes and rice with omelette. A cute little doggy gave as a warmly welcome as well as the owner.
review_4_text: Hidden gem. We went for some lunch and the service and food was fantastic. The staff were friendly. The seating is so cute and they have a little garden you can sit and eat in. I recommend the French toast and vanilla milk.
review_5_text: Very good breakfast. Lovely owner and dog also. 😊

name: FIFTYFOUR COFFEE
review_1_text: Very good.price and drink taste good
review_2_text: Ok
review_3_text: This shop also sells rice and curry. The coffee tastes delicious.
review_4_text: If it's delicious, you have to tell others.
review_5_text: Everything on the menu is delicious and the prices are affordable.

name: HI YOU COFFEE TEA สาขาหน้ากงสุลอเมริกา
review_1_text:
Great customer service.
Quick and easy / great value
review_2_text:
This is a small coffee shop right in front of the newly opened Lotus Go Fresh.
The staff was friendly and the place was clean and well-maintained.
I ordered an Orange Americano, medium roast, and it was clean and delicious.
I also received a coupon for a free drink with eight stamps.
I would definitely come back.

Just a small coffee shop right in front of the newly opened Lotus Go Fresh. The staff are friendly and the place is clean. I ordered an Orange Americano, medium roast, and it was smooth and tasty. I also got a stamp card—8 stamps = 1 free drink. Definitely would come back!
review_3_text: Went to buy at 8:45 AM. The staff were not interested in selling. Called 3 times, busy looking at the phone, even though the sign said it opened at 7:00 AM. It might have been too early so they weren't ready to sell yet.
review_4_text: The coffee is fragrant, tastes good, and is reasonably priced. It's served quickly, and the staff provides good service.
review_5_text: The service was good, and the drinks were delicious.

name: แก้วชา ม.พายัพ
review_1_text: The vendor was polite, the price was very affordable at 20 baht, and it was incredibly delicious and worth more than the price! I really want everyone to try it. Highly recommended! 👍

name: Marblemaei Cafe
review_1_text: Cute little coffee corner inside yok bakery store
review_2_text: The pure matcha is very delicious. It's easy to eat and not bitter at all. However, the price is a bit expensive. The shio bread is crispy on the outside and soft on the inside. There's melted butter inside. It's very fragrant. The staff provides good service. There are tables and a bar to sit at.
review_3_text: Delicious desserts, nice atmosphere.

name: Nine Nine Coffee Bar - ไนน์ ไนน์ คอฟฟี่ บาร์
review_1_text:
Real authentic arabica coffee with range of roasting levels: low/medium/high. All cups are served with double shots that will kick your alertness till sunset 😂. The shop is situated in the middle of Chiang Mai Business Park and they offer all varieties of beverages: hot/cold coffee, non-coffee, and pastries.

Price per cup starts from 40-45 THB.
Super cheap price for their good quality coffee.
Do give this place a chance to kickstart your day. My favorite here is peppermint latte 🥰.
review_2_text: Very nice coffee with good prices and nice open windows. Couldn’t find yet in CM like this kinda cool coffee shops to work. I think after 5pm it turning into to bar. I visited in the rainy morning and enjoyed a lot. Definitely try their Americano with peach.
review_3_text: I really like the iced latte here. I've gotten it twice now and really enjoyed it. The atmosphere is nice. The place smells a bit strange, but I think it's possibly just paint smells.
review_4_text:
Price is  cheaper than others
I am very satisfied with coffee especially Cocoa The  location is near Payap university it's the best place ever
review_5_text: I was disappointed. It says it’s a coffee shop that’s open late, but when I got there, it’s actually more like a bar and they weren’t serving coffee at all. If you are going to be a bar, don’t advertise to be a coffee shop.

name: Not Just Coffee CNX
review_1_text: A lovely small cafe which is near Payap University, the food is not bad, the atmosphere is good! Will try the coffee there next time!
review_2_text:
Amazing food and nice service and atmosphere. We had Baked Spinach with Cheese, Mushroom Cream Soup, Waffle, Roti with extra spinach and cheese, Vietnamese Noodle Pho Bo (Beef), Strawberry Smoothie, Matcha Green Tea.
We can recommend all of it and will be back soon.

Update: As mentioned by the owner I ordered the special dish Roti with extra spinach and cheese again on our second visit. I really recommend it!
review_3_text:
I ordered Iced Vanilla Latte and it was just perfect - the right amount of coffee, milk, and vanilla flavor. The staff was super friendly and offered me a free taste of the Big Toast, which was pretty good too. But my absolute fave was the mixed fruit tart.

The place has a really cozy vibe and they offer free Wi-Fi, which is great if you need to catch up on work. They've got a bunch of food and drinks to choose from. All in all, a great spot to chill and hang out!
review_4_text: Vietnamese beef rice noodles....the soup is too salty. Beef is too hard and tough. Noodles are ready-made. Price 80 baht. Cafe Latte iced 70 baht.
review_5_text: It's a great café. The taste is excellent, and the shop's decoration looks good. The food and service are also great.

name: Cherry Monkey Craft Bar
review_1_text: Great coffee great staff amazing matcha and now with cats.
review_2_text: The location is great, the coffee is aromatic, and the cafe has a beautiful atmosphere. Whenever I visit Chiang Mai, I always make sure to stop by.
review_3_text: Already was here and everything was amazing. But the last time was disappointing. I came 1 hour before closing. The barista was unfriendly, made a to-go drink instead of nice cups they have, even though I didn’t ask for it. No water. Also I chose middle roasting but got the cheapest dark one. Felt like the barista wanted me to leave quickly🥴
review_4_text: Every time I come during the day, the coffee in this shop is very good. I like whisky coffee best.
review_5_text:
You can choose your favorite coffee beans and place an order.
First of all, the coffee is delicious, and the place stands out with its spacious seating and cool air conditioning.

name: Nine Nine Car Protection Center ศูนย์บริการติดฟิล์มใสกันรอย เคลือบแก้ว
review_1_text: Nine Nine was very helpful explaining the product and services. I was told to show up on Monday and it would take 4 hours to apply the Ceramic Coating 3 layer 10H+. When I came back at 12pm, the car looks stunning and had the shine coat all over. The inside was all clean without a speck of dust. I am very happy and will return for the follow up check after 6 months.  Good job Nine Nine!
review_2_text: Good car washing service Fast and clean, delicious coffee and croissants.
review_3_text: The best car wash , ceramic coating and film protect in Doi saket district. Amazing service and quality. There’s also a cafe right next to the car wash area. Which is very convenient. Great value for money for a good service.
review_4_text: Reasonably priced, did washing inside and outside and they did a good job for my car. Have a nice AC cafe for customers to wait while the car is getting clean. Will definitely visit again.
review_5_text: delicious coffee, pleasant and air-conditioned place and the greatest company of a dog 🐶

name: Chiangmai Christian International Library
review_1_text: Good place to study and read book! Nice service.
review_2_text: This is the space that helped me the most during my month-long stay in Chiang Mai. It has many great books for children and adults, and a recently opened cafe makes it a great place to read with your children. Regardless of religious affiliation, you are worthy of respect for your continued support of Korean residents. Thank you so much for everything you've done.
review_3_text: This library is Chiang Mai's only Korean-style library operated on a membership basis. Upon joining, you pay a one-time annual fee and gain free library access for one year. You can borrow books, use the bookshelves during library hours, and even study at the book café.
review_4_text:
It feels like a collection of only foreign books, so it's actually better than libraries in Korea.
There are so many books!
There are not only Korean books, but also books in English, Chinese, and Thai, so it's incredibly diverse.
There's a separate children's area, which moms like me are simply grateful for.
review_5_text:
The annual fee is cheap, making it more economical than studying at a cafe. Cafes usually offer drinks, but with an annual fee, you can study there anytime and spend your time comfortably. It's highly recommended. There's also parking available.

(Note: The repeated "ประจำปีราคาถูก" translates to "The annual fee is cheap, so it's more economical than studying at a cafe. Cafes usually offer drinks, but if you pay an annual fee, you can study there anytime and spend your time comfortably. It's highly recommended. There's also parking available.")

name: Minimal Coffee
review_1_text:

I usually stop by the Tha Phae branch. The guy at Tha Phae is very polite and attentive to customers. This branch has a lot of international customers and accepts cash.
Yesterday, I was going to the CMU branch, and a female employee said, "Give me this one chance, pay in cash."
That wasn't a nice comment. I understand that this is the system; they don't accept cash.

name: ChaTraMue
review_1_text: ChaTraMue at the CMU Main Food Court is a must-try spot for tea lovers! Famous for its Thai iced tea, this place serves a rich and flavorful drink that is perfect to cool down during a hot day. The tea is creamy, sweet, and has just the right balance of flavors, making it a favorite among students and visitors alike. Besides the signature tea, ChaTraMue also offers a selection of other beverages, from milk teas to fruit-based drinks, all served in generous portions. The convenient location in the heart of the university's food court makes it an easy stop for a refreshing break between classes. It's an ideal place to relax and enjoy a delicious drink while soaking in the busy campus atmosphere.
review_2_text: Bad customer service
review_3_text:
The advantages are that there's a Cha Tra Mue tea shop in CMU, and they offer a wide variety of teas, including vegan and low-calorie healthy options.

⚠️However, the disadvantage is that the staff is very rigid in making milk tea according to their recipe. I ordered a less-sweet milk tea, and when I asked how many ml of condensed milk to use for a typical less-sweet order, the staff member said it had to be measured in a cup without specifying their "less-sweet" recipe. I didn't ask further because their answer wasn't direct.

When I received the tea, it was still quite sweet. Normally, when I order less-sweet drinks, I only ask for about 10-15 ml of syrup or condensed milk. But at this shop, "less-sweet" was probably equivalent to adding about 25-30 ml of condensed milk.

I went back to ask the staff member how much sweetness they had added, but I didn't get an answer. So I asked if it would be possible to ask for even less sweetness next time.

The staff member looked confused (probably wondering how to answer) and replied, "It's possible, but we have to follow the recipe."

So we asked again, "Isn't it just a matter of reducing the amount of condensed milk?" The staff member hesitated and replied that if other branches knew that this branch adjusted the sweetness level to "less sweet" as requested by customers, it would undermine their standards. Otherwise, customers would have to choose the "unsweetened" option... But...🙄

In short, this branch cannot adjust the sweetness level to customer preferences. One visit is enough.

review_1_text: The cafe is cute and it gives you more private space and atmosphere if you don’t like dining out in public. Plus, the owner is so friendly, kind and makes your eating space comfortable.
review_2_text: This is my go-to shop. The coffee is good, high-quality, and reasonably priced. They have a wide variety of drinks to choose from. The shop has a Japanese theme, and they play music and decorate according to the seasons. The owner is very friendly, and they also sell some fried snacks.
review_3_text: The shop moved from the female dormitory 1 (already demolished) to the male dormitory 6. The shop is closed every Monday. It is a cafe that sells rice dishes and steamed bread as a dessert. The tea menu is considered common except for the matcha which is easy to drink and has a fragrant milky smell for 35 baht. I have not tried the cocoa menu. I have not tried the coffee yet, but the menu with milk is delicious and fragrant and just the right amount. The shop does not have black pearls, but will have konjac pearls instead. If you want to add them, the price will be an additional 5 baht. As for the food, the ramen costs 35 baht, the noodles are soft and the toppings are delicious, especially the Naruto. The soup is considered normal. As for the chicken karaage rice, it is very delicious. You can choose the sauce. I personally chose the tonkatsu sauce, which is delicious. The rice is soft and not soggy. The vegetables are fresh. The fried chicken is fragrant, crispy, and not oily for 35 baht. The shop does not have special orders, but you can ask for more when ordering, for example, 1 chicken and 1 rice, the price will increase to 55 baht. The shop owner is good, smiling, and friendly. There is a point collection system via Line. The shop is small but has a good atmosphere and is clean, but there may be a few ants at the counter (I have never seen any ants in the water or food). There are seats both inside and outside the shop.

Cozy Cafe near Chiangmai Uni. If you are looking for somewhere to keep yourself calm and isolate I would definitely recommend this Cafe.
I also love iced coffee with orange and cake's varieties are very fantastic.
And of course, prices are friendly to student.
review_4_text:
I walked in this simple ,neat and super chill place for morning  coffee.
I had a cup of latte, it was great with reasonable price . The doggy in the shop was also cute.
review_5_text: The best coffee place in Chaing Mai! Relaxed place and the staff are so friendly. Coffee was phenomenal and offers alternatives like oat milk for people with allergies! ☕️⭐️

name: Fresh&Mild since 1992 @Acc-BA CMU
review_1_text: Not bad~ It tastes better when eaten with the food in the cafeteria
review_2_text: Really delicious. The fresh milk is really good.
review_3_text: The atmosphere is great.

name: แรดมากCoffee
review_1_text: My go to coffee spot in Chiangmai. I’m here several times per week. Value for money the best that I’ve found,  the owners are super friendly and the hot cappuccino is solid at 40 baht. It’s more of a stand but there’s some outside seating and a bathroom if you want to stay for a while. Highly recommend.
review_2_text:
I come here every day to have coffee, Matcha, Thai tea ..everything 😂

New is such a lovely person and the drinks are really good. Thanks to her 💛
review_3_text: Coffee beans and method of extracting coffee is very delicious. Service by Khun New was fast, professional, and super-clean. Love this cafe!!
review_4_text: Great dark roast Cappuccino and Es Yen. Highly reccomend if you’re around!
review_5_text: Very good! And the owner was nice and told me about where his beans come from in Thailand. Will go back.

name: Wake Cup Café
review_1_text: A small coffee shop located infront of 7-11 store. The coffee shop looks normal from the outside but their coffee , tea and soda taste very good. The price is a bit lower than average but the quality exceed the price. The waiting time for 1 drink is around 5-10 minutes. You can park near the coffee shop.
review_2_text: A take out only coffee store right in front of a seven eleven. Coffee here is 40thb regardless of ice/hot or type. The portion seems a bit more than other cafes.
review_3_text: Best coffee in Chiang Mai! The place was right around the corner from our Airbnb so we stopped here on a whim- WOW we’re glad we did. I got an iced latte 4 days in a row because it was so good. It’s prepared fresh for you while you wait. I love this place!
review_4_text: Unassuming coffeeshop at the corner of the road, right next to 7-Eleven and Chiang Mai Holistic. Owner Palm obviously takes great pride in his work and during my 10mins of waiting, I could tell he was very invested in making sure of the quality of his coffee. Good quality and reasonably priced (most are just around 40 baht). Was one of my best finds in Chiang Mai.
review_5_text: The best price performance ratio cappuccino I have found anywhere. Quality almost on par with Ristr8tto, for less than half the price.

name: Brunch Boxx
review_1_text: I ordered take out and the pancakes are burnt and butter is completely melted. Who eats burned pancakes with melted butter? Plus, the pancakes are too dry. They put an apology note but what is the point? Big restaurant and no accountability
review_2_text: The sandwich is taste sooooo good!! Drink is great 🫶🏻👍🏻
review_3_text: Tuna eggs sandwich with cafe latte, that’s made me a day❤️
review_4_text: Nice coffee with good price, I always order from food delivery app in the morning. the recommended menu is Tuna Cheese Egg Sandwich, Yummy :)
review_5_text: Yummy Breakfast! Reasonable Price  👍🏻

name: WAN-WI COFFEE
review_1_text: The green tea is delicious! Sweet, creamy, and perfectly balanced. This is the place to go! 🥰
review_2_text: The coffee is really good. The taste is okay, just like in expensive shops. 😆😆
review_3_text:
Today, I'm recharging with an iced coffee from Tom's Coffee ☕️.
I have to say, "It's amazing!" The flavor is rich, the coffee aroma is fragrant, and it's not too sweet.
It's refreshing, perfect for a long workday.
If you're near this shop, stop by and give it a try. I highly recommend it 💯
review_4_text: A cute little coffee bar. The owner is super friendly. The green tea is fragrant and delicious. The peach soda tea is also great. 😋😋
review_5_text: I had the opportunity to try the cold milk. It was very delicious. The sweetness was just right, well-balanced, and the colors were beautiful. The shop was clean and looked very appetizing.

name: ROASTRYN COFFEE BAR
review_1_text:
Recently moved to this new location. Counter seating only.

Great coffee and the gentleman spoke English so communication is not an issue.

My fresh brewed cappuccino was 45baht

Right to 7-11 so easy parking.
review_2_text:
I went there because it opened early in the morning.
The coffee was also excellent.
Thanks to you, I started my morning off right.
review_3_text: All menus are 45 baht, and the coffee is from Chiang Mai, very strong and fragrant (chocolate flavor). The owner is friendly and chatty haha.
review_4_text: I had the orange smoothie coffee for the first time, and wow, it was delicious. The strong coffee and orange smoothie go so well together. The owner speaks English well and is very friendly. I hope you have a great time 👍 👍
review_5_text: Excellent coffee! Great selection and nicely laid out. A very friendly man who puts in a lot of effort.

name: Ristr8to Original
review_1_text:
Hot mocha is a must order. Sg mocha is very milky but theirs is house blend.

This one hits different.

Make sure you finish every single drop before you leave.

The barista here is better than SG one in general. Taste the coffee and you’ll know.

My brother in law ordered the cigaretto and he said it’s nice. You can try it if you want.

If you duno what is what, the menu has the coffee description.

One thing I really kennut is the barista face is way too near to my coffee -.-
Almost breathing into it when doing yo my order: As shown in photo. But whatever.

You can get coffee beans here as well. Haven’t tried it but you can ask the staff for recommendations.

You can even request to smell the beans before getting it.

Atmosphere is just meh, normal cafe nothing special. Enjoy the coffee and move to next cafe.
review_2_text: With many cafes in Nimman to choose from, Ristr8to has become a firm favourite of mine. I’ve become partial to a Cortado and have to admit I’ve never been let down here. Smooth and strong its made with care and attention. With wonderfully friendly staff, it’s nice to have somewhere I can call my local cafe. There’s a lovely ambiance that allows one to sit back, drink nice coffee and let the world drift by. Based on my own experience I can recommend Rist8to.
review_3_text: Extensive menu with almost every variety of coffee you can imagine. Tried some of the popular favorite and agree that the coffee is good. Pretty chill ambience with both indoor and outdoor seating. They do have a few food options like waffles but wish there was more. Place only accepts cash.
review_4_text: I first visited this place 9 years ago, and I’m amazed that they’ve managed to maintain the exact same high standards. The latte art is still as unique and beautiful as ever—truly their signature. The vibe is incredible no matter when you visit; it's the perfect spot for a morning caffeine fix, a late brunch, or a relaxing evening coffee.
review_5_text:
Extensive coffee menu, well laid out and with informative detail. Limited seating inside with air conditioning and some outside. Nice ambiance with rustic decor with relaxed music. Can be very busy so not a place to work. Would return and highly recommend.

No credit cards, only QR or cash.

name: Lot of Taste
review_1_text:
A much overrated place.

I first tried their cloud latte (130baht). It was simply an iced latte made from decent doi Chang coffee bean, with a low-quality coconut ice cream on top. And both elements had zero synergy in flavors.

Later i decided it to give it a second try since it features quite a few very interesting beans. I ordered a passion-fruit-fermented black (120baht). As opposed to most fruit-enzyme-processed bean which taste exceptionally fruity and characteristic of the fruit used, it was average at best.

And the barista in the afternoon and night gave me different info about their coffee, which is not a sign of well-trained staff.

At a higher-end price in Chiang Mai, this does not meet the cut.
review_2_text: The coffee was delicious, and the cake was equally good! Perhaps it’s popular because the place is showing signs of wear and tear. I’d love to return for the coffee.
review_3_text: This coffee shop demonstrates a clear commitment to exceptional coffee brewing and minimal space design. It has attracted a significant number of patrons, both local and international, and benefits from its proximity to the prominent and bustling Nimmanhaemin Road. However, a notable concern arises regarding the placement of the designated smoking area, which is situated near the public pavement. The proximity of this area allows cigarette smoke to disperse, potentially affecting pedestrians and motorcyclists passing by. I urge the owner of this establishment to consider their social responsibility in this matter, as the current arrangement may negatively impact the health of others. While the coffee quality is commendable, individuals prioritizing social responsibility may wish to re-evaluate their patronage of this establishment.
review_4_text: Nice cafe and atmosphere. It’s perfect to just sit and relax with your coffee outside especially in the cool season. Friendly staff and quick service.
review_5_text: I had a flat white with oat milk take away - great coffee, good vibes of the cafe. I didn't get a chance to chill at the cafe, but it looked good, modern and reasonably priced. My coffee was 80 plus 20 for oat milk. They didn't have any vegan foods/bakery to offer which was a con, but good overall.

name: Mont Nomsod Chiangmai
review_1_text: Quite crowded during night time and we had this at 9pm with lots of table occupied. Order the pandan and egg custard toast which is 2 of their famous one. Taste is very good and pair with their famous chocolate milk or pink milk is out of the world. Service is pretty fast less than 5 minutes I have my order ready. You can sit outside or inside to enjoy your toast. Overall worth it and price is not expensive.
review_2_text:
This was a nice little stop for dessert after dinner. They had the usual and traditional flair of steamed and toasted bread with variations of toppings.  There was a steady flow of people so the wait for a table and the food isn’t long. It faces the main road on Nimman so it was a nice little area to people watch after a long day of walking.
Nice stop to fill up the space you saved for dessert.
review_3_text: We were walking on the street and saw crowd. Just tried without having any expectations. It’s surprisingly very good. Love it. It’s more than just a toasted bread.
review_4_text:
Seems to be very popular for locals (most of the customers here were speaking Thai)

Tried the steamed bread w pandan custard. Tasted quite good but a tad too sweet for me.

I’d like to try the other items on their menu next time.
review_5_text: I walked in curious because of the long queue , and left regretting it. The cleanliness was unacceptable , hair on the floor, sticky and dirty surfaces. Dirty plates next to us were left on the table for over 20 minutes. When the staff finally came to clean our table specifically , he looked annoyed, picked up previous customer trash , and didn’t even bother wiping the table.  We had to clean it ourselves with tissues ! The service was shockingly rude , easily the worst I’ve experienced in Thailand. On top of that, the chairs were so uncomfortable they gave us back pain. As for the toast , completely normal. Nothing special to offer.

name: Starbucks Nimmanhemin Soi 9
review_1_text:
This is one of my best Starbucks experiences in Thailand. The staff is very nice, the quality of my brewed coffee great and the atmosphere in the store is quiet and relaxing.
I could choose between four different coffee beans and they dripped the coffee in front of me having a nice conversation, more like at a bar. The staff really seems to love what they do. Thank you.
review_2_text:
Nice service with good quality coffee
There are many tables and seats. If you like to sit privately there is the 2nd floor space
review_3_text: The staffs here are nice and polite. Fluent in English. 4 parking spaces for car . The old man at the parking lot is a bit annoying though, moody all the time .
review_4_text: I’m visiting Chiang Mai and have been to this branch twice during my trip. The staff are very nice, helpful, and friendly. They recommended the drip coffee, and it tasted amazing. The atmosphere is cozy, with charming northern-style decorations. Highly recommend!
review_5_text: Disclaimer that I'm not a Starbucks fan. I gave it another try again here because the location looked nice and I wanted to know for sure that there's plant milk. It really is a nice place to sit and the staff are very nice. I ordered a hot Houjicha Latte w soy milk, no sugar. The drink was more on the warm than hot side, not very flavorful and really sweet, maybe sugar was added? Also really big size even for smallest order.

name: Toffee Roasters
review_1_text:
THB70 for the quickest Iced Americano in the world. While it doesn't seem like there would be a lot of space for you to stay, it's highly recommended for those who need their coffee right away and have somewhere else to go.

I'm not fancy enough to go connoisseur with beans so whatever the house blends is fine with me.
review_2_text:
Great coffee, we tried 1 hot filter & 1 dirty. One of the best dirty coffee i've tried during our trip in Thailand (i tried at least 20 dirty in every coffeeshop 😆).
The hot filter is clean & good acidity.
review_3_text: Great place to experience high standard quality coffee. They are knowledgeable of coffee culture beyond just serving coffee beverages, and we talked about Ethiopian coffee varieties. The almond orange cake was fresh and full of flavours. Congrats!
review_4_text:
Rating: 100/10!
The service and staff are super lovely! 🩷

This café offers free water (love that 😆).
Drinks are good:
•	Green tea — mild and a bit seaweed-like, not bitter.
•	Orange juice — just okay.
•	Banana bread — tasty and not too sweet!

Reasonable price and highly recommended!🫶
review_5_text:
The coffee hit all the right notes - just excellent, smooth with the right amount of boldness. Best coffee I’ve had so far. And, the team there is so nice! No wonder the place is full of people!

Edit: we have been to a few other places and no other shop compares for the coffee, staff, community vibe. Best coffee shop in Chiang Mai.

name: Morestto
review_1_text:
5-star in all aspects: food, service ambiance!

We went for coffee and snacks. Also needed a cake for our daughter’s birthday celebration.

Both the cappuccino and Matcha were delicious. The cake with painting option, too, was really scrumptious. The baker was very friendly and skilled. Last but not the least: the location is so convenient and beautiful.
review_2_text: This coffee shop is disappointing. Their coffee is unevenly brewed, and the coffee liquid tastes like water. The Thai food they serve is also the most mediocre I've had in many days. Many people come here just to take photos of the environment. If you want to enjoy a delicious cup of coffee and a tasty meal, I wouldn't recommend coming here.
review_3_text:
A cute spot, nicely decorated for Christmas.
I ordered the choux custard and a dirty coffee, both of which were tasty.
My partner ordered a regular coffee and i didn't like the taste at all
review_4_text:
There are too many cafes in Nimman!
But glad we found this one, easily the best space so far, great design and it's easy to relax. Great prices and service. They got meals and snacks too.
review_5_text:
Loved painting my cake at Morestto Cafe it was delicious! The Thai tea was rich and tasty. 🎂✨

Staff gave great recommendations and were super friendly. Cozy cafe with plenty of plugs-highly recommend! 🥰

name: Uncle Kani
review_1_text: The ambiance is great, the cats are super well-behaved, and all the staff members adore them. The food here is delicious too—especially the beef, which is perfectly tender, and it only costs 190 baht, such a great deal! The grilled salmon is a bit overcooked, but the rice is fragrant and tasty. I’ll definitely come back just for the beef.
review_2_text: Tranquil atmosphere, with nice music not a large menu (which is a good sign), the food was delicious and the steak meat was grilled medium rare in my dish, I also had the egg on top. It had a great chilled ambience too. At the end when going to pay they have free cat stickers 😂, unique little spot and a bit of a gem in Chiang Mai. Highly recommend. I think we will be coming back ! I want to check out their coffee!
review_3_text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

Uncle Kani is a lovely, quiet spot in Chiang Mai. One of the highlights is their three super cute cats which make the place feel extra cozy and welcoming.

The food is great — we really enjoyed the beef fried rice, steak, and salad. Everything was tasty and affordable. We actually went there twice during our stay,and the second visit was even better. The rice came out hotter and the overall flavor was improved.✔️

If you’re looking for a calm place with good food and a relaxedmosphere (plus adorable cats), Uncle Kani is definitely worth a visit
review_4_text:
A small restaurant that serves delicious food. Very specialised menu. Location is a bit tucked away in a local neighbourhood.

The food is great and cooked perfectly. Portion was a bit small so I would recommend to upgrade the beef and tallow fried rice.

Tables are limited, and they frequenly sell out their menu. So arrive early. Also it is a place to enjoy your meal but not to linger since other people will be waiting for your seat.
review_5_text:
lovely place & lovely comfort food! i went here for dinner with my husband & ordered the beef fat fried rice, hashbrown, aus ribeye, peach tea, ginger ale, and the caramel custard thing (shaped heart, so cute). all are tastes nice!

bonus: they had 2 lovely cats hehe. as a cat lover, this is like +10000000 aura! must visit when you are in chiang mai.

name: Blue Coffee At Nimman
review_1_text:
Finally some good coffee again like being back in Vietnam!
Even Thailand has also a great coffee culture, you can feel its more for faran (foreigners), but this cafe here is a game changer.
This coffee, especially the medium beans, taste like a real yummy coffee!
Cappuccino hot for 80 baht is not cheap but consider that taste and its a well worthy coffee.
10/10 definitely recommend with a nice outside seating.
review_2_text: Great spot for a coffee. I tried their blue latte which was very good. I like the vibe here and definitely I place I would come back to for another coffee. The service is great too
review_3_text: Decent coffee shop on the main road in Nimman. The coffee is ok. Not the best one in the neighborhood but ok. The staff was very nice. They have indoor seating as well as a terrace. Prices are ok. Standard for the area. I paid 80 Baht for a cappuccino. Looks like they have several places across Bangkok and Chiang Mai.
review_4_text: I am a regular at a few cafés in the area, Blue being one of them. It is open until 1 AM which suits me perfectly when I just feel like being out and around other people at night. Staff is excellent. I really enjoy the coffee, maybe my favorite in the area. It’s also got a bit of a unique vibe with a nice mix of local young people, students, and westerners like me.
review_5_text:
Great little coffee spot! ☕️

Had an iced black coffee for just 65฿ – super refreshing 🧊Also tried the piccolo, which was smooth and well-balanced. Loved that you can choose your own beans – such a nice touch!

Bonus: they had decaf options too!! 🎉

Will definitely be back! 😊

name: 8days Cafe
review_1_text:
This café on Nimmanhaemin Road in Chiang Mai has a quiet, peaceful atmosphere with a subtle Japanese-style design. The space feels calm and relaxing, making it a place I instantly fell in love with.

I visited with a friend and we ordered their signature green tea, priced at 150 baht. The flavor was rich and well-balanced, with a smooth, deep taste that felt very comforting. It was clear that a lot of care went into the quality of the tea.

The café is also very photogenic—every corner looks great in photos—yet it never feels noisy or crowded. It’s an ideal spot to slow down, enjoy a drink, and spend some quiet time with friends. I truly enjoyed being here and would happily come back again.
review_2_text: The Vanilla Sour beer is to die for: flavorful, crisp, and very refreshing.  The staff are great hosts and the menu features local Thai Cuisine.  A short walk from the Silver Temple or a Tuk-tuk from the airport.  Worth it!
review_3_text: This place is absolutely fantastic. Not only is there coffee amazing but they pass all the vibe checks. Super cool design inside and out and you can just tell they put a lot of creativity into their work. I really appreciate this coffee shop and will be back again for another iced Americano.
review_4_text: Amazing little cafe. Cosy and chill with good coffee and good pricey. Great place to get some work done! All coffee is solid
review_5_text: Very good coffee! Delicious desserts! Excellent service and very nice ambiance. You can seat inside with the air conditioning or outside for the fresh air. You can come alone to work or come with friends to enjoy the coffee and the atmosphere!

name: JULIET.cnx
review_1_text:
Cute store with lovely flowers in the front. Greek yogurt was also nice but absolutely tiny portion, so don't go expecting a meal size - more of a snack.

Had an orange americano which was also really good! Recommend if you're looking for something light.

Only a small seating area
review_2_text: Great hangout spot, a hidden gem. The croffle was amazing, should've asked for more honey 😔. Staff is really friendly too. 10/10 would visit again for the yogurt.
review_3_text: Greek yogurt croffle is gooddddd. The store is so small. There are a few table outside but the weather is too hot to sit chilly. The vibes are good despite the weather. There are free parking lots near the store.
review_4_text:
Such a lovely café
I ordered a berry glazed smoothie, and it was super fresh and nice!
review_5_text: One of the best Greek yogurt bowl I’ve ever tried, delicious and amazing price, I think this is a very special Greek yogurt because of the taste it’s kinda different from others, in my opinion this one is even more delicious, the place it’s beautiful, very peaceful and cozy, it feels like home, the girl who works there is very friendly and makes the bowls very quickly, I completely recommend the place❤️

name: The Barisotel by The Baristro
review_1_text:
