Walked into this cafe and instantly felt like I stepped into a dream. The all-white theme is surreal and calming, perfect for both relaxing and working. I had the English breakfast, which was genuinely authentic and satisfying, followed by a cappuccino and an espresso shot both were spot on.

I spent around 3–5 hours upstairs working and the vibe was quiet, peaceful, and very Instagrammable. Though the Wi-Fi lagged a bit at times, the overall experience was still excellent. Would totally come back for the aesthetic, the food, and the chill atmosphere.
review_2_text:
THIS IS FOR THE COFFEE SHOP

A hostel and coffee shop combined - something you see quite often in Nimman, and very convenient. They offer a good selection of different coffee roasts and also sell beans to take home. I tried one of the pastries as well and really enjoyed it.

There’s seating both indoors and outdoors, with the outdoor area being my clear preference. The atmosphere inside feels a bit stiff, but overall it’s a nice spot for good coffee and a relaxed break.
review_3_text:
I come here almost every day. Work gets done very efficiently, and the staff are extremely kind and thoughtful.
The Wi-Fi connection is stable, and the white-themed décor gives it a stylish feel.
The entrance has a distinctly Japanese aesthetic, and the matcha is served in the traditional Japanese style, making it feel as though I’m in Japan.
review_4_text:
Beautiful Spot, Disappointing Food Quality

I visited today with a friend after high recommendations, and while the venue is absolutely beautiful and highly photogenic, the food was a big letdown.
Our items were stale and tasted old. My friend’s scone was dry and crumbling. My House Roti was mainly whipped cream and didn't taste fresh. The quality was far below cheaper street food options. We left both plates unfinished.
Sadly, I won't be returning unless the quality of the pastries and desserts drastically improves
review_5_text:
Review the café, not the hotel.
Food itself was quite good overall.
Staff can improve in the service itself though and even make a buck out of it. Adapting small things that are not on the menu won't hurt really

name: CHARLIE THAI TEA x KAME KAFE - Nimman Soi9
review_1_text:
Go grab a tea here.. like yesterday 😅

I'm usually not a fan of expensive "Instagram cafes", but this one is worth the price tag!
They have a wiiiiide variety of different teas (including green tea, red tear, black tea, Cylon etc) all regionally sourced within Thailand.

They also have a ton of super nice looking and even more delicious Thai tea creation! You'll chosose yiur own tea, vrewing time and sweetness. Really worth testing it out

Unfortunately, they do not offer non-dairy milk options (no oat, almond or other plant based  milk), otherwise this would have been an easy 5 stars for me
review_2_text: This is the best Thai tea I’ve had in Thailand so far! When you order the Soft Latte Thai Tea, you can choose the type of tea leaves you want, which makes it even better. The tea aroma comes through gently in the drink, and it tastes amazing. I also added an espresso shot to the Mint Choco Latte, and it was incredibly good too! If you’re a mint-choco lover, I highly recommend it!
review_3_text:
Cute cafe in the Nimman neighbourhood that serves up incredible Thai milk teas.
They have the option to customise which tea (which you can also smell before you order), sweetness level and brew time to decide how intense the tea flavour is.
We went with the servers recommendations and opted for the OG and the Charlie with the Chiang Rai Gold and Songkhla tea options. 50% sweetness was more than enough for us (probably would choose 25% sweetness in the future). Would highly recommend both drinks as a cute relaxing cafe date.
review_4_text:
My experience here was honestly frustrating.

When ordering, the staff appeared disengaged and unhelpful. The counter area is extremely cramped — it barely fits one person to look at the menu and smell the tea leaves. The shop only has 13 seats (7 small tables), and there is no clear system for seating. Some customers look for seats first, others order first, but the staff provides no guidance at all.

As a result, after we ordered, we had nowhere to sit. This confusion also led to our drinks being served to the wrong table — they were given to customers who ordered after us but found seats first. After a while, the staff realized the mistake and simply brought the drinks over to us. Honestly, would you feel comfortable drinking something that had already been sitting on someone else’s table????

There is also no self-service return area for finished drinks, and staff were not proactive about clearing used cups. When we finally sat down, two of the six seating groups were occupied by new customers sitting with leftover cups and trays still on the tables — that’s one-third of the seating area. At one point, a customer had already finished their drink but continued occupying a table while four people waited. The staff made no effort to coordinate or manage the situation.

The drinks themselves are okay, but the purchasing and seating process is chaotic and poorly managed. There’s really no reason to endure this kind of experience for a shop that serves “okay” Thai milk tea. Compared to Khiri Thai Tea in Bangkok, the difference in organization and customer experience is significant.
review_5_text: The atmosphere is wonderful. Thai tea here is truly unique, and don’t forget to add the cream cheese, it’s the perfect combination. If you’re someone who loves to relax and enjoy a slow pace, this is a great place to chill.

name: The Larder Cafe & Bar
review_1_text:
If you ask any real local person they’d say this place is the best place for brunch! Ive been coming here for years and the food + service have always been top notched.

My to go is the parmesan scramble egg because it’s super rich & creamy so much so that it melts in your mouth sometimes. You wouldnt be able to find a better egg than this. Their veggies and tomatoes are fresh & sweet too.

Other bake goods are also nice. Their scones have the half scone half biscuit texture which for me is really addictive haha

Anyway, it’s the most perfect place to start your day in CNX!
review_2_text:
Tasty dishes with fresh and quality ingredients.

Still one of my reco places for brunch in Chiangmai.

French toast with mixed fruits today was the best!!!
review_3_text:
So good I had to come back twice!
Portion was huge, coffee was good, the cats were a nice surprise. Just a cool cafe around the neighbourhood ❤️
review_4_text: Quaint cafe with a resident cat that might come sit at your table if you're lucky. Food is great and you need to order the sourdough bread they get fresh daily.
review_5_text: Well prepared brunch. Good service also fast. Waitresses are attentive and well trained. I would dine here again.

name: Starbucks reserve Nimman soi3
review_1_text:
Starbucks Reserve on Nimman Soi 3 is a very cozy and inviting place. If you are walking around One Nimman, it is just a short walk to enjoy your favorite coffee here.

The staff are friendly and always smiling, making the atmosphere even more pleasant. The coffee quality is excellent, on par with what you would find in the U.S.

It is a great spot whether you come alone or with friends, as there is plenty of comfortable seating.

Dr. Niwech
review_2_text: Enjoyable experience at this Starbucks Reserve location in Chiang Mai. The space is well-designed with a good selection of coffees. A warmer welcome from the staff would have enhanced the visit. ☕️
review_3_text:
This is a really beautiful coffee shop.  They have some small batch coffees and drinks that are specific to Starbucks reserve.

There is a large area upstairs that is a nice place to work or have a meeting.
review_4_text: Baristas here provide warm service. Love the vibe in the whole place. Coffee is of the same standards of course.
review_5_text: Very cozy cafe at Nimmana Haeminda Road, Starbucks reserve Nimman soi.3. There are some alcohol options like espresso martini highly recommended. Overall atmosphere is calm and gorgeous. Very easy to find its location.

name: yesterday cafe'
review_1_text: One of the best-designed cafés in Chiang Mai with truly excellent coffee. The space is beautifully curated and thoughtfully detailed, and the location is perfect. The owner is incredibly sweet and welcoming. God is truly in the details here—don’t miss exploring their hotel right next to the café as well. A must-visit!
review_2_text:
Me and my husband come here twice a week, and we truly love this coffee shop. It’s the best one open at night, and we always enjoy our visits.

However, today we ordered our usual drinks — the hot chocolate and the almond chocolate — and unfortunately both were disappointing. The cocoa drink was tasteless, and the almond chocolate had very little chocolate flavor. This has never happened before.

As regular customers, we really hope the owner pays attention to this issue because we don’t want to lose such a great place.
review_3_text: You can pick and choose your own beans. The flat white was decent, nothing special. The Thai milk tea was alright. Good place to work! The road outside gets busy and noisy, so while the patio is nice, not very conducive. Nice service staff. Indoor seating is chilly. Pretty expensive drinks for the area.
review_4_text:
Something magical about this place because I was mysteriously pulled in while walking past the cafe. ❤️

I knew it was going to be good as soon as I saw the design, the architecture, the old wood, and the coffee bar inside. I was immediately greeted by the manager who was very helpful and informative. I don't usually choose coffee bars, but this one is special. After 5 minutes of learning about their slow drip process and the different coffees they offered, I chose the Ethiopian bean.

They take their time and bring you what you need to enjoy the coffee. The Ethiopian blend was amazing. Exactly as described. I drank it without any sugar or cream. I had to have the chocolate croissant.

The seating is comfortable. The atmosphere is relaxing and great for meetings, couples, or by yourself. You don't hear a lot of street noise if you sit inside. I can tell that it would be fun to sit outside in the evenings when it's cooler and you can watch people walk by.

I definitely found a great cafe and will come back. I highly recommend this place if you are picky about coffee and want to experience something different than your average coffee shop. The cost is worth the visit. You are paying for quality and ambience as well as for great service.
review_5_text:
Coffee is awsome ( I had a hot latte with Harmony blend) but the bakery was awful…
So recommend to enjoy only COFFEE

name: Stoic cafe & Brunch
review_1_text: A charming, small Scandinavian-style coffee shop with a warm and inviting atmosphere. The minimalist interior feels cozy and calm, making it an ideal place to unwind or enjoy a slow morning. The bagel is a standout — fresh, flavorful, and thoughtfully prepared. The scrambled eggs are incredibly delicious: soft, creamy, and perfectly seasoned. The coffee is excellent, rich in flavor and clearly made with care. The service is friendly and attentive, which really elevates the whole experience. A lovely spot that’s absolutely worth visiting
review_2_text:
Great coffee and matcha but the food is a hit and miss. We tried the salmon avocado toast (so good!) and the avocado egg toast (meh - was very undersalted).

The place is cute and boutique so they charge more than usual places. Parking is a challenge on is street so try to walk or bike it.

Come here for the coffee!
review_3_text: wandered in based off the enticing photos. Small shop with ac and limited, outside seating on some small uncomfortable stools. Prepare your translation app and be prepared to wait a while. Enjoyed my cappuccino but honestly all the food fell short. I ordered avocado egg bagel and it was so bland and the bagel so dry. Copious amounts of salt and pepper was needed and it still was flavorless… I tried to revive the dish by ordering extra tomatoes 35 thb and feta 40 thb. The food does not taste as good as it looks! Definitely pass on this place, there are so many better places at this price point with better food, ambience and service.
review_4_text: Stoic Cafe is definitely worth checking out on Nimman Road. We really enjoyed the Nutella crepe! It’s made in a classic French crepe style: light, delicate, and not too sweet. Easy to enjoy with coffee.  They also serve  a lovely homemade bagel with plenty of options.
review_5_text:
We love this café!
The electro vibe and Scandinavian minimalist decor make it such a great spot in Nimman.

The homemade bagel is hands down the best I’ve had in Chiang Mai, the ingredients are top quality and the seasoning is just perfect. It honestly made our brunch today so good!

Haven’t tried the rest of the menu yet, but I’ll definitely be back, that no-carb option looks amazing.
Highly recommend the Stoic cafe. It’s my second visit, and definitely not the last.

name: ALL BLACK COFFEE
review_1_text:
🐱☕ Best place in Nimman if you're looking for delicious specialty coffee and a place to chill.
This spot has been my second home for months — not only thanks to their flavorful black coffees, friendly staff, and relaxing outdoor space, but maybe mostly because of Bobby: the sweet, adorable cat you’ll usually find on her favorite chair, often in a yogic position and deep sleep.

You can choose from various blends from around the world. Many are single-origin, with info about the washing process, altitude, and bean type. I preferred the hot Americanos: they’re made so well! A perfect way to really taste the beans and take your time to simmer with your coffee.
review_2_text:
☕️All black: Simplicity is the best👍🏻
This tiny hidden coffee shop sells only americano with a selection of local and imported beans. Prices vary from 50 to 100+ baht. I tried their Khun Chang Khian for just 50 baht, and the taste is worth more than its price👍🏻✨
review_3_text:
Good coffee, cute cat.

Recommend if you like specialty coffee. The espresso has been well-made both times I've been there, not over- or under-extracted, and they have a good range of beans from around the world.

It's a small place with mostly outdoor seating. There is a discount for to-go drinks if you bring your own cup.
review_4_text:
Simply the best coffee spot in Nimman. I love black coffee, and their quality is truly top tier — you can taste the difference. It’s incredibly refreshing in the morning.
My little son also loves playing with the owner’s black cat, who is just as chill as the café vibe.
If black coffee isn’t your thing, you can still order it and add milk at home . I usually drink half straight and turn the rest into an iced latte.
review_5_text:
very good selection of speciality coffees.
if you love espresso or long black visit here for wonderful coffee amd service.  it is reasonably price also compared to some other specialty coffee shops nearby

name: Nine One Coffee Chiang Mai
review_1_text:
If you search for a little cafe to work in, that could be your place.
They got a very unique design and its pretty cozy to take a seat and relax a while.
I got a cappuccino for 85 baht, not the cheapest, but still alright.
They offer you a variety of beans 🫘 for that.
Definitely a chill vibe here.
review_2_text: One of the best tasting coffees ☕️ in Nimman.  As you know, traveling is a challenge when you cannot find a great cup of coffee!   Nine One delivers on the simple promise of fantastic coffee.  The cafe is charming.  Sit out front and watch the world go by, inside, or in the back garden.  My absolute favorite is the medium-dark roast.   Beautifully prepared by the friendliest coffee staff in the city.  ♥️ ☕️
review_3_text: This has been my go to cafe in Niman area and it’s simply amazing! Lovely staff, delicious food and affordable prices 💚 definitely recommend! The only thing is that they only accept cash.
review_4_text: I tried the coconut coffee and a plain hot latte, and enjoyed both. The two women working were friendly and spoke English. Prices were good. Menu is fairly basic but the coffee is solid. They also sell minimal food (waffles and eggs), coffee beans, and some merchandise. Very cute spot with large windows and natural sunlight. Also has outdoor seating. Free WiFi and a water station for customers. Would return here!
review_5_text:
This cute little coffee shops is based in a little quiet side street making it the perfect place to enjoy a chilled out coffee.

There is also a small food menu, which I can confirm is prepared with love, is delicious, and beautifully presented.

Coffee was amazing, and there are milk alternatives available here.

name: Hang & Craft
review_1_text: Hang & Craft is such a lovely hidden gem. They serve great coffee and delicious matcha with red beans, beautifully presented and full of flavor. What makes this place truly special is the free painting activity you can sit, relax, enjoy your drink, and paint at your own pace. The atmosphere feels creative, cozy, and inspiring, perfect for unwinding or spending quality time with friends. A wonderful spot for both coffee lovers and art lovers alike. 🎨☕🍵
review_2_text: Great little cafe for the creative-inclined. True to their name they offer a variety of crafting projects and their shop is quite interesting. Out of the blue I found myself painting this little guy, included in the price of the coffee. Quite a lovely atmosphere.
review_3_text: Great atmosphere, great decorations, great staff, great coffee and if you are into handy stuff, here you go!
review_4_text: This is a coffeeshop with a theme: handicraft and leather works. The atmosphere is quite nice. Coffee tastes good. Some of the cakes are quite nice. Service is good as when they messed up one of my orders, they immediately changed it. The macadamia cake is a must try. Parking spaces available in front of the shop.
review_5_text:
Lovely coffee and handcraft place but not ideal if you’re looking for a place to work.

The overall atmosphere feels wonderful, creative and peaceful. I especially loved the natural materials (wood, leather, plants) everywhere. It feels like being outside in nature. Lovely for a change compared to white, modern other places.

All over the shop, you can find handcrafts and other handmade products. If you’re into DIY, that place will trigger your curiosity.

It’s nice for a change to work there. Working from the couches can be nice for a while. But if you’re looking for long time work (half a day for example), there more suited options in the neighborhood.

name: On the way cafe Chiang Mai
review_1_text: We visited the mini stall in Siri wattana market, we got an iced matcha latter & caramel latte. Both were so nice we both ordered another. Highly recommend :)
review_2_text:
Thai milk tea and coffee are good in quality with very affordable price.
There are 3 types of coffee beans you can choose for your cup of coffee: light roast, medium roast and dark roast.
I don’t like the bitterness much so my preference is light roast.
35-40 BTH/ drinks.
Owner is very nice too.
You can buy to take away or you can sit at the store to drink.
review_3_text: Best value take out coffee in this area only 35thb for any coffee including cappuccino or latte and many more. You get to choose the roast level of the bean and the process looks professional as well. There are some small seats, but it’s better to get a to go here.
review_4_text: Great coffee at a decent price with friendly service! This air conditioned cafe has 3 coffee strengths to choose from (light, medium, strong) and offers interesting coffee combinations. For example, the lychee coffee was yummy, as the sweet lychee flavor blended well with the slightly acidic notes of the coffee.
review_5_text: Amazing coffee for a great price, lovely kind service, and rad music. Waited out the rain here and loved it, definitely recommend

name: Chichai coffee Nimman
review_1_text: A hidden gem, delicious coffee always made quickly and with a friendly smile! Beautiful outdoor seating area and cozy atmosphere inside. Prices are the best around by far. I’ve loved their coffee for a while now but they recently added a matcha menu as well and it is truly so good!
review_2_text: The tiny cute cafe shop under the condo and the cafe is good with reasonable price. The atmosphere here is quite cozy and u can work here..I drink hot cappuccino here...
review_3_text:
I really love this little cafe. It’s hidden in the corner of the lower floor of an apartment complex, and it is the perfect spot to relax.

It’s really peaceful, quiet, and comfortable.

Plus the coffee is great. Better than the majority of the bougier spots.
review_4_text:
Cozy and cute café.
All coffee drinks are 60B (hot or iced).
The iced latte is good — it has a flavor that Koreans would likely enjoy.
review_5_text:
This place is located in the same building as a yoga studio.

I stopped by after class and what a surprise 🫢 good cheap coffee.

The coffee smell hit me as I walked in.

It's very small, nothing special about the decor, and the walls are mostly plain. No real photo opportunities. Not a lot of seating available.

The coffee was excellent. The flavors were there, not over powered by milk or sweetness.

I would mark it a 4 star based on decor, but the coffee saved it.

name: fimue
review_1_text: A beautiful café with lovely decoration. The place feels like an antique house, full of vintage furniture and old objects, which gives it a very special charm. I ordered a sesame latte and it was delicious. They also had a tiramisu that I didn’t try, but it looked amazing. The staff was absolutely charming 🍪🍰☕
review_2_text: Had dirty coffee and latte. Very Good coffee! The Owner delivered Tiramisu on our table with a big tray, which makes it feels quite a special service and freshly made cake . Love the ambiance. Very nice deco! They also made drinking water with lemon in it available for the guesses to help themselves. We feel welcomed. Enjoyed our time there! Thank you!
review_3_text: Very nice coffee shop. Unfortunately many people think so. The place was packed with people posing for pictures. But ok. They do sell a lot of cute knock knacks. It’s worth checking out. The coffee was ok. Not exceptional. But the matcha madeleine was great. Moist and too sweet.
review_4_text:
Quaint cafe that shares space in a shop that also sells jewelry/accessories. Guess most of the items on display are for sale.
Cozy cafe to spend an afternoon.
We had the hot latte, orange coffee & matcha tiramisu.
review_5_text: A Korean cafe with delicious tiramisu. Earlgrey tea latte is light and accompanies the dessert well. I particularly like the selection of music, and there are many corners for nice photos.

name: KLĀY cafe
review_1_text:
I haven’t tried the food yet but I’ve come here several times for drinks and the atmosphere and I love this place.

The staff are super friendly and cool and the interior is beautiful minimal, warm brown/beige tones, very Japanese-inspired. Perfect for anyone who appreciates calm, aesthetic cafés. It has indoor and outdoor seatings.

It’s a small space but very well located in the middle of Nimman. A great spot to stop by, refresh and just enjoy the vibe.
review_2_text: Another classic “Thai-style zen service (lazy indifference)” moment at this place. It was early morning, not busy at all. We just wanted something light with a coffee before yoga; nothing dramatic, just caffeine and calm. To be fair, the coffee was good (Chiang Mai coffee rarely disappoints, but the cinnamon roll was softly rolled up like a tissue after use). But the service? Ice-cold. Not the refreshing kind; more like “did we accidentally walk into a silent retreat?” There were four or five staff members behind the bar, seemingly very focused on their appearance (honestly, it felt like rehearsals for a catwalk fashion show were about to begin) rather than helping each other or serving customers. I asked one of the ladies twice for a glass of water. She acknowledged me, looked at her male colleague, and… nothing. Meanwhile, he had no problem delivering water to the tables around me while skillfully pretending I had mastered invisibility. After being ignored long enough to question my physical existence, I asked him directly for a glass of water. Miraculously, I became visible again;  and the water arrived, served with the subtle energy of someone doing me a personal favor. That whole “we are blessing you with our presence but we are giving you a favour” attitude is exhausting. Cheer up, it’s not charity work; it’s literally the job description. We might go back, just to see if the invisibility spell is still active.
review_3_text:
Another great place for breakfast fast. Tried thier Thai traditional beef fried rice and big breakfast.
Beef was good, portion was good as well. Big breakfast portion was big, wife had a hard to finish it all.
review_4_text: I came to Klay Cafe for breakfast because I wanted something healthy, well-priced and delicious. I got the colorful tropical smoothie bowl which was perfectly balanced in taste and texture. Sometimes bowls can be too sweet, too runny, or sometimes - too cold. This one was just right. However, the tropical bowl wasn’t the highlight…it was the coffee. I had one of the best flat whites I’ve ever had. It was silky - like sipping a coffee liqueur without the alcohol or overwhelming sweetness. I’ll definitely be back to try some other things on the menu.
review_5_text: The best breakfast we had in Chiang Mai. I think the pictures speak for themselves but they have a great range of dishes in a beautiful setting. The service is slightly slow but it doesn’t take away from the food and the atmosphere. Great coffee and French toast!

name: PLAYWORKS SHOP&CAFE
review_1_text:
This shop is so lovely and very unique. This is truly a must-visit place when in Chiang Mai.

The only downside is that you might end up buying more than you planned 😄

There are beautiful art pieces, clothes, and accessories to choose from. We ended up taking several art prints home.
review_2_text: Nice and beautiful store, lots of souvenirs available and clothing brands. But the store is quite small and narrow. Some of the souvenirs and cloths prices are quite high. Overall just a nice place to pay a visit. This area is very famous for the tourist and neaar this also there are few stores that sell souvenirs and items for visitors.
review_3_text:
Great and unique gifts. Really a must visit when in Chiang Mai, only downside is you’ll end up buying more than planned!
Great art prints, nice clothes and accessories for sale. The cafe is really cute too with a nice variety of drinks. The Thai milk tea was less sweet as requested, very appreciated.
review_4_text: Love this cute little souvenir shop selling all kinds of local postcards, pins, stickers. If not for this place we wouldn't have discovered the photo spots right outside the shop as well, very aesthetic youth park vibes area worth a stop by for insta
review_5_text: I love this shop and the art they have. The business is run by three siblings who are the artists. I got plenty of new art for my apartment. I can highly recomment to check them out, I am sure you will find something for yourself or as a souvenir for friends and family.

name: Roast8ry Coffee Lab
review_1_text: Nice little coffee shop near One Nimman, within walking distance. Their coffee was unique and interesting. If you want to try something different, this place is a fun one to visit. I went before lunchtime, and it was very busy, but the line moved pretty fast.
review_2_text: Coffee was amazing - had the flat white with art, husband had restretto, pricing was good for us but we’re from London so used to it 😂 worth it! Guys working there are lovely - lab is nice to sit and enjoy some time in the day.  Award winning - worth a stop if you’re in the area!!
review_3_text:
This legendary spot is highly recommended for all coffee lovers. Make this (or its sister spot) a must visit. The cafe is located on a fairly quiet Soi in what appears to be an affluent neighborhood.

Absolutely beautiful coffee and friendly team that are always smiling
review_4_text: Excellent coffee with stunning latte art. Drinks are smooth, well-balanced, and made with real skill. The space is relaxed with both indoor and outdoor seating perfect for anyone who truly appreciates quality coffee.
review_5_text: Definitely worth visiting here. Aesthetic interior, chill surroundings. Their dark roasted lungo has an exceptional taste (added only a little bit of water and I love the flavor, citrusy and strong; just my type of coffee) Visit here at least once if you're in Nimman area.

name: FOHHIDE
review_1_text: Great cafe !!! Super highly recommended. Nice balanced taste of all the flavors. I recommend medium roast. Great taste coffee and an incredible mountain views! It is located on the 5th floor, tiny little elevator up to 5th floor. They use Slayer espresso machine and mahlkonig grinders. They serve light and medium roast.
review_2_text:
A coffee shop in the heart of Nimmanhaemin, with a great atmosphere and great coffee.
A coffee shop where you can relax and enjoy the view of Nimmanhaemin. The atmosphere is great. I ordered the Dirty coffee, which was incredibly smooth and affordable. This shop has a great style.
I'll definitely be back again.
review_3_text:
Hidden little gem.
Sadly, a lot of digital nomads/tourist know that place and take a lot of space to „work“.
Besides that, their staff is very friendly and helpful. Their Menu is pretty variable and their beans taste good.
And the view…its amazing to start your day with a view over jungly mountain ⛰️
review_4_text: They serve good cappuccino here but my go-to is the dirty latte. Cute little drink that’s perfect for late afternoons in Chiang Mai. It’s a cozy spot to do crosswords or sudoku (but not reading) and I’ve also seen people writing in their journals. Mornings and sunsets are especially lovely with the sun hitting Doi Suthep and the surrounding buildings. Another reason I keep coming back is I love taking the lift here lol
review_5_text: small cafe with the best mountain view. their dirty latte is the best. the atmosphere is a little but crowded. but this is a place you should visit in Nimman area.

name: Mali Cat Cafe & Bar
review_1_text: Visiting this cat café in Thailand was such a special experience. You purchase a ticket that includes a free drink and an hour to spend with the cats, which felt like the perfect amount of time. The space was clean, peaceful, and thoughtfully maintained, so it never felt chaotic or overwhelming. Being so far from home and missing my own cats, it was such a gift to sit, relax, and enjoy their sweet company. I left feeling happy and refreshed. Highly recommend if you love cats!
review_2_text: Came here in the evening with my husband as I love cats, The Café it itself was very clean had no smell and was quite large. The amount of cats they had there they had some toys that humans could play with them. I did notice that majority of the cats were not interactive and not playing. Maybe this is because they’re not used to being played with I’m not sure. I would like to make a suggestion to have a few of those catnip toys that cats love to play with as I know my cat loves them. You can also get a bird on a stretchy string that you attach to the ceiling that I think cats would love as they can play with it to themselves when there are no humans around
review_3_text: There are so many cute beautiful cats here. Loved the place and spending time with them all. The package is 250bhat per hour and you get a drink with it also. You can feed the cats also but i think it’s extra. You can pet the cats, play with them or just simply enjoy the company. I bought the Thai tea and it was good. I just went there to see those cute beautiful cats anyway. There are care takers as well. Overall the staff is good and cleanliness is maintained. I hope the welfare of the cats are maintained as well. Like to recommend this place. Love from 🇱🇰
review_4_text:
If you’re a cat lover who appreciates quiet elegance, Mali Café in Chiang Mai is like stepping into a furry palace of British Shorthairs and Scottish Folds— Mixed Munchins, Sphinx others around 80 of them! These kitties aren’t your typical clingy types; they’re more like the soft-spoken aristocrats of the cat world—polite, poised, and preferring gentle admiration over hugs and squeezes. Please follow the café rules; keeps things calm, be mindful for all visitors not to pet too aggressively (totally fair—these cats are basically celebrities).

The place feels cozy and well-kept, and watching all those fluffy faces stroll around is honestly therapeutic. It’s less about cuddling and more about soaking up the feline vibes. Perfect spot for cat lovers who enjoy observing the graceful side of meow-life. 🩵☕🐾meow meow
review_5_text:
The place is clean, spacious and it smells good. The cats pretty much kinda mind your own business. Didn’t really see any pussy fights - very peaceful. You can also tell these kitties are very well taken care off - staffs clean their eyes, nose and ears during the time I’m there.

The nearest toilet would be at the hotel next door. Upon entry, they will ask which packages are you gonna take - we got 3 hours + drink for one each at 400 baht.

You’ll have to remove your shoes and socks (the usual), then wear their socks that provided you and wash your hands prior entering to spend time with the cats.

You can also bring the beverage into the cat space but you have to put in the cabinet provided as some of the cats have fetish in chewing straws 🙃

Overall, it was so worth my 3 hours.

name: Newtown Nimman
review_1_text: This place gets packed every night. You don’t think it‘s much of a buzz when you walk past it around six or seven. But after eight there is hardly a seat left. Almost all of the customers are young Thai people. They even have a bouncer. But he only checks age.
review_2_text: Electric nights in Nimman's heart! Pulsing with a killer DJ spinning infectious beats that get the whole crowd grooving, this hotspot buzzes with vibrant energy—perfect for letting loose amid the lively throng. Finger foods arrive fashionably late but pack a punch of crispy, flavorful bliss that keeps the party fueled. Unbeatable vibes for your wildest evenings out!
review_3_text:
I visited Newtown Nimman around 10:00–12:00 and it was the perfect spot for a chill morning.

The place wasn’t crowded, so it had a really relaxed vibe—great for chatting with friends or getting some work done. The coffee was solid and the space is beautifully designed, with both indoor and outdoor seating.

Definitely a nice find if you’re looking for a calm café in the Nimman area!

7/10
review_4_text:
I wouldn't describe this as a brunch place. We came at about 10pm and it was packed - they even have security on the door.
They do a lot of beer towers and they have loads of outside seating. It's got a trendy atmosphere.
review_5_text:
New hype place for brunch/coffee/beer/bar and easy bistro open 8am to mid night.

easy fast food: hot dogs, fried chicken with fried potatoes.

Nice vibes with outdoor seats but out door seat is quite not comfy.

Nice and friendly staffs.

name: TANN
review_1_text: Very hip and nice coffeeshop / runners shop. They also sell running equipment (not shoes). The coffee shop is a bit hidden and quite small. But they have a nice outdoor seating area. Although it‘s a bit messy too. Sandwiches are very tasty and coffee is good. Staff can be very nice. Depends on who you end up with.
review_2_text: The shop is nice and calm. The staff knows things well about coffee. This is my personal preference that I didn’t like sour coffee but if you like fruity and sour coffee, you will like this place. Nice outdoor seating.
review_3_text: Stayed nearby Tann coffee during my stay in Chiang Mai and I was there for 3 days consecutively. The coffee was incredible and aromatic, food wise was tasty as well. I ordered the ham and cheese sourdough - crispy, full of flavors and kept you wanting for more. Sourdough with scrambled eggs was simple yet homely. Highly recommend this cozy cafe!
review_4_text: the vibes / atmosphere of the cafe was nice, calm and relaxing. One of the best places to have a slow morning with a coffee in your hand. The coffee was nice as well. Ordered dirty latte and mocha. I prefer the dirty latte tho. the tuna melts was good as well, delicious !
review_5_text:
A nice, simple cafe that opens from 7am onwards. Offering a unique but rather simple menu in term of drink and food.

Espresso, Americano are nice but choose the right one roast will make a big difference.

Love their ham cheese sandwich. Very crunchy sourdough bread with thick cheese applied on top

name: GRAPH ground
review_1_text:
I asked the staff member for their top recommendation, and he suggested the Monochrome with natural charcoal, describing it as delicious and distinctive. The shop itself has a clean, modern atmosphere that adds to the overall experience.

I have edited this post several times, as I visit the café daily and try a different coffee each time. Today, I tried the Sompetch with orange, and it was excellent
review_2_text:
Service - 4.5 stars

Seaweed coffee cocktail - 4.5 stars
The seaweed was fragrant and the savoury umami flavour balanced the coffee well. I'm not usually a fan of coffee cocktails but this was well done!

6oz white
Khun chang kian - 4 stars

Huay chom phu - 4 stars

Both were pretty delicate. No obvious notes in the white coffees. Reliable WiFi and clean bathroom.
review_3_text: Recently, the quality of coffee in northern Thailand has dramatically improved, and Thai coffee beans also have a distinct flavor. There are many good cafes in town, and this cafe is one of them. If you like coffee, you’ll like this cafe. They’re serious about the coffee they serve.
review_4_text: Wow wow WOWWWW. Such an overall perfect experience GRAPH. We thoroughly enjoyed our the MoMA and Holiday coffeeS, and the brownie wasn’t bad either. We very much appreciated the chill and darkly mysterious vibe inside. Perfect spot for relaxing or working. Thank you!
review_5_text: One of my favourites cafe in Chiang Mai, all drinks are unique and wonderful, especially Graph no. 17, the tomato juice makes it so refreshing, especially after walking under the sun for a while.

name: Manifreshto Cafe & Restaurant
review_1_text: This restaurant was in a very convenient location and seemed full of tourists. I liked the idea that the food was farm to table. We had both the regular and beef Benedict’s along with a healthy vegetable and fruit smoothie. You could tell everything was made with high quality ingredients and the smoothie tasted very good. The Benedict’s both tasted really good, but not mind-blowing. Price is a bit higher than other spots.
review_2_text:
I walked around my neighbourhood while i came across this restaurant. I saw from the outside something which hyped me really up: „free range eggs“, and you can taste that these chickens actually got some sunlight and could enjoy life.
Besides that they look for their ingredients, real cheese, real meat, real eggs,… their staff is super friendly and kind.
The food was also very good. You can create your own „breakfast“ which is pretty convenient.
10/10
review_3_text: I was wandering around Nimman  and saw the pulled pork on their menu and knew I had to stop in to try it. I’ve been in Thailand for 6 weeks and was missing some of my favorite foods from the states. This meal did not disappoint! The pork was on a mini hot skillet still sizzling when it came to the table. The presentation was lovely. The pork had a light sauce on it and just a tiny bit spicy. The toast was warm and perfect! So tasty!! Aroi maak maak! I think this was one of  my favorite Meals I’ve had in Thailand  so far, in that it gave me a taste of home but with the high level of quality and presentation the Thais are known for. Highly recommend.
review_4_text:
Good cafe for all day breakfast & they also served some german food, some local beers & all of it looks good but I don't try it. I came only in the morning for breakfast.

You can create your own breakfast & mostly is very good.
Baked potatoes: 5/5
Crispy bacon: 5/5 (well cooked, crispy & flavourful)
English Breakfast Sausage: 4/5
Croissant: 3/5 (a bit chewy & not so crispy)
Scramble egg: 5/5 (cooked perfectly, still moist, creamy & balanced)
Omelette: 5/5 (perfectly cooked).

The environment is also very nice, you can seat indoor or outdoor. The temperature in Chiang Mai is perfect for this kind of setup. It's also a great place to hangout with small circle
review_5_text:
Top-tier brunch spot in Chiang Mai 🍳🥗

We found ourselves at Manifreshto every morning of our stay and it was always a win. From the fresh juices and smoothie bowls to the all-day breakfasts and paninis, the ingredients tasted real and the flavour was next level.  ￼

The atmosphere? Laid-back, friendly and comfortable. The team genuinely cares about what they serve, you can see they’ve put real effort into sourcing clean ingredients, and the mood is just easy-going and welcoming.  ￼

If you’re in the Nimmanhaemin area and want a place where you feel looked after, with great food, great service and good vibes, this is it. Will definitely be coming back 🙌

name: Graph One Nimman
review_1_text: What a wonderful coffee shop and overall experience. This is modern coffee brewing at its finest. They have some 10 different beans and combined with the style of brewing you can definitely visit multiple times to enjoy your coffee as you like it. The food on offer is also delicious and worthy. Their entire shop's architecture is what I found amazing, with the unique quote on the main door and the dark, bar like aesthetic interiors makes for an unique experience .
review_2_text:
Graph has firmly established itself as a must-visit destination for specialty coffee lovers in Chiang Mai. It's not just a café; it's a curated experience that blends high-quality coffee with high-concept art and design.
​
Graph is serious about its coffee, offering a sophisticated selection of single-origin beans for classic espresso drinks and pour-overs. Where they truly stand out, however, is with their incredibly creative signature menu. They are well-known for their inventive "nitro" cold brews, often infused with unexpected ingredients like fruit, spices, or floral notes. While the prices are at a premium, you are paying for a unique, well-crafted beverage that you won't find elsewhere.
​
Each Graph location is an exercise in minimalist, artistic design. They are famous for their "Instagrammable" interiors—think monochrome color palettes, dramatic lighting, and modern, gallery-like aesthetics. The cafés are often small and intimate, focusing on the quality of the product and the design-forward atmosphere rather than offering large, comfortable workspaces. It's a place for appreciating the craft and soaking in the cool, quiet vibe.
review_3_text: Excellent coffee drinks, Graph is well worth the visit. Really a must visit if you love coffee. There's a substantial menu of different coffee concoctions available,it's a little pricier but the quality is there. I want to keep returning until I've tried the whole menu. This visit I had monochrome - espresso, charcoal, milk, and vanilla over ice, it was great. This location is a bit small, but I love the vibe of a full coffee shop with lots of conversations going on.
review_4_text:
The All-Rounder (Detailed & Enthusiastic)**

🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟 A Hidden Gem in One Nimman!
Graph One Nimman is more than just a cafe; it's an experience. The modern, industrial-chic interior with artistic touches makes it the perfect oasis from the busy mall. We tried the iconic **Monochrome** drink and it was as delicious as it was Instagram-worthy—a perfect balance of espresso, milk, and charcoal. The **No. 18** (Lychee Espresso) was also a surprising and refreshing burst of flavor. Paired with a decadent cake, it was the perfect stop. The staff was incredibly cool and friendly. A must-visit for coffee connoisseurs and anyone looking for a stylish, high-quality break in Chiang Mai!
review_5_text: Excellent coffee from skilled and welcoming staff. Had a super tasty cappuccino made with beans from Chiang Rai. Doi Chang. Well worth a bit steep price ta, if you love coffee and appreciate the workmanship behind it.

name: MOO Coffee & Bar @One Nimman
review_1_text: Moo Coffee has just opened inside the Maya shopping center. I couldn't find the location on Google Maps, so I'm leaving my review here. I ordered a hot cappuccino to go — the drink was great. The staff were friendly and cheerful.
review_2_text: Amazing coffee and great service. Just ask “for here”. In glass coffee tastes much better than in plastic cup
review_3_text:
Good coffee quality. There are several coffee bean options: light roast, medium roast, dark roast.
The coffee store located inside One Nimman.
The take away bag is very creative.
review_4_text: You can pick up great quality of coffee here at One Nimman. How they make coffee is very detailed and things look right and taste right as well. You can choose your preferred roast level. There are many chairs and tables around as it is located in the food court area.
review_5_text: Well controlled coffee! Good balance of taste with their house blend. Interesting take on innovative drinks like Black Coconut Flower coffee! Passionate & friendly team! Lovely to relax in this huge and airy yet stylish covered food court!!

name: Co&Co cafe
review_1_text:
Translation:

My first visit to Chiang Mai truly surprised me. There are many very lovely restaurants and cafés here. The staff are very enthusiastic and friendly. The food at the café really suited my taste. I arrived at 10:00 a.m., so the place was quite quiet.
review_2_text: This english looking cafe took me by surprise. The decor was beautiful inside and out. What's best is that the service was immaculate as well. Food was great as well. I tried the fish and chips with no expectations but it turned out to be one of the best I've tried in recent times. Coffee was good too. This is not a paid review but a genuine one. If you're in Chiangmai, consider dropping by here! My server / waiter, Pang was very good and considerate too. 10/10 will be back!
review_3_text:
The cafe itself seems enticing at first. Nice modern fit out with cool waiters.   When we arrived, it was suspiciously empty : only one other table. We ordered the Khao Soi Fettucini and a Wagyu Fried Rice. We then waited. 20 minutes later, the waiter came back and said they were sold out of the wagyu. It was then I realised they hadn’t started cooking at all. So I changed it to a slow cooked pork curry - knowing that they probably had this prepared since it needs hours slow cooking.

So we waited. And waited. And waited. In the meantime, the staff had gone missing. Some other table had to go inside to find some service staff.

We finally had our meals after 35 minutes of waiting. The slow cooked pork curry had been reheated, but was leaning on the lukewarm side. The fettucini was fusion khao soi fettucini , but ended up less tasty than either dish.

But oh my, the wait! The wait wasn’t worth it for us, but for people who have a lot of time on their hands to waste, it may be worth it for them.
review_4_text: Interior is very luxurious and they have a nice shaded seating outdoors. We got breakfast salmon toast and poached bacon eggs, both of them were delicious and the bacon was crispy with well seasoned side greens. Only comment is that the portions are a bit small.
review_5_text: The DJ in the evening sets a great vibe, and there are also live bands and sometimes even concerts. During the day, the terrace is perfect for coffee, the interior is stylishly decorated, and the pastries are excellent. Special mention to Miiot, the owner, always smiling, kind, and attentive. A place worth coming back to, whether with friends or for a more intimate moment

name: Ccccc CAFE
review_1_text:
Dirty is nice.
Not too sweet and very creamy.
The coffee is not too strong and blended in very well with the milk.
Friendly staff.
review_2_text:
Excellent coffee shop. A small shop located in the heart of nimmaman. The cheese cake is awesome. They have a good supply of drinks and cakes
To choose From.  2 different roasts to choose from.  Service is friendly.  No parking. Good AC
review_3_text: Dirty coffee was okay. Only shame is the place full of people on laptops leaving no space for customers to consume and killing the ambience. We had to take our dirty coffee in a paper cup outside, which degraded the experience.
review_4_text: Passed by this cafe while staying in Eastin Tan Hotel located next door and decided to come in since it was empty. Ordered cappuccino and mentaiko pasta which were both amazing! My cappuccino choice of dark roast hit the spot and the mentaiko pasta was to die for! Staffs were really polite and friendly and I appreciate the interior, vibe and choice of lofi music. Highly recommended when you are in Nimman!
review_5_text:
Nice vibe! Comfortable seating in a rainy relaxing afternoon 🥳
Excellent recommendation of the lady with iced latte with dark roast coffee and the Black Summer is something not to be missed 🤩

name: Diciotto SlowBar Coffee
review_1_text: I always walked past that little cafe, but today i went inside and it was a good decision! Compared to others close by, which are charging same or even more, he is the one which is definitely worth it! I got an Machiato Espresso for 80 Baht, not the cheapest, but the way and the quality of it, makes it worth it! The owner, i guess a older thai guy, is very friendly, professional and polite! I definitely recommend coming here since its like an Vietnamese coffee experience! 10/10
review_2_text:
A hidden gem where Japanese precision meets Italian art in the world of coffee. Every cup here is crafted with elegance, care, and passion. Master Ohm is not just a barista – he is a true artist, elevating the experience of coffee to something memorable and unique.

The atmosphere is warm and inviting, with beautiful music that perfectly complements the slow bar philosophy. From the rich aroma to the balanced flavors, every sip feels like a journey. If you love coffee, this place is a must-visit – not just for the drink, but for the artistry behind it.
review_3_text:
Good vibe to relax and chill while enjoy the boss preparing the coffee...
Espresso is made with Flair manual coffee machine
Love the setup and music
review_4_text: There are many cafes in Chiang Mai, but everything in Diciotto is perfect. I can feel the barista’s expertise and passion for coffee. I ordered a cup of pour-over with light-roasted beans. The coffee has a rich taste, which really impressed me.
review_5_text:
The barista here takes his craft very seriously and pours a lot of love into his brewing.

He uses manual devices, so your coffee can take time. Hence the concept – slow bar. The quality of coffee that comes out of it is top-notch.

I ordered the special dirty coffee. More than the taste (which was great), I loved seeing him prepare it.

It's a small cafe with only about four small tables. And the WiFi isn't great either. So it's not meant for coworking but rather enjoying the coffee over conversations.

My only complaint is with the menu design. It's ridiculously tough to read anything on it. As a designer, I'd be happy to help him out with it.

name: Saded Cafe'
review_1_text: This was the first place we had something to eat during our first trip to Thailand. The pineapple rice meal I had was delicious and there was so much of it that i couldn't finish it all which is rare for me! There was a varied menu from a full English breakfast to waffles & fruit. For the three of us the total bill was £15 which included two full set meals (main, accompaniments, fruit platter and hot & cold drinks) and dessert waffles with a cold drink. The complimentary water was topped up at least 6 times before our glasses were empty and the waiter service in general was excellent. Lots of fans to keep you cool and very modern, tasteful wooden decor made it a delight to look at.
review_2_text:
our tenth meal in CNX，and it is the worst

we order pad thai and american breakfast

the bacon is uneatable like paper，we ask to change another one but still the same

pad thai is too sweet and undercooked

service is good though
review_3_text:
Delicious pan cooked eggs with a selection of sausages.   Good latte.

Cafe seating is on an elevated terrace along a peaceful Soi in an otherwise busy Nimman area.
review_4_text: Reasonable price with big portion, so if you are not a big eater, you can share the portion. A good place for breakfast or brunch, I didn’t get to try other dishes on the menu though. Fast service, thoughtful staff.
review_5_text:
Opens at 7am. One of the earlier breakfast places in nimman. 230 for a full English. Very good portion. Fast service , friendly staff

Only concern was there was a crazy amount of grease.

name: Samudlanna
review_1_text:
A good stationery store. I was looking for acrylic paints and markers and found them here.
Parking is at the back of the building.
review_2_text:
We love this little stationary and office/craft supplies store. They seem to have almost everything that you need for a project or for your home office. They also sell quite a lot of home goods, like picture hangers, hooks, tape, adhesives, small hand tools, light bulbs, etc, etc.
The staff is always friendly and helpful.
They often have holiday decor, too.
review_3_text: Walked in looking for paint. No one looked up at me. No one greeted me or asked if I need help. They have lots of good stuff but no customer service.
review_4_text: A nice stationery store--paints and canvases on the mezzanine level, most everything else (writing instruments, notebooks, envelopes, adhesives, whiteboards/corkboards, erasers, craft supplies, binders, etc.) on the ground floor. Carries fewer fountain pens now than 5+ years ago, and doesn't appear to carry capped Uniball Signo pens (I know, that's very specific, but they're personal faves) anymore, but it does carry more locally produced crafts than before and the selection of pens is still large. For those who are on the lookout for fountain pen-friendly paper on a small budget, the kraft paper-covered BSP notebooks (see photo) they carry have done surprisingly well in my experience. (I should note that I prefer extra-fine and fine nibs, which usually write drier than medium and bold nibs.)
review_5_text:
A huge stationary store at Niman...
There are couple of stationary stores in Chaing Mai but this one is bigger and more items then those stores...
There are many things for Students, Artists, Designers, Etc...
The Interior design of the shop is also quite interesting...
If you need stationary no doubt to just go there if you are near Niman...

name: Ombra Caffe
review_1_text:
We were staying at theOmbra small house no. 3 above the Ombra Caffe for 4 days in Jan 2026.  As there is no google pin for the house, I would like to leave the review of the house and caffe here.  We had an absolutely fantastic stay at The Ombra Small House No. 3 in Chiang Mai! From the moment I booked, Jennie was super helpful and responsive — she replied to my messages lightning fast, provided very clear check-in instructions and went above and beyond to assist with anything I needed. She was super proactive too, even recommending some great nearby food spots that I ended up loving.
We were staying at theguest house of Ombra Caffe upstairs.  As there is no google pin for the guest house, Iwould like to leave my review of the house and the cafe here.  The house itself is incredibly spacious — perfect for relaxing. It’s super super clean; even when I walked around barefoot without the provided slippers, the floor felt spotless with zero dust at all. The bed is comfortable — I slept so well every night! There’s a smart TV with Netflix and the place is very well-equipped with everything you could need (kitchenette, fridge, etc.).
Downstairs there’s their Ombra Cafe (which you can store your luggage before and after check-out). I believe they can deliver food up to the room (though I didn’t try it this time, I went down to eat and the food was great!
Overall, this place exceeded all my expectations. Next time I’m in Chiang Mai, I will definitely stay here again without hesitation. Highly highly recommended — you won’t be disappointed! Thank you Jennie and the team!
review_2_text:
A calm and relaxing café with a refined sense of style. The interior is beautifully arranged with vintage typewriters and globes, creating a nostalgic yet cozy atmosphere. A bookshelf adds to the charm, making it an ideal place to enjoy a quiet moment with a book.

Free Wi-Fi is available, making it convenient for light work or a relaxing break. I had a latte and vanilla ice cream waffle — both were delicious and carefully prepared. A perfect hidden gem in Chiang Mai for those who appreciate a peaceful and well-designed space.
review_3_text: Had a wonderful breakfast here, super generos portions, coffee was really good as well. There's plenty of space and a few tables outside as well. It's laptop friendly too and with good wifi! Definitely recommend.
review_4_text: Ombra Caffe offers a fantastic atmosphere that perfectly balances modern, sleek design with a cozy, plant-filled interior patio. It’s an ideal workspace, boasting excellent Wi-Fi, abundant power sockets, and comfortable seating. The coffee is a highlight, with many praising their strong, well-made cappuccinos and beautiful latte art. They also cater to various dietary needs with non-dairy milk and vegetarian options on their food menu (which includes breakfast, brunch, and desserts like éclairs).
review_5_text:
it used to be an issue finding good quality coffee in Chiangmai
but now a days there are good cafes in town. This is one of it and their espresso is very rich and full of flavors. I love this cafe.

name: Roastniyom Coffee
review_1_text: Very cozy little cafe. Good vibe, very friendly and nice staff. Also serve a real coffee with even different beans options.
review_2_text:
- reasonable coffee prices
- iced cappuccino with 50% is super goodddd.  A great cup to refresh your day and it’s just 70฿
- Many interesting tea blends are sold here
- free WiFi
- smoking area is outside
- Plugs point are available indoor
- payment by cash or QR code
- Drink-in and to-go are both available
review_3_text:
My go-to cafe in Chiang Mai. It can be packed but the people are friendly and some don’t mind sharing a table with you. The staff are friendly too!

I recommend the americano with orange juice (THB 100). It’s refreshing.
review_4_text:
Their tea options are quite good. The drinks are delicious.

Note: More than half of the tables in the café are occupied by individuals who order a drink and work there with their notebook. The place would sell more if there is enough tables for others.
review_5_text: My fave coffee place in Nimman. The atmosphere is relaxed, the music isn’t too loud. The staff are friendly, and when it’s not too busy they’ll bring your drinks to the table. I ordered matcha and the delicious Macademia croissant that they heated before serving it. Note that it’s cash only.

name: Tawansy Restaurant & Cafe ตะวันซี่
review_1_text: Tawansy has become one of our “go-to” spots for great food and friendly service. We’ve liked everything we tried, but especially the tamarind-glazed chicken wings and the grilled beef. They make the best chicken with cashew nuts that I’ve tried anywhere (sorry no pics of that because it’s always eaten too fast). And every time we go, we get the Egyptian salad, which is delicious and healthy. I’m literally getting hungry writing this. The servers/owners are incredibly kind and attentive. Highly recommend!
review_2_text: I was there yesterday and had a great experience. The food was very delicious. We were welcomed very friendly, such nice people.I ordered the pumpkin soup, stir-fried vegetables, and an omelette, and everything tasted excellent and fresh. My friend had Australian beef with rice and egg, which was also very good. We will definitely come back.
review_3_text:
This little place, just northwest of old town, is a gem. While many restaurants have Thai and western offerings, the food here truly is truly a fusion of Thai, western, and middle eastern cuisines.

The owners, Ramy and Vi, are kind and attentive. Really nice people.

Everything was cooked to perfection and fresh. They use deliciously tender Australian beef for some dishes (like the beef with Jaew sauce) and Thai beef for others. They understand the nuances of flavors and use only the best seasonal ingredients.

Their Tamirind glazed chicken wings and prawns are unbelievably delicious.

The papaya salad (Some Tum Prara) is spicy, tangy, and delicious. Get some rice to soak up all the tasty good juice. Yum!

I will be coming back for sure.
review_4_text: Another really good spot in Chiang Mai. The food is always fresh and delicious. The menu is pretty big, so I had a lot of options to choose from. I already have been here a couple of times and every time I left with satisfaction in my stomach.😁
review_5_text: I stumbled on here looking for ginger tea. The lady was super kind enough to prepare one despite they don't make one as a regular drink from the menu. She also offered me a local Thai drink with spices that helps ease the stomach and prevents nausea. Thank you're very much!

name: The Donut Cafe
review_1_text:
We have been looking for donut spots and were happy to see The Donut Cafe was nearby. It's a nice, open lobby space with lots of seating areas and lots of donut flavors. We got 6 different flavors and have enjoyed them all - but Lemon Poppyseed is THE BEST!

When we brought our donuts to the counter, the cashier let us know it was Buy 6, Get 1 FREE! So we snagged 1 more!

We are satisfied customers and will definitely be back.
review_2_text:
This is a cool spot inside of a hotel in Chiang Mai.

Are these the best donuts? In my opinion, they are not as good. They are on the heavier side. There  is another spot with better flavor and lighter. Also, my bang for your baht.
Now, they do have a huge breakfast menu. I think it's just part of the hotel.
I would come for breakfast or lunch.

The inside is also beautiful 😍
The staff is very friendly.
Plenty of seating.
review_3_text:
This is an absolute little gem for a good sweet treat. The donut is are absolutely delicious and fair priced in relation to the businesses in this area. I had two donuts and a coffee for 175thb.

I had a Boston crème and a maple donut, and both were absolutely delicious.

The cafe is In the lobby of  a hotel so the working ambience is so so, but I would absolutely come here again for the donuts!
review_4_text: After a few observation and purchases,  some of them seem arrogant and entitled. Not friendly at all. Their listening skill and service orientation needs to improve instead of acting confrontational. They just want money, to get your food and get out. Zero service level communication despite they all speak good English. They just don't care to listen. You order one thing, they give another. Learn how to ask customers IF they want this or that, don't assume everyone is the same. Talk, you have got a mouth! The breakfast menu is a combination of healthy and unhealthy option. If you ask them to remove what it is not needed to add customer preferred option, they simply dismiss or charge more for it, they can't think beyond just the menu.
review_5_text:
the Oklahoma Burger is one to return for again! Really delicious. Tasted like a majorly upgraded white castle burger!
the staff is really friendly and the atmosphere is very relaxing whether you feel like a coffee and a donut or a meal.

name: Calanthe Café
review_1_text: Excellent Coffee, Superb Decorations. The appearance makes me feel like a Cathedral Church. When I pass the door in to the cafe. Wow! The table and the chair and decorate things. Make me feel Luxe, Clean and classic. The hot latte taste is very good. Butter, Aroma, Choco is signature no one else likes this. Recommend Calanthe Cafe' when you visit Chiangmai you will get a great experience.
review_2_text:
Excellent service. Helpful and polite.👌
We enjoyed a coffee break at Calanthe.
Spacious, pleasant music and very comfortable seating.
Just a walk away from KAD.
Parking available at the CM Orchid Hotel.
review_3_text:
a pleasant jazz tracklist plays on loop, the tables are thick, the seats are soft. with a vaulted ceiling and room-high windows, there's an enormous amount of natural light, and then there are the chandeliers. it's a cozy square footage with a grand, airy aesthetic. hardly a soul on a monday afternoon. waitress has a beaming smile, and whips up a wicked signature tea.

excellent café! a personal go-to of mine whenever i'm in the area.
review_4_text:
Good taste
Good service
Good mood
Good presentation
Good music
review_5_text:
Best Coffee I have had on Chiang mai so far.

Love the cafe.

name: Mac Cafe Santitham
review_1_text: Excellent phone shop with a wide range of products. The staff are knowledgeable, polite, and not pushy. Prices are reasonable, and the overall service was smooth and trustworthy.
review_2_text: The price is really valuable for us. The shop and cafe are spacious. We are grateful that Oil helped us a lot. She is polite, gentle, explain very clear and carefully all information. If you need some place to buy the IPhone Ipad Macbook, we recommend this place
review_3_text: The staff are polite and the service is friendly. The shop is clean.
review_4_text: such a wonderful experience to be here, also the service are great!
review_5_text:
I came to this shop to buy a new iPhone as during my long time travel I broke my old one.

Oil helped me perfectly to find the best phone for me and also supported me to transfer the data from my old to the new phone. It was perfect service, plus free tea. I highly recommend this shop and the nice staff!

name: Santitham Breakfast​ & Chiang Mai Pizza​
review_1_text: Great breakfast eatery open from early till past noon, with a casual open-air atmosphere, serving up great food at a decent price, from a menu ranging from Thai staples to Western offerings. Service is warm and cordial. Had the Pad Thai for breakfast, which was as hearty as it was delicious, and well worth the price. The space is amply tabled and while it gets a little busy on a weekday morning catering mostly to foreign diners, a few tables always appear to be available.
review_2_text:
Love the freshly baled pizza from was it fire/brick wood oven. Serving was fast as lightning, we just ordered then boom, served! Love the thick crust and the nice atmosphere

They only serve pizzas during fridays and saturdays btw

330 baht for a whole pizza. go here before 9pm as they close 9pm
review_3_text: Wide variety of breakfast to choose. Both Thai and Western(but does not have Northern Thai food, so keep that in mind). Food are great! Delicious and fairly priced. They got  rice soup, porridge, noodles, omelette, toast and more. Sourdough toast is amazing! Great spot for getting breakfast.
review_4_text: Came here for breakfast, it was ok. Maybe I ordered the wrong thing. I got smoked salmon and scrambled eggs. For the price was a bit bland, only 1 small piece of sourdough (although their freshly baked sourdough) and wasn’t proper smoked salmon, was more flaked salmon. Ice coffee was nice and chill vibe but overall was average.
review_5_text: Easy Thai and western food at reasonable price. Thai food wasn’t the best but ok. They don’t accept card payment.

name: Sowon - Cafe and Restaurant
review_1_text:
This is korean food restaurant, but also combine with cafe. I drink the tropical ade. It is Quiet & calm place to have a meal, mingle with friend, because they had some board gane. Also the room is soundproof from the sound of passing vehicles, so it's comfy for working online.

Facilities:
* 🌬️AC
* 📳Free wifi
* 🎲 Board game
* 💳QRis payment (my BCA Indonesian is works)

🍹They also offering FREE drinks, if you gave review. Want to get it, visit now❗❗❗
review_2_text: Very cozy place with board games and warm sunlight. The menu is quite big as well and the price is very affordable. Was especially surprised by the portion of Kimbap , which turned out to be really big and made me full:) thank you!
review_3_text:
This is THE spot! Very authentic and yummy korean food 😋. Try the kimbap, Rice cake soup! The Rib stew is also good!

I'll definitely come back to this place for more :)
review_4_text: No card just cash or scan :( Came out to about 600 thb, which is a little under $20 usd. Extra star for no wait (only one other table there at the time) and food came out quickly.
review_5_text: Cute and clean cafe that serves Korean food and many types of drinks, there’s a wide range of menu to choose from too. Would like to come back to visit again!

name: Sweet Red Cafe
review_1_text:
Look very strange but actually not to bad especially at 2 am 😲😁.
It is sweet no egg
review_2_text: Who knew that toast was such an amazing dessert. The bread was super soft, and the nuts and caramel made.it tastes like an amazing cinnamon bun.
review_3_text: Loved their cup bingsu for 40 THB, their Peach soda (30 THB)  is amazing too!
review_4_text: So tasty!
review_5_text: Good Good Good

name: Red Panda Hostel & Cafe
review_1_text:
Red Panda Café & Hostel is an absolute gem in Chiang Mai.

From the moment I arrived, the whole place felt incredibly warm, cozy, and welcoming — the kind of hostel where you instantly feel at home. The atmosphere is calm and comfy, perfect for relaxing after exploring the city.

The staff and service are truly exquisite. Everyone is friendly, attentive, and genuinely cares about the guests. They even helped me organize transportation to Mon Jam, which made the trip completely stress-free and easy — a huge plus!

The bedding deserves a special mention: the laundry was spotless, fresh, and super comfortable. It’s one of those small details that makes a big difference, and here it was done perfectly.

On top of all that, the café is lovely and adds so much character to the hostel. Great vibes, great people, and great service all around.

I would 100% stay here again and highly recommend Red Panda Café & Hostel to anyone looking for a cozy, friendly, and well-run place to stay in Chiang Mai.
review_2_text: This place is amazing! Chonnicha is such a bright, hard working, kind hearted woman (speaks multiply languages also). I have been coming back to this place again and again, because I am so happy with everything. Always clean, charming hostel. The breakfast you can chose and tastes amazing also. They pay attention to details and that everything goes perfectly. I think one if not the best hostel in Ching Mai. Highly recommended for anyone who wants to rest in a safe, clean, charming place.
review_3_text: Highly recommended youth hostel! The place is tastefully decorated, absolutely gorgeous, and has such a vibrant vibe. It’s not just a hostel—it also doubles as a café, and their coffee and drinks are truly delightful. The hostel itself is set in a lovely environment, with spotlessly clean shared bathrooms, incredibly soft beds, and a delicious breakfast. What’s more, the two female staff members are exceptionally warm, outstanding, and dedicated to serving every guest with care. I’ll definitely be coming back again!
review_4_text: 10/10 experience! The vibe was amazing, the beds were comfortable, and everything was clean. The free breakfast served daily was great! The staff went above and beyond to make me feel at home. A huge shoutout to P'Emma, P'Chonnicha, and P'Suthep for their professionalism and hospitality🙌I’ll definitely be back!
review_5_text: After having to flee my previous hostel this was a welcome surprise. It is chic, new and mostly clean! The 4er girl dorm was on the small side so larger backpacks were hard to store out of the way but you even got a little locker for your belongings. Access to the hostel and rooms was by code which was pretty nice! The only downside was that the bathrooms were not that clean and full of ants but apart from that the beds were comfy, complimentary towels were given and there was a daily room clean up service that even made your bed! All in all a great experience minus the bathroom situation which I am sure can be easily improved. Would recommend as a stay away from all the party hostels!

name: MATCHA CABINET
review_1_text: Cozy spot for matcha lovers. Their ceremonial-grade matcha is vibrant and perfectly whisked. Reasonable price for ceremonial-grade quality. Will definitely be back🍵
review_2_text: Matcha is delicious, good quality, good price. Most importantly, the dessert is very delicious. There are outdoor and indoor seats.
review_3_text: Nice shop with a good atmosphere, but it gets very crowded and there aren’t enough tables. The matcha tasted alright — decent, but nothing outstanding.
review_4_text: Wow my wife loved your matcha I think more than me. Thank you for taking her away from me 10/10
review_5_text: I really love this café in Chiang Mai. It has a cozy ambiance with a cream color theme. The matcha latte is exceptionally creamy and flavorful, but a bit more sweetness would make it perfect. There are so many great spots for taking photos, with seating both inside and outside. Highly recommended!✨❤️

name: Yokojung Yogurt
review_1_text: Absolutely loved this yogurt shop in Chiang Mai! The yogurt was incredibly smooth, creamy, and had the perfect amount of tang. We tried their smoothies and an ice cream bowl, and both were fantastic. The ice cream was soooo good—rich yet refreshing—and came with fresh fruit, which we topped with a drizzle of honey. We even took some of their homemade yogurt home because it was that delicious. Friendly atmosphere, great quality, and truly delightful treats. Highly recommend!
review_2_text:
Adjacent to the famous Michelin recommended Khao Soi Maesai, Yokojung yoghurt offers yoghurt bowls, smoothies and coffee in a relaxing space.
The Thai style coffee was intense but not bitter, with a touch of sweetness from the condensed milk. We ordered a lychee strawberry yoghurt shake as well which was good but felt the lychee flavour could have been stronger (perhaps was overpowered by the strawberry too much). A comfortable place to get a drink while waiting in line next door.
review_3_text:
I wish I lived near this place so I could buy their yogurt every morning or enjoy it at home. Their yogurt is excellent and offers great value. They have a variety of options, from regular yogurt to Greek yogurt.

As for the dessert dishes, they come with fresh fruits, other toppings, and free honey. It’s absolutely delicious! Also, the ice cream is refreshing as well.
review_4_text:
A cute yogurt shop in Chiang Mai! They have delicious Greek yogurt and coffee.
We got their Es Yen coffee, and their medium size Greek yogurt bowl that had orange, mango, banana, kiwi, strawberry, and granola on top. They also have honey on the side if you want more sweetness 🐝🍯😋.
review_5_text:
Despite its small size, this restaurant offers a unique and memorable culinary experience. The space is intimate and welcoming, with simple but charming decor that creates a warm atmosphere.

Their specialty is yogurt, made from high-quality fresh milk from dairy farms in northern Thailand. The yogurt is so thick and creamy that it resembles snowballs, a pleasant surprise for those expecting traditional yogurt.

You will also have a choice among a variety of coffees and desserts. Of course, the prices are in correlation with the quality of the products used, but everything is delicious!

name: House no 33 ️
review_1_text: Lovely cafe with a woody, warmly appearance and a familial atmosphere, with a decent amount of sturdy seating, tended to by a bright and friendly bunch. The drinks and cakes are great, and its morning hours on a weekday don't get too busy, with the jazz playing on its speakers always taking centre stage audio-wise. Fantastic spot for some morning bevs and a bit of focus or a chat.
review_2_text: I was staying at a hotel near this café, so I came several times. I love it! The coffee is delicious, and the cookies and cakes are great too. The place is very bright and clean, with pleasant music and comfortable seating.
review_3_text:
This minimalist-style café has a simple and cozy atmosphere, offering a selection of drinks, pastries, and possibly whole cakes for order. I stopped by after having a meal at the restaurant across the street and decided to try some desserts.
The staff were friendly and provided great service. I ordered a scone and a hot chocolate. The hot chocolate was delicious—rich and well-balanced. However, the scone wasn’t quite to my taste. It was generously sized, but the texture inside was a bit too crumbly for my liking.
There are a few seats inside, and while the space isn’t too large, it doesn’t feel cramped. It’s a nice spot to relax with a drink. If you enjoy minimalist cafés with good service, this place is worth checking out!
review_4_text: One of my favourite-favourite cafes in CNX; I only wish I'd discovered it sooner. Beautiful drinks, and the strawberry cake had a wonderful soft, plush crumb and a frosting that wasn't too sweet or overpowering. No need for sweetener in the hot coffee (unless you enjoy sweet coffee, no judgment!) because there's no unpleasant bitterness to be found, nor is it a sour shot. Very balanced. My favourite iced drink--and I tried several, for science!--was the coffee and fresh orange juice, which is seasonal. Presentation is perfection, and by this I mean that not only is it aesthetically charming with the cups and stickers, but they even open a tab on the iced drink lid for smooth, easy straw insertion. It's not necessary, but I deeply appreciate that level of thoughtful attention to detail. Cafe is mostly quiet, comfortably air conditioned (and there's an air purifier)--perfect place to read, journal, and write letters. Or bring a friend! Seriously, I can't recommend it enough, the quality of the experience and the very reasonable prices had me coming back daily.
review_5_text:
Cosy and clean cafe! Came here to chill as was waiting for the northern food opposite which was packed, surprisingly found another nice place to chill here.
They have quite a wide range of coffee, teas, sofas and a few different varieties of cakes and traditional biscuits.
The coconut latte was just the right taste and creaminess, the butter cake is not overpowering buttery, it's soft and moist, perfect to go with the latte.
Coconut cream pie is another nice cake to go with the lattes, the coconut is on a lightly sweet end.

name: Minimal coffee - santitham
review_1_text: Nice atmosphere, good coffee, and friendly staff. Prices are reasonable and the café is very comfortable. Highly recommended!...
review_2_text: Great coffee cute staff and love atmosphere at a great price
review_3_text: Minimal is a good pick up coffee chain in Chiang Mai. This location does not feel as nice as others I have been to probably because others were much newer. The coffee here was still pretty good though.
