review_4_text: The shop is cute  minimalist easy on the eyes good drinks affordable price good service staff
review_5_text: Smooth tasty coffee and good service too. Had a latte and one of the best in Chiang Mai. Thank you! 😋 minimal seating as the name suggests, presume it's mainly for takeaways. Recommend.

name: Chapterone/cm
review_1_text: Lovely little coffee shop! Very pretty and aesthetic. Quiet and peaceful for working and has great internet. Staff was so friendly and kind. We enjoyed the honey garlic chicken, gochujang chicken, paprika french fries, iced latte and iced peach tea. There is a variety of seating upstairs in addition to what is available downstairs. Larger tables for 6 people if you are coming with friends, a nice sofa if you'd like a very comfy seat, plus good tables if you need a sturdy surface for study/work.
review_2_text:
Nice minimalist Cafe, pleasant interior theme and calming music ideal of chats or even getting some work done.
Great atmosphere and friendly staff. Nice coffee. Average prices.
Wish they could have some nicer bakery items.
review_3_text: Pretty nice cafe with reasonable prices. 2nd floor is much bigger and it’s well spaced out. However the seats are limited. You may wanna check if your seat is available before ordering your drink here. Cappuccino here is 55k and it was good. There is a pubic bathroom right outside and it’s very clean.
review_4_text:
It is always a shame when businesses waste customers time with misinformation.

Wrong information both live and online in GoogleMaps. This coffee shop should open 8:30am every day. I was there at 8:40, ready to do some work, but place was dead empty.

Boardgame evenings here are fun though.
review_5_text:
Very clean and quiet space to work. The matcha latte was delicious and the staff was so helpful and friendly. Will definitely come back 🤍

They also have board games to play upstairs (:

name: alga.cafe
review_1_text:
The cafe features stunning architecture and interior design with beautifully coordinated materials. It creates the ambiance of being in a cozy shelter—cool and inviting with a warm atmosphere. The wait was a bit long due to their meticulous preparation, but the coffee is delicious. The latte is exceptionally good and aromatic.
​​​​​​​
review_2_text: Passed by this cafe on my way to lunch. It’s air conditioned, empty and had a minimalist environment. Got a pear latte less sweet (thb85) to try, love how the coffee was pretty strong and not overpowered by the milk. The pear syrup also went nicely with the coffee, adding a hint of sweetness but not cloying. Highly recommend as a pit stop in the hot weather!
review_3_text:
A great little cafe just north of Chiang Mai's old city. Alga serves fantastic coffee and cakes. Staff are friendly and the decor is beautiful. From the outside the view of the cafe is stunning and this is matched by the design on the inside. Highly recommended!
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
review_4_text:
Cleanest bathroom in a cafe- Ever.
Free wifi, comfy seats (inside) and good coffee (had the oatmilk latte with dark roast which was was smooth and balanced).
review_5_text: We had pear latte, ice americano and banoffee. That was great. Lots of parking space, indoor and outdoor seating.

name: So good coffee & smoothie
review_1_text:
Perfect place for a drink stop (takeaway or small sit in place) while waiting for a table at the famous Michelin Khao Soi Maesai up the road.
The passionfruit yoghurt smoothie was a perfect blend of creaminess, sweetness and refreshing tangy flavour. So so delicious and the staff were super friendly too!
Would be keen to try other drinks including the mango, blueberry or mixed berry yoghurt smoothies.
review_2_text: I tried their mixed berries smoothie and it was so good! 🍓Perfect balance of sweet and tangy, super refreshing, and you can really taste the fresh fruits. The staff were very friendly and welcoming, which made the visit even better. Price was really affordable too, great value for such quality! Definitely a spot I’d come back to again. 💕
review_3_text: Amazing coffee, delicious smoothies (the avocado/banana/yoghurt smoothie is going to sustain you for a while), great prices and the owner is so lovely. Small businesses like this are the best part of exploring a city 💗 I’ve been coming here every morning while in Chiang Mai. Thank you so much.
review_4_text: Great spot for a take away coffee or smoothie! It’s very small, so not much of a dine-in place. The service and prices are excellent. So far I’ve just had an Orange Americano. I love that they use real orange juice rather than syrup like some places. Will definitely be back.
review_5_text: This is hands down my favorite smoothie spot in Chiang Mai. I come here often, and the quality is always consistent fresh ingredients, well-balanced flavors, and smoothies that genuinely make you feel good afterward. The space is calm and welcoming, perfect for starting the day or taking a quiet break. It’s one of those places that quickly becomes part of your routine. If you’re in Chiang Mai and appreciate good smoothies, good energy, and consistency, this spot is a must.

name: PerSimmon Café
review_1_text: Beautiful little coffee shop - very chill ambience and fantastic coffee along with yummy soft cookies.
review_2_text: What a gorgeous find in Chiang Mai! A stones throw from where I am staying. They serve delicious coffee and have a cat (perfect combo) also they sell local ground coffee so I can enjoy the coffee elsewhere too. Such a cute place really quirky and reminds me of home cafes.
review_3_text:
Laid back coffee shop with AC.  Nice coffee and good value.  Inside and outside seating
We had Lattes
review_4_text: Stumbled upon this hidden gem around the corner with coconut ice cream and a nostalgic & relaxed atmosphere 😎
review_5_text: My favorite coffee shop in the old city! Great coffee and lovely people working there☺️

name: Dee Cafe
review_1_text:
Dropped by Dee Cafe and was pleasantly surprised. Their coffee is really aromatic, smooth and strong enough to perk you up. I had the orange Americano—the coffee is quite intense, but it is to my liking. If you prefer something lighter, you can actually ask them to adjust with less coffee and more fresh orange juice—they’re happy to tweak it for your taste.

The raisin Danish puff pastry was nicely done—crispy outside, soft inside, not too sweet, just right.

But the one that really stood out was the coconut cake. Super soft, moist, and topped with a thick layer of coconut cream with actual coconut flesh inside. It’s rich but not jelak—seriously good!

The cafe itself is cozy and comfortable, perfect spot to chill. I think travellers will find this place worth visiting, especially with their unique drinks and dessert options. Highly recommend trying the ones I mentioned!
review_2_text:
Best matcha and americano coconut in town
Fabrication with fresh coconut with pieces of coconut inside
The owner is very kind
Come on 😍
review_3_text: This is a comfortable little cafe I visit to enjoy a refreshing iced tea or coffee and read a book. The owner is very friendly and makes a great mocha yen. There is comfortable seating, both, inside and outside. The pastries are always fresh. There's also a club card buy 10 get 1 free. That's pretty cool 😎
review_4_text:
Our favorite café in all of Chiang Mai – and probably all of Thailand! 😊

We first visited in April 2024 and loved it so much that we made sure to come back in January 2025.

Don makes the best drinks, and we have so many favorites: - Cappuccino (hot & cold) – perfect every time - Thai Milk Tea – richer and more flavorful than most places, hence the darker color  - Green Tea – made with high-quality tea, you can really taste the difference - Thai Tea Lemon – not on the menu, but Don made it for us, and wow, it was THE BEST - Honey Lemon Soda – so refreshing!

We worked from the café every day, and Don always greeted us with a warm smile – it really felt like home. We’ll miss this place so much in the coming months but can’t wait to come back for more of Don’s amazing creations.

Highly recommend it to anyone in Chiang Mai!
review_5_text: Found a great cafe at Dee Cafe! Dee is mean good! I think this cafe is even more good like extremely cafe😄love it!

name: Small Talk Coffee
review_1_text:
I lived on the opposite side of Chiang Mai…
Still, I rode here nine times just for one thing — their coffee.

Rich. Aromatic. Organic beans brewed with real intention.
No hype. No shortcuts. Just pure quality that hits exactly right.

And the owner…
A truly kind, grounded woman.
Every time I stopped by, we ended up talking about life, the world, everything.
It felt less like a café — more like stepping into calm energy.

This place became my reset button.
My little sanctuary in the middle of the city.

If you want coffee that actually centers you, this is the place.

Small Talk Coffee — where a man comes to breathe.
review_2_text:
Owner was constantly on phone but otherwise kind to us.

Had a mango smoothie (less sweet), and a mango yogurt smoothie normal sweet. Would definitely recommend a touch of sugar, otherwise the smoothie will come out a bit bland / watery tasting. But great price and thus a great value!
review_3_text:
First, I would like to say that the location and the owner were wonderful.  She is super nice.

I did the Google search, and I had to check it out.

I got a hot latte. Yes, I'm that person.  It looked wonderful.  The taste was almost too much milk and not enough coffee flavor. I even brought me some cookies for my afternoon coffee ☕️ 😋

I will come back and get a do over.  👌
review_4_text: Great coffee. Super nice lady that speaks English and can help you find things you need around Chiang Mai. Her family owns the restaurant next door. Very good food.
review_5_text:
My girlfriend and I regularly eat lunch at the buffet next to this cafe, and we always grab a smoothie/coffee after our lunch.

I like to order the Mango, Passion Fruit, and Banana smoothie. Its delicious! I also had a mango smoothie, but I didn't like it as much.  My girlfriend gets a brownie and says that they are the best brownies she's had in Asia.

The staff is always friendly, and it is a great place to meet other travelers. There is also WiFi, but there is only outdoor seating.

I would highly recommend this place to anyone.

name: Hillkoff (Chang Puek)
review_1_text: Coffee lovers dream place. Lol heaven on earth. I always buy my coffee beans here. Either online or when I'm physically here, I have them ship it. They've got a cute coffeeshop as well and it's the best cappu yen I've had. 😂
review_2_text: Nicest coffee store in have seen in Thailand and lived here 10 years. Many Single estate and local coffees from Northern Thailand 🇹🇭 awesome selection of high end espresso machines and accessories😁
review_3_text: If you plan to buy local coffee in Chiang Mai, this is the best place to buy. You can also buy Doichang coffee at a low price.
review_4_text: This place has everything coffee related, from wholesale coffee machines to drip coffee. I was so happy I was able to find coffee filters for my AeroPress!
review_5_text: Hillkoff coffee shop is the best! They have everything you could possibly need. And the staff is very nice and helpful. I highly recommend!

name: A-Roon coffee
review_1_text:
Best coffee in Chang Mai without a doubt. Extraordinary service and perfect quality.
The basque cheesecake was surprisingly delicious.
The barista is a very nice and very polite young man.

Kop khun ka, my friend🙏🏼🫶🏼
review_2_text: By far the best coffee in Chiang Mai so far. Espresso 40 baht is light, fruity, lemon, not bitter at all, made from Arabica beans of the family farm of the owner, a young guy. Don't go elsewhere, highly recommended.
review_3_text: The owner is very friendly and warm.There are many coffee shops in Chiang Mai, but I highly recommend this coffee shop.The owner gave me my favorite cake as a gift.🤭Drinking coffee makes me feel happy.☺️
review_4_text: This is the place for caffee lovers and all these people who want to try excellent caffee for just a fair and affordable price. The owner is a caffee enthusiast and every cup he makes it's really the real deal. It's a MUST when you are visiting Chiang Mai! Thank you for great cup of latte and the positive vibes in your great caffee shop! Appreciate it 🙌
review_5_text: Delicious coffee made with passion. Huge respect to the guy that makes the coffee for smiling and being extremely friendly all the time. This, together with amazing drinks makes this place a must to visit for all coffee lovers.

name: The Highlandner
review_1_text: Absolutely amazing service. I needed to get new gear for trail running - they were very helpful in selecting the right hydration pack and other essentials. I highly, highly recommend runners to stock up on equipment here and to bring all your questions. Great service!
review_2_text: Made for endurance junkies like myself. Terrific curated quality products for mountain and adventure sports. Can refuel with healthy energy bars for next leg of Northern Thailand bike tour of over 2,000 km. Terrific coffee and music to boot. Solid place and good vibes.
review_3_text: Wow impressive store I didn't even know was here. They seem to focus on running. But have biking and swimming stuff too. Everything is high quality so don't expect cheap prices. But very well stocked and knowledgeable English speaking staff.
review_4_text: The boss first of can't speak English properly so can't even understand his accent. And has a real attitude problem.
review_5_text: Not open on Saturday when you say you are. Same experience at CMU store.  Please update the info

name: coffee Let it Be & Beer
review_1_text: The lovely lady running the place makes every Thai Tea from scratch and really cares about her costumers. She also makes clothes and little cute souvenirs herself. The atmosphere is very chill and great to relax there.
review_2_text: A very cozy café with a home-like atmosphere. It is located in the owner’s home, and all of the décor is handmade by the owner, which adds a personal touch. The space is small but peaceful, and we felt welcomed and comfortable during our visit. The owner showed us all the things she made herself. A nice spot to relax and enjoy a quiet café experience. Drinks were priced reasonably and were good.
review_3_text:
I ordered Thai Tea with ice.

A lovely café with a great atmosphere and a charming vintage vibe. It’s a perfect place to relax, run by a lovely couple who are very warm and welcoming.
review_4_text: Such a cute little coffee spot! Really friendly service, great prices and amazing drinks. I was craving Thai milk tea with coffee, despite it on being actually on the menu she was happy to make it! Will be coming back here for sure!
review_5_text: Run by a lovely lady who also runs the seamstress shop. Comfortable chairs and couches and delicious coffee that is served with a heartfelt smile and love.

name: Barneo Dessert Bar
review_1_text:
Such a cozy and charming dessert spot 🧀✨
The cheese pastry was absolutely amazing: served hot, perfectly crispy on the outside, and generously filled with rich, sweet cheese filling. Every bite was incredibly satisfying.

The place itself feels warm and inviting, with lots of beautiful flowers adding a special touch. Everything was clean and well-kept, making the experience even more enjoyable.

A lovely place to relax and treat yourself. I’d definitely come back again!
review_2_text: Loved everything about this café delicious drinks, amazing Cheesecake and desserts, and such a peaceful vibe. Perfect spot to just sit, relax, and escape the city for a while. If you’re in Chiang Mai, you really shouldn’t miss this place.
review_3_text:
Awesome desert bar/cafe!
You must try all the deserts….
The cheesecake and the coconut cake were our favorite!
The cafe is very nicely decorated and the service was excellent.
A must visit in Chiang Mai and free onsite parking….
review_4_text: The owner is very friendly and very attentive,  she even turned on the AC for me when I came in! The matcha lemonade is super delicious, tastes very fresh, and is the perfect amount of sweetness, and the tapioca tastes very fresh and high quality! This is the best boba I’ve had in Thailand so far :) the interior is also very cute and cozy, they have free wifi, and I love how they decorate for Christmas. There’s also cute cats who live nearby. I highly recommend this place if you are in the old city and are looking to relax while drinking refreshing boba tea
review_5_text: Cute and cozy cafe with nice staffs. Waitresses are so friendly and recommended me sincerely. Original and Hokkaido cheesecake are the best in Chiangmai. There are a little sweet, cheesy, salted. Everything are good combination. Couldn’t recommend more!

name: Café Amazon
review_1_text: Best staff in Chiang  Mai in any Amazon .I always friendly, I always start my day with a double espresso , luckily non of those cheap one coffee use free wi fi Nomads here….
review_2_text: It's not a good workspace because there's a 1-hour limit on wifi. The air isn't that good either, perhaps because of the smell from the air conditioner, and the seats are uncomfortable.
review_3_text: You can pour the entire content of a regular cappuccino into a small cappuccino. A complete scam to make an extra 10 Bahts from customers.
review_4_text: I could smell moles…. Tables were very dirty… view in front of a temple was good though
review_5_text: I love their hot americano ☕️, staff is always professional , AC is great, good place to work too or cool down while on road trip

name: The pool Cafe & swimming
review_1_text: Sunday afternoon and 5 pm . Pool I think closes at 7 pm today . What's not to love. Think the restaurant closes at 5pm so nothing ordered. Price was thb50 entrance. I see there is a sign for thb650 for a month which is a consideration for those staying for a long time.
review_2_text: Clean pool with big space and no one here !! Feel like my own place HAHAHA , 50 BHT  swim you can stay as long as you want. Also they selling coffee for good price.
review_3_text: Really cosy space with great coffee and drinks menu. Cafe has really nice chairs and tables to do some work at. 50baht swimming pool entrance and the area is great to relax in or swim laps. Quite deep one end and shallow on the other. There’s also a small swimming pool which is a safer option for young children.
review_4_text: Beautiful swimmingpool and not many people at all.
review_5_text: A great swimming pool.  Only 50bht for as long as you like.  It has a shallow end but is very deep at the other end.  The perfect place to swim or sunbathe on a hot day.  They do have a small cafe.

name: Macnuts Coffee
review_1_text: Hands down the best coffee I’ve had in Thailand!
review_2_text:
We got ourselves Iced Americano and Iced Latte, love it. It's so refreshing and love that the barista is serious about her techniques.

Would come back again.
review_3_text: A coffee shop in the Chang Phuek area. I got a coffee matcha latte and it's nice! Besides, they roasted coffee beans by themselves and also have their house brand cold brew.
review_4_text: Best coffee I've had in Chiang Mai, freshly roasted and brewed, and I always get the best service.
review_5_text: A coffee bar inside a hostel. We stayed on this lively hostel street nearby and spent a wonderful afternoon here, surrounded by the rich aroma of coffee.

name: Speed Addict Society
review_1_text: Great coffee shop where they serve decent drip coffee 107 baht, it's also a Harley Davidson specialist, and though I'm not a motorbike fan, the whole atmosphere is great.
review_2_text: A motorcycle shop with a cafe, selling HD motorcycle accessories, with a lot of products. The motorcycle service is excellent, meticulous, and the prices are reasonable. All the staff are friendly. The coffee is excellent and the price is good. The shop is beautiful and the atmosphere is good. It is not a waste of time to stop by.
review_3_text: Good atmosphere for bikers. Hang out with friends. Also be a modified Harley shop in Chiangmai. Come to check it out. Good taste coffee. Lovely staffs including owner.
review_4_text: Absolutely love this place, great coffee, great price, pool table! Plus bikes bikes bikes
review_5_text: Great little place, friendly staff and good coffee.

name: ACCIO Café
review_1_text: This cafe is a part of a hotel. The space is not big, but I believe you can use the hotel space and you have access to more chairs and tables. I have come to this cafe several times, but it was always closed, so it’s probably inconsistent. The opening hours are also a bit strange that they close at 4pm. Their drinks are not bad though.
review_2_text:
A comfy hotel cafe. A decent place to work for an hour or two. The seats are likely most comfortable for people who are similar in height to Thais.

There is a loft level above the main floor, with floor/counter seating and USB charging ports.

Charming staff and pleasant atmosphere. I'll be back if I'm in the area.
review_3_text: went for a coffee and a cake, it was very good! the staff is really kind, and the place so enjoyable
review_4_text:
Cafe of ISTY Hotel. It's air-con but use the glass wall so always bright and a bit hot till noon. Nevertheless the good place for a sip of coffee and relax. There is a white cat to pat but today she's not here :(.

For a coffee, i ordered the piccolo latte the flavor tends to be a little dark coffee but not bad, recommend to drink with water for a milder tastes
review_5_text: Great coffee. Good place to work. Not busy, but even has a second floor!

name: KAME KAFE (คาเมะคาเฟ่) - ถนนสนามกีฬา
review_1_text:
This small café sits right by the main road, tucked inside a hotel property. We were pleasantly surprised — despite its simple look, the coffee quality was excellent, with a good variety of beans. Drinks like cappuccino and latte were well-balanced and smooth.

We'll definitely be coming back regularly!
review_2_text: Good service and polite staff. The drinks prices are also very reasonable.
review_3_text: This cafe is located in the checkin area of a hotel and things are organized and clean and it feels right. They have a large drink menu. You can choose the roast level of your coffee and I got light one and it was very good. Taiwanese milk tea was also great. One of the best quality drinks around for sure. It seems like a very popular spot for delivery pick ups.
review_4_text: KAME KAFE is perhaps the only cafe I would consider working till late because it’s open till 10:30pm. The only slight (-) is probably the tables and chair, not a lot and can be a little squeaky. Other than that, the air-condition temp is just nice for work environment. I was able to focus well, on top of that, the cafe has cream cheese topping for drinks
review_5_text: I visited Kame Kafe and tried the Coconut Matcha Foam—it was delicious! The service was really nice and the staff were friendly. Great atmosphere overall. I definitely recommend this place!

name: Rich coffee house
review_1_text: The lemon cake here is just sublime. Moist cake layers, perfect structure, tartness just the way I like it, and the cake is light to the taste. Absolutely a place to release your craving for cakes or sweets. The cafe also oversees the water and the coming traffic in a serene way, good place to spend time at.
review_2_text:
True masters of espresso. This is one of those rare places where every step of the process is done with precision and respect for the craft. You can choose between a medium roast Thai–Laos blend or a dark roast Thai blend — both roasted and extracted perfectly.

Each bean type has its own dedicated grinder, calibrated to deliver exactly 15 grams of coffee. After dosing, the barista uses WDT needles to evenly distribute the grounds, followed by a leveler and tamper for perfect consistency. The extraction is spot-on: 30 ml in precisely 30 seconds.

The result? A flawless almond-colored crema, a cup that’s neither overheated nor under-extracted — just beautifully balanced and full of character. Every espresso is served with a small glass of water (I’d personally suggest a slightly smaller one, since it’s meant just to cleanse the palate — but that’s a minor, personal note).

For this level of attention to detail and repeatable perfection, you could easily compete with some of the best espresso bars in Italy or Portugal.

And honestly — if I had to choose anyone’s espresso (apart from my own 😉) — I’d choose yours!
Congratulations, Rich Coffee House — truly exceptional work.
review_3_text: Cozy little cafe with open seating for few, cheerful staff. Ham-cheese was great, latte was nice, a bit dark for a latte. Cakes were fresh. Macademia cheesecake was great! There is a detergent-included laundromat right next door. Takes about 45 mins. So it's convenient to get the laundry done while getting a coffee here. It does tend to get busy.
review_4_text:
Good mood and lovely bakery!
The cake was incredibly soft and tasted delicious.

I tried the Brown Sugar Thai Tea cake (though I can’t quite recall the exact name), and it exceeded my expectations. It was soft, smooth, and not overly sweet. The brown sugar jelly inside paired beautifully with the cake, creating a delightful combination.
review_5_text: Excellent coffee with an AC room with balcony. I appreciate that the staff turns on AC for me even though I was the only one there. All staff are courteous and kind. Great view! Thank you for the relaxing moment.

name: FLOW
review_1_text:
Came here today for coffee..lovely coffee, great vibes and the nicest people work there!! Met some really good people ❤️❤️🙏

Definitely support a local business and drop in!🥰🙏

Oh, and they have the CUTEST cat!! And it has a bandana!!!😍😍
review_2_text: Great modest cafe with great coffee. The owner even asked me if I wanted dark or medium roast! The only fault was the total absence of any sugar or sweetener, only their local honey looking sirop that I never tasted. I recommend!
review_3_text: Affordable and good coffee for pick up. Not much acidity level and they don’t have light roast beans.
review_4_text: Awesome little cafe and bar! Open from 10 - midnight! Dope and cheap. 50 baht coffees. I suggest the peach tea!
review_5_text:
Coffee quality is good.
There are some seats at the store if customers want to drink at the shop.

name: Cat Brothers Cafe
review_1_text: Atmosphere is rated 100 stars out of 5. Cats look happy and very content :)
review_2_text: This is my second time visiting this cafe, i do it every time I'm in Chiang Mai. Entrance is 120 baht and you get a drink of your choice and an hour with the cats. I also recommend buying treats for the cats for 20 baht per serving. This portion is enough to feed several cats and they will happily come to you for food. All the cats are clean and beautiful. I highly recommend visiting this place 🙏🏼👍🏼
review_3_text:
Our first time at a "cat" cafe was overall enjoyable. When we went, 140 Thai Baht got you 1 hour in the cat play room and a drink (coffee, juice, etc). I recommend paying the additional 20 Thai Baht for the cat treats, as the cats will FLOCK to you for the treats and it makes for a better experience, in my opinion.

The cats were so adorable and playful! The staff kindly told us not to interact with the aggressive cats, who wear little red bowties.

Of course, the cat play room does smell quite a bit like a litter box, but what else can you expect? Also note, you will be asked to take of your shoes before entering the cat play room.

If you have an hour to kill and are looking for some coffee, check this place out!
review_4_text:
I had a great time at Cat Brothers Cafe! This is a really well-organized space with a fantastic concept - a cat cafe where the cats are well taken care of and always supervised by a staff member. The entrance fee of 120 baht is a fair price, and it includes a drink. You can also buy treats to feed the cats, which is a lot of fun.

The cafe is clean and comfortable, and there are plenty of places to sit and relax while you enjoy the company of the cats. The cats are friendly and playful, and it's clear that they are very well-cared for. The staff member supervising the cats and visitors is always on hand to make sure that everything is running smoothly.

I also appreciated the fact that the cafe is well-ventilated and doesn't smell like a typical animal cafe. It's clear that the owners have taken great care to create a space that is comfortable for both the cats and the visitors.

Overall, I would highly recommend Cat Brothers Cafe to anyone who loves cats or just wants to have a fun and unique experience while in Chiang Mai. It's a well-organized and well-managed space that is a joy to visit.
review_5_text: I didn't come here for the food but to see the cats. The entry fee is 120 thb, and for that, you get a free drink included. The cat food is 20thb if you want to feed them. There are a lot of cats and they are very cute. Most of them were sleeping, but two were awake and wanting to be fed. They love the liquid paste. If you are a cat person you will love this place. It's not a big place, though. The cats are upstairs, and there is a downstairs area if you want to drink without the cats.

name: Light Up Cafe
review_1_text:
Great spot for a quick eat or takeaway coffee.  We ordered iced lattes and americanos daily; both were great and served within minutes of ordering.

Food is basic, but who doesn’t love a ham and cheese toasty/ croissant when on the go.
review_2_text: Mill cream croissant is different from the picture. I ordered from Lineman and it showed like the cream is made with good quality but in reality the cream inside is whipping cream. And Matcha shake has no taste of matcha at all. Only tastes like milk.
review_3_text: Good breakfast options for a quick solution, coffee is good and service is fast
review_4_text: Chic cafe offering coffees, smoothies, pizzas, cakes and finger food. They no  longer serve steaks despite what the signage says. The interior is cosy and attracts local undergrads. Their coffee and smoothies seem to be a huge hit looking at the number of patrons each day. Staff is very friendly and helpful. One speaks good English and very accommodating. I think you can book the second floor for meeting or YouTube shoots if you ask.
review_5_text:
Quick, friendly, delicious tea.
They used too much ice though, so was hard to get the jelly.
Beautiful street frontage.
Many people stopped to take a photo.
Small space, so wouldn't be ideal for working or taking too long.

name: ตุ้ยต๊ะโต ขนมหวาน ของหวาน
review_1_text:
the atmosphere makes me feel like at home
foods are very good
must try when you are in Chiang Mai ❤️
review_2_text: This place is SOOOO good!! Not far from the old city and totally worth it to pop over for a light sweet treat!!! Go go go!!!
review_3_text: Very nice and stylish place. We tried the coffee drinks, soda and desert and all was very good. Try the shortbread, it was amazing. Very pleasant!
review_4_text: The jelly in sweet syrup and plum juice is delicious and refreshing. The Taiwanese-style pies are also very tasty. Everything tastes great and is priced at 40 baht each. The shop is cute, clean, and comfortable.
review_5_text:
This is a small shop, but the desserts here are delicious. There aren't many options, only about 4-5 kinds, but they are all delicious. They are refreshing and tasty, and the prices are not expensive.
这家店虽然很小，但店里的甜点非常好吃。选择不多，只有4-5种，但都很美味。吃起来清爽可口，价格也不贵。

name: Kanoon Cafe & Bistro
review_1_text: When in Chiang Mai, this hidden gem is a must-visit. Their matcha coconut drink is incredibly delicious – it'll make your taste buds explode! The place is adorable, the food is amazing, don't miss it! Very Enjoy!
review_2_text: Kanoon Cafe & Bistro is a gem! I visited around 5 pm, and even though they closed at 5:30, they were incredibly accommodating, letting us enjoy our meal in a relaxing environment until 6 pm. The mixed juice was incredibly tasty, and the mixed fruit waffle was simply yummy. The environment is so cozy, making it a perfect spot to unwind.  The best part? It's Halal! They offer a fantastic selection of dishes, including beef, chicken, Khao Soi, and curries. The staff was friendly and attentive, adding to the overall positive experience.  If you're looking for a delicious meal in a welcoming atmosphere, Kanoon Cafe & Bistro is a must-visit. Highly recommended!
review_3_text: Clean restaurant that serves amazing food. Best meat skewer I had in Thailand by far. Halal and friendly staff
review_4_text: Really enjoy the vibe.. so serene..the food also delicious.. and the service .. 👍🏻the best..
review_5_text: A beautiful with relaxing ambience cafe. Filled with greenery and colourful flowers. Nice coffee.

name: บ้านทองดีคาเฟ่ Baan Thongdee cafe’
kurokuro.coffee.roaster
review_1_text: Such a lovely little coffee shop tucked away next to the temple, it’s a real hidden gem. The coffee was delicious and the Tiramisu latte was especially amazing. The cafe has such a cute, cosy, cat themed vibe that instantly makes you feel welcome. I’ll definitely be back tomorrow for another coffee and to sample one of their bakes because the tiramisu, brownies and cheesecake all looked incredible. A really sweet spot that’s well worth a visit. ☕🐾🍰
review_2_text: Today we are at Kurokuro Coffee in Chiangmai. We ordered two cappuccinos with oat milk and two cakes. The cappuccino tastes very good. Cake also tastes good, but there is nothing to come to this café for. The café itself is small, very friendly, quiet and relaxed. The two young people who work in this café are very very nice but they are pretty much all in Thailand... we can really recommend the café to everyone who visits the city. It's already something special.
review_3_text:
Lovely little coffee shop with intimate atmosphere. The staff/owners are very kind. High quality coffee for low price. Cozy to sit and chill, read, have a relaxed conversation. Free drinking water.
Just good laidback vibes - will come again when I am in Chiang Mai.
review_4_text: A truly lovely little café! It’s a bit hidden, but that’s part of its charm. The coffee is absolutely delicious  and the cakes are fresh and tasty. The staff are very friendly and welcoming, making you feel right at home. A real hidden gem for anyone who loves great coffee and a cozy atmosphere!
review_5_text:
I'm kind of envious of those who can enjoy coffee at Kurokuro right now 😭
I tried Dirty Coffee in Udon Thani at the best-rated coffee shop in the city ("Dose Coffee" - never again!) for almost twice the price of Kurokuro. And you know what? I'm deeply disappointed. I hope to come to Chiang Mai someday to have another amazing coffee here... Thanks so much to the staff! They're so welcoming and play great music. I miss them already, oh my! 🎶❤️

name: Valentier Cafe and Hotel
review_1_text: Very pleasant basic hotel with everything you need and no surprises. Located in a busy area, but in a quiet, peaceful lane. Very kind, helpful owners. Excellent value.
review_2_text:
Perfect location
The staff is very king
Amazing value for money in total
The room are clean
We were at five different hotels in Thailand and this hotel’s shower is the best we had here
We will definitely come again
review_3_text:
I had the best time in this hotel.
The hotel owner was really nice.
It was quiet and clean, and everyone on staff was friendly and quiet.
The bathroom was clean.
And it has a reasonably sized swimming pool.
It is also close to the Tha phae Gate.
If I come back to Chiang Mai, I will book this hotel.

One thing to note is, there is something like a mechanical sound in the room.
If you are sensitive to noise, you should be careful.
review_4_text:
This is my first time staying in Chiang Mai, and it was the perfect place to do so. It was so good that I stayed there for over two months.
The location is perfect, in a relatively quiet neighborhood within the old city. The place is close to everything I needed. The design of the hotel is clean, pleasant and calm, including a pool for those interested.
The room suited all needs, including a table and a comfortable chair when I needed to work.
But the most important thing is the people who run the place. Lovely people who helped with everything I needed, gave me a feeling of home.
A place I would like to return to
review_5_text: Nice and clean accommodation in a good location. Booking via booking.com was overpriced. In my opinion, there is no point in booking a room by the pool for a higher price. The room was very dark and small. The pool was also small and can only be used during the day. I really appreciate the cleanliness.

name: TWO - โท: Bed and Cafe
review_1_text: The cafe' is so amazing, I love your style black and white that's really cool. Coffee so good, Staff they're so nice and friendly. So quite cafe' i meaning is a little bit private.
review_2_text: Had a perfect stay and beautiful hospitality from our friends. Delicious food and coffees.
review_3_text: Their drink are very created and intend for every menus. More photo corner you'll fall in love this space. Really recommend !
review_4_text:
Minimal style and very clean room.
Breakfast better than we think.
Mind service, very well suggestion.
So appreciate !!!
review_5_text: cozy in minimal style. Their drink is quite good. So chill and warm.

name: Fruit Plus+ Cafe
review_1_text: Wawa makes all her smoothie / acai bowl fresh to order, soo healthy and taste so good. Her homemade salad dressing is amazing. Wawa is the owner and she really has put her heart and soul into trying new ways to perfect her acai bowls. She prides herself on health food for a healthy body! The best 💛😊
review_2_text: Very nice avocado and eggs on toast, for those days when you just don’t feel like Thai food. Super chill vibes, sit outside and watch the world go by.
review_3_text: The best acai bowl I have ever tasted, and it will be hard to beat this one. Not just the taste, but the bowl looked insane! Will miss this place!
review_4_text: Super friendly staff. Amazing options for fresh juices, smoothies, smoothie bowls, coffees. Came back daily.
review_5_text: The food was so amazing, so healthy and clean. Perfect to seat while enjoying the ambiance. A lot of options for vegetarian and vegan💛

name: Lady Bake
review_1_text: Cute, quiet cafe with quick service. I tried the orangano, the orange juice was super fresh and delicious. Nice tasting espresso as well. For food I tried the just breakfast platter, simple but delicious and has everything you need.
review_2_text: Great breakfast spot, lovely cafe! I came this morning and had an iced latte and a warm pastry and it was so good. My dad had the full breakfast and it was huge and all cooked fresh. Capper the dog is so cute too, I definitely recommend :)
review_3_text: Nice, quiet cafe! Good place for a full breakfast, which my son enjoyed. I had eggs on toast--eggs were nice and fluffy. Relaxed atmosphere, perfect place to people watch as they walk by or to read read quietly.
review_4_text:
I ordered mushroom bread with cream cheese and a lemonade.

The bread came with almost no cream cheese, nothing like in the picture. I suggest that if they don’t have enough cream cheese, they should offer customers the option to order something else.

The lemonade, which cost 70 baht, came in a small cup and wasn’t even filled to the top.

The food tastes good, though.
review_5_text: Delicious tuna melts! Came here many times for all their sandwiches. The salmon egg one is also very good. Coffees and juices are nice too! Nice sitting area and self service/order and pay at the bar.

name: Soi Dog Blues
review_1_text: The Soi Dog Blues bar is a fantastic bar to visit, great atmosphere and music. The owners and staff are very welcoming. I attended a Sunday night jam session, got up to play and had a wonderful time. The standard of musicianship was very good. It was a totally enjoyable evening with friendly people and great conversations. The only bar in Chiang Mai where you can listen to great blues and soul music.
review_2_text:
At last I got to Soy Dog blues bar and was it worth it.   A proper sized bar for bands, excellent service and a great range of cocktails.  Snacks were good too.

Plenty of room for a performing band and seating inside and out.  Very clean and professionally run.  I will certainly be back.

Tonight I was there to see and hear Moat Rats who were pretty damn good too.

Highly recommended for music and good drinks.
review_3_text:
Loved spending the evening here! The service, drinks, atmosphere, and live blues music were all excellent 😊 Tonight was my second visit, and I loved it just as much as the first. You really don’t feel like leaving early! The hosts, artists, and guests all share a genuine love for good music, which makes the place feel so warm and welcoming.
If you enjoy real blues, this cozy little bar in Chiang Mai is a must-visit. Great sound, friendly people, and talented musicians — perfect spot for a relaxed, music-filled evening. 🎶🍸
review_4_text:
I am a blues guitar player who spent years playing in the US (Simsbury, CT area), and I know the difference between a tourist attraction and a real musical home. Last year, I visited the famous jazz spots in Chiang Mai (like North Gate) and honestly, I was disappointed. It felt like a circus—crowded, hyped, and technically skilled but lacking genuine spirit. I was searching for 'the pocket,' not a show.

Then I found Soi Dog Blues Bar. From the moment I saw the photos, I felt a warmth that the other places lacked. I grabbed my cheap guitar and headed over for the Sunday Open Jam.

I met Mark, the owner—a genuine American gentleman who sets the tone for the whole room. He got me on the list immediately. No ego, no 'interrogation,' just music. I plugged in for a 12-bar shuffle in C, threw in my signature lines, and instantly connected with the band. As I've always said, you can know someone in a few seconds of jamming better than days of talking.

If you are a musician looking for a 'monkey scene' or Instagram hype, go elsewhere. But if you are looking for authentic blues, a welcoming community, and a place that feels like home (even if you just moved to Charoen Mueang like me), this is the place. I’ve played three nights so far, and I’m just getting started. Real blues lives here.
review_5_text: A new venue in Chiang Mai live music scene. The staff is welcoming and attentive. The sound is really good making a nice experience to listen to jazz. It's overall a good experience!

name: Jue Kim
review_1_text: Great coffees, Khun Jane is really friendly and speaks excellent English, and there's a cute dog too! Can be hard to find with Grab, go to the nearby guesthouse at Wishes Hotel and walk.
review_2_text: Such a lovely cafe, gorgeous interior and great energy for a relaxing morning coffee. Nice quiet location, and very friendly owner (with the cutest dog!!) :)
review_3_text: Recommends Jeu kim cafe!!! Thai tea&Dirty that so impressive.Best Thai tea forever! Absolutely worth trying! P.s.Khaonueng soooooo cute🤩
review_4_text:
This is exactly what an ideal coffee shop should be. The vibe is incredibly chill. You can relax at the bar and chat with the owner for as long as you like. By the way, the owner is super friendly and a multiple barista competition winner!

Alternatively, you and your friends can simply enjoy the coffee and savor the supremely relaxing environment. From what I understand, the building used to be a Chinese drugstore owned by the owner's grandparents. This history gives the place a charmingly retro vibe. And of course, the coffee itself is also excellent.
review_5_text:
The owner is really sweet and friendly, the drinks are delicious, the place and atmosphere is beautiful & their dog is so so cute💫
I've been here twice in the span of 1 week!

name: 8To18 Breakfast&Brew
review_1_text:
Ice Americano 10/10

Double shot of espresso over ice 10/10

Rosemary salt bagel with cream cheese egg and mayo 10/10

Seasonal fruit 10/10 (we have wanted just fruit, no added anything, for a while - happy this place has it!)

Mom and pop shop
Free WiFi
Clean
Cleansing wipes on table
Indoor and out door seating
Resident cat on a leash
Music is not loud, and great playlist! (I'm surprised actually how well the volume is)

Got here at 8:25am. Zero wait. Seat your self.

Everyone here is incredibly kind, portion sizes are big. Prices are more than reasonable! I'll be coming back.

------

I went back the next day to try the French toast and egg Sando. Again good stuff!
review_2_text:
I visited this place for brunch and was pleasantly surprised. The pancakes were delicious—fluffy, flavorful, and definitely the highlight of my visit. The atmosphere is simple, nothing fancy, but comfortable enough to enjoy a relaxed meal.

I also loved the small detail of having wet wipes on the tables, which is both practical and thoughtful. On top of that, the staff was very attentive and friendly, making the overall experience even better. A great spot if you’re looking for a tasty, no-frills brunch.

The only thing I’d recommend improving is the cleanliness of the restroom 🚽.
review_3_text: So happy to have found this cafe! They open early, serve delicious homemade dishes with quality and fresh ingredients. Great variety and huge portions. Their homemade bread is so yummy and same for their chocolate sauce and iced chocolate. Also love their pancakes. Family run, super nice and welcoming and there's acute little cat. Will definitely come back :)
review_4_text: We visited this brunch spot two days in a row and absolutely loved it. We ordered the bacon pancakes and the seasonal fruit, and everything was fresh and delicious. I can also recommend the French toast!! The interior is minimalist with a really warm and welcoming atmosphere. On top of that, the guy working there was incredibly friendly and made us feel right at home. I can highly recommend this place and would definitely come back!
review_5_text:
We had the best bagels and hot cocoa so far in Chiang Mai!

The bagels are homemade, crispy on  the outside and soft and chewy on the inside. The ingredients are fresh and tasty. The scrambled eggs are fluffy and yummy.

Hot chocolate is creamy and thick with just the right amount of sweetness!

The restaurant doesn’t look fancy, it’s a normal home-type Thai place, so if you are looking for an Instagram picture there is none, except the actual food pic!

And they also have a super cute cat that you can pet ❤️

name: Anyway Cafe (Book Cafe)
review_1_text:
Anyway Cafe is such a lovely café and definitely one of my all-time favorites. ☕📚
I highly recommend everyone to stop by. The location is great, and there are free books for you to enjoy while relaxing in the café.
A perfect place to slow down and spend some quiet time. 💫
review_2_text: Such as a nice cozy and homey book cafe. There’re full of great translation books and thai fictions. And also lots of rotation workshops and activities that you might enjoy💙
review_3_text:
I love the shop and they have cool books, both for sale and swapping!

The space is nice to sit and work! Thai milk tea is the best :-)
review_4_text:
An absolutely beautiful small cafe with a very local feel. A perfect place to come and get some work or admin done. I came here twice during my stay in Chiang Mai and both times had delicious drinks and friendly staff. Prices are quite decent as well.

They also hold workshops from time to time (they invited me to a flower arrangement workshop but I unfortunately couldn’t make it).

They have books for sale, books to swap and just books to read as well.
review_5_text: First thing I stumbled into in Chiang Mai and already the best place ever! Such a cute bookstore and café with all the right values and nice people :))

name: หมูทอดอาม่า - Moo Tod Ama
review_1_text:
A hidden gem!
I ordered an omelette through food grab and it was delicious, well packaged and great value. I decided to come here to check it out and wasn’t disappointed. Extremely cleanly presented, modern and a relaxed atmosphere. The food is fresh, delicious and great value. This place is on par with any similar good cafe back home at a third of the price.
Highly recommend you try this place out
review_2_text:
Went for breakfast. The restaurant was empty but we were greeted by a friendly staff.
Food was made fresh and rather yummy. The black coffee was not strong enough though.
BLT sandwich was good but I feel that it's a little pricey.
The atmosphere of the restaurant was cosy. Overall, a good place for early breakfast.
review_3_text: The food here was super yummy, good price and the sandwich was really tasty- the bread wasn't sweet, and it was a really good size. I also got a chai latte with coffee that was tasty and enjoyed the fruit bowl with yogurt- although the yogurt was a very liquid consistency. I will come back :)
review_4_text: Had an amazing brunch at Moo Tod Ama! The food was delicious and portion sizes were generous. We ordered one bacon toast and one fried garlic rice with pork, which easily satisfied three people. The staff was super friendly and provided excellent service. Highly recommend this place for a delightful brunch experience!
review_5_text: Cozy and good vibe restaurant, feel liked home. The staff are gentle and amazing service. Clean food, good taste, cheap price. It's worth coming here once I were in Chiangmai. Absolutely to visit again. ❤️❤️

name: Refine Coffee Roaster.TCDC
review_1_text: The mocha was beautifully balanced — rich, smooth, and comforting without being too sweet. Paired with their homemade desserts, it created the perfect little moment of calm. The staff were kind and welcoming, adding to the cozy vibe that makes the place feel a bit like home.
review_2_text:
A lovely little coffee spot with a cozy and refreshing vibe. 🌿
The atmosphere is relaxed and inviting, surrounded by greenery — perfect for a peaceful break or a casual meet-up.
The staff are friendly and welcoming, making you feel right at home. Whether you’re grabbing a quick coffee to go or staying to enjoy it in the garden, it’s a great place to recharge.
review_3_text: Cute cafe with friendly owner. The coffees are good and the service is really excellent.
review_4_text: My friend told me to try Refine coffee. So when I flew from USA I stop by Refine coffee and it is as good as my friend advertised. Coffee aroma is amazing and the barista Karn told me about the Rose Soda, very refreshing.
review_5_text: Great little Cafe, walked past it many times.  So clean and bright inside.  As you can see from the pictures.  There opening sign is there mascot, who on first entering greeted us.  "So Cute". Staff were very friendly.   Will be back again soon thank you.

name: Café Amazon คาเฟ่ อเมซอน ปตท.ช้างม่อย
review_1_text: They are open from 6 a.m. to 6 p.m. every day.

name: Boonrawd cuisine
review_1_text: Incredible Thai food in a quirky, eccentric decor! The food was mind blowing ! ( a little slow for service but so so so worth it) some of the best Thai food we ever had ! Highly recommend.
review_2_text: Service a bit slow. Food's fine. Liked the crab curry. Pretty presentation.  A nice place with history. Same place as the Sync Cafe. Asked for coriander with roe salad. Told no roe then but would give a discount if it's still wanted. Said ok. Got 10% reduction on that item.
review_3_text: 6/23 great cafe! Congee was delicious and fresh. Thai curry was also fresh and good. Good prices. Perfect open in the morning on the way back from the bus station.
review_4_text: Cute restaurant near the phae gate, offering good drinks and delicious khao soi, along with other dishes. Friendly staff and good prices!
review_5_text: Chill vibe and fresh, clean Thai cuisine at very reasonable prices. Low key place.

name: ON THE WAY CAFE @ Jang Sri Poom
review_1_text:
Stepping into On the Way Cafe @ Jan Sri Poom was an absolute delight. It quickly became my favorite Chiang Mai stop. I was immediately struck by the truly calming atmosphere. The interior design thoughtfully uses soft, warm lighting, natural wood tones, and lush greenery, creating a peaceful escape from the city bustle. It’s the perfect environment whether you need to focus on work, enjoy a quiet read, or simply unwind. I happily spent several hours here and felt completely relaxed and welcome.
Beyond the aesthetics, the service here is genuinely top-tier. Every member of the team is exceptionally friendly, attentive, and clearly passionate about their craft. They were patient in explaining different brewing methods and offered excellent recommendations tailored precisely to my preferences. My order was served quickly, always with a genuine smile, which truly elevated the entire visit.
The menu boasts an impressive variety of cold and hot drinks, catering to every possible craving imaginable. I first tried their signature iced latte, which was perfectly balanced and refreshing, and later enjoyed a rich, expertly crafted hot chocolate. They also frequently have unique seasonal specials and a fantastic selection of teas. This cafe is a must-visit gem—a rare combination of superb quality, peaceful ambiance, and five-star hospitality. Recommended!
review_2_text:
Happened to pass by this cafe and saw this big Thai tea sign with the price (35 baht!), so I went in and tried it. Safe to say I finally found the best Thai milk tea in Chiang Mai! Yassss! 🤩

P.S. i always ask for less sugar
review_3_text:
This is a great little place. Modern and clean. Note - they ONLY sell hot and cold drinks - the lovely looking macaroons are only for decoration 😂.
Great coffee and Thai tea.  Most drinks are only 35 bhat.
review_4_text:
Nice cafe, chill spot with good prices.
Perfect for a relaxing break!
review_5_text: Cute place to grab a drink and cool down. Very kind staff!

name: Dollar Coffee
review_1_text: Fantastic coffee. Cheap and great quality. The sweet older lady who owns it is exceptionally kind and speaks great english. I started going regularly and she would bring me food for free every now and then — egg, chinese black bean moon cake. Really lovely lady and really great coffee. Great place to do work or just relax
review_2_text: A cozy, family-owned café that opens early. It’s the perfect spot to enjoy a cup of coffee and soak in the tranquil atmosphere of Old Chiang Mai before the city fully wakes up.
review_3_text: Nice lemon and passion juice and the place is very calm and clean. Nice people and atmosphere, plus they open early in the morning
review_4_text:
Right next to historical Sriphum corner of moat surrounding the walled old city of Chiang Mai, this Dollar Cafe is located on main moon Muang road. Run by two inspiring dedicated women, range of coffee and other drinks including coconut and sandwiches like tuna cheese sandwich are all amazing. Very reasonably priced (35 baht onwards sandwich for example), neat and clean cafe. It has indoor air conditioned seating as well as outdoor covered open air seating as per preference of guest.

Recommended.
review_5_text: Nice little quiet place open early staff are so nice. Nice to sit inside and watch the traffic go by on a cold Chiang Mai winter’s morning.

name: Kuro Kuro Boba
review_1_text: Very cute place, perfect coconut matcha 👌🏻
review_2_text:
Very sweet coffee store ☺️☺️ In the backyard waits tiny cats to cuddle. Also the coffee tastes wonderful ☕️

A great place to relax with a coffee in the backyard.
review_3_text: the founder is so sweet! and the latte is to die for. oh dont forget to order the banana cakes. so delightful
review_4_text:
I've been in Chiang Mai for two weeks now and every day I've been here for morning coffee. I made a mistake once and went to a different place which I regret. That says a lot. Best coffee shop in town.

Also they three(?) beutiful cats walking around! And many vegan milk options.
review_5_text:
They no longer serve Boba :(

But they have coffee, matcha and so on

name: T-Koff Coffee
review_1_text: Very nice iced coffee. 45 baht.
review_2_text: Good coffee👍
review_3_text:
I've been to T-Koff Coffee several times now, and each time it's been a delight. I particularly like the Iced Thai Coffee Tea. It's intense, aromatic, and simply unique. You rarely find something like it.

The owner is incredibly friendly, always in a good mood, and makes you feel immediately welcome. It's one of those places where you'll want to stay because everything is just right: the taste, atmosphere, and heart.

If you don't stop by, you're really missing out!
review_4_text:
Very very delicious coffee
And at a great price!
Just a cafe without food, highly recommend
review_5_text: The cafe latte was delicious! 40 baht

name: Coffee Time (ใกล้สำนักงานเทศบาลนครเชียงใหม่)
review_1_text: Great coffee, nice ambient and the lady at the counter is super nice
review_2_text: A very nice small coffee shop. The woman owner is extremely nice.
review_3_text: Good coffee at a cheap price. Lovely lady.
review_4_text: Cute little coffee shop with good and cheap coffee and very friendly owner.
review_5_text:
This shop is my most fav. 💛💛💛
Really recommend for all who love easy coffee with good taste and good price.

name: Natwat Home Café
review_1_text:
Subject: From Consistency to Uncertainty: An Open Letter to Natwat Home Café from a Loyal Patron
To the Management of Natwat Home Café,
I am writing this letter to express my profound disappointment regarding an incident that occurred at your café on January 2, 2026, at 8:57 am. As a loyal customer who has consistently supported and trusted your establishment since 2024, today’s experience was deeply upsetting and, quite frankly, embarrassing.
What I encountered this morning was not merely a refusal to allow my dog into the air-conditioned zone; it was a total failure of professional communication. I have attached several photos from my previous visits throughout 2024 and 2025 as evidence that, for nearly two years, your café’s policy has allowed well-behaved pets in the indoor area. My dog has always been welcomed and has strictly followed all house rules.
Today’s incident raises several concerning questions regarding your brand’s standards:
Professional Problem Solving: The staff member informed me that I could not stay inside because of their personal "pet fur allergy." In a self-proclaimed "Pet-Friendly" establishment, I find it unprofessional that internal staffing issues were shifted onto a loyal customer. A professional solution would have been to have another staff member attend to our table, rather than forcing a regular patron to leave the premises.
Public Embarrassment and Lack of Decorum: The staff chose to confront and reject me loudly in front of other guests. This created a highly negative atmosphere, making me and my pet look "disrespectful" in the eyes of others. Consequently, a neighboring table (foreign tourists) misunderstood the situation and asked me to leave. Being "shamed" in public due to a staff member's communication style is the most distressing experience I have ever had at a supposedly professional café.
Inconsistent Policy: Claiming to be a "new staff member who doesn't know the rules" is not a valid excuse for compromising the service standards that a regular customer has relied on for years. If a policy has changed, there should be clear signage or a polite notification upon entry—not a confrontation in the middle of a meal.
The attached photos prove that I am a customer who loves and has long supported your business, and that my dog is calm and disciplined enough to share a space with others. Today's experience has severely damaged the image of Natwat Home Café that I once admired.
I hope this feedback encourages you to re-evaluate your staff training and internal management. I trust that you will take steps to ensure that no other "pet-loving family" has to endure such an embarrassing and exclusionary experience again.
With deep disappointment,
Ricky T.
Loyal Customer (2024 – Present) with documented history
review_2_text: For a small café, Natwat does not feel crowded, the ambience is very calm and inviting. Our service was wonderful, with those little touches of noticing us right when we walked in and suggesting alternatives to things they were out of. They get all of the little touches right. Lovely seating inside or outside in the garden area.
review_3_text: Huge servings, delicious food, reasonable prices, nice ambience, great service.
review_4_text:
Delicious food, I really recommend to try the breakfast quesadilla 🤤
Coffee also is very good and stuff is super friendly.
review_5_text:
Outstanding food! The best coffee I've had in Chiang Mai so far. Will be coming back.

Edit. I've been regularly coming to Natwat over a period of a month and actually ended up moving to the area. My favorite place for breakfast and coffee 🥳

name: Monsoon Tea Wat Ket
review_1_text:
I love their tea! Amazing flavor and business model. I also did their tea blend workshop and was so worth it! The staff was soooo friendly and kind!
I will definitely be coming back
review_2_text: Nice tea house with multiple rooms and outdoor seating area, calm ambience and a good selection of locally produced teas and tea blends. The staff were friendly and gifted us a few extra small packs of tea with our purchase.
review_3_text:
A forest-friendly tea shop in Chiang Mai — now relocated just across the street. The peaceful atmosphere remains, with a great selection of teas and a simple yet interesting food menu.

What I loved most was their signature tea. It's perfect for enjoying at home and makes a lovely souvenir or gift for friends.
review_4_text:
Absolutely marvelous place!
The staff is very welcoming, the food prices are fair and the teas... well, they are a bit more expensive than the norm because this is probably the highest quality tea that you will find anywhere in Chiang Mai and the vicinity. The tea pot was very large and generous, and was offered to try another too. The ambient music blended in so well that you hardly notice it is there, and tea houses not being everyone's cup of tea (no pun intended), it was almost empty, so you get a very private experience, either by yourself or with company. Highly recommended.
review_5_text:
Definitely check out Monsoon Tea if you have limited time in Chiang Mai. It’s without a doubt one of my favorite spaces in the area. A lot of their food incorporates tea leaves and offers some unique twists on local dishes that you won’t find anywhere else. Oh, and they have excellent, jungle-grown tea to match.

I like bringing my laptop here to work as well. WiFi is excellent and seats are comfortable. The large floor to ceiling windows and surrounding greenery make for some exceptional ambiance.

name: Take Me Home Ice Cream - Ping River
review_1_text:
Promotion Ice Cream Buffet (15-21 Sep 2025)

Both Cheesecakes flavor and Banoffee are great, cookie crumbs inside the ice creams make them more texture and enjoyable.
Holy Basil and Passion fruit Gochujung flavor are weird but good, a little bit spicy.
Worth for Calories
review_2_text: So good! Staff were welcoming, made suggestions and let us try many flavors. The flavors are unique and so quality!
review_3_text:
We found this amazing Italian restaurant by chance, we needed a break from Thia food, we love this food, this place was incredible, the service was top notch as was the pasta and wine, we decided to finish with simple ice-cream, I was proven completely wrong the ice-creamer was totally full of passion and ran us perfectly through the complexity of all his wonderful flavours, what a great experience, thanks a million 🙂
Yummo...
review_4_text:
All the ice cream had such unique flavors — I liked every single one!
And it turns out this place isn’t only about ice cream — they’ve got food as well!
review_5_text:
As an ice cream lover I have to say, it's very good.
Calamansi is my favorite.
Other than that, the place is nice, clean and staff very welcoming.

name: Fresh&Mild @ The Prince Royal's College
review_1_text:
On campus so mostly for staff and students.
AC, WiFi and coffee all good.
review_2_text: The shop is located inside Prince of Songkla University School, next to the Grade 4 cafeteria. It's a small milk shop in the school, but it has air conditioning and not many tables. Children often come here to order milk.
review_3_text: Located next to the Prince School gymnasium, we recommend the Prince Milk menu, which is butterfly pea milk mixed with coconut milk. Delicious and refreshing! 😻 Only 35฿!
review_4_text: A coffee shop located in Prince School. The shop is decorated cutely. They have desserts, fresh coffee, and fresh milk with pearls. I came here because of a parent meeting.
review_5_text: Delicious food

name: Peppa Bubble Tea
review_1_text: Great Thai milk tea with boba and cheese cream! I don’t know what else they added, I just told them everything you want! They were so kind! Delicious and refreshing!!
review_2_text: We had an omelet with ham and rice for 50 thb. And had a berry smoothie too. All good 👍
review_3_text: The bread and tea was nice. The vendor for some reason told me that they are closing the place inside and told me to eat outside, but I saw others come in and eat inside. Did I just get discriminated against? Oh jee I hope not, that would be sad.
review_4_text: Fancy! Delicious Bubble Tea!
review_5_text: The shop is clean and has a wide selection of snacks. All the drinks are delicious, especially the cream cheese one.. 🧋😋

name: ว้าวโคโคนัท (มะพร้าวน้ำหอมดำเนินแท้100%)
บารัก คอฟฟี่
review_1_text: Order black coffee without sugar and get the taste of freshly roasted coffee. Excellent and cheap.
review_2_text: I ordered an unsweetened latte. The carefully made latte was delicious.
review_3_text: It's next to a 7-Eleven, and a utility pole is blocking the view; you almost wouldn't know there's a
review_4_text: Delicious and great value.
review_5_text: Delicious, cheap....

name: MAR Marocchino Coffee Chiangmai
review_1_text: Great little place with an outside and inside dining area.  Coffee was good and the waitress was friendly.  Latte will set you back 50 baht, good place to work from but I couldn’t see many power points inside.  Breakfast is available and the WiFi is fast. #BeatTheGrind
review_2_text:
Nice place to get some work done or relax after an afternoon walk near Ping river. Coffee was nice with nutty taste.

Interior is somewhat modern with white walls and high ceilings.

Wifi available. Electrical sockets are scarce. And the shop closes early in the evening (5:30 PM)
review_3_text: Awesome coffee shop!!  Yummy.  Friendly.  Caramel Macchiato!!  Caffe Latte and Mocha were great too!
review_4_text:
Been here a couple times and really didn't enjoy the staff. So cold that Doesn't look like Thailand.

Besides that and things being more on the overpriced spectrum,  it's a good and cozy place and excellent overall quality of good and beverages.
review_5_text: Lovely latte, good price, nice staff

name: อารยา คอฟฟี่
Nerb Nerb coffee roaster
review_1_text: A place for slow life for chilling with coffee and tea. Barista also recommend a drink whatever you want !!! 👏✌️😎 price not too high and good taste.
review_2_text: Amazing coffee, possibly the best flat white I've had in Chiang Mai. They use a special milk that is super smooth, creamy and the medium roast beans had a good nutty and fruity balance. Tried the americano with medium roast beans too and the balance was perfect, smooth and silky. Love this place! Wished I could bring their beans home!
review_3_text: A great little coffee shop. I had a cold Americano while I waited for my motorbike to get repaired down the street. Great atmosphere and very kind owner.
review_4_text: The place is quite tiny, not much table; recommend for take away. Parking lot is available behind the shop[same one with the printing shop].They serve specialty coffee, the barrista speaks English very well. The price is very cheap compare to the special bean they served.
review_5_text: Coffee was great! The medium roast wasn’t bitter and it was very smooth. Burger, the man who runs it, is very nice too and knows a lot about coffee! I’ll definitely come back. They also sell fresh eggs!

name: Dekdoi cafe
review_1_text:
it was very clean n cozy.

review_3_text: Had flavourful iced coffee with toasted bread.

review_5_text: Bright coffee shop.  AC inside, outdoor terrace.   Well presented coffee and tasty cappuccino.

I had my iced latte in the air-conditioned seating  inside  waiting for the guided tour of the Doctor Prince Museum to start. Might try outdoor area when it's cooler.
review_2_text: Good location, nature environment, hot latte 60 baht Easy parking, open early.
review_3_text: Great cafe one the way from bus terminal to Chiang Mai’s town centre. Very nice coffee and great atmosphere, and the surrounding garden is amazing.
review_4_text: An excellent spot for an early morning coffee. Very kind staff and delicious coffee drinks.
review_5_text:
Nice brand new ( opened 6 months ago) coffee shop. Coffee is ok ( for my taste)

Shop is very very clean so that’s absolutely worth a lot of  ++++

The sitting area outside has a big garden around it. Although the road is like 50 meters apart n front of the shop it’s not annoying with regard to noise,  because the cars drive relatively speaking very slow at this specific location. Today I had my coffee here and I understand that every Monday coffee has 50% off. I do not know if this is a limited promotion or all the time. If in the neighborhood absolutely worth the visit.

name: Bubble Jam - Coffee & Taiwan milk tea
review_1_text: Kind, welcoming staff; tasty food, nice music, good prices
review_2_text: Excellent place for quiet reading and really good latte and dessert 👍
review_3_text: Great place, fair prices and super friendly staff! The coffee is very good
review_4_text: Lovely and cozy cafe with cold aircon. Had the Tiramisu Latte Frappe with pearls and it is gd! Very friendly & warm staff!
review_5_text: Very friendly and accommodating staff. Delicious and very reasonable priced drinks!

name: นมสดหน้าแมคฯ
review_1_text: Cheap. Value for the price
review_2_text: Fresh milk is deliciously fragrant. Iced cocoa, iced coffee mixed tea, and iced Nestea tea are also delicious and inexpensive. There are pearls, sago, and jelly to choose from. Most importantly, the auntie's custard is very delicious, fragrant, and not too sweet. The auntie who sells it is very kind.
review_3_text:
Delicious and affordable, but not sold every day. Prices start at just 20 baht, and custard-filled bread is 15 baht.

The shop is located right by the roadside, and you can park on the side of the road.
They only sell in the evenings.

name: Chin Cafe- จินต์
review_1_text: Take a break during the hike; the scrambled eggs with rice are delicious. (The parking lot is quite large.)
review_2_text: It's delicious.

name: HO-SHI ร.พ.แมคคอร์มอค

It's very confusing. I haven't encountered this just once, but every time I come here, everyone who comes to buy says the same thing. I recommend that you don't support them.
review_2_text: The price doesn't match the price on the sign. I asked the staff and they made faces at me. I couldn't buy it and asked to eat it. Should I change the staff so that sales will improve?

name: chubbi hobbi coffee
