review_2_text: The service is very good, the atmosphere of the shop is cool and comfortable, there are cool photo corners.
review_3_text: good

name: Mingmitr Coffee
review_1_text:
Amazing coffee!
Every day he created a different piece of art in my cappuccino and instantly made my day — simply incredible! And he even did it in my takeaway coffee. You can really feel the passion and attention to detail. Great coffee, lovely atmosphere, and highly recommended ☕️✨

Cappuccino was very good
review_2_text:
Wow! I'm impressed. I wish they'd do flat white (hot latte with double shot in smaller cup), but I'm very happy to get this hot latte!
The place is full of locals working on their laptop which I like (I can't deal with tourists even if I'm one); and the music is not too loud making it perfect to concentrate.
I'll come back. The barista behind the counter is a magician, I had to order a second latte!
review_3_text: I wanted to give a shout out to their latte art! It’s so beautiful! The staff are sooooo kind, they always are very diligent and friendly. I love the coffee too!
review_4_text:
Loved coffee from this brand. It had a good aroma and nice flavour even though they made it with dark roasts bean.
I tried many times and now became a regular customer of this brand.
Good coffee shop in Chiangmai!
Highly recommended!
review_5_text:
On a good location, close to the bus station and Mc Cormick hospital you find this coffee shop.

Nice atmosphere and clean. Enough seats available and also enough parking.

The service is of a good level. Very friendly.

The coffee is of very good quality.

Recommendable.

name: ENTHEOS
review_1_text:
Quite literally, this place has the best burger in Chiang Mai. Honestly, one of the best burgers I've had in the world. The consistency of always getting an amazing burger blows me away. If you are hungry, the multiple burger combo is awesome!
I recommend eating meditatively. Eat slowly, and savor every bite of this deliciousness. 😋
Also, the restaurant is relaxing. And the high amount of plants in this restaurant promote a very calm atmosphere.
Would highly recommend, have gone multiple times, and will go again before I leave Chiang Mai!🥰
review_2_text:
Chiang Mai's best cafe and burger place!

1. The inside of the cafe is so clean, and the bathroom is clean.
The outdoor terrace on the second floor is so pretty, and the pictures come out well!

2. The hamburgers are so delicious.. The best hamburger in my life.🍔 patty is so thick, and rich in ingredients!
We were very full even though two women shared a burger and a half.

3. Coffee is also delicious. ⭐️⭐️⭐️coffee bean (roasted by the cafe owner himself)

4. The boss and the staff are so kind and sweet!
review_3_text: The coffee there is very good!! Next time we’ll try the burger there!!
review_4_text: Nice and cozy coffee shop. The shop is actually much larger than what you see from the outside. They offer a variety of specialty coffees. The owner is super friendly a nice place to drop by to have a cup of coffee with friends.
review_5_text: We have been looking for a place with good burgers and saw good reviews about Entheos. The reviews are very very accurate. We came here twice. The first time to try the burgers. We both had the double cheeseburger. Additionally, i had fries ans a cola. The burgers were excellent. The patties were nice big and juicy. I grew up in LA with In-N-Out Burger and I can say that these burgers are just as good or dare I say better than In-N-Out. It is a bit pricey but worth it. We had coffee there the next day (Mocha and Flat White). The coffees were also excellent and very reasonably price. We will come back again for burgers and coffee.

name: Bean Scene Cafe
review_1_text: A/C, wifi, delicious coffe and matcha beverages, best cafe open past 4p for laptop working I found in the area. Low glare, regular hours, open 1p until 7p Tuesday through Friday, closed Monday, closed at 5p Sunday. Could offer simple packaged snacks but it seems like most beverage cafes are focused on doing one thing well. There were 6 people learning to perfect drinks and they remade my 50 baht matcha I didn't understand why but I should have gotten another, it was delicious.
review_2_text:
I had an amazing experience at this cafe! They teach you everything about coffee — from the absolute basics to advanced brewing methods and even latte art. The teacher is incredibly kind, patient, and humble. He takes the time to make sure you truly understand each step, and he never gives up until you get it right.

When I first joined, I didn’t know anything about coffee, but now I feel confident — almost like a professional barista! The atmosphere is friendly and inspiring, and you can really feel the teacher’s passion for coffee. Highly recommend this place to anyone who wants to learn how to make great coffee!

Also after 1Pm you can come and enjoy the good coffee a very nice place for working and drinking a good cup of coffee
review_3_text: Cute small place and nice coffee ☕ small table outside in a yard/parking area. Prices seem good too. Only dairy milk afaik
review_4_text: A wonderful coffee shop with friendly employees! The staff was welcoming from the second I walked in the door. It is a clean and cool interior with good wi-fi. I really enjoyed their matcha—you can tell it is good quality and not just “green tea powder.” They have soy milk available! Less than a 10 minute walk from Bus Terminals 2 & 3.
review_5_text: My favorite thing about this café is that the coffee tastes amazing, and the customer service is excellent. The décor is lovely, and the place feels so cozy.

name: Bunny Story - คาเฟ่กระต่าย
review_1_text:
So nice :) highly recommended
Lovely bunnies
So kind owner

Dog is incredible 🤣🤣
It behaves rabbits and it looks so cute
And also : there is so tasty orange coffee
review_2_text: Rabbits are my favorite animals ever! It was a wonderful experience to see the beautiful rabbits here of all shapes and sizes ❤️ employees were so friendly.
review_3_text: Amazing cafe with very cute bunnies and dogs! The drinks were delicious, and the service was impeccable. Very nice owner who made us feel welcome! The bunnies were adorable and well taken care of. The 2 dogs were very sweet and loved to be pet. Would definitely recommend it if you are a bunny lover!
review_4_text: An absolute must visit! The owner is so lovely, and as soon as you come in you’re greeted by her sweet dog cookie! She does bark when you get there which might make people who don’t know dogs nervous, but that’s just her way of saying hello! Food and drinks are delicious and the service is very fast. I sat in the pen with the rabbits who are all clearly very well looked after, very very friendly jumping up onto my lap! Would 100% recommend for animal lovers
review_5_text: It's one of the cutest cafés in town. It's a bit far off the center, but I totally recommend you come here! The menu is in Thai, but the owner can speak a bit of English. Prices are decent as well. But the highlights are the bunnies in the back and Cookie, the owner's dog. The animals are well-behaved, and you can feed the bunnies with some pre-cut carrots for ca. 20 Baht. There aren't many customers around noon. However, the café is packed with students from a nearby school in the afternoon, but we didn't mind them. There is a lot of heart to this place 🩷

name: Best Part Coffee Roasters
review_1_text: Probably the best latte in town. Big cups, great coffee, and Ethiopian beans are a must-try. The owner is very friendly, and there’s a cute cat who sometimes feels like the real owner of the place.
review_2_text: variety of coffee blends and cozy perfect for slowing down and enjoying the moment. The service is friendly, the cup is full of flavor
review_3_text: The owner surprised me with a delicious pour-over coffee and two cats named Jedi and Snowman. Such a nice place to grab a coffee or a cold drink!! 🥰
review_4_text: 5 stars for happy lazy cat.  Loses two stars for being closed at 9.10am when Google map shows them open. I hope to visit again
review_5_text: First time I had this Latte here, mysterious aroma kept in my mouth after a sip, like some nuts or something else I never knew, very interesting, I like it.

name: The Sun กาแฟโบราณถุงกระดาษ
review_1_text:
I ordered iced coffee with jelly. It was run by two lovely girls with lovely smiles.
The prices were reasonable, and the atmosphere made it easy for foreigners who didn't speak the language to order.
I highly recommend it. 🙏🏻‎✨
Iced coffee with jelly: 20 baht
review_2_text: Cheap and good, very fast.
review_3_text: Selling things and relying on parking on the main road, but the general public is prohibited from parking and is chased away to park elsewhere. May you prosper.

name: BURGER BAR เบอร์เกอร์บาร์ กาแฟ ชา สมูทตี้คาเฟ่
review_1_text: Was looking for a taste of home and found this gem.  😋  I ordered a pork hamburger to try something a little different with fries.  The porkburger was flavourful and juicy with a homemade sauce.  The fries, good, crispy and soft in the center.  Milk bubble tea was good as well lots of ice and refreshing.  The price was just over 115 bht with an addition Coke.
review_2_text: Just devoured what might just be the very best (value) burger ever! Dropped in on a whim and ordered the egg cheese burger and an iced cappuccino. The drink was great but the burger was truly spectacular! Made from scratch and TASTY!! The price for the two? I doubt it can be beaten anywhere, Try this place. The welcoming and most friendly service is much appreciated. 👍👍👍
review_3_text: Excellent value, great burgers, varied menu with fish and chips, chicken on rice and beef burgers. Smoothies and coffee too!
review_4_text: Fabulous burgers made fresh to order, crispy fries, and excellent iced coffee. Run by a lovely family. You can get food to go but the small dining area is very nice.
review_5_text: Nice place with good coffee and thai drinks. They have a milk for vegans ❤️ The prices are very reasonable:)

name: TEMPO
review_1_text: Shows open on Google Maps. Was closed, owner not reachable by phone. After a while an employee came and said “just open on app, not open now.”
review_2_text: Excellent coffee and neat place to drink coffee.
review_3_text: This coffee shop and restaurant is a favorite among the students of Dara School because it's located right next to the school's back gate.

name: เปล่ง Slow Bar
review_1_text:
The specialty selected bean that you can choose! ☕️
You can find the quality coffee in cheap price. Nice owner~ also nice community here in a small kiosk.
The shop nearby bus terminal so you can walk to.
review_2_text: Best coffee in town. The boss selects and roasts all of his coffee beans. Can have drip coffee, mocha pot or espresso machine. It's just a small shop but a must try if you come to Chiang Mai! Also there is a small smoothie shop across the road for those hot days, very affordable and very high quality for both.
review_3_text: Great coffee!
review_4_text: Amazing coffe! Very professional and cool vibes
review_5_text: A small shop with delicious, fragrant coffee. It's roasted and ground in-house. Most importantly, the owner is very friendly and cheerful.

name: Lily of the Valley Cafe
review_1_text:
I ordered Cocoa Frappe and Blueberry Cheesecake.
The Frappe was really amazing. It's simple but the taste 5-stars. Pure chocolate taste. Doesn't take like diluted in ice.

The cheesecake was also amazing. From the base that has an interesting crunch, the cheese layer that just creamy and dense but doesn't taste heavy, and the toppings it was really good!

High Praises from room 516
review_2_text: Just dealt with Food Poisoning for the last 48 hours - this place served up sweaty smelling chicken. DO NOT RISK IT. Should have stopped my daughter from eating it but I figured out the smell a little too late.

name: Coffee Cup คอฟฟี่คัพ
review_1_text: This is a lovely little coffee shop, that has very good lattes. It was a staple for us to go there before continuing on to the Sunshine massage school. The owner is so sweet and kind. The coffees were tasty, and very economically priced. Would highly recommend this cute little coffee shop.
review_2_text: My favorite coffee stand! The owner consistently makes the perfect temperature coffees and is so smiley. She's very sweet! The coffees are economically priced and I stop by every day, since it's close to Sunshine Massage School. I will miss her coffee when I leave!
review_3_text:
My favorite place for coffee
Since 3 month I come here just for coffee
Ladies is so sweet smiling 🌸🌸🌸
review_4_text:
I love this place for a hot or iced coffee/latte/mocha....
Good service and attention 👍
review_5_text: Great coffee, great prices and friendly staff! My favorite spot to pick up a coffee during my lunch break.

name: S…Sip coffee
review_1_text: Absolutely fantastic drinks and the service was amazing. Noi is such a lovely person and her coffee shop is the first thing open and it’s only 2 minutes away from the station ! We had a Thai tea and coffee. But the real star here is noi, she is so friendly and helpful. Gave us lots of recommendations for things to do in Chiang mai !
review_2_text: the coffee is amazing! the shop is located right next to the bus terminal and opens super early - so in case you need amazing coffee right after a long bus ride, that's the place to be! the owner pi noi (i hope i write it the right way) is a cute, lovely person, who made everything to make my stay as comfy as possible! i will definitely come back as soon as possible!
review_3_text:
Best location for relaxing and chill with coffee and unique. The owner her name is Noi, she is very freindly (Language barrier is not interrupting her kind and service mind at all.

Love
review_4_text: We first noticed the shop while walking and stopped for a watermelon smoothie and it was soooooooo soooo sooo good that we had to double back for another one and I had to write a review for her she’s so sweet 🥹
review_5_text: The best place to wait for the bus! Super cheap prices, delicious smoothies, and the best service ever! I recommend trying the coconut smoothie!!!

name: I'm Avocado & Smoothies
review_1_text:
The best smoothie I’ve ever had❤️ This place has lots of really special + tasty + healthy smoothies. Highly recommend “avocado&coconut smoothie” or “purple sweet potato&Avocado smoothie”🥑
Really cozy vibe and so kind🥰 Must visit place in Chiangmai !!!!!
review_2_text: The coconut milk recommended by the cafe owner was so delicious. Strong creamy similar to avocado The best coconut milk I've ever tried in Thailand!
review_3_text: Golden Gem of Chiang Mai! Best vegetarian avocado breakfast ever :) If you're serching for healthy start of the day - that is the place!
review_4_text: Fantastic hidden gem with delicious smoothies. Staff are friendly and attentive, there is a lovely garden to sit in. I asked for mine without sugar and had fresh fruit only, it was a great service. There were lots of flavours on their extensive menu.
review_5_text: Average overpriced avocado 🥑 smoothie not worth a visit if you’re staying in old city or further away from the cafe

name: Sweets for gods Cafe
review_1_text: Cosy yet elegant, atmospheric little place to eat laddu while looking out at Ganesha.  Both masala chai tea and mango and coconut laddu were rich in flavour, the latter filling with its grainy texture. 150baths.
review_2_text: A beautiful little spot and the masala chai is lovely
review_3_text: This place is a hidden gem! The coffee was prime quality and taste, the place is so comfy and the prices are truly cheap. I definitely recommend to visit this place
review_4_text: Good Vibes!  I met a new friend from England. This place very well:)
review_5_text: It has this certain humbled, regal aesthetic. Felt welcomed and although they don’t have a full menu they offer delightful & bright sweet snacks for a moment of pleasure during your day. I will be recording this one as a recommended option in Chiang Mae for meetings, computer work, writing, & relaxing. Not to mention it shares a lot with a beautiful temple. This is a secret little place to keep in your heart.

name: THE Y SMART COFFEE
review_1_text: The coffee is good. The guy who make the coffee also very passionate about it. I mean, look at the bunny. How come you not love it. ♥️♥️♥️
review_2_text: Really good place to spend time while you wait for a bus or do some laptop work. They have lot of electric plugs and nice staff and comfortable chairs.
review_3_text: Very kind and Good coffee..
review_4_text: Lovely coffee!
review_5_text: Closed on two occasions we’ve tried

name: Doipui Coffee Chiang Mai
review_1_text:
Run away from this cafe!! Like a scam place
They put free wifi in front of the shop but I urgently need to charge my battery for work to send my email. But they charge 20 baht for phone and laptop 40 baht!!

which I already ordered some drink which just a cheap fake green tea but i know we need to order smth the  can use a wifi and charger.

They dont put this sign in front of the shop even I’m Thai but this cafe is way too greedy and don’t communicate clearly

Anyway it can still alive in this business as only they are quite close to bus terminal

Only one time for me at this kind of place!!

Not surprised why no customers! You can trick only random travelers or visitors but as Thai I need to review this

Never seen any place so greedy and scame like this before

By the way, their drink also quite expensive and cheap quality already

So in total I paid 100 baht for this barely edible drink better to go to starbucks!
review_2_text:
I give Doi Pui Coffee 4 stars. Reason is that the Americano Orange is of really good quality, made with fresh oranges! Really nice.

The service of this place is okay. The only thing what I don't get it why, when the shop is empty, they don't serve the coffee; you need to pick it up.

The atmosphere is, actually, not okay. It's old and really needs to be cleaned and refreshed. The furniture is old and broke.

I really think when the owner invests a bit in renovation, there will be more customers.

The location is perfect , just opposed the bus stations 2 and 3.
review_3_text: Nice little coffee shop. Very good on a hot day because it is cold and dark inside. Located next to bus terminal 2 and 3. Coffee tastes different. Friendly professional service
review_4_text:
The signs inside clearly state that charging costs 20 Baht for 1 hour. But we were then informed that charging for 15 minutes (as that's all the time we had to drink our coffee before getting the bus) would cost 20 Baht. That equates to 80 Baht per hour....the signs are very misleading, and do not mention any minimum charge.

No toilet is available for customers. There is a bathroom there, but the guy said that it is only for him and customers cannot use it.
review_5_text:
Good for waiting a bus time with cool AC.
Cafe late and one piece of butter toast 80 baht. But no toilet.

name: Rise&Bloom Coffee (Star Avenue 7)
review_1_text: I loved this coffee shop, the coffee tastes amazing and it is from a farm in Pai, that produces small amounts of good quality coffee beans. The owner is very passionate about his job and you can see that reflected in the quality of his products and the ambience of the store. The banana cake made by his girlfriend was delicious. I can’t wait to be back next time I ll stop by in Chiang Mai.
review_2_text: Cute small coffee shop. Nice barista. I've ordered light roasted cappuccino with oat milk. It was good .
review_3_text: Of you are coming to Chiang Mai Bus Terminal you just have to come here also. Amazing taste of coffee, barista knows all about the products that he is selling. Ask him any question about the coffee culture in the North Thailand, recommendations, buy some coffee and enjoy the rest of your day.
review_4_text: a small, quiet and cosy café near the bus terminal in Chiang Mai. excellent coffee and a small selection of cakes (to eat in or take away).
review_5_text: If you are into Specialty Coffee, this is a great place to visit!  Had a lovely chat with the professionals, and the coffee from Pai was awesome!

name: Stan’s Cafe
review_1_text: The coffee is very nice, good quality beans. Price is surprisingly very good (50-100baht). Nice atmosphere.
review_2_text: I liked this place. Sat here drinking coffee and drawing for hours, really enjoyed it :)
review_3_text: Really nice coffee shop with super friendly employees! Highly recommend :)
review_4_text: There are a variety of coffees to choose from, and the prices are very cute. The decorations are in a soothing tone, and there's a big teddy bear too. It's really cute! ✨🧸✨
review_5_text: A very friendly welcome. Delicious coffee, made with love. Delicious cheesecake with various flavors. We were served homemade cantuccini with our coffee. The owners and staff are proud of their business, and rightly so.

name: Bakery by Daeng
review_1_text:
While waiting for our bus for Chiang Rai, we got some beverages and bread to go from here.

Their Thai milk tea was good. It has strong tea flavor balanced out by the milk and a little sweetness. Their iced coffee was strong as well. We also bought a few packs of bread. It was good decision and we had something to munch on during the bus long bus ride.

name: Blue Cafe and Apartment service
review_1_text: we stayed here when we came back to Chaing Mai just for 2 nights as it was near the bus station. i wouldn't stay here if I actually wanted to explore Chaing Mai just because of the distance to things. staff were lovely. did think it was strange that it had a kitchenette (hob) but no pans were provided (it didn't state that when we booked it). bed was mega comfy and the room was huge. bathroom was nice with a lovely warm shower.
review_2_text:
This place is great.  Excellent prices and a great atmosphere that feels like something I'd see back home in California.

Try it, you won't regret it.
review_3_text: ♥️ Best tasting coffee in Chiangmai also only 60THB, They also have a good food selection menu also well priced.
review_4_text: Just stopped for coffee, but it was good, and the cafe had a nice atmosphere.
review_5_text:
Came here just for a bite and to charge the phone.

Food is a bit overpriced. Drinks 70-120 THB, food 80-180.

I got a smoothie for 80 and personal pizza for 165. They were both good, but wouldn't say any better than cheaper places around. The smoothie was kinda too sweet, pizza was nothing to write home about.

name: CHIC COFFEE &BAR
review_1_text: I drink a lot of coffee and I love the coffee at this place. Excellent dark roast !  The baristas know how to make good coffee.  Very comfortable and quiet inside.
review_2_text:
Tucked away near Khum Paya resort, this is a chilled out spot perfect for your morning coffee - for us vegans/plant-based, the oat milk option here is delicious and iced or hot, you can be assured you’ll have a beautiful drink every time.

The staff are polite, friendly and considerate in every way - affordable, convenient but also serene in amongst a little hustle and bustle of outer Chiang Mai.

Highly recommend!
review_3_text: The atmosphere and coffee here are very nice they make a very good coffee here for coffee lovers. The location is great, with air-conditioned indoor seating and plush chairs, as well as outdoor seating to enjoy your coffee. It's also very well priced.
review_4_text:
Friendly greetings from staff.
My husband ordered a hot cappuccino and I got iced latte we also got cookies.
Everything was nice.

Good chill vibes inside small cafe - clean and quiet.

nice place to sit and enjoy coffee in the morning :)
review_5_text: Great little coffee shop with excellent coffee, mixed drinks and some snacks. Employees are very kind and respectful, would definitely come back here!

name: Café Amazon
review_1_text: Americano is not good……. the interior is great and air-conditioned though
review_2_text:
We enjoyed sitting here for a while and working. We ordered fruit smoothies, but surprisingly the available flavors were strawberry and a couple other berries. Not sure if this is an international brand that has to be consistent, but where was mango or dragon fruit or...
You are in Thailand, be proud of your local fruits!
review_3_text:
Too cold
The staff doesn't know how to control the Aircon
review_4_text: Being able to sit outside under the roof in the shade  is for me personally a pro. The coffee is ok.
review_5_text: Still have a nice coffee. Friendly and pleasant customer services.

name: The Extraction CBP
review_1_text: Ning is the best waitress in the world, I wish she worked in England so I could see her everyday! I will miss her beautiful face every time I’m not with her
review_2_text: Two very milky flat whites and the barista does not know what "magic" is for the third cup.
review_3_text: Very small coffee
review_4_text: A small coffee shop with two types of coffee beans, both delicious and inexpensive. The menu isn't extensive, so don't overthink it. It's very convenient. The shop has one table inside with plugs, one outside, and one on the side of the road. The green tea is quite ordinary.
review_5_text:
The coffee is delicious and aromatic. They've selected good quality coffee beans for you to try, with a variety of options at reasonable prices.
I give it an 8.5/10. Highly recommend it!

name: MEENCOFFEE
review_1_text: Came close to closing time and got a Thai tea to go. She pulled the tea from the espresso machine. The flavour was intense, smooth, and so fragrant. Definitely coming back. Barista was also friendly and warm.
review_2_text: Good vibes with great coffee ☕️
review_3_text: Great coffee and nice service!
review_4_text: A good cozy cafe with good coffee and friendly staff
review_5_text:
Best value coffee in the neighborhood/area or even Chiang Mai.

I'm a regular customer. I've been visiting daily for a year now.
The owner/barista is always nice to all her customers; I've never experienced an unhappy or unsatisfied customer.
The cafe is clean, cozy, and has a warm atmosphere. Give this place a visit once, and you won't be disappointed with the taste of the coffee or the value. You might even become a regular here.
The coffee tastes great, and considering the price and quality per cup, it's definitely the best value in Chiang Mai. I've been a regular customer for a year, and it's consistently delicious every time. The owner takes great care of the shop, and she has many regular customers who love it. I've never heard of a customer being dissatisfied with the drinks or service from the owner in all the years I've been here.

The shop is clean, and the atmosphere is warm. If you have the chance to try the drinks here, I guarantee you'll become a regular customer.

name: Black Canyon บิ๊กซี Extra เชียงใหม่
review_1_text: Food served fresh and well made. Khao tom and fried glass noddles with herbs and shrimps was exactly what I needed. Staff were attentive.
review_2_text:
Let’s get this out first, the staff was great! But… To be honest it is expensive compared to other places you can go for in the area.

With that said it is also very clean and has good service. I personally dislike the food in these restaurants. But the rest of my the family agrees that the food is good.

Since I’m the one reviewing, I will set it at 4 out of preference. Expensive, the food feels almost plastic to me. The butter they use has a different aroma and flavour, overall try it for yourself- you might give it a 5.

The coffee was good and comes in a timely manner. They include some crackers and warm tea. This Definetly was on the plus side.
review_3_text: For 200 THB, this is extremely disappointing. The portion is very small and the overall quality feels like the consumer is being taken advantage of.
review_4_text: Name brand coffee you can trust.   Few coffee shops give you a shot of tea and a snack with your coffee.  Consistently tasty and fresh.  This shop has good friendly service.  It's location is inside big c near central festival mall
review_5_text: quiet corner in big c shoping center with the top selling can't fail menu, pad thai and black canyon coffee. need to get staffer attention otherwise they will respect your privatcy.

name: Ninebar Coffee Roaster; Business Park
review_1_text:
Nice coffee and a good price!

A lot of seating and all are outdoors covered by a roof.

The parking lots are many around there.
review_2_text:
Had a few hot cappuccino and latte here. I like the taste of the coffee. Price is ok, but the coffee should be hotter.
Today we got the first time paper cups instead of real cups. If they keep that we are not coming back.
review_3_text: Awesome little corner cafe with interesting drink choices: I recommend the coffee with orange
review_4_text: Lovely freshly brew coffee at very reasonable price at cozy atmosphere!
review_5_text: Great place for morning coffee. The coffee is really aromatic and have a strong aftertaste that lingers pleasantly in your mouth.

name: TONG KAFE
review_1_text: Great coffee and ideal stop while enjoying the views. Friendly staff and a great atmosphere ☺️
review_2_text: Just dropped off for coffee, which was really very good. What makes it stand out however it was extremely clean toilets. Owner asks you to remove your shoes before you go in, and I think that makes all the difference.
review_3_text: Basic coffee shop. Friendly simple man serves and makes coffee.   Coffee taste is good and the beans are grown locally.  This shop will does not make specialty coffees like cappuccino.  Expresso and americano.   Short selection of drink.  Some beer is in the refrigerator.  Cool weather at this location. 10 minutes past doi suthep.  10 minutes before you reach Doi Pui.  No food at this location. There are other shops to buy at food nearby.
review_4_text:
We went up there by accident and as our kids were sleeping decided to get a cup of coffee.
It was the best Mocha cup we've had in Thailand this trip so far and we were lucky enough to experience this eerie atmosphere while sipping our coffees
review_5_text: Amazing place on top of the mountain few kilometer pass doi sutep, nice and easy place to chat and get out of the sun, right infront. of the parking of the bubhing place, cheap and strong coffee, a cat that was the king of the moment, and lovely person making the coffee, would definite go back, and recomend it to all.

name: Sai silver
review_1_text:
Unexpected oasis of Kyoto-esque elegance and calm in an alley in Suthep.

Extensive selection of matcha in their Slow bar, a large architecturally-pleasing space that manages to feel surprisingly intimate, restrained even, and even their clayware ‘cups’ are exquisite.

Tip 1: there’s an 80baht entrance fee, ostensibly to prevent hordes of IG-hunters trampling over the grounds. The ticket can be redeemed as a discount for your drink.

Tip 2: 80baht ticket only partially deters crowds so go early. At 10am the space was serene, full of book readers, solo matcha lovers, small groups engaged in polite chatter. By 11.30, the gardens were overrun by selfie-seekers and tourist vans depositing loud groups and noisy children.
review_2_text: Make sure to stop here for a Thai tea after heading up to the temple. The owner is lovely and the drink we incredible. Great music as well which really set the vibe. I nice oasis in the chaos of other tourist shops.
review_3_text: Not just a stand.. It's a full fledged independent coffee shop with a character out of step from the touristy shops near by. Nice view of the forest from the back of the shop and, most critical, an excellent cup of coffee.
review_4_text: Great place for coffee right next to Doi Suthep. Cool setting and hospitable. Recommended
review_5_text: Awesome coffee and drink art, cost and a great vibe! Definitely stop by here before/after the temple

name: Pai Doi Coffee & Burger
review_1_text: Nice
review_2_text: Great and quiet place to chill after the long jog
review_3_text: Great Thai Tea! It is a super calm spot for a drink
review_4_text: Pretty spot to stop and have a mouth watering burger!
review_5_text: There are very few places in this world where you can get high quality hamburger with high quality coffee so lovely presentation and service with love for coffee and hambutger

name: BK Coffee House
review_1_text:
Small, very tidy shop with a high-quality espresso machine. They offer coffees, smoothies, and ice cream. You're welcome to bring food from the shop next door to your table. They also had vegan milk alternatives.

We had a delicious Americano and passionfruit smoothie and would definitely come back.
review_2_text: The drink shop here is pretty good. After buying my drinks, I went to the gift shop next door. It's small, but it has a lot of stuff, especially at very good prices. You can save a lot of money by just turning the corner. The owner is also very friendly.
review_3_text: Great places for a quick coffee before sightseeing :)
review_4_text: Coffee, fruit smoothies, and tea are all delicious.

name: Coffee JEANS
review_1_text: Good coffee at a good price and a nice chill spot to relax and recharge after the climb.
review_3_text: nice coffee, you can visit temple and then take a rest here.
review_4_text: Iced oat latte 10/10
review_5_text: Amazing cappuccino with amazing people, musician included

name: ฮักดอย คอฟฟี่
review_1_text: A place where you can enjoy a cup of coffee while looking down from the entrance of Doi Suthep Temple~

name: Mr. Waffles (Waffel-Cafe)
review_1_text:
Nice price and really good waffles
Missing a bin to throw the trash in
review_2_text:
ENGLISH
Mr. Waffles offers super delicious waffles on the way to or from the temple. The many variations are each freshly prepared.

The employees were very friendly and the product tasted great - what more could you want?

Here you pay cash - enjoy the little refreshment.

Feel free to follow my Google Maps profile, check out my other reviews and be sure to visit foodadvisorblog!

GERMAN
Mr. Waffles offers super delicious waffles on the way to or from the temple. The many variations are each freshly prepared.

The employees were very friendly and the product tasted great - what more could you want?

Here you pay in cash - enjoy the little refreshment.

Feel free to follow my Google Maps profile, check out my other reviews and be sure to visit foodadvisorblog!
review_3_text: This waffle is the most delicious.
review_4_text: it is delicious
review_5_text: beautiful

name: Unknow Cafe Doisuthep
review_1_text: Good taste best coffee
review_2_text: Good taste best coffee😋
review_3_text: The smell of coffee mixed with friendship
review_4_text: The coffee is delicious, really delicious.
review_5_text: Good atmosphere, good service, delicious coffee.

name: Sansuk cafe
review_1_text:
Late January 2026 We visited Sui Tep restaurant which was full and were accommodated at the fronting café which seemed to be owned by the same establishment as they shared the same menu.

The cafe is a rustic and informal local restaurant servung traditional Northern Thailand cuisine and Thai drinks.

Service was quick and with ample serving sizes and affordable price range.

The curry is treated much like a soup in this area of the country.

Very ideal for quick eats during your visit to the nearby temple.  Generally Thai eateries will have plenty of spices but will be open to have less spicier versions.

name: Raan Beem Coffee
review_1_text: Very delicious and cheap coffee. Nice staff. And they have OAT MILK 😍
review_2_text: Great fresh fruit shakes for low money on lower end of straits to Doi Suthep.
review_3_text: Simple place that serves nice drinks. We ordered a mango smoothie - yum! And and orange juice espresso. FUN!
review_4_text: We had a smoothie, an iced cappuccino and a super sweet mango. It's nice to sit there after visiting the wat
review_5_text: Got the mango smoothie, ice looked clean and bought externally. Very refreshing after waking around!

name: Law Coffee Club ลอว์คอฟฟี่คลับ คณะนิติศาสตร์ มช.
review_1_text: The student cafe offers a variety of menus, including coffee, tea, and soda. There are also some seats available for studying, working, or discussing with your team. However, the ambiance can be quite loud.
review_2_text: I really like this place…so much better than the “livin’ the dream” farang place close by.  Nice working area, many students and great staff serving good drinks.  It’s in a nice walking area and always enjoyable to visit.
review_3_text: Great coffee quality! I used them at home as well. Good employees :)
review_4_text: Very lively environment with a lot of students. Good for getting work done when you want people around!
review_5_text: Probably the best coffee shop inside CMU.

name: Living A Dream ร้านกาแฟอ่างแก้ว
review_1_text: My favorite cafe in Chiang Mai. Location is  perfect. Beautiful view. Good choice of food and drinks. I always have coconut. Green tea latte with almond milk is my second choice.
review_2_text: This restaurant is directly across from the water, so you get a great view. The staff speaks very good english. The food is always delicious. They have indoor and outdoor seating. We really enjoy this place.
review_3_text:
The atmosphere is very beautiful i recommend going here if you are in the lake's area. I got an iced espresso and an almond croissant. The croissant was ok, not too bad not too good, I enjoyed it but would not come back for it.
The iced Espresso i got was an iced latte, I asked why i have milk inside my drink and they told me that I should have ordered an iced Americano and not an espresso because the iced espresso is actually an iced latte. It is not specified in the menu, I don't know if that's is a cultural thing but i would ask next time if my drink has milk inside of it.
review_4_text:
The coffee shop with the best view in Chiang Mai.
I went there the other day, and the service was excellent, especially from the cashier. The food was delicious as well. I highly recommend the fruit granola yogurt and a hot caramel latte.
review_5_text: Free bathroom even if you don’t buy anything! They are really friendly and the food and drinks are solid with a super awesome view of the water and mountain.

name: Café Amazon CMU Heart ม.เชียงใหม่
review_1_text: **Café Amazon CMU Heart** is a charming coffee shop located within the Chiang Mai University campus, offering a peaceful spot to relax and enjoy a drink. The café has a cozy ambiance with plenty of seating, making it an ideal place to study, meet up with friends, or take a break between classes. The menu features a variety of drinks, from their signature coffee to refreshing iced beverages, all made with quality ingredients. The friendly service and welcoming environment make this place stand out. Plus, the café’s location near the heart of the university adds to its convenience for students and visitors. If you're looking for a nice spot to unwind, Café Amazon CMU Heart is a great choice!
review_2_text: Uni wifi accessible, cool to cold a/c, quiet with no music/musak, accessible electricity, great natural light, staff are fabulous and kind. Open from 6am, 7 days/week.
review_3_text: Nice tea
review_4_text: A good place to study and hangout.
review_5_text: This branch has a lot of seating! There's a wide selection of cakes and pastries, and they also sell other Amazon products. Personally, I feel like this branch has the most consistent taste in the CMU area. + Staff and students get a 5 baht discount. 🥰

name: LAW COFF. STAND ลอว์คอฟ สแตนด์ RB3
review_1_text: **LAW COFF. STAND RB3** is a cozy little coffee shop located in a convenient spot, perfect for those who want a quick caffeine fix. The place is known for its friendly service and inviting atmosphere. Whether you’re in the mood for a regular cup of coffee, iced drinks, or something more unique, this place has got you covered. The coffee is consistently good, and the staff is always welcoming, making it a nice stop for a relaxing break. With its laid-back vibe, it’s also a great spot to grab a quick drink on the go or to catch up with friends. If you’re near the area, it’s definitely worth checking out!
review_2_text: Great location and same great tasting coffee.  I really like their light roast beans.
review_3_text: Every menu item is reasonably priced, worth the price, and tastes great. The shop doesn't have a place to sit and drink, making it ideal for people who want to buy and then take it to school/the library, or buy and then return to their dorm/home. Personally, my regular order is iced fresh milk, which is the perfect fresh milk! My friends and I all like to order green tea. I'm secretly curious to try it. I'll have to find an opportunity to try it. 😋
review_4_text:
A quality-conscious coffee shop with student prices.
The coffee, drinks, and desserts are all excellent. The flavors are delicious and the food is clean. They have a wide selection of beans and menu items.
They're made quickly, so you don't have to wait long.
Opens at 7:30 AM.
review_5_text:
The coffee is inexpensive and delicious, perfect for university students. It's best to grab a takeaway to enjoy while studying or working, as there's no seating inside the shop.
The coffee tastes really good.

name: Micha Coffee Shop (CMU Faculty Of Humanities Branch)
review_2_text: Today I went to buy an iced tea with less sugar, emphasizing this to the staff. What I got was iced tea with plenty of sugar. Terrible service, and it wasn't even worth the 45 baht price.
review_3_text: The coffee and jasmine tea were absolutely awful, but the Thai milk tea and green milk tea were pretty good.
review_4_text: Today, at approximately 3:40 PM, I visited the store and the staff seemed unwelcoming and spoke rudely to customers. I'm not sure if they were forced to act that way, but I would like this matter to be given special consideration so that the store will be more inviting.
review_5_text: The staff's manners are completely useless. Honestly, if you don't want to sell, don't sell. Just close the shop. Why are you acting so angrily and making a sour face? You're talking like you're asking for free food? I can't take it.

name: Whatever
review_1_text: The Whatever café, conveniently located near the Chiang Mai University Cooperative Store and directly opposite the Central Library, is a favorite among students and locals alike. This small but charming bubble tea shop specializes in offering high-quality drinks at very affordable prices, with an average cost of just 30 THB per cup. Despite its relatively simple menu, the café has gained a loyal following for its rich and creamy milk teas, which some customers claim have a more robust flavor compared to other local options. The atmosphere is casual and welcoming, making it a perfect stop for a quick refreshment after classes or study sessions. Many patrons appreciate the consistent taste and value, making Whatever a must-visit spot for bubble tea enthusiasts in the area.
review_2_text: Good coffee.
review_3_text: This cafe is located at the entrance to the supermarket across from the CMU Library. They serve cheap and delicious coffee. Their Taiwanese milk tea is also recommended. Get one free drink for every 12 stamps.
review_4_text: This little coffee shop serves incredibly rich and satisfying coffee. I've finished my studies, but I'll try to stop by regularly.
review_5_text: The tea is delicious, especially the Taiwanese milk tea. You absolutely have to try it!

name: Pak café
review_2_text: very cheap
review_3_text: I was visiting Chiang Mai University and was so out of it from the blazing sun that I had an iced Americano...it was the best...and it was only 35 baht. The portions were generous and the taste was delicious. Two large dogs were also wandering around in front of the store, so gentle and cute.
review_4_text: It's quiet and friendly, but it's a shame there's no Wi-Fi.
review_5_text: Dangerous dog

name: กาแฟออร์แกนิค Black Wanila Organic Coffee
review_1_text: Black Wanila Organic Coffee at Chiang Mai University offers a cozy and refreshing spot for coffee lovers who prefer organic, high-quality brews. The café is tucked in a quiet corner of the campus, making it a perfect place to unwind or catch up on work while enjoying a cup of coffee. The organic coffee beans used here are rich in flavor and have a smooth, well-balanced taste. They also offer a variety of beverages, from strong espresso shots to refreshing iced drinks. The café's atmosphere is peaceful and welcoming, with friendly staff always ready to serve. If you're on the lookout for a healthy, delicious coffee option, this is definitely a great choice within the university!
review_2_text: Reasonably priced take out only cafe at CMU food court. Coffee is priced at 35thb to 50thb here.
review_3_text: Good coffee with great aroma. Menu is various. The staff is friendly.
review_4_text:
Very good and freshly roasted coffee.
Variety of roasted choices and very reasonably price.

name: Fresh Me - หอสมุด ม.เชียงใหม่
review_2_text: It's tasty, but it's a bit pricey for the amount. It's right next to the library, so I guess there's nothing we can do about it.
review_3_text: The pearls were very bland, but the tea was delicious. You have to order a lower sweetness level than you normally would because the tea here is very sweet.

Good taste, Good price, a lot of choices of coffee bean and syrup

review_2_text: Best coffee shop inside CMU. Spacious and comfy. You meet the best people here.
review_3_text:

name: Mohcoffee CMU.
review_1_text:
Good tastes coffee, good price
Feel very comfortable, relax beside natural views
The coffee shop locates inside Chiang Mai University area. 👍☕🍰🎉
review_2_text: Tasty drinks with reasonable price
review_3_text:
I'd like the restaurant to try improving their matcha menu because, to be honest, it's not delicious at all. In the matcha menu, they don't measure the matcha. They just scoop it and add it to the hot water. Even whisking the matcha doesn't break it up. The matcha is lumpy because it's mixed with a spoon, and the taste is very astringent. I've tried ordering coconut matcha, pure matcha, and honey lemon matcha, but this one is the most edible (because the lemon and honey flavors completely mask the bitterness of the matcha). I've stopped eating matcha at the restaurant for a while now.

If the restaurant wants to make a matcha menu that stands out at a budget price, they don't need to add or change anything. They just need to be more meticulous in making it. For example, they don't measure the matcha a lot—just 3 grams is enough. (The vendor probably scooped over 10 grams because it was so much.) It also saves on ingredients. You can use a tea whisk or a frother if you're in a hurry to break up the matcha. That's how delicious it is.

Please consider this feedback. And I'll be waiting to try the shop's delicious matcha. I'd like to see a delicious matcha shop in the university. I'm rooting for you.
review_4_text: You should definitely try the Chiang Mai cafeteria. The average price is around 35 baht, which is cheaper than other expensive restaurants in Chiang Mai, and it's clean. In particular, noodle shop #6, which costs around 35 baht, has a generous seating area where you can add your own condiments, and there's a water purifier (next to the trash can). Drink shop #7 offers green water with condensed milk. A large size is 20 baht, and I personally recommend it if you're not sensitive to strong aromas. They don't have Zero Coke.

name: Madam Coffee

review_2_text: I only walked by in the morning on a Saturday and want to let you know it still exists and is open! It's cute, I'd come back 💧
review_3_text:
Yes, I checked out another new school cafe. ⁄(⁄ ⁄ ⁄ω⁄ ⁄ ⁄)⁄

name: Cloud Coffee
review_1_text: Good coffee. I got a flat white and a nitro cold brew. All were good but I did not like that they put ice in the nitro cold brew. The space is really nice and good size. It has a section for sitting on the floor with mats that was unique.
review_2_text: Good for working space and having good coffee. Plenty of parking. People coming here to work, so u would get some library or common area vibe. The light roasted Americano is really good with the price. Free plug in and WiFi. In fact, all bills are partly donated.
review_3_text: The best coffee shop in Chiang Mai! I love it so much!
review_4_text: Two wonderful experiences at this incredible cafe and co-working cloud loving space in Chiang Mai. Delicious food, incredible coffee, delightful team and very inspiring space for work on the go either as a nomad or to bring your team. Styling is brilliant! Can’t recommend highly enough, I will be back 💯 next visit to Chiang Mai.
review_5_text:
Cafe for people who want to change the environment for working. This place was very quiet and and there are so many table zone even you come here alone is okay because it had a one seat table bar

Bread and beverage here are good
I would love to recommend!

✅wifi
✅car park

name: Camp71 Chiang mai
review_1_text: Lovely little coffee shop, really nice coffee and one of the best honey lemon sodas we’ve had. Really cool clothes shop, you need to explore this just to see the cool things they have here, really retro, and clothing is reasonably priced.
review_2_text:
Date of Visit: August 20th

This is a café I stopped at on my way to Nimmanhaemin. I was recommended the cappuccino. I think the taste was average, but the atmosphere was very nice for working. It was the first café I visited in Chiang Mai, and I have very good memories of it.
review_3_text: Unusual specialist shop selling vintage things, including toys, clocks, sewing machines and other paraphernalia. Looks like a museum selling antique things. Very interesting shop.
review_4_text:
Tranquil place to sit and enjoy the music. Very sweet staff. Only drinks on the menu, coffee, tea and specialty sodas.
Attached to a 3 level clothing store.
review_5_text: Inside an amazing clothes shop that is also part retro museum, pinball machines, model cars by the hundreds, military models

name: กลิ่นกาแฟภูคำ:: Klin Coffee Phucome
review_1_text: This café has a great selection of coffee and other drinks. Its location is perfect for tourists and visitors staying nearby. Situated in the heart of Chiang Mai, it offers good value for money and a cozy atmosphere.
review_2_text: Conveniently located at the corner of intersection, across the street from my hotel. The owner is a nice guy and I ordered an americano coffee. It is good.
review_3_text: Barista is a really lovely man and my iced latte was delicious!
review_4_text: Good coffee and cheap price 👍
review_5_text:
A roadside coffee shop selling exhaust fumes

is alright. The passion fruit coffee is pretty good. 👍

name: Double Eleven Cafe&Space
review_1_text: I’ve been a regular customer for about 5 months. Although the shop is a bit small, it’s clean and beautiful. The coffee tastes really good. My favorite snack from Double Eleven is Toast. The best thing about it is the owners are really really friendly, sweet and kind-hearted. Love it!
review_2_text: I am staying in condo1 but walk all the way to condotel2 s cafe- 11:11- bc this coffee shop is clean, cool, and the barista super friendly and talented!!! Lovely oasis of a place.
review_3_text: A lovely family run business with good coffee, caring service. Good value chicken wraps all made with such attention to detail
review_4_text: Friendly guy who owns the shop. Great coffee and lovely atmosphere.
review_5_text: Good coffee and super tasty banana cake!

name: ฝันดีกาแฟโบราณ
review_1_text: Great place to buy some snacks and drinks.

name: WAKO BAKE
review_1_text:
Friendly service, though orders took much longer than expected (30 minutes) considering the few customers at the time.

Food is standard, though portions are small for the price; guess you pay for the setting, which is nicely designed.
review_2_text: We heard about this place from a friend, and wow, what a gem! High-speed 150 Mbps internet, big tables with power sockets, a great food selection, and a beautiful, peaceful garden. It's a perfect place for working and chilling. The bacon sandwich is amazing, and the prices are great.
review_3_text: The food, the place, and the service were incredible! I’ll recomend it 10 out of 10
review_4_text: Delicious vegetarian (and non) food packed with flavour. The garden is so peaceful and the drinks are delicious! I had the spicy red curry, hot Thai tea, and a mango/passion smoothie. The service was quick! Can’t wait to return.
review_5_text: nice garden, workable environment, fast wifi :) I have used this cafe since 5 years ago and this is always one of my favorite place. Good drink, nice garden, great vibe. You can also rent a team working room by hour here.

name: Yelloo
review_1_text:
A nice shop that is easy to find in the Nimman area. Bright coffee shop with a simple but effective menu that focuses on the basics. Everything has a sort of clean look to it, including the items you order.

Service is intuitive which is a nice pleasant surprise as well. An enjoyable experience.
review_2_text: Wow. What a gorgeous environment, incredibly friendly staff, and the best unique iced coffee that I've had in my life. You HAVE to try the Yelloo Latte - it's the marriage of a creme brulee and iced coffee, done to perfection. Amazing
review_3_text: Well located quaint little coffee place full of light, some plants and lots of warm smiles. The staff speaks English.
review_4_text: The place is great for fun unique drinks, it’s not too loud, there is also great lighting and great WiFi
review_5_text: Such a gorgeous cafe! Beautiful coffee, made with care. I have enjoyed iced lattes, juice, brownie, and delicious lunch here over the last few days and keep coming back. The staff are so friendly and have remembered my order each day and welcome me with smiles ☺️ The interior design and little courtyard is so nice! 🙌

name: Feel Nimman Boutique
review_1_text:
The front receptionist was amazing, helping me carry my 25kg suitcase and also during check-out due to no elevators available.

My room was spacious with a work table and stable Wi-Fi. Receptions often asking whether I needed my room cleaned, which was helpful.

They ask you to store your shoes away at receptions in replace of hotel slippers, which was a first for me but was no hassle.

Great location with 7/11, cafes, and restaurants nearby (some within 1 min walk), quiet side streets despite being near the main road, and scenic mountain views.

The pool wasn’t functional, but there was a convenient laundromat on the same street.

Overall, i felt safe and comfortable as receptions was also 24/7 and the location was safe for a solo female traveller.
review_2_text:
Rooms were nice and comfortable.
The establishment has a policy where you have to remove your shoes near the reception and use a pair of slied provided by them.
Apart from that and the fact that it does not have a lift, no complaints about the rooms or the service.  The staff was very friendly and the rooms were clean, modern and good value for money
review_3_text:
Do not trust the other reviews of this hotel.

My room, infested with ants, forced me to request a cancellation, but the manager refused a refund.

This place is for you if you like hotels with:
- a ridiculously tiny and creepy pool,
- a cramped entrance,
- bizarre "design"
- no elevator

I left the hotel when the staff came into my room to spray it with insecticide.

Be warned: if you choose this hotel, expect the manager to be remorseless and adopt a ruthless approach to any issues that arise.

The standard professional ethics found in most reputable hotels are absent at Feel Nimman Boutique. In fact, I struggle to find any similarities between this establishment and a professionally managed hotel.

I strongly recommend considering hotels like Hi Chiangmai, Bed Nimman, or Baan Sang Singh. I've stayed at all three and they excel in cleanliness and comfort. They are also slightly more affordable.

Meanwhile, Agoda, the booking platform through which I reserved the stay at Feel Nimman, acknowledged the deplorable situation and compensated me with an appropriate voucher. As I understand it, the voucher's value equates to their commission on the booking.

Currently, I am still fighting for a refund from the hotel, although it appears that issuing refunds for mishandled customers is not part of their policy.
review_4_text: Amazing place: love the desk and functionality of the room. The lobby lady is really kind. They are a bit weird with shoes system but at least it is clean
review_5_text:
room is clean, area nearby convenient. staff is good and helpful. noisy at night before 12am coz a bar is just opposite to my double bed room. no lift for 3 floors house.

name: THE VOLCANO One Nimman
review_1_text: Happy to find this place. Delicious first meal in Chiang Mai!! The Cheese ice cream with crispy bacon goes so well. Never tried anything like this before~  Mentaiko Cheese toast is so cheesy. Must try 😆 ~
review_2_text:
THE VOLCANO at One Nimman is such a cozy spot to sit and relax. At first, I thought the prices would be high because of the location, but I was surprised—they’re actually very reasonable for this area. An iced green tea is just 45 baht!

The must-try item here is the Pocket Cheese Toast—crispy, fragrant, and absolutely delicious, with gooey, stretchy cheese inside. Perfect comfort food to go with your drink.

👉 A great place to chill, enjoy good snacks, and not break the bank while hanging out at One Nimman.

Dr. Niwech
review_3_text: The staff were extremely unfriendly, and the food was terrible. The bacon was overcooked and dry, and everything felt overly greasy and unhealthy — pure junk food. With so many better food options nearby, there’s really no reason to eat here. I wouldn’t recommend it at all.
review_4_text:
I stumbled across this gem, and it did not disappoint. I initially went in for the egg cream toast, only to find out it’s no longer on the menu. The cashier recommended the strawberry toast when I mentioned I wanted something sweet. When she asked if I wanted cheese, I was a bit skeptical about the combination, but I’m glad I went for it.

The whole strawberry cheese toast had unexpected flavors and the toast itself was extremely delicious – crispy, rich, and satisfying in itself! Highly recommend the place if you’re looking for something unique and different. I bet everything on the menu taste great.
review_5_text:
One of my favourite snacks in Chiang Mai!
We tried sooo many things and honestly loved every single one. The dough is just so good – soft, fresh, and comforting. The pocket toasts, whether filled with cheese or fruit, always hit the spot. Total comfort food! I only wish they had more locations across Southeast Asia 🥺 I’d be a regular for sure. 🤤

name: Starbucks Maya Shopping Mall Chiangmai
review_1_text: Good service with all of staff and clean area, just a little bit noisy because they have many tourist, is still be nice
review_2_text: This Starbucks branch is really pleasant and welcoming. The atmosphere is calm and comfortable, making it a great place to sit, relax, or get some work done. The staff were friendly and efficient, and everything felt well organized and clean. It’s a nice spot to enjoy a coffee break in a relaxed environment, and I’d happily come back again.
review_3_text: Very conveniently located on the ground floor of Maya. First time I’ve had the Starbucks peppermint chewing gum. See photos. And also first time I’ve had the banana cake with mixed grains.
review_4_text: Visited them twice during my 4 day stay in Chiang Mai. The staff were friendly. The location is good, but there are a lot of kids using it for studying, which is not good for paying customers as they stay there for hours that regular customers paying like us have no place to sit and enjoy our coffee.
review_5_text: The Starbucks in the Maya mall is a great place to hideaway and get some work done in their many tables and cosy nooks. The staff are wonderful, speak really great English and make amazing suggestions for coffee etc. They even do decaf coffee if you love the taste but can’t handle the caffeine ❤️and the wifi is pretty good too.

name: CAMP Creative and meeting place
review_1_text: I think this is one of the best working place here in Chiang Mai. You can work here if you just buy some food/beverage. It seems like you get 2 hours of wifi / 50baht you spend. It’s quiet and you easily forgot that you’re in a huuge shopping mall. Until you need to use a toilet, then you need to use shopping mall’s ”public toilet”. That’s something they could improve on! Terrace is nice and I 100% will come back soon.
review_2_text:
A spacious and trendy looking area to get some work done. I like the convenience of CAMP being in the mall in case I want to have more food options later 😁

The only downside is the WiFi strength isn’t strong here so expect some choppy date speeds. Other than that, I would give this place a visit 👌🏽 -@melanieguintu
review_3_text:
July 2025 Update:
No membership fee, but must purchase at least 1 item, a drink or food. Minimum spend ฿20 for a bottle of water.

Truly Amazing library and coworking space open for all. No monthly, weekly or daily membership or pass is needed. You can buy drinks or even work or read books without purchasing anything. Open from 8:00am till midnight everyday including Sunday.
review_4_text: Free coworking space/library. Open from 8 am until midnight. If you go before mall is open, you need to enter via garage. Internet is free for 2 hours with consumption of 50+ baht. Quiet space, perfect for working and studying. Tons of tables and sitting spaces.
review_5_text: Convenient study cafe with a variety of seating and desks, ranging from cubbies to group-oriented tables. Would have loved a place like this when I was a student. As it is, I enjoy it for the quiet. Regular cafes may have better specialty coffee drinks, but you're more likely to be subject to loud conversations. If you want to concentrate on your book, letter writing, etc. with fewer distractions, this is a good place for that. Arriving in the morning usually means better seating options. Seating is not super accessible for those with mobility restrictions.

name: Cha Tra Mue
review_1_text:
Very delicious Thai Tea with bubble. Reasonable price. A little bit much ice.

Love it.
review_2_text:
We really like this brand and this one is easy to get to in the basement of the mall.
It's busy, so expect a short wait.
review_3_text: Nice more chill ChaTraMue location 🤗 On the bottom floor. Lots of tables and good quieter place. Vegan options too. Staff is super friendly. I've been here two times.
review_4_text: They messed up my iced black tea by putting in black pearls (which I did not ordered); but corrected it quickly upon feedback. Friendly staff, one just need to have more patience with them.
review_5_text: Nice cafe brand with many drinks to choose from. Well known for their thai tea drink. The location is at the bottom of the Maya Mall in the corner of the food area.

name: ร้านผกา Phaka
review_1_text:
Nice sandwiches and salad at this place. Craft beer and desserts too

The place next door has other hot food and drinks and is the same owner

We had a bacon sandwich and a very good large  Caesar salad
review_2_text: coziest chill spot away from the noise :) really good sandwiches and nice music
review_3_text: I love this place so so much. I’ve been here a handful of times and it has never disappointed. They always make sure I have plenty of shade and am comfortable, they truly go above and beyond
review_4_text:
Haven't tried the food because of the deliciousness restaurant next door, but the coffee and ice coffee is great.

Friendly and chill guy who runs the place, always plays some nice chill music to vibe with in the garden under the tree 👌🏻
review_5_text: Came across this really cute coffee and tea bus stand while walking in the neighborhood:) I tried the hot apple tea and it was delicious. They have some seating on the side with a fan to keep you cool from the heat. Cash only.

name: 1% coffee Nimman
review_1_text: A small, no-nonsense coffee spot in Nimmanhaemin, Chiang Mai. The owner truly knows coffee and gives spot-on recommendations. Fair prices, a solid variety of beans, and quality in every cup. Simple, honest, and made for people who take their coffee seriously.
review_2_text:
Not a cafe-hopper, but definitely a coffee-hopper. so glad I made the right choice!

Chiang Mai has so many cafes, but the coffee here is amazing. I was so impressed with the light roast latte (usually I drink dark roast) that I had to go back and ask what coffee it was.

Definitely a good call among so many coffee spots!
review_3_text:
Good, hop coffee shop. Tiny place right by the main road. There is some seating. But most people just stop and by take away. They also sell beans.

The coffee is good and very cheap. 50 Baht for a cappuccino and other hot drinks. Lot‘s of locals but also tourists stop for coffee.
review_4_text:
Stumbled across this small startup coffee shop and boy I was lucky! Great coffee, two good flavour profiles of beans to choose from and since I was the last order of the day, he didn’t even charge me, what a guy :)
It was my first day & first coffee in Chiang Mai and what a lovely welcome experience.
review_5_text: Randomly found this gem while strolling around Nimman today. I ordered an Americano, and it is so juicy, in fact, much better than many specialty coffee cafes. Would revisit every time I have a chance! Recommended to everyone who loves great coffee, not to mention that it is not pricey at all. I hope the owner gets his own store/building in the future!

name: Cmor by Recall Hotels, Chiangmai
review_1_text:
I stayed at this hotel for a couple of nights and had a truly wonderful experience.🥰 All of the staff were kind, professional, and very sweet, which made my stay in Sharma Cmor much more comfortable.

I especially want to thank a staff member named Puupay. Late one night, when I needed help, she went out of her way to assist me with so much care and discretion. Even though it wasn’t something the hotel normally provides, she personally helped me and made sure I felt comfortable and not embarrassed at all. Her thoughtfulness and warmth genuinely touched me.🥰😊🙏🙏

Because of people like Puupay, this hotel feels more than just a place to stay🥰🥰 it feels like a place where guests are truly cared for. I highly recommend this hotel and sincerely appreciate the kindness of the staff.
review_2_text:
We were away for a special celebration. I guess this was the 'authentic' experience. Lots of Thai locals use this hotel.

The Pros: rooms are large and clean. Free bottled water, tea and coffee in the room.
Kitchenette for those who want to cook for themselves.
Located in short walking distance to a very busy and popular shopping/dining area.
Small but well presented breakfast

Cons: On a flight path - if you want a peaceful night sleep this is not for you, unless you're a very very deep sleeper.
The ladies on reception were not very friendly and seemed as if we were an inconvenience and that they would rather be somewhere else.
Breakfast not smooth - omelette stand never operated, and i had to turn on the waffle machine as noone could work out why it wasn't doing anything.
Pool on first floor, in the shade.
review_3_text: Great location with convenient transportation. The accommodation is excellent—very clean, with a swimming pool and well-appointed rooms. The staff are friendly, lovely, and attentive. Breakfast is good, with a wide variety of options and great taste. The hotel is located in the heart of Chiang Mai, close to Maya Shopping Mall and the airport. Beautiful views and pleasant weather make the stay even better.
review_4_text: My stay at this hotel was truly delightful. The room was clean, spacious, and beautifully decorated, with all the necessary amenities provided. The staff were warm, welcoming, and offered excellent service throughout my stay. The location was convenient and made traveling around the city very easy. It’s a great choice whether for relaxation or business. I would definitely stay here again on my next visit.”
review_5_text:
Location is good. 10min walking distance to Maya shopping center
Room is spacey, equipped with microwave
However , the aircon of the room seem to be off, I been turning on it at 16celsius but it does not feel cool

name: % Arabica Chiang Mai One Nimman
review_1_text: Seems like a chain (I also saw it in Beijing). A bit more pricey than usual, but the coffee had a unique taste — rich and smooth. I really enjoyed it.
review_2_text: For the area this is good coffee in a wonderfully atmosphere at a higher than average price. The design aesthetic of the coffee shop is what brought us in. And the coffee was great, by default it is not served with sugar which is refreshing and the only place in Thailand we have seen to do this. We ordered two hot lates, a chocolate croissant, an almond croissant, an iced chocolate milk and were offered two small child sized milks for free. (COST: 800TB, $22USD) We were the first in the shop at 9 AM.
review_3_text: Friendly staff and great coffee. The service was warm and attentive, and the coffee was smooth and delicious. Highly recommended 👍🏻
review_4_text: The matcha was amazing and I’d highly recommend it. It is very strong so I added a bit of sweetener and that made it perfect for me. The only thing is that it made my stomach hurt very badly and my chest hurt. I don’t know if it’s because I had it on an empty stomach, but my stomach hasn’t hurt like that since i got appendicitis so I’m not sure🤷‍♀️
review_5_text: It is a design coffee shop à la Starbucks but with far more design. The coffee is great! It is of course not a cheap coffee shop .. by design.

name: Tiger Ted Cafe
review_1_text:
Ice lattes are not my first choice order. But on this hot and sunny day I went for one.

This is one very decent ice latte. The body of the espresso itself should be quite heavy, resulting in an overall pleasing texture. Strong tasting notes that does not let the mill dilute it.

If the ice latte is good, I figure the other coffees gotta be good.
review_2_text:
This is one of the best cafes behind the giant mall.
I'm telling you if you want a better tasting coffee with delicious pastry. The price is amazing.  With parking.

You have outdoor and indoor seating with aircon.
It's better than trying to fight for parking. This is too easy. Pay half the price for your latte and pastries.
Also, it's set up for your social media 📸

The service was amazing, and the coffee was delicious 😋
They warmed up the banana bread.
review_3_text: Had breakfast and lunch here multiple times, we just kept coming back! Best matcha I have ever had, but their coffee(machine) is just as impressive. Food is great also, thai omelet and thai basil stir fry where my favorite. Staff is super friendly. Overall, 10/10 would recommend!
review_4_text: Excellent Coffee and a surprising sense of isolation even though it’s right next to Maya. I love working here on my computer in the mornings when the crowd is low. By mid-day though, this place can fill up fast. Love the shipping containers and the giant tree. It really feels like a treehouse upstairs. I’ve even been visited by squirrels once or twice. Prices are good and the ambiance is great. I just wish it wasn’t so close to the road and the airplane path.
review_5_text: Opposite my hotel. Ate fried rice and Pad Thai. It was delicious and the fried rice had a mild taste of wok hei (charred) which is great. The lattee and Thai tea is good. The boss is very accommodating and speaks good English. I would recommend you the come if you're around Maya shopping mall and need a rest n drinks.

name: Cottontree
review_1_text: Best espresso in the past 10 years, made of local beans - just giving credit where it's due. Carrot cake is good. Cappuccino was made with care suitable for brain surgery on one's own mother.
review_2_text:
🍃This cosy coffee shop, tucked away in the sports centre near Maya Mall, serves freshly brewed coffee. They offer a selection of local coffee blends.

💓The friendly staff, cozy space, and free Wi-Fi make it a great place to relax. They also have a clean-out house available.
review_3_text: As for coffee and service, it's simply really good. Barista knows what they are doing. But for the cakes there is still some room for improvement.
review_4_text:
Quaint little place just at the back of Hotel Mayu near a badminton centre. Presumably for the parents to wait after they drop their kids off for a badminton session...

The coffee was really lovely, the food is also nice as well. If you live nearby in one of the hotels or u are coming to Mayu mall and looking for some coffee or brunch food then i think its definately worth the short walk over to get some coffee
review_5_text: Another peaceful cafe with good coffee and dessert. The smoothie bowl was cool and could be better with more crunchy granola or cacao nibs. Hot flat white was delicious with moderate price of 70 Baht. The banoffee pie was delicious; it's a big one. You should probably go with someone to finish it.

name: EatMor Cafe & Bistro
review_1_text: I tried 3 lunch sets as we had 3 people. Their pasta dish was not so good, but everything else was great. Their Khao Soi tastes like something between Khao Son and Japanese curry rice. This restaurant is located in the 1st floor of a 4 star hotel, so the bathroom and the space is good and clean. This place usually has discount available online, so I never pay the full price here.
review_2_text: Discovering the EatMor cafe @ Cmor hotel was a pleasant surprise. The atmosphere was relaxed and inviting, with friendly staff to match. The menu offered a great selection of options to suit any taste. Excellent coffee and blended drinksI thoroughly enjoyed our visit and will definitely be back for more! 5/5 stars.
review_3_text: Great food, very flavourful and presented perfectly. Highly recommended!
review_4_text:
Cream cheese dessert is highly recommended.
Khao soi is good.
review_5_text: Quiet place to work on laptop, easy to find, spacious, great food and cost, lovely service 🙏

name: Homey Home Cafe
review_1_text: Cozy morning magic in Chiang Mai's Santhitham! This homey haven whips up fluffy toasts, fresh brews, and sweet treats that warm the soul—especially those creamy matcha drinks we savored two of, perfectly blended and refreshing. All in a charming indoor-outdoor setup with different theme rooms and endless photo ops. Relaxed vibes, friendly faces, and that feel-good escape? Your perfect start to any day.
review_2_text: A stately, historic mansion that these days takes form as an extravagantly large cafe, tastefully remodeled to fantastic effect. A notably ecclectic and volumnious spread of seating is spread across multiple floors on the interior, and likewise across multiple outdoor areas. Early morning opening hours here on a weekday are quiet, making for an opportune time to snoop about, explore the many facets of Homey's fascinating and beautifully laid-out space, and find the perfect nook to spend the next hour or two. Not to forget Homey's cafe aspect, where friendly and welcoming staff serve up great beverages and bites to accompany one's time here.
review_3_text: Unexpected to find this cafe in the suburb neighborhood with small lanes of residential shop houses. Its just 100m from our accommodation place. The coffee and tea drinks are good - go for the iced version as weather is quite hot. Try a cake too.
review_4_text: Such a big house, made as a cafe. It is 4 half-storey house as far as I can see. The serve western breakfast sets, which came with a big portion of salad.
review_5_text: I'm confused by the employee's statement that said the matcha here is expensive. 129 baht per glass. I intend to walk in and buy it. Whether it's cheap or expensive, I can pay. Employees don't need to ask customers questions like this.

name: Cozy Owls Chiang Mai
review_1_text: Overall a pleasant stay. The rooms were ok, you get what you pay for. Cleanliness was very good, the maids would clean and disinfect the rooms and bathroom every day. Mai who was at the front desk goes above and beyond. She’s so bubbly, positive and friendly a real refreshing ray of light. Unfortunately, the boy who’s there “Puu” is miserable and rude. Extremely rude and unhelpful. All he does is sit play his games and look at you like you’ve asked him for a kidney if you require any assistance. Not what I want to be seeing during my travels this negative energy. But it’s okay because Mai countered it. I would stay here again I liked the vibe, the rooms and the location. Rent a ped though as it’s way easier to get around
review_2_text:
Stayed here for two nights and honestly, you can’t beat the price — 5 USD a night is insane for what you get. The accommodations were simple but totally fine. My sheets were clean, no hair, and the bed was comfortable enough. The room did get a little warm, but that’s just part of sharing a dorm with other people, not the hostel’s fault.

What really stood out was the front desk. Super helpful every time I asked for assistance. They even made calls for me and helped confirm my pickup for an elephant sanctuary reservation I had. They really go out of their way to make sure things run smoothly for you.

Overall, great value, clean stay, and genuinely kind staff. I’d definitely stay here again.
review_3_text: Stayed at Cozy Owls for 1 month in their Double Deluxe Studio. It was perfect. The room is new and spacious. There’s a little balcony to chill. Staff is very friendly too. Wi-fi is also good, I could work on it. It’s in a very quiet location, but very close to everything you need (restaurants/supermarket, etc).
review_4_text:
Cozy Owls Chiang Mai is an excellent choice for budget-conscious travelers and long-term visitors, offering a combination of hostel and apartment-style living. Guests consistently praise its exceptional cleanliness—it’s often noted as one of the cleanest hostels in the area. The rooms and private accommodations (which sometimes feature balconies with mountain views) are modern and comfortable, providing good value for money.
The staff are frequently highlighted as friendly, helpful, and knowledgeable about the local area, enhancing the overall welcoming atmosphere. While the location is a short distance from the Old City, it's conveniently close to local markets like Chang Puak and accessible by local transport.
review_5_text:
Room 301 – Terrible experience
There was a strong smell coming from the bathroom, hair on the bed and floor, and dirty marks in the bathroom. The sheets and pillows were also dirty and had hair on them. It was impossible to sleep with those bad odors. When I spoke with the manager, she said it was the guest’s fault and claimed the room was fine, but she refused to come and check the room herself to see how dirty and smelly it really was.
Stay date: November 6, 2025.

name: Bannom cafe
review_1_text:
Pasta and spaghetti cafe. Have a lot different kinds of drink. I try tje spaghetti beacon with dry chilli.

Facilities:
* Indoor lounge
* AC
* Private room with Japanesse seating style
* Free wifi
* QRis pay (bank permata bisa disini)
* Drink from outside is not allowed

Note:
* The Mango bingsu need to try, aroi mak 👍
review_2_text: My initial visit was not entirely satisfactory.
