The music selection, specifically the K-POP dance performance, seemed incongruous with the coffee shop's intended atmosphere, and the volume was somewhat elevated. While I surmise the establishment may be targeting a mid-tier market segment, the overall experience was rather unremarkable. The practice of presenting the bill immediately upon service of coffee and food warrants discussion. Although some establishments adopt this approach to ensure transparency regarding order details, I find it less than optimal for customer engagement. This practice may inadvertently discourage additional purchases due to heightened budget awareness. Furthermore, given that order details were reiterated at the point of payment, the immediate printing of the bill appears to be an unnecessary expenditure of resources and is not environmentally sustainable. On a positive note, the coffee's flavor was exceptional and exceeded my expectations. The staff members were consistently polite and helpful.
review_3_text:
not bad
I was afraid of meeting a friend named Apple, but fortunately she was nowhere to be seen

but my back hurts because of the chairs I sit in at the coworking space.

The waitress named Eve was very nice.
review_4_text:
Find this place as walking around there.
I was in the cafe around 6pm to 9pm.
A lot of local people. Some people are working . Some people just eat and leave.

Ordered spicy spaghetti Macha strawberry latte and fruity rotti(?) .
Taste is good and reasonable price
3 come out less than US$10.
review_5_text: With reasonable prices and a diverse menu, it’s perfect for having brunch or just coffee and dessert. The atmosphere is cozy and versatile—great for chatting or getting some work done over brunch.

name: Paper Plane CNX
review_1_text:
We payed 11€ for one night and this was the best place we stayed at for this price. Good AC, clean, hot water. Wasn't looking for more at this price.

Cons - bathroom has like plastic bit in roof (instead of window) - looks ok, but rain makes it very loud.

Also there was some minor noise behind the walls, but for short period of time
review_2_text:
We stayed in room 1, and if you checked the previous review, someone had already pointed out a strong smell coming from the bathroom drain. I can't believe this problem hasn't been solved after all these months. When we asked for assistance regarding this issue, they just placed a plate with air freshener to cover the drain. However, even with five air fresheners in the bathroom, the smell couldn't be offset. I think the hotel should take this problem more seriously.

On the next night, we suddenly couldn't get into the room and couldn't find any staff to help us physically. We could only contact the receptionist by text. They told us they had changed the password, but we were confused as to why they didn't inform us initially. What if we had come back late at night and no one responded to our WhatsApp text?

We also doubted the cleanliness of the room as the bed sheet had so many black stains. The air conditioner and fridge were running, but they weren't cooling at all. Moreover, the digital door lock was too simple and didn't have a latch inside the room, which made us feel insecure.

The receptionist was responsive tho, and replied to us in a timely manner. The design of the room was cozy, and the location was fine. Those are the pros I can think of. It's budget-friendly, indeed, but the hotel should focus more on the facilities and service.
review_3_text: Great location. The coffee is good and the flavors are bold. Indoor and outdoor seating available in a lovely small garden. They also sell coffee beans in case you want to bring some home. The coffee shop itself isn’t big but very cozy and friendly atmosphere. Super friendly and helpful staff. Highly recommended!
review_4_text:
WARNING! Read before you book!

Terrible Service.
Booked a room during the Loy Krathong and before I booked and paid I contacted the premise via Whatsapp to confirm the availability of the room and been confirmed it was available.

Yet at the last minute they cancelled my booking stating it's a system error for the room had already been booked during that day.  Apparently cancelling my booking and hiked up the price to sell for more profit.

Ended up ruining my stay in Chiangmai during the Loy Krathong.  The worst ever travelling experience.
review_5_text: They have a cafe at the entrance and I had hot cappuccino and it was ok. The space has AC, but is pretty small and only 1 good table and others are small tables.

name: BeansLiquor
review_1_text:
Super neat hole in the wall. Would've missed it if I was randomly driving or walking around. But someone I knew recommended it, and it was a great recommendation.
Service was great(limited english speaking, but english on menus), atmosphere pretty quiet(great place to study and has outlets so your laptop doesnt die!), the decor was clearly thought about. And it has 3 FLOORS(eventually to be 4??) with lots of great seating and lighting. Highly recommend the place whether for a hangout or a study session.
I tried a coffee with Lychee syrup and a dessert cake, both of which were pretty decent. I will definitely come back!
review_2_text: Stumbled upon this place randomly on a morning walk. Delicious coffee and breakfast sandwich. The coffee shop is also very uniquely decorated and quite spacious with three floors.
review_3_text: Good coffee and delicious food, reasonably priced. The space is pleasant for working or studying with plenty of tables available (outlets too), but also nice minimalist decor for just enjoying a coffee. The staff are very kind and helpful
review_4_text:
Coffee is okay. Pasta is okay.

Staff are nice!! This coffee shop is very much work friendly.

Dont make the same mistake as me, good amount of tables and chairs with outlets are located at the 2nd and 3rd floor.
review_5_text: To be completely honest, I didn't set my expectations towards the food to taste this good despite how good the presentation is. The while place is well decorated and super chill. It's perfect for hanging out or even a nice brunch. 100% recommended.

name: Have You Bean
review_1_text: Nice, chic cafe along a quiet street with a cosy, wood-padded aesthetic and tasteful decorative finishes and furnishings—albeit with limited dine-in seating—sporting a contemporary aesthetic across the board. Tended to by nice and cordial staff/owners, serving up superb coffee and cakes at a pretty solid price.
review_2_text: Just discovered this new coffee shop and already in love! 🧡🤎 Great Coffee & Thai Tea at a good reasonable price, with a stylish space that’s full of charm. Nice staff. The vibes are super relaxed — perfect for catching up with friends or getting some work done!
review_3_text: You can feel great taste of coffee. I love here that I can choose the coffee bean with the affordable price.
review_4_text:
A cool coffee space that pop up around the corner of the street. Coffee is good, price is really affordable, the place is great if you want a quiet place to work or relax away from the heat.
You can also choose your coffee roast! Definitely coming back and making it my regular coffee spot.
review_5_text:
I recently stumbled upon this charming little café run by a talented young barrister, and I couldn’t be happier with my experience! The atmosphere is well lit, cozy and inviting, making it the perfect spot to relax with a good book or catch up with friends.

The highlight, of course, is the coffee. They use a Victoria Arduino espresso machine and local beans, and you can really taste the quality in every cup. The hot latte is a masterpiece—both visually stunning and deliciously rich. And let’s not forget the latte art! Each cup is a work of art, showcasing the barista’s skill and creativity.

I’ll definitely be returning for more of that amazing coffee and to see what new designs the barista comes up with. Highly recommend!

name: Path Nimman
review_1_text:
Jeju Matcha Coconut has a truly luxurious matcha flavor, with a refreshing finish and a smooth, easy-to-drink texture. It’s a refined taste that’s hard to find elsewhere, so I highly recommend it.

If you want to experience the perfect harmony of smooth coffee and rich cream, be sure to order the cream latte.

This café is especially known for its cakes and desserts—make sure to try every variety at least once.

The friendliness of the owner and staff is an added bonus.

Parking is very convenient, as there is a dedicated parking space right in front of the café (not street parking).
review_2_text: Chic cafe ! Seems like Seoul one tho.. pretty chills and peaceful recom to come to work !
review_3_text: Tasty cakes and good service, minimalist Cafe, recommend 👌
review_4_text: If you want a well prepared cup of coffee please come here. Great beans and diligently prepared to bring out the tasting notes.
review_5_text: We were very happy that this cafe is opend again and very closed to my house. The old friend came back with nice coffee and bakery.

name: TEA FAC.
review_1_text: Solid bevs and bites at this cafe, decked out in thematic spooky decor for Halloween when I visited. Cordial and efficient service, and though there doesn't seem to be that much seating, it was nice and quiet on the weekday afternoon I went.
review_2_text:
By far one of the tastiest teas and coffees I had in Chiang Mai!
I recommend the rose tea milk and orange juice-coffee.
You can also buy tea leaves/coffee bags to take home.
Discovered this place 2 years ago when I was living here and decided to come back and try it out once more.
The service is real nice!
review_3_text:
✨ Hidden Gem for Tea & Coffee Lovers in Chiang Mai – TEA FAC ✨

If you’re in Chiang Mai and looking for a cozy spot to enjoy premium tea or coffee, TEA FAC is a must-visit. Located in a quiet alley not far from the city center, this place blends minimalist aesthetics with a deep love for quality brews.

The menu offers a variety of thoughtfully curated teas—especially Thai teas, which are rich, aromatic, and served in beautiful glassware. Their coffee options are also excellent, with beans sourced from local roasters and brewed with precision. I tried their Thai Milk Tea and it was perfectly balanced—fragrant, smooth, and not overly sweet.

The staff were friendly and knowledgeable, happy to share insights about each drink. The vibe is peaceful, making it a great spot for relaxing, working, or catching up with a friend.

Whether you’re a tea enthusiast or just looking for café  in Chiang Mai, TEA FAC is a delightful stop. 🌿☕️
review_4_text: Not my favorite type of coffee as there is no acidity and they do not have light roast beans to choose from. The prices are very affordable, so it is still worth a try.
review_5_text:
Very cute cafe , tasty medium roast coffee.
Open early at 7:30am.
There is parking for customers.

name: Uhas Cafe เชียงใหม่
review_1_text:
Clean and bright brand new space with ample seating including power outlets and wifi. Excellent pour over coffee. Overall great and very affordable .

If they added some healthy snacks it would be a great place to get some work done for a longer session.
review_2_text:
They have a lovely light roast coffee hidden away in a drawer.

If you ask them they will take it out 😉 was glad I did as I don’t normally drink dark roast coffee.

Was one of the best cups I have had in chiang mai.
review_3_text: So glad to find this place for work. Also the food is great and it closes late. I'll be frequenting it for sure 🙏
review_4_text: There are plenty of seats and power outlets available. They also offer non-coffee drinks like cocoa. The air conditioning is just right, so it’s comfortable even for long stays. It’s open from morning until night, which is really convenient. I was pleasantly surprised by how clean the restroom was.
review_5_text: Very nice cafe 👌

name: FOEI
review_1_text:
FOEL Coffee Shop – Chang Phueak, Chiang Mai ☕️🌿

I recently had the chance to visit this Coffee Shop in the Chang Phueak area, The atmosphere is cozy and relaxing, with an open and airy feel. It’s a great spot to sit back, or simply unwind on a laid-back day.

I ordered a cappuccino, and it was excellent. The texture was smooth and creamy, with a wonderfully balanced flavor. The coffee aroma was rich yet mellow, not overly bitter, and the milk foam was fine and velvety. Everything blended together perfectly.

Overall, it’s a warm and welcoming café—ideal for recharging during the day. If you’re in the area, it’s definitely worth a visit. ☕️✨
review_2_text:
FOEI in Santitham is such a hidden gem.

Cozy vibe, great coffee, and super friendly staff. The drinks and desserts are beautifully made and taste amazing. Perfect spot to chill, work, or catch up with friends.

Highly recommended!
review_3_text: I tried here couple of items and can say that matcha tasted better cold. Hot cocoa was more milk than cocoa. The black coffee was 👌
review_4_text: Es-yen is elite! Not overly sweet. Cafe has a quite warm ambience and the cafe next door offers good bakes too.
review_5_text:
Good coffee with great taste at an affordable price Parking is available
Perfect for chilling and relaxing.

name: ชาตาโต คาเฟ่&คาร์แคร์ สาขาสันติธรรมเชียงใหม่
review_1_text: It’s a very cute coffee spot in Chiang Mai. The attention is great and so many good options of drinks and dessert. I recommend it, cool spot for pictures but also quality drinks for a good price.
review_2_text: Very good cleaning job. My car damage In flood and they open all and full cleaning. It is 10 years old. Now looks like my new car. Good job. 👍👍
review_3_text: A bright and cozy cafe with amazing drinks that located not too far from the old town. Today they offer me Strawberry Smoothie topped with Waffle and Mixed Fruits and I enjoyed it very much. Lovely place and reasonable price. High recommended. 🫰🏻❤️
review_4_text: Only reason I come here is because of the adjacent car wash, one of the more honest ones I can find in Chiang Mai. Typical coffee bar with an assortment of hot and cold drinks. It's still a nice place to drop by even if you're not getting a car wash.
review_5_text: Original taste and very good quality value of money i like that place and recommend to all

name: Coffee inc nimman
review_1_text:
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
A hidden gem in Nimman! 💖 The coffee here is amazing — I had the Americano (60 baht) with a lovely toasty, nutty flavor that really stood out.

Both the indoor and outdoor seating areas are cozy and relaxing, making it a perfect spot to chill, catch up with friends, or get some work done. Highly recommend stopping by if you’re in the area! Many good photos spots and instagrammable.
review_2_text: 10/10 My wife and I come here every single day!! Coffee is great, service by faii is the best!! Love her so much shes so sweet and good at her job! 💕💕 They also sell snus for a good price if you need! :)
review_3_text:
☕✨ Hidden gem in Nimman!
This café has such a cozy and peaceful vibe — chill interior, soft international tunes playing in the background, and the perfect spot to relax or get some work done.

Tried their mocha with 25% sweetness today and wow… it’s exactly the flavor I was craving! Definitely adding this place to my list of go-to cafés in the area.
⭐ 9.5/10

P.S. The AC could be a bit cooler, so if you’re coming straight from the hot sun, you might still feel a touch warm.
review_4_text: It was a great Saturday. I've been here twice this week. I love the Thai-style mango sticky rice cookies; they're not too sweet. My boyfriend and I ordered some to go with our hot cappuccinos. We'll definitely be back.
review_5_text: Super cool spot, and they have the Snus! Gob and Time helped me out, awesome guys - there’s more Snus flavors than you know what to do with. They even have sample taster cans if you want to try before you buy. 100% recommend 🤙

name: cafe & Restaurant
review_1_text: Nice restaurant with air-conditioned space and terrace. Staff was very kind. We ordered tom yum chicken and red curry stir fried chicken. Both meals were good.
review_2_text:
Such a nice place for lunch!
Very comfy place with nice service.
Food is yammy! And aircons is just a life saver in this hot days.
review_3_text: I like as much the ambient as the thai tea, very recommended!
review_4_text: Looks like it’s closed down
review_5_text: A cool and clean café. I've been here several times, and the Thai tea is truly delicious. They also offer snacks and meals, but I've only tried the roti twice. Its crispy texture makes it perfect for a snack. The interior is cool, and there are ashtrays outside for smokers.

name: Cafe Liberty Chiang Mai
review_1_text: If you’re in Chiang Mai and love coffee, Cafe Liberty is a must-visit! Their coffee is perfectly brewed, with rich flavors and a smooth finish that will delight your taste buds. The cozy atmosphere and friendly staff make it the perfect spot to relax and enjoy a great cup of coffee. Don’t miss out – come and taste the difference at Cafe Liberty!
review_2_text:
There are almond milk and oat milk in substitutions for regular dairy milk.
Coffee beans have 2 options: dark roast and medium roast.
Coffee is good.
Coffee space is small with inside and outdoor seats.
Staff is nice.
review_3_text:
I strongly advocate for small business owners and their endeavors.
. Enjoyed a delightful ice Mocha that was absolutely delicious.
. The barista was exceptionally polite and provided me with a wonderful xperience.
. The establishment is modest yet pleasant.
review_4_text:
no breakfast food choice
just a sandwich which just taste so so, can skip if not hungry
coffee serve with a small tea
staffs are nice gave me an biscuit
review_5_text: Ordered Thai tea frappe and cocoa, both tasty. There is toilet so can stay long time.

name: Lucky's Vietnamese Restaurant - Chiang Mai
review_1_text: Delicious and affordable! The DIY spring roll platter was fresh, fun, and full of flavor. Loved the grilled pork and herb combo. Flan was silky and not too sweet. Casual vibes, generous portions. Definitely coming back.
review_2_text: I really like Vietnamese food, and this was extremely good. We ordered the plate and everything tasted so fresh and amazing. It just fits so well together. The coffee is also really good and strong and will keep you awake. Loved the food and the staff! 10/10
review_3_text:
A very homie Vietnamese, not a lot of choice but uniqueness menus and delicious. Owner and staff are very nice.

They are also welcome pets even it is outdoor only but the weather is so nice.

Sauces are special nutty, a little buttery (from nut) and not so spicy. อร่อยเลย
review_4_text:
I would say thank you guys by done a great job that making our Vietnamese cuisine so special. It's not really rare to find the Vietnamese Food there or, in Thailand but this spirit, i would say u can find nowhere. Let's try it to feel it guys.

Hopefully I can see you guys really soon in the future for a new brand here in Bangkok.

Thank you guys once again yahh! Take care y"allll 👏
review_5_text: 15/10 — this place is unbelievable! The food is beyond excellent and the staff are so friendly. We’ve spent a lot of time in Vietnam and have eaten at countless Vietnamese restaurants around the world, and this one easily makes my top five of all time. We had the bun cha, bun no na bo, and the custard dessert — each dish was somehow even better than the last. So happy to have discovered this place, and we’ll absolutely be back. Highly recommend it to anyone visiting!

name: BOB Coffee
review_1_text: Great place to have coffee and spend some time to chat or even work! Love the furnitures and the overall vibe there. There's not much to eat tho
review_2_text: Nice coffee, lovely staff, and a comfortable, spacious place where you can choose your own spot.
review_3_text: Is a really nice and cosy coffee shop. Their coffee is really nice and the bakery tastes really good. There's other space at the back of the shop where you can take pictures and bring your laptop for work.
review_4_text: Pretty popular cafe among young locals. There are some workable tables here and I like how the windows are large and it is very bright. I tried cappuccino for 50thb and it was great. The bathroom is super clean and there is a car parking.
review_5_text: Coffees and Thai tea are good. There's two large space to work - one with air-conditions and one with fans, but not all tables have electric sockets. There's car parking space at the back as well.

name: คาเฟ่ เดอ โสต Cafe de Sot
review_1_text: Discover the most enchanting café in Chiang Mai, nestled just north of the Old Town in the charming Chang Pueak neighborhood. Step into a tranquil oasis where a cascading waterfall, a peaceful pond, and vibrant greenery create the perfect escape from the city’s hustle and bustle. Savor exquisite European-style cakes and pastries, paired with expertly brewed coffee and a variety of fine teas—all at prices friendlier than those in the historic center. What makes this experience truly special? Every visit supports and empowers the local deaf community, making your time here not only delightful but meaningful.
review_2_text: Beautiful cafe. They only seen to serve cake which is a pretty but I had a lovely time nine the less. Such nice surroundings. The perfect place to chill, have a coffee or get some work done.
review_3_text:
"Hey! 👋 I found a really lovely spot called Cafe de Sot I'd love to take you to!

I picked it specifically because it's known for being quiet 🤫 and having a calming atmosphere ✨, which means it should be much easier on your ears and make chatting comfortable. ☕
Are you free to try it out sometime soon? Let me know! 😊"

I can also draft a short social media post about this cafe if you'd like to share your find!
review_4_text: A beautiful cafe with a pond and waterfall and a beautiful social mission to help deaf students, but it serves low-quality products and doesn’t have any plant milks.
review_5_text:
I had an iced coconut Americano. I liked it, though it was a bit too sweet for my liking.

The outdoor area, with all the greenery, is awesome and very pleasant to look at. However, the inside is quite confusing. The ladies at the counter were also not very accommodating and seemed irritated when asked questions. Hopefully, this can be improved.

name: Areemitr Coffee
review_1_text:
This place has become very popular over the last few years, especially if you live around Santitham.
It’s honestly the best coffee ever... made with so much love and it costs only 40 baht.
I always love to support small family business and they are the sweetest.
the son and his dad work together and brew the best coffe, I really like them.
It's always a pleasure to enjoy my morning coffee here. It has such a cute surrounding with the small plants in the sitting area.

Since it became more popular, the waiting time can be a little longer, but that’s because everyone wants good coffee for 40 baht.
review_2_text: Excellent coffee, good price! The owner is very kind, and the service is thoughtful, they provide mosquitoes spray on every table. Sometimes you have to wait over 20mins due to too many customers, but the owner will tell you waiting time while ordering. This cafe is almost my everyday coming-to place. Really a hidden gem!
review_3_text:
The iced latte ☕ really lives up to the recommendations—absolutely delicious. The price is a rare find in this area at just 40 THB.🌟

The owner and his son are incredibly lovely and welcoming, which adds to the experience. The location works perfectly for me and gives off very homey, cozy vibes.

The only small note is that the menu is quite limited, but that’s totally okay. I’ll definitely be coming back!💖
review_4_text: Wanna know why this place is popular? The latte is double the size of other places, 40bhat, and tastes A+ level. Yea you could find some places with S tier coffee that might edge Areemitr out, but you will pay triple the price or more. The only downside is the wait times; I hope they can upgrade to a larger machine or hire help and expand their wonderful business.
review_5_text:
This Cafe is perfect place for digital nomad and people who want to take a rest. Especially Korean will be loved for here. Taste, Aroma & even price was really awesome. Whenever I visit the Chiangmai Cafe, there’s very few amount of coffee & beverages. But this cafe provided plenty of amount & great taste.
I’ll really be here, again.

name: Magic Brew Coffee
review_1_text: Absolutely 5 stars. A magic cafe that brews both good coffee and Thai tea. Once you drink their ice latte and fresh orange americano, you will understand why they have queues everyday in the shop. Drinks are cheap, around 40/50 baht per cup. The owner grows his own bean proudly. I think they are a family small business. Do order their ice latte, it’s strong nutty flavored coffee with special chocolate aroma. Most importantly, try their Thai tea, both black and green are super good. Their tea is way better than Chatramue with same price. I guess their secret is to boil the tea with moka pot. Fantastic flavor! My top 5 cafe in Chiangmai.
review_2_text:
During my stay in Chiang Mai, my perfect morning routine starts next door at Nana Bakery, where I pick up a freshly baked pastry, then bring it over to Magic Brew Cafe to enjoy with their excellent latte.

This cozy spot attracts many regular Western customers, some even bringing their own breakfast to pair with the coffee. The latte here has a rich, full-bodied flavor with low acidity, which makes it one of my personal favorites in town.

The staff are friendly and welcoming, and the menu is affordable with plenty of variety, making it a great choice for a relaxed and satisfying start to the day.
review_3_text:
Tried so many coffee and Thai tea in chiang mai. This is the best. The coffee is delicious and made with such care and love. The thai tea is brewed in a mocha pot, it gives it a special kick of freshness and taste.

The smoothies, the coconut, the orange coffee - everything in this shop is so fresh, and you can feel it when you drink.

+ they have a large bar sitting, it functions as a real social hub of santitham.
Costumers are a mix of locals and foreigners with a good palette for coffee.

Highly recommended.
review_4_text: The best coffee I’ve ever tasted! Perfection every time. Ask for dark roast 🙌🏼. The only downside is that I had to leave. Win is an absolute craftsman!
review_5_text:
A coffee shop in Chiang Mai that’s always busy with both locals and tourists.
They offer three roast levels — light, medium, and dark. I’m a dark-roast person, so I usually go for the iced dark-roast espresso. It’s bold, aromatic, and really refreshing.
Good prices and friendly service make this a place I can come back to almost every day. Definitely worth a stop if you’re in Chiang Mai. 👍

name: Book Thief Cafe
review_1_text:
What a wonderful pleasant surprise. Atmosphere is wonderful, relaxing but stylish. Not noisy, and more upscale than places around it. An oasis of sorts.

I like it so much that I will be back!
review_2_text:
Cozy cafe for "thiefing" your time in reading book, online working or mingle with friend for coffee or muffins. Quiet & calm place, not noisy with traffic.

Facility:
* Free wifi
* QRis pay (BCA gak bisa)
* Card pay (min 300 baht)
* Had 2nd floor
* Had outdoor area
* Had a little bit private spot for meeting (can held 4-12 people i think)
* Had 2 side window spot
* Had swimming pool

Request:
* More electric plug on table spot
review_3_text: Really a cool place with a brilliant design and a positive vibe.. several cozy spaces with seating and surfaces, good for getting things done… nice people and a simple but satisfying menu.. would recommend to others
review_4_text: My favourite cafe on this side of Chiang Mai to get a great coffee, tasty Thai tea, and most importantly for me to get some work done - perfect location to take a laptop and be productive. Also fantastic service from the barista 🙂
review_5_text:
Super cute cafe and chill area where you can relax and work from here also.

Coffee was nice but not the best I have had in the area, it’s worth coming for the chilled vibe and lovely staff though.

name: OYES Smoothies & Happy Food - โอเยส ผักผลไม้ปั่นเพื่อสุขภาพ
review_1_text:
Highly recommend. Delicious creamy chocolate strawberry smoothie bowl with chocolate protein. YUM. Delicious and healthy! Best prices too!
Calm relaxing atmosphere. Tried coffee from the Karen Tribe in northern Thailand here , now I have a new favourite coffee bean!!

Wonderful place. Many healthy options with protein (whey + vegan) Come, you’ll enjoy it. 😌
review_2_text:
OYES Smoothies & Happy Food is a great spot with friendly staff and a pet- and work-friendly atmosphere. The smoothies and açaí bowls are delicious and refreshing, and the coffee is tasty as well. The cookies are absolutely to die for!
It’s an excellent place for breakfast or brunch, especially if you’re looking for healthy and satisfying options in a relaxed environment. Highly recommended!
review_3_text:
The food- amazing smoothies and smoothie bowls.
The service- most friendly staff in the area.
The atmosphere- wonderfully appointed, soft music, quiet inside, wifi, good vibes, nice outside area.
review_4_text:
One of my go to spots to enjoy a tasty and healthy breakfast before going to a coworking space around the corner.

Kind staff and also good coffee!

Pro tip; add in a scoop of Whey protein to make sure you’ll hit your macro’s
review_5_text: Wonderful smoothies and fruit bowls made with high quality products and without the sweeteners, water or ice get in so many other places. Friendly service and good location as well!

name: Epilogue Cafe & Souvenir
review_1_text:
A new cozy café with a stylish interior and convenient opening hours.
Good coffee, desserts, and food. You can come here just to relax or to work with a laptop.

You can also buy souvenirs from local artisans here: wooden and leather items, bags, jewelry, as well as dried fruits, soaps, and fragrances.

The service is polite and friendly. Highly recommended!
review_2_text:
I was looking for a cafe where a nomad could work, so I visited, and found out it was the cafe of popular YouTuber Ricky (aka Mango Family). I also happened to run into Ricky, who happened to be at a cafe.

It boasts a cozy atmosphere,
and I had a flat white, and the coffee was delicious. and Pad thai was also really delicious.

The network speed was also very good. The cafe was packed with people working remotely.
review_3_text:
Great location and good food. A relaxing place that’s perfect for taking a break, grabbing some tea, and reading.

One suggestion for improvement: the order bell is very loud. It might be better to use one that just vibrates.
review_4_text:
All about style here. Not really a place for espresso lovers, generic at best. Up beat pop playlist mostly old American if you like that. It's a rainy day so I'm enjoying the bright lights and sense of being somewhere else kinda suspended in time!
Their concept is carrying to travelers on the last day in CNX, even adding an airport shuttle service. Somehow slightly louder music intentionally fits that aesthetic.
review_5_text: A bright double-storied space with varied seating that, while decently ample, does get quite occupied on a midafternoon. The drinks are refreshing, served by very warm and friendly staff.

name: Mood:D Cafe & Hostel
review_1_text: Cute little indoor / air conditioned cafe. Peaceful break from traffic noise. Fair prices considering the overheads they would have. I had the teriyaki chicken bowl and plain iced latte. Food was tasty. Only disappointment was the coffee that didn’t have any ice and was sweetened heavily without me asking. Maybe due to a language miscommunication.  They have some baked goods that looked nice though I didn’t try them. There is a little shelf of card and board games that people can use, which is a nice touch.
review_2_text: Relatively modern cafe with AC. You can choose the roast level of your coffee here, but my americano should be better for the price. I also tried chicken nuggets and that could be better as well. The space is nicer than many cafes around with some decent tables and power outlets. It would be not a bad option during the summer time.
review_3_text: I stopped by for a quick drink, and ended up having hours of great conversation with the owner and her staff. The decor is simple and minimalist, and I even got to see the rooftop area that serves really delicious izakaya style skewers. Great sunset and mountain view there. The business is fairly new so I look forward to how the cafe/hostel/izakaya combination will evolve in the future.
review_4_text: We came 3-4 times and ordered the same thing 🤣🤣 its so good and affordable too
review_5_text: I really liked the cafe, it is small and very clean. The interior is nice. The coffee was tasty and the brownie was good too. This is a good place to work because they provide fast wifi, A/C, sockets and most importantly the place is quiet.

name: Firefly Factory - Thai & Italian Fusion Restaurant & 3D Immersive Dining Experience
review_1_text:
I really wanted to give a five star review, but there are too many things nit quite matching the atmosphere.

Firstly, the 4 stars is all on atmosphere.  Our kids had a fantastic time interacting with the walls.  They drew pictures which were then scanned up into the projections.  Really fun and rewarding.

Look at the pictures and you will see that the dining experience would be also a great place for romance... at the other end of the room.  Or, the place would be a sensational venue for a special group event if you booked it out entirely.

Some unwarranted criticism in other reviews - you don't need to walk through rubbish or a warehouse.  The restaurant is easy to find.  Go up the stairs and look for the signs - or simply turn right (ser the video).

Warranted comments in other reviews.  The service - yes, the stagg are unfriendly.  They are abrupt and generally just take your order with a forced smile.  There are too many of them, so perhaps they like leaving the work to their colleagues.  I don't know... but it needs fixing to match the experience factor.

The food - the Brazilian styke BBQ was great.  It was tge only dish that truly matched the ambience.  The rest were ordinary - but the portions were good, so I think the pricing is about right.

A few minor things.  There are power cords across the floor.  I almost tripped on one.  They need to be properly secured.

The table positioning means.that some seats are in direct line with the projectors.  I sat with lights in my eyes and couldn't see the people sitting opposite.  Simply putting the edge tables on angles would fix this issue.  Otherwise, take a table in the middle of the room.

The food mostly came out together - so that previously mentioned issue seems to have been fixed.  Although, there was a small gap as only one waiter served us despite there being many staff on hand.

So come here for the experience and enjoy the food.  You will have a good night out.
review_2_text: If you want to go to those super fancy hologram rooms, but you don’t have enough money to pay for it, This is a place to go! The food is priced reasonably well for the room that you sent in. I recommend getting the salmon as it is very crispy and peppery . But I don’t recommend getting the floating barbecue because the pork is very chewy but other than that I’ve definitely recommend going to this place because of it’s holograms and style. I recommend going with you and one other person.
review_3_text: What an amazing experience! Had a group birthday dinner and it was a magical time. All those projectors set up were very impressive and created a 180 immersion. Drinks were fantastic! Best cocktails I’ve had in Chiang Mai. Definitely a cool place to come with friends for a celebration.
review_4_text: Overall, it was a good experience. However, the staff could benefit from some additional service training. For example, when we ordered a bottle of wine, the server poured it directly into the glasses without first asking our preference or offering to serve each guest individually. Additionally, with four dishes on a small table for two, it would have been helpful if the staff checked in to clear empty plates as we went along. Small improvements in attentiveness would make the dining experience even better.
review_5_text: This place is a gem you might not find unless you were looking for it. The food was good-- one of the best takes on khao soi pizza I've had so far. But the atmosphere of the seperate dining spaces is the real draw. It was fun and whimsical.

name: TORA BAKE トラ•ベイク : Homemade Bakes & Coffee Shop
review_1_text:
Cool and warm ambient, great coffee like Australia's test, great cake and cookie
Very enjoy this momnet.
review_2_text:
Forgot to write a review about this place .

Hidden at the end of a road. Coffee was great but I only took pics of the cakes which were equally good.

Owner was friendly and didn't realise it was a co-working space also until I saw the other area.

Parking : within compound
review_3_text:
This café is tucked away at the end of a quiet alley, making it a peaceful spot to relax. I’ve been here twice, and the cakes are delicious—light, fresh, and not too sweet. The atmosphere is cozy, with a charming message board full of cute sticky notes, along with books and self-serve drinking water.

It also serves as a co-working space, offering both indoor and outdoor seating. The restroom is clean, which is always a plus. A great place to unwind or get some work done!
review_4_text: The best cafe in Chiang Mai! Great oat milk latte and matcha. And Mod and the owner are so kind.
review_5_text:
Tucked away in the far back of a Soi, you can find Tora the tiger 🐅. He doesn't look too impressed with tourist photos but his owner makes some great Coconut Water Americano. The Orange Americano was really nice as well thanks to the fresh orange juice.

We also had a Banoffee cake which was very tasty. It has a biscuit base that tastes similar to Oreos, a thick layer of bananas and it's covered in cream. I generally do not like Banoffee cake but I have to admit this was great 👍

If you're in the area and up for an adventure down the Soi, pay Tora Bake a visit. You'll walk through some traditional Thai living quarters and be able to see the local way of life.

name: Cafe’ Amazon
review_1_text:
Cool cafe
Nice atmosphere
Laptop friendly

--> toilet 5 min walk by street to another building
review_2_text: There was a power outage for over an hour, but the staff were friendly. 😅
review_3_text: Sell drinks but for the toilet you have to go to the supermarket 100m down the road even though they have plenty space inside. Dirty windows. Bad set up, bad maintenance
review_4_text: Very best coffee place in Chiang Mai
review_5_text: Amazing, warm and friendly service. Even though I spilt water all over the counter top, oops. Thank you so much for your patience!

name: Elephant Organic ( Health Foods )
review_1_text:
Very nice place for those passionate about organic and local products
I got a bunch of thai coffee beans and cocoa beans. I am waiting forward to tasting it. The people who work there are also very nice. If I ll visit Chiang Mai again I ll come back for sure.
review_2_text: Been missing the access to herbs, oil, and tinctures and Elephant Organic filled that void internationally. Tucked away down a busy local business shop street. The shop is clean and well well organized. Enjoyed the jams and the friendliness Cee was amazing! If you are in need of natural Earthly necessities stop by.
review_3_text: Amazing shop with super foods, natural products, ceremonial cacao, honey, candles,, essential oils. I’m a regular here, absolutely love it! And the owner is the best!!!! This is kind of a small business I wish we had more in the world. Thank you!
review_4_text: Fabulous, local health food & healthy products store just near Old City... an easy walk from the North Gate.  Especially love that they stock Pure Thai Naturals products. Nice people & great service.
review_5_text:
An absolute beautiful establishment!

Since I am plant-based/vegan/organic lifestyle, I love to visit and support local organic health stores.

I found elephant organic health foods shop just  by searching organic on Google maps, and this rare gem store popped up as I’m so thankful and blessed to have found this wonderful place.

For those who are health conscious, looking for organic Superfoods/powders/protein powder/grains, essential oils, delicious smoothies, and other health products, this is the place to stop in and shop. They have a little bit of everything in case you’re traveling abroad and worried about not having certain items with you to satisfy your health needs.

They have their own brand/ products of organic superfood powders and more to satisfy all of your health needs.

I started out shopping for a vegan floss which I found and I love, then I saw a gentleman walked in and ordered a smoothie which I didn’t realize until I saw the menu later. So I decided to order the super green smoothie and it was delicious especially if you enjoy your greens, well balanced flavor with the fruits and their in-store brand super green organic powder.

I love how they utilize their own products in their smoothies, a great way to sample their powders so if you plan to make your own smoothies at home , you can buy the powder there and enjoy at home or wherever you’re staying so you can make your own smoothies.

You can also order their products and have them shipped if you plan to stay in Thailand for sometime

I had the pleasure of speaking with the owner  Sasa who is very friendly, cool, and fun to talk with especially aboutHealth/travel/life /and more. Sasa is very knowledgeable about Health foods/and more to help accommodate your daily needs to optimize nutrition and overall to maintain a healthy body.

I ended up staying in the shop for almost 2 hours, just hanging out having a great conversation with the owner and other team members, shopping around, testing out products, and also ordering a second smoothie which was the berry boost, another delicious smoothie on the menu as I look forward to trying more before I leave.

So I ended up buying a few smoothies, some super green powder, mosquito repellent, vegan floss, and Sasa’s Bonita essential oil made by the owner.

Overall, this is a beautiful establishment as I am blessed to have found Elephant Organic (Health Foods). Be sure to stop in and try a smoothie and test out some of their products and enjoy a great experience. 😃🙏🏼🌱💚🫐🥭🥥🥬🇹🇭

name: Wanwaree
review_1_text: This cafe sells some food and has a small garden. They don’t have light roast bean and you can choose either medium or dark roast. The drinks were just ok.
review_2_text:
Really lovely tranquil cafe that has good customer service and the best homemade banana cake I've had.

Usually quiet enough to get focused work done!

On the menu is pastries, good coffee, teas and smoothie. All day breakfast is toast with eggs etc.
review_3_text: Quiet comfortable small cafe serving coffee and tea with both AC and outdoor seating. Low key and rarely busy. It's mostly locals that hang out here for an hour or two. Perfect for those looking to escape from heat or rain during the day. Staff is friendly.
review_4_text: Great coffee but most important amazing toast, finally some enjoyable western bread toasted with topping. Great breakfast
review_5_text:
Coffee was good and they sell some sweats that look good. The lady running the place is very friendly. Unfortunately we waited something like 20 minutes for 2 toast, 1 scrambled egg and one fried egg. She is doing everything by herself and the place was not even half full.
The breakfast was basically toast and egg, not so good.

name: Villa Nard
review_1_text: Food and service 10/10. Australian style brunch done better than in Australia. The owner is so passionate and enthusiastic about her business it is so nice to see, you can feel the attention to detail. They use high quality ingredients. The best omelette and chicken noodle salad I have had. The coffee is on point also! They have a cool vintage store on level two also! I will be back. Thank you :)
review_2_text:
This is one of the best restaurants I’ve been to in Chiang Mai. Not only was the food delicious, but there were Western, Thai, and Korean food options.

The atmosphere is light and casual, and there’s even and there’s even a little thrift shop on the second floor.

Also, the owner is absolutely lovely! We chatted for a little while and she made sure we had everything we needed. Can’t wait to go back!
review_3_text:
Had a matcha tiramisu and a cafe latte. Cake is delicious with a soft texture. Coffee is full of flavour and no bitterness.
Glad to see European style cafe/coffee shop evolving in Thailand and doing well.
review_4_text:
Five stars for every subject. 🤩🤩🤩

If you are lucky, you will meet the very hospitable owner. 👩🏻

The food satisfies my tummy, and the coffee is good. The space is huge, and you can feel you have a private area to yourself. Kids are also welcome 👧🏻👶🏻🧒🏻.

Highly recommended.
review_5_text: Absolutely amazing space, delicious coffee which is accompanied by complimentary piece of chocolate. Beautiful ambiance and they sell home made vintage home decor which is out of this world! Love the place and will be definitely back tomorrow 😃🙌.

name: Waseda わせだ Chiangmai coffee and milk tea
review_1_text:
Cute little, minimal shop that I really respect is open until 2 AM

Came in, has a freshly brewed cappuccino, and chilled a bit while working in peace
review_2_text: I very very like this shop. There has many  bubble milk tea. The last time I ordered original one, it's very good and the price is so lovely. Now I came again and tried the matcha latte, less sweet that found out it's so fantastic and next time I will order this milk tea again. Delicious and lovely ❤️
review_3_text: I mostly work from home at night, so I wanted something to keep me awake but I don’t like coffee. This is matcha with water. (It’s really hard to find tea or coffee shops open late at night, but this place is one of the rare ones.)
review_4_text: This matcha is so good even I ordered 0% sweets. It means The matcha is good quality I love it 🍵 suits for matcha lovers ❤️
review_5_text: The best bubble tea I have ever had! Open late, amazing service, fresh and absolutely delicious. Made with love! 🙏 I won’t be going anywhere else in Chiang Mai 🥰

name: BULOV CAFE
review_1_text: The coffee was not only incredibly delicious but also served at the perfect temperature. The foam on top had an ideal consistency—creamy and smooth, enhancing the overall experience. Each sip was a delightful blend of rich flavors and impeccable texture, making it a standout choice for any coffee lover. Whether you’re in need of a morning pick-me-up or a leisurely afternoon treat, this coffee hits all the right notes. Highly recommended for anyone seeking a top-notch coffee experience!
review_2_text: One of the best cafes in town. It has an indoor and outdoor seating area, beautifully decorated and I appreciate the details put into the different drinks and snacks. The coffee is of very high quality, with an option for dairy free milk. Highly recommended 💕🌟🫶
review_3_text:
This cafe in Chiang Mai is a vibe.

I was worried that it would be all show. Bulov did not disappoint.

The Swan Art I was definitely impressed.  You can see things posted online, and when you get there, the Barista is not there. She delivered the goods. But what good is the art if the flavor is not there. It was delicious to the last sip. 😋

The owner was really nice and pleasant.

This is the kind of spot that a true coffee snob can appreciate.  I even got the vegan oatmeal cookies.  😋

As soon as you walk into the door. It's calm music  and the decor is very elegant but not over the top.

It's a great use of space.  The color  is simple, but it just works.

You have small tables, and even a couch wear you, and six of your closest friends can hang out.  There is also plenty of seating outside.

So, if you want to treat yourself and step out of the hot sun. Yes, this is one of the good ones.
review_4_text: I love their coconut coffee! Having tried it all over Chiang Mai, this place serves the best! The coffee is strong but not overpowering and complements nicely with the coconut juice and tender coconut pieces. It is beautifully presented—a drink made with care! I look forward to this delight every morning in a very relaxing space. Baristas are also very friendly!
review_5_text: One of the best espressos in Chiang Mai hands down. Dark roasted full body, strong yet smooth. Hint of caramel. Long lasting frothy crema. Top class. And the design of the decor deserves an award. All black everything. “Murdered out”. Style points. Feels premium and the logo is reminiscent of Bugatti. Looking forward to trying the teas, smoothies and fruit creations. Will be back for sure. 👍🏽

name: All in cafe
review_1_text: Wow, I am so impressed with the chicken souvlaki! The Mediterranean spices were perfectly balanced. 👌The Greek salad was delicious and the tzadziki was off the chain.  These guys know Greek food. It's a small, small shop but 110% worth finding.They also have a limited menu on Grab. Do yourself a favor, and give them a shot--you won't regret it!
review_2_text: Everything here is proper. They don’t *** around when it comes to food. Amazing experience meeting Darius. It was a privilege. True authentic food coming from a humble man with a great story and lots of surprises. Recipes are straight from his family tree and have been passed on for generations.
review_3_text: Some of the best Greek food I have had. Very unassuming place, good chat with the owner. Amazing tzatziki
review_4_text:
I just stopped by Get Er to the Greek at All-In Cafe, and I was absolutely blown away! Darius has put together a small, focused menu, but every single item is made with pure quality. I had the chicken and beef souvlaki wraps, and they were some of the best Greek food I’ve ever had—he’s using sirloin steak, organic chicken, and top-notch ingredients across the board.

On top of that, Darius is just a genuinely great guy—passionate about his craft and committed to making amazing food. You can taste the effort and love he puts into every dish.

If you’re a fan of authentic, high-quality Greek food, this is a spot you need to check out. Highly recommend!

Location: Get Er to the Greek @ All-In Cafe
review_5_text: This is exactly what I needed in my life. So fresh and clean and delicious and the owner was a top quality guy. Will be back asap!

name: Green Roasters Coffee
review_1_text: Great V60 drip coffee from a local coffee farm 120 baht. Espresso is cheaper of course. The host is very precise, cleans his espresso machine every time, so top quality. Nice atmosphere too.
review_2_text:
This is a great coffee shop in the neighborhood! There are 3 bean roast options available - all of them are local to the Chiang Mai region. The espresso taste is fantastic.

The coffee shop has a cozy feel. And the barista owner is very sweet. The chairs are great for lounging and there’s WiFi available.
review_3_text:
Coffee made with passion & professional attitude is what I felt from Green Roasters.

The time I went was months ago, I remember they offered choice of house blend from Kanchanaburi,  Chiangmai to seasonal blend from Columbia. Price were very affordable from $45B up.

I ordered Flat White, also it's out of the menu but lady owner made it for me, thank you for the coffee, which was nutty and full body.

The cafe itself is very simple and clean. Their coffee machine is same as i saw in Asama Cafe, which is rare in Chiangmai. The morning I went were all locals and the owner were having a class with secondary school students about coffee beans, I was very impressed that they put their efforts not only on business but to the community too.
review_4_text: Very cozy coffee shop in CNX one of hidden gems that you should visit.
review_5_text:
Small coffee roasters and cafes offer a really good coffee for a very reasonable price (especially for the quality). My light roast Americano was clean, tasty with complexity and was not too hot. The shop offers both local and foreign beans.

The owner was friendly and even offered to wash my thermal mug.

name: Seal Sweet Chiang Mai
review_1_text: This cafe is rlly cozy and really cute. It’s perfect for anyone who wants to have a chill day or relax with some cute atmosphere and enjoy Japanese aesthetic style of cafe. The drinks are also really delicious and good pricing as well.
review_2_text: The atmosphere is great, cool, quiet, and a nice place to sit. There are various toys to play with, and the seal plushie is adorable. The drinks are delicious and well-balanced. I highly recommend going!
review_3_text: The shop isn't big, but it's super cute! They even have video games to play. It feels like hanging out at a friend's place with your group.
review_4_text: The cafe is nice and the decor is very cute. However, the reviews said it was quiet and peaceful, but when I arrived, the cafe was full of noisy and annoying students. It was almost impossible to take pictures anywhere. They had taken other people's chairs and tables to put their belongings and bags on, leaving only the tables available. They were playing games, working, and talking loudly. I had to sit outside to find some peace and quiet. It was hot inside, though; the only cool place was inside the cafe.
review_5_text: The Orange Americano here is really delicious... The daytime temperature of 35 degrees Celsius has completely cooled down. If you like Orange Americano, please try it here🥹

name: ZONE Bingsu & Café
review_1_text: Great cosy place
review_2_text: Good place
review_3_text:
This is a bingsu shop near Kad Thanin that's been open for quite some time, but I'm sure many people don't know about it (I haven't seen any posts about it on social media).

The shop's decor features beautifully painted polar-themed murals on the walls. The air conditioning is icy cold, creating a truly chill atmosphere. The shop offers both bingsu and drinks, just like any other cafe. The bingsu comes in two sizes, and the flavors are decent.
review_4_text: ZONE Bingsu & Café is a very stylish cafe. The interior has a calming atmosphere, perfect for relaxing. Their bingsu (Korean shaved ice) is especially delicious, with a wide variety of flavors, including fruit and red beans. Each one is beautifully presented, almost too good to eat. The drink menu is also extensive, offering not only coffee and tea, but also seasonal special drinks. The friendly staff and excellent service are a plus. It's a great spot for chatting with friends, reading alone, or even a date, so be sure to give it a try. I'm sure it'll become your favorite.
review_5_text:
I'll definitely be back here! 💓 Normally, when I go to other bingsu places, I don't finish them because they're too sweet.
But I ordered two items at this place and finished them all. They were incredibly delicious, not too sweet, and a joy to eat.
The blueberry bingsu was incredibly delicious! The size M cost 185 baht, which is a great value for the portion.
In the hot weather, if you're looking for a cool dessert, I highly recommend this place.

name: Lanna Laundry & Lanna Coffee
review_1_text: Bring your laundry here! Not only they open 24/7, it is staffed so you don't need to anything after dropping it off!!! You can select water and dryer temperature to your liking. Pick up as quickly as 2 hours. The cost is also unbeatable. 65thb to wash 14kg and another 65thb for drying.
review_2_text: Best laundry ever! State of the art new and clean SpeedQueen laundry machines! Enjoy a drink with aircond while waiting for laundry!! There are friendly staff here to take care of your laundry while you are away and pick-up later!!
review_3_text: The best best best laundry ever.  Drop off fluff and fold in 3 hrs (depending how busy they are).  They even gave me my pocket change back!  Open 24/7, great staff, modern machines, awesome price.  Can they open branches everywhere I live because they’re really the best!  Thanks Lanna!
review_4_text: Very recently used these guys for my dirty clothes. Friendly service, clothes were clean and folded nicely. Offered me a 3hr turn around but they said I could turn up whenever (they are 24hr which is good). Easy drop off and pick up. Will use again before I leave.
review_5_text: Good place to do laundry, you can just drop and go, come back to pick your clothes after 3 hours and they are done washing drying and folding!

name: Overcup
review_1_text: This is actually a pretty nice well organized cafe. It is not too small and this place has AC. They also have some good tables as well as some power outlets. You can choose the roast level of your coffee as you like and their coffee was actually great and the value is great given the quality and space.
review_2_text: Clean workstation, good quality coffee, good espresso. Outlets and workably ergonomic seating.
review_3_text:
If you like silence i recommend for this Store
The coffee and Matcha is good
review_4_text:
Really good Nan light roast.
Made to order.
review_5_text:
Pure Matcha uses 100% pure green tea powder for a wonderful aroma.
The coffee is also delicious and has a pleasant sweetness. The price is reasonable.
The vintage atmosphere has stood the test of time.

name: GANDAMU กันดามู กันพลาเชียงใหม่
review_1_text: The shop has a very friendly atmosphere. I had a lot of fun talking to the staff and they gave great recommendations. I was extremely impressed!
review_2_text: The shop owner is polite, friendly, and very welcoming. I'll definitely be a frequent customer next time.
review_3_text: The shop is very friendly and talkative. I had a lot of fun talking with the staff and they gave me really good recommendations. I'm impressed.
review_4_text: The shop owner was very nice and friendly. The shop is great.😔👍

name: Montrio Reflow Cnx
review_1_text: Definitely the spot to go to just north of old town for a quality tasty brew. Super authentic and local vibe, rustic decor with lots of space to sit and enjoy your drink. The price for a coffee is pretty good. You can also tell that they have high quality coffee machines and have a wide range of coffee beans. They don’t just do coffee either! I try and grab a coffee every time I pass by! Great spot slightly hidden in plain sight.
review_2_text: Hidden gem! This cafe is set in a little corner on a busy street. Feels more like a garage than a cafe but the coffee is delicious and they really care about the taste! Super fair prices and friendly staff. Awesome. Also great coconut water!
review_3_text:
Nice, typical Thai café. Exceptionally clean. The ice cubes are made with boiled water. The owners are very friendly and kind. The place has an industrial charm, with lots of upcycled decor.
One star off: I ordered a caramel macchiato, but there was no caramel syrup in it – it still tasted really good though.
review_4_text: Was here 3 times in Chiang Mai within 1 week. They serve the best coffee in Chiang Mai. The vibes and atmosphere is just amazing! Super recommend!
review_5_text: Really really good coffee.  The shop is run by a group of young, friendly and cute barista. Different roast level to choose from and the latte is always served at the perfect temperature with the right consistency.  Cool vibe, bright and airy and excellent price.  Excellent place and great people !

name: ชาตรามือ สาขาม.ราชภัฏเชียงใหม่
review_1_text:
This branch also has 'Thai Tea Slushy'!
Or, as it's also called, the Thai Tea Slushy with the "Hand Brand" logo 😋 (You have to spread the word!)

The atmosphere under the classroom building is great; I often stop by to study here.
Because the aroma of Thai tea in the shop helps me relax from studying and also makes me feel more alert.
review_2_text: Cha Tra Mue is a Thai beverage franchise, a Thai tea brand that has been a part of Thailand's culture for over 50 years. They offer drinks such as lemon tea and Thai milk tea, as well as snacks. This branch is located on the 1st floor of the 90th Anniversary Building at Chiang Mai Rajabhat University, Wiang Bua Campus.
review_3_text: I ordered green tea with brown sugar boba. The staff brought me green tea with brown sugar boba. Okay, I understand that communication can be misunderstood. I had already received the order and nothing happened. But the staff turned to another staff and said that the customer was talking nonsense. Is this okay? How did you know? My friend who was standing there heard it all. She glanced at the customer with the corner of her eye. If you don't love service work, go do something else. Or stay in the back and don't come out to greet customers. Just because you're a university student, can you treat me however you want? I came to pay as a customer. Because I asked many friends and they have encountered similar situations many times where the staff have used harsh words. Please improve our service.
review_4_text: The staff have very poor manners; they should receive training in customer service etiquette.
review_5_text: The service was good.

name: Bake for u
review_1_text: This morning, we stopped by Bake for U and enjoyed a cappuccino latte and Thai tea. Both drinks were freshly made and absolutely delicious. The café has a warm and inviting atmosphere, perfect for sitting down to enjoy your meal. They bake their own cakes, breads, and pastries, adding a fresh aroma to the air. The staff was very friendly, providing quick and efficient service. The upkeep of the place is excellent, with the owner even taking care of the plants outside. There's also a cozy outdoor seating area if you prefer to enjoy your food and drinks in the fresh air.
review_2_text: Nice place.  Friendly service.  An iced coffee latte was only 35 Baht.  There are snacks and a bakery but I wasn't hungry.
review_3_text: Very nice little breakfast spot, recommended!!
review_4_text:
The nicest family bakery.

Good coffee, good pastries, good bread, good breakfast/brunch deals and better people.

I usually don't have breakfast but it was impossible not to try the croissants and the cookies. Cakes are veery tasty too.
review_5_text: Very nice place and really great and cheap breakfast. Authentic Thai people with big hearts and quality products :)

name: Daughter's Happy Place café
review_1_text: Lovely food and super friendly staff ! If you want to have a relaxing time in a cozy, air conditioned cafe, this is the place ! Free WiFi as well, I couldn't ask for better !
review_2_text: The food is delicious! I had the Cocoa drink and could not believe how nice it tasted, a definite gem ! Air conditioning and WiFi, awesome place with very friendly owners.

name: Keane Coffee and Guest House.
review_1_text: Really nice coffe shop. We had a night flight and had to wait few hours to check in to our hotel so visited this place. The people working didn't mind us waiting and relaxing. We ordered few drinks and truly enjoyed them. The lemon cheesecake tea was unbelievably good.
review_2_text:
If you’re looking for a cozy-ish spot to sip coffee while escaping the crowds, Keane Coffee & Guest House is a hidden gem near Jing Jai Market. With its vintage and hipster decor, stepping inside feels like entering a warm, inviting home. The ambiance is relaxing with nice music in the background, although the lighting leans a bit too warm for our taste.

The seating is well thought out, with options for both work and chilling. We enjoyed their light and medium roast iced lattes, both of which were made well. They also have a good selection of non-caffeinated drinks, making it a great choice for everyone. They also have non-dairy milk options with additional 20 Bahts. The drinks are priced between 60-85 Bahts which is not bad for the air conditioned cafe.

On a second visit, we tried the Thai iced tea, but it was a bit too creamy for our liking, despite its popularity. The butter cake was tasty but on the small side for the price.

Overall, it’s a lovely cafe with friendly owners and a chill vibe, perfect for getting some work done or just unwinding with good music.

Definitely worth checking out!
review_3_text:
I’m so proud of myself for finding such a cozy and minimalist space in Chiang Mai. I even feel a little envious to share this vibe with others! But I truly hope that someone who’s been longing for a place like this will discover it and find peace of mind here.
The place is super clean and smells amazing. The guest house is safe, quiet, and reasonably priced.
The café is perfect for chilling, reading, or even a photo shoot.
review_4_text: This room has a minimalist and cozy design. The dark green walls create a calm and relaxing ambiance, while the warm beige curtains complement the darker tones. The low bed with dark bedding adds to the simplicity, and the wooden floor provides a natural and warm feel. The bedside table with a lamp and water bottles adds functionality and a welcoming touch. The ceiling-mounted air conditioner ensures comfort, but the room might feel a bit small due to the compact arrangement. Overall, it’s a practical and serene space.🫶🏻🧸
review_5_text: Feel like home , cozy ,classy, friendly 🧋🥤☕️

name: พันธุ์ไทย coffee

review_2_text:
Lovely and clean little cafe. Coffee and Thai tea is incredible!

Highly recommend!
review_3_text: My first time to know about and try the passion fruit presso and it was great as my drink of choice is always iced Americano. The coffee beans are roasted also giving the Americano a fresh smooth roasted flavor.
review_4_text: Love to come here for an excellent cappuccino and homemade waffle. Quiet atmosphere and very friendly owners. What a great way to start the day.
review_5_text: A wonderful café. Perfect coffee, excellent service, and low prices.

name: White House cafe
review_1_text: Really cute little place. Anytime I feel like Pad Ka Praow I come here. Very flavourful and well seasoned. Only 40 baht or 50 baht with an egg. The owners are super nice and friendly too
review_2_text: Nice peaceful atmosphere. Foods and drinks are basic but very good with lovely service from owner. Price is very reasonable compared to busy fancy cafe on Nimmahemin areas.
review_3_text: We always had the place to ourselves. Humble place. Nice and quiet. Very convenient for us as we are checked-in ay the Lotus Hotel. Our go to place to quench thirst!
review_4_text: lovely little place with an awesome atmosphere! we had Thai Tea, Rice with Omelette and Spicy Stir-Fried Minced Pork with Holy Basil.The flavor is very intense and delicious! Also, the owner is very friendly!
review_5_text:
Hidden gem in one of the strangely abandoned attachment of the hotel.
You wouldn’t expect to find a nice lady serving nice Thai lunches and fruit smoothies. Great value.
-nice tree shade and breeze too

name: ออน เดอะ เวย์ คาเฟ่ เชียงใหม่ สาขาสนามกีฬา
review_1_text: The iced tea is delicious, with a unique aroma. This branch has a huge selection of desserts. I couldn't decide which one to choose. The salespeople are very friendly. If you're looking for a reasonably priced drink, I highly recommend this place. ☕

name: Glass Cafe

You should also try their bakery, the coconut cake we had was not too sweet and deliciously creamy. The staff were very informative and super nice.
review_2_text: The place is really ‘glass’y, bright and modern vibe. Drinks selections are variety enough. Coffee itself tastes decent. Dirty is pretty good. Price is considered on a high side. Cafe itself is a bit hideous, need to carefully look out for the logo. Bakery looks good, gonna try next time.
review_3_text: The newest cafe in Nimman. Nice coffee and services. Come and visit, you will never disappoint. 🥰
review_4_text:
Lovely Cafe💛
A must to visit! High quality coffee +  fresh baked bakery
Friendly staffs 😊🎁
review_5_text:
Nice and Cozy place with very friendly staffs.
Since I am a BIG fan of Yuzu I ordered “Some Yuzu” Dang, one sip and you know it, Its a high quality Yuzu right here, must try!

name: Mizu cafe in car cmru.
review_1_text: Delicious coffee, low prices, and great service. I highly recommend when you’re nearby and want to grab a coffee to go.
review_2_text: Tasty Latte for 35 THB :)
review_3_text: Low price and good taste. If you are nearby, I recommend to you.
review_4_text: I ordered for the first time and the green tea and Thai tea were incredibly delicious! I'll definitely order again.
review_5_text: Orange Coffee is delicious 😋 and also looks beautiful 😍 The lovely female owner is very friendly and helpful. If you happen to be nearby, I recommend trying a refreshing drink at Mizu.

Cheap condensed milk green tea

Aimee Coffee& bakery
review_1_text: Thai milk tea was good and reasonably priced, and the woman working there was really nice

review_1_text: This café gets quite busy on weekends, but it’s spacious with plenty of seating both indoors and outdoors. The coffee is genuinely good, and the staff are fast and friendly. Located right inside Jing Jai Market, it’s super convenient to enjoy a cup of coffee and then wander around shopping.
review_2_text: A coffee shop serving only drip coffee, with a calm Japanese-style atmosphere and beautifully crafted sustainable natural furniture.
review_3_text: Very friendly staff and delicious drinks - highly recommend the Black Honey Coffee & Thai Tea.
review_4_text: The gallery drip is a pillar in the Thailand coffee scene. From Hua Hin to BkK to CM, it’s a great place to this location is beautiful and the staff are amazing. Great coffee.

name: Sukhum cafe

review_2_text:
Our morning coffee fix at the market and it was great!

First time trying a dirty coffee and thought it was really good, so much so that I almost went for a second cup of their signature drink but had to stop myself..

Definitely come by and support these local coffee cart vendors! 👍🏻
review_3_text: The Thai tea with coffee was good! Thinking about make me want some right now 😩😩😩
review_4_text:
Thai tea 👍
Matcha orange👍
review_5_text: Very high standard coffee. Do not miss it.

name: Roastniyom JJ-ECO ร้านกาแฟรสนิยมสาขา ECO (ตลาดจริงใจมาร์เก็ต)
review_1_text:
A Hidden Gem in the Rhythm of a Hectic Life**

If you're looking for a perfect break spot in the Chang Phueak area, come to **Roastniyom JJ-ECO, True Market branch (Address: RX4W+7H8)**. This shop is like a small oasis hidden in a bustling market.

*   **Atmosphere:** Relaxed and friendly, perfect for a short rest while shopping or waiting for friends. There is both indoor and outdoor seating.
*   **Service:** The staff are friendly and very fast. They are cheerful and make drinks quickly, even during busy times.
*   **Taste:** The coffee has a rich and well-balanced taste as expected from Roastniyom. The latte has a fragrant milk foam and beautiful art on the cup. It's a great drink for re-energizing.
*   **Conclusion:** A great "value-for-money" shop. Convenient and fast. The RX4W+7H8 pin makes it very easy to find! Highly recommended if you are near the Chang Phueak area.
review_2_text:
Very nice coffee in this chain. All other branches I got good service. They got my order wrong. Then they told me there's no large lattes🙄.
I asked for extra hot. They gave me like warm. I asked them to make it hotter. They microwaved it 😳😅.
Honestly Roastniyom you normally do better.  This branch has a service problem☠️☠️☠️
review_3_text: The coconut latte was so delicious. Recommended, especially if you do not drink milk. Cold with coconut pieces. The atmosphere is beautiful. Good for work, read or anything talk with a friend. Quite during weekdays.
review_4_text:
I visited this café and was truly impressed by both the atmosphere and the quality of the coffee.

However, during my visit on February 10, 2026, the staff member on duty appeared quite tired and slightly tense, which affected the overall experience for customers to some extent. It even made me hesitate to order an additional drink, despite the menu being very appealing. My friends who were with me noticed the same thing.

Having additional staff during busy periods might help the service run more smoothly, as the café is clearly very popular. Every time I visit Chiang Mai, I bring friends here and always recommend this place to other international friends as well.

On a previous visit, I was served by a male staff member who handled a very busy and noisy situation with great professionalism. He was polite, attentive, and considerate. My friends were very impressed, and one of them translated for me when he apologized to customers for the noise that day (the café was extremely crowded). I could tell he was tired and working alone, and although he seemed a bit stressed, he still did his best to smile and provide excellent service to everyone.

Overall, this is a lovely café, and I sincerely hope to have an even better experience on my next visit.
review_5_text:
Nice cafe in heart of the market.

Air conditioning was very comfortable.The place to set inside is limited.But you can sit outside, If the weather is good.

I\nTried the black orange coffee?Which is just expresso in orange juice and it was just Devine.That's what you need on a hot summer day.

review_1_text: got an ice mocha… this is the 2nd time i have been here.  excellent hand pressed coffee. the guy works very and there’s now a long long line. if you are patience, you will have a nice coffee.  practice mindfulness when in line.
review_2_text:
Always a treat watching the coffee being prepared. Tried the orange coffee (60baht) — not something I’d usually pick, but it turned out to be a refreshing way to cool down after exploring Jing Jai Market.

Matcha latte was sold out during my visit but the hojicha latte (80baht) is tasty too
review_3_text:
Great coffee at this pop up store. Based on Google Maps, they do have a coffee shop which is slightly out of town.

Tried the americano coconut, and it was perfect!

Coffee beans are freshly grinded at the store.

Coffee prices are also reasonable. Staff is patient and friendly. Will definitely return to get a second cup when I visit again.
review_4_text: Unfortunately, our experience at Tinn Coffee did not meet our expectations. The owner clearly puts a lot of time and effort into making each order, but unfortunately the espresso in my cappucino was not very hot and my wife’s Thai Tea was too watery. The wait was very long as well. I wish I didn’t have to say this but you may want to look elsewhere in the market for a coffee
review_5_text:
Amazing little coffee corner.
We had the strong (dark) espresso and the espresso coconut (iced)
The coffee was super tasty and mild.

Highly recommended.

If you looking for a place in early morning to chill out on weekend or day-off, this place is one of a kind. The taste of smoothies is ok and I love the tiny space that they try so hard to make it shady and green with plants
so cute♥️
review_3_text: A small coffee shop in a tree market where the seller is attentive to details, recommending menus to customers, asking about their preferences, and being attentive. You can order as you please. I love this shop. There are many menus to choose from.
review_4_text: This coffee shop and bakery in Kad Kham Thiang offers a comfortable seating area with beautiful potted plants, croissants, and a selection of pastries. It's a great place to relax and enjoy the plants afterwards.
review_5_text: Hong Kong egg waffles are delicious! It's close to Jing Zhai Market and a great place to visit the flower market!

review_4_text: The smoothie is delicious!

name: ร้านทศวรรษชานม
Thancoff Coffee Truck
review_1_text:
This is a one man operation serving coffee and tea beverages in Jing Jai market.

The ordering system was a little difficult to fathom at the start as it was not stated - you write out your name and orders on a slip of paper and then stick it in the spike in front. The owner/server will work his way through the order slips and call your name when it is your turn.

It can be quite a long wait on a busy day as it is just one man, but the drinks were still nice.  We had three cappacinos, a caramel latte and two Americanos without sugar.  Prices start from 50 THB.
review_2_text: The owner was already closing up the store but still made me a really good iced latte! Thank you!
review_3_text: Need something to drink at Jingjai market, and attracted by this good looking truck. Ordered an orange coffee, not the best but still good.
review_4_text: Cute coffee truck in the market, but 75% of the cup is just ice. Got a matcha orange and the taste is just ok. Not worth the wait.
review_5_text: Nice coffee in nice ambience, good queue system.

name: Jowa Cafe & Hotel
review_1_text: I booked based on the glowing reviews we read, but our room 201 - had a tub which was what my wife enjoys most but it’s small! The bed mattress is on the floor so not easy and comes with several tripping hazards too. The bum gun leaks so our towels were soaked but there is no way to get dry ones when the desk staff is away. No toilet paper so bring your own. Maybe this room is best for short people because everything is very low. The area is not easy to walk so you need to use grab for everything. If you have allergies the a/c filter may be dirty like ours was
review_2_text: Great for a business trip, not much parking space but great room👏👏they don’t have breakfast but they do have cafe downstairs, which they give you one free drink if u stay there😁😁😁try out orange juice coffee
review_3_text:
Pleasant cafe, good range of espresso drinks (from a gorgeous red La Marzocco), some cakes & sandwiches, *friendly service*, fast wifi, clean restrooms.
No car parking in front, but there's a lot 50 meters away.
review_4_text: Good coffee in a beautifully outfitted environment.  Plenty of power points around, comfortable seats and decent coffee for 55 baht for a hot latte. #BeatTheGrind
review_5_text:
Great property. Quiet and quaint neighbourhood.
Great coffee and awesome front desk.

name: Moddangfire
review_1_text: Great coffee only 25 thb
review_2_text: Good coffee roaster here.
review_3_text: coffee experian
review_4_text: We came for pizza but stumbled upon a coffee shop with a lovely female barista. She was fun to talk to and gave great coffee recommendations. She's got what she likes and can suggest whatever flavor profile you prefer. Definitely stop by! Come for coffee and pizza at this "guerrilla" shop. The owners of both shops are siblings. Highly recommend trying them. Everyone has their own tastes, and what's delicious to us might not be the same for everyone.🤟🏼😎
review_5_text: I'd forgotten it was Buddha's Birthday. Following the map this morning, I arrived only to find the doors closed, seemingly about to miss my trip. Luckily, a few persistent Korean tourists knocked and managed to get in, finally allowing me to have coffee and pizza. Coffee and pizza for breakfast is a rare combination for me, but it didn't seem out of place here. I had no idea these items came from two different shops. Perhaps the owners were used to this order, so everyone worked efficiently and we were quickly eating. They had several coffee bean options, and the coffee paired perfectly with the thin, crispy pizza – highly recommended. The two owners were incredibly welcoming; if they hadn't worked overtime, I would have missed out on breakfast. Thank you so much!
