My partner and I are very motivated by our visits here and are discussing how we can incorporate some of her ideas and plants into our own garden.
review_2_text: A refreshing break after or during shopping. Located in the heart of the Kamtien garden center, the coffee shop offers a variety of coffees and other refreshments at reasonable prices. Clean, pleasant atmosphere with friendly, fast service.

name: Zest Espresso Bar
review_1_text: Small tiny espresso bar, owner is very knowledgeable about coffee and very friendly.  Espressos and coffees are offered at different levels of roast.  Very delicious
review_2_text: Cozy coffee bar, great coffee, nice barista perfect for morning and afternoon break
review_3_text:
What a pleasant surprise. The rain came so we saw the signboard and dropped in for a quick coffee after finishing our khao soi across the road. This is definitely one of the better cups I've had in Thailand so far 👍

Am a big coffee nerd back home in Sydney so it was nice to find abit of well-rounded acidity (long black/americano) in place of the usual bombardment of smokey/darker roast tastes that you often get across Thailand, even from supposed 'specialty' coffee joints. Was great seeing the barista enjoy his craft (weighing in, distributing etc).

Small shop with a couple seats and tables inside and a few counter stools outside the window. Very chill.

Don't hesitate to drop in for your caffeine fix if you're in the neighbourhood.
review_4_text: Very simple shop, but everything I ordered over the course of two visits was good. I especially liked the Sun Zest. The owner seemed like a nice guy.
review_5_text:
We went for a coffee here this morning as our hotel was down the road.
The owner was friendly and welcoming, we got a hazelnut latte and an americano with a little milk(my request) which he made perfectly.
The coffee was lovely, the perfect strength and temperature to drink and it was nice to watch the world go by with the seats he had outside!

There is parking outside for a car or a few bikes.

review_5_text:

review_4_text: The shopkeepers are friendly, lovely, and very kind.
review_5_text: The coffee is delicious. There's seating available. It's clean and tidy. There's also a restroom. Highly recommended!

name: คนรักไม้ Lanna Cafe
review_1_text: We had a great experience here! We stayed at a hotel nearby where there were plenty of options for drinks but we loved this place the most. The women who helped us were so kind and sweet. I ordered an iced coffee and my partner ordered a strawberry smoothie. They offered us each a steamed bun while we waited for our drinks. The also offered us a discount which was very generous given the prices were all very economical. Either way we tipped the woman and she was so very grateful. Please please please try this place out, they even wrapped our drinks in napkins!
review_2_text: Good coffee, reasonable price.
review_3_text: I was staying nearby, and as I was walking past the cafe, the owner struck up a conversation with me. I was having trouble at the time, so I asked her for help, and she helped me out. I'm so grateful 🙏 I also had Thai tea at the cafe. She adjusted the sweetness just right, and it was delicious. Then she asked if I wanted to eat some food, and showed me all kinds of pictures. The portions were generous and delicious. I could eat it every day. The owner is always smiling, and it's a place that makes me feel glad I came to Chiang Mai. Everything the owner's cooking is delicious!

What really impressed me was the menu. It’s huge, with a mix of Thai and European dishes, so you can come here for anything from a light snack to a full meal. The staff were friendly, the vibe relaxed, and the overall experience made it an easy place to spend a few hours.
Highly recommended if you’re looking for good coffee, great food options, and a peaceful spot to work in Chiang Mai

A newly opened café in the CBP zone, the shop is conveniently located right next to Dr. Chen's clinic. The shop is roomy, lovely, and warm, decorated in a minimalist style with white and light yellow wood tones, reminiscent of a beautiful café from China. I ordered a chestnut caramel milk tea, which was delightful and had a strong tea aroma, unlike typical milk teas where the milk often overwhelms the tea flavour. It was perfectly sweetened, not overly sweet, and included crunchy chestnuts for added texture. Overall, it was extremely delicious.

The café offered a very creative drink menu, along with a dish of dry noodles with minced pork (the waiter referred to it as 'Wan Zha Mian'). This dish was also excellent, with a generous portion. The noodles were perfectly chewy and soft, and the taste was authentically Chinese, as if it were tailored specifically to Chinese tastes. The café also offered complimentary tiramisu and Chinese seaweed salad, as these dishes were being test-marketed before being officially added to the menu. Every dish I tried seemed intentionally crafted to please customers.

The chef was handsome and friendly, enhancing the overall pleasant experience. My first visit was very impressive. I will absolutely return!
review_3_text: Delicious and not too salty~ The drinks were great too, I'll definitely come again next time.
review_4_text: Wonton dumplings, chestnut milk tea, traditional Chinese flavor NICE
review_5_text: It was delicious! Authentic Chinese flavor.

name: Charlie ชาร์ลี Thai Tea สาขา BigC Extra
review_1_text:
I'd seen this shop for a while, but just decided to give it a try. My first impression was the wide selection of teas and their different brewing methods. I hadn't thought about the variety and brewing methods of tea (I thought they only had coffee). But learning about the different types of tea, their aromas, and the brewing techniques was a real eye-opener. I chose Surat Thani tea, steeped for 5 minutes, with 25% sweetness. The staff said it was fragrant and intense, so I ordered it. The aroma, rich flavor, and deliciousness made my day!
It might take a little while, though, because the tea needs to be brewed and there may be a lot of online customers. But I encourage you to support me.
review_2_text:
My first experience with Charlie's Iced Tea.
The promotional price is great, both in-store and for delivery. I ordered the Iced Tea (Gold).
It's fragrant, rich, and most importantly, delicious.
The sweetness level is 75%, just right.
Highly recommended.
Ice tea lovers, don't miss this! 🧡🧡🧡
review_3_text: Charlie's menu is very fragrant. You can choose Southern/Northern tea. It's topped with salted caramel foam. It's so smooth.
review_4_text: The prices aren't too high, there's a wide selection of teas, and the staff are helpful and provide good information.

Located on the Chiang Mai University campus, this café has a chill and laid-back atmosphere, making it perfect for students and visitors alike. They offer a wide range of beverages, from specialty coffees to refreshing iced drinks, along with a variety of light bites and pastries. The café is known for its friendly service and convenient location, making it an ideal spot for a quick break between classes or a peaceful place to unwind. It’s a must-try if you’re on the CMU campus!

Have always enjoyed stopping here for good coffee as I wait for our daughter who is attending university here. The coffee is good, the staff are polite and they normally serve fresh cake and pastries, but unfortunately today, they fail miserably
Their muffins are dry and days old, even after being heated up in the microwave. I loathe sending back food in Thailand and yet hate wasting food money on unedible food.
I asked the staff for cream, that it might help the taste or lack of and ask they soulful suggest,was I buy another dessert
It's all very frustrating when you find a place you rave about and recommend and then come back and suffer for it
Maybe it's a change of ownership or new staff or too early in the day
I dislike giving bad staff reviews. It's not like they are earning in these jobs, and chances are  they themselves are students, earning weekly pocket money
Maybe it's the I am older and cantankerous, so take my review with a pinch of salt, I think I just needed to vent
No one died
I'll live to drink coffee and eat fresh pastries again, just maybe not here

name: Arboretum Bliss coffee shop
review_1_text: Don't usually leave reviews, however this place deserves one. Great and underrated place for coffee. Spent three consecutive mornings here. Peaceful atmosphere, unassuming place, fantastic affordable latte. Highly recommended. While many may head to the cafes near the reservoir for the views (but more crowded and pricier), I came back to this place during my visits, which still brings me right next to nature within the arboretum
review_2_text: This is the most peaceful little coffee stand that sits inside the Huai Kaeo arboretum. The coffee is great.
review_3_text: This cafe is considered to have the most natural atmosphere in Chiang Mai city. There are many seating areas under large trees in the arboretum, allowing you to enjoy your coffee while listening to beautiful background music.
review_4_text: A small coffee shop with a peaceful atmosphere in a garden.
review_5_text: A lush green coffee shop

name: Doi Luang Coffee
review_1_text: A pleasant little stop. I really liked my Espresso Frappe. You might really like yours too. Worth a stop.
review_2_text: A lovely cafe, I will definitely come to buy a cup every time I pass by, it tastes good.
review_3_text: Good milk-based drinks. I like green tea with milk here. They use fresh milk and ice that is made in house. Sometimes they give free milk to customers.
review_4_text: Great spot right by the zoo to stop by and get a drink
review_5_text: Nice place for a quick coffee

name: WAR15COFFEE
review_1_text: Easily the best capuccino in Thailand so far. Opposit lovely tree park. Arbotoreum
review_2_text: "This drink is so refreshing!"
review_3_text: The coffee shop next to the police station served large cups of coffee, but they were very bitter. I drank a cup of coffee there to escape the rain.
review_4_text: Cheap price but limited seating in front of the shop, only a few tables. You can park at the police station.
review_5_text: Delicious food at a great price. The barista is lovely, and the owner is also lovely.

name: Mac Cafe Chiangmai
review_1_text: This shop is so friendly and cute, the staff are very nice and recommend the products very well. I had no knowledge about what I wanted and they gave me very great advice! They take care of their costumers very well and the price is great:)
review_2_text: Great service. The staff gave very good advice.
review_3_text: I went in for a 2nd hand MacBook but walked out empty-handed because of the high prices. The woman who helped us was very kind and knowledgeable though, and it’s a cute cafe.
review_4_text: Mac Cafe in Chiang Mai offers a peaceful retreat despite its busy roadside location. The atmosphere is pleasant, complemented by friendly and accommodating staff. The coffee is particularly noteworthy, making it a worthwhile stop for both a great brew and a tech check-out.
review_5_text: Awesome little spot with great people and a supremely cute Pomeranian. We were told my laptop could be fixed for super cheap and were so impressed with the honesty and absence of profit motive of the staff we ended up buying an M1 for a fantastic price instead. Tom, the owner, is Aussie but speaks Thai and has a local Thai employee as well. Thrilled to have an upgraded laptop now! They make custom tea and espresso drinks at the cafe also :) Come here for fixes n great deals on sweet tech! 💯

name: Red Panda Cafè (CNX) | ร้านกาแฟแพนด้าแดง (หน้ามช.)
review_1_text: I went to Red Panda today for lunch! It is such a fun environment and the service is wonderful! The Khao soi burger really impressed me! I couldn't believe how much it actually tasted like the famous Northern Thai noodle dish! It also didn't sit too heavy on the stomach, like some burgers do. The place has a lot of seating and is also a great place for studying or meetings. I highly recommend you go and try it out!
review_2_text: If you’re looking for the best hamburgers in Thailand, Red Panda is unbeatable. The patties are juicy, packed with flavor, and cooked exactly right. Fresh toppings, great buns, and amazing service. Easily one of my favorite spots.
review_3_text:
Really nice and chilled cafe, they have a  spacious area. 2 couch areas, a big wooden table for more people to sit and 3x 2-person tables and 2 high chair sitting areas. Above they have a co-working area which you can book and a game room with Nintendo switch, ping pong table, board games etc.
Really nice place to hang around. Really chill and nice ambience. Staff is very friendly, prices are totally ok and acceptable.
Nice atmosphere. They have a metal slide which you can slide down (on your own risk, it's quite fast).
Their food and drink (Thai Tea) tastes really good, can also recommend the Matcha Brownie. They also have a small section of merchandise, red Panda branded.
Would love to come back here, big recommendation...
review_4_text: very friendly environment, high speed internet and good coffee offcourse 😊
review_5_text:
Great Vibes & Even Better Coffee!
This place totally surprised me! I just dropped by for a quick caffeine fix, but ended up staying much longer than planned. The vibe is super chill—perfect for catching up with friends (because it has a game room) or just getting some work done.

I tried their iced caramel macchiato and iced es-yen and it was amazing—not too sweet, and you could still taste the espresso. I also grabbed a brownie, and wow… soft, moist, and full of flavor.

The staff was really friendly, too. They even recommended a few drinks to try next time, which I really appreciated. The space is clean, well-lit, and has that cozy, Instagram-worthy interior (MUST try their slide).

Definitely one of my new go-to spots in Chang Mai, Thailand. Highly recommended!

name: Hello māo café
review_1_text: Friendly, helpful staff and the cats behave well and are lovely. However, the cats were not well groomed (the fur had not been brushed) and many of them were sick with runny noses. However, I cannot know whether the cats receive medicine and are groomed later so I will still give a fair review of 3 stars. I just hope the staff finds the time to take a bit more care of the cats or, maybe give the customers brushes so they can do the grooming instead?
review_2_text:
Guys, please help the cats get better - some of them are really sick. Some have runny noses and itchy eyes.

People here have written that the cats are skinny, but I think they look that way because many of them are still teenagers and therefore appear very thin. They have free access to food.

The cat room smells terrible. When you keep multiple animals in the same room, you need to keep it clean. My feet were sticking to the floor, and I'm guessing it's because of the urine that can remain on the cats' paws. You need to wash the floors several times a day and change the litter in their litter box more often. The smell is truly terrible. For comparison, you can go to a similar place in Niman. It's spotlessly clean and there's no smell.

And of course, it's worth mentioning that some of the cats are very dirty. Because they have long hair, some of them have fecal matter under their tails. I feel so sorry for the animals that the staff and owner don't care about them.

In our parish, one of the employees was studying English with a tutor while working. It would be better if you brushed one of the cats or washed them:/
review_3_text: Cozy cafe with delicious drink options. The orange americano and caramel macchiato tastes good. The kittens are very interactive. Got house rules before playing with cats (such as wearing socks). If you are not wearing socks, can buy a pair for 10 baht.
review_4_text:
I found this café accidentally while walking around and I feel so lucky that I did. It's an amazing place with plenty of wonderful, cute and beautiful, unique cats! Maine coons, Persian, Munchkins and others, kittens, adults. All the cats were very playful, friendly and healthy.
The staff members are extremely polite, kind and helpful. They are hardworking and keep the place and litter boxes very clean.
All visitors should wear a pair of socks when entering the cat interaction room, and also mandatory to disinfect your hands.
It's possible to visit the cats only and you can also have drinks (coffee, tea, soft drinks)

I had an amazing time there and recommend it to everyone who loves cats.
review_5_text: I had a great time at the cat café! The cats are super cute, playful, and full of energy. They all look very happy and well cared for. It was a lovely experience, I’d love to visit again!

name: RotSomJai (Kin Sa Bo)
review_1_text:
Rossomjai Coffee has strategically relocated from a local community setting to a more prominent position near the main road leading to Doi Suthep, a move that is expected to enhance its visibility and accessibility. While the flavor profile of the coffee did not align with my personal preferences, it is important to acknowledge that taste is subjective, and other patrons may find it quite appealing.

Upon attempting to connect to the internet, I noted that the restaurant's Wi-Fi network was detectable. However, there was no visible display of the Wi-Fi password within the establishment. As a guest, I felt a degree of discomfort in approaching the staff to request the password, particularly as they appeared to be fully engaged with their duties at the bar. I suggest that prominently displaying Wi-Fi credentials, perhaps on tables, could significantly improve customer convenience and encourage a more seamless online experience.

Furthermore, I recommend a review of the current table arrangements. My seating position, directly facing the bar, exposed me to a somewhat cluttered area, which could detract from the overall ambiance. Optimizing the layout could enhance the dining experience for guests.

In terms of pricing, the cost of items was acceptable, though it was comparatively higher than some local competitors who offer what I perceive as a more comprehensive experience.
review_2_text: A tiny cafe with good drinks. The thing here is they will adjust your drink how you want it and it is super flexible as you can see in the picture. The space is tiny, so it is better for many to just to get a take away.
review_3_text: Their entrance shows pour over coffee.. but they don’t have pour over coffee…
review_4_text: Thai milk tea can be adjusted with the sugar levels and how strong tea flavour you want.
review_5_text:
Delicious! I don’t like overly sweet drinks so I love how customizable these drinks are. You can get 0, 10, 25, 50% sweet as well as adjust for how strong of tea flavor you want.

Got the genmaicha and dark cocoa, both good!

name: T-TEN Cafe & Restaurant
review_1_text: Nice latte and espresso. The Thai-style espresso is quite sweet 🤣 so keep that in mind if you prefer less sugar. Friendly service.
review_2_text: I stopped by T-Ten Cafe recently and honestly, it’s such a cozy spot. The atmosphere is super relaxed, with a simple but warm design that makes you feel comfortable right away. It’s the kind of place where you can sit for hours, either reading a book or chatting with friends.
review_3_text: We love T-TEN! The food is very tasty and the service is great. We go at least once a week. They have oat milk too which is good cause I can't drink dairy.
review_4_text:
LOVE it!
I keep coming back. The fried banana is so yummy! And they now have charging ports. Never seen these anywhere else 🥳✨
Cappuccino is strong 👍

The atmosphere, the service, and the food were all excellent.
review_5_text: Always my first choice whenever I go to “หน้ามอ Nah-Moh” (in front of the Chiangmai university). The restaurant offers a wide variety of menu options and also has a small café at the front. It has been open for over ten years since I was in high school and I still love it. A lot of memories with friends and tasty foods.

name: Roastniyom coffee
review_1_text:
Great coffee place right opposite main gate of Chiang Mai University on Huay Kaew road. Great ambience, space to focus on what you need to do with lovely coffee, and very kind and helpful staff - especial mention of Dew, thanks! Wifi washrooms and snacks etc

It is the people in the team that makes a place special - this is one such place
review_2_text: Lovely vibe for a small cafe by a busy junction facing the University of Chiang Mai and road up to Doi Suthep. Coffee is excellent. Thai milk tea cake we ordered was super yums. The icing is abit jelly cream like and the sponge cake was moist and soft. Forgot to ask if they made the cake themselves but truly a gem.. great place to stop by for cupola after the zoo or from Doi Suthep
review_3_text:
Nice coffee shop, opposite Chiang Mai University.
Coffee tastes is good.
Price is acceptable.
review_4_text:
Nice coffee shop
Good taste
Beautiful atmosphere & hospitality here
review_5_text: Nice roasted coffee and yummy dark chocolate cake. Nice ambience to chill out. Friendly staff.

name: Press continue cafe
review_1_text:
I was looking for a cafe with outlets to spend my last afternoon in Chiang Mai (forgot my portable battery pack in Bangkok 😭) and Press continue was perfectly suited for my needs! It wasn’t my original plan but I saw it on Google Maps and thought it would be a good fit because I’m a big gamer.
Coolest little cafe ever and I’m glad I stopped by! Super geeked to be able to try out some old-school NES games, and spent like 2-3 hours trying to beat Super Mario 3 to no avail. That game is harder than it looks! There were a few modern consoles too, though I didn’t try them. The owner’s wife was sweet and helpful, and it didn’t feel like there was any rush at all. Sabai maak maaaaak!
The owner’s collection is extensive and amazing to browse.
I got a Thai tea (45 baht), good price, refreshing and yummy to drink while gaming. Unfortunately no food offerings, which would’ve made this perfect cafe even more perfect.

In conclusion: highly recommend, if you’re a casual or avid gamer and looking for good drinks and games while on your way back to the city from the mountain temples!
review_2_text: Amazing place to chill and play some games! We played Mario kart on the switch and some Ps5 , they have a menu of nice drinks, the decor is awesome, the owner is just lovely. Comfy couches to sit on, they have retro Nintendo 64, PlayStation 1 and some other ones , loved this spot will be back for sure ! And it was nice and cool in there on a hot day! 5 Stars 🌟
review_3_text: I've been here yesterday, what a stunning gaming cafe! Owner and staff have been super friendly and helpful. There are five CRTs with retro consoles where I spent my time. Everything is well set up, cleaned and maintained. You can play almost all retro games you wish. There are also five flat screens with PS5s and Switches. For the retro consoles you buy a drink and can use them, for the modern consoles its 50 THB per hour, which I think is very fair. Highly recommend this place, loved it!
review_4_text:
This cafe bring me further than just playing ps5 but with some of retro consoles I never heared of them even I am the big fan of gaming console

you can order cafe or lots of drink and enjoy many types of game including lots of mainstram games in both single player & multi players like Black myth wukong , Elden ring , Ghost of yotei , tekken 8 , street fighter 6 or even party animals and smash bow in Nintendo you named it.

With service minded , caring , kind from P kwan & P bol I'm highly recommened you guys to visit here even for chating and exchange teenage dream in console

Cheers !!!
review_5_text: This place is awesome! Super huge selection of games and consoles, retro & modern. I definitely recommend any gamer come here to hangout, get a tasty drink and play some games! I hope to come back again and dive deeper into the games collection! 10/10

name: CuppaCharm Coffee
review_1_text:
I visited this café two times, and I had a great experience. The place is clean, with relaxing jazz music playing in the background. The drinks are reasonably priced, with a variety of options, including coffee, tea, and soda. You can also customize the sweetness level and add extras like honey if you prefer. They also offer free Wi-Fi and charging spots, which is super convenient.

I had a chat with the owner, who was incredibly friendly. They mentioned that the café opened just a few months ago and that they’re planning to introduce a new menu soon. On my first visit, I ordered a Cocoa Latte with regular sweetness. It was delicious! The owner also gave me a banana cake with caramel to try for free, saying they were still perfecting the recipe. It was fantastic!

The next day, I decided to visit again in the late evening and stayed until the place was about to close. One of the owners remembered me and asked if I wanted to try an unreleased drink, a strawberry latte. The day before, I had asked if they had any fruity drinks besides peach since I’m not a big fan of peach, and they told me the strawberry latte would be available the next day. So, of course, I came back.

The drink was great, but at first, they gave me a regular straw, which made it a bit difficult to mix the strawberry with the milk and drink it properly. When the owner asked for my feedback, I mentioned that the straw wasn’t strong enough for mixing and wasn’t wide enough for the strawberry pulp to pass through. She immediately apologized and brought me a larger straw, the kind used for bubble tea. On top of that, she gave me another banana cake on the house.

I’ll definitely be back if I visit this city again!
review_2_text: I’m pretty sure we were given 2 cups of milk when we ordered two hot cappuccinos… at least say that you don’t know how to make a drink, but to wait quite a while for that.. just kind of unprofessional. Wanted to give a good review but just being honest about our experience.
review_3_text: Located at the entrance of an alley near the university, this coffeeshop will become one of my favorites in Chiang Mai. It has been open for a month by Golf and Sophia, a friendly young Thai couple who are smiling and who will give you a warm welcome. They have concocted different homemade blends of organic coffees from plantations in the Chiang Dao district, north of Chiang Mai. Whether you like a smooth or strong coffee, there will be one to suit your taste. Unless you prefer an excellent green tea or a delicious strawberry milk! The space is bright with a high ceiling. The polished concrete floor and vintage furniture elements contribute to the relaxed atmosphere. This coffeeshop stands out for another significant aspect. Golf and Sophia are lovers of good music and they have equipped their shop with high-end audio equipment. A delicious coffee or tea while listening to good songs and sound in a warm and smiling atmosphere, all this at very reasonable prices... what else?
review_4_text: A super nice cafè near chiang Mai university. I came here several times while living in the area. They have very good coffee and two variations of roast to choose from, which I really appreciate. The owner and staff are super friendly and welcoming. I like to come both for some relaxing coffee or for extended work stints. All in all very recommended place:)
review_5_text: Very delicious food and awesome customer service. Totally recommended! You have to try their banana bread!!!

name: Juice Central 2
review_1_text:
I regret living on the other side of town, but I'm ready to commute here every day. First of all, this place is amazing because of the friendly staff. I couldn't resist when the owner invited me in. Also, they have excellent homemade baking, which is a rarity in Thailand.

I’ll keep coming back until I’ve tried every single cake. And after that, I'll keep coming until the owner kicks me out! Great place. You should definitely check it out.
review_2_text:
This place became our morning habit. We stop in for a drink almost every day. 🫂 The owners always meet us with a smile, so warm and friendly, like visiting friends. The atmosphere is simple and kind, without any show - that is why we like to come back. The cafe owners teach us Thai words 🙏😄

The coffee is tasty and not expensive. But the best part is their homemade bakery. In Chiang Mai coffee shops it is rare to find something really homemade, fresh and warm. Here they have pies, cakes, cheesecake. My favorite is the pie with pandan - it is amazing! All is fresh and made with love.

💛 If you want not only coffee, but also a cozy place with good people and real taste - I really recommend to come here.
review_3_text: Absolutely amazing place. The atmosphere created by the crew, along with delicious coffee, smoothies, and pastries, is wonderful. The prices are very friendly. The owner (a very passionate traveller) and the rest of the staff are incredibly helpful—they are happy to give recommendations and assist with your travels. Wi-Fi is also available. One of the best places I've visited in Chiang Mai (and I've been to a lot!). Can't wait to come back!
review_4_text:
amazing fruit smoothies and muffin🥧
the boss is friendly and warm
I‘ll order another taste of fruit smoothies tomorrow🍹
review_5_text: Family-run establishment with comfortable seating and a choice of coffees, juices and baked goods. Nothing fancy but the price is right and it is a pleasant environment for spending an hour if one happens to be in the neighborhood.

name: The FAM Story
review_1_text: Decent bibimbap for 99 baht.  No small dishes, but the restaurant is really cute with lots of books.
review_2_text: It's delicious. It tastes exactly like the tteokbokki you eat in Korea. They even made the steamed buns for you!!! You have to take off your shoes before going in!! The store is clean and cool, and the owners are Korean and are really, really kind. I'll come again~!
review_3_text:
This is a place where you can eat Korean food. You can also read a book and enjoy a cup of coffee together by sharing opinions with each other in various gatherings. Please visit once. You'll feel like you're in Korea. ^^

This is a place where you can eat Korean food. You can read a book and enjoy a cup of coffee together by sharing opinions with each other in various gatherings. Please visit once. I feel like Korea well. ^^
review_4_text: Korean kimchi stew, kimbap, and ramen are so delicious.
review_5_text: When you come here, you can feel the taste and affection of Korea.

name: ร้านสวนชา garden tea หน้ามช.
review_1_text:
Delicious, clean, and reasonably priced. The vendors are friendly and provide excellent service. While waiting, I could smell the aroma of the drinks.
The shop is closed on Sundays.
review_2_text: Every dish is delicious.

name: Curry puff coffee หน้ามอชอ
Pine Cafe
review_1_text:
​Pine Cafe is a charming, cute cafe well worth the short walk off the main busy street. ​The coffee is nice, I tried the iced coffee (medium roast) with caramel, which was perfectly made to my liking.

​The cafe boasts a beautiful two-floor layout with plenty of seating for both groups and digital nomads looking for a seat. The decor is cool, featuring a fusion of contemporary and classic Western-inspired designs.

​The ambience is laid back... the light jazz background music encourages soft, low tones, creating thr atmosphere for working, reading, or quiet conversation.

Check them out
review_2_text:
Absolutely a hidden gem of Chiang Mai mostly known to locals.  Cafe has a lovely ambience with a quiet atmosphere similar to a library. Despite the cafe being filled with students, it was silent.

The staff are friendly and added bonus of in house cats roaming freely to entertain you.  Deserts, cakes and light food served which were all delicious. It was my favourite hiding place while I was in Chiang Mai. Great place with great coffee and cakes. A must try if you are looking for a nice place to chill and relax during a busy holiday.
review_3_text:
We came across this café during our walks and, despite the construction next door, decided to give it a try. The space is beautifully decorated with a good mix of seating — cozy window spots for solo visitors, tables for couples, and larger setups for groups.

The menu is quite limited, offering only four breakfast items along with drinks. While we were there, we noticed several university students working on their laptops over drinks.

Overall, it’s a charming place for a morning coffee if you’re not allergic to cats and can tolerate some construction noise.
review_4_text: Perfect little cafe away from the hustle and bustle of the main streets. Awesome coffee and snacks. Definitely recommend if your looking for somewhere away from the crowds
review_5_text: Last week I stayed at the Airbnb next door. The place was very nice, and the coffee was good too. The staff were very polite. They also have some adorable cats!

name: bays coffee co.
review_1_text: This place is a winner !  Very good coffee and cake. But, this place has a lot more to offer.  It has an attached vegan restaurant with lots of shared seating.  Both AC seating and non AC.  The interior has nice decor with modern furniture made For large people.  This shop has a very large and beautiful supply of baked goods.  The apple crumble is awesome.  The coffee taste will bring me back to this place.  The. Lunch and dinner food looks very nice and fresh.  There were 3 very professional and polite bartistas working.   I highly recommend this place
review_2_text: Best Hot Chocolate I have ever had in Chiang Mai! It is so close to what I had in Spain!
review_3_text: The place is incredibly comfortable and beautiful, and the staff are hardworking, kind, helpful, and extremely excited that you're there! Also, you can't beat the food, it's too good. Would 100% recommend for everybody!
review_4_text:
A cozy place with a pleasant interior and polite staff, located a short distance from the main road. It will be a real discovery for coffee enthusiasts: a wide assortment of different varieties (cold brew with coconut milk is my recommendation 👍). The desserts are also good, especially the carrot cake. Not crowded and stays open late, which is also an advantage.

It's  not a cheap, but prices are ok for this quality. They also have a happy hour (2-4pm) when you can buy one coffee and get a second one for free.
review_5_text: Found this gem of a place.   Lovely outdoor sittimg area and the interior is nice too.  The eggs benedict was delicious.   They have a huge variety on their menu from breakfast items to sandwiches and wraps and burgers even. The coffee is really good and they even make you plain matcha tea if you want.  We will try to come here again before we leave.

name: YOBO (โยโบ) Smoothie Bowl & Yogurt Café Chiang Mai
review_1_text:
YOBO is a great place to start the day or take a relaxing break during it. They serve what is, in our opinion, the best egg coffee in Thailand—truly Vietnamese style. We had the iced egg coffee and loved it so much.

They also have yogurt bowls, cookies, and other creative options on the menu, all of which look absolutely delicious.

The place is very clean, the owner is extremely kind and happy to explain everything. The indoor seating is cozy and neat, with soft background music that isn’t disturbing at all. A clean toilet is also available.

Highly recommended!
review_2_text: Amazing little gem! Super kind and welcoming owner, huge selection of smoothie bowls, smoothies, coffee, juices, bakery. High quality fresh ingredients, super tasty! They also have some board games and very chilled atmosphere. Highly recommend it! :)
review_3_text: Such a good find! The only place I know for authentic Vietnamese coffee in Chiang Mai and the smoothie/yoghurt bowls are amazing - all natural and healthy. There is parking space at the back, and the vibe is really nice for doing a bit of work too.
review_4_text:
Great spot for a fantastic fruitbowl, many choices and i tryed alot of them!
They also serve egg coffee wich was new to me but very delicious.
Both for 250 baht quality and a good start of the day
review_5_text:
Just finished an amazing smoothie bowl at Yobo with my partner, and it was honestly excellent. The fruit was super fresh, the texture was smooth and creamy, and the toppings were perfect — almonds, nuts, seeds, pea protein, everything you’d want in a nutritious bowl.

The portion size was great, and the presentation was clean and beautiful. Light, refreshing, and satisfying all at once. Easily one of the best smoothie bowls I’ve had in Chiang Mai.

We’ll definitely be back again. Highly recommended! 🍓🥝🥥💚

name: Neo Entertainment Gallery
review_1_text:
Neo Entertainment Gallery locates near Ibis Hotel on Huaykaew road. The place specializes on HIFI stereo, audio equipment and turntable. Neo Entertainment also offers CDs and Vinyls for sell. The upper floors are the vinyls and artworks (thats why they are also an "gallery"). From the looks, they also have mini cafe as well on the lower floor.

Lovely attentive staff at all times during my visit.
review_2_text: Very nice ambience and great coffee
review_3_text: Quality audio/video products
review_4_text: มีทั้งหูฟัง Gadgets ลำโพง และเครื่องเสียงไฮเอนด์  บริการดี ประทับใจ มีร้านกาแฟเป็นโซนต้อนรับด้วยนะคะ เยี่ยม!
review_5_text: If you want the best sound system, you have to come here.

name: Tree Black House
review_1_text: Very kind owner stays up late to serve coffee and tea until 2am. This is a great little hole-in-the-wall cafe.
review_2_text: Great coffee (at an excellent price) and really chilled atmosphere. Will be coming back again.
review_3_text:
The best prace for the weed in the city
Nice staff
Beautiful cat as well ❤️
review_4_text: This is a small, minimalist coffee shop filled with the rich aroma of coffee, as well as delicious cocoa. A must-visit for coffee lovers.
review_5_text: Delicious food, excellent service, and a lovely owner.

name: Fresh Corner Cafe
review_1_text: Amazing café with perfect coffee and the friendliest staff — cozy, welcoming, and easily my new favorite spot in town!
review_2_text:
amazing cafeteria! The cocoa strawberry was so good we ordered another one. The cappuccino was also great.
the staff was super friendly and nice, the ambiance is new and beautiful, a perfect place to spend some time.
Also the internet was super fast!
review_3_text:
Such a cozy little gem of a coffee shop! I had the Matcha Latte on my first visit. On my second visit, I tried the Strawberry Milk, which was super refreshing and not overly sweet. The customer service is genuinely warm and friendly, and the prices are very reasonable.

It’s also a great spot to socialize — I met a few English-speaking customers and had some lovely conversations. Highly recommend supporting this local favorite! 💚
review_4_text:
Delicious coffee and they currently have a student discount
The owner is very friendly and acommodating
review_5_text: Delicious coffee and good portions for a cheap price, good service and they have the view of the mountain. Every time I go by their shop I have Latte to take away and so far have never been disappointed!

name: Mingmitr Coffee - เจ็ดยอด
review_1_text:
Cozy coffee shop kind of vibes.  I am here during Chirstmas and NY eve.
The decoration looks really nice!

Good place  to get a hot cappucinon with friends and family.
Staffs are  so friendly.
Pet Friendly environment! There is an orange cat in the neighbour come say hello!
review_2_text: Nice atmosphere and friendly staffs. Lots of drinks and snacks available. A perfect place for your every cup!!
review_3_text:
Mingmitr Coffee Jedyod Branch is very cozy and invating place.

It is a great spot whether you come alone or with friends
Plenty of  parking lot.
review_4_text: Good coffee with reasonable price👍🏼👍🏼
review_5_text: The best coffee, atmosphere, and service in Chiang Mai.

name: Good Drink Good Cups at Chang Khian
review_1_text: The drinks taste good and the shop is cute.

The coffee is great, and the retro decorations and cat-theme is so fun and inviting. Ice coffee is 45 Baht and there are lots of small snacks including handmade bakery items. The owner is lovely. 🌸😊
review_2_text:
If you come to this Cafe,You will find a lot of Architecture and Interior Design students,Teacher ETC.
The owner so cute and friendly.She can speak every language whatever you want,Especially Japanese
Bakery this shop daaa BEST🤍
review_3_text: Great blend at an affordable price compared to Nimman's area, and I believe this is the best around the campus area in the front zone of CMU/CMRU. I recommend it to those who want to taste coffee without any fancy or elaborate stuff—just great taste and passion in beans. I highly suggest you try it.
review_4_text: The coffee is very nice and the coffee shop is very cute and cozy. I recommend this place!!
review_5_text: Super chill and cute 🐱cat cafe, amazing coffee and tea.

name: Miracle Coffee - Chang Khian
review_1_text:
Nice little coffee shop tucked away on this road. Reasonably priced, most iced stuff is 35 thb each and hot stuff is 25 thb each.

They give takeaway packaging to drink easily while walking. Had the iced latte and it was good, generous portion. 😊

Place is open from early morning 7am.

Recommended.
review_2_text: The taste is delicious and well-balanced. The staff are lovely. 🥰
review_3_text: The price is cheap!
review_4_text: They aren't taking my order.
review_5_text: The taste is delicious and well-rounded.

name: Street Coffee Crew
review_1_text:
Absolutely love this spot, it has such an amazing vibe.
I already knew this coffee from the stand at Jing Jai Market and I’m really happy he opened his own café.
Great taste and one of my favourite coffees in Chiang Mai.
review_2_text: Great vibe , great ice americano , sweetest lazy white doggo, vinyl turntables for a morning coffee, honestly my favourite coffee shop of all time in the entire galaxy , 5 stars would caffeinate again (and I will). Also the crew are a nice bunch of people.
review_3_text: A awesome place. Young and hip vibe, and hip-hop based music was also good. Highly recommanded.
review_4_text: The magic latte was super good, probably the best in chiang mai. But the music was quite loud inside, I don’t see how people can talk or work there.
review_5_text: I love that they offer a choice of light, medium, or dark roast beans — all at the same price! The atmosphere is relaxed and cozy, with a steady flow of customers during the late morning. Their pastries are delicious and reasonably priced.

name: Bannom Minimal Cafe
review_1_text: Highly recommended for students/working professionals who like to study/work peacefully in a cozy place. Has a lot of coffee varieties in their menu with delicious pastries for reasonable price. With very fast wifi and location is easy to pin on Grab/Bolt ride app.
review_2_text:
Nice place to sit, relax, or get some work done.

Lots of seating and have 2 floors.

Most are nearby college students working on assignments or locals working on laptops.

Affordable prices.

Strong Wifi.

AC is quite strong.

Open till late (1 am), perfect for catching deadlines or simply working in different timezones.
review_3_text: Baannom Cafe is a great place to read and relax. There are plenty of seating options, making it easy to find a cozy spot. The menu offers a variety of food and beverages, ensuring there’s something for everyone. The peaceful atmosphere makes it a perfect spot to unwind with a book or enjoy a quiet break.
review_4_text: It's nice to drop off your laundry at the nearby coin laundromat and enjoy a refreshing drink while you wait. The coconut drink was especially refreshing and delicious.
review_5_text: Great co working space! Great coffee, great prices! Very recommended!

name: The Coco Club
review_1_text:
I can’t believe a place like this exists in Chiang Mai. You only pay 300 THB for a day pass, which includes an ice bath, sauna, swimming pool, and free tea and coffee.

It’s a great community space to relax and also to work. The staff are very kind and welcoming.
Next time, I will never miss the chance to come and rest here again.
review_2_text:
Totally recommend if you need a space to work and place to chill at the same time!
wish we have coworking & wellness community like this in Bangkok! Definitely go back again if I visit Chiangmai!
And their smoothie is sooooooo good!
review_3_text: This place is really great. It’s the perfect spot for a quiet and relaxing time. I like that they both have a coworking space, café, pool, sauna and ice bath. I can highly recommend it
review_4_text:
This  place is peaceful and relaxing, great for anyone who wants to rest or even get some work done. They also have activities like an ice bath and a sauna.

Overall, I was pretty impressed.
review_5_text:
This place is honestly such a hidden gem for both party lovers and those who just want to chill. The pool is surrounded by tall green trees and palm leaves, which gives off a tropical vibe that makes you forget you’re still in the city. When the sun is out and the sky is bright blue, the water looks extra refreshing—perfect for cooling off, lounging on a float, or just hanging out with friends.
The pool itself is spacious, with fun striped floats you can relax on, and there’s even a bar right by the poolside where you can grab drinks without ever leaving the water. What makes it even better is that it’s not just about the pool—this spot also has a sauna and an ice bath. After a long day in the sun or a fun party session, jumping between the heat of the sauna and the cold plunge is the ultimate way to reset your body and recharge.
Overall, it’s the kind of place that has everything you need: a lively atmosphere, good drinks, refreshing water, plus wellness perks like the sauna and ice bath. Whether you’re here with a big group of friends for a pool party or just want a relaxing weekend escape, it’s definitely worth checking out

name: CHALALAI garden ร้านมะยงชิด สวนชลาลัย (เจ็ดยอด)
review_1_text:
This store sells mayongchid (plango) sweet dessert.
I tried mayongchid cheesecake ice cream. It was good.
The store is next to highway but have a garden vibe seats.
review_2_text: A small store with a garden and they have home made ice cream and smoothie available. Even though it is located on the large street, there is a small garden at the store.
review_3_text: The most delicious coconut smoothie as I walk to CNX Coworking space. Within five minutes I am cooled off and my palate is happy. I have tried their coconut ice cream as well. It’s a winner.
review_4_text: WOW! You like ice cream? Come HERE! This place is cute for a date and a place to indulge in self-reflection, while you eat amazing ice cream❤️
review_5_text: A lovely ice cream and smoothie shop, an oasis of cool and cuteness. Great place to chill. Super friendly service.

name: Lush Cafe & Garden
review_1_text: This place is very peaceful and has a great atmosphere. The food tasted really good, but it was not hot when it was served. It took a long time for the meal even though they did not appear to be busy when we were there, but perhaps they were busy with delivery orders. I would eat here again, I didn't mind waiting, but hope that the food would be hot next time.
review_2_text: Fantastic cafe with nice garden. It feels like Bali here and pretty nice to relax. This seems like a part of a 3 star hotel and you can use the bathroom inside the hotel. Their coffee is very good as well as the food and the value is also great.
review_3_text:
Gorgeous garden and patio area! I ordered a Thai tea which was sweet but a little too milky. My husband ordered a latte and a Thai tea as well and both of his drinks were perfect.
I really enjoyed the views and the calm atmosphere which was perfect for studying.
review_4_text:
Food is very tasty. I picked up fried rice with northern style dish.
Passionfruit freppe is really fresh.
Vibe is cozy and good relaxing. WiFi is quite strong.
Plenty of parking lots.
review_5_text:
Lovely cafe which is part of a charming old hotel. Beautiful landscape.

Pasta prices are good 👍 (80B-90B). Portion was good too. So happy as most places are charging 150B and more for a plate of aglio olio pasta.

The only downside is that they are not very flexible. They were not able to add prawn at additional charge. And when I asked for extra basil leaves, was told they ran out of it. But few orders delivered afterwards came with the basil leaves. Guess they have limited amount, which again quite strange for a hotel standard. Food still good nevertheless, but I would have enjoyed it more if there was more basil leaves on my plate. Oh well... 😅

Vanilla latte was good too. Though a bit expensive at 80B.

Definitely a new fave place for me.

name: Penguin Ghetto | Coffee and Beverages
review_1_text: Great little cafe! Awesome coffee at cheap prices and really friendly staff. Inside and outside seating. Great orange espresso. Lovely
review_2_text:
LOVE this place! Amazing coffee and cute cafe!
Hidden gem on the back roads of Nimman area.

This cafe is very tiny, but very cute. I hope more people will know about it and support this place because I love it!

We got their cold brew latte which was amazing! The presentation and flavor was utter perfection.  MUST get!

Also got her Oreo cheesecake which was a perfect accompaniment to the delicious cold brew latte.

Cash only and be patient, a great little place to hang out.
review_3_text: Small and lovely vintage cafe on Sompotch 700 years Road. Dtac customer offered 10% discount for the drinks.The entrance is quite small and parking at the side of road. Try this menu "kori kori coffee" (ice cube coffee with cold milk). Coffee bean are from Thai plantation.
review_4_text: Quick coffee spot in the little small vintage space. Inside there is just a coffee bar with the owner who makes coffee or other drinks. Coffee here tastes good but a few seats inside.
review_5_text: Wow... Their coffee is amazing... And Oreo cheescake... Wow... This is a cozy small cafe, peaceful... Staff is very polite n smiling always... Love that... Their coffee menu is cool... Must try... 😊😃

name: Paris House Bakery @CNX
review_1_text:
Cute little coffee shop with freshly baked croissants. I actually have been to their shop before and forgot. Not this one. But they also have a coffee shop in Pridi / Phra Khanong in Bangkok.

The croissants are good and so is the coffee. The owners / staff are very nice. Also a good spot to do some work. Internet is fast.
review_2_text: My go-to breakfast spot in Chiang Mai. Had breakfast here every day for weeks. The owners are super friendly and welcome you like it’s their home. 10/10 recommend!
review_3_text: Great breakfast, and beautiful to smell fresh baked croissant!  Ice americano was perfect and the owners very friendly. Good prices for  western style breakfasts.
review_4_text:
Tick for every box. Atmosphere is welcoming and friendly. Vibe is positive 🩷 and music great too.🎶
Menu is simple, and delicious 🤤. Simple things are quite often the best. And affordable. Will definitely make it a regular thing and have already started telling my friends about it. Credit where it's due. 🙏🏽🩷🎶
review_5_text: Was getting my motorbike serviced at Honda nearby and wanted to have some breakfast. Glad I found this place just 50m down the road. Had the egg pesto feta toast, it was incredibly tasty. Everything is reasonably priced and unlike many places, all their pastries seem to be actually homemade.

It was easily better than expected. This place is usually has many customers, and now I know why. The prices are better than many places around as well. Highly recommended.

review_3_text:
Pros: very stylish aesthetic, affordable coffee (not super cheap though)
Cons: my coffee was pretty weak flavor-wise, the cashier/barista was not very friendly (she wasn't outright rude)
review_4_text: nice cafe
review_5_text: Good taste and cheap price. Nice.

name: We R coffee

review_2_text: I picked up ice americano here. It is a tiny cafe, mostly for to go, but the prices are cheaper than most of the coffee places around and the quality is good.
review_3_text: Very quaint coffee place, really nice.  I ordered the iced latte, and it was perfect. Price was even better 🙂, only goes to show you that you don't need to pay a lot to get good coffee.
review_4_text: a nice cozy place, the barista customized the coffee for me, I got a Mint Coffee black hot while it’s only available for iced
review_5_text: Good coffee, great price, friendly owner

review_1_text: This is a very cozy place where you will be greeted with a smile and fed the most delicious roti. We go here every week.
review_2_text:
45 minute to make 1 roti.
When customer ask to cancel because you prefer do Online orders rather then Customer in shop, dont be rude and be polite to him.

review_4_text:
Bang Bo Roti: A paradise for roti, tea, and coffee lovers in Chiang Mai!
If you're looking for a delicious roti shop in Chiang Mai, you absolutely can't miss "Bang Bo Roti"! Their roti is perfectly sweet and fragrant, with generous fillings and a wide variety of options, from banana and cheese roti to cheese roti and various special rotis – guaranteed to please everyone.

But the deliciousness of this shop isn't limited to roti. Their drinks are equally amazing, from fragrant coffee and rich Pakistani tea to refreshing blended drinks.

And you absolutely can't miss the beef rice bowl! It's the best I've ever had. The beef is tender, the flavor is perfectly balanced, and it pairs flawlessly with the hot rice.
review_5_text: The roti is delicious. It's fried until crispy and the filling is just the right amount of sweet. I really like the corn cheese roti. It's delicious. The water is reasonably priced. The hot Pakistani tea is very fragrant. I've never tried it before. P.S. There are musical instruments and board games to play for free. I like this the most.

name: Food Exchange at Novotel Chiangmai Nimman Journeyhub
review_1_text:
This restaurant is seriously underrated. Whether it’s Thai or Western cuisine, every dish is absolutely delicious. What really impressed me is how well they balance the flavors — nothing is too salty, and everything is seasoned just right. Whether you’re craving authentic Thai flavors or a really good Italian pizza, they deliver on both fronts.

I honestly think this place is worth a special trip. The food blew me away — I originally just stopped by because I was tired and wanted something near the hotel, but I was genuinely surprised by how amazing it was. Despite the lack of crowds, the quality is top-notch. The space is also really cozy and atmospheric, making it a perfect spot for group gatherings.

The staff here are incredibly attentive, and every detail in how the food is prepared is just right. Their service is truly outstanding.
review_2_text: Very bad western food. The club sandwich came out cold even though it’s grilled somehow, and it’s like a supermarket quality sandwich that I can make myself with zero cooking experience. I had a bite of it and immediately felt sadness. The burger was slightly better, but literally zero juice drips doesn’t matter how hard you squeeze it. This is the first bad food I have had in this city this year.
review_3_text: Food are generally good but the grilled river prawns did not seem hit my expectation. For the price, I would think more can be done to increase the food selection. Surprisingly, the fried chicken drum let's tasted exceptionally good.
review_4_text: I am a allcor plus member and I stay in many Accor hotels around Thailand. That is by far the best Accor restaurant I am experienced. My girlfriend and me are now extending our stay in Novotel for about one month and we are eating daily in the restaurant. They have delicious seefood, pizza and also healthy options. The staff is excellent. After having a bit bad experience in Andaman in phuket I really like Novotel and the Novotel food exchange a lot. Also if you register as member and buy the Accor plus membership you will get free welcome drinks and 50% discount of the food if you bring your partner. I am seriously considering living full time in Accor hotels!
review_5_text:
Gets better.

Adequate hot food and nice little local delicacies section.
Good pastries and bread.
Nice coffee too.

review_4_text: Good coffee, fast WiFi, polite staff. This place is quite enough for you to get some work done. Popular with students because of the price. Small and must arrive to get a good seat.
review_5_text: Very long wait for my drink. The staff talking and laughing with eachother.

name: Funky Roaster ฟังกี้ โรสเตอร์ 咖啡厅和酒吧

Cool Coffee Shop that opens early in the morning. So it was perfect for me to stop on my way to the office. Skipping hotel coffee and having a proper one instead.

review_2_text:

(posted a photo of their menu)

review_4_text: I absolutely adore you. This is the strongest coffee in Chiang Mai! And you make it incredibly fast. I don’t even know how I’d live without you. Love you!
review_5_text: Very good concept, very good coffee, but sadly provided wifi didn't worked and I had to go somwhere else :(

name: Sudkhum cafe & Restaurant
review_1_text:
Amazing place, cosy.

Perfect service.

Delicious food and fair prices.
review_2_text:
This is so cosy nice place.
We like to be here.
And staff is very friendly. And food so tasty :)
Thank you so much.
review_3_text: Everything was good. I got the spicy pork spaghetti, chicken nuggets, French fries and a banana smoothie.
review_4_text: Very tasty food in a spacious, pleasant setting and they make their own ice cream!
review_5_text:
We have a lot to talk about. 👁️🫦👁️

Brother Guan Ting, I'm Guan Ting, brother. It's a 1-1 draw, lol. I went to Nong Hor Market and it was raining, my feet were so dusty and muddy 😭. It stained the shop.

First of all, there was no one inside the shop, and the air conditioning was blaring. I wanted to steal your money and run away. I waited for 10-20 minutes.
I called the number on Google Maps, and the owner probably answered, saying he was calling a staff member.
In short, we didn't know where he was. A woman walked in, and she didn't apologize, just asking if someone had taken her order.
Then, out of nowhere, a man appeared from behind the shop. He didn't apologize either.

The food was incredibly slow (maybe 25-35 minutes).
It must have just been cooked (I'm serious).
Because the shrimp paste rice was so pale and bland, and the rice was soft. Did he just finish cooking it? I can tell.

The spaghetti was delicious. Usually, when I eat it elsewhere, it's greasy and bland at the end. But this one wasn't. It was delicious.

Both drinks were sweet. The banana was okay, but the mixed berry was overly sweet (probably because it was not sour at all, just sweet).

The tart was delicious, with a fresh creamy texture and not overly milky. It was creamy and not heavy on the tongue (personally, I was indifferent).

Then, when I paid, it was a total shock!
The bill was miscalculated, 466 baht. What? I pressed *2 for the shrimp spaghetti.
I already transferred the money. Luckily, I didn't notice why it was that price.
The woman said, "Oh, I pressed double. I'll refund you."
Then, there was no apology at all, just refunding the cash. I was really disappointed.

It's a good thing the photos I took today turned out well, or else it would have been a bigger mess.

review_1_text: Alls good, cute shop with many bunny soft toys & nice coffee with choice of roast & they understand English. However cashier didn’t understand to give me 20 baht change, when I gave her 55 baht for 35 baht egg tart 😅
review_2_text: This is my second time being here. The bunnies are so cute. Now they have a new collection, cats. I didn’t try them today. Might try it next time. review_3_text: Nice cozy coffee spot, the iced latte was delicious (50B). They’ve got 3 different blends (dark, medium, light roast). Love the cups it comes in, friendly staff.
review_4_text: Tasty drink and lovely dolls. I love the Toto set! Check it out everyone. It is a small cafe but full of happiness. The staff are really friendly.
review_5_text: Warmly coffee cafe with cute bunny as a unique 🐇🐇

name: FOW.space โฟ่วสเปซ
review_1_text:
It seems to me that people come here to work, but the coffee shop/work space has untapped, even wasted potential:
- The music is too loud (I come here to work, not to listen to music like in a bar).
- The chairs are uncomfortable. I came with my partner and we wanted to sit opposite each other, but one of us had to sit on a bench... It was impossible to stay there for several hours.
- I had problems with the connection. Are some sites restricted? (Like TikTok?)

My comment is sincere feedback for this place, which I think has good potential. That's why I'm still giving it 4 stars.

Downside:. The drinks were not that great. Was too sweet for me. The chairs are also not comfortable for long time sitting..
review_3_text:
Cute coffee shop with very friendly staff.
The price are reasonable, and they also sell some adorable items.
review_4_text: Everything's so fine, except for the music as it's too loud, more like a bar than a relaxing place. Makes it hard to focus on work or reading sometimes 🫠
review_5_text:

review_3_text:
reasonable price
comfortable place
good atmosphere

the female owner is really kind and friendly.
touchable cat

review_4_text:
Nice bakery.

Coffee below average IMHO.
review_5_text: Great place to sit with laptop. Good coffee with good price.

review_1_text: The worst shop ever, totally unfriendly to customers. I wanted to sit at a table and order coffee. I already had my bag there, and it was impossible to order a coffee from the side of the tables. I had to go to the other side to order and that meant I lost my seat. Thank you so much, because that's how customer service should be, thanks Amazon coffee for nothing. And if you then tell him that this isn't right, they look at you as if to say, "What do you want?
