review_3_text: Consistent quality across the chain of shops. This location is great for sipping a latte and people watching.
review_4_text:
Bad attitude from staff. Refused to give my wife a splash of milk in her tea, which has never been an issue in any other Cafe Amazons. When I asked why, they just said we can not! I offered to pay extra & they said, no we can not. The staff were rude and laughing between themselves at us. The manager eventually came and gave us some milk.

We'll be giving this one a miss in future.
review_5_text: Staff refuse to hand me a coffee at the table behind the station and insisted that the only way to got my paid coffee is to walk around to the spot they place it. I can walk fine and it okey to grasp my heavy belongings with me. But it kind of rude for me.

name: Le​ Cafe​ Arabica
review_1_text: Lovely little cafe that's operated by a elderly couple. The cake choices were limited but very tasty. We ordered another carrot cake after finishing one. The drinks were also well prepared and served with high quality ceramic coasters.
review_2_text: A small cafe, but things look and feel sophisticated here somehow. I feel the owner care about details and it is pretty impressive. It feels right and smells right being here. The prices of drinks are pretty affordable as well. My ice cappuccino was pretty good. I will come back to try their cake next time.
review_3_text:
Just walking along the Main Street and found the most amazing little coffee shop .
35b for a coffee was very cheap and the coffee was good .
The man was very friendly who runs it .
His brown cookies were amazing.
Nice comfy chairs and the ambience is perfect to get away from crowded areas .

Check it out !!!
review_4_text:
I happened to pass by this cozy little café run by an elderly couple. The coffee is very affordable, and they also offer some pastries. The atmosphere is warm and simple, with air conditioning, some Japanese anime decorations, and comic books. There are plugs for charging your devices as well. I ordered a hot cocoa latte for 40 THB and sat down to relax for a bit.

Feb 28, 2025
review_5_text: What a great place! The owner himself is a older guy and he is so friendly. 10/10 ⭐️

name: อยู่สุข - U sook 𝗛𝗼𝗺𝗲 𝗰𝗮𝗳𝗲
review_1_text: What’s not to love?? The staff is kind, the ambience is like a cozy crafty back yard garden, the food and drinks are tasty. My new favorite place in santitham 💗
review_2_text: My favourite coffee shop in Chiang Mai. Beautiful large hot latte and a cake for 100B and in a garden with plenty of shade and fans. Super chilled out place to relax.
review_3_text: Peaceful nature-style café with a cozy, homey vibe. Not crowded and very relaxing. They even have drawing cards and free books to enjoy. The hojicha is absolutely amazing! Easy to get here and they also serve drinks, bakery, and simple meals. Definitely worth a visit ❤️
review_4_text: This is a cute cafe. The food and drinks are delicious and reasonably priced. We ordered Khao Soi Gai (chicken noodle soup) and Pad Krapow (stir-fried basil with chicken), both were excellent. The matcha sago dessert was unique and tasty. There are many photo opportunities and activities to do. The service was excellent. Highly recommended.
review_5_text: The atmosphere is amazing. Board games and drawing are great for kids, and the Paka Paumoo Sap is the best I've had in Thailand. Kai Soi is also a must-try. The omelets are great for kids, and the coffee is from Nambawon, Thailand!

name: บ.เสือป่า-ไอที จำกัด
review_1_text: The parking lot is spacious, the staff are friendly, and there is a complete range of food stalls, coffee shops, IT equipment, and mobile phones. I really like it.
review_2_text: Sent the phone for repairs. The first time in March, they sent it back very quickly. In short, the Wi-Fi didn't work and the sound was gone. Sent it back again in early April. Until now in May, it still hasn't been repaired. In short, is it repaired or is it being delayed?
review_3_text: The repair service was very fast and efficient.
review_4_text: I went to buy IT equipment. I bought several items and asked for wholesale prices. I really like it.
review_5_text:
So skilled
Understand the problem
Standard repair price

name: RUF Cafe
review_1_text: service is nice and coffee is not bad
review_2_text: The air conditioning is cool, the music is great, there's plenty of parking, and the staff are welcoming. Come and check it out! 🤟🏼😎
review_3_text: A super chic coffee shop in the Santitham area. The atmosphere is great, with lots of photo spots and a spacious parking area. The staff are friendly and helpful.
review_4_text: The sweet drinks/coffee are delicious. The atmosphere in the shop is beautifully decorated. It is located in the FUR shop. The parking lot is very spacious. When we went, there was a promotion, buy 2 get 1 free. 🥰
review_5_text:
Want to lose weight? Drink an Americano. Want a phone number? Be brave enough to ask.

RUF Cafe, with its Hot Summer style, is located in the FUR CAFE CNX project, alongside a kingdom of imported furniture from America and Scandinavia from famous designers. The colors are eye-catching, and they also sell furniture. There's plenty of parking.
The drink menu includes coffee with a choice of medium and dark roast beans, as well as non-coffee options.

name: Becoming Coffee House
review_1_text: Ver good coffee in a nice space. They had their coffee beans being dried right outside and the quality of the coffee is good. I came in and chill a bit and luckily, i got to play with the baby cats and i had a great time here. The staffs were really nice as well.
review_2_text:
Cute little shop with 2 cats. Owner customized my drink because I can't drink milk! Ordered coffee latte (oat milk) black orange coffee and a mixed fruit cookie 🍪

Very friendly and speaks good English the female owner is very social
review_3_text:
They proceed their own coffee beans here.
Coffee is good. There are light roasted and medium roasted coffee bean options.
Store owners are nice.
review_4_text: If you are fan of cats and coffee - this place is a must visit. This is cozy cafe with cute cat craft souvenirs, 2 amazing cats and very tasty coffee
review_5_text:
so happy to find the cafe open in early morning, and feel fresh with beautiful garden. Cheese cake and lemon cake are highly reccommened.
P.S. Cats normally join to cafe on Tuesday and Saturday.

name: Bluemochatea
review_1_text:
A cozy and cozy coffee shop, perfect for chilling out.

The owner is lovely and friendly.

This shop is great for meeting friends for work or working quietly on your laptop (Wifi available).

There's seating both indoors (air-conditioned) and outdoors on wooden chairs.

They have a wide variety of drinks, including tea and coffee.

We tried the rose tea – it was fragrant and had a strong tea aroma – and the hot latte was smooth and delicious.

Regarding the tea roasting section, we recommend trying it yourself. If you like it, you can buy some to take home. If you're planning to open a tea shop, you can come and try the teas and get advice. They even have tea menus available. They roast and wholesale tea leaves, and have many different types and blends of tea.

Parking is available on the street in the alley next to the shop.
review_2_text:
This place is really good for drinks.

I like the americano,
and the various teas.

The owner is very kind.

There's a cute and very friendly dog.

I've been to this shop 10 times already.
review_3_text: You have to come and try it. I stumbled upon this. I don't usually come here for this kind of noodles. It's delicious and the price is good.
review_4_text: This coffee shop has a cozy atmosphere and super strong WiFi. If you're looking for a place to work from morning till evening, I highly recommend this place. Parking is available around the shop, along the street. Once you get there, don't forget to try their new coffee flavors; they have a wide variety to choose from, plus many different teas. I've tried so many that I'm wide awake now!
review_5_text: The coffee is excellent, the tea is fragrant and delicious, and the prices are reasonable.

name: 48 City Coffee n Cookie Cup
review_1_text: There are endless coffee shop options in Chiang Mai, so when you come across a place like 48 City Coffee 'n Cookie Cup, it stands out amongst the masses. The owner is filled with passionate and knowledge about coffee and treats every cup with special care.  His wife makes the cookie cup and it is delicious! His mother also makes a young coconut cake that is divine. It is a lovely neighborhood.
review_2_text: Very sweet little coffee shop. Great coffee. You can pick if you want light, medium, or dark roast. It’s made perfectly. The cookie cups are homemade by the barista’s wife! It was delicious.
review_3_text: Hidden Gem in the area!! Have been around this area for a while but never stop by this little cafe. However, his coffee is very good esp. latte Cookie Cup☕️🍪. Lov it and will come back for more menu. A bit hot to sit in the afternoon though. Suggest for morning time or take out.
review_4_text: My first visit but it certainly won’t be my last. I tried a latté (which was delicious) and had it served in their homemade edible cup. So it’s a coffee and a cookie in one. Fantastic! I highly recommend to try it. Eco friendly idea.
review_5_text:
Nice Thai tea sweet and smooth.
Flourless chocolate cake and hot cocoa is a good combination.
The coffee here is very good and the barista knows about coffee and he can answer most of the questions about the coffee.
I already tried every menu and I really like it.
I hope you all like this place.
PS. He's not good with english but don't worry he still can talk with english.

name: Saanit Café By SL Tennis Court
review_1_text:
So glad I stopped by this cafe. From the moment you enter you can tell it's going to be a good experience.
Cozy, colorful atmosphere with discuss seating and tasteful art.
The drink combinations make you curious to try, and didn't disappoint.
The chicken wings were crispy to perfection, and the gloves for the wings were a considerate touch. Didn't get to taste the ice cream but the customer sample was a treat, thanks! 10/10 recommend
review_2_text:
A Place with a very cozy atmosphere, we loved it 😍 the food was really really good, we can recommend the chicken wings 😋
When we arrived, the Café was about to close, but they extended the opening time just for us. We are so grateful for this kind service!
review_3_text: Beautiful place with beautiful and warm people:)
review_4_text: The coffee is excellent, and the food is incredibly delicious, especially the minced pork basil stir-fry – it's absolutely perfect! The service is great. I was very impressed with my first visit and will be coming back often.
review_5_text: The coffee is excellent. The fried chicken is very delicious. I highly recommend it. The ice cream is very delicious. The shop is beautiful and well decorated. The atmosphere is cool and comfortable.

name: Stay
review_1_text:
Air conditioner + amazing coffee 👌🏻👌🏻
The coffee was amazing but I also recommend the milk tea!! Great local flavour! The place is clean and has air conditioner and the prices are good. Give it a try!
review_2_text: I stopped by here because it was so hot while I was walking around. The latte and cappuccino were both rich and delicious. Everyone here is friendly and the coffee is delicious~~
review_3_text: I happened to stop by. A rich and delicious latte~~~!! Highly recommended :)

name: เอ็นช็อปสันติธรรม(NShop IT) จำนำโน๊ตบุ๊คมือถือเชียงใหม่ ขาย,ฝาก,ซ่อม
review_1_text: Good service thank you 🙏
review_2_text:
Great store!
Excellent service.
They are very professional and reliable. I recommend them for cameras, laptops, smartphones, and even GoPros. Used items.
Thank you for repairing my beloved camera!
review_3_text: The service is very good. I will recommend my friends to come and support me. 🫶🏻🫶🏻
review_4_text: Buy-Sell Service

name: Mon Cafe
review_1_text: Local cafe with a few chairs. I picked up thai tea and it was good and cheaper than many other places.
review_2_text:
Good Thai milk tea.
Can ask for sugar adjustment.
review_3_text: I love the ice latte here, best I've had in forever! Made with real espresso and not the powdered coffee, to the price of 35thb. The girl who runs this place is a sweetheart too and will greet you with a big smile.
review_4_text: Mon is a cheerful and nice girl. She speak  english too. Ordered a coffee and it taste similar to Singapore standard. The shop is located at the side of the road and it is beside a restaurant.
review_5_text: Friendly service. Very good rich dark Americano more like a double espresso for only 30 baht. This place according to the girl that served me is called Mon Cafe not Coffee Love.

name: KRISP Café
review_1_text: A very cool and incredibly creative place combined with an art gallery. Two floors with plenty of cozy, beautiful spots for working and getting inspired. An interesting space with seating both indoors and outdoors. The coffee is good, and the overall atmosphere makes you want to stay longer. Highly recommended!
review_2_text:
Such a beautiful café with a unique vibe, it feels like a contemporary art museum.
Outside, there’s a pool designed for sitting and working, which makes the space really special. Inside, you’ll find paintings and sculptures everywhere, adding so much character to the place.

The atmosphere is calm and relaxing, perfect if you’re looking for a quiet spot to work on your projects. We ordered a mocha and a matcha chocolate, and both were absolutely delicious.

A lovely place to slow down, get inspired, and stay longer than planned. ☕✨❤
review_3_text: Lovely place for breakfast. I highly recommend the almond croissant which tasted delicious. There’s plenty of comfortable seating indoors and outdoors to enjoy your pastries and coffee. I would come back if I return to Chiang Mai!
review_4_text: A beautiful spot that feels like a little escape from the city chaos. Tasty desserts, good drinks, friendly staff, plenty of seating, and charming decor.
review_5_text: Nice, cozy place with inside and outside sitting. Had coffee and pastries here, both were very good. Baristas were lovely and spoke English :)

name: Saruda Finest Pastry Espace
review_1_text:
I expected a bit more from this café. The atmosphere is very pleasant, and the interior design is really nice and thoughtfully done. The pastries are great and well presented.

There is an art gallery on the second floor, which is a nice concept, but unfortunately the space feels quite cluttered and messy, with boxes and items stored around. This sense of disorder is noticeable in other parts of the café as well. If the gallery and surrounding areas were organized and cleaned up, this could become a really great place.

I didn’t quite enjoy the coffee, but that’s a matter of personal taste. Overall, the café has good potential.
review_2_text:
Tried the lemon cake.
It’s quite refreshing. With layers of lemon jelly and the cream is not too heavy.
Very nice outlook and the taste is there too.
Love the environment and there’s steps at the outside of the stall for sun walking.
Friendly staff and very chill environment
review_3_text: Very delicious cakes. Not too sweet and very well balanced. Each cake looks creative and beautiful. I really enjoyed it.
review_4_text: There is another location in Nimman, but this location is larger and nicer and this location has a large car parking. I feel Saruda has the best cakes in Chiang Mai. They don’t just look nice and different, but they actually taste great and sophisticated. What I can tell you is their cakes are not average cakes. The prices are higher than most of the cakes in town, but they are well worth it.
review_5_text:
Beautifully crafted and elegant cakes with delicious flavors. The price is on the higher side, but the quality makes it worth it. There’s also another branch in the Nimman area.

Dec 17, 2024

name: dot.coffee
review_1_text: The atmosphere is relaxing, perfect for studying, just enjoying some quiet time. Coffee tastes amazing rich flavor 👍👍the staff are super friendly and polite. I also loved the little details clean tables& nice background music. Definitely one of my new favorite spots. Highly recommend! 🌿✨
review_2_text: I love this coffee shop! The coconut coffee latte is the best I've had. The shop is small but the interior is very tastefull and well picked. You can tell the owner has a an eye for the beautiful. The music is also chill to work to and not your regular radio pop (except during Christmas to be fair). The owner might seem short of polite phrases but is actually very nice. One time I lost my wallet and didn't know where I left it and he not only checked the shop but also checked the cctv for me. Also very reasonable priced, just an overall 10/10 for me.
review_3_text:
"Thank you very much indeed! As a coffee shop owner, I prefer good coffee, but the barista makes high-quality coffee and creates a great environment in the room.
Please allow the owner to take a photo with the Library Teacher and English book on the bookshelf.

Additionally, my favorite drink is Matcha Milk Coconut—it’s even more delicious!

Thank you so much, na krab.
From Kru Watthanakorn Kanthakaew 😊🙏🏻
I purchased a drinking third time! 😁
review_4_text: Cosy and peaceful tucked in place, great staff and of course great coffee 🙏🏽🤩
review_5_text: I saw in Google that was opened, but when I arrived to the Dot.coffe was closed.

name: OB:B.b Cafe & Laundry
review_1_text: Nice cafe with nice well organized AC space. Their coffee is ok, and the croffles are great. The seats are limited especially good ones inside. There are some tables and seats outside as well.
review_2_text:
Very good place, reasonable prices, friendly staff. Comfy and cozy, very good to work.

Wifi may let you down when the place is crowded.

I read some complaints about beeing a loud place.. when I got there, there were about 15 Chinese in some kind of meeting but they weren't doing any loud noises at all. After I inserted my earplugs I didn't hear anything

RECOMMEND: Club Sandwich and Blueberry Cheesecake

[Dont forget to support local guides by liking the review]
review_3_text: Minimal café near ChiangMai Rajabhat University very clean and comfortable,the owner very friendly and helpful.I like Coffee and Lemon honey soda.
review_4_text:
Surprisingly super delicious food! Ordered the fish and chips which wasn’t traditional fish and chips (it’s Thailand, duh) but it was very good. Carrot cake and juice was nice too! Good atmosphere and wifi worked fine for me.

Add: We’ve been to this place several times now and still speak highly about it.
review_5_text: Great sandwiches, they come with a simple salad and some even come with chips. Wifi is good, but best bit is finally a cafe that serves a range of coffees (frappes/lattes) as well as having a little cake cabinet! Hard to find a place in Chiang Mai that does all of the above.

name: พอดีคาเฟ่ & บิสโทร Por Dee Cafe & Bistro
review_1_text: Very cute cafe and bistro. Very quiet and peaceful place. You can definitely enjoy the atmosphere and your coffee. The aunties were very friendly and charming. Coffee was so good. The cheese and spinach toast I ordered was cute and delicious. They only take cash. I'd definitely visit this place again. Great place to chill and relax. This place was very close to my airbnb and recommended by my host. I highly commend ☺️❤️
review_2_text:
A warm welcome awaits you by Sai and her team.
Beautiful fresh coffee and flavour filled food served with hospitality in a  magestically beautiful and peaceful oasis to relax in.
review_3_text: Such a nice relaxing cafe with a very nice well maintained garden. I came to have lunch and it was not really a good decision as their pasta and food were not as good as many other local restaurants around. However, the space is very nice so I don’t regret coming here anyways. Getting some drinks would be good here.
review_4_text: Great comfortable place to get some work done and drink great coffee.  There’s a nice padded leather bench seat that extends one length of the place that’s really nice to sit on.  The tables are beautifully crafted and so solid they don’t rock around when your leaning on them.  There’s some futon style seating and an outdoor area but the air conditioned interior is fantastic.  A hot latte will cost you 55 baht, they have WiFi and it’s quite fast. #BeatTheGrind
review_5_text:
Lovely little café! Good coffee, a variety of beverages, tasty pasta dishes, easy yummy appetizers, and delicious North-Eastern food too.

Love the amosphere, simple and relaxing decor, indoor and outdoor seats available, and some proper parking spots available too.

Our visit was on a Sunday of a long weekend, so the café wasn't crowded, but I imagine it could get quite busy during the week.

Definitely another great dining option for this area.

name: Early Owls
review_1_text:
This was the first cafe we visited in Chiang Mai. It’s a beautiful and peaceful place, and we liked the concept of choosing your own place to sit down outside in the garden. The yoghurt bowl and the breakfast wrap were really good, as well as the fresh juices.
Only small downside was, as more guests arrived, the restrooms got messier, but that unfortunately is mostly on the guests, so not really a critique to the cafe.
review_2_text: I really enjoyed the food here and meals were under 200 baht each from what I saw. I enjoyed my coffee. The atmosphere is nice. Only have lower stars on service as it is pretty much self service goto the counter order and pay. But the staff standing outside were helpful if you asked questions. Nice quiet cafe area to relax in.
review_3_text:
Latte 80 ฿ (2025)

Has english menu.

Very nice environment and they offer tiny camping chairs and tables that you could take and bring it to anywhere you like to sit.

Setup your own camp, and be happy with the greenary environment here.

The trees are tall and there are some noisy squirrels here, maybe their mating season. One of them is an albino. (I think with its pale complexion)

The coffee was okay, i appreciate the latte art, and really i am here to drink the view in with me.

Nice toilet and clean too.
review_4_text: Good drinks! Helpful staff and the garden was clean and tidy. So nice to sit, relax and have a nice drink. Good place to escape the busy city for a little bit. There was no small table available for us but we preferred the mat anyways for that picnic vibe so it was fine!
review_5_text: Early Owls is a space that has a yoga studio (for indoor practice) and a cafe. There’s also tons of green space to do yoga outdoors. For yoga, you have to pay in advance (250 Baht per person for each class) and you can only book 4-5 days beforehand. The classes are taught in Thai with some English phrases to supplement. Lovely space but didn’t try the food or drinks, and I would say the yoga experience is 4/5.

name: วิฬาร์คาเฟ่น้องแมวเชียงใหม่
review_1_text:
Early Owl Cafe is so popular and crowded that we decided to explore a new spot to relax.

Luckily, we discovered this charming cat cafe filled with adorable cats and offered at an affordable price.

The atmosphere is laid-back and surprisingly clean, especially considering the number of cats in the room. The cats are well cared for and look healthy.

A perfect recommendation for cat lovers.

For those not overly captivated by cats, there’s an outdoor 🌳 area without cats😽😼 and no minimal spending.
review_2_text:
First of all, Thais can get into the cafe just order a drink and enjoy your cat vibes there. However, foreigners have to pay 100 baht minimum for the entry even though you get a drink as well.
I don't understand why they have 2 prices for the entry, what's the matter?
The cats were so cute and very chubby though.
review_3_text: It's very make your happy if you come here you will love because cats have so cute 🥰🥰If you don't want to play cat games, there are board games and drinks available.
review_4_text:
I'd describe this place as quaint, peaceful, and homey. You'd expect that the place would be dirty because of the aesthetic but everything was clean and smelt good.

The music played in the cafe added to the peaceful vibe of the place, and the service was fast and the staff were really helpful. The drinks they had was cheap too, and were quite good.

If you're in the area, this place is a must-visit for cat lovers.
review_5_text: Found this place coincidentally and was a true gem. The place has a good drinks menu and cute cats. All cats look quite comfortable with people and it shows how well these cats are living in this place. There r also board games, so u can kill ur time if u get bored. But u won't be, because of these cute cats! Such a healing place for me 🥹

name: saMOODI smoothie bar
review_1_text: very worth 99.- baht with the given portion. I tried the pineapple and Banoffee smoothie. Totally recommend for people who loves fresh smoothie and want a healthy and delicious drinks or even breakfast!
review_2_text:
Walked into the bar and decided to give it a shot. Honestly, my expectations were low—mainly because I saw the owner handing out free coupons to all the pretty girls. Sadly, I wasn’t one of them. :(

I ordered some ‘Mango Booboo Juice of Panda’ (don’t ask, I panicked). The drink came out surprisingly fast. Just as I was sipping, the owner’s girlfriend stormed in and absolutely flamed him over his ‘coupon tactics.’

10/10 experience. Great drinks, live drama, and a free side of relationship chaos. Gordon Ramsay would be proud.
review_3_text: Taste great! One of the best smootie around Chiangmai. Fresh and delicious.
review_4_text: Has a very creative way to present healthy smoothies💚
review_5_text: Quality ingredients and reasonable price. They’re new in town and I expect their consistency to improve with time.

name: Minimal coffee - Kad Thanin
review_1_text: Minimal is one of the best pick up coffee chains in Chiang Mai. Their cappuccino and latte are especially good. I have been to some of other locations and they have just opened up this one and it is right by a large local market.
review_2_text: One of my favourite coffeeshops in cnx. Very kind staff and great coffee.
review_3_text: Small coffee shop, good coffee with 3 bean options: light, medium and dark roast.
review_4_text: The best coffee for 40b. There is choice of 3 grades of bean roast. Demand Signature, the smoothest one, and you'll be indulged. Though there is no any cakes just coockies
review_5_text: Iced Coffee Latte is the best!!!

name: Café Amazon สาขาม.ราชภัฏเชียงใหม่
review_1_text: Nice weather today.  🍮🍮
review_2_text: The service is very, very slow. It's not that slow, but the staff looks unprepared to manage. Every time I go, it's like this.
review_3_text: I stopped by for a little work, not for a vacation.
review_4_text: The staff is very slow, only taking orders and not processing orders that were already taken... It's a huge waste of time. They haven't even started working in 10 minutes.
review_5_text: The shop is a little hard to find.

name: DamKimMim Coffee (ดำคิมมิมคอฟฟี่)
review_1_text:
The coffee latte was strong and good. The prices are also inexpensive. My iced latte was 45฿. They have several types of roasts to choose from. They also have a selection of teas. The baristas are very friendly.
Note: There's no bathroom available to use.
review_2_text: The shade of the black colour from the cafe’s name exists only in the Lanna language and doesn’t occur in standard Thai. This cafe maintains that truly Northern charm very well. Quiet, relaxed atmosphere.   Inexpensive prices, tasty coffee (at least coffee!), and warm service won’t leave the customers disappointed. The parking though might be the issue.
review_3_text: Cheap coffee, super chill and great service. I recommend the black orange!
review_4_text: My mocha was delicious and the atmosphere and staff were very warm and welcoming
review_5_text: One of not many that makes lime green tea and does it really well. Superb recommend

name: Choy Coffee
review_1_text: Finally I found a morning coffee shop that I can easily take out with reasonable price. Of course it has a good coffee
review_2_text: Where can one find good coffee for a low, low price? Choy Coffee, of course. 30 baht for a latte that cost 40-50 baht elsewhere, Choy Coffee is now firmly on my caffeine hit list. They sell more than coffee. The Kiwi Smoothie is something special and the Peach Soda is also a must try. They are tucked in a corner of Thanin Market where the watch repair men are.
review_3_text: Very nice. Iced capu is only 35baht and taste good. Good quality and cheap.
review_4_text: Visited on 12/24. This take-out coffee shop in Thanin Market seems popular and is always busy. You order at the counter and pay when you receive your order. The iced Americano in Chiang Mai is delicious. They offer medium and dark roasts, so be sure to specify when ordering. In addition to coffee, they also offer smoothies and sodas. Please note that there is no seating available, so if you want to relax, please be aware of this.
review_5_text: This place is so delicious lol. The prices are also really cheap. I come here often. The pink milk is especially delicious. It tastes like super sweet strawberry milk. The owner is also very friendly. Dinner is served until 6:30.

name: STUDY CAFE
review_1_text:
It's the same as the last one!!
It's a good idea, and it's a great deal. It's a wonderful day, and it's a wonderful day! It's a wonderful time.

Cheap drinks and delicious coffee!
There is also a study cafe. Suitable for university students. The staff are friendly and all the drinks are delicious! I recommend the coconut smoothie.😋
review_2_text: Coconut shake, fragrant, refreshing, suitable for hot weather. It has soft coconut meat. with coconut water for a naturally sweet taste Blend until fine. It's very delicious. As for the other drinks, they were just as delicious, so I really liked them.
review_3_text: The coconut smoothie is delicious. I highly recommend it. The avocado one is 35 baht. The other drinks are also delicious. The price is good. The shop has a great atmosphere. I highly recommend this shop. It's very suitable.
review_4_text: The coffee is delicious and the atmosphere is nice :)
review_5_text: Very tasty coffee! Rich flavor, not much ice. 10 baht discount if you take it with you.

name: D O O R COFFEE
review_1_text: The even have Oat (plant-based) milk!!!
review_2_text: Such a lovey Café 🥰
review_3_text: The price is not expensive, a cup of coffee is 45 baht.
review_4_text:
Simple yet extraordinary, this small doorway behind Rajabhat University houses a compact coffee bar, about the size of the door itself, serving both coffee and non-coffee drinks at incredibly affordable prices, starting from just 30 baht. If you're passing by, stop in and grab a takeaway drink!

🍹Iced lime juice with honey 35 baht
review_5_text: G o o d

name: SS coffee
review_1_text: I don't drink coffee, but they have a delicious Thai Tea Frappe. There is a great restaurant near by, so easy to eat and enjoy a drink.
review_2_text: Perhaps, the best coffee (even iced, yes) in Chiang Mai for reasonable price.
review_3_text:
Hello. I'm InRoll, a 100% Korean.

There are so many cafes in Santitham. Some are so famous you can't even find a spot, while others have thousands of stars and incredibly good reviews. However, if you look carefully, you'll find some with few reviews but still great reviews. This is a hidden gem cafe. Located right next to the market, it's not an easy place to find, but if you visit, you'll experience something special.

They serve coffee that's attractive to look at, and I found it to be the strongest and most delicious coffee in Chiang Mai. Of course, don't ask for it to be sweetened. That way, you can enjoy the original flavor. The taste was incredibly rich and nutty. Every time I go to a cafe, the flavor varies depending on the milk they use, but this one was just right. The rich, nutty flavor was so good that I couldn't help but say it was delicious.

If you're visiting this market or planning to, I highly recommend stopping by. They usually don't have seating, so you can get takeout. Thank you.
review_4_text:
After work, I had some time to wander around Chiang Mai. I wandered around from Chang Phueak Bus Terminal to Thanin Market, where I stopped for a coffee. Walking through the market, I found SS Coffee, a small, uncrowded coffee shop with a friendly atmosphere and excellent prices. Coffee starts at just 45 baht! It's a rare price. Try ordering a medium-roast iced Americano and you'll see that even for just ten baht, you can find quality and flavor. It's not just about the intensity, but also the aroma of the coffee beans.
The owner also acts as a guide, offering recommendations for places to visit in Chiang Mai. Chatting with him was fun, like hanging out at a friend's house.
For those looking for a good cup of coffee to replenish their caffeine fix during a day of exploring Chiang Mai, this is a must-try.
review_5_text: I'm not a coffee drinker, but of all the ones I've had, this shop is the most delicious. The iced latte has a fragrant aroma of coffee and milk, just the right strength, not bitter, and not too sweet. The iced green tea is also fragrant and rich, not cloyingly sweet, and well-balanced. The iced cocoa has a strong cocoa flavor, not cloyingly sweet. The owner is very polite, and his skills are consistently excellent. The price is not outrageously expensive, and it's worth it for the well-balanced flavor that you can't find in expensive, luxurious shops.

name: KT Tong Muan House cafe`
review_1_text:
Lots of fillings, full of toppings, very delicious, not expensive, crepe buffet is very satisfying.
It looks small in the picture because we folded it incorrectly, haha. Afraid of overflowing, we asked the seller to make it ourselves.
review_2_text: The shop is cute. The crepes are delicious and you get a lot. I'll come back and support you again.
review_3_text: Strong tea, not-too-sweet whipped cream. Good! 👍
review_4_text: The crispy rolled wafers are delicious—small, thin, and wonderfully crunchy. The fresh coffee is strong and satisfying, and the crepes are generous in portion size. Highly recommended!
review_5_text: The whipped cream is so delicious and smooth.

name: สถานีน้ำยาปู กาดคำเที่ยง | Namyapoo Station | ขนมจีน น้ำยาปู น้ำเงี้ยว เขียวหวานไก่ I เมนูครัวร้อนทะเล I กาแฟสด
review_1_text: The taste is good, but the service attitude is not good. The thin woman who took the order had a very bad attitude. Later, a male service was much better. From ordering to paying the bill, the thin woman always had a very bad attitude. If I hadn't made an appointment with a friend to come here, I would definitely change the restaurant and would not come a second time.
review_2_text:
Excellent nam ya pu and nam ngiao! Both among the best that I've had. Environment was v nice, even had live piano. Service was friendly and efficient. Mostly locals here even though it's near the popular jing jai market.

Prices are reasonable. Even with crab was still less than 200baht per person for a nice restaurant. Very happy!
review_3_text: The dish features a rich and creamy crab curry with generous portions of crab meat, making it well worth the price. It is beautifully presented with plenty of fresh vegetables on the side, ensuring a clean and appetizing experience. The appetizers, such as dumplings, and desserts like the traditional Thai ice cream with various toppings, are also delicious and satisfying.
review_4_text:
A good restaurant where the main dishes are based on crab (even if it’s also possible to order chicken or pork).
The food is good and so is the service.
The only minor negative point is that sole dishes on the menu weren’t available. The tea was also too strong for me.
Total bill was 540 thb for 4 people.
review_5_text: Beautiful Thai food, good environment

name: The Baristro at Jingjai Market
review_1_text: This is one of the smallest Baristro locations I have visited, but it keeps all the charm and quality the brand is known for. It is nice to know they still offer the full menu, although the selection of coffee beans is somewhat limited. The drinks, however, remain top-notch, with specialty coffee that is hard to match. The recently remodeled space looks beautiful and welcoming, making it an ideal spot for any coffee lover and anyone who appreciates quality beverage
review_2_text: Loving the vibe here on a lazy Wednesday afternoon. Got the americano beer, not actual beer, just americano topped with cream cheese. Perfect snack/drink. And this chain looks amazing (based on the pics on the menu).
review_3_text:
The hot mocha is nice, got a great latte art on it, no sweet very chocolate and the milk is of good quality! The only downside is they overshadowed the espresso flavour for a bit.

We had the matcha cheese cake too, it’s quite nice, very matcha!

They lean on the pricy side but you also get comfy seating, free WiFi and air conditioner.

The staff are so friendly. You can also purchase drip bags and whole beans here.
review_4_text: We loved our visit to this coffee shop. It is beautiful inside, small but very zen and it has a lovely vibe. They have a lot of matcha drinks, good coffee and icecream. Our drinks were very good, the service was friendly and we will be back here again soon.
review_5_text: I have visited many branches of the Baristro , and this one is near Jing Jai Market, it is very convenient to visit. The space is just right, the coffee is great and the staff are very nice.

name: Buncha's Espresso Bar
review_1_text: Great small cafe with a cool, laid-back atmosphere. The coffee is excellent and the bakery selection is super tasty. Definitely worth a visit if you’re looking for a chill spot to grab a caffeine fix in Chiang Mai!
review_2_text: Excellent coffee. Choice of light roast or dark roast artisanal coffee beans. I had a double cappuccino, which was superb. Located right next to the weekly Jing Jai farmers market.
review_3_text: Very cute little coffee shop with fantastic coffee. There is also some outdoor seating available.
review_4_text:
A great respite from the extremely hot Chiangmai heat in June. We came for coffee after visiting the Jing Jai market right beside.

They have different coffee blends but I personally enjoyed the dark roasted one. Aesthetically pleasing cafe and great coffee. Would highly recommend!
review_5_text:
fb : Travel Cafe Eat Drink - Malaysia & Asia

The surrounding makes this café a great place to enjoy your cup of local grown coffee. My latte cost only THB50 and was strong yet aromatic too.
It's located in Jing Ja-i village and it's a trendy hangout place for youngsters here where lots of boutiques and eateries are here

name: Roastniyom Coffee JJ Market
review_1_text: Nice latte, can taste the coffee aroma just nice. Blueberry lemon yogurt so refreshing and tasty after we had a hot journey outside JJ market 👍
review_2_text: It's okay. The staff struggled with what an Americano was, and the coffee was average. The Red Velvet was good, but it's better in GA. I'd come again.
review_3_text: Pin, New and Guy are all amazing ! They get my coffee right every time and are so kind! My favorite baristas
review_4_text:
An incredibly cheerful team and, above all, such a delicious COCO Latte!

I highly recommend it—go without hesitation!
review_5_text: If you’re in jing Jai area definitely stop here ! There’s something for everyone and the customer service is incredible

name: Gramping Camping

Camping theme hangout. With tents.

It offer limited assortment of beers and coffee. It does not offer a full range of drinks.

It food is Thai finger foods and barbeque.  In the winter remember to dress well as the night progress it gets cold.

review_4_text:
Atmosphere: Tent-style camping. Relax and enjoy a cup of coffee. The coffee is excellent. Let's dunk it! It's delicious.
Parking: Available, but not very extensive.
Service: Excellent, with excellent service and advice.
Other conditions: I recommend going on a less sunny or chilly day.
review_5_text:
캠핑 분위기 너무 좋아요.

name: ONE AND ONLY : MATCHA (หนึ่งเดียวมัทฉะ)
review_1_text: I ordered via Grab, and it was packaged very well. Large ice cubes were included, and the green tea and milk were separated. I appreciated that they were open late, as I needed it for the morning, and other green tea shops were closed.

name: Panmai Coffee
review_1_text: It a lovely cafe located at the Kham Tien garden market.  We came early in the morning, very relaxing and fresh.
review_2_text: Absolutely amazing gem hidden in the plant market in Chiang Mai! This place has everything you could want, magical nature filled atmosphere, amazing food (both thai and western options - we had the chicken fried rice and Pasta Carbonara), and prompt, kind service.
review_3_text: I came across this restaurant by chance at the plant market. I ordered pork fried rice as a simple meal, but what I got was very fast. The staff was very service-minded. I was sitting working. The staff intentionally placed a plate of rice for me quietly, not daring to disturb me. The fried rice was like purple crab rice. The taste was very delicious. It was the best fried rice I had eaten in a year. I was very surprised that I didn't come to buy plants very often, but I just found this restaurant. I recommend you to come and eat. The price is not expensive, the atmosphere is very good.
review_4_text: Nice area to take a break from shopping at endless amount of plant shops.  Atmosphere is beautiful with all the trees and plants.  Coconut pie has by far been the best (out of about 4) that I have tried in Thailand. Coconut smoothie was not sweet at all but just got them to add more sugar syrup (or whatever) to make it better. Host was friendly and welcoming.
review_5_text: Perfect place to go before exploring the plant market. Large drink and good menu with both Thai and western dishes. They also have a line of craft sodas with fun flavors 🪴 🥤

name: Curry Puff Coffee, Lotus Kham Thiang
review_1_text:
Well managed shop.  These guys take customer service seriously.  Tables are frequently tidied and clean.

Excellent coffee, beautifully  presented in a real cup & saucer.

Iced latte can be made with dark roast for a full rich flavor.

Chicken curry puff has crisp flakey pastry and a flavorful filling.
review_2_text: Although this shop in a shopping center I was very impressed with the taste and quality of the coffee and the special gem for me was the chicken curry puff for only 10 baht! Wow I was so  impressed, I was hungry and thought a little snack would hold me over and I ended up eating two. Its worth a stop if you need a coffee fix or a light snack. Sorry for the partially eaten Puff!
review_3_text:
An the entranxe of the Lotus Mall
Staff ultra friendly and very nice products and choice. ( coffee, Tea and Smoothies )
Quality / Price unbeatable
review_4_text: Nice coffee shop inside tesco lotus kamthieng. Can choose between medium or dark roasted beans for the espresso based drinks. Curry pufs are nice.
review_5_text: Enjoy a great cup of coffee or an iced coffee. They offer a nice variety.  Loved my iced Mocha. Presentation, vibe and service was awesome. Thank You!

name: Choojai Coffee
review_1_text:
The coffee man who grew, roast, grind and make his own pour over coffee in a bustling weekend market! It’s as much as an experience as it is good coffee. You get a choice of light or medium roast and my favourite was definitely the light. You can sit for as long as you like, and get as many cups as you like - it’s a pay as you wish place. Also sells bags of his own beans and ground coffee as well. A lot of people are frightened to approach or sit down as there are no clear signs but take the leap of faith and good coffee will follow (no sugar or milk, just pour over). He speaks decent English but coffee is a universal language.

He is only here on weekends! Saw his stand on a Saturday but not in the exact location marked on google maps. Take your time in finding this place - it’s worth it!
review_2_text: We saw this coffee on a travel YouTube video and so glad we went to visit. The drip coffee is delicious. There is no set price, you pay by donation. There is a lady there that can draw you on a coffee cup for a donation as well. Great atmosphere and service, definitely recommend checking them out. We went on Saturday and they weren't there and came back to find them on Sunday so might be a Sunday only thing.
review_3_text:
Nice Drip Coffee street stall with interesting pricing: Pay as you like :)

Every cup has a unique drawing too! and you can ask for different levels of roasting. Must stop by if you’re in Jing Jia Market
review_4_text: Just a guy making pour over. Has light and medium roast. No sugar or milk. He is selling beans on the side and makes them himself. It is free. He is here to make friends and spread love. You can pay but it is up to you and what you can afford. Super nice and creates a wonderful community of people. It is great to listen to the conversations and he truly cares about you and your experience at his little shop. A wonder man.
review_5_text: Good coffee with a relaxing environment. I love the light roast coffee there. Fruity aftertaste note with medium body. Recommended if you are visiting to JingJai Market. (JJ Market)

name: 삿갓 아저씨 드립 커피
review_1_text: It was early in the morning, and there were no customers. The assistant was on her phone, so the man with the hat made the coffee and didn't serve it right away. The coffee served in a thin paper cup was passed over with a "no-look" gesture, so I almost spilled it. It was self-priced, so I paid about the same price as a nearby trailer coffee, but the beans were bland and the service was terrible. I didn't even waste 10 baht.
review_2_text:
It was something new.
The man in the hat would make drip coffee on the spot, and he said you could put in as much money as you wanted.
It's hard to describe, but it had a strong coffee aroma and flavor.
review_3_text: Pour drip coffee into a hand-painted cup. It's a refreshingly acidic coffee. There's no separate price; just add it to your cart.

name: Cafe'me
review_1_text: Kind host, delicious coffee, cute second floor, neighborhood view from the second floor.

review_1_text: Nice drinks
review_2_text: Damn good pour over specialty coffee!!!!
review_3_text: This is one of the first camping-themed coffee shops, and the decor is incredibly atmospheric. Being an outdoor cafe, it might be a bit hot, but it's a must-visit for photography enthusiasts!
review_4_text: I came on 19/10/63 at 10.25. It was a ridge with good weather, 23 degrees, comfortable and cool. The overall atmosphere was like camping. I would recommend installing a partition to prevent cars from being seen, that would be awesome. You can park your car at the Jing Jai Market project without a fee. The bathroom is also in the Jing Jai project. Most of the coffee here is drip coffee, both hot and cold, starting at 60 baht. An interesting item is the cold drip coffee mixed with fresh sugar. The coffee has fresh sugar cane pulp, which is fragrant and delicious. The shop uses bagasse straws, which are biodegradable, which is quite good. Other menus currently include toast and fried eggs. The shop just opened not long ago. The name of the shop is "Kin Phee Suea Korng". Another dessert I would like to recommend is Nazo, a Mexican dessert made from pumpkin. It looks like Thai fried dumplings, but the dumpling skin is harder. It's a pleasure to eat with coffee.
review_5_text: A cup of coffee, a ray of morning light, a small gathering with a few friends at a campsite—pretending to be camping in the heart of the city, earnestly enjoying the tranquil moments. In Chiang Mai, this is life.

name: hahm.coffeebar

Small coffee shop with nice and warmly decoration in Fah Hahm area front of Charoen Rat Rd.

Did not expect much but it surprisingly GOOD coffee. Delicious coffee, fast, and cheap price.
Americano 55THB

Open early from 7AM. Can be your daily dose on your way to work.
review_2_text: Cute aesthetic coffee shop across the famous curry spot. Such a great spot to cool off and enjoy your drinks. Recommend the “Here comes the sun”. It was refreshing and light - Nothing I’ve ever had! I also got the matcha Latte with oat milk. You can tell it’s high quality matcha and the oat milk was so creamy. The employee Fon who made our drinks was so sweet.
review_3_text:
Had an excellent caramel macchiato here!!!Just the way I like it

Very nicely designed cafe and the ambiance is very nice
review_4_text: I was having lunch around this area so I stopped by this little cafe after lunch. I didn’t expect much but OMG they have one of the best Thai milk tea! I would love to go back there for their thai milk tea!
review_5_text: Great coffee! Good job!

Latte will set you back 50 baht and there’s a large bench in the middle you can work from.  I tried a lemon tea which was nice, can’t drink coffee at the moment on account of coming back from India and my stomach is riddled with bacteria 😝. Will be back to try their coffees!! #BeatTheGrind
review_2_text: So cute place!!! Good coffee and signature deserts! So nice atmosphere there!!!!
review_3_text: Nice and quite place. Drinks were great.
review_4_text: Good food Excellent service staff and all decoration all as goods 🍻
review_5_text: Went later in afternoon so not sure about the bakery. Nothing on offer. Decent Latte though and I enjoyed the last century decor and Philadelphia memorabilia.

We enjoyed 😇

The Japanese-style matcha ice cream was surprisingly delicious, and the chocolate in the Banoffee paired perfectly with the cream without being too sweet, making it ideal for those who don't have a sweet tooth but still crave dessert after a meal.
review_2_text:
The Japanese tea room has a lovely ambiance, air conditioning, and is comfortable to sit in.

But given how much effort they put into decorating the space, I'd expect them to at least use real cups for drinks. 😂 The plastic cups clash completely with the overall atmosphere.
review_3_text: Grapefruit soda (two small sips) 105 Thai Baht. You can use this as a reference.

name: AIKORY COFFEE
review_1_text: super worth it! very affordable and tastes good 😊 i got mine with light roast beans for 50 THB and it’s perfect.
review_2_text:
A newly opened shop offering unique flavors, a friendly atmosphere, ample parking, and a wide selection of flower shops, both bouquets and fresh flowers.

This is a coffee shop I recommend to my friends.
review_3_text:
Looking for a delicious, strong-flavored iced tea? Ask for less sugar! This shop is perfect. The owner is very friendly.

P.S. They also have a points system for free drinks!
review_4_text: The coffee tastes good, but the shop is very hot. If they're so serious about keeping the air conditioning on, why did they choose to make the shop out of glass?
review_5_text: Give a million stars
