review_2_text: Good service, great taste.
review_3_text: If you want to know, you have to try.

name: ซาวบาทsคอฟฟี่ (SAAO BAHTs COFFEE)
review_1_text: Good coffee and nice view
review_3_text: What a lovely find. The iced cappuccino was delicious and smooth. I will for sure be back to this lovely coffee shop! The owner was so kind and made me feel welcomed.
review_4_text: Americano (light roast) 20 baht. It's delicious! Just the right amount of ice, and the best part is it's only 20 baht. The owner is very kind. The cocoa is also delicious. They've only been open for less than a week. Go try it!
review_5_text:
The coffee is much cheaper than next door.

They also have coconut ice cream.

I recommend coming here for coffee and ice cream after you finish eating noodles next door.

name: All Red Cafe&Hostel
review_1_text: The surrounding is peaceful. Though the bathroom and toilets are shared, they have a great service maintenance. I would totally recommend it. I stayed here 3 nights and it had no issues at all.  I got the 1 bunk bed and the place was VERY quiet, The front desk ladies were super sweet and helpful and spoke English fairly well. No problems communicating. It is by no means where the action of town is but it is about five minutes away by garb or bolt. You’ll probably want a moto if you are staying here. AC works very well and is placed in a great spot. Issue with charging plug, if you put anything it keeps on falling, especially 3 pin adapter. lots of places to sit and work; downstairs terrace, living room, upstairs room and private terrace all are option. The shared bathroom still feels private, as there's 2 toilets and 2 showers for 2 rooms. Free cold water, hot water and coffe
review_2_text: Highly recommend. I stayed in the dorm room and it was surprisingly quiet, with multiple spots to work if you need to. I actually chose to stay here instead of booking a private room closer to the Old Town because the atmosphere, the owner, and the cleanliness are hard to beat. Grab rides are cheap and easy if you don’t have your own transport. Definitely book ahead if you want a private room because they sell out fast! But honestly, the dorms are great too, and each bed has its own curtain for privacy. Free coffee and water and plenty of spaces to do some work on your laptop.
review_3_text: I stayed here 3 nights . Two nights in a private room with king bed 🛌, clean , big , but a little bit noise because near the main of  street . One night in a bunk beds with less privacy but less noise because a room without windows . I really recommend this place especially for the atmosphere and the warm and empathy of the owner. Thanks for everything 🌿
review_4_text: It is very close to central mall and they speak english so well. The surrounding is so peaceful too. Though the bathroom and toilets are shared, they have a great service maintenance. I would totally recommend it. I stayed here 2 nights and it had no issues at all.
review_5_text: This was def a five star experience, cannot beat the price! Close to sunshine massage school. I got the 2 bunk room and the place was VERY quiet, thank god! Not social, but I was in class all day making friends with my classmates and seeing the night market so not a problem at all. The front desk ladies were super sweet and helpful and spoke English between fairly and well. No problems communicating. It is by no means where the action of town is but it is about five minutes away by moto. You’ll probably want a moto if you are staying here. Just wish they had soy milk at the cafe :) AC works very well and is placed in a great spot.

name: Café Amazon - ปตท.ฟ้าฮ่าม
review_1_text:
This Cafe Amazon is probably my fav because of the comfy indoor/outdoor seating options & waterfall feature 😍
Quiet setting. So peaceful sitting outside under the covered deck, listening to the sound of running water with beautiful koi fish swimming about. Outdoor outlets make it perfect for working online & being able to enjoy the coffee shop life 🫶🏽
review_2_text: This branch of Cafe Amazon is located in the PTT Fa Ham station. There is a spacious and shady garden area where when you buy a coffee you can sit at a table in the garden. The staff are good and they inform me of various promotions too. I am very impressed with the discount from using the service.
review_3_text: Nice atmosphere, good place to stop and grab some coffee
review_4_text: Calm and cool to RELAX and CHILL besides the HIGHWAY. 😁
review_5_text: Nice atmosphere. Friendly customer service. Good coffee.

name: Morrow coff.
review_1_text:
A tiny homey coffee shop hidden in small alley. Cute decorations with warm welcoming vibe here ready to serve good coffee.☕️

Reasonable price and friendly staff. They also  offer soft cookies and sweet bites🍪🍩
review_2_text: "Morrow Coff. is a hidden gem! The coffee is rich and flavorful, the atmosphere is cozy and welcoming, and the prices are surprisingly affordable. The staff truly love what they do — their service comes with genuine warmth and a smile. Highly recommended!"
review_3_text: Amazinggg mixed berry smoothie. So cute and cozy inside. Perfect place to relax and read
review_4_text: Love this place! Fair prices, quick and friendly service. Small space inside but never super busy so you can sit if you want. Very nice modern decor
review_5_text: A small, quiet cafe perfect for chilling out. Great atmosphere, beautiful lighting for photos. Their new Thai tea cream cheese is incredibly delicious – rich, creamy, and perfectly sweet. Their matcha green tea is also gorgeous. The desserts are tasty, the staff are friendly and provide excellent service 👍🏻👍🏻. Prices are reasonable, you'll get change back from a 100 baht note. Plenty of parking. This is my nth visit.

name: WARI ワーリ coffee
review_1_text: Best price to quality ratio. 🙌 Choose between dark, medium and light roast with no extra cost.
review_2_text:
Delicious coffee.

Highly recommended by

IG tomtompanda_traveler
FB tomtompanda traveler
review_3_text: This cafe' got order from walk in and from online platform. They have variaty of coffee bean that you can choose. Unfortunately that I knew it later after the barista had already made my coffee. The normal bean if you did indicate, it will be dark roasted. It is quite bitter than I can accept.
review_4_text: The best coffee we’ve had in Thailand and we’ve had it every day! Really good prices as well. They have lots of different options of beans including from different locations across Thailand. Well worth the trip.
review_5_text: Good taste, have choices of coffee bean, rec. to take away or delivery.

name: 6 Signature tea & coffee
review_1_text: This cafe is super cute and cozy, with a lovely style. The photos turn out so beautiful I have to come back again! ✨ The iced tea is delicious, and the matcha is incredibly fragrant.
review_2_text:
Newly opened shop located beneath All Red Hostel.
Rich cocoa, a must-try for cocoa lovers.
The tea is also fragrant, both Thai tea and green tea.
The owner is handsome and provides excellent service. You definitely won't feel lonely here.
review_3_text: Thai tea has the best and strongest flavor 👍🏻
review_4_text: For tea and coffee lovers, I highly recommend this 👍

name: MAKE KAFE' เมคคาเฟ่
review_1_text: Delicious food, clean environment, good service, and affordable prices.
review_2_text: Good service, good taste, reasonable price, convenient
review_3_text: Recommend a place to sit and work, chill out.

name: โมชิคอฟฟี่บาร์
review_1_text: Great quality coffee with reasonable price! Vegan option is also available with non-dairy milk and vegan whipcream. Menu are various
review_2_text: Okay, considering the price.
review_3_text: mellow

name: ร้านพระจันทร์กาแฟ
review_1_text: Awesome fried bananas!
review_2_text: It's a coffee cart. They have both cup and bag coffees. They have a wide variety of menus, including soda, tea, and coffee. They serve a fairly large amount. You can order from the vendors at the front of the shop. In the same shop, they also sell fried bananas and fried potatoes, starting at 20 baht. If you go to the shop, it's only for take-away; there's no seating inside.

name: First image studio
review_1_text: Staying home alone

name: คาเฟ่ ชากัญ ตัวแทนจำหน่ายภาคเหนือ
review_1_text: The first glass was addictive. The next glass made me feel good. Haha.

name: The Arrow Rest
review_1_text:
Absolutely loved it here the staff are amazing. I’ve never done archery before in my life and They taught me everything about archery and I ended up doing so well!! Loved it so much, but I went the day before I left and I wished I’d tried it at the beginning so I could go a few times during my stay.
They have a lovely cafe there too so I could chill out before my lesson!
Highly recommend them if you want to learn and practice there! ❤️❤️
review_2_text: Just moved to Chang mai and feel very lucky to have stumbled across this place. From the uk and used to do archery, it’s been great to get back into it again. Such a lovely place, great vibes, lovely drinks and the staff are amazing, super helpful and kind. Will definitely be going back. Definitely give this place a visit.
review_3_text:
An amazing place for first time archery lessons. Small and intimate, the instructors are kind and professional and will guide you through it. It’s cheaper if you book in advance so they know you’re coming and have time for you - just send them a message via Facebook messenger. We booked it only an hour in advance.
Highly recommended!!!
review_4_text: Tried a 1-hour outdoor archery shooting class at The Arrow Rest and had a great experience. The staff were friendly, patient, and very helpful for beginners. Location is convenient and the session was well organized. Definitely worth trying if you’re curious about archery.
review_5_text: It’s really fun and the instructor is very helpful at getting you started fast and enjoy archery even if it’s your first time!

name: A-mai Homemade Bakery & Cafe
review_1_text:
Very chill and calm atmosphere, a lot of light, beautiful interior and exterior zones. In general, it’s a nice place to sit and work, not many customers, pretty good coffee and unordinary desserts.
Just be aware they have a rule 1 order per person, so you are obliged to order at least a drink for each person you came along with
review_2_text: We had such good experience at A-Mai, we came more than once during our stay in Chiang Mei! Delicious coffees and desserts, in a quiet area to focus and get some work done. Owners are so sweet and kind. Thank you, A-Mai!
review_3_text:
This cafe has a great atmosphere. The coffee is delicious and tastes amazing. They offer free Wi-Fi, which is incredibly fast — I tested Download 443 Mpbs/ Upload 553, so working is super smooth.
The staff are friendly and helpful. Its a perfect spot to work or chill.
review_4_text: Such a cute place with a cozy Christmas atmosphere❤️ I love their desserts, they’re masterpieces beautiful and delicious!
review_5_text: Very lovely, looks like it is intended someone's house but dont be put off - it is a beautiful cafe with lovely service, coffee and thai tea or sweets

name: Starbucks
review_1_text: Good ambiance and great customer service.
review_2_text:
1.) It is the good location on the first floor near the fountain which in front of the mall.
2.) The area for sit it’s a lot of chairs and tables.
3.) The staffs are active to service you but slow to clean the tables.
**On the weekend is crowded here it’s not a good choice to come here.
*** MY PROBLEM is a lot of MOSQUITOES fly around I have a mosquito spray they still bit me. I think they should fix this problem it’s quite dangerous for humans.
review_3_text: The food tastes great, and the service is nice too.
review_4_text: I paid triple the amount for a latte that came tasting of warm milk. I had to request another shot of coffee to flavour the milk. I get a better coffee from any street cart for 45baht. Extremely dissatisfied
review_5_text: My chill spot after walking around Central Mall. I visit this location at least 4 times a week and the staff is friendly. The place is always clean. I see many tourists pop in and out while I dine here.

name: Café Amazon
review_1_text: As someone who drinks his coffee black, this was easily the best place to get coffee in the mall. The medium roast is bold and smooth, similar to a dark roast elsewhere, but without the burnt taste.
review_2_text: I usually sit in the evening. Honey Lite is my favorite.
review_3_text: Why does the small hot black coffee cost ฿ 65 ？But here it say‘s ฿40 on the menu.No good coffee here but some place to sit.
review_4_text: One of Amazon Cafe friendchise located in Central Festival Chiang Mai. Their Thai tea taste normal. The price of the Amazon Cafe is quite cheap compared to other coffee shop in the same area. There are plenty of seat available. The outdoor area is a good place to sit but after 15.30 pm sunlight will reach some of the outdoor area.
review_5_text: 10 minutes until closing their clothes cannot serve me green tea with milk. They tell me to go away even though I'm in the shop in the shoppers door is unlocked bad form

name: Oxygen Coffee Studio
review_1_text: Great coffee, friendly staff, fair price, right beside 7/11 for snacks.
review_2_text: Nice little coffee stand outside 7/11. Good coffee at the right price
review_3_text:
It's a tiny kiosk that makes coffee.
Prices are reasonable.
Coffee is OK.
Staff are friendly and polite.
It's very close to D Condo apartments.

It has temperature check and hand sanitizer.
Kiosk has window where you place order and pick up coffee.

It is situated outside 7/11.
review_4_text: The coffe taste delishes :)
review_5_text: Good coffee with affordable price & good vibes.

name: Memorize Brownie สาขาเซ็นทรัล เฟสติวัล เชียงใหม่ คาเฟ่ขนมหวาน บราวนี่ เค้ก และ กาแฟ ชาไทย ชาเขียว
review_1_text:
Definitely one of the best brownies every had.
It’s moisture and dark.
Not too sweet. The frappe is great too.
review_2_text: We had the brownie shot. There are 10 so good enough to share. The brownie was moist and the cream was light. Really enjoyed it.
review_3_text: Legit good brownie shake. Even with no sugar it's sweet. Tastes  good with the brownie chips sprinkled on top
review_4_text: Best brownie in Chiang Mai 😋
review_5_text: Memorize brownie was delicious, coffee was not good one.

name: Cha Tra Mue
review_1_text:
Thai tea (30% sweet) 45 ฿ (2025)

Give me Cha Tra Mue anytime I will be happy.

Even though it has an extensive menu, but I simply couldn’t resist to order Thai Tea, because it is that good.

I could smell the tea fragrance from afar before reaching the stall.

It is a wonderful treat for me in Thailand.

Yummy, kop khun krap!
review_2_text: Gotta try Thai teas from the famous Cha Tra Mue brand while in Thailand. Having a view of a Thomas train riding around inside mall while enjoying the drinks is also a bonus.
review_3_text:
Came by for a hot drink as I was getting sick from the heat - and thought the honey lemon drink would be a good ail to my condition.

The drink came a little too sweet though, I was half hoping it’s due to the honey and not cos of added sugar..

In any case, it’s still a great place to catch a cup of tea or our favourite cocoa 👍🏻
review_4_text: A tea store stand selling packed original product from Cha Tra Mue Tea and Coffee as well as prepared coffee and tea drinks. The staff is friendly, the prices are great and they have sitting area.
review_5_text: Good drink. I ordered Thai tea

name: minimal coffee central festival
review_1_text: Tiny cups and they don’t even fill it up. not good tasting. Way too sweet and overpriced for what they serve. All 3 ladies working looked unfriendly and really gives no reason to visit this place. There are better spots a floor away
review_2_text:
First off coconut iced coffee + dirty coffee ☕ 5* fantastic. However there is very limited seating. I went to a seat where there were 4 chairs with 1 person and the customer didn't allow me sit as she had a bunch of papers and laptop 💻 was probably using it as a workspace. All the other seats also has 1-2 people occupying 4 seats and seemed like they were working.

Tip: find a seat first before ordering.
review_3_text: The coffee was way too sour, and I didn’t feel welcomed at all. The place also had kind of a cheap vibe.
review_4_text: I got the orange presso which was a delicious afternoon pick me up. 60 baht which i thought was very fair. Got it lightly sweetened which was perfect!
review_5_text: Reasonable and wonderful coffee. 55b for one hot coffee. Must try.

name: Doppio
review_1_text: Amazing coffee beverages and friendly staff! I had the Black Yellow (pineapple) and Orange Espresso. Really good stuff!
review_2_text: 3 bartistas working today. 3 professionals all very attentive to my requests.  I was provided 3 different roasts to choose from.  The coffee taste very good and the equipment is all professional quality.   It is located inside the shopping mall 3 rd floor 100 meters From the banks. Coffee is not cheap here ! I wish they had more food options.
review_3_text: The americano tastes like sour milk. Order a mix drink to mask the overpriced dirt you're drinking. Stupidly went here multiple times hoping for a different outcome. Stick to Roastinyom, Amazon, or Starbucks.
review_4_text: This is a coffee shop located in the Central Festival. The price of coffee is a little expensive, but the coffee tastes very good and the staff is kind. The chair is very uncomfortable.
review_5_text:
3rd floor coffee kiosk.  Flavorful well made coffee drinks.  Innovative combinations.

Try the 'Dirty Thai Tea,'.  An expresso shot in cold Thai tea.

name: Baan Sabun-nga บ้านสะบันงา
review_1_text:
Absolutely lovely cafe and owner! It’s a cosy place with nice undercover outdoor cafe tables and chairs under a traditional Thai 2-roomed BnB.

The coffee was delicious, atmosphere was peaceful for me to sit and work for a couple of hours, and the owner was lovely. She patiently helped me practice and learn a bit more Thai and some facts about the local area, and speak excellent English.

Although I didn’t go upstairs, I bet here is a lovely place to stay as well!
review_2_text: I’m so impressed! Baan Sabun-nga is a cafe that feels like you’re just hanging out at a friend’s house. The shop itself is a beautifully designed modern-Thai wooden house that feels incredibly warm and cozy. The ground floor has a lovely minimalist cafe vibe that is just perfectly put together.  My favourite part was how peaceful and shady the atmosphere is outside, as it’s the perfect spot for anyone looking to escape the noise and to sip some coffee & relax. There's a nice water-feature outside too. The owner is also wonderful and very friendly, providing excellent service that makes you feel right at home.  Her English is 100% exceptional. The coffee is great.
review_3_text:
If you're tired of the noise from cars and motorbikes, this is the perfect place to visit.
It feels like time has stopped-calm and cozy.
The owner is incredibly friendly and speaks excellent English. And the coffee? My wife said, "It's much cheaper and tastes way better than Starbucks at Central Festival!" Highly recommended!
review_4_text: A true hidden gem in Chiang Mai. The coffee is outstanding, and the owner’s kindness makes every morning feel brighter. I was so happy to enjoy such delicious coffee throughout my stay. Highly recommended!
review_5_text: Quaint little coffee shop on the outskirt of Chiang Mai.  Freshly roasted coffee in a shop that sits in a small well manicured garden.  At 9am with the breeze blowing through, it's a nice place to have your cup and relax a bit.   The owner is super kind and attentive.   Come and see for yourself!

name: Black Canyon เซ็นทรัลเฟสติวัล เชียงใหม่
review_1_text: Good service n decent matcha. Abit sweet though but I like the ambience n wifi .
review_2_text:
Foods and beverages there were good but came out pretty slow. It’s a place where you visit when you have time to kill.

Because the price of drink stalls in Central mall is very high, sitting in a cafe/restaurant like this make more sense.
Proper seating with about the same cost.
review_3_text: We ordered the pad Thai and it was ok. I think I expected it to have a little more flavour. The service was fine and there was no service charge.
review_4_text:
Food is ok drinks is good
1.)I feel like their food is freeze dried go to microwave
2.)if you have member card more value-able10%discount
3.)good table
review_5_text: The fish was old and not really good to eat. It took 30 mins to cook this 💩. Dont recommend.

name: Yuzu House by Honey moni - Central Chiangmai
review_1_text: Columbia Barrel Aged rum iced drip coffee not worth the money. But other drinks with Yuzu are delicious!
review_2_text: Very refreshing(Yuzu Soda)
review_3_text: So good delicious
review_4_text: The yuzu juice is very so refreshing!
review_5_text: The best yuzu in my life

name: Café Amazon - Greenpark Chiangmai
review_1_text:
I left my phone here on 14th June 2023 around 6 p.m. Not knowing it until 8 p.m. the same day. I used my friend's phone to call my phone and the barista at Amazon picked up. She said someone found my phone on the floor and had handed it to her. It was pretty late, but she was waiting for me to come pick my phone up. That's a very nice of her and bad for me that I didn't ask her name. Thank you so much!!!

Everyone who works here are very friendly and manners. Always smiles and remembers me what I always order.
review_2_text:
Super comfortable, air-conditioned dining area.  Quiet, smooth jazz playing.
Great way to start my day with a delicious cup of coffee.
review_3_text: I really like this shop. The staff are friendly, lovely, and provide excellent service. The drinks are delicious and strong, just like every time I visit.
review_4_text: The milk green tea tastes terrible. The color is very pale. It's unlike anything I've ever had.
review_5_text: The shop closes early. The staff are not very attentive. I ordered less sweet and got the normal sweet. It closes at 7:00 PM. I walked into the shop at 6:45 AM and they were no longer taking orders. This doesn't include the staff's behavior.

name: Curry Puff Coffee สาขาบิสสิเนสพาร์ค
review_1_text:
We came in the morning, the weather was nice. The staff were smiling, provided excellent service, and were very polite. The prices were reasonable.
There is parking in front of the shop.
review_2_text:
Delicious coffee and a great atmosphere ☕ We love coming here.

It's a very comfortable place to spend time, have a relaxed chat, or get some work done in peace and quiet.
review_3_text: The coffee is rich and fragrant. The curry puffs are crispy and delicious.
review_4_text: The best coffee and the best curry puffs at this shop.

name: เสนาทิพย์คอฟฟี่ Senatip cafe
review_1_text:
truly unique little coffee shop, nicely decorated inside and out, good prices and cozy atmosphere
owner is sweet and friendly, cold cocoa was very tasty 😋
review_2_text: This charming hidden café is a little oasis surrounded by beautiful flowers and greenery. The coffee is excellent, and the service is warm and friendly. Located just beside a small laundry place and a short walk positioned behind Green Park Shopping Center, it’s a perfect spot to unwind and enjoy a peaceful break.
review_3_text: The iced latte is perfect!!!! Cute inside. Nice to hang out in for awhile
review_4_text: Good
review_5_text: Love the place

name: Roastniyom Coffee, Central Festival
review_1_text:
Great location for people watching in the mall. Always reliable coffee.

Delicious coffee and other drinks.  Fresh pastry.
review_2_text: Can’t really fault this place. Fairly comfortable for a mall coffee. And have wifi
review_3_text:
The shop is located on the 4th floor of Central Chiang Mai. They offer a wide variety of drinks, as well as bakery items and pastries at reasonable prices.

The coffee tastes good, with a decent selection of coffee beans. They also have both premium and regular matcha.

Free drinking water is provided in a pitcher.

The staff are lovely, provide good service, and have a great service mind.
review_4_text: The food was delicious and I really enjoyed it. The staff also provided excellent service; they were very polite, friendly, and cheerful.
review_5_text: My favorite coffee shop at CentralFestival Chiang Mai.

name: Arigato
review_1_text:
Located inside Tops — this is our go to spot for coffee — it’s reasonably priced and most importantly, their beans are delicious.  We’re also greeted with such care and kindness each time.  Highly recommend.

There are also a handful of tables coupled with comfy chairs if you want to sit for a bit.
review_2_text: The matcha is delicious, and the drinks are cheap, but the chairs in the shop are so uncomfortable you'll get tired no matter how long you sit.

name: Only cafe อาหารและเครื่องดื่ม
SONG SEAN COFFEE
review_1_text:
Excellent place to stop and enjoy the view on the way to the Hmong village.

Absolutely stunning scenery, can see the other mountains like into the horizon.

Also available are local honey and raspberries ✌️
review_2_text: One of the best cafes in this area. Easy and large parking space, great view, and good drinks. It is very relaxing and the staff is nice. It is a nice stop when you are on a scooter trip.
review_3_text: My fav coffee shop at the Doi Sutep mountain. Best view, drinks and good WC.
review_4_text:
The view, the tea, the friendly staff.
Worth to go after visiting Doi Suthep, super quiet surrounded by nature
review_5_text: Stunning views and great coffee. Must visit if you’re going up the mountain.

name: KonJohn Coffee Slowbar
review_1_text: Had a nice tasty cappuccino here. A nice relaxing spot.
review_2_text: Nice place to stop by for a good cup of coffee. Pleasant, airy, modern, up-cycling kind of atmosphere.  Top value for money.
review_3_text: Great coffee at a great price. I usually have Moka pot coffee but drip coffees are available as well. The shop has an upstairs seating area with a mountain view.
review_4_text:
A nice spot to hang out and chill. There is ample sheltered seating, surrounded by nature.

The coffee is also amazing! From what I can see they use a range of suppliers for coffee, from Kenya and Brazil.
review_5_text:
Update....Still the best Konjohn .The real one.

Wow!!!The bigger,better Konjohn ....so peaceful up here.Delicious ,best coffee at a price that amazes...not expensive at all for specialist coffees.Big selection of drinks.Thai tea is the best too.

name: JUMBÁ COFFEE BAR
review_1_text:
This is an absolute Gem of a place. It's old and a bit rough around the edges, which adds to it's charm, but it's so serene with the waterfall right next to you, the sounds of frogs and birds and water.
Only had a snack but my brother ate here last time and said the food was great, the crumbed chicken strips I had was hand made with real breadcrumbs.
Just down the road from the Temple and worth a visit and a drink and something to eat.
review_2_text:
An almost secret coffee bar, beside the Huay Kaew waterfall, great to listen to the sound of rushing water, and watch butterflies and birds flitting about in the trees,whilst drinking excellent coffee

Entrance to this place is through the restaurant, which has an excellent, inexpensive menu. Best to spend time at both!
review_3_text: This place needs more attention! Great coffee and pad Thai, in a great building with stunning views of the waterfall as you sit
review_4_text: Hidden place, good music, amazing view, amazing coffee. I can’t believe there are no reviews currently. I will be back here often - my favorite coffee place in chiang mai by far
review_5_text: Great lemon honey tea and pad thai. Lovely and relaxing view too

name: ออน เดอะ เวย์ คาเฟ่ เชียงใหม่
Tidwhan Cafe' | ติดหวาน คาเฟ่
review_1_text: Very nice cafe with beautiful outdoors it's like we're sitting in a garden, except during lunch time, otherwise there will be a lot of people and there won't be any seats.good coffee, good prices. The atmosphere is good.
review_2_text: If you want a nice coffee place near RMUTL that's cheap and has tasty drinks, try this place. It's surrounded by green plants, which makes it feel really relaxing. The vibe there is cool and friendly. It's a great place to chill with a good cup of coffee that won't cost you much.
review_3_text: Amazing coffee and cool decor. They have several specialty coffee options for drip. More expensive but totally worth it.
review_4_text:
Quite and cozy place with cute vintage stuff
Board games, tasty drinks
Could be nice to read a book there
review_5_text: Every seat has their own concept :) it makes this place special

name: DAS COFFEE
review_1_text: They use real cups instead of plastic ones which is good. The inside is ac and the outside is spacious with comfortable chairs. Two cappuccino's for 100thb. Friendly barista.
review_2_text: Coffee: 45 Baht. Ambient small cafe' with great coffee and a friendly owner. Individual tables which are good for laptops/reading. A small outside/roadside area has tables and permits smoking (for those that do).
review_3_text: Terrible ! I went almost all coffee shops near here. This coffee shop is the most unkind. I spilled a little water in toilet and smoking ashes outside. The owner came to me “ you’re not welcome, you’re dirty”. I think the saying is rude but I apologized politely several times. But she came again and repeated again. She needs totally clean space , why she’s running the coffee shop ? Coffee shop should provide coffee but also good services. The staffs were also unkind and they don’t clean often. Sometimes I clean the left coffee cups and trashes and returned the tray. They never say Thank you. They just always see the phones. Even this coffee shop don’t keep the business hour. They are very lazy, never seen that it’s open in the business hour they post. They should change the time or make a notice to customers. That’s why this coffee shop don’t have many customers in this village. In Chiangmai, this coffee shop is the worst coffee shop that I’ve gone. They don’t respect customers at all.
review_4_text: Friendly stuff, good aircondition and delicious latte for only 45baht
review_5_text: Best cappuccino in Town

name: Take Away Coffee Shop
review_1_text:
Such a lovely cute little place. Discovered it by accident as I picked up a rental Scooter around the corner.
My Coffee was really really good and only 35 Baat! If you have the chance: pop by - also liked the rather non-touristic vibe of this area!
review_2_text: A great way to spend you morning because of the lovely staff and good tea🕶️✌️ the atmosphere is vibrant with it being close to Chaing Mai University👌 you don’t take away coffee but take away a smile
review_3_text:
Good take away coffee.
They have medium and dark roasted coffee bean.
review_4_text: A small to go only cafe. Their prices are cheaper than many others.
review_5_text: Well made coffee! Affordable price for students.

name: บ้านมะพร้าว ช่างเคี่ยน (ตลาดเทพมงคล) - SDCoconut Smoothies Changkian
review_1_text: the coconut coffees here are SO good, it's nice that you can customize your sweetness level :) and the cashier when I went was very cute and helpful!!
review_2_text:
Amazing place for drinks! I had the coconut milk cocoa frappe and it was the best drink I’ve had since being in Thailand.
My partner had the coconut espresso frappe and his was equally as good. The staff are lovely too, highly recommend!!
review_3_text: I had their coconut ice cream in a coconut. I was surprised there were three big scoops of coconut ice cream plus lots of coconut meat inside the coconut. It was delicious and super filling. The price was very reasonable at 40 baht. Their espresso was strong too!
review_4_text: The best coconut ice cream in the world! They also have some drinks like smoothies and coffee.
review_5_text: Ice cream is delicious.

name: GET AWAKE CAFE
review_1_text: Nice little pace by a large residence to work from its nestled in the heart of the university area.  I ordered the get awake coffee which is basically like a milk coffee but it was pretty damn strong so it lived up to its name!  Place just has some ceiling fans to keep cool and there’s no power outlets for charging your phone.  Still a nice place to work from. #BeatTheGrind
review_2_text: everything else was great but that owner lady excuse us for bringing other's shop drink into hers, which we DID NOT. we bought snacks from the shop that has the same owner and he said we can sit there (as long as we purchase something of course) so we did. so,, ?????
review_3_text: New shop, great atmosphere. Filled with university students.
review_4_text: Just drop here. Google maps says it is open, but it is closed. Update your information!
review_5_text: A mini-cafe offering hot and cold drinks, along with consumer goods, is available within Get Zleep Premium budget hotel.

name: กาแฟไก่โห่ Coffee Rooster
review_1_text: Delicious drinks. Beautiful lovely design, you can feel that this place is full of heart. Next time hope to try the food.
review_2_text:
A small and cozy coffee spot run by a lovely Thai lady who's always smiling and makes you feel right at home. She serves excellent shakes, coffee, and more - all at very affordable prices.

It's one of my favorite places to work from with my laptop 👨‍💻 - calm, welcoming, and great value.
review_3_text: Every aspect of this little café is perfect! I had the Panned Eggs and a mocha and both were above expectations! Highly recommended if you're looking for a quiet place with a super nice atmosphere 👌
review_4_text: Nice relaxed cafe with some food options
review_5_text: Homely, clean, delicious. The cafe is small but cozy.

name: Smile Coffe 2
review_1_text: A small cafe with good drinks. I picked up ice cappuccino here and it was pretty good. The is a few chairs, but the space is tiny, so it’s probably best for many to just get it to go.
review_2_text:
Not a fancy place but good coffee at a great price. Great little coffee shop if you live in the local area and want a caffeine or soft drink fix.
As I'm a fairly regular customer I take in my own washable cup and straw to save waste on plastic. Owner is happy to put drinks in your own container, if you want to do the same.
Street side setting. ..so expect passing local traffic.
review_3_text: Khun Taro is one of the nicest people you will meet in Chiang Mai and his coffee is delicious
review_4_text: I love the coffee there, and the owner is very kind and always smiling. 🤗
review_5_text: Cozy little coffee shop with great location in Ban Chang Khian. I discovered it as it was close to several laundromats in the area. Great coffee at a reasonable price is one of the reasons I keep coming back. They also have a small selection of cookies and pastries.

name: ชารัญจวน
review_1_text: The coffee shop is lovely. It's open and airy. The staffs are friendly. I took my employees to eat there. They like it very much because it's a place where students walk by, which makes the taste of the drinks amazingly rich. Oh wow!!! The price is not expensive. I don't know if you can sit there for a long time. But my employees want to move their house registration there, so it's okay. It depends on what you like. It's a nice shop to sit in.
review_2_text:
Tahitian Milk: A Local Restaurant
Students line up for lunch here.
You can watch the process firsthand.
review_3_text: Lovely female staff

name: Toki Coffee est. 1968
review_1_text: Sound from Galyani Vadhana. Good coffee here with a story of the Pakakayor hill tribe. I also love the new drink on the menu, cascara lemon tea. The owner is nice and loves to share his own coffee journey as an expat. I use the phrase “sound from Galyani Vadhana” because he is a young man who brings his products from his district to town, so for me it feels like the sound of his district when I have a sip of his coffee.
review_2_text:
Had came for a car wash, which Toki Coffee was within the compound.
Ordered a Matcha Green Tea & Lemon Tea for ourselves.
Young boss felt that the first green tea he made was not up to his standard, therefore prepared another cup which was free of charge. Great pride in his service & product. Thumbs up to him!!! 😀
review_3_text:
Made an excellent coffee to order at second attempt!
Balance of body and citrus.Smooth.
Medium roast .Natural process
review_4_text: A very cozy and relax establishing to enjoy a nice cup of coffee. It was run by a Karen family and the owner took great care to brew a cup of coffee. Would be back again.
review_5_text: Very good coffee and very warm welcome service. Natural and honey drip coffee are highly recommended.

name: Cafe Arte
review_1_text:
Beautiful, cozy, and lovely place. I ordered toasts & scrambled egg, served with butter and delicious homemade strawberry jam (tasted even more like alpine strawberries). The scrambled eggs were perfectly cooked.

!The only thing i didn’t like was the way the toast was prepared. It was quite burnt, and could taste an unpleasant burnt taste. This happens when you put fresh toast bread in a very hot pan, instead of slow cook (in my own experience), but i can’t know exactly, so i don’t want to criticize. Maybe it was just one time mistake.
Anyway, if the owner and kitchen takes this issue into account, it would be ideal and relaxing place to spend time with yourself or friends/family. The girls were very polite and helpful. Barista made a decent coffee, and i enjoyed it. Thank you!
review_2_text: Beautiful café in a charming house, perfect for reading or relaxing with a good coffee or tea. The space is very aesthetic and cozy, ideal for taking photos. The garden and interior have a calm, peaceful vibe. The staff is incredibly kind and welcoming, which makes the experience even better. A lovely spot to slow down and enjoy Chiang Mai 💕
review_3_text:
I am writing to provide a complete account of my experience, as the management’s recent response has chosen to sidestep the core issues and instead offer a selective, dismissive version of events. This has only compounded the disappointment.

Here is a detailed timeline of what actually transpired:

· 2:00 PM: I had a scheduled afternoon tea meeting with two long‑unseen friends at this café. As I had a fixed commitment in Lamphun at 3:00 PM, I informed my friends in advance that I would only have about one hour for our visit.
· 2:20 PM: I arrived at the café. Upon learning that my friends were delayed in traffic, I selected an empty table and, as a gesture of goodwill and intent to consume, promptly ordered a drink for my companion (an iced chocolate). I planned to order more once my friends arrived.
· 2:49 PM: My friends finally arrived. Given the time, I could now stay for only 5‑10 minutes before leaving for my next appointment. To avoid ordering a drink I would have no time to enjoy—and to prevent waste—I politely informed my friends that I would not be ordering further and would leave shortly after a brief greeting.
· The Critical Moment: The café was nearly empty (aside from our party of four, there were approximately two other customers). A polite female staff member reminded us of the minimum spend policy. While I was displeased by the inflexibility given my imminent departure, I understood her position. However, the situation escalated when i leave and turn back ,a male employee with thinning, grey‑white curly hair intervened. His demeanor was not helpful but confrontational. He used an iPad to mechanically translate the rules in a manner that felt deliberately intimidating and demeaning, as if addressing a severe violation rather than a customer who had already consumed and was communicating a change of plans.

Key Points the Management’s Reply Conveniently Ignored:

1. I was a consuming customer, not loitering. A purchase was made immediately upon sitting.
2. I explained my time limit to both my friends and the staff.
3. The central failure was one of tone and empathy, not policy. The management’s defense of the “rule” while completely ignoring how it was delivered is telling.
4. Additional concerning practices observed:
· A table inside was marked “Reserved,” yet staff indicated it would be given to us if we ordered four drinks. This suggests the “reservation” was a tactic to pressure higher spending, which is deceptive.
As far as i know approached to order more if they stay over an hour with a single drink, confirming a culture of pressurized upselling over genuine hospitality.
A establishment that values rigid enforcement over thoughtful service. If a mandatory fee is required, transparent models exist (e.g., The Baristro Asian Style, which posts policies and charges admission at the door). What is unacceptable is cornering customers with last‑minute demands after they are already seated.

The male employee with thinning, grey‑white curly hair intervened in question has made it clear he does not care. Therefore, I can only caution others: if you seek a place where respect and understanding come before strict monetization of your seat, you may wish to look elsewhere in Chiang Mai. I certainly will.
review_4_text:
A lovely clam place with a warm and welcoming atmosphere. The staff are incredibly kind, polite, and always smiling, making a great impression from the moment you walk in.

Coffee and drinks are excellent💗✨
ดีมากเลยค่าา
review_5_text:
A incredible find. Delicious coffee, the most amazing scrambled eggs with homemade toast and jam and the absolutely delightful host.
The garden is beautiful but it was a hot day so decided to sit inside, which was so stunningly decoration in a simple traditional style. Even the music was old, making this place feel like an historic gem. Would definitely come back!

name: Looper Wave
review_1_text: This complex of swimming pool, onsen, and café is a great place to relax. The spacious pool is divided into lanes, with a hot tub and a cold stone bath nearby. There are quite a lot of signs informing visitors about the rules in this area. On the second floor, there’s a cozy café with great coffee. The prices are reasonable, and the service is good.
review_2_text:
Looper Wave is more than just a swimming pool—it’s also a great café with a modern, chill vibe. Through large glass windows, you can enjoy views of the pool while sipping coffee.

The barista, with extensive latte competition experience, delivers exceptional latte art.

Creative coffee options, especially the peanut-infused one, are a must-try. Highly recommended!
review_3_text:
This review is strictly for the cafe itself, not the pool/onsen.

Forget about going here to work. Probably not even to hang out and chill. Plenty of other places for that. It's clearly not the place for either.
I don't think it even knows what it wants to be. It's really dark and loud, in stark contrast to the entire property around it. Plus it doesn't serve food!

This cafe really should be redesigned to complement the pool/ "onsen" business.

The chairs are super uncomfortable, and the tables are tiny.
The music was very loud too, and the Cafe had most of its blinds down so they can play some really out of place cartoon projected onto the wall. No idea what they are thinking.

I got the "energy" smoothie which was absolutely terrible. It was really small for the price (120, +20 for almond milk,) and it came out as a thick slush that you need a spoon for (which they didn't give). It tasted like a bag of cacao blended with a couple ice cubes. Pretty gross and not what was expected.

Hard pass on this place. Wifi was good and nice view of the pool though.
review_4_text: Good decoration and vibe but not a place to work because loud music (good for chilling) and uncomfortable chair. Btw, the coffee is not good as expected (by this price) and the staff is really not warm welcome … maybe she had a bad morning before going to work at the café. I really have no idea that it is not allow to wait outside before 10am. (bad air pollution then need to find some free space to sit and wait). Once the staff arrived and saw me sitting on the 2nd floor, she was frustrated and spoke to me with negative attitude like I would steal or break sth. by just sitting in front of the cafe… but honestly no sign at the G floor not to go upstair before 10am…who is gonna know? Better sit by the pool if the weather is nice. 😢
review_5_text: Excellent cafe. I am the first one to review. It is amazing. Great pool next to it. I will come back!! Thank you.

name: KOM COFFEE
review_1_text:
Lovely café, perfect for coffee or getting some work done.
A cozy and stylish place with a beautiful outdoor area that’s ideal for sitting with your laptop or just enjoying a good coffee. The atmosphere is calm and inspiring, making it easy to focus or relax. Definitely a great spot to spend a few hours 🫶😍
review_2_text: I have been here so many times, and the coffee is so good. Absolutely love this coffee shop! The coffee tastes great, and the whole place has a calm, quiet atmosphere—perfect for relaxing or getting work done. There are plenty of charging spots, which is super convenient. The seating is very comfortable, the space feels cozy, and the staff are friendly and welcoming. Highly recommend for anyone looking for a chill and well-equipped café!Love this shop so much 🩷✨
review_3_text: Btutalism, concrete, wood, inner uard. Good for work and make photo, mostly empty. Good food
review_4_text: A spaceful and stylish place in the sleeping city area. The coffee shop has a huge backyard with tables.
review_5_text: I arrived and nobody said hello to me, it was super weird. The coffee is good however. But wow the rudeness of the people… I didn’t feel welcomed.

name: Twenty T Coffee Cafe
review_1_text: After over 2 years in Thailand, it's rare to find such diverse coffee beans! This 10㎡ shop carries global varieties – from commercial blends to single-origin beans. Truly amazed how this tiny space holds a coffee universe. A must-visit for coffee lovers!
review_2_text: Delicious and special coffee. I saw coffee beans here that I haven't seen anywhere else in Thailand. Definitely recommend and I will definitely come back next time👍🏽👏🏽
review_3_text:
Productwise, it is best coffee in the neighborhood!
The owners are amongst the nicest people I've met, although I don't speak thaï that much they always try and talk to me. I always feel welcome here.
When you add to it the warmest and coziest atmosphere with some of the cutest cats you get this incredible place!
A little hidden gem!
review_4_text: The best coffee in Chiang Mai no doubt, small local business with a varaity of local coffee beans, the service is amazing too, recommend!
review_5_text: This coffee shop has the BEST coffee in chiang mai hands down! It has so many unique flavors you must go and try 🙌🏽

name: Inthanin Coffee สาขาช้างเผือก
review_1_text:
☕ Inthanin Coffee – Chang Phueak Branch

Stopped by this cozy café on a relaxing day and absolutely loved the atmosphere. The shop offers both indoor air-conditioned seating and a breezy outdoor area surrounded by greenery 🌿 — perfect for working or just unwinding with a cup of coffee.

The coffee was aromatic and flavorful, with quality that exceeded the price. Staff were polite, friendly, and always ready with a smile 😊.
There’s convenient parking available, which is a big plus if you’re driving 🚗.

Whether you’re just passing by or looking for a peaceful spot to recharge, I highly recommend visiting this branch. It’s the kind of place where you can sip slowly, breathe easy, and enjoy a moment of calm with a shot of caffeine 💚
review_2_text:
☕ Inthanin Coffee, Chang Phueak Branch
Stop by for a relaxing coffee on a chill day. This shop has seating both inside (air-conditioned) and outside. The coffee has a wonderful aroma and great taste, with mid-range prices that offer excellent value for money.
The staff are polite, friendly, and welcoming. Plus, there's convenient parking. 🚗 If you're passing by this area, I highly recommend stopping by. You can chill out and get a caffeine boost! 💚
review_3_text: The staff were polite, but the service was very slow. During peak hours, there was only one staff member on duty.
review_4_text: The staff are lovely and provide good service. The shop is clean, comfortable, and not crowded. No long wait.
review_5_text: It's hot~ I'll fill up the tank and take a break while I'm at it.

name: บ้านขนม เจ็ดยอด HAPPY TASTY มะพร้าวน้ำหอม สด ไม่มีน้ำตาล 100%
review_1_text: Walking into the store already knowing their products are going to be very good since the space is well organized and every corner is cleaned and well detailed. The guy is a true professional and I can tell he does not skip any layer of the processes to make it easier and making sure he makes effort to make it really good. I think this place and the guy is special, so you need to come check it out. Highly recommended.
review_2_text:
Nicely decorated store.
I ordered ice cream with sweet bun. The shop owner gives us a donut. All are very good.
Highly recommended.
review_3_text: This is just so good. We came here not in purpose but just passed by for a coffee. Their thai tea latte is so good and the owner was so kind to provide a refill of it🤣 We also ordered the coconut ice cream with taro pearl and it tasted soooo good too. The vibe here was so relaxing that we felt so sleepy haha. The owner was so polite and kind and generous. 😊
review_4_text: Delicious and friendly owner. Would definitely come back again
review_5_text: It was really good! The owner was really nice and gave us lots of delicious freebies :)

name: MASS’ BARBER X COFFEE
review_1_text: One of the best coffee I ever had. The owner very friendly. Fresh and tasty coffee. They also have fresh orange juice, they also have home made bakery. Very comfortable seat inside. If you guys have a chance to come near by this area. Please stop by and made yourself refreshed from this coffee shop. Highly recommended.
review_2_text: Great idea! A great professional haircut AND a professional coffee for 1 great price.  He does both for you. Super atmosphere. Highly recommend.
review_3_text: Nice atmosphere, good coffee, great haircuts
review_4_text: Great hairdressor good price and even a free coffee after haircut too (haircut and shave around 200 baht) new place definitely worth looking at and even if not for the haircut good coffee Dì maak!
review_5_text: Great vibe, good people and amazing coffee. Also the barber is the best in town

name: allin coffee
review_1_text: Honestly, I’m still trying to figure out where all the five-star reviews came from. My dark roast was clearly over-extracted — strong, but not in a good way — while my friend’s medium roast seemed a little too shy to show up. As for the Shamrock, it was… well, impressively flavourless. Maybe we just came on an off day.
review_2_text: I just discovered a fantastic new coffee spot! They have a great selection of coffee beans, and everything I tried was delicious. The staff is super friendly, and the location is perfect. Can't wait to go back!
review_3_text: Coffees and smoothies are very good. The shop is very easy to find, nearby oneplus jetyod. Can parking on 147 avenue and walk a little bit on the right to the shop.
review_4_text: It has a/c, couches, and 40 baht green tea lattes. What more could you ask for?
review_5_text:
The coffee is delicious and well-balanced.
The strawberry milk is also very juicy. I highly recommend it! 💞

name: 2STREETCOFFEECREW
review_1_text: Chill vibes central in Chiang Mai! Sipped on a creamy matcha latte that was pure green goodness—smooth, not too sweet, with that perfect frothy top—while sinking into the cozy nook, lost in the great background music weaving mellow tunes through the air. Ideal spot for unwinding and letting the day melt away.
review_2_text:
After the rain
A cup of hot latte is just what you need.
The coffee shop around the corner is very distinctive, and the staff are warm and sweet.
The coffee beans are amazing. The medium-roast flavor is very rich, and the acidity is just right. It's mellow and has a long aftertaste. I'll definitely visit often.
review_3_text: You can choose the roast level and each cup is carefully made. It’s one of the popular coffee pick up spots in this area. My light roast americano was good.
review_4_text: Best coffee in Chiang Mai! Regular coffee stop with great staff and very good coffee. The cafe has a great vibe, with a friendly team who are always happy to see you. Highly recommend 2StreetCoffeeCrew. Love it here.
review_5_text:
One of my favourite coffee spots in Chiang Mai. Amazing coffee, the best staff, wonderful vibe.

Just a joyous spot to hang out for a coffee solo or meet a friend.

Must visit destination when in Chiang Mai.

name: Inthanin Coffee
review_1_text: I had low expectations since it's located right behind the gas station so was imagining more of a 7-11.   Instead I found the chairs and seating area to be comfortable and the coffee to be ok.   I enjoyed sitting and spending an hour working and reading my book.
review_2_text: Nice quiet cafe great place to get some work done,  located in the gas station off the main road, friendly staff & good tasting coffee. Iced Latte (75B)
review_3_text: I like coming to the Inthanin coffee shops for a refreshment. Also the fact that supporting a Thai company seems more correct to me than supporting the American companies when visiting Thailand. This Inthanin is located a bit outside the city center but if you happen to pass by it go and have a cool or warm refreshment in there
review_4_text: Great place away from the busyness . Big enough to have space and do digital nomad work if that's your requirement. Internet speed modest but works with low latency issues.FANTASTIC coffee and my poison of black Americano which is a modest thb40. But try their cashewnut brownie which is to die for. Staff are really nice as well. Friendly and professional.
review_5_text:
A quiet place to work, right off the main street.

Was looking for a place to do some computer work for a couple of hours and wondered into this little coffee shop. It is a chain, but not as pricey as Starbucks, but with many tables and couches. The coffee is good and the food too, and with Free wifi it is a great little spot to get in some work for the afternoon.

name: สวนชา เจ็ดยอด (ใต้ต้นฉ่ำฉา)
review_1_text: Very local looking place where you can get a variety of drinks for take away. I picked up Thai tea and it was pretty good for the price. It is cheaper than most of the places around.
review_2_text:
1. There are no tourists, locals come here often.
2. The staff didn’t speak English, so I used translation app to ask him: Recommended drinks with less sugar.
3. Finally, I bought Thai milk tea, with less sugar and added pearls.
Delicious and cheap.
review_3_text: They have a wide variety of fried items, but I bought them at 3:30 PM so the batter wasn't crispy anymore. Ordering a mixed platter is a good price. I tried the dried banana fritters, but all the bananas were hard, probably too dry. The banana fritter stall is next to a tea shop (probably owned by the same person). I've bought tea from them before; it's standard taste, and they prepare the food quickly.
review_4_text:
Came here based on reviews. Mmm, it's really delicious, especially the pearls.
The price and portions are reasonable, filling! They have everything from small to jumbo cups. They also have whipped cream and fruit salad. There's a huge menu, so you can try a variety of drinks, both cold and blended. They also have grass jelly. I'll definitely come back, but parking is on the side of the road, lol.
review_5_text: I'm giving it 2 stars. I bought a 50 baht blended cocoa with tapioca pearls, but I found two strands of foil, like scouring pads, in my cup. What was that? I couldn't drink it anymore.

name: Lung Nuad Coffee
review_1_text:
Great quality coffee, Friendly prices, and a funny barista. 🤣🤣
You should definitely try, guarantee you will love this Cofee shop. 😊😎
review_2_text: Cool local coffee shop. Variety of coffee beans to choose from. Extensive non-coffee drinks menu as well. Nice chilled out atmosphere. Appreciated the owner letting me prectise my basic Thai 😆
review_3_text: Pretty good coffee and they roast their beans. It is a small space and the music is a bit loud. I got to see how they roast it and it was kinda cool. The prices are good for to go.
review_4_text: lovely cafe with a cute cat and khun Top the barista is very fun and friendly
review_5_text: My neighborhood coffee spot! I am a regular and he is ready with my order. I typically get takeaway but it is a cute spot to sit for a coffee or snack. Both indoor and outdoor seating. Every time I go back he has a small new way to make it even better!

name: Goodneighbor Cafe
review_1_text:
The cold drink was placed directly on the table without a coaster or tray, and the water flowed onto the table. I felt that there was a lack of basic serving consideration.
The response during the ordering process was somewhat dry, and there was a lack of guidance on additional requests, so the overall atmosphere was not comfortable.
The flavor and completeness of the food did not meet expectations for the price range. Compared to other stores with similar prices, it was difficult to feel any competitiveness.
review_2_text:
Once again, Google family...❤️

Upon traveling Thailand, my lady and I found this gem of a place. Smooth techno music, friendly staff, and the food was great. If youre looking for a place to chill/work or just simply be lazy with great breakfast, you won't regret spending your time here! First time here today and we will be back. See you soon 😊 ❤️
review_3_text: Amazing and healthy food. Probably the best breakfast I had in Thailand. Highly recommend the açai protein bowl, so yummy! The coffee is also high quality. I went there 3 times, and always I left with a smile. The staff are really kind and friendly. Great experience :)
review_4_text: Great place for breakfast. There is a big variety of smoothies and bowls. We came here a few times already and the food was great. The presentation is beautiful of both - food and drinks. Most importantly they are pet-friendly!
review_5_text: Everything was fine except for the coffee and fat boy bagel (bagel wasn’t freshly baked tbh). I ordered a cappuccino with coconut milk and got this. To be honest, it was impossible to drink. I’d recommend not offering drinks that don’t work well with alternative milk. Possibly, it’s fine with regular milk or with other drinks.

name: Beans of us Coffee Roaster
review_1_text: What a hidden lovely place. I tried the Thai-Ethiopian coffee blend with oat milk. Great natural high standard flavours and notes. I am picky about coffee, Ethiopian arabica coffee blends well with other regional beans, but it also tastes incredibly good without blending and adding nothing in it. The chocolate chip cookie was warm and fresh, I don't think I had something like this anywhere in Thailand so far. The lady at the coffee bar was nice and welcoming.
review_2_text: Great little coffee shop. Good coffee and nice little bakery items. Nice location. If sitting outside, it is a little noisy due to being right on a road. They let our small dog be with us in their outside seating.
review_3_text: White tone is cold-brew coffee mixed with forest honey. It is absolutely refreshing. Definitely a perfect glass for hot weather day. The barista is friendly and professional. The atmosphere in the cafe is nice and the place is spacious which is absolutely for working or being a gathering place for chitchatting.
review_4_text: I cam we here very early in the morning after my half marathon. So I was alone and the staff was still a bit sleepy. Not judging. I would be too if I had to work on a Sunday morning at 7am 😅 I usually don’t like to have the first coffee of the day at a coffee shop since the machine is not up to speed. But I really needed one. And it was good.
review_5_text: This cafe has a really nice atmosphere, and the coffee was so good. I got a vanilla latte, and it was just what I wanted. It is also pet friendly, so you can bring your little puppy and enjoy your coffee and a snack.

name: Omnia Cafe & Roastery
review_1_text: The staff was very friendly and explained each coffee bean clearly. I chose one from Chiang Mai, and it was really good. The place is also great for working.
review_2_text: A specialist Coffee joint! The latte is heavenly and the medium roasted long black is aromatic! The premise is small but rustic and delightfully warm. A must try for genuine coffee lovers. It has won numerous awards.
review_3_text: Very good coffee and it was nice that it was served with a glass bottle of water. The flavor of the coffee I tried was pretty distinctive and I enjoyed my cup. The space is small and the tables and chairs are limited.
review_4_text:
People might have heard that this place has a good coffee but why order green tea latte?

The only lesson I ordered the green tea latte here because the green tea here is not the actual green tea. It’s the green tea that made from jasmine! Hahaha you heard it right. It’s also quite a favor as well. I really enjoyed the green tea latte here ❤️
review_5_text: Great coffee and a cool little hipster environment to work from.  There’s a large table with stools you can sit at with a power point next to it.  The bathroom is clean and tidy inside the premise and a hot latte with set you back 65 baht.  The barista was quite polite and had a great command of the English language. #BeatTheGrind

name: Racha caftel คาเฟ่ที่พักย่านเจ็ดยอด
review_1_text: Very affordable , well kept , relaxed and modern hotel. Staff are very accommodating and friendly. Hotel is not too far from the centre. Shops and atms within walking distance. I will definitely be back.
review_2_text: I lived here a few months. Staff is very friendly and rooms are great! (Pretty small but good for the price)
review_3_text: Efficient and affordable. 600 baht per night. We booked on the day and move in 2 hours later. Room is clean and as all the basics (AC, TV, Towels, Shower gel and Shampoo). The little coffeeshop near the reception is a us
review_4_text: I don't like the concept of sharing good reviews and getting free drinks, so the review you see from here, may not be real but just the people who get free drink.
review_5_text: Good accommodation at an affordable price. The rooms are a decent size for the price, close to the city center and convenient for getting around. The rooms are fully equipped with amenities, including a hairdryer and power strip. The only downside is the limited parking space; you have to park in the side street.

name: Cafēin
review_1_text: A lovely cat themed cafe (without actual cats). The barista was very friendly and made us delicious coffees. The almond croissant wasn't the tastiest I've had, but only because it wasn't overly sugary so for a good reason! You can even play good old Super Mario here 😁 I highly recommend this place for the coffee! They have all sorts of cute little items, from Baby Yoda onwards. Such a sweet atmosphere. All the best to the owner 🫰
review_2_text: Nice café, which opens early to get your caffeine level to working levels Good price for the coffee. Friendly service. For fans of retro gaming, a chance to beat Mario high score while waiting for your drink.
review_3_text:
Cutesy little cafe around the street, with good wifi.
Latte is good!

I like coming here, just sit and relax. Sometimes work a bit, pretty quiet and not much ppl inside.
review_4_text: This cafe has a nice long table even though the space is small. The prices of the drinks are affordable and their coffee is dark roasted one and i felt lots of caffeine as the store name suggests.
review_5_text: A pretty good place to relax. Various types of coffees and beverages can be chosen. The Boss or staff is friendly. Recommend.

name: เติมใจรัก Coffee home
review_1_text:
This cozy little coffee shop is truly worth the short trip off the beaten path. It has that personal, welcoming feel that’s getting harder to find these days.
The food here is a standout, freshly made, and absolutely delicious. It’s not crowded with tourists, which helps the place keep its natural charm and relaxed atmosphere. I tried the pork rice bowl and highly recommend it; the flavor and quality were surprisingly good for such a humble setting.
I’ll definitely be back to try more dishes. A real Chiang Mai gem!
review_2_text: Nice family run place to eat. A little bit of the beaten track but worth the visit. I had hoped to make it back… next time I’m in town I’ll go for sure.
review_3_text:
Great spot for food and coffee, the atmosphere is unique with vintage vehicles and retro technology and knickknacks all around. It is far from the road so there is no traffic. This appears to be their garden, where you are a guest; it really is a shop that feels like home.
Edit: a year later it is even better! The food is amazing 👏
review_4_text: Such a nice relaxing place with good food and great service. The lady here is super nice and welcoming and the space is comfortable and feels really great. They have nice home cooked meals aside from drinks, so you can plan to spend some time here if you wanna just sit back and relax for a bit.
review_5_text:
A retro delight. CDs and cassette, turntable. A menu of traditional cafe food, replete with some untypical additions. Delicious 👌.

Indoor and outdoor seating. Be careful walking on the moss-covered bricks outside when it rains!

name: ออน เดอะ เวย์ คาเฟ่ เชียงใหม่ สาขา เอสโซ่ เจ็ดยอด
review_1_text: Many branches of this coffee shop in the north, nice coffee beans they use 👍
review_2_text: Great coffee with reasonable price.
review_3_text: The coffee shop at the gas station is affordable, the taste is decent, there's parking available, and the staff provides good service.
review_4_text: Delicious, not expensive, good service, parking at a gas station, reasonable price.
review_5_text: It's delicious. I'm happily waiting for the car to be washed.

name: ร้านกาแฟข้างวัด (เจ็ดยอด)
review_1_text: Nice lady great iced cappuccino 35B.
review_2_text:
Everyone's standards may be different, but for me, this cafe is simply fantastic.

Reasonable prices, great food, a great atmosphere, and a friendly owner. This is a place I'll be visiting often while staying around Chiang Mai's Jet Yot area.

If you're ever in the area, I highly recommend stopping by.
review_3_text: The fruit smoothies are delicious, I recommend the coconut smoothie with fresh milk. The prices are reasonable and the atmosphere is nice, located next to the temple.
review_4_text: The fruit smoothies are very delicious. The vendor is in a good mood.

name: Taste Me Sandwich Cafe
review_1_text: Great little place with delicious food! Bread was very good, all the ingredients were quality and fresh. The latte came with a very cute cat foam art, and tasted great! The worker was very friendly and the service was quick. Overall, a great cafe for a quick meal and a drink. The full sandwich was pretty big so if you're not starving, a half would probably be good too. Will definitely come back!
review_2_text: Probably the best sandwich I have had in Thailand and healthy too. I had Italian Milano Salami, but will try the raw parma ham next time. Nice friendly staff, fair priced.
review_3_text: Sandwich is tasty. The owner is really friendly. Small local shop recommend to visit🤤👍👍
review_4_text: the BEST tuna sandwich omg I wanna go back. Plus, peach iced tea is so refreshing loved everything
review_5_text: Delicious Sandwiches, I eat an Italian Salami. Best Quality Food, thanks you so much. Best Sandwich since long Time.

name: The Blue Hut Cafe
review_1_text: This beautiful little spot is a hidden gem with the most lusciously green and flowery garden Ive seen here. It serves great coffee in a cozy cafe with inside and outside seating in the garden sun or shade, super green and nice and zen. I definitely recommend!
review_2_text: Great cosy place to come and enjoy a coffee and work from your laptop. name: the bliss kitchen
review_1_text: Cute little cafe, hidden down the end of a quiet street, with a small menu and limited outdoor seating. Great coffee, delicious food and tasty bakery items too, fresh out of the oven! All to a wonderfully chilled soundtrack playing in the background and super sweet owner/staff!! 🥰
review_2_text: Great spot to relax with a coffee or grab a sandwich. Cozy atmosphere, friendly service, and the prices are very reasonable. Definitely a nice place to unwind or catch up with a friend.
review_3_text:
Nice little cafe. Reasonably priced but I found my americano to be a little watery.
Good service.
I wish they had a bathroom, though.
review_4_text:
Five Stars for Charm, Coffee, and a Truly Magical Experience! ✨

I stumbled upon this little gem in Chiang Rai, and I'm so glad I did! From the moment I stepped inside, I was captivated.  The atmosphere is cozy and inviting, the perfect blend of rustic charm and modern comfort. But what truly sets this coffee shop apart is the owner.  She's absolutely enchanting – warm, welcoming, and radiating a genuine kindness that immediately puts you at ease. Her smile is infectious, and her easygoing nature makes you feel like you've known her for years.

Beyond the captivating owner, the coffee and Thai iced tea are exceptional! The coffee is rich, aromatic, and perfectly brewed.  The Thai iced tea is the best I've had in Thailand – perfectly balanced, creamy, and intensely flavorful.  It's clear that only the highest quality ingredients are used.

This isn't just a coffee shop; it's an experience. It's a place where you can relax, unwind, and soak in the charming atmosphere while enjoying delicious drinks.  The owner's warmth and hospitality add an extra layer of magic, making it a truly unforgettable spot.  If you're in Chiang Rai, you absolutely MUST visit this hidden treasure!  You won't regret it.  I can't wait to go back!  ☕🇹🇭💖

review_1_text: We had a wonderful experience at the Artistic Lab! 😍 The perfume bar was so much fun - we could mix our own scents, and it felt really special to create something personal. name: Mont Blanc Patisserie
review_1_text:
Mont Blanc Patisserie might just be one of Chiang Mai’s top 10 restaurants overall when I consider service, ambience, decor and the dining experience. I’ve eaten my way through this city, including the Michelin approved spots, and very few of them can come close to what this place delivers.

The staff were warm, polite and helpful, as one would expect from the amazing people of Chiang Mai. The ambience is spot on: warm lighting, music at the right volume, and décor that feels like it was curated tastefully by people who appreciate old books, vintage cameras, radios that take you back in time, and classic vinyl. It’s effortlessly charming.

I’m sitting here right now wondering how I’ve only ever tried their desserts, which are themselves absolutely fantastic and not too sweet. This is my second day in a row coming here, yesterday I was only here to have dessert, thinking that’s all they offered. But today, the food and ambience really hit me on a completely different level. The chicken steak with pepper sauce? Easily one of the best chicken thighs I’ve had anywhere. Perfectly seared for a crispy skin that was packed with flavor, and the meat was juicy well‑seasoned. The mashed potatoes  tasted like it was made by my grandmother, a compliment of the highest order.

In two visits, I feel like a teenager falling in love for the first time, everything seems perfect, but this is genuinely how good it is.

Mont Blanc Patisserie easily stands alongside, if not above,  the very best restaurants I’ve visited in Chiang Mai. I’ll be back. Often.
review_2_text: Love this place and always enjoy the atmosphere whenever I’m here. The only thing that keeps me and many of my friends from coming more often is the consistently high music volume. It’s noticeably louder than anywhere else in town, which makes it tough to work or even have a relaxed conversation. Everything else about the place is genuinely fantastic, so it still deserves 5 stars. I just hope the owners consider turning the music down a bit so more people can enjoy this great spot.
review_3_text:
Huge thanks to Pon and Mon for making our visit such a great experience! They were so friendly, welcoming, and attentive ,  you can really feel the positive energy as soon as you walk in. Their service was spot on and made us feel right at home.
The food was absolutely delicious, and the prices are more than reasonable for the quality and portions you get. It’s honestly such great value for money!
The place has such a nice, comfortable vibe , clean, cozy, and perfect for relaxing and enjoying a good meal. Plus, the parking is excellent, which makes everything so convenient.
Overall, everything was fantastic. Highly, highly recommended!
review_4_text:
Variety of delicious desserts and cakes 🍰
Staff are very friendly with good service.
The atmosphere is very laid back, dim lighting; comfortable seating; soothing music, can be conducive for a romantic couple or any occasion.
Alcohol in the form of local beer; liqueurs; spirits and a choice of bottles of European wines. During permitted hours only.

review_1_text: My wife found this Coffee Shop by accident during a thunderstorm. She brought me here to show me and I am impressed. It is very neat and tidy with a wonderful decor. It is situated on the Super Highway but is fairly quiet once you are inside. I had a caramel frappe and a chicken and rice dish which was a little spicy but absolutely delicious. Worth the effort to visit.
review_2_text: This is not your average instagramable shop! Most of the items are made from scratch in house! Pretty plating and even garnished very fresh fruits, very good homemade bread for sandwiches. We ordered three dishes and they are all 5 stars! Coffee is good too! Highly recommended to go here for brunch!
review_3_text: Wife and I came by Sosoulful to support I Tim. We met him at another coffee shop and he currently works here. It’s relatively new. Wonderful atmosphere with lots of space. Come by and support local coffee shops. Better than StarSucks.
review_4_text: Came here to support a friend’s friends’ new venture. Beautiful space with multiple floors. Has two meeting rooms upstairs and plenty of seatings downstairs. As a Christian I love all their public faith decor. Great coffee. Didn’t get to try their food. They are still working on the golf center which I’m curious what it would look like. Cool space to gather for sure! Plenty of natural lighting.
review_5_text: Cute cafe, tasty coffee, nice workers, good price.

name: Mai bakery in garden
review_1_text:
Mai Bakery in Garden is such a charming and cozy spot; it instantly gives you that warm, farmhouse feeling the moment you step inside. The interior design feels just like a countryside home in Texas, with rustic wooden furniture, soft colors, and lovely vintage decorations that make you feel right at home. The whole place is surrounded by greenery, making it a peaceful retreat for anyone who loves nature and good food.

The café offers a wide selection of dishes, freshly baked cakes, and excellent coffee. Whether you’re in the mood for a hearty breakfast, a light brunch, or just a slice of cake with a cup of latte, Mai Bakery in Garden has something for everyone. Everything is beautifully presented and tastes just as good as it looks.

One of the best parts about this place is that it’s connected to a hotel; making it incredibly convenient for hotel guests. Imagine waking up in the morning and walking just a few steps to enjoy your breakfast in a lovely garden atmosphere, surrounded by flowers, trees, and fresh air. It’s the perfect way to start the day.

Mai Bakery in Garden is not just a café, it’s a relaxing experience. Whether you come for the food, the cozy ambiance, or just to unwind with a book and a cup of coffee, you’ll leave feeling refreshed and happy. It’s truly one of those hidden gems you’ll want to return to again and again.

Dr. Niwech
review_2_text:
This place is an absolute hidden gem! 💎 The garden is a tranquil oasis—so serene and cozy, it feels like a little escape from the hustle and bustle. The coffee here is exceptional, and the desserts? Wow, they’re simply divine.

We’ve spent countless hours sitting in the garden, soaking in the peaceful atmosphere. Even though it’s tucked just behind a busy and noisy main road, the space is so well-hidden and insulated that you can barely hear the traffic.

The ambiance is enhanced by the gentle background music they play. The volume is perfect—not intrusive, but just enough to notice if you want to. It’s kept so low that you can still hear the birds singing, creating a perfect harmony of nature and music.

The staff are incredibly friendly and welcoming, which only adds to the charm. This spot truly has it all: amazing coffee, delicious desserts, peaceful surroundings, and the perfect touch of music. Highly recommend!
review_3_text: Great pastry and tasty coffee. The garden is tranquil and cute. A perfect place to take a break and chill. The food menu looks a appetising and I'll be back to try. Wish I'd found this place sooner😎
review_4_text:
We had a fantastic dining experience here and have eaten here a few times for breakfast.

The food is delicious and has that comforting, home-cooked feel. The restaurant offers both cozy indoor and relaxing outdoor seating. The staff is incredibly friendly and welcoming.

We ordered the Tom Yum Mama Noodles with egg and chicken, as well as the egg white salad—both were flavorful and satisfying. We’re staying right next door at 51 Hometel and wish we’d discovered this place sooner!

The prices are very affordable, and the desserts are a delightful treat to end the meal. It’s also a great spot to get some work done, with Wi-Fi and bathrooms are available. Highly recommend!
