name: Hmong Doi Pui Family Coffee
review_1_text:
Late January 2026 Local Hmong cafe serving a wide range of specialty and crafted coffee ☕️

One of the few interesting places at the village originated when the peoples of this region once cultivated opium poppy plantations.  The then late king made efforts to introduce more sustainable alternative crops and soon a small coffee industry was born.

The selection itself is notable from basic blends to single origin beans 🫘 reflecting the deep knowledge of the family behind this local brand.  Even selective beans are available as well as various brewing options.

The staff is strictly counter style with option to do your own pour 🫗 over order.  Retails options are also available as well as other coffee by products and alternative drinks.  Meals pairings are also at hand.

The atmosphere and the view are particularly beautiful and once can imagine the restful view in the early sunrises 🌅 😍 👌   Truly one of the must visit places in the village.
review_2_text: Very nice place to relax and enjoy the view and good coffee. We hat a tasty Iced Cappuccino. The hot Mocha was rather disappointing as I missed intense Mocha, it was rather weak, so not my personal favorite. Maybe the Iced Mocha would be a better choice.
review_3_text:
What a unique and impressive place to be! Though we could not enjoy a clear view due to a very foggy, humid day, it was a once-in-a-lifetime experience enjoying our coffee, given to us by the extraordinarily welcoming staff, in this extremely extraordinary environment. The view, limited to the Hmong village below us, not allowing to see what lies beyond, actually made it an even more special experience, giving us the feeling to be from the world, at least for a little while. A clear must-do recommendation.

We drove ourselves. It takes some guts to face the ever-narrowing street until you reach the village, but it is a well-worth adventure. Unfortunately, it is not suitable for wheelchair drivers.
review_4_text:
Great place to drink coffee: beautiful view, incredibly hospitable staff, delicious coffee.
There are very few places where the coffee beans from the coffee you drink are picked directly around you. The employee who processes and roasts the coffee beans gave us a whole tour and showed us how the machine works. Really very nice, thanks! The quality of the coffee is also very good. You can also buy ground coffee and coffee beans here.
Besides this there's a restaurant as well.
review_5_text: If you're looking for a perfect blend of great coffee and stunning views, this cafe on top of the mountain is a must-visit. The coffee is exceptional, making it a great spot for both relaxing and working. I always go for studying and writing, and the serene atmosphere, combined with the panoramic mountain views and the mesmerizing movement of the clouds, provides the ideal environment for focus and creativity. Be prepared for a short, 10-minute walk from where you park, but the breathtaking scenery and peaceful setting make it well worth the effort.

name: คาเฟ่หลงเขาดอยปุย

The garden view is beautiful, surrounded by mountain air and nature all around. The space is cozy and cute, and the family that runs it is so kind and welcoming. You can feel the love they’ve put into the place. A perfect stop if you’re looking to slow down, sip something warm, and enjoy the view.

When you go down to the coffee shop, it is very fun. When you go back up, it is very hard.
review_3_text: This is a nice place to enjoy your coffee (or even  cappuccino) and to have a look at the waterfall, valley, garden and mountains. Go to the second floor, the view is amazing. review_4_text: Great coffee shop! A hidden gem! The coffee was incredible, and locally sourced. We also ordered a matcha latte, and it was surprisingly very good!

review_4_text:
This place is a hidden gem in Doi Pui Hmong village. As it is located bit away from the main tourist area (you need to walk about 200m) to get to this place. It has basic cottages (about 6, I think) on various ground levels. Although I had only a meal at this place, I am sure it is a nice experience to stay in one of these cottages.
The food was delicious, and well-presented authentic Hmong food. Food is freshly prepared using local ingredients. You immediately see the difference between pre-prepared food and freshly prepared food.
The owner and his wife are very friendly. You can sit at the open-air dining area at the top part of the property with an amazing view over the valley.
There are only very small direction signs (name and how to get to this place) at the centre part of the village and that could be the reason that it is not known to visitors.

review_2_text:
Hmong Doi Pui Village

Hmong Doi Pui Village is more than just an ordinary village; it's a cultural learning center that seamlessly blends with the beauty of nature. Located at a considerable altitude, the air here is exceptionally clean, even on the hottest days at sea level.

A hike to the top of the village reveals a beautifully arranged flower garden with a small, artificial waterfall, creating a very relaxing atmosphere.

There's also a Hmong-run coffee shop offering friendly prices, perfect for enjoying a cup of coffee while soaking in the natural beauty of Doi Pui.

Overall, Hmong Doi Pui Village is ideal for those seeking a change from city cafes, wanting to breathe fresh air and learn about local culture.

Living a simple life.
Building houses on the hillsides.
Preserving the traditional hill tribe community style.

review_4_text:
Super relaxing onsen. A good time/price ratio too if you have the chance to stay until closing (23:45).
Furthermore the people; the guests and the employees, made me feel very welcome.
There's two hot pools/baths with different temperatures and one cold plunge bath. Then you have a steam room and a regular sauna, with the option to steam it yourself, on the hot rocks. There's a quiet relaxing-room too, filled with heavenly chairs, like you're laying on clouds, as well as some soft blankets, making you feel like a child in pyjamas again. Then there's an option to have some japanese snacks and drinks at the reception, you can even eat outside if you like.
Be aware that women and men are not allowed to come together, there's different time sloths for each gender. And consider that it is a full-naked onsen, although you can wear a towel whenever you please of course.
Overall, great experience!

review_2_text: Warning if you go here: the staff try to get money out of ‘dumb farangs’ (foreigners) by adding expenses to your tab that you did not order. Be sure to check the prices as the dishes are all written in Thai on the receipt. Our 355 bhat meal came out to 600 and they didn’t think we’d notice. Their acting was very bad, and you could sense the conniving beforehand, snide excitement (when they thought we fell for it) and guilt after. Sounds ridiculous and made up but really showed the flip side to the genuine Thai hospitality. Bummer too, I was gonna leave a great review for their food.

review_5_text: It seems like a place run by a Hallyu fan(?). It was a space where customers were also packing goods and such. But the food was really delicious! The chicken feet were not spicy and soft, and the tom nyang kung was really tasty and I recommend it! There weren't many customers, but I recommend the taste. When you go, you can hear Korean music, and you can see posters of Korean singers, cup holders, stickers, etc. The customers were mostly women in their teens and twenties! It's worth going at least once if you're looking for food, regardless of the atmosphere. Stir-fried chicken feet was 75 baht, tom nyang kung was 135 baht, and omelet rice was 75 baht.

review_1_text: Chubboy coffee is 11/10. I had it everyday for 2 months. It’s hard to find a good caramel macchiato that taste like back home (US) but this place has it! They can adjust the sweetness for you. It’s a large size for only ฿50 and only ฿10 for an extra shot of espresso. Him and his mother are soo sweet and good genuine people. I look forward to coming back in the future, thank you 🙏🏼😊
review_2_text: Perfect Coffey by low price!
review_3_text: Great chocolate, and good lattes for little cost
review_4_text: Good
review_5_text:
Chubboy Cafe - Chubboy Cafe is a coffee shop in Chiang Mai with a unique and distinctive style. This time, I ordered drinks through the Foodpanda app and was extremely impressed with the speed of delivery and, most importantly, the generous discounts. It was even better value than I expected. I ordered the Iced Cocoa and Iced Matcha Latte. The flavors were rich, just the right amount of sweet, and not at all cloying. The cocoa had a distinct aroma, while the matcha gave a refreshing, Japanese-inspired feel. I didn't want to put my cup down. The packaging was cute and the attention to detail was excellent. Even with delivery, the quality remained excellent.

If you're in Chiang Mai or looking for a cafe with great drinks, excellent service, and reasonable prices, Chubboy Cafe is a must-try. You won't be disappointed. Especially if you find a discount code on Foodpanda, it will be even more worth it.

Okay so I ordered from Chubboy Cafe on Foodpanda the other day and damn, it was way better than I expected. Got a crazy good discount, like almost half-off kind of deal. I got an iced cocoa and iced matcha—both were bomb. The cocoa was super rich and smooth, not too sweet. And the matcha? Bro, it tasted like a straight-up Tokyo café moment. So good.

Even the packaging was cute, like they actually put effort into it even though it was just delivery. If you’re in Chiang Mai and craving something cold and tasty without breaking the bank, def check out Chubboy. And if you catch a discount on Foodpanda? Say less. Worth it 100%.

review_1_text: Great place that has it all - gym, sauna, ice plunge, café, coworking. And most importantly that it's pet-friendly. The staff is kind and welcoming. The coffee was great. They also provide a free refill of the water
review_2_text:
⭐️

Amazing Spot for Post-Workout Refuel!

Absolutely love this place! The space is beautiful—clean, modern, and super inviting. It’s the perfect spot to grab a protein shake after a workout, and of course, the coffee is top-notch too! ☕

Whether you’re looking to chill out or get a little post-training energy boost, this café totally hits the mark. Highly recommend! 😍
review_3_text: Lots of green and great vibe. Perfect morning in the winter in Chiang Mai looks like waking up and drive in a chilly weather and get a cup of coffee here and get relaxed. They roast their coffee here as well and i really enjoyed their coffee. Their cookies were also very good.

name: O-Cha
review_1_text: Locating quality coffee at a price point of 45฿ in the central Chiang Mai area presents a challenge; however, this establishment successfully meets that criterion. While the coffee shop's offerings are commendable, the customer experience could be enhanced. Specifically, a warmer reception from the barista and staff, including a welcoming smile and Thai greetings, is desired. The coffee shop's decor is well-executed, adapting to international festive periods. Despite the standard service, the competitive pricing makes this establishment recommendable.

There coffee is the best I've had yet in Thailand and they also have oat milk, which was good for the wifey since she can't have regular milk!

I chose the mild roast and it was delicious but the serve was too small. I ordered the 89baht food (can't remember the name) that comprised of two cocktail sausages, scrambled eggs on croissants and buttered toast. Ordered a hot latte to sip while waiting.
But I opened the cup because it was a takeaway cup.
And I was amazed! Only 45 baht per cup!
They even did latte art!
The coffee was good, fragrant and smooth. I loved it!
I'll definitely come again if I have time.^^
review_3_text: I learned about this shop through the government's co-payment scheme. The coffee is decent, and the bakery items are delicious. The only downside is the woman who works at the battery shop, presumably the owner, who never smiles when greeting customers. I've been there 4-5 times, and she's never smiled at me (as a customer) even once. She always looks like she's angry at someone...

review_5_text: delicious

This coffee shop is always our favorite. It has a warm atmosphere, classic décor, comfortable seating, and a lovely atmosphere, perfect for a relaxing coffee break.
The shop serves fresh, delicious coffee, perfectly balanced, and a great choice for coffee lovers.
They have a wide selection of teas and smoothies to choose from.
The owner is lovely and very friendly.
I highly recommend it to everyone.

review_4_text: Open for a long time, the coffee tastes delicious and smells great.

Cozy atmosphere with cool air-conditioning.

review_5_text: Everything was delicious! I really liked this restaurant; the food tasted great and there was a wide variety of dishes to choose from. Parking in front of the restaurant depends on luck whether there's a spot available.

review_2_text: Just try it

review_2_text: The food is delicious! I loved their crispy Southeast Asian-style omelet on top of the rice. I tried the Tom Yum Goong and Fish Soup—both were excellent. The iced café latte was also good. The ambiance is nice and relaxing, perfect for a hot day or while waiting for laundry next door.
review_3_text: Great cold and hot coffees in a nice quiet cafe with friendly service and wifi!
review_4_text: Very nice seating with laidback music.quiet and restful location with alot of small shops.

Review of Coffee or Me

Coffee or Me is a charming café nestled within a hotel, which I happened upon by chance while driving through the area. It’s an ideal spot for those seeking a quiet, nature-filled retreat to work or unwind, offering a refreshing contrast to the bustling cafés in downtown Chiang Mai. With its lush greenery and serene atmosphere, the setting is undeniably inviting.

However, when it comes to the coffee, I found it somewhat underwhelming—perhaps because the café prioritizes ambiance over the quality of its brews. Additionally, the service felt a bit distant, which slightly detracted from the overall experience. A more attentive approach to customer service could enhance both the atmosphere and the coffee itself, making this hidden gem even more enjoyable.

review_3_text:
A Beautiful, Pet-Friendly Café in Chiang Mai With Amazing Matcha & Fresh Pastries

Dorle Coffee Shop in Chiang Mai is truly one of the most charming and peaceful cafés in the city. If you’re searching for a relaxing spot with great drinks, delicious pastries, and a pet-friendly environment, this place is a must-visit.

One of the highlights is their pure matcha (clear matcha) — it’s absolutely spot on. Smooth, refreshing, and perfectly balanced, it’s one of the best matcha drinks you can find in Chiang Mai. They also offer a delightful selection of freshly baked pastries, all of which are incredibly yummy. Whether you love buttery croissants or other treats, everything tastes freshly made. They even have sourdough, which is a big plus for bread lovers.

Dorle is also wonderfully pet friendly. Dogs are welcome inside the air-conditioned area as long as they don’t disturb other customers, making it an ideal café for hot Chiang Mai days. Their outdoor garden is another highlight—lush, beautifully manicured, and truly zen, perfect for relaxing with your drink or spending quiet time with your furry friend.

The staff are lovely, polite, and genuinely friendly, adding to the overall warm and welcoming atmosphere.

If you’re looking for a pet-friendly café in Chiang Mai, a spot with excellent matcha, or a garden coffee shop with fresh pastries and sourdough, Dorle Coffee Shop is absolutely worth supporting and visiting. Highly recommended!

review_1_text:
This is actually a tea place as much as it is a coffee place.   SO GLAD I stopped in here instead of the other two standard coffee chains nearby (Roastiniyom and Wake Up).  This independent cafe has 3 floors and ample space for lounging (relaxing), getting work done, having a conversation, catching up on reading, etc.  It is perfect for anything informal.   Don’t expect to have a business meeting here unless it is mainly creative-based.   This place has a vibe that supports creative drifting and it’s currently open from 8am to 9pm (0800-2100).  So, you could literally spend a whole day here for getting in some personal time.  There’s a food menu serving Asian and western dishes.  Their drink menu is where this place really shines especially if you are serious about tea and/or coffee.   It’s way above average in terms of what they offer here.  And they sell coffee/tea peripherals as well as to-go bags of a wide range of teas and some coffees.

**So DEFINITELY come here or recommend those tea-friends of yours because there aren’t that many TEA places that have this assorted range of offering!**

❤️all these independent cafes.  Support them because they took the time to put their passion into creating an experience that accentuates the beverage you’ve just purchased.   The decor, the furnishings, the vibe; all of these things are what makes independent cafes worth supporting.

This place even has roped nets where you can lie down and let your creative thoughts drift if you need to.   There are reclining seats (on the 3rd floor) where you can practically lie down, or work from a proper body-to-table distance that is more comfortable. (Just like Japanese and Thai floor-seating arrangements).   This place is just fabulous for an array of reasons, but mostly for just being a relaxing (properly air-conditioned) spot to spend several hours or an entire day getting in some personal time.
review_2_text:
Anyone miss Taiwan?   Well, there's a cafe that has a bit of the Taiwan cafe vibe, with a specific theme, and a proper selection of coffees and teas all under one roof—and it's a big roof, since they have about 4 floors.  The theme here is oceanic, with their blue sofas and ocean cushions, and other ornaments that reflect that.  They even have two fish-tanked glass tables that you can sit around and enjoy.

On the second floor, there are "nets" (that resemble the sort you fish with) with big cushions that you can relax on and drift in creative thought or fall asleep on.  Perfect for kids and those young at heart.  There are also tables with sofa-type seating.  And even standing tables on first and second floor that you can work on (for those that prefer standing and typing on a laptop or reading a book).

The 3rd floor has cushioned low-tables (Thai/Japanese-styled seating).

++And here's a cafe that is actually family friendly with ample parking for cars, where parents can arrange play-dates for their kids and have some relaxing time on the first floor while their kids play hang out on the second floor.  This is definitely quite unique about this cafe and worth recommending to friends who have kids that want to get together in a place with a wide selection of teas and coffees (where they can hang out—-and their kids can also not get bored).++

There is light relaxing music in the background that adds to the charm of this place and makes the big space feel more personable.  The teas are mostly Asian (since the owners are Taiwanese-Thai), and for those who want the Taiwanese bubble tea, they have it here, along with some other more proper tea leaves that don't require such an inordinate amount infusion of sugar and milk.  As for coffees, I spotted 3 grades of roasts.

I ordered the Oolong Tea Pot, which I enjoyed.
And I tried their local Basil and Pork pizza, which was sufficient for one but mighty tasty! I did see an order for a neighboring customer’s Thai Instant Noodle Spicy Salad, which looks amazing. (I will be back for that!)
review_3_text:
What a beautiful café! They have great drinks and delicious food. The interior design is beautiful and ocean themed. They have various seating available: bars, couches and normal tables. There are electric sockets too.

Other than that they have hanging nets for laying down and aquarium tables.

We had two cold drinks, rice Mushroom dish and French fries for 250
review_4_text:
Edit 2: What a nice surprise! The lady who I am guessing is the owner or one of the owners, came to me to let me know that they had instructed the staff to enforce control of children that may run wild after they do their tutoring on the upper floors. A business that is responsive to their customers! Wow! That is a very rare and very welcome experience. So, the info from my first edit will hopefully not need to be concerned about in the future. But you may want to be aware that there are likely to be many students here during any time of the day doing their studies. They are usually polite and quiet....
I will upgrade my rating to full stars. A business that actually responds to criticism is a rare gem.
Edit 1: Unfortunately, I felt the need to reduce my rating by one star. I would HIGHLY recommend NOT coming here between 3:15 to 4:45, Monday, Wednesday, and Friday. There is a Chinese group that does some kind of after school study here and they are noisy as hell! And kids run around making all kinds of racket. It is out of control and I'm sure the staff feels like there is nothing they can do about it. I was informed that there is a similar study group on weekends, but it is quiet "because they are Thai children." It's a great business model to have, but they should seal off the 3rd floor with a door to control the noise emanating from there. Asking the families to control their children wouldn't hurt either....
Fair warning! Otherwise I really like this place!
There are a number of coffees shops in the very near vicinity, but this one out does them all in a variety of ways. They have a great selection of teas. I'm not familiar with coffee, but sure looks like they take their coffee seriously. They have an industrial grinder (roaster?) machine in a neighboring room. The third floor is very child friendly. Plenty of electrical outlets purposefully placed pretty much at every table I think. Plenty of parking in back if it is full in front. They have a decent menu with pizza, spaghetti, some Thai dishes, etc. And the place is clean! Good service too! I won't be visiting any of the other places around here anymore....

name: Hidden Village Chiang Mai
review_1_text:
It’s truly the best place for parents and kids.
The best place indeed. You can feel that the owner created it more for children to enjoy and for parents to feel comfortable rather than for business profit. For a father like me, who has to take care of a child all day, it has been the perfect place. If you can show a Thai driver’s license, or if your child studying in Thailand can show a student ID, you get a 50% discount on the entrance fee.
review_2_text:
Hidden Village Chiang Mai: A Must-Visit for Families and Fun Photo Ops!
"If you're looking for a fun, action-packed destination just outside the main city, Hidden Village is the perfect choice, especially if you have children! This venue successfully combines several unique attractions into one engaging space.
Key Highlights & Experience:
The most impressive feature is definitely the Dinosaur Village. The life-sized models—some of which move and roar—provide a genuinely exciting and slightly educational experience for kids. Beyond the prehistoric giants, the venue offers a Pet Village where children can interact with friendly animals, and fun zones like the Giant Insects section, which is fantastic for unique, Instagram-worthy photos.
Atmosphere & Facilities:
It's a large, well-maintained area that gives the feel of an exploratory, whimsical park. There are plenty of activities and play areas to keep younger visitors entertained for hours. Facilities, including dining options like The Barn Steak House, are available on site, making it easy to spend a half or full day here.
Expert Tip:
While it caters primarily to families, the fun and quirky themed zones offer excellent backdrop material for anyone looking for creative photos. Highly recommend for families visiting Chiang Mai looking for an easy, guaranteed day of fun!"
review_3_text: For the price and the experience, this is easily a 5-star attraction for younger children. It features a charming, simple play area and small animals that you can feed for a small fee. The grounds are spacious and fantastic for kids to explore. I highly recommend The Hidden Village in Chiang Mai to any families with little ones who have the time to visit.
review_4_text: Do you really think this place is expensive? This is not a hotel playground. The grounds are very spacious and constantly being cleaned. Although it’s not the newest facility, there are many hidden things that children would enjoy. The animals were also living quite comfortably, and the place felt clean for us as well. However, it’s more suitable for toddlers than older children, and it’s a good idea to bring a hat. I would recommend not going if it rained the day before.
review_5_text:
No need to do anything extra besides what the park already offers and it is just great for the kids! They loved it. We were here during the week almost alone.

name: Chong Wa Coffee Shop
review_1_text:
I came across this charming little shop by chance, a cozy café with a general store vibe. Though small, it offers an impressive variety of items. The coffee is freshly ground from beans grown in the nearby mountains, with a rich aroma and a pleasantly bold bitterness. Sitting in the backyard under the shade of a tree, enjoying the gentle breeze and soothing music, with a well-mannered dog keeping me company, felt incredibly relaxing.

The real surprise was the fried noodles, which were unexpectedly delicious. The noodles were perfectly cooked and not greasy at all. The friendly owner’s warm hospitality made up for the missed cherry blossoms, leaving a lasting impression of comfort and contentment.
review_2_text: Nice place to have a coffee. First time in Thailand I had a coffee like at home, strong. I loved it. The owner speaks very good English and is very kind. We came to the village to see the cherry blossom, we understand we need to come around February. We didn't regret the long ride, we found this nice place.
review_3_text: Decent cafe for a coffee or quick bite when visiting Doi Pui and surrounds.  Many hikers use the cafe for lunch, and the place is pretty small (three tables on a deck in back and a couple of tables out front), so it can get overwhelmed on weekends.  The Phad Krapow Moo is pretty good, but the owner has only one wok, so service can be a little slow if it’s busy.  The attached store has a decent variety of drinks and snacks.
review_4_text: Nice coffee shop with a good view and nice outdoor seating.
review_5_text: My favourite place in Chiang Mai. I hike here almost every week. The coffee & food is good and Chong Wa and his  wife are so friendly and engaging. It's a wonderful place & experience

review_3_text: Definitely a must visit place in Chang Mai. There they make their own coffee, which you can also buy. In addition, there is simply a beautiful view. A must for coffee lovers and people who want to see a coffee farm.
review_4_text: Amazing coffee in a cute little village.
review_5_text: The coffee is self grown by family  and grinded by hand. Worth a visit when you make the passage up. We did it by scooter. So don't hesitate. You can do it. Nice scenic view on top.

review_2_text: Przepyszna palona kawa Americano z lodem, z dodatkiem miodu własnej produkcji 😍.

Since you've made the effort to come all the way here, it would be a shame not to buy some to take home. They have a variety of coffee beans to choose from: light, medium, and dark roasts, and they also have ground beans (the packaging looks great as a souvenir). There's only one size: 250 grams for 250 baht. After getting your coffee, don't forget to explore the area before you leave. Along the way, there are souvenir shops, and you can admire the northern Thai cherry blossoms up close (the trees aren't tall, and the blossoms are abundant...absolutely stunning!). The Khun Chang Kian village sign is at the end of the road, another interesting viewpoint.

There is air conditioning, and there are many kinds of drinks.

The price is reasonable

Take a rest after exercise.

Quickly recover physical strength
review_2_text: Having been to 700 stadium a little earlier than planned it was still hot and was in need of a cold drink.  So I chose to cool down in ChocoToss. Nice place if you've just finished your walk, run swim.
review_3_text: The coffee shop in the stadium. It is very comfortable. The coconut latte ordered is very good. The staff are very beautiful and very nice. I will come to buy a drink during sports.
review_4_text: The girl behind the counter could work abit more on personality. Otherthan that it is quite pleasant and quiet place except for after school time like 3.30 pm onward.
review_5_text: Good, clean, and relaxing place to chill out after activities. Friendly staff

name: Three Animals Coffee กาแฟสดอินดี้
review_1_text: The prices are great, everything on the menu is 30 baht. I always order an espresso, but lately it's started having sediment. Sometimes I order a regular sweet espresso but it's not sweet at all, just bland. Sometimes I get a latte instead of an espresso. The owner seems to have hired new staff. I don't want to tell them directly because I don't want to bother the staff and the owner. But overall, the other menu items are good.
review_2_text: Excellent value for money. Highly recommended. Great coffee and beautiful view.

name: Sheeva Cafe
review_1_text:
This is a coffee shop that's perfect for people waiting at the Land Department office.
- It's a small shop located in the parking lot of the Treasury Department. There are 6 seats inside and one marble table outside.
- The coffee isn't very strong. I ordered a cappuccino, and the milk foam wasn't very smooth.
- The atmosphere inside is okay for waiting for your order.
- If you're looking for fresh coffee while waiting at the Land Department office, give it a try.
review_2_text: The staff are lovely and the cake is delicious.
review_3_text: Delicious coffee at reasonable prices. The barista is lovely. The shop is open Monday to Friday from 7:00 AM to 5:30 PM.
review_4_text: The coffee is delicious, I highly recommend it!!

name: Coffee Bench by Mat Day Cafe
review_1_text: Stop by to do some business at The Land, a delicious coffee shop with cool air conditioning.
review_2_text: The coffee tastes great and the service is excellent.
review_3_text: Strong coffee, good.

name: กาแฟดอยแตง สาขาเอ็นที ศูนย์ราชการจังหวัดเชียงใหม่
review_1_text: Nice coffe, nice staff...thank you
review_2_text: The coffee is really good and strong. If you come to the government center and get to drink good coffee next to the TOT center, the locals know what I mean.
review_3_text: A small coffee shop next to TOT, but the taste is strong, the price is not expensive, there are outdoor seats and air-conditioned rooms, free Wi-Fi.
review_4_text: The coffee is delicious. It's next to the TOT Center, Chiang Mai City Hall.
review_5_text: very delicious

name: ร้านสาวเชียงใหม่มินิมาร์ทศาลากลางจังหวัดเชียงใหม่
review_1_text: Good quality coffee, good price, good taste.

name: BREW MORE
review_1_text: Found on Grab, order twice in a row, good Cappuccino with variety beans to choose. Very lovely packaging. Worth to try! Will def order again when I am back to Chiang Mai! 🥰🥰☺️☺️🎉🎉
review_2_text:
Prices start at 45 Baht
I ordered a cup of latte with medium roast
The taste was good for me.
review_3_text:
This cafe is one of best coffee shop  in cnx
The staff is lovely
You should try it !!!!
review_4_text: Stop for coffee not that expensive and Savoring the rich flavors of this exquisite coffee blend
review_5_text: PANAMA

review_1_text: This cafe is so nice. It’s inside the Women’s Prison, but anyone can go. They have some good Khao Soi and coffee and honey sodas and bakery. The staff are so lovely and nice, and the seating is beautiful. I highly recommend.
review_2_text: The taste is delicious... I must come back again. Taste, shop, savor, and share!

name: กาแฟโอชา สาขาแยกศูนย์ราชการเชียงใหม่
review_1_text: High quality of coffee. Good taste. Aromatic smell. You can choose level of coffee. And beans. This shop also sell the coffee equipment and coffee beans too. Recommend.
review_2_text: Hidden Gem for coffee lover at Chiang Mai. Price range from 40-80 THB. You can choose type of roast for your coffee from Light - Medium - Dark. I would recommend latte honey hot that taste of wild honey. They do sell many kind of coffee such as Omkoi and Doi Chang and also coffee equipment.
review_3_text: Good coffee. Nice decor. Sells coffee related stuff as well. Great place to do nuthing on the sofa or have a long discussion at the long table on 1st floor.
review_4_text:
LOVE THIS PLACE!!
Best latte I've had in Chiang Mai. Great coffee products and well priced coffee beans. Wife's hot Coco was very nice too.
Great atmosphere!

Highly recommend.
review_5_text: Cute and cozy little space serving good coffee and many other beverages, small snacks, baked goods, a few light dishes. Busy during peak hours, but the friendly staff are usually very quick!

name: BLESSED CAFE
review_1_text: Very good coffee! Must try if you visit Chiang Mai
review_2_text:
The best cup of black coffee I've had in Chiang Mai for three years, better than those specialty coffee shops in the Moat. I was surprised that the very fruity coffee beans are Thai.

Friendly and courteous staff.
review_3_text: The owner is very nice, the products are very high quality, I definitely recommend it.
review_4_text: Amazing coffee! Highly recommend if you are looking for nice staff and high quality coffee 🫶
review_5_text: The coffee beans at this shop are handpicked and roasted by the owner in Mae Hong Son, which is the heart and soul of their coffee. You can truly feel the care put into every single cup to ensure great quality and flavor — and the best part is, the price is very reasonable too.

name: อุ๋มอิ๋ม กาแฟ
review_1_text: I went there for the first time in a while. It's a small cafe but it's relaxing. Iced latte is 45 baht. Good! Latte is 35 baht.
review_2_text: This shop makes very delicious food. It's located before reaching the city hall, a little past the Esso gas station.
review_3_text: The coffee is fragrant..the owner is in good shape..the taste is truly perfect.
review_4_text: The young people at the shop are lovely, fun to talk to, and friendly. The prices are not expensive.
review_5_text: The owner is lovely and speaks nicely, and the drinks are already delicious.

name: Hilltown Cafe
review_1_text: A beautiful and trendy cafe perfect for your next Instagram post. With a bright, modern aesthetic and plenty of natural light, it's an ideal spot to relax, work, or catch up with friends. Enjoy a wide selection of coffee and refreshing drinks, along with a tempting menu of pastries and light bites. The stylish decor and inviting atmosphere make Hiltown a must-visit spot for both locals and travelers.
review_2_text: Coffee is AMAZING!! The outside area is lovely too. Make sure you order Katsu curry it’s the best.
review_3_text:
Second time here this week
Pets allowed inside in a stroller(available for borrowed at
the cafe)
Love the music, friendly and welcoming staff, variety tasty food, good coffee.
I like outdoor seating in the morning and can just move inside when it's too hot.
review_4_text:
I came here for the second time.
The barista is really good, you should try the dirty coffee at Hilltown.
The bakery was perfect, and the place has a nice, relaxing atmosphere.
Price is quite expensive
review_5_text: Seriously the best croissants! Hilltown Cafe also offers a lovely air-conditioned environment, delightful ice cream, and you'll never have to worry about parking ❤️ Love this place!

name: All by myself coffee house
review_1_text:
Secret little cutie, cozy place for short relaxing.
Have a cute cat, good matcha.
Lots of plants, Green environment. Wifi, and chill music.
review_2_text:
Great coffee shop in a quiet area.
The coffee is really good and the atmosphere is great.
review_3_text: Authentic coffee taste and nice atmosphere far from chaotic downtown. Will visit next time with a book and might enjoy reading in their garden.
review_4_text: Such a hidden gem in Chang Phuak area. Enjoyed the coffee, cake and the area is very chill and outside has a cabin feeling and inside is modern. Owner is nice as well.
review_5_text: Nice cozy coffee shop 😊 Tasty flat white and friendly owner. Thank you very much 🙏🏻🤩

name: กาแฟดึกดำบรรพ์ By คุณยาย
Exotic Roasting Coffee
review_1_text:
I am happy to have found this coffee shop on the Ping river.  They have coffee
From all over the world. You can smell each of them.  3 bartistas delivering expert service.  This shop really takes coffee serious. I had the Myanmar dark roast and it was excellent!  The 1 only important concept that is missing at this coffee shop is the lack of cake or sweet options.  Today there was one option and it was pretty unimpressive as you can see from my photo.  There is enough seating for about 30 people.  There are 3 floors with bar seating and table and chair seating.   This is an excellent coffee shop for all kinds.  It would be really cool if they had some windows show casing the ping river.
review_2_text: Excellent coffee in a nondescript location alongside the river. If you are here, you are here because you love coffee. They have coffee varieties from all over the world and the proprietors and employees are obviously enthusiasts of the highest order. Pocket friendly prices for real quality.
review_3_text: Wife and I exploring and found this coffee shop when we were in the area. Excellent coffee and surrounding. I had a hot Mocha and my wife had a hot Vanilla Latte. We chose local beans. If you choose specialty beans, it’s an additional 20bht. We didn’t think it’s worth it as we were drinking flavored drinks. if you are a coffe connoisseur, it’s probably worth the xtra 20bht to get different beans. The place is next to the Ping River so you can get a good view. The place is nicely decorated in a modern industrial style, which we like. Come to this place to support the local coffee scene. Better than Starsucks.
review_4_text: They have an exceptional selection of coffee beans all roasted on site. There is no other cafe in the area that offers such flavorful and aromatic coffee. The staff speak English and are very friendly. A MUST try cafe! It will leaving wanting to come back to try all he different beans and roast.
review_5_text: Travel from Suthep area during rainy day🌧, definitely worth it! We order Iced Americano mix with orange juice🍊, Flat White(hot) and Americano(hot)☕️ So goooood👍🏻. They have plenty type of coffee bean, parking lot is available as well!

name: Chong Cha Ba ช้องชบา
review_1_text: Very nice coffee! Cafe owner is very kind, i got free brownies and also a quick ride back to my hotel because i was going to walk and its very hot. Owner was so super nice to offer a ride.
review_2_text: I absolutely adore this gorgeous cafe. The owner is so sweet and welcoming. We immediately felt at home and well taken care of. The coffee was very good and the owner very generously offered my daughter a chocolate brownie for free. A wonderful homely place with authentic character. Definitely a place to return, even just to sit with the owner for a chat. He has some great stories to tell.
review_3_text: Everything here was great.  We got coffee, Thai tea, and a cold cocoa.  The owner puts loving attention into each drink, and the cake he brought out to drink with it was a nice extra touch.
review_4_text: What an adorable place!  It’s a gem in the neighborhood. I love the vibe and decor. The cafe is decorated in a chic, but homey way. I also love how they showcase hundreds of sport trophies earned by the owners’ children. They staff is super nice and friendly, and more importantly, the coffee is amazingly good. The drip coffee is a must-try. I wish they would have food and more stuff in the menu.
review_5_text:
Old school café with bunches of Thai antiques decorations (I believe there will be lots of stories to talk about them too) I'm not a big fan of coffee but I
did really enjoy the hot cocoa I could feel the owner got all the high quality ingrediens for everyone. Highly recommend.

name: น้ำปั่น@มุมกาดบ้านท่อ
review_1_text:
Ban Tho Coffee has been selling for a long time, becoming legendary.
The shop is a cart in front of the temple at Ban Tho Market.
The price is cheap, the taste is delicious, and the flavor is rich and satisfying.
Workers on a budget can enjoy this every day.
The vendor offers a wide selection of coffee, tea, condensed milk, and plain milk. If you like it extra sweet, less sweet, or creamy, please let the vendor know in advance. He'll go all out. If you don't like it sweet, be sure to tell him in advance.
The price is 25 baht per cup, a great deal.
Quick brewing, short wait, and chairs are available for waiting. Parking is available in front of the temple.
review_2_text: Ban Tho Coffee, located in front of Ban Tho market during the daytime, offers a very rich and delicious coffee that's well worth the 25 baht price tag. Especially the large iced Milo for 25 baht – it's amazing and incredibly good value for iced Milo lovers! ✨😆😆✨ The seller is very friendly and respectful to all customers, regardless of age or gender. ✨😆😆✨ It's no wonder this small coffee shop has so many people waiting in line. I truly admire this shop! ✨☺️✨
review_3_text: Order a large size! #IcedMilkTea Perfect for the summer. Fragrant and sweet. Come late and it might be sold out! #BanThoCoffee
review_4_text: This old-fashioned coffee shop in front of Wat Ban Tho, opposite Ban Tho market, is open during the daytime. It's busy, with prices starting at 15 baht for iced drinks. The owner is friendly, the taste is average but reasonable for the price, and the drinks are prepared quickly with minimal waiting time. There are chairs available to sit and wait.
review_5_text: It's a coffee shop that makes us feel very good every time we go there.

name: มิตรเจริญ เชียงใหม่
review_1_text:
The food is delicious, the prices are affordable, and the view is beautiful.
The service is excellent. I highly recommend this restaurant; you won't be disappointed.
There are also many photo opportunities.
review_2_text: Very delicious, especially the cake. The owner is lovely and the price is good, not expensive, worth the price. Highly recommended!
review_3_text: The coffee and prices are great. I suggest improving the seating arrangement to provide shade from the sun.
review_5_text: It's good. The atmosphere is good. The only problem is that the sun shines in too much. But overall, it's good.

name: Bigpapa's Coffee
review_1_text: Great tasting coffee!

review_1_text: Very affordable price.

name: ปังปิ้งเนย

review_1_text: Great coffee. Nice service.
review_2_text: Great coffee!
review_3_text:
Meegin is a nice little coffee shop located across from Por Pan 7 military camp in Chiang Mai. The shop is easy to find and has a comfortable atmosphere ☕️

You can sit inside and enjoy the cool air-conditioned space, or simply order your drink to go if you’re in a hurry. The drinks taste good and the quality is quite impressive for the price✅

The prices are very reasonable and affordable, making it a convenient spot for a quick coffee break. Overall, it’s a good local café to stop by if you’re in the area🥛☕️🍵
review_4_text: The light roast Americano is great, you have to try it. The cakes are delicious too. The air conditioning is cool, the music is nice, and it's a comfortable place to sit. The prices are affordable for frequent visits. You have to try it because our tastes might be different, and what's delicious to us might not be the same for everyone.🤟🏼😎
review_5_text: Meegin coffee, a coffee shop with a great atmosphere. Every menu is delicious. The staff are polite and provide excellent service.

name: NAMA Coffee Slow Bar
review_1_text: Adorable van next to the street serving fresh coffee that tastes amazing. Gotta love these little spots in Thailand, it’s defenitely worth a visit!
review_2_text: Very nice Coffee and not expensive  about hot30 baht With Ice 35 Baht/Menu Camping Stlye and barista on the Classic Van...let try!!!
review_3_text: Nice place to have a break
review_4_text: Super chilled. Quick cup of coffee served w a smile.
review_5_text:
One of the best coffee I had in Thailand. Recommended by local coffee lover.
Come with Tam ;-)

name: November.handberw
review_1_text: The coffee is great, the owner is friendly, and the shop is very cute.
review_2_text:
The coffee is good, and the atmosphere is nice. There might be a bit too few chairs, but that's okay. We'll probably expand the shop later. Anyone passing by, please stop by and support the shop!
Wishing you even more success in your business! I'm cheering you on! 💚
review_3_text: The coffee is fragrant, has a well-rounded flavor, and is not expensive. The two salespeople are friendly and lovely.
review_4_text: A small coffee shop on the roadside between the city and Mae Rim. It's very cute and the food is delicious. It's a new experience.
review_5_text: Delicious coffee, lovely owner, reasonable price.

name: OFF
review_1_text: The shop is cute and the atmosphere is great. Personally, I drink it every morning before work. I don't like sour coffee, so I usually order the dark roast with an extra shot. It's bitter at the start but sweet and fragrant at the end – delicious! For me, I'm hooked on this shop's coffee.
review_2_text: The coffee is delicious, the staff provides good service, and the prices are reasonable... I invite everyone to stop by and try it if you have the chance. (It's located opposite the 7th Infantry Battalion, past the Provincial Hall intersection towards Nakornping Hospital and Mae Rim District.)
review_3_text: I ordered a Thai tea with less sugar, but what I got was very sweet 😤. However, the coffee at this shop is delicious; it has a lovely aroma and a great taste.
review_4_text: Coffee prices: Hot drinks 40 baht, Cold drinks 45 baht. The coffee is very strong and bitter.
review_5_text: It's a small branch in a local area. The prices are affordable, the taste is good, and the pastries are delicious. Finding parking might be a little difficult.

Most Chiang Mai vendors have a distinctively grumpy appearance.
This restaurant has a limited selection of food...
review_2_text: Delicious and affordable. Iced tea is only 25 baht.
review_3_text: They had an unwelcoming expression, like they didn't want to sell anything.
review_4_text: The pizza is delicious, and they have a special sauce unique to the restaurant...^ ^"
review_5_text: ห้องแอร์  สอาด อร่อย ราคาถูก

review_1_text: Delicious coffee, nice place, kind owner, great price
review_2_text: Good coffee at a cheap price. Too bad the shop doesn't have Grab.

name: เมเม่ สเปซ MEME-SPACE
review_1_text: The food is delicious, the flavors are good, and there's a complete range of both savory and sweet dishes. I really like it. The restaurant has a nice atmosphere and is beautiful.
review_2_text:
It's fresh fruit, the bingsu is delicious and just right. I loved it so much!
They also have food at the shop, I'll try it next time 🥳✨🥰🥰
review_3_text: I ordered BBQ ribs to eat at home. They were delicious and the pieces were big and full of ingredients. The whole family liked them.
review_4_text: Great atmosphere and delicious food, this is the place to go!
review_5_text: The food is delicious, the taste is good, and the service is excellent.

name: อิแม่กาแฟ
review_1_text: At first visit, I didn't expect anything apart from some form of caffeine for my body to continue my day. Turns out that this coffee shop is a hidden gems of this area. Khun Dao, the owner, is serious about the ingredients. Coffee beans, milks, and others are specifically selected from specialist suppliers, not a random picked from next door convenient stores. You can order online via platforms, but if you visit the shop by yourself, you can even request for seasonal special beans! All of these for only quarter of the price of a cup of Starbucks!!! Unfortunately, the downside is that it's only available for takeaway, no table in the shop.
review_2_text: Everything is delicious and the prices are reasonable. Parking is difficult, and they're extremely busy with orders.
review_3_text: It's next to the market so it's hard to find a parking spot, so I always use Grab. They have a wide variety of drinks, including coffee and fruit juice, and they're all delicious and worth the price. They're not super tasty though haha, so it's perfect for when you just want a drink on the cheap.
review_4_text: This is one of the first shops I'll choose for bubble tea. - The problem is slowness. When I saw the shop, I understood that they only do one person. - I moved to ordering after 2 PM instead, not during Prime Time. - For those who are in a rush to eat bubble tea during the noon or afternoon, I recommend ordering elsewhere. - I like the small pearls and the lava pearls the most. The Taiwanese tea is delicious. The coffee is just right. I ordered the Oreo blended 5 times, and only once the taste was weak. (If I have another time, I'll call and let you know.)
review_5_text: The drinks at the shop are very delicious. Whenever I have business to run, I stop by and buy some. Or if I'm busy, I order through the rider app.

name: Save Cup Coffee
review_1_text:
If you're stuck for somewhere to stop, we recommend stopping by Save Cup Coffee. They have coffee, brownies, and cookies at very reasonable prices. The spacious space is perfect for chilling out at your leisure. 🍪🍫☕ 🌴🌻🌳🌾
A little slice of heaven ⛅☁️🏡
review_2_text: I really like the atmosphere of this shop. It's cool and relaxing to sit and sip coffee. Plus, the coffee is delicious and not expensive. The cookies are the best and the cornflakes are excellent.
review_3_text: This coffee shop has a nice, shady atmosphere and the mint cocoa is delicious. It's perfect for sitting and reading a book.
review_4_text: I love the orange coffee. The coffee is very good, very fragrant, and deliciously well-rounded. Another menu I like is the cookies. They smell of real butter and taste very good. The price is very cute.💕
review_5_text: The cats in the shop are so cute. The coffee is great. 🥤

name: ชามิจิ สาขาMBC หน้าค่ายป.พัน7
review_1_text: The bubble tea is delicious. I often order from Foodpanda. This is my first time at the shop. The seller is lovely.

review_1_text: good
review_2_text: It was delicious! Highly recommend! 👍🏻

name: OFTEN Coffee
review_1_text: Stopped by for a cup of Thai tea after lunch in Chiang Mai. Its warmth & sweet aroma make it a delightful treat. A bit crowded during lunchtime, but the queue moves quickly. Thanks to the efficient staff. 👍
review_3_text: A small, cozy shop with delicious iced tea and good service... Parking is available on the street. 😊
review_4_text: This small, cute, and warm shop is very affordable and delicious. 😊
review_5_text: The prices are lovely; I've never seen drinks at these prices in a coffee shop in Chiang Mai. / The green tea has a nice aroma but lacks body.

name: Khun Tanai de Cafe
review_1_text:
Cozy atrium 'wedge' at the end of the building.   Large windows with indoor and outdoor seating gives a great view of an intersection in this quiet neighborhood.

The iced cappuccino was well made and flavorfull.  Counter help, helpful.
review_2_text: Padthai was purely sweet, even the sweetness is my favourite savory. On top of that, chives was not clean out.
review_3_text: Nice little spot in Chaing Mai, Thailand, offering a mix of Thai and western food, makes a good pit stop, for drinks and food, there are also toilet facilities. Food was nice however my hot latte was served a little cool for my liking, looked amazing though!
review_4_text: Found this sweet place in my neighbourhood, it has two floors with the view on the temple, sounds of birds in the background and now and then a car passing by. Plenty spots to charge your Laptop and phone. Amazing staff, very helpful, giving advice and opinion and speaks good english :)
review_5_text: a small local coffee place worth checking out

name: Alter Coffee Cafe #กาแฟสด Coffee#
review_1_text: I had an iced latte for 35B while waiting for my car to be washed. The shop was filled with DVDs and old cassette tapes on display. The owner was also very friendly.
review_2_text: The coffee is strong and the taste is good. The containers are clean. The shop's decoration is classic and 90s-era. I think it would be a hit. The shopkeepers are friendly, polite, and the service is good. They smile and are cheerful. Overall, it's 5 stars.
review_3_text: The atmosphere is good, the coffee is delicious, and they also sell snacks to go with the coffee. The shop is very nicely decorated and the service is excellent.
review_4_text: I went to pick up coffee for a customer via Lalamove delivery service. It's my first time here, and the shop's interior is amazing!
review_5_text: This shop is classic, I love it.

name: poom poom coffee
review_1_text: Good coffee.
review_2_text: I only drank coffee, so I don't know the taste of anything else.

name: เพื่อนทนายคาเฟ่
ออน เดอะ เวย์ แคมป์ ปิ้ง ย่าง
review_1_text: Lively camping vibes under the stars! Rolled into this Chiang Mai hotspot to find it buzzing with a packed crowd soaking up the chill outdoor energy—perfect for knocking back three ice-cold Singha bottles while tunes float through the air, or dipping toes in the mini pool for that extra cool-down. No food needed when the atmosphere's this electric and inviting; total unwind win for easy evenings.
review_2_text:
Loved the service at this place
Food was great, music okay
review_3_text:
🎪 Restaurant Atmosphere

This restaurant has a chill, outdoor camping feel, with an open-air area. There are tables perfect for groups of friends or families in the evening to chat while grilling – it feels just like a relaxing picnic in a tent! 🍖✨

🌆 The highlight is the chill atmosphere rather than luxury, making it a great place to meet friends, have a date, or a small party. 👍
🍢 Food & Menu

🍖 The restaurant offers a wide variety of grilled items including pork, beef, chicken, and seafood, along with various side dishes. You can grill everything yourself in a DIY style. 👩‍🍳
🍺 The prices are affordable, perfect for those who want a BBQ party without breaking the bank.
🥗 There are side dishes, dipping sauces, and à la carte options available.
🍻 It's best to visit in the evening for the best atmosphere. 🌇
review_4_text:
The food is affordable and tasty, but expect a long wait (over an hour) as it's very crowded. The restrooms are clean, and there's live music, though it's located near the pool. The staff are friendly, although service is a bit slow due to the volume, but they'll happily accommodate any request.

On my second visit, the food arrived relatively quickly. The crispy morning glory salad was delicious, as was the oyster salad. The dipping sauces here are excellent; the seafood sauce is spicy and the sesame sauce is tasty. I personally wouldn't order the fried minced pork larb again.
review_5_text: This delicious outdoor camping-style BBQ pork restaurant is located by the main road and has parking. It's an all-you-can-eat buffet for 200 baht per person.

name: Thar Jao Rimping Restaurant/Coffee Shop/Bar
review_1_text: Freindly price, authentic food, welcoming staff, relaxing environment in which you can even take a nap. Yet, there is some mosquito issue. On the day I visit, I fell in love with the bands playing the most classical and soulful songs.
review_2_text: Lovely place to come for a coffee or a meal. Thai food only but really good, and friendly staff. Right by the river in a beautiful and calm setting
review_3_text: Enchanting place lovely fresh food great vibe with soft live music. Provided mossy spray but to be honest didn't have a problem with gentle breeze.

name: กาแฟคุณนาย
YOURMINE Coffee Roaster - Ping River
review_1_text:
A new coffee shop has opened under the underpass by the Ping River. It's the third branch of YourMine.
Prices start at 50 baht, with options for light, medium, and dark roasts. The coffee tastes great, and they roast their own beans. They also have imported beans to choose from. There are many fancy and delicious menu items.
For example, coconut foam latte, Black Forest, and matcha strawberry. If you're in the area, stop by often!
review_2_text:
A famous shop from Lampang.
Good coffee, with additional beans to choose from for 20-40 baht.
The Thai coconut tea is delicious.
View by the Ping River.
